title: Resilient Byzantine Agreement with Predictions
summary: This paper studies the Byzantine Agreement problem where the nodes have access to a predictor that flags nodes for suspicion of faulty (Byzantine) behavior. We focus on algorithmic resilience -- the maximum number of faulty nodes an algorithm can tolerate -- and present algorithms and impossibility results whose resilience depend on the accuracy of the predictor. As our first main result, we bring a complete characterization of the consistency--robustness trade-offs in both the non-authenticated and authenticated settings: for $n$ nodes and a parameter $α\in [0, 1]$, we present algorithms that tolerate up to $α\cdot n$ faulty nodes when the predictor is correct (consistency), and up to $\frac{1-α}{2} \cdot n - 1$ faulty nodes when the predictor is arbitrarily wrong (robustness); in the authenticated setting the robustness bound improves to $(1-α) \cdot n - 1$. These trade-offs are exactly tight as we show that one additional faulty node renders the problem impossible. Our second main result characterizes smoothness: the rate at which resilience degrades as the predictor becomes less accurate. We show that resilience linearly decreases in the number of wrong predictions as long as that number stays within a constant fraction of $n$. Concretely, in the non-authenticated setting each additional wrong prediction loses one unit of resilience, whereas in the authenticated setting the decline is halved since two wrong predictions are needed to lose one unit of resilience.

AI.tldr: 该论文研究了带预测器的拜占庭协议问题，完全刻画了一致性与鲁棒性的权衡关系，并证明算法韧性随预测误差呈线性退化（认证场景退化率减半）。所有结果均为紧界。
AI.motivation: 传统拜占庭协议要求容忍不超过1/3的恶意节点，存在过度保守的问题。若引入能标记可疑节点的预测器，理论上可突破这一限制，但预测器的准确性会动态影响算法的容错能力，需要建立预测精度与算法韧性之间的精确权衡关系。
AI.method: 通过构建最坏情况下的构造性算法和证明下界，分析了预测器正确/错误两种极端情况以及连续退化过程中的韧性变化。具体分析了三类参数：容忍故障节点数的一致性保证（预测器正确时α·n）、鲁棒性保证（预测器任意错误时）、以及平滑性（每单位预测误差对韧性的边际损失）。
AI.result: 得出三个核心结论：(1) 一致性-鲁棒性权衡：预测器正确时可容忍α·n个故障节点；预测器完全错误时，非认证场景下为(1-α)·n/2 - 1，认证场景下为(1-α)·n - 1；(2) 权衡上界紧致：故障节点数再多1个即不可解；(3) 平滑性分析：非认证场景每1次错误预测损失1单位韧性，认证场景需2次错误预测才损失1单位韧性，线性退化规律在错误数不超过常数比例n时成立。
AI.conclusion: 该研究给出了拜占庭协议中预测器辅助的完整理论框架，证明了算法的韧性严格依赖于预测精度，且在认证/非认证场景下呈现不同的线性退化特征。这些结果为设计实用化容错协议提供了精确的边界条件。

title: Theory-optimal Quantization Based on Flatness
summary: Post-training quantization has emerged as a widely adopted technique for compressing and accelerating the inference of Large Language Models (LLMs). The primary challenges in LLMs quantization stem from activation outliers, which significantly degrade model performance especially at lower bit precision. While recent approaches attempt to mitigate outliers through linear transformations across feature dimensions, our analysis reveals that the transformed weights and activations still exhibit persistent outlier patterns with concentrated magnitude distributions. In this paper, we first model the mathematical relationship between quantization error and outliers, and then introduce a new metric Flatness to quantify the distribution of outliers. Based on this, we derive the theoretical optimal solution with respect to Flatness. Building on these insights, we propose Bidirectional Diagonal Quantization (BDQ), a novel post-training quantization framework that effectively disperses outlier patterns through optimized matrix transformations. BDQ strategically distributes outlier magnitudes across matrix dimensions via learned diagonal operations. Extensive experiments demonstrate that BDQ establishes a new quantization benchmark. It achieves less than 1\% accuracy drop in W4A4 quantization on the LLaMA-3-8B model. In the more challenging W2A4KV16 experiment, compared to state-of-the-art approaches, BDQ reduces the performance gap by 39.1\% on the DeepSeek-R1-Distill-LLaMA-70B model.

AI.tldr: 本文针对LLM后训练量化中的激活异常值问题，提出基于"平坦度"度量的双向对角量化（BDQ）框架，通过优化的矩阵变换和学习的对角操作分散异常值分布，实现低位量化下模型性能的显著提升。
AI.motivation: 后训练量化是LLM压缩和加速推理的关键技术，但激活异常值问题严重损害模型性能，尤其在低位精度下。现有方法通过线性变换缓解异常值，但变换后的权重和激活仍存在持续的异常值模式和集中的幅度分布。
AI.method: 提出双向对角量化（BDQ）框架，通过学习的对角操作将异常值幅度战略性地分布在矩阵维度上，有效分散异常值模式。核心创新包括：（1）建模量化误差与异常值的数学关系；（2）提出"平坦度"（Flatness）度量指标量化异常值分布；（3）推导基于平坦度的理论最优解。
AI.result: BDQ在多个模型和量化配置上实现显著性能提升：W4A4量化精度损失<1%；W2A4KV16配置下性能差距降低39.1%。
AI.conclusion: BDQ框架在多个模型上建立了新的量化基准。LLaMA-3-8B在W4A4量化下精度下降小于1%；DeepSeek-R1-Distill-LLaMA-70B在W2A4KV16配置下相比SOTA方法性能差距减少39.1%。

title: OpenHealth Lake: Designing and testing a data lakehouse platform for health applications
summary: Data management can be a complex challenge in fields such as bioinformatics and health sciences, which continuously generate extensive heterogeneous datasets. In the context of collaborative global health initiatives, secure storage and sharing of data are crucial to support impactful research. However, the absence of a unified data management platform complicates efficient data exchange and governance within these initiatives. In this paper, we introduce the design process of OpenHealth Lake, a data management prototype platform based on a data lakehouse architecture, data federation, and the FAIR principles. The platform is designed using open-source tools, guided by system requirements identified in previously published studies and complemented by insights from the existing literature. The current prototype platform comprises a user-friendly website, an open API, Python and R packages, allowing users to interact with the platform in multiple ways. Through a user study that included participants with varying technical backgrounds, we showed that our proposed data management prototype is both usable and useful. Our prototype design showcases the adaptability, scalability, and reproducibility of a lakehouse system that can be used by any organisation. It is designed as a flexible and complementary approach that allows organisations to customise data management systems to their specific requirements and resources, including cloud-based or self-hosted storage choices.

AI.tldr: OpenHealth Lake是一个基于数据湖仓架构、联邦和FAIR原则的开源数据管理原型平台，旨在解决生物信息和健康科学领域的数据管理复杂性，通过多渠道访问方式和用户验证证明了其可用性和灵活性。
AI.motivation: 生物信息学和健康科学领域产生大量异质性数据集，现有缺乏统一的数据管理平台，导致协作性全球健康倡议中的数据安全存储、共享和治理面临挑战。
AI.method: 采用数据湖仓架构、数据联邦和FAIR原则设计平台，使用开源工具构建，包含用户友好的网站、开放API、Python和R软件包；通过纳入不同技术背景参与者的用户研究进行评估。
AI.result: 原型平台实现了多方式交互访问（网站/API/包）；用户研究表明平台具有可用性和实用性；证明了湖仓系统的适配性、可扩展性和可重现性。
AI.conclusion: OpenHealth Lake展示了一种灵活且可定制的数据管理解决方案，通过数据湖仓架构实现适配性、可扩展性和可重现性，支持云端或自托管存储选项，可被任何组织采用。

title: Position: Uncertainty Quantification in LLMs is Just Unsupervised Clustering
comment: Accepted by ICML 2026 Position Paper Track
summary: Uncertainty Quantification (UQ) is widely regarded as the primary safeguard for deploying Large Language Models (LLMs) in high-stakes domains. However, we argue that the field suffers from a category error: mainstream UQ methods for LLMs are just unsupervised clustering algorithms. We demonstrate that most current approaches inherently quantify the internal consistency of the model's generations rather than their external correctness. Consequently, current methods are fundamentally blind to factual reality and fail to detect ``confident hallucinations,'' where models exhibit high confidence in stable but incorrect answers. Therefore, the current UQ methods may create a deceptive sense of safety when deploying the models with uncertainty. In detail, we identify three critical pathologies resulting from this dependence on internal state: a hyperparameter sensitivity crisis that renders deployment unsafe, an internal evaluation cycle that conflates stability with truth, and a fundamental lack of ground truth that forces reliance on unstable proxy metrics to evaluate uncertainty. To resolve this impasse, we advocate for a paradigm shift to UQ and outline a roadmap for the research community to adopt better evaluation metrics and settings, implement mechanism changes for native uncertainty, and anchor verification in objective truth, ensuring that model confidence serves as a reliable proxy for reality.

AI.tldr: 本文是一篇立场论文（Position Paper, ICML），主张当前LLM的不确定性量化（UQ）方法在机制上等同于无监督聚类：它们度量的是模型生成结果的内部一致性，而非外部事实正确性，因而无法发现"自信的幻觉"（confident hallucination），反而在高风险部署中制造虚假的安全感。作者提出"从无监督启发式转向有监督保证"的范式转变，包含三支柱路线图：评估上从平均性能转向最坏情况鲁棒性（尾部风险评估、稳定性曲线AUSC、低FPR下的TPR）、机制上从事后启发式转向原生不确定性（保形预测CP的集合效率、后训练不确定性对齐）、以及以客观真理为锚（可验证环境单元测试、原子事实验证）。
AI.motivation: LLM在医疗、法律等高风险领域的部署依赖不确定性量化（UQ）作为主要安全护栏，主流方法涵盖熵类、语义熵（Semantic Entropy）、图结构类（如U-eigV）、语言化置信度（P(true)）等。但作者观察到模型正日益"对自己的幻觉充满信心"，使得当前不确定分数具有欺骗性。作者认为根源在于一个范畴错误（category error）：现有UQ方法在机制上与无监督聚类同构，只能测量数据点间的分离度，无法判断语义正确性。由此产生三个病理：①超参数敏感性危机（分数随采样温度、NLI阈值、采样数、提示词剧烈波动，最优参数在部署时未知，导致参数过拟合式"虚假进步"）；②内部评估循环（以自一致性为代理指标，等同于用"轮廓系数"评价聚类，把稳定误答当成低不确定性，从而漏检自信幻觉）；③缺乏ground truth的"裁判问题"（真实不确定性不可观测，只能用AUROC等"不确定性—正确性相关性"做代理，而开放任务中的正确性判定又依赖LLM裁判本身，噪声、昂贵且有偏，导致方法排名随正确性阈值τ不稳定）。
AI.method: 本文以"机制同构"为分析主线，用归纳（induction）方式逐类拆解主流UQ方法：（1）语义熵及其变体（SAE、SEN、KLE、SNNE、SDLG）——用NLI模型将采样序列聚成"答案类"，再在类上计算熵，等于显式聚类，分簇质量决定分数有效性；（2）图方法（SGC、GU、SGD、SeSE、GENUINE、D-UE等）——构建响应-响应/断言-响应图，以对称归一化拉普拉斯算子的特征值U_EigV=Σmax(0,1−λ_k)度量语义模态数，等价于谱聚类的内部簇效度指标（零特征值重数=连通分量数；实际稠密加权图靠小特征值与谱间隙推断有效簇数）；（3）语言化置信度（P(true)、CIn、CEl、SelfCheckGPT、UaIT、SelfReflect等）——模型被用作软聚类函数，把自身潜空间划分为高置信区域并做成员度检验。作者通过PCA可视化Qwen2.5-32B-Instruct在QASC上P(true)估计时的隐状态，展示高/低置信样本形成几何分离的信念簇。实验上，在QASC上计算不同UQ方法top 10%/20%/30%高不确定样本的Jaccard相似度（表1），显示方法间重叠极低（U_SE vs U_P(true) 仅0.080），证明方法间根本分歧；并引用正确性阈值τ变化导致AUROC与排名不稳定的结论（Liu et al., 2025b）。同时明确划定框架外方法：token级熵/困惑度、Deep Ensembles（跨模型分歧）、以及基于正确性标签训练监督分类器的方法（后者正是作者所倡导的外接有监督范式）。最后以五个"反对意见—回应"章节处理审稿式质疑（敏感性是特征而非缺陷；UQ应测信念而非真理；一致性足以代理正确性；生成任务无ground truth；规模可解决校准），并给出三支柱路线图：①评估：从平均性能转向最坏情况鲁棒性——借鉴Carlini等MIA第一性原理，把UQ定义为"告警/拒绝机制"，在极低FPR（如<0.1%）下测TPR，并在高/低不确定子集上单独计算AUROC；提出AUSC（性能对超参数连续扫描的积分）作为强制报告标准，惩罚仅在窄温度窗口有效的解码伪影；②机制：以保形预测（CP）作为应用层评测框架，在相同覆盖率（如90%）下比较预测集大小，"自信幻觉"表现为集合爆炸；通过RLHF等后训练做"不确定性对齐"，奖励生成前显式的颗粒化置信标记（"我很确定…" vs "可能…"），重塑潜空间使内部表示锚定到显式有效性主张；③接地：强制在可验证环境（代码执行、数学定值答案）通过"黄金标准单元测试"，再以原子事实验证（AFV）分解复杂叙述为原子断言，用搜索引擎、结构化知识库、Lean4形式化证明器与深度检索代理进行外部裁定，取代LLM裁判的循环论证。
AI.result: 核心结果是一系列诊断性论断与初步实证：（1）机制层面证明主流LLM UQ方法（语义熵族、图谱方法、P(true)族）分别在显式聚类、谱聚类与潜空间置信聚类三种形式上与无监督聚类同构，其分数只反映生成结果的内部一致性/语义模态分离度，与事实正确性无因果关联；（2）实证层面，QASC上Qwen2.5-32B的top-k高不确定样本Jaccard相似度极低（0.080–0.404），说明不同方法对"哪些样本不确定"存在根本分歧，无法交叉验证；P(true)隐状态的PCA可视化经验性地确认了内部信念簇的存在；（3）由聚类类比推导出三个必然病理：超参数敏感性危机、内部评估循环（自一致性≠正确性，AUROC被大量"易样本"主导而虚高，掩盖实例级失败）、以及因裁判缺陷递归而生的ground truth缺失（正确性函数噪声沿评测链传播，方法排名随τ漂移）；（4）由此得出"自信幻觉"是当前UQ范式的系统性盲区，形成幸存者偏差——最危险的稳定错误恰好通过内部指标检测；（5）提出可操作的替代方案：尾部风险TPR@低FPR、AUSC、CP集合大小、原子事实验证等作为truth-aware指标，可对自信幻觉形成实际惩罚（集合爆炸）。
AI.conclusion: 结论是当前LLM的不确定性量化本质上是无监督聚类，只能度量内部一致性而对外部事实正确性盲视，因而在高风险场景制造"欺骗性安全感"；社区必须放弃追求更好的无监督启发式，转向以客观真理为锚的有监督保证体系——最坏情况鲁棒性评估（尾部TPR@低FPR、AUSC）、原生不确定性机制（保形预测下的集合效率、后训练不确定性对齐）、以及基于原子事实验证的外部裁定，从而让模型置信度成为事实正确性的可靠代理，阻止过度自信模型在关键领域静默失效。

title: Interference-Aware Multi-Task Unlearning
summary: Machine unlearning aims to remove the contribution of designated training data from a trained model while preserving performance on the remaining data. Existing work mainly focuses on single-task settings, whereas modern models often operate in multi-task setups with shared backbones, where removing supervision for one task or instance can unintentionally affect others. We introduce multi-task unlearning with two settings: full-task unlearning, which removes a target instance from all tasks, and partial-task unlearning, which removes supervision only from selected tasks. We show that shared parameters couple the forget and retain sets, causing task-level interference on non-target tasks and instance-level interference on other instances. To address this issue, we propose an interference-aware framework that combines task-aware gradient projection, which constrains updates within task-specific subspaces, with instance-level gradient orthogonalization, which reduces conflicts between forget and retain signals. Experiments on two multi-task computer vision benchmarks across five tasks show that our method achieves effective unlearning while maintaining strong generalization, reducing UIS compared with the strongest baseline by 30.3% in full-task unlearning and 52.9% in partial-task unlearning.

AI.tldr: 本文提出"多任务机器遗忘"新问题与"干扰感知"框架（任务感知梯度投影 + 实例级梯度正交化），在 NYUv2/PASCAL 五个任务上，UIS 相比最强基线在完全任务遗忘下降 30.3%、部分任务遗忘下降 52.9%。
AI.motivation: 现代模型普遍采用共享骨干的多任务架构（共享表示或 LoRA 适配器），而现有机器遗忘方法几乎都针对单任务设定。当从某个实例移除某项监督时，共享参数会把遗忘信号的"溢出"传导到其他任务与其他实例，预实验显示直接把单任务遗忘方法套用到多任务模型上，retain 集性能最多下降 25%。论文因此：(1) 形式化多任务遗忘问题，区分 full-task unlearning（移除目标实例在所有任务上的监督）与 partial-task unlearning（仅移除选定任务上的监督），并按"实例×任务"两轴把数据划分为 forget 集 D_f 与三个保留子集 D_r^clean / D_r^inst / D_r^task；(2) 从理论上刻画干扰来源。
AI.method:
**问题形式化**：定义 D = {(x_i, t, y_i^(t))}，遗忘集为实例子集 X_f 与任务子集 T_f 的笛卡尔积，保留集分为 D_r^task（遗忘实例-保留任务）、D_r^inst（保留实例-遗忘任务）、D_r^clean（保留实例-保留任务）。

**理论分析（Theorem 1 / Corollary 1 / Proposition 1）**：在 L_r、L_f 二次可微、H_r 可逆、|D_r|≫|D_f|（ρ≪1）的假设下，θ* 局部极小化 L_r+ρL_f，可推得任意保留样本的损失变化 ℓ_{i,t}(θ_r)−ℓ_{i,t}(θ*) = ρ∇ℓ_{i,t}(θ_r)^T H_r^{-1} ∇L_f(θ_r) + O(ρ²)。即干扰本质是"经保留集曲率（Hessian）预条件"的梯度耦合，且任务级与实例级干扰由同一一阶项在 D_r^task 与 D_r^inst 上的聚合决定。进一步，Proposition 1 证明在固定一阶遗忘效果 ∇L_f^T δ = γ 的约束下，最优更新是 δ* = γ(H_r^{-1}g)^T g · H_r^{-1}g，直接沿遗忘梯度 δ = α∇L_f 除非该梯度恰为 H_r 的特征向量，否则次优——这解释了为何需要修正更新方向。

**方法（模型编辑视角 + 参数高效低秩更新）**：冻结预训练权重 W*，把遗忘表示为低秩编辑 W̃ = W* + BA^T（LoRA 因子 A∈R^{k×r}, B∈R^{d×r}）。
1. *任务感知梯度投影*：为每个任务 t 学一个正交基 U_t ∈ R^{r×s} 与投影器 P_t = U_t U_t^T，将该任务的梯度限制在任务特定子空间内（∇_A^(t) = ∇_A P_t，∇_B^(t) = ∇_B P_t），并以 Σ_{t≠t'}‖U_t^T U_t'‖_F² 正则化使各任务子空间相互正交。Theorem 2 证明投影后跨任务梯度的内积上界为 γ_{t,t'}·‖∇‖_F‖∇‖_F，抑制任务级干扰。
2. *实例级梯度正交化*：按 clean → inst → task 的顺序对遗忘梯度依次施加正交投影算子 Π^⊥，剔除与三个保留子集梯度冲突的分量。Theorem 3 给出正交后内积的精确上界 ε/(‖∇_r‖²+ε)·|⟨∇_f,∇_r⟩|（ε=0 时严格正交）。
3. *总体优化*：A ← A − η1 ∇_{A,r} + η2 ∇_{A,f}^⊥，B 同理；η1、η2 分别控制保留与遗忘强度（η1=0 时退化为纯遗忘）。最终将低秩更新合并回 W*。
AI.result:
**数据集/骨干**：NYUv2（SEG/DEP/NOR 三任务，像素级）与 PASCAL VOC（CLS/OD 两任务，图像级+实例级），骨干 ViT-L 与 Swin-L，共享 LoRA(rank 16)，10% 训练实例作为遗忘集，10 次随机划分取平均。**基线**：NegGrad+、Fisher、Influence、SSD、OrthoGrad、SCRUB，并以 Original/Retrain 为上下界参考；指标含各任务效用（mIoU/阈值精度/角度精度/mAP）、基于负损失的 MIA（unlearn-vs-val 的 ROC-AUC），以及综合指标 UIS（对"遗忘任务应贴近 Retrain、保留任务应贴近 Original"的参考行为在 retain/unlearn/val/MIA 四维上的归一化偏差均值，越小越好）。

**主要结果**：完全任务遗忘（FU）下本文 UIS 最低，NYUv2 由 28.6%（OrthoGrad）降至 22.0%，PASCAL 由 35.8%（SSD）降至 22.9%；部分任务遗忘（PU）下 NYUv2 平均由 24.6% 降至 13.4%（相对降 45.7%），PASCAL 由 44.1% 降至 18.1%（相对降 59.0%）；整体相对降幅分别为 30.3%（FU）与 52.9%（PU）。Swin-L 上同样最优（FU 31.2%→14.6%，PU 36.0%→11.2%，相对降 68.8%）。同时 Forget 集性能向 Retrain 对齐、Retain/Val 性能接近 Original、MIA AUC 接近 Retrain 参考。**消融**：去掉任务级约束（w/o Task）退化最严重（FU UIS 22.0%→164.4%，PU(SEG) 升至 76.6%，PU(NOR) 升至 58.7%）；去掉投影升至 30.8%；w/o Inst 与 w/o Clean 影响较小。**可扩展性**：遗忘比例从 10% 增至 50% 时本文 UIS 稳定在 20%–25%，而 SCRUB 在 50% 时超过 200%、NegGrad+ 常超 50%，说明基线是因 Ret/Val 崩塌而非单纯"忘得不够"。
AI.conclusion: 多任务共享骨干中的遗忘本质是一个双轴（实例×任务）耦合问题：删除某一任务-实例对会通过共享参数的 Hessian 预条件梯度耦合，溢出到非目标任务（任务级干扰）与其他实例（实例级干扰）；直接沿遗忘梯度更新在理论上次优。论文提出的干扰感知框架——任务感知梯度投影把更新限制在相互正交的任务子空间内、实例级梯度正交化按 clean/inst/task 顺序剔除与保留信号冲突的成分——在两个基准、五个任务上以统一 UIS 指标显著优于六种代表性基线，且在更大遗忘比例下更稳定。局限：仅在视觉基准验证，未来需扩展到文本、音频等任务定义与监督结构差异更大的领域；此外文中未涉及"遗忘整项任务能力"（X_f = X）的场景（仅作为讨论提及），且 Task 子空间维度 s、正则强度等超参的影响尚未深入分析。

title: Swimming with Whales: Analysis of Power Imbalances in Stake-Weighted Governance
summary: Voting methods weighted by stakes are the fundamental governance paradigm in Proof-of-Stake (PoS) blockchains. Such a paradigm is known to be prone to power distortions: a few users possessing large stakes may completely control decision making, even without owning the totality of the stakes. We study this phenomenon through the lens of computational social choice, focusing on the extent of power imbalances in stake-weighted voting when power is quantified using the Penrose-Banzhaf power index. Our work presents both analytical and empirical contributions. Analytically, we demonstrate that while a perfect alignment between power and relative stake ownership is generally unattainable, it can be approximated in expectation under specific conditions. Empirically, using data from a real-world on-chain governance system (Project Catalyst), we provide a more fine-grained understanding of the power imbalances that are likely to occur in current stake-weighted governance systems.

AI.tldr: 研究PoS区块链中质押加权投票机制下的权力失衡问题，采用Penrose-Banzhaf权力指数量化分析，证明了完美权力对齐的不可达性，同时指出在特定条件下可在期望意义下近似实现。
AI.motivation: PoS区块链中质押加权投票范式存在权力扭曲问题：少数大额质押用户可能完全控制决策，即便他们并不拥有全部质押。
AI.method: 使用Penrose-Banzhaf权力指数量化权力，运用计算社会选择理论框架进行分析；实证部分采用Project Catalyst的真实链上治理数据。
AI.result: 证明完美权力对齐一般不可达，但可在特定条件下近似实现；揭示了当前质押加权治理系统中实际发生的权力失衡程度。
AI.conclusion: 完美对齐权力与相对质押所有权通常不可实现，但在特定条件下可在期望意义下近似达成；通过Project Catalyst真实链上治理数据揭示了当前质押加权治理系统中可能发生的权力失衡问题的细粒度特征。

title: ClusterRAG: Cluster-Based Collaborative Filtering for Personalized Retrieval-Augmented Generation
comment: 17 pages, 2 figures, to be published in the proceedings of ACL 2026
summary: Personalized Retrieval-Augmented Generation (RAG) relies on accurately selecting user-relevant documents. In practice, existing RAG approaches often suffer from high retrieval costs and overlook that collaborative signals from similar users can enhance personalized generation for the current user. We propose ClusterRAG, a Cluster-Based Collaborative Filtering for Personalized Retrieval-Augmented Generation. ClusterRAG represents users through their profile documents, organizes users into semantically coherent clusters using density-based clustering, and performs retrieval at both the cluster and document levels via cluster-level similarity and fine-grained ranking. Extensive experiments on the LaMP benchmark demonstrate that jointly leveraging the target user's profile and profiles from top similar users consistently yields the best performance across diverse tasks. Further analysis shows that ClusterRAG integrates seamlessly with different dense retrievers and rankers, and remains effective when paired with both fine-tuned and zero-shot language models.

AI.tldr: ClusterRAG proposes a cluster-based collaborative filtering approach for personalized RAG, addressing high retrieval costs and user collaborative signals by organizing users into semantic clusters and performing dual-level retrieval, demonstrating consistent performance gains on the LaMP benchmark.
AI.motivation: Existing RAG approaches face high retrieval costs and fail to leverage collaborative signals from similar users for personalized generation.
AI.method: ClusterRAG uses density-based clustering to organize users into semantically coherent groups, then performs two-level retrieval: cluster-level similarity followed by fine-grained document-level ranking, combining the target user's profile with profiles from top similar users.
AI.result: Jointly leveraging the target user's profile and profiles from top similar users consistently achieved the best performance across diverse tasks on the LaMP benchmark.
AI.conclusion: ClusterRAG was validated on the LaMP benchmark, showing effective integration with various dense retrievers, rankers, and both fine-tuned and zero-shot language models.

title: Provable Fairness Repair for Deep Neural Networks
comment: 15 pages, 6 figures, 7 tables. full version of the paper accepted by ASE 2025
summary: Deep neural networks (DNNs) are suffering from ethical issues such as individual discrimination. In response, extensive NN repair techniques have been developed to adjust models and mitigate such undesired behaviors. However, existing fairness repair methods are typically data-centric, which often lack provable guarantees and generalization to unseen samples. To overcome these limitations, we propose ProF, a novel fairness repair framework with provable guarantees. The key intuition of ProF is to leverage interval bound propagation (a widely used NN verification technique) to soundly capture model outputs over the whole set $S(\mathbf{x})$ around a biased sample $\mathbf{x}$. The derived bounds are utilized to guide fairness repair which encourages the model to produce consistent outputs on $S(\mathbf{x})$. Specifically, we integrate fairness constraints and model modifications into a unified constraint-solving formulation, which can be transformed to a Mixed-Integer Linear Programming (MILP) problem solvable by off-the-shelf solvers. The solution to the MILP problem effectively induces a repaired model with guaranteed fairness over the whole set $S(\mathbf{x})$. We evaluate ProF on four widely used benchmark datasets and demonstrate that it achieves provable fairness repair, with generalization of up to 95.93\% on full datasets and 93.16\% on the entire input space. Notably, ProF can be easily configured to support multiple sensitive attributes and more practical fairness definitions, while providing provable repair guarantees and delivering around 90\% fairness improvement. Our code is available at https://github.com/nninjn/ProF.

AI.tldr: ProF 是一个面向 DNN 个体公平性（individual fairness）的"可证明修复"框架：先用区间边界传播（IBP）在敏感属性相似集 S(x) 上对特征提取器做渐进式边界收缩校准，再用符号边界（symbolic bounds）+ 拉格朗日对偶把"公平约束 + 末层参数修改"统一编码成 MILP，用 Gurobi 求解，从而得到在 S(x) 上有确定性公平保证的修复模型。在 Adult/Compas/German/Bank 四个数据集上，Certified Unfair Rate 全部降为 0，IDI-D/IDI-S 相对下降 95.93%/93.16%（最优基线 GRFT 仅 71.44%/72.67%），平均精度损失 2.27%，平均耗时约 18 秒，并支持多敏感属性与松弛公平定义。
AI.motivation: DNN 在犯罪风险评估、公共政策、信用评分等敏感领域会产生个体歧视（仅敏感属性不同的相似个体得到不同预测）。现有的公平性测试与验证工作只能发现/证明不公平，却无法给出修复方案；已有的修复方法（CARE、RUNNER、IDNN、NeuFair、GRFT、翻转微调等）存在两个根本局限：(1) 其修复手段（启发式算法、梯度式参数调优、神经元隔离）本质上是经验性的，缺乏确定性保证，即使在用于修复的歧视样本对上也未必满足公平约束；(2) 它们只依赖 S(x) 中有限采样得到的歧视对 ⟨x, x'⟩ 进行修复，只能覆盖 S(x) 的有限区域，修复后的模型在未见/未采样输入上仍可能不公平，泛化性差。此外，重训练式修复成本高、且在模型来自第三方或训练数据私有时不可行。因此需要一个既可给出可证明保证、又能泛化到未见样本的公平修复方法。
AI.method:
ProF 将 DNN 切分为前 L-1 层特征提取器 f_{1:L} 与末层分类器 f_L，包含两个核心组件：
(1) 有偏特征提取器校准（Alg.1）：对每个修复样本 x^i，用 auto-LiRPA 的区间边界传播（IBP）在其相似集 S(x^i) 上计算特征空间的 concrete bounds [h^i, h^i]，得到轴对齐超矩形以刻画真实特征集 H^i；将 ‖h^i - h^i‖_1 与初始值的比值作为归一化公平损失 L_fair（在 [0,1]，0 表示相似个体特征完全一致），与在少量保留集 D_c 上计算的 BCE 损失 L_bce 相加，通过 T=200 轮、lr=0.001 的梯度下降迭代收缩具体边界，从而缓解特征差异（不提供保证，但显著减小后续求解负担）。
(2) 基于符号边界的可证明修复：naive 做法是直接用 concrete bounds 构造约束求解问题，但具体边界因区间算术的神经元独立性假设而过于保守，会导致末层被过度修改。为此，ProF 用 auto-LiRPA 计算 h 与 x 之间的线性边界并合成符号边界，把特征集刻画为多面体 Ĥ^i = {h | α^≤x+β^≤ ≤ h ≤ α^≥x+β^≥, S_L(x^i) ≤ x ≤ S_U(x^i)}，比超矩形更紧致地逼近 H^i。修复问题为 min ‖ΔW‖_1 + ‖Δb‖_1，s.t. min_{h∈Ĥ^i} f̃_L(h) ≥ 0 ∨ max_{h∈Ĥ^i} f̃_L(h) < 0。由于约束中含非线性项 ΔW·h 且 Ĥ^i 非轴对齐，ProF 借助拉格朗日对偶/强对偶：把 min_{h∈Ĥ^i}(W+ΔW)h 重写为 LP min_p C^T p s.t. A_i p ≤ D_i（p=(h,x)，A_i、D_i 为常数矩阵），构造对偶问题 max_{λ_i≥0} -λ_i^T D_i s.t. A_i^T λ_i = -C，从而解耦 ΔW 与 h；上界用另一组对偶变量 η_i 构造。最后通过 Big-M 方法与二元变量 Z_i 将析取约束转成合取，得到可由 Gurobi 求解的 MILP（Alg.2）。论文另给出多分类扩展（向量上下界 + one-hot 编码的 Z_i）。
AI.result:
四个基准数据集（Adult、Compas、German Credit、Bank Marketing）上的修复模型来自 Fairify/FairQuant 的有偏 DNN，修复集 D_r 从训练集随机取 100 个样本，另给 D_c 保留集维持性能。主要结果：
- RQ1（单敏感属性修复）：ProF 在所有设置下 CUR = 0%，实现可证明的公平修复；基线（FLIP/CARE/GRFT）仅降低约 60–70% 的 CUR 且无理论保证。泛化性上，IDI-D 平均降至 0.43%（相对下降 95.93%），IDI-S（10 万随机样本）降至 0.33%（相对下降 93.16%），而最佳基线 GRFT 分别为 71.44% 与 72.67%。精度方面，ProF 平均损失 2.27%（FLIP 1.81%、CARE 2.37%、GRFT 3.32%），CARE/GRFT 在 Compas-Age 上精度掉近 10%。效率上，ProF 平均 18 秒/设置，优于 CARE 的 244 秒（PSO），与 FLIP/GRFT（约 1 秒）同量级但可接受。
- RQ2（多敏感属性与更实际的公平定义）：多属性组合修复下 ProF 仍达 CUR = 0%，IDI-D/IDI-S 平均相对下降 92.97%/89.67%，FLIP/GRFT 仅 63.99%–69.46%；松弛相似性定义（φ_A、φ_B、φ_G 等非敏感属性容差）下 FLIP 反而可能变差（-3.57%），GRFT 约 70%，ProF 达 100% CUR 消除、IDI-D/IDI-S 相对下降 92.17%/92.27%，精度损失 2.90%（GRFT 5.03%）。
- RQ3（第三方公平性测试框架评估）：在 ADF、EIDIG、NeuronFair、GRFT 四个测试框架下，ProF 的 N_repair/N_ori 平均比值为 0.06、0.12、0.05、0.16，即减少约 84%–95% 的 IDI；基线最好仅 GRFT 约 70%，FLIP/CARE 在 German 数据集上甚至出现比值 >1（修复后更不公平）。
- RQ4（消融）：Step 1 中 L_fair 随迭代稳定下降而 L_bce 保持平稳，说明边界收缩有效且知识基本保留；Step 2 中符号边界版比 naive 具体界版本精度更高、MILP 最优目标值更小，验证符号边界的紧致性收益。
AI.conclusion: ProF 首次为 DNN 个体公平性修复提供了确定性的可证明保证：通过 IBP 对整个相似集 S(x) 做可靠的输出/特征刻画并做渐进式边界收缩校准，再以合成符号边界把公平约束与末层参数修改统一为约束求解问题，用拉格朗日强对偶消除非线性项、用 Big-M 与整数变量处理析取，最终构造可由现成 MILP 求解器（Gurobi）求解的精确模型，其解在 S(x^i) 上保证输出一致性，且因符号界更紧致，最优修改量严格不劣于具体界版本。实验证明其在可证明性、泛化性（相对不公平率下降 90%+）、精度保持与可扩展配置（多敏感属性、松弛公平定义、多分类）上均显著优于 FLIP、CARE、GRFT 等最先进方法。局限性方面：MILP 本质 NP-hard，复杂度随整数变量数指数增长（但本文整数变量数与模型规模无关，可缓解爆炸）；仅要求末层为线性层故可扩展到更复杂模型；Step 1 的边界收缩是公平专用（鲁棒性修复要求扰动输入全部正确分类），Step 2 的对偶与析取处理技术可迁移至鲁棒性修复，因而 ProF 目前仍局限于公平性场景。代码开源于 https://github.com/nninjn/ProF。

title: PROWL: Prioritized Regret-Driven Optimization for World Model Learning
summary: Modern action-conditioned video world models achieve strong short-horizon visual realism, yet remain unreliable on rare, interaction-critical transitions that dominate downstream planning and policy performance. Because passive demonstration data systematically under-samples these high-impact regimes, improving robustness requires actively eliciting model failures rather than relying on their natural occurrence. We introduce a KL-constrained adversarial curriculum in which a policy is trained to expose high-error trajectories of a diffusion-based world model while remaining close to the behavior distribution. The world model is continuously fine-tuned on these adversarially discovered trajectories, yielding an adversarial training loop that converts rare failures into a stable, near-distribution training signal without drifting into out-of-distribution exploitation. To maintain pressure on unresolved weaknesses as the model improves, we propose a Prioritized Adversarial Trajectory (PAT) buffer that re-ranks trajectories based on prediction error, action fidelity, and learning progress, focusing training on unresolved failure modes rather than repeatedly revisiting solved cases. We implement our approach in the MineRL framework and evaluate it on held-out out-of-distribution trajectories; PROWL improves robustness over models trained on passive data alone, reveals reward-hacking behaviors under weak behavioral constraints, and demonstrates that effective adversarial world-model training critically depends on balancing exploratory failure discovery with explicit behavioral regularization. Our results suggest that scalable world models benefit not only from larger datasets, but also from selectively generating informative training data.

AI.tldr: 本文针对视频世界模型在罕见、高风险交互场景中可靠性不足的问题，提出PROWL方法：通过KL约束的对抗课程和优先级对抗轨迹缓冲，在保持行为分布的同时主动发现并利用模型预测错误进行对抗训练，提升世界模型的鲁棒性。
AI.motivation: 被动演示数据系统性低估了高影响交互区域（rare, interaction-critical transitions），导致世界模型在下游规划和策略性能中表现不可靠。现有方法依赖自然发生的失败样本，缺乏主动暴露模型弱点的机制。
AI.method: 1) KL约束的对抗课程：训练策略以暴露扩散世界模型的高误差轨迹，同时保持与行为分布的接近；2) 连续微调：世界模型在对抗发现的轨迹上持续微调；3) PAT缓冲：基于预测误差、动作保真度和学习进度重新排序轨迹，聚焦未解决的失败模式。
AI.result: 在MineRL环境中，PROWL相比纯被动数据训练的模型提升了鲁棒性，揭示了弱行为约束下的reward-hacking行为，证明了探索性失败发现与显式行为正则化平衡的重要性。
AI.conclusion: 可扩展的世界模型不仅受益于更大规模数据集，更需要选择性生成信息性训练数据。

title: Fine-tuning language encoding models on slow fMRI improves prediction for fast ECoG
summary: Neuroscientists have recently turned to intracranial brain recording methods, like electrocorticography (ECoG), for human experiments because of the fine spatial and temporal resolution that they afford. Models trained on this data, however, are fundamentally restricted by the patient populations that can receive the implants necessary for recording. We propose using non-invasive fMRI to bridge the gap in training data. Using spoken language representations fine-tuned on fMRI, we build encoding models of ECoG. These representations showed improved prediction performance in ECoG, even though the temporal resolution of fMRI is two orders of magnitude worse. Prediction improved in frequency bands well beyond what is directly measured in fMRI. Next, to test the procedure's generalization ability, we fine-tuned models on fMRI responses that were temporally downsampled by a factor of 2. Despite the loss in resolution, these models were able to predict fMRI and ECoG responses at levels comparable to the original fMRI-tuned models. Finally, we showed that ECoG performance steadily scales with the amount of fMRI-tuning data. Our results show that "slow" data like fMRI can be a valuable resource for building better models of "fast" brain data like ECoG. In the future, integrating across multiple recording methods may further improve performance in other applications, like decoding.

AI.tldr: 研究证明非侵入性fMRI数据可用于训练预测侵入性ECoG脑活动的模型，实现跨模态迁移学习，揭示"慢"脑数据对"快"脑数据的训练价值。
AI.motivation: ECoG等侵入性脑记录方法受限于可接受植入的患者群体，需要寻找替代数据来源来扩展训练数据。
AI.method: 使用在fMRI上微调的语音表征来构建ECoG编码模型；通过时间下采样测试泛化能力；测试不同fMRI数据量下的扩展性。
AI.result: fMRI微调表征在ECoG预测中表现改善，即便fMRI时间分辨率低两个数量级；预测改善延伸至fMRI直接测量范围之外的频段；时间下采样2倍的模型性能与原始模型相当；ECoG性能随fMRI调优数据量增加而稳定扩展。
AI.conclusion: "慢"数据（如fMRI）可用于构建更好的"快"脑数据（如ECoG）模型；跨记录方法整合可能进一步改善解码等应用的性能。

title: Embedding by Elicitation: Dynamic Representations for Bayesian Optimization of System Prompts
summary: System prompts are a central control mechanism in modern AI systems, shaping behavior across conversations, tasks, and user populations. Yet they are difficult to tune when feedback is available only as aggregate metrics rather than per-example labels, failures, or critiques. We study this aggregate feedback setting as sample-constrained black-box optimization over discrete, variable-length text. We introduce ReElicit, a Bayesian optimization framework based on \emph{embedding by elicitation}. Given a task description, previously evaluated prompts, and scalar scores, an LLM elicits a compact, interpretable feature space and maps prompts into it. Leveraging a probabilistic Gaussian process surrogate, an acquisition function then selects target feature vectors, which the LLM realizes and refines into deployable system prompts. Re-eliciting the feature space as new evaluations arrive lets the representation adapt to the observed prompt-score history. We evaluate the setting using offline benchmark accuracy as a controlled aggregate proxy: the optimizer observes one scalar score per prompt and no per-example labels, errors, or critiques. Across ten system prompt optimization tasks with a 30 total evaluation budget, ReElicit achieves the strongest aggregate performance profile among representative aggregate-only prompt-optimization baselines. These results suggest that LLMs can serve as adaptive semantic representation builders, not only prompt generators, for Bayesian optimization over natural-language artifacts.

AI.tldr: ReElicit 把"仅有标量聚合反馈的系统提示词调优"形式化为离散、变长文本上的样本受限黑盒优化问题。核心思想是"embedding by elicitation"：让 LLM 依据任务描述与提示词-分数历史启发式地构造一个紧凑、可解释的语义特征空间（[0,1]^d，d 通常为 2–3），把提示词映射到该空间，在其中用 GP 代理模型 + 采集函数做贝叶斯优化，再由 LLM 将选中的目标特征向量"实现"为可部署的硬提示词，并用特征差距反馈迭代精修。10 个基准任务、30 次目标模型评估预算下，ReElicit 在所有任务上数值最优或与最优无统计差异，整体胜平率最高；理论部分给出可达性上界 f(x*)−f(x_t) ≤ δ + 2BLη_t。
AI.motivation: 系统提示词是现代 AI 系统的核心控制机制，但当部署反馈只表现为总体标量指标（任务完成率、安全事件率、满意度、留存等）而非逐样本标签、错误轨迹或文本批注时，提示词调优无法再视为"有监督的提示词改写"，而变成了离散变长自然语言上的样本受限黑盒优化。现有自动提示词优化（APO）方法（ProTeGi、TextGrad、GEPA 等）普遍依赖实例级细粒度反馈；聚合型方法（APE、OPRO、PromptBreeder）虽只用标量，但缺乏显式的不确定性建模与探索—利用权衡。BO 是标量昂贵反馈的天然工具，但其前提是固定低维连续域 + 可逆的逆映射，而提示词既离散、变长又语义结构化：手工核需在文本上枚举/采样，学习式潜空间需辅助数据与训练好的编码器—解码器，现成稠密文本嵌入在极少样本下维度灾难且解码需额外训练器。论文因此需要（i）紧凑、可支撑代理建模与采集优化的语义空间，（ii）从连续点回到可部署文本的机制。
AI.method:
设定：f: X→R 为提示词到标量分数的映射，预算 N=qT，批大小 q，采用批量 BO。

ReElicit 每轮四阶段：
1) 特征启发（DefineFeatures）：仅此子程序能看到分数，比较 TOP/BOTTOM 提示词的差异，提出 2–3 个具因果机制、彼此独立、值域 [0,1] 的任务相关语义轴（如答案格式控制、校准不确定性、显式推理结构、证据使用、字面/隐喻对比等）；ExtractFeatures 只看提示词内容与特征定义、不看分数，避免结果泄漏坐标。
2) 特征集选择：每轮并行启发 K=5 组特征，用 LOO-CV（n<10）或 10 折 CV 的 MSE 择优；t>1 时把上一轮在册特征集在扩大的历史上重新抽取并作为候选一并打分。
3) 嵌入空间中的 BO：BoTorch SingleTaskGP（Matern 5/2 ARD、Normalize/Standardize 变换、精确边际似然拟合）在嵌入观测上重拟合，用 qLogNoisyExpectedImprovement（20 重启、512 采样）在 [0,1]^d 上选 q 个目标特征向量。
4) 实现与精修：并行生成 M/2 个候选提示词，取特征距离最近者，再按特征差距绝对值降序做 M/2 步"特征引导精修"（只改写不重写、保留已对齐部分、ℓ2 距离 ≤ τ=0.1 提前停止），最后评估并更新历史。

信息访问控制表：DefineFeatures 见 (提示词, 分数, 特征)；ExtractFeatures 见 (提示词, 特征) 不见分数；生成与精修见全部。

理论（可达性分析）：设存在注入的 oracle 嵌入 g* 与平稳 latent 核 k_Z；假设 1) f 属 oracle 核的 RKHS 且范数 ≤B；假设 2) latent 特征映射 φ 关于 latent 距离 Lipschitz（L）；假设 3) 第 t 轮启发嵌入与 oracle 嵌入误差 ≤ η_t。定义 f_t 为通过 g_t 可表示且范数 ≤B 的最佳一致逼近。定理 1：若 x_t 对 f_t 为 δ-次优，则 f(x*)−f(x_t) ≤ δ + 2BLη_t，即优化误差加表征误差；δ 为嵌入内优化误差，2BLη_t 为通过非 oracle 嵌入优化所付的"表征代价"，其随 η_t 减小而收紧——这正是"再启发"降低 η_t 的理论依据（证明见附录 A，含 Lemma 1 用 Cauchy–Schwarz 与 Lipschitz 性给出逐点差 |f−f_t| ≤ BLη_t）。

实验设置：10 个任务（GSM8K 500 题、MMLU 500 题、BBH 8 任务各 250 题：Boolean Expressions、Disambiguation QA、Tracking Shuffled Objects、Penguins in a Table、Causal Judgement、Formal Fallacies、Snarks、Hyperbaton）；N=30、q=5、T=6（第 1 批为共享种子集 D0，共 5 轮优化）；30 个随机种子，报 95% CI。优化器 LLM 为 Llama 3.3 70B Instruct，目标 LLM 为 Llama 3.1 8B Instruct，仅通过 lm-eval 零样本贪心解码返回聚合准确率。基线为聚合反馈改造版：APE-style 采样、OPRO（按分数排序历史条件生成）、PromptBreeder（种群 20，变异+重组）、TextGrad-style 批评-改写；所有方法共享任务上下文、D0、标量历史与评估预算，并共享分层子采样工具（前 25%/后 25%/中间 50% 随机，n_max=12）。效率口径为目标模型评估次数，而非优化器侧 LLM 调用总量。
AI.result:
主结果（表 1、2）：ReElicit 在 10 个任务上均为数值最优或与最优无显著差异（如 GSM8K 0.833±0.006、Boolean Expr 0.768±0.009、Snarks 0.551±0.009、Hyperbaton 0.796±0.006、Causal Judg. 0.584±0.005、Formal Fall. 0.581±0.007、Penguins 0.441±0.010）；平均成对胜平率 0.81，高于 APE 0.56、OPRO 0.58、PromptBreeder 0.40、TextGrad 0.49（相对各基线 0.78/0.79/0.85/0.82）。优势主要体现在 MMLU（0.571 vs 0.508–0.595）与 Penguins/Snarks 上。

组件诊断：重复抽取稳定性高（<4% 特征值 std>0.05，0.7% >0.1）；跨轮线性 CKA 均值 0.81（高但非 1，说明保守适配）；动态特征相比静态初始特征显著降低 GP CV MSE，且均优于均值预测基线；最终特征与 BO 目标的 ℓ2 差距越小，下一轮改进概率越高（精修轨迹显示 ℓ2 差距随步数下降）；选中特征维度通常 2–3 并随迭代略增（Snarks 案例 d 从 2→3，CV MSE 0.0612→0.0199→0.0119）。

消融（表 3，配对 t 检验，汇总 task-seed）：No Refinement −0.009±0.004（p<0.001）、No BO（改为特征空间均匀采样）−0.007±0.003（p<0.001）为显著负贡献；Static Features −0.003±0.004（p=0.168）、Independent Extraction −0.002±0.004（p=0.329）不显著。即特征差距精修与采集函数引导贡献最大，动态再启发主要改善代理模型拟合结构，联合抽取（b=10）在历史最大时每特征集仅需 3 次 LLM 调用而非 25 次，且不损害最终性能。
AI.conclusion:
结论与定位：论文把"仅聚合反馈的系统提示词调优"重述为黑盒优化并提出 ReElicit——LLM 不只是提示词生成器，还能充当自适应的语义表征构建者，在紧凑、可解释、随证据演化的语义坐标空间里做 BO，再把优化点实现为可部署硬提示词。实验支持该表示兼具可抽取性（稳定）、可预测性（改善 GP 拟合）与可实现性（目标差距可行动），并指出动态再启发通过降低表征误差 η_t 收紧可达性上界。

局限：聚合反馈用离线基准准确率代理，仅是用户满意度、留存、安全事件率等部署目标的代理，验证真实目标需要线上系统与变化的用户群体；与相关 APO/BO 方法（软提示、指令-示例程序空间、候选池、固定嵌入、多保真子集）接口不同，本文是聚合-only 硬提示词设定内的"同类比较"而非通用排行榜；效率主张仅限目标评估次数，优化器侧 LLM 调用开销未计入。

可推广性：只要候选可用文本描述、约束可用文本表达、评估是昂贵的标量测量，该"文本可描述结构化制品"的配方即可迁移，原则上可用多模态模型扩展到图像/音视频，以及智能体工具使用指令、评估量规等。

风险与建议：方法可能优化有害目标或过优化错配指标，削弱未被测量的安全、公平、隐私与鲁棒性约束；部署时应把指标设计视为安全问题的一部分，配合人工复核、留出评估、安全相关切片、鲁棒性检查，以及"指标增益不来自违反被省略约束"的显式测试。论文实验全为离线基准，未向用户部署优化后的提示词。

title: EngiAI: A Multi-Agent Framework and Benchmark Suite for LLM-Driven Engineering Design
comment: 26 pages, 10 figures, to be published at IDETC 2026
summary: Large Language Model (LLM) agents are increasingly applied to engineering design tasks, yet existing evaluation frameworks do not adequately address multi-agent systems that combine simulation, retrieval, and manufacturing preparation. We introduce a benchmark suite with three evaluation dimensions: (1) a workflow benchmark with seven prompt styles targeting distinct cognitive demands-including direct tool use, semantic disambiguation, conditional branching, and working-memory tasks; (2) a Retrieval-Augmented Generation (RAG) benchmark with gated scoring isolating retrieval contributions to parameter selection; and (3) an High Performance Computing (HPC) benchmark evaluating end-to-end ML training orchestration on a SLURM cluster. Alongside the benchmark we present EngiAI, a Multi-Agent System (MAS) reference implementation built on LangGraph that operationalizes the benchmark by coordinating seven specialized agents through a supervisor architecture, unifying topology optimization, document retrieval, HPC job orchestration, and 3D printer control. Across four LLM backends and two EngiBench problems, proprietary models achieve 96-97% average task completion on Beams2D, while open-source 4B-parameter models reach 55-78%, with clear generational improvement. Conditional branching proves most challenging, with task completion dropping to 20-53% for the conditional style on Photonics2D. RAG gating confirms near-perfect retrieval-augmented scores ($\approx 1.0$) versus near-zero without retrieval, validating the evaluation design. On HPC orchestration, one model completes all pipeline steps in 100% of runs while another drops to 50%, revealing that multi-step instruction following degrades over long-running workflows.

AI.tldr: 该论文提出了一个针对LLM多智能体工程设计系统的基准测试套件(EngiBench)，包含工作流、RAG和HPC三个评估维度，并配套提供EngiAI参考实现。实验表明专有模型表现优异(96-97%)，条件分支任务最具挑战性，检索增强对参数选择至关重要，长工作流中的多步骤指令遵循会退化。
AI.motivation: 大型语言模型智能体在工程设计任务中的应用日益增多，但现有评估框架未能充分涵盖结合仿真、检索和制造准备的多智能体系统，缺乏系统性的评估方法。
AI.method: 构建了包含三个评估维度的基准测试套件：(1) 工作流基准测试，含七种提示风格针对不同认知需求；(2) RAG基准测试，通过门控评分隔离检索贡献；(3) HPC基准测试，评估SLURM集群上的端到端ML训练编排。同时提出基于LangGraph构建的EngiAI多智能体系统参考实现，通过监督者架构协调七个专业智能体。
AI.result: 专有模型在Beams2D上达到96-97%的平均任务完成率，而4B参数开源模型为55-78%，存在明显的代际改进。条件分支最具挑战性，Photonics2D上完成率降至20-53%。RAG门控验证了近乎完美的检索增强分数(~1.0)对比无检索时的近零分数。HPC编排中，一模型100%完成所有步骤，另一模型降至50%。
AI.conclusion: 多步骤指令遵循在长运行工作流中会退化。条件分支是最具挑战性的任务类型。该基准测试有效验证了评估设计的合理性，为工程设计领域的LLM多智能体系统提供了系统性评测方案。

title: Agentic GraphRAG: Navigating Unstructured Financial Data with Collaborative AI
summary: We present a collaborative agentic GraphRAG framework for expert analysis of commercial registry data. Public registries are often formally accessible, yet difficult to use in practice because they combine structured records with large volumes of unstructured legal text. This limits conventional keyword and vector-only retrieval, especially for multi-hop, temporal, and entity-centric investigations. Our approach builds a Neo4j knowledge graph through a three-phase pipeline: (i) deterministic ingestion of strong nodes from verified structured fields, (ii) LLM-based extraction of weak nodes from unstructured notices, and (iii) deterministic identity resolution and deduplication. On top of this graph, we introduce an analytical modular agent that integrates zero-shot intent routing, a bounded reflection loop, secure tool-mediated graph access, and state-aware response synthesis. A human-in-the-loop dashboard exposes evidence and execution traces to support transparency and auditability. We evaluate the framework on the Swiss Official Gazette of Commerce, a multilingual corpus of more than seven million publications over seven years. We further contribute a multi-tier evaluation protocol covering entity-resolution precision, tool-routing behavior, answer quality, and multi-turn conversational performance. Across automated, human-curated, and conversational benchmarks, the proposed agentic GraphRAG system consistently outperforms a standard agentic vector-RAG baseline, with strong gains in correctness, answer relevance, information recall, turn success rate, and context carryover accuracy. The architecture is modular, reproducible, and transferable to other commercial gazettes and public-sector registry systems.

AI.tldr: 本文提出一种用于商业注册数据专家分析的协作式智能体GraphRAG框架，通过Neo4j知识图谱三阶段构建（确定性结构化摄取、LLM非结构化提取、身份解析去重）结合模块化智能体（零样本路由、有限反射、安全图访问、状态合成）实现复杂查询处理，在瑞士700万+商业公报数据集上验证了相对于向量RAG的显著性能提升。
AI.motivation: 公共注册系统虽正式可访问，但因将结构化记录与非结构化法律文本混合而难以实际使用，传统关键词和纯向量检索在多跳、时序及实体中心调查场景中存在明显局限。
AI.method: 提出三阶段流水线构建Neo4j知识图谱：(i)确定性摄取结构化强节点；(ii)基于LLM从非结构化通知中提取弱节点；(iii)确定性身份解析与去重。在此基础上构建分析模块化智能体，集成零样本意图路由、有限反射循环、安全工具介导的图访问及状态感知响应合成，并引入人类在环仪表板以支持可解释性和审计追踪。
AI.result: 在瑞士官方商业公报（超过700万份七年多的多语言出版物）上验证了该框架。构建了涵盖实体解析精度、工具路由行为、答案质量及多轮对话性能的多层评估协议。实验表明，该智能体GraphRAG系统在自动化、人工策划及对话基准测试中均显著优于标准智能体向量RAG基线，在正确性、答案相关性、信息召回率、轮次成功率及上下文保持准确性方面均有大幅提升。
AI.conclusion: 该架构具有模块化、可复现且可迁移的特性，可应用于其他商业公报及公共部门注册系统。该研究为复杂商业注册数据的智能分析提供了新的技术路径。

title: Characterizing Real-World Bugs in Tile Programs for Automated Bug Detection
comment: In Proceedings of the 35th ACM SIGSOFT International Symposium on Software Testing and Analysis (ISSTA 2026)
summary: Tile-based programming frameworks are increasingly adopted to write high-performance GPU kernels in domains such as deep learning and scientific computing. While these frameworks enhance productivity and hardware utilization, their multi-stage compilation pipelines introduce distinct code generation bugs that are tightly coupled to input shapes, data types, and backend targets. These bugs often manifest as silent correctness or performance issues, making them difficult to detect using existing compiler testing tools. Additionally, the unique programming conventions of tile domain-specific languages complicate root cause identification, while fixing such bugs demands specialized knowledge of tile abstractions and compilation pipelines. Despite the growing adoption of tile-based systems, their code generation bugs remain largely unexplored. This paper presents the first systematic study of tile-program code generation bugs. We curate 401 bug reports from GitHub and identify 301 tile-program codegen bugs for analysis, categorizing the root causes, symptoms, input patterns, test oracles that trigger these bugs, and the strategies used to fix bugs. Our study provides foundational insights for building debugging, testing, and repair tools tailored to tile-based compiler infrastructures.

AI.tldr: 本文首次系统性地研究了基于瓦片(tile)编程框架中的代码生成bug。研究团队从GitHub收集了401个bug报告，识别出301个tile程序代码生成bug进行深入分析，涵盖了bug的根因、症状、输入模式、触发测试预言机以及修复策略等方面。研究结果为构建专门针对tile基编译器基础设施的调试、测试和修复工具提供了基础性见解。
AI.motivation: Tile-based programming frameworks are increasingly adopted for high-performance GPU kernels in deep learning and scientific computing, but their multi-stage compilation pipelines introduce code generation bugs tightly coupled to input shapes, data types, and backend targets. These bugs manifest as silent correctness or performance issues with unique programming conventions that complicate root cause identification, making existing compiler testing tools inadequate.
AI.method: Systematic study of tile-program code generation bugs by curating 401 bug reports from GitHub and identifying 301 tile-program codegen bugs for analysis. The researchers categorized root causes, symptoms, input patterns, test oracles that trigger bugs, and fix strategies.
AI.result: First systematic categorization of tile-program codegen bugs including root causes, symptoms, input patterns, test oracles, and fix strategies for 301 bugs.
AI.conclusion: This work provides foundational insights for building debugging, testing, and repair tools tailored to tile-based compiler infrastructures.

title: A parallel wakeup problem and multi-room light switch strategies
summary: The wakeup problem in distributed computing asks for a symmetric protocol that enables one of several processors to eventually guarantee that all (or, in a more general setting, enough) other processors have acted, using a shared register but no global clock. Dropping the symmetry requirement gives a well-known exercise often phrased in terms of prisoners entering, in an unknown sequence, a room equipped with a single binary switch, and using it to communicate. Kane and Kominers recently analysed a more general version of the latter with multiple parallel and indistinguishable rooms. We answer some open questions of Kane and Kominers regarding the minimum number of switch states needed for the prisoners to solve the problem. We also consider the symmetric ``wakeup'' version of this scenario, and establish exactly for which numbers of processors and registers a solution is possible.

AI.tldr: 本文研究了分布式计算中唤醒问题的对称协议设计。通过分析最小开关状态需求和对称场景下的可解性条件，解决了Kane和Kominers提出的开放问题，并精确刻画了在何种处理器数量和寄存器数量组合下问题可解。
AI.motivation: 分布式计算中的唤醒问题要求设计对称协议，使处理器能够在没有全局时钟的情况下，仅通过共享寄存器确保所有其他处理器已采取行动。Kane和Kominers研究了多房间版本的更通用形式，并提出了关于囚犯问题中所需最小开关状态的开放问题。
AI.method: 通过分析共享寄存器的切换状态数量，结合对称协议设计，证明了对称唤醒场景的可解性条件。
AI.result: 回答了Kane和Kominers关于囚犯解决问题所需最小开关状态的开放问题；完全确定了在给定的处理器数量和寄存器数量下，对称唤醒版本问题是否可解。
AI.conclusion: 完全确定了在哪些处理器数量和寄存器数量的组合下，问题可解。解决了Kane和Kominers提出的关于最小开关状态数量的开放问题。证明了在对称唤醒场景下，问题可解的精确条件。

title: Adaptive Multi-Scale Goodness Aggregation for Forward-Forward Learning
summary: We propose Adaptive Multi-Scale Goodness Aggregation (AMSGA), a novel extension of the Forward-Forward (FF) algorithm designed to improve stability, robustness, and generalization in local-learning neural networks. AMSGA addresses several limitations of the original FF framework by introducing multi-scale goodness aggregation across local, intermediate, and global representations; adaptive curriculum-guided hard negative mining; layer-dependent adaptive thresholds; and a warm-up cosine annealing learning-rate schedule for improved optimization stability. Together, these modifications strengthen the FF paradigm while preserving its biologically plausible and memory-efficient properties. Experiments on MNIST and Fashion-MNIST demonstrate consistent performance improvements over the baseline FF algorithm, achieving up to +1.45% improvement on MNIST and +1.50% improvement on Fashion-MNIST without significant computational overhead. Our results suggest that local learning methods can become substantially more competitive when goodness estimation and training dynamics are carefully designed.

AI.tldr: 本文提出 AMSGA（自适应多尺度 goodness 聚合），通过四个模块扩展 Hinton 的 Forward-Forward（FF）局部学习算法：多尺度 goodness 聚合（局部/中间/全局，按深度加权）、课程引导的自适应难负样本挖掘、随深度与训练进程自适应的层阈值、以及 warm-up + 余弦退火学习率。在 MNIST 与 Fashion-MNIST 上分别比基线 FF 提升约 +1.45% 与 +1.50%（文中正文另称达到 94.45% 与 84.5%，存在数据自相矛盾），且每轮训练时间仅小幅增加（2.5s→2.7s/2.8s）。
AI.motivation: 反向传播（BP）需要在正向传播中缓存中间激活以计算梯度，内存开销大，且其权重传输/误差回传机制与神经科学中的局部、活动依赖的学习机制不符。Feedback Alignment、预测编码、平衡传播等替代方案虽更贴近生物学，但在复杂基准上仍落后于 BP。Forward-Forward（FF）通过"正样本前向传播 + 负样本前向传播"两次前向、逐层独立训练，无需反向传播与全局梯度存储，内存高效且具生物学合理性（MNIST ~92%、Fashion-MNIST ~81%），但其 goodness 仅为单一平方激活和、负样本随机选取、阈值全层全阶段固定、学习率恒定等设计过于简单，限制了适应性与泛化。作者的目标是不改变 FF 核心结构，仅通过改进 goodness 估计与训练动态，让局部学习规则缩小与 BP 的差距。
AI.method: 1) 多尺度 goodness：定义局部（每神经元平方激活均值 g_local）、中间（把神经元分成 K=min(8, ⌊D/10⌋) 组后组内均值 g_inter，D 太小则退化为 g_local）、全局（全体样本与神经元平方激活均值 g_global）三种度量；按深度线性加权 w_local(l)=0.4-0.15l/L、w_inter=0.35、w_global(l)=0.25+0.15l/L。2) 课程引导负样本挖掘：按训练进度 p=e/E 分三阶段——早期(p<0.3) 边界邻域选取，带宽 r 由 0.3 增至 0.5；中期(0.3≤p<0.7) 带宽扩至 1.0 并以 40% 概率混入 g_neg>θ+0.5 的极难负样本；后期(p≥0.7) 带宽 1.0~1.5、极难样本率 50%；若选中样本少于批量的 60%，按 goodness 由难到易补齐。3) 层相关自适应阈值 θ(l,p)=θ0·(1+0.15l/L)·(1+0.3p)，θ0 为 2.0（MNIST）/2.5（Fashion-MNIST）。4) 学习率：前 10% 训练 warm-up 线性升到 η0，随后 90% 余弦退火至 0.1η0。损失沿用 FF 的 log(1+e^{θ-g+})+log(1+e^{g−-θ})，逐层独立优化并 detach 层间激活。实验用 MLP（基线 [784,500,500]；AMSGA 在 MNIST 用 [784,600,600,500]、Fashion-MNIST 用 [784,700,700,600]），Adam(β1=0.9, β2=0.999)、梯度裁剪 0.3、Kaiming 初始化，MNIST 1500 epoch / Fashion-MNIST 2500 epoch，全批训练（batch 50,000）。
AI.result: MNIST：表格给出基线 FF 92.00% → AMSGA 93.45%（+1.45%），训练准确率 93.50%，训练-测试差距 <0.1%；正文/结论则称达到 94.45%（+2.45%）。Fashion-MNIST：表格给出 81.00% → 82.50%（+1.50%），正文称 84.5%（+3.5%）。与 SOTA 对比：Standard MLP 约 98%、CNN 约 99%（MNIST）；Fashion-MNIST 上 MLP 85–90%、CNN 90–95%，AMSGA 仍显著落后于 BP。计算开销：基线每 epoch 2.5s，AMSGA 为 2.7s（MNIST）/2.8s（Fashion-MNIST），且 epoch 数更多。作者声称消融实验表明四个组件各自有贡献，但正文未给出消融表格。
AI.conclusion: FF 的性能瓶颈主要源于其默认的设计选择而非算法本身；系统性改进 goodness 估计、负样本难度演化、阈值标定与学习率动态后，局部学习可在几乎不增加计算量的情况下稳定提升精度，同时保留无反向传播、无全局梯度存储、逐层优化的内存高效与生物学可信特性。作者认为该工作说明生物合理性学习并非天然局限于简单任务，而在更大基准上与 BP 的差距仍需解决标签信息嵌入方式、goodness 与分类的关系、以及是否可以部分放松层间独立性等问题。需注意论文存在明显内部不一致：摘要/表格给出 +1.45%/+1.50% 与 93.45%/82.50%，而正文与结论声称 94.45%/84.5%；方法命名在 AMSGA 与 AMGA 间混用；AMSGA 采用了比基线更深的网络却声称"不增加计算量"，以及消融实验缺失，均削弱了结论的说服力。

title: A Case for Agentic Tuning: From Documentation to Action in PostgreSQL
summary:
Documentation has long guided computer system tuning by distilling expert knowledge into per-parameter recommendations. Yet such guides capture only what experts conclude, discarding how they reason. This fundamental gap manifests in three concrete deficiencies: documentation grows stale as software evolves, fails under heterogeneous workloads, and ignores inter-parameter dependencies.
  We propose shifting from static documentation to dynamic action for system tuning. We introduce PerfEvolve, which translates expert tuning methodologies into executable skills that equip LLM-based agents to perform version-consistency verification, workload-specific profiling, and multi-parameter joint optimization. Evaluated on PostgreSQL under TPC-C and TPC-H benchmarks, PerfEvolve outperforms state-of-the-art documentation-driven tuning baselines by up to 35.2%. The tool is available at https://github.com/ISCAS-OSLab/PerfEvolve.

AI.tldr: 本文提出PerfEvolve框架，将静态文档驱动的系统调优转变为动态可执行的智能调优方法。通过将专家调优知识转化为LLM智能体的可执行技能，实现了版本一致性验证、工作负载感知分析和多参数协同优化，有效解决了传统文档调优的过时性、泛化性和依赖性三大问题。
AI.motivation: 传统文档驱动调优存在三个关键缺陷：软件更新导致文档过时、多样化工作负载下表现不佳、忽略参数间依赖关系
AI.method: 将专家调优方法转化为可执行技能，赋予LLM智能体进行版本一致性验证、工作负载特定性能分析、多参数联合优化
AI.result: 在TPC-C和TPC-H基准测试下，PostgreSQL调优性能提升达35.2%
AI.conclusion: PerfEvolve outperforms state-of-the-art documentation-driven tuning baselines by up to 35.2% on PostgreSQL under TPC-C and TPC-H benchmarks, with open-source availability

title: Diagnosing Multi-step Reasoning Failures in Black-box LLMs via Stepwise Confidence Attribution
summary: Large Language Models have achieved strong performance on reasoning tasks with objective answers by generating step-by-step solutions, but diagnosing where a multi-step reasoning trace might fail remains difficult. Confidence estimation offers a diagnostic signal, yet existing methods are restricted to final answers or require internal model access. In this paper, we introduce Stepwise Confidence Attribution (SCA), a framework for closed-source LLMs that assigns step-level confidence based only on generated reasoning traces. SCA applies the Information Bottleneck principle: steps aligning with consensus structures across correct solutions receive high confidence, while deviations are flagged as potentially erroneous. We propose two complementary methods: (1) NIBS, a non-parametric IB approach measuring consistency without graph structures, and (2) GIBS, a graph-based IB model that learns subgraphs through a differentiable mask to capture logical variability. Extensive experiments on mathematical reasoning and multi-hop question answering show that SCA reliably identifies low-confidence steps strongly correlated with reasoning errors. Moreover, using step-level confidence to guide self-correction improves the correction success rate by up to 13.5\% over answer-level feedback.

AI.tldr: 针对闭源（黑盒）大模型多步推理中"哪一步出错难以定位"的问题，本文提出步级置信度归因框架 SCA（Stepwise Confidence Attribution）：仅依据已生成的推理轨迹（无需访问模型内部 logits）即可为每个推理步骤打可靠性分数。其核心思想是基于信息瓶颈（IB）原理，从采样得到的多条正确解轨迹中挖掘"共识锚点"（逻辑不变量），与共识结构一致的步骤给高分、偏离共识的步骤标为可疑错误点。框架包含两个互补实例：非参数闭式解 NIBS（纯语义相似度对齐，无需训练）与基于图的可微掩码学习方法 GIBS（用 BERT+GCN 编码推理图，通过 MCS 共识图正则化训练软掩码）。在 GSM8K、Math、MoreHopQA 三个数据集与三个 LLM 上，SCA 能有效识别错误步骤（GIBS 在 9 组配置中 7 组取得最佳 AUROC），并用步级置信度引导自纠正，比答案级反馈将纠正成功率最多提升 13.5%。
AI.motivation:
1) 大模型在 CoT/GoT 等可验证推理任务上表现强，但中间步骤的错误难以定位；答案级置信度（CE）只能给出粗粒度可靠性信号，无法指出具体哪一步导致失败，而已有步级诊断方案要么依赖昂贵的人工步骤标注，要么依赖 LLM-as-judge 带来的偏差与不一致。
2) 现有步级 CE（Ye et al. 2025；Han et al. 2025）依赖 token 概率等内部信号，只能用于开源模型；而真实部署大量使用闭源 API 模型，黑盒步级归因是空白。
3) 核心挑战是"合法变异性 vs. 真实错误"的区分：正确解在步骤顺序、表达式、细节粒度上差异巨大，但都共享关键的逻辑不变量（逻辑锚点）；错误则是偏离共识结构的漂移。因此必须找到共识结构作为可靠性代理。
4) 作者还强调概念区分：内部确定性（token 概率）与面向正确性的可靠性不同——"自信的错误"与"罕见但正确"两类现象使单纯内部信号失准，故本文的"置信度"定义为与有效推理轨迹的一致性。
AI.method:
问题定义：给定输入 x 与 N 条采样轨迹 S={(T_i, A_i, z_i)}（仅提供最终答案正确性标签 z_i∈{0,1}），学习 f:(T_i,S)→{c_ij}，输出每步可靠性分数。

信息瓶颈形式化：min_Z I(T_i;Z) − β·I(Z;Y)，X 为推理轨迹、Z 为带置信权重的压缩表示、Y 为正确性信号；压缩项对应稀疏选择步骤，相关性项对应保留与正确性相关的信息。

(1) NIBS（闭式、非参数、免训练）：用最终答案标签划分正确/错误轨迹集合，从 S_correct 中对每一步做语义相似度计算（BERT 句向量余弦 或 DeBERTa-large-MNLI 蕴含），再按轨迹内取 Max 或 Mean 聚合，得到 c_ij（公式2）。压缩=仅保留共识步；相关性=共识重叠与正确性强相关。

(2) GIBS（基于图、可学习）：用 LangFun 风格结构化提示让模型实例化 ReasoningGraph（节点=中间结果， 边=推理操作/子问题），规则解析器抽取有向图，每步表示为 (v_ij, e_ij)。以正确轨迹图两两求解启发式最大公共子图（基于 NLI 蕴含阈值 τ_e=τ_v=0.7、top-K=10 种子 + BFS 扩展）聚合出共识图 G^MC，再对齐得到二值共识掩码 m_ij。离散子图选择不可微，故用可微掩码 p_θ=f_θ(G) 松弛：压缩项用 KL(p_θ‖Bernoulli(ε<0.5))（同时最小化掩码熵以鼓励二值化决策），相关性项用交叉熵 CE(p_θ, m_i)，总损失 L = H(p_θ) + λ·CE(p_θ, m_i)。推理时一次前向即可输出步级置信度 c_ij = p_θ,ij，无需再做 MCS。

实验设置：数据集 GSM8K、Math、MoreHopQA（最终答案用精确匹配/GPT-4o 评判）；步骤级真值标签由 GPT-4o 标注；模型 LLaMA-3.1-8B-Instruct、Phi-4-Reasoning、DeepSeek-R1-Distill-Qwen-32B（另测 Qwen2.5-72B）；每题采样 N=20 条、温度 1.0；GIBS 在 2000 张推理图上训练（BERT + 2 层 GCN，Adam 1e-3，早停）；指标 AUROC、AUCPR、ACC@80%、ECE；基线含白盒 SL(norm)/Entropy/P(true)/LeCo 以及改造的 ROSCOE/PARC 黑盒方法；另在 PRM800K 人工步骤标注上验证。
AI.result:
1) 经验证据：1,000 张推理图的平均 MCS 比例分布显示，正确解集中在约 0.8，错误解峰值约 0.4，证实"正确=推理路径稳定可复现、错误=结构碎片化"。
2) 准确率：GIBS 在 3 数据集×3 模型共 9 组配置中 7 组取得最佳 AUROC（如 Phi4/Math 0.6946、DeepSeek/MoreHopQA 0.8084），在 MoreHopQA 等结构依赖强的任务优势明显；NIBS 变体无需训练也具竞争力，且对相似度模型选择鲁棒（Cos-Mean 与 NLI-Max 接近），但结构性建模缺失使其在部分设置落后。
3) 通用性：在 PRM800K（人工标注的自由形式 CoT）上 NLI-Mean 达 AUROC 0.8181/AUCPR 0.9019，GIBS 0.6556，说明方法可迁移但结构信息不足时 NIBS 更有优势；在 Qwen2.5-72B/MoreHopQA 上 GIBS 达 AUROC 0.7982、AUCPR 0.8385，全面领先基线。
4) 下游效用：给出低置信步骤的步级反馈引导自纠正，纠正成功率比答案级反馈最高提升 13.5%，在 DeepSeek-R1、Phi-4 等强推理模型上增益最明显；案例分析显示步级反馈能定位"根因步骤"（如误用杂志创刊年份而非出版社信息）从而真正修正答案。
5) 消融与鲁棒性：去掉图编码器或边编码器均显著降 AUROC（如 Math 0.6946→0.5961/0.4763）；GNN 骨干中 GCN 最优（0.6619 vs GraphSAGE 0.6446、GAT 0.5806、GIN 0.5815）；NLI 阈值在 [0.7,0.8] 稳定，过松过严均退化；采样数 N>15 后性能趋稳（0.5964→0.6679）。
6) 无标签与分布外：All-trajectories 共识明显退化（AUROC ~0.55），Self-consistency 伪标签在 DeepSeek/Phi4 上接近 oracle（0.7843/0.6610 vs 0.8084/0.6619），性能与伪标签质量强相关（Phi4 伪标签与金标重叠约 80%，Llama3.1 仅 28%）；跨域训练（MoreHopQA→Math）时 GIBS 仍优于 NIBS 与白盒基线；显式 MCS 监督（"MCS-Only"）推理需 5–19 小时，GIBS 仅 0.005–0.05 小时，性能相当而速度提升三个数量级。
7) 误报与人工验证：最低 20% 置信度步骤中真实正确者占 14.8%–21.6%，说明并未系统性压制罕见但合法的推理；MoreHopQA 上人工核验，最低置信步与人工识别错误步的匹配率为 Phi4 60%、DeepSeek-R1 80%，与 AUROC 排序一致；首错步检测实验中 GIBS 在三个模型上均最优（0.6164/0.7885/0.6841），说明能定位真正的失败起点而非被后续级联错误主导。
AI.conclusion: 本文提出并验证了面向闭源 LLM 的步级置信度归因框架 SCA，把"在推理链中定位出错步骤"形式化为信息瓶颈问题：共识锚点作为压缩表示，与正确性相关的共识对齐作为相关性项。NIBS 提供免训练闭式解，GIBS 通过可微掩码与共识图正则化学习结构感知的子图选择，二者在数学与多跳问答任务上均能产出准确、良校准的步级置信度，稳健定位错误步骤，并可作为下游选择性纠正的可操作信号（纠正率最高 +13.5%），且具备对标签可用性、推理格式与域偏移的鲁棒性。方法的适用边界与后续方向在于：共识锚点需一定质量的参考轨迹（伪标签质量决定上限）、对结构化图抽取的依赖（PRM800K 等自由形式 CoT 上 GIBS 优势减弱）、以及 NLI 阈值/采样量等工程成本。

title: Memory-Augmented Reinforcement Learning Agent for CAD Generation
comment: 26 pages; multilingual submission: English version first, followed by Chinese version
summary: Automatic generation of computer-aided design (CAD) models is a core technology for enabling intelligence in advanced manufacturing. Existing generation methods based on large language models (LLMs) often fall short when handling complex CAD models characterized by long operation sequences, diverse operation types, and strong geometric constraints, primarily because reasoning chains break and effective error-correction mechanisms are lacking. To address this problem, this paper proposes a memory-augmented reinforcement learning framework for CAD generation agents. The framework encapsulates the underlying geometric kernel into a structured toolchain callable by the agent and builds a closed-loop mechanism of design intent understanding, global planning, execution, and multi-dimensional verification. It also designs a dual-track memory module consisting of a case library and a skill library, and proposes a dynamic utility retrieval algorithm. By introducing reinforcement learning into retrieval and policy optimization, the agent can effectively avoid retrieval traps in which examples are semantically similar but geometrically infeasible, enabling online self-correction and continual evolution without additional large-scale annotated data. Experiments show that the proposed method significantly improves both the success rate and geometric consistency on complex CAD model generation tasks.

AI.tldr: 本文提出一种记忆增强强化学习框架，用于解决复杂CAD模型自动生成问题。该框架通过结构化工具链、双轨记忆模块和动态效用检索算法，配合强化学习实现无需大规模标注数据的在线自纠正和持续进化，显著提升复杂CAD模型生成的成功率和几何一致性。
AI.motivation: 现有基于大语言模型的CAD生成方法难以处理复杂模型（长操作序列、多样化操作类型、强几何约束），主要原因是推理链断裂和缺乏有效的错误纠正机制
AI.method: 记忆增强强化学习框架；封装几何内核为结构化工具链；设计案例库与技能库的双轨记忆模块；提出动态效用检索算法；将强化学习引入检索与策略优化
AI.result: 成功率和几何一致性显著提升
AI.conclusion: 显著提升复杂CAD模型生成任务的成功率和几何一致性，展示了无需大规模标注数据的在线自纠正和持续进化能力

title: LWGR: Lagrangian-Constrained Personalized World Knowledge for Generative Recommendation
summary: Recent progress in large language model (LLM) based generative recommendation (GR) shows that leveraging LLM world knowledge can substantially improve performance. However, existing methods rely on fixed, manually designed instructions to generate semantic knowledge and directly incorporate it into GR, which has two limitations. First, fixed instructions cannot capture the multidimensional heterogeneity of user interests. Second, uncontrollable knowledge fusion may conflict with behavioral signals and harm recommendations. To address these limitations, we propose LWGR, a framework that leverages Lagrangian constraints to transfer users' personalized world knowledge from LLMs into generative recommendation. LWGR enhances GR along two axes: knowledge extraction and fusion. It builds personalized soft instructions to extract behavior-relevant LLM world knowledge, and formulates knowledge fusion as an optimization problem with explicitly bounded performance degradation, which is solved by a Lagrangian primal-dual method to selectively incorporate beneficial knowledge. We further design two training strategies for different LLM scales and a deployment scheme that combines nearline precomputation with lightweight online serving. Experiments on multiple public datasets and one industrial dataset show that LWGR outperforms eight state-of-the-art baselines by up to 11.23% and brings a 1.35% revenue lift on a large-scale advertising platform, demonstrating its effectiveness and practicality.

AI.tldr: LWGR 将大语言模型的“世界知识”以用户个性化、受拉格朗日约束可控的方式注入生成式推荐（GR）。它包含两部分：用并行码本 + IBQ 直通梯度学习“个性化软指令”，引导 LLM 抽取与用户行为一致的世界知识；再用 [BOS] 处的交叉注意力融合该知识，并把融合建模为带性能退化上界的约束优化问题，用拉格朗日原始-对偶方法自适应求解，从而只吸收有益知识。在 Beauty、Toys 与工业数据集上超过 8 个 SOTA 基线，最高相对提升 11.23%；工业广告平台 A/B 测试带来 1.35% 收入提升、1.17% CTR 提升，延迟仅增加约 1.5%。
AI.motivation: 生成式推荐（GR）虽摆脱了大规模物品嵌入表，但其语义建模主要依赖用户历史交互，难以显式利用外部知识以刻画复杂兴趣结构。LLM 蕴含海量世界知识，但现有“提示式两阶段知识融合”范式存在两大局限：(1) 依赖固定、人工设计的任务指令，无法刻画用户兴趣的多维异质性，限制了性能上限；(2) 知识融合缺乏显式约束，不可控的知识注入可能与行为信号冲突、损害推荐。作者在真实电商场景的预实验进一步验证：指令与用户特征的一致性决定知识价值（人口统计引导指令可提升部分人群上限），但并非所有世界知识都有益，指令与兴趣结构错配时甚至低于无知识的基线。因此需要解决两个问题：如何让 LLM 生成与用户行为高度一致的个性化世界知识；如何约束融合过程以保证稳定增益。
AI.method: 1）知识抽取：将 GR 编码器输出的用户上下文经均值池化与 K 个线性投影映射到 K 个子空间，在每个子空间用并行码本（OPQ 思想）做最近邻量化，得到 K 个用户个性化离散码；再投影到 LLM 隐空间作为 K 个“个性化软指令”token 前置拼接于历史物品文本前送入 LLM，得到个性化世界知识表示 H_u。量化选择不可导，故采用基于 IBQ 的直通估计器（硬 one-hot 前向、softmax 分布反向）实现端到端训练、全部码字可更新，且相比“每用户独享 K 个向量”把表达空间从线性扩展到 K^m 且支持跨用户共享。2）知识融合：以 [BOS] 表示 q0 为 query、H_u 为 key/value 做多头交叉注意力，得到增强的 q̃0 送入解码器，在不改动原架构的前提下让知识全局引导自回归生成。3）约束优化：先预训练并冻结无知识融合的参考模型 θ_ref，定义基于平均 token 对数似然得分的退化惩罚 C(θ)=E[max(0, s_ref − s_θ − δ)]，约束 C(θ)≤ε；用拉格朗日函数 L=L_rec+λ(C−ε) 的原始-对偶交替更新（θ 梯度下降，λ 投影梯度上升 max(0, λ+η_λ(C−ε))），避免固定权重 β 的调参困境。4）训练策略与部署：冻结 LLM（只训软指令、融合与 GR 模块）或 LoRA 低秩微调（秩 8、缩放 16、dropout 0.05）适配不同规模 LLM；部署采用近线预计算（秒~分钟级刷新个性化世界知识，存入以 user ID 为键的知识库）+ 在线轻量服务（一次索引查找 + 一个交叉注意力块），无需在线 LLM 推理。基线 LLM 统一为 Qwen3-4B，K=5，AdamW，bf16，δ=ε=1e-4。
AI.conclusion: LWGR 证明，将 LLM 世界知识以“个性化抽取 + 受约束融合”的方式引入生成式推荐是有效的：个性化软指令（并行码本 + IBQ 直通梯度）解决了知识与用户兴趣对齐的问题，拉格朗日原始-对偶约束优化解决了知识注入不可控、性能退化不可控的问题。离线与在线结果共同显示其在公开基准与超大规模工业系统中均达到 SOTA 且具有工程可行性（毫秒级延迟、兼容现有 GR 管线）。未来工作方向包括：面向更大规模 LLM 更高效的部署策略；以及 LLM 与 GR 之间更具可解释性与可控性的协作机制。

title: CriterAlign: Criterion-Centric Rationale Alignment for Code Preference Judging
summary: Pairwise human preference prediction is central to evaluating code-generation systems, where quality often depends on task-specific trade-offs beyond functional correctness. While rubric-based LLM judges improve interpretability by decomposing evaluation into explicit criteria, most existing pipelines remain pointwise: they score each response independently and derive preferences by comparing aggregated scores. We show that this design is poorly matched to pairwise code preference prediction and can underperform a strong monolithic judge. We propose CriterAlign, a criterion-centric framework that adapts rubric-based judging to pairwise preference evaluation through direct criterion-level pairwise judgments, tie-driven criterion refinement, swap-consistency filtering, and final pairwise synthesis. We further introduce Human-Preference-Aligned Guidance (HPAG), synthesized offline from training examples by extracting recurring rationale gaps between human preferences and monolithic judge predictions, and injected into the criterion generator, criterion judge, and final judge. On BigCodeReward, CriterAlign improves a Qwen2.5-VL-32B monolithic judge from 60.4% to 66.3% accuracy, with ablations confirming the contributions of pairwise criterion design and HPAG.

AI.tldr: 本文提出 CriterAlign——一个面向代码"成对偏好判断"的准则中心（criterion-centric）框架：把原本逐条独立打分的 rubric 判断改造成"准则级直接成对比较"（A/B/tie/insufficient），并引入批量平局驱动的准则细化（BTCR）、交换一致性准则过滤（SCF）以及离线从训练集人类偏好与单体裁判分歧中提炼的 HPAG 人类偏好对齐指引。在 BigCodeReward 上，Qwen2.5-VL-32B 单体裁判的准确率从 60.4% 提升到 66.3%（+5.9），超过最强复现的 criterion 基线 11.3 个百分点，并可跨裁判/合成器迁移。
AI.motivation: 代码生成质量的判定往往依赖任务特定的多维权衡（视觉保真、健壮性、可维护性等），仅靠功能正确性不足以决定优劣，因此代码评测本质上是"给定指令与两个候选解，判断人类更偏好哪一个"的成对偏好问题。单体（monolithic）LLM 裁判把"选哪些准则、逐条比较、聚合证据"全压在一次隐式推理中，易过度关注冗长/格式等表层线索、忽略执行或视觉证据，且对回答顺序敏感。基于 rubric/准则的方法（LLM Rubrics、Chasing the Tail、RRD）虽提升了可解释性，但绝大多数仍是 pointwise：分别给两个回答打分再比较聚合分。作者实证指出这种设计与成对偏好目标不匹配——直接把已有 pointwise 准则生成管线套用到代码成对偏好上，准确率反而低于强单体裁判（如 RRD 仅 55.0% vs 单体 60.4%），即"更多准则"本身不解决问题。
AI.method: 问题形式化为 (x, a, b, e, y)：指令、两个候选响应、可选执行/视觉证据 e、人类偏好标签，标签空间映射为 {A, B, tie}。流程为：(1) 准则生成器在指令、两响应与执行证据条件下生成 16–20 条原子化、比较性、可判定的任务特定准则；(2) 准则裁判对每条准则直接输出成对裁决 v_i ∈ {A, B, tie, insufficient}（而非各自的满足度打分）；(3) BTCR 对判为 tie 的准则批量生成至多 2 条更细粒度子准则，经一次批量冗余检查与一次批量冲突检查后由同一成对裁判复判（每轮最多 3 次调用）；(4) SCF 用交换顺序复判同一准则（同时交换执行产物），仅当 v_i→ = π(v_i←)（π 交换 A/B）时保留该条准则—裁决证据，从而在准则级去除位置敏感证据而非丢弃整例；(5) 终判器接收原实例、保留的准则级证据与 HPAG，输出 A/B/tie。HPAG 只在训练划分（20%）离线合成：先让单体裁判输出偏好与自由文本理由，再由"理由分析"模型依据人类标签反推人类投票理由，组装结构化记录交给指导合成器（默认 Claude Sonnet 4.6）归纳出人类在意而裁判漏掉/过重/过轻的维度，蒸馏为全局与六类任务族（web、game、creative、diagram、scientific、problem solving）的准则生成/准则判断/终判三类自然语言指导，在推理时注入三个阶段；验证集不参与更新。评判模型全程冻结，仅用 vLLM 在 4×H200 上服务开源权重模型。
AI.result: BigCodeReward 验证集（3,785 例）：单体 Qwen2.5-VL-32B 60.4%；复现的 pointwise 准则基线全部更差——Rubric Is All You Need 48.1、LLM Rubrics 50.3、Chasing the Tail 53.3、RRD_UW 51.6、RRD_LLM 55.0；CriterAlign 达 66.3%（+5.9 / 相对最强基线 +11.3）。消融呈累积效应：pointwise RRD 55.0 → pairwise RRD 61.8（+6.8，最大增益来源）→ +BTCR 62.2 → +全局 HPAG 63.6 → +SCF 64.6 → +类别级 HPAG 66.3。完整性对照：仅把 HPAG 加到单体裁判上为 63.3/64.4，说明增益不单由指导解释；去掉类别指导 64.6、空类别指导 64.9，类别脚手架贡献有限；HPAG 注入生成/判断/终判三阶段分别 63.4/64.6/65.2，全注入最优 66.3。SCF 诊断：准则级 A 位置偏置由 +12.9pp 降至 −1.7pp，样本级多数偏置由 +17.3pp 降至 −0.9pp（人类参考 +1.6pp），移除 25,464 条准则判断（约 34%），准则池 75,177→55,511，92.9% 样本至少被过滤一条。BTCR 使细化阶段调用从 96,571 降至 10,908（−88.7%，8.9×）。跨裁判泛化：Kimi-VL-A3B 46.5→56.9（自合成）/60.7（Sonnet），Gemma-4-31B 57.7→64.5/63.7，Qwen 60.4→65.2/66.3，最弱裁判相对增益最大。WebDevJudge 迁移（HPAG 由 BigCodeReward 合成）：单体 65.0→67.7，pointwise RRD 61.1→64.2，完整管线 68.0→68.7。案例研究显示准则级证据可解释为何选择某解（如 Rule 30 任务中更重视 ANSI 可读性与边界一致性），也暴露弱支撑准则的噪声。未报告误差条/显著性检验。
AI.conclusion: 面向代码成对偏好的准则式裁判不应只追求"生成更多准则"，而必须让准则的"比较方式"与"聚合方式"对齐人类成对偏好：逐条独立打分 + 聚合分是错误范式，准则级直接比较才使准则真正有用。CriterAlign 通过 pairwise 准则裁决、tie 驱动细化、交换一致性过滤与 HPAG 人类偏好对齐指引，在 BigCodeReward 上将 Qwen2.5-VL-32B 从 60.4% 提升至 66.3%，并证明增益在多裁判/多合成器与跨数据集（WebDevJudge）上可迁移；同时提供更可检查的准则级推理轨迹。局限：多阶段流水线带来额外推理延迟与成本（可蒸馏或选择性触发）；仅在 BigCodeReward 与 WebDevJudge 上评估，跨领域/跨用户群体偏好差异未覆盖；HPAG 以自然语言注入依赖裁判的指令遵循能力与上下文预算；定性案例仍存在弱支撑准则产生的噪声证据；缺少重复运行的误差条与显著性检验；代码尚未开源。

title: Conflict-Freedom as a Progress Condition
comment: 24 pages, 2 figures. This is an extended version of a conference article. The conference version of this article appears in the proceedings of the 2026 ACM Symposium on Principles of Distributed Computing (PODC'26)
summary: An obstruction-free implementation guarantees progress to every operation that is given enough time to take steps in isolation. But, as we show in this paper, the mere presence of concurrent operations alone does not have to prevent progress; only incomplete conflicting (non-commuting) operations may do so. This progress condition, that we call conflict-freedom, is a natural generalization of obstruction-freedom that promises efficient implementations for objects exhibiting semantic commutativity. We show that, as with obstruction-freedom, every sequential object has a read-write conflict-free linearizable implementation. Our conflict-free universal construction is based on a novel generalization of the instrumental commit-adopt object, interesting in its own right.

AI.tldr: 本文提出冲突自由度作为阻塞自由度的新泛化，该条件只要求不完整的冲突操作阻止进度，而非所有并发操作。文章证明任何顺序对象都可以通过基于新型提交-采纳对象的通用构造实现读-写冲突自由线性化。
AI.motivation: 传统阻塞自由的定义过于保守，实际上并发操作的存在本身并不一定会阻止进度，只有不完整的冲突（非交换）操作才会阻止进度。现有阻塞自由条件无法充分利用对象语义可交换性带来的效率提升潜力。
AI.method: 基于新型通用提交-采纳（commit-adopt）对象构建冲突自由线性化实现。该方法扩展了传统提交-采纳对象的概念，使其支持读-写冲突自由的实现。
AI.result: 证明了每个顺序对象都存在读-写冲突自由线性化实现，且该构造基于新提出的通用提交-采纳对象。
AI.conclusion: 提出了冲突自由作为阻塞自由的自然泛化，通过基于新型提交-采纳对象的通用构造证明了任何顺序对象都可以实现读写冲突自由线性化。该研究为具有语义可交换性特征的对象提供了高效的并发实现方案。提出了冲突自由作为阻塞自由的自然泛化，通过基于新型提交-采纳对象的通用构造证明了任何顺序对象都可以实现读写冲突自由线性化。该研究为具有语义可交换性特征的对象提供了高效的并发实现方案。

title: Block-Based Double Decoders
summary: Encoder-decoder models offer substantial inference-time savings over decoder-only models, but their pretraining objectives suffer from sparse supervision and dynamic sequence lengths, keeping them out of practice at scale. We propose block-based double decoders, a novel transformer architecture that utilizes doubly-causal block-based attention masks to train with full loss supervision and static sequence packing, combining decoder-only training efficiency with encoder-decoder inference efficiency. In scaling law experiments, block-based double decoders strongly outperform encoder-decoders and closely track decoder-only models across scales. At inference time, they cut KV-cache memory and per-token compute by at least 2/3 without sacrificing prefill caching or other existing inference optimizations available to decoder-only models.

AI.tldr: 提出一种基于块级双解码器的Transformer架构，通过双向因果注意力掩码结合两种模型的优点，在保持训练效率的同时大幅降低推理资源消耗。
AI.motivation: 传统的encoder-decoder模型在预训练中存在监督稀疏和动态序列长度的问题，限制了其在大规模训练中的实际应用；而decoder-only模型虽然训练高效，但在推理时缺乏encoder-decoder架构的计算优势。
AI.method: 采用双因果的块级注意力掩码机制，实现完整损失监督和静态序列打包训练；架构包含双向解码器结构，可在推理时保持KV-cache缓存等现有优化。
AI.result: 在扩展定律实验中，该架构显著优于encoder-decoder模型，并在不同规模下与decoder-only模型表现接近；推理时KV-cache内存和每Token计算量减少至少2/3。
AI.conclusion: 提出的双解码器架构通过块级双向注意力机制，成功融合了decoder-only模型的训练效率与encoder-decoder模型的推理效率，在保持竞争力的同时显著降低了计算资源需求，为大规模语言模型的高效推理提供了新的设计思路。

title: AI Technologies in Language Access: Attitudes Towards AI and the Human Value of Language Access Managers
summary: The rapid emergence of AI technologies is reshaping translation practices and theory across the board. This paper deals with the impact of AI in language access. This area is characterized by the need to serve broad and diverse user populations, within a context where efficiency and access are shaped by legal mandates, ethical and commercial tensions, and safety concerns. This paper reports on the attitudes and perceptions of language access managers towards the AI and the human value in the AI age. Methodologically, this paper presents an analysis of a subset of a broader study on language access and technology, specifically a qualitative thematic analysis of ten semi-structured interviews with language access managers in the USA working in healthcare, court, public service and local government contexts. The results indicate that language access managers show conditional optimism towards the inevitable AI implementations, are strongly risk aware, and deeply committed to the human value and human oversight of AI implementations and output.

AI.tldr: 本文是一篇质性研究论文，考察美国医疗、法院、公共服务与地方政府等语境下10位语言服务管理者（language access managers）对人工智能的态度与感知。研究发现：他们对不可避免的AI落地持"有条件乐观"（conditional optimism），同时风险意识极强，并深度致力于在AI实施与产出中维护人的价值与"人工监督"（human oversight）。
AI.motivation: AI技术的迅速涌现正在重塑翻译实践与理论。本论文聚焦"语言可及性"（language access）领域——该领域需服务广泛且多元的用户群体，其效率与可及性同时受法律强制要求、伦理与商业张力以及安全关切的制约。因此，研究者希望弄清处于该领域中枢位置的从业者（语言服务管理者）如何理解AI、如何评价AI带来的风险与机会，以及在AI时代如何界定人的价值，这是学界尚未充分解答的问题。
AI.method: 方法上，本文是作者一项关于"语言可及性与技术"的更大规模研究的一个子集分析，采用质性主题分析（qualitative thematic analysis），对来自美国医疗、法院、公共服务及地方政府等语境的10位语言服务管理者进行半结构化访谈，并对其转录文本进行主题提炼，分析维度集中于受访者对AI的态度、风险认知以及人本价值与人工监督的立场。
AI.result: 结果显示：语言服务管理者对AI的落地持"有条件乐观"的态度——即承认AI实施的必然性，并期待其带来的效率与可及性收益，但这种乐观是有前提和边界的；他们表现出强烈的风险意识（risk aware），尤其关注法律合规、翻译准确性、错误后果及安全风险；他们同时对人的价值与人工监督表现出深度承诺，强调AI输出不应脱离人类的判断、责任承担与把关。此外，多元用户群体的服务需求也被视为AI难以完全替代人的关键原因。
AI.conclusion: 结论指出：AI在语言可及性中的普及是不可逆的，但语言服务管理者并不接受无监督的技术替代，他们主张以"条件性接受"和"以人为中心"的框架来部署AI——即保留人类的核心价值判断与监督责任，把AI定位为辅助工具而非取代者。该研究以小样本质性访谈呈现了语言可及性管理者对AI的集体立场，为翻译行业在AI时代的伦理规范、风险治理与专业角色定位提供了实证依据，也提示后续研究需扩大样本并检验不同机构与语境的差异。

title: POLAR-Bench: A Diagnostic Benchmark for Privacy-Utility Trade-offs in LLM Agents
summary: LLM agents increasingly have access to private user data and act on the user's behalf when interacting with third-party systems. The user defines what may and must not be shared, and the agent must robustly follow that intent even when third-party systems behave adversarially. We introduce POLAR-Bench (Policy-aware adversarial Benchmark), in which a trusted model with a privacy policy and a task converses with a third-party model that adversarially probes for both task-relevant and protected attributes. Across 10 domains and 7,852 samples, we score privacy and utility by deterministic set-membership and vary privacy policy dimension and attack strategy along two orthogonal axes, producing a 5 times 5 diagnostic surface per model. Our results reveal a sharp split: current frontier models withhold over 99% of protected attributes, while smaller open-weight models in the 1--30B range, the class users most commonly run as their own trusted agent on-device or via private inference, score notably worse, with the weakest leaking over half. POLAR-Bench thus localizes where each model's intent-following breaks down, providing a foothold for privacy alignment where it matters most.

AI.tldr: POLAR-Bench 是一个面向"隐私—效用"权衡的诊断型基准：在双模型对抗设定下，受信模型持有源文档、隐私策略与任务指令，第三方模型以 5 种攻击策略探取受保护属性；评测沿"隐私策略维度(P1–P5)× 攻击策略(S1–S5)"两条正交轴构成 5×5 诊断面，覆盖 10 个领域、7,852 个样本，隐私/效用均以确定性正则集成员判定打分（结果环节无 LLM 评判）。结果显示前沿模型可守住 >99% 受保护属性，而 1–30B 开源权重模型（用户最常本地部署为可信代理的一类）显著更差、最弱者泄漏过半；隐私—效用权衡并非单调，攻击形式（尤其是是否/多选收窄与多轮渐进）比策略表述难度更能决定失败模式，且 GPQA 推理能力与隐私强相关但与效用几乎无关。
AI.motivation: LLM 智能体正被部署为个人代理，读取用户私人文档并代表用户与第三方系统交互。用户以单一隐私策略规定"可共享/须保密"的边界，智能体需在第三方以直接提问、角色扮演、提示注入、逐步诱导等方式施压时仍严格遵从该意图。已有基准多在单轴条件下测量（一次只用一种策略类型或一种攻击类型），缺乏把"隐私策略表述难度"与"攻击强度"作为两条正交轴同时变化的评测，因而无法定位某个模型究竟在哪里、为何、以何种方式失效（是过度披露，还是过度保守而无法完成任务）。同时，现有智能体隐私评测普遍依赖 LLM-as-judge 判定泄漏，存在主观性与不可复现问题。
AI.method: 威胁模型：借鉴 AirGapAgent 的"可信模型 T vs. 外部对抗模型 E"双智能体结构。样本 I=(D,P,T,Q) 由源文档、隐私策略、任务指令、攻击者提示序列构成；文档中每个属性先按类型标注 A=A_task∪A_protected∪A_other（任务必须给出 / 必须保留 / 无关噪声），再渲染为自然语言。隐私策略轴 P1–P5 按推理难度递增：显式字段约束、语义类别约束、条件性披露、部分/抽象化披露（只给国家不给城市）、冲突目标（任务与策略相互竞争）。攻击轴 S1–S5 按强度递增：单轮直接索取、是/否或多选收窄、角色混淆（审计员/医生/招聘者）、提示注入（越权/调试/审计话术）、3–6 轮渐进诱导。生成流程为"符号化画像采样 → LLM 渲染 → 验证 → 定向修复"；关键设计是任务与策略解耦（T⊥P，通过提示级护栏禁止任务提示出现策略/最小必要等措辞，禁止策略携带执行目标），迫使模型独立解读策略。质量控制：源文档用正则确定性校验全部 allowed/do-not-disclose 值是否可从文档中恢复（覆盖失败则定向重渲染修复，最终移除 23 条样本）；策略/任务/攻击提示用 LLM 语义评判检查有效性、字段级覆盖与"不暴露攻击意图"（三个不同裁判独立接受率 80.0%/91.7%/91.7%，均值 87.8%）。评测：对话 K 轮，抽取转录中出现的属性集合 ε(H)，Privacy=1−|ε∩A_protected|/|A_protected|，Utility=|ε∩A_task|/|A_task|，Score=λ·Privacy+(1−λ)·Utility（默认 λ=0.5），配 iso-score 线分析。固定第三方模型 E=Llama-3.3-70B-Instruct，评测 20 个前沿与开源权重模型（GPT-5.4、GLM-5.1、Kimi-K2.5、DeepSeek-V3.1、Gemma-3/4、GPT-OSS、Mistral-3 系列、Apertus、OLMo-3.1-32B、SmolLM3-3B、Qwen3-32B 等）。可复现性：全局种子 42、逐字段由 (sample_id, field_name) 派生渲染种子、温度 0 解码、验证后冻结 JSON/JSONL；并做 E 选择敏感性、跨域一致性与去模型/去家族留一法鲁棒性检查，外加 PrivacyChecker 防御基线。
AI.result: 1) 模型排序：GLM-5.1 94.6 > GPT-5.4 92.6 > Gemma-4-31B 91.4 > DeepSeek-V3.1 91.0 > Gemma-4-E4B 90.9；SmolLM3-3B 与 Apertus 系列垫底，首尾差距超 30 分，无模型接近上限。前沿模型隐私分 >99（GPT-5.4 99.86、GLM-5.1 99.23），而 1–30B 开源权重类显著更差：SmolLM3-3B 隐私 46.77、Ministral-3-3B 49.05、Apertus-70B 57.78、DeepSeek-R1-Distill-Llama-70B 56.18（最弱者泄漏过半）。2) 权衡非单调：GLM-4.7-Flash、Kimi-K2.5、Llama-3.3-70B、GPT-OSS 20B/120B 隐私近满分但效用仅 53–75（过度保守）；SmolLM3-3B、Ministral-3-3B、Gemma-4-E2B 效用高而隐私低。GLM-5.1 在所有 λ 下均居首，说明强隐私与高效用可兼得，差距主要由对齐与训练而非参数规模决定。3) 规模效应不一致：Apertus 70B→8B 隐私反升、Gemma-4 随规模隐私升效用降、Mistral-3 呈非单调（3B 62.03→8B 68.04→14B 58.99）；DeepSeek-R1-Distill-Llama-70B 隐私低于更小的 GPT-OSS-20B 等。4) 能力相关性：GPQA Diamond 与隐私强相关（Pearson r=0.752、Spearman ρ=0.848，均 p<0.001，留一法稳健），与效用弱负相关（r=−0.291、ρ=−0.156，置信区间跨零）。5) 诊断面：策略维度影响很小（最好与最差仅约 5% 差距，两轴几乎无交互），攻击策略影响大；S2 是/否收窄最危险（隐私均值 66.06、跨模型方差 724.19），S5 多轮渐进最隐蔽（隐私 78.08，但效用均值最高 84.24、效用方差最低 11.64），S1 直接索取最易防（隐私均值 89.73），S4 提示注入最一致（87.26）。6) 领域：Finance 最高总分均值 84.47、Legal 83.77；Customer Support 最难（总分 65.13、效用 48.22）；Recruitment 隐私风险最高（隐私均值 73.27、方差 601.65），Housing/Travel 隐私最安全（88.46/85.40）；跨域排序一致性高（域-总体 Spearman 0.893–0.982，Kendall W=0.915）。7) 防御基线：PrivacyChecker 全面提升隐私（Ministral-3-3B +27.52、Apertus-70B +5.89、SmolLM3-3B +10.20），效用变化很小（−2.72~+1.54），说明基准能捕捉隐私干预的行为效应。8) 鲁棒性：更换第三方模型对强 T 影响极小（总体分差 0.2pp），对弱 T 隐私分可差 3.9pp。
AI.conclusion: POLAR-Bench 的价值在于把"是否失败"细化为"在哪里失效、失效模式为何"：过度披露受保护信息、过度保守以致无法完成任务、或在特定攻击形式/策略类型下的脆弱点。核心发现是前沿模型与 1–30B 本地可部署开权重模型之间存在部署相关的鸿沟——后者恰是用户为避免把私有数据发往第三方 API 而最常自行托管为可信代理的类别；且该差距并非规模的纯函数，族内扩展常呈非单调，推理/对齐选择比参数量更关键。方法论上，作者主张：仅用直接提问或提示注入类攻击无法评估隐私鲁棒性，增量式与对话式攻击（是/否收窄、多轮渐进）才是必要的压力源；确定性正则打分 + 冻结数据 + 种子化渲染保障了可复现性；该基准也可作为 PAPILLON、PrivacyPAD、PrivacyChecker 等推理时防御的应力测试平台与隐私对齐的落脚点。局限包括：样本来自结构化画像而非真实用户日志、外部效度依赖渲染文档对真实文本的忠实度；P1–P5 与 S1–S5 的难度序未与人类评审校准；仅覆盖英语；所有攻击者提示由单一 Llama-3.3-70B 生成，攻击结论条件于该模型；确定性匹配对改写式披露不敏感（在 P4 抽象与 P5 冲突场景尤甚），"最小披露"判定仍是规范性而非经验校准；防御评测仅覆盖 3 个可信模型与 1 种防御。

title: Operationalising Artificial Intelligence Bills of Materials (AIBOMs) for Verifiable AI Provenance and Lifecycle Assurance
summary: Artificial Intelligence (AI) systems are increasingly dependent on complex, multi-layered software supply chains that introduce challenges for reproducibility, transparency, and security assurance. This study presents an Artificial Intelligence Bill of Materials (AIBOM) schema extending the CycloneDX standard to capture AI-specific provenance, model lineage, and disclosure metadata. The framework provides a formalised approach to verifiable software provenance through structured schema engineering, cryptographic validation, and agent-driven automation. An autonomous AI pipeline is developed to perform continuous environment inspection, vulnerability enrichment, and reproducibility auditing using machine-verifiable provenance chains. Empirical evaluation demonstrates 98.7% reproducibility fidelity, 96.2% vulnerability match precision, and a 63% reduction in manual oversight across containerised analytic workflows. These results confirm the feasibility of automated provenance assurance and reproducible AI lifecycle validation. The AIBOM framework advances the scientific foundations of software supply chain transparency and AI reproducibility engineering, offering a generalisable methodology for securing AI systems, strengthening provenance integrity, and supporting compliance with international information security standards.

AI.tldr: 本文提出人工智能物料清单（AIBOM）模式，通过扩展 CycloneDX 标准以刻画 AI 专属的溯源、模型血缘与披露元数据；结合结构化模式工程、密码学校验与智能体驱动的自动化流水线，实现可机器验证的 AI 供应链溯源与可复现性审计。实证结果为 98.7% 可复现保真度、96.2% 漏洞匹配精确率，容器化分析工作流中人工监督减少 63%。
AI.motivation: AI 系统日益依赖复杂的多层软件供应链，导致复现性不足、透明度缺失与安全保障难以验证。传统 SBOM 主要面向传统软件组件与依赖关系，难以覆盖模型权重、数据集、训练管线与推理环境等 AI 特有要素，也缺乏可机器验证的溯源链与自动化审计手段。此外，AI 系统的披露合规要求（如模型与数据来源声明）需要结构化元数据承载，但现有标准缺乏统一表达方式。因此需要一种面向 AI 的、形式化的物料清单与自动化验证框架。
AI.method: （1）模式工程：以 CycloneDX 为基础扩展 AIBOM 模式，定义 AI 专属组件类型（模型、数据集、训练/推理管线、算力与容器环境）、模型血缘（lineage）关系以及披露元数据字段，形成形式化、机器可读的溯源表达。（2）密码学校验：对清单条目及其血缘关系施加签名/哈希绑定，构建从源码、构建产物、模型权重到部署环境的端到端可验证溯源链（provenance chain），使篡改可被检测。（3）智能体自动化：开发自主 AI 流水线，持续执行环境巡检、漏洞信息富化（将 SBOM/AIBOM 条目与漏洞数据库关联匹配）以及可复现性审计，形成闭环的"发现—富化—验证"流程。（4）实证评估：在容器化的分析工作流环境中，以可复现保真度、漏洞匹配精确率、人工监督削减比例等指标对框架进行量化评测。
AI.result: 实证评估显示：可复现性保真度达 98.7%；漏洞匹配精确率 96.2%；在容器化分析工作流中人工监督工作量降低 63%。结果表明，基于智能体的自动化溯源保障与 AI 生命周期可复现性校验在工程上可行，AIBOM 能够为 AI 供应链提供结构化、可验证的元数据基座，并支持与既有工具链的集成。
AI.conclusion: AIBOM 框架将 AI 供应链透明度与 AI 可复现性工程标准化，验证了自动化溯源保障的可行性：形式化模式 + 密码学溯源链 + 智能体流水线可在降低人工成本的同时维持高保真度的复现与漏洞检测能力。论文主张该方法具备可推广性，可用于加固 AI 系统、强化溯源完整性，并为符合国际信息安全与合规标准提供技术支撑；后续方向可包括模式与外部法规披露要求的进一步对齐、跨组织信任根与联邦验证机制、以及更大规模的实证评测。

title: Improving Retrieval-Augmented Generation without Taxonomy-based Error Categorization
summary: Retrieval-Augmented Generation (RAG) improves the factual accuracy of large language model (LLM) outputs by grounding generation in external knowledge. Recent agentic RAG systems extend this paradigm with critical agents to evaluate model responses and iteratively refine outputs. However, most prior work implicitly assumes reliable critic feedback and focuses on planning strategies, while paying limited attention to the robustness of the error-correction process itself, which can be impacted by misaligned error categories and ineffective or incorrect corrections. Here, we hypothesize that RAG performance can be improved without explicit error categorization. We propose RePAIR, a response-action learning paradigm that directly maps flawed RAG outputs to error-mitigating action plans without relying on fine-grained error taxonomies and explicit critic supervision. Across multiple benchmarks, RePAIR consistently improves agentic RAG performance.

AI.tldr: 本文提出RePAIR，一种无需显式错误分类即可提升RAG性能的响应-动作学习范式。该方法直接建立缺陷输出与纠正行动之间的映射，在多个基准上验证了其有效性。
AI.motivation: 现有agentic RAG系统隐式假设可靠的评论家反馈，主要关注规划策略，但忽视了错误纠正过程本身的鲁棒性问题，包括错误类别对齐错误及无效/错误的纠正。
AI.method: RePAIR采用响应-动作学习范式，将缺陷RAG输出直接映射到错误缓解的行动计划，无需依赖细粒度错误分类体系或显式评论家监督。
AI.result: RePAIR在多个基准测试中一致性地提升了agentic RAG性能。
AI.conclusion: RePAIR通过端到端的响应-动作学习范式，无需显式错误分类即可提升RAG系统的鲁棒性，为agentic RAG的错误纠正提供了新思路。

title: Understanding Inference Scaling for LLMs: Bottlenecks, Trade-offs, and Performance Principles
comment: ISCA'26: The 53rd International Symposium on Computer Architecture, Industry Track
summary: The transition from standard generative AI to \emph{reasoning-centric architectures}, exemplified by models capable of extensive Chain-of-Thought~(CoT) processing, marks a fundamental paradigm shift in system requirements. Unlike traditional workloads dominated by compute-bound prefill, reasoning workloads generate long chains of reasoning tokens that shift inference into a \emph{Capacity-Bound regime}. This paper presents a comprehensive system characterization, evaluating models ranging from 8B to 671B parameters on GPUs clusters. By systematically exploring the interplay between Data, Tensor, and Pipeline parallelism, we identify critical bottlenecks that defy standard scaling heuristics. Our analysis reveals that data parallelism is throughput efficient for small models but hits a capacity trap on reasoning workloads as KV-cache fragmentation forces early throttling resulting in sub-optimal compute utilization. Tensor parallelism unlocks stranded memory and delivers sublinear gains near the 32B crossover. At frontier scale, dense models (e.g., Llama-405B) are interconnect and memory-bandwidth bound and favor high-degree TP, while sparse Mixture-of-Experts (MoE) models (e.g., DeepSeek-R1) are limited by routing and synchronization latency and benefit from hybrid strategies. These insights provide a rigorous decision framework for navigating the reasoning cliff, establishing new architectural imperatives for the next generation of inference infrastructure.

AI.tldr: 本文系统分析了从标准生成式AI到推理中心架构的范式转变，通过对8B至671B参数模型的评估，揭示了数据并行、Tensor并行和Pipeline并行在推理工作负载下的关键瓶颈，发现KV-cache碎片化导致容量陷阱，MoE模型与稠密模型具有不同的并行策略优化方向。
AI.motivation: 随着CoT推理模型生成大量推理token，系统从compute-bound转向capacity-bound regime，标准扩展策略失效，现有系统设计无法有效支撑长链推理工作负载，亟需新的架构决策框架。
AI.method: 在GPU集群上对8B至671B参数模型进行系统性评估，探究Data、Tensor、Pipeline三种并行策略的交互作用，识别各规模模型的关键瓶颈。
AI.result: 数据并行对小模型吞吐高效，但推理工作负载中KV-cache碎片化导致容量陷阱和计算利用率不足；Tensor并行可释放 stranded memory，32B参数规模附近收益递减；稠密模型（如Llama-405B）受限于互联带宽和内存带宽，偏好高维度TP；稀疏MoE模型（如DeepSeek-R1）受路由和同步延迟限制，适合混合策略。
AI.conclusion: 推理工作负载需要重新审视并行策略选择标准，KV-cache管理是关键瓶颈，稠密与稀疏模型需差异化优化策略，为下一代推理基础设施提供系统性决策框架。

title: Compositional Literary Primitives in Instruction-Tuned LLMs: Cross-Architectural SAE Features for Self, Style, and Affect
summary: We characterize a compositional architecture of literary primitives in two instruction-tuned large language models (Llama 3.1 8B-Instruct and Gemma 2 9B-IT) via sparse autoencoders on mid-depth residual streams. Four feature classes emerge: naming-gates that promote lexical tokens of a target affect, an eleven-self cluster of first-person register features, stylistic register modulators (show-don't-tell and defamiliarization), and compositional emotions that arise only from multi-feature steering. Under a forced-choice 5-LLM judge panel applied to a 27-category emotion taxonomy (Cowen-Keltner), Llama reaches full 27/27 coverage by combining naming-gates, multi-feature recipes, and single self-feature steering; Gemma reaches 23/27 with adoration as the single residual strict-fail. Under random judging, the per-cell pass probability is on the order of $10^{-3}$ and the expected number of two-seed false-positive cells across the catalog is negligible, so the observed coverage is not consistent with chance.
