AI.motivation: RAG 在检索上下文知识（CK）与参数知识（PK）不一致或都不可靠时会产生知识冲突。现有工作三大路线——源仲裁（source-arbitration）、上下文质量处理（context-quality）、检索调控（retrieval-regulation）——都只在"选哪个源"上做协调，从未独立地检验"PK 路径或 CK 路径各自是否会答对"，把"两者都错"这一情形排除在决策空间之外，从而把模型推向自信但错误、无依据的回答而非诚实的"我不知道"。作者主张忠实（faithful）RAG 需要 LLM 的自我觉察：既包括知识边界觉察（何时自身知识不足，对应"自信幻觉"），也包括推理可靠性觉察（何时检索上下文导致不可信答案，对应"上下文过度依赖"）。论文以"开卷考试"类比：学生=LLM，记忆=PK，可能有误的参考书=CK，两条路径都不可靠时应选择弃答。
AI.method:
【基准构建】从五个冲突型 QA 数据集（ConFiQA 的 QA/MR/MC 三个子任务、ConflictQA-PopQA、ConflictBank 抽样约12K、以及 Huang 等构造的 TriviaQA 与 NQ 对抗子集）汇总；四骨干（Qwen-2.5-3B/7B-Instruct、Llama-3.1-8B、Llama-3.2-3B-Instruct）各自运行 PK-only 与 CK-conditioned 两条答案路径，用 alias 感知匹配（Unicode 归一→精确匹配→token 包含级联）对齐真值，得到四格 (y_PK, y_CK) 可靠性标注；每骨干 55,097/6,889/6,886 训练/验证/测试，共约 68,872 条；按 query id 划分 80/10/10。指标：Acc、CF（仅 CK 正确格的准确率）、KF（仅 PK 正确格的准确率）、MFS=(CF+KF)/2，以及选择性预测指标 Score（对+1/错-1/弃0）、Coverage、R_C、弃答 F1。

【SABER 方法】冻结骨干，测试时两级估计：
1) 自我先验表征 h_q：仅输入原始问题（无 system、无指令模板）前向一次，读固定先验层 ℓ_p 的隐状态。
2) 条件推理表征：PK 侧与 CK 侧各采样 K=3 条 CoT 推理链（温度0.9、top-p 1.0、重复惩罚1.05、max 256 token、种子0/1/2），再对每条链做自评估前向（询问该推理是否事实可靠），读固定条件层 ℓ_c 上推理段的逐 token 隐状态并均值池化；多条链再均值池化为每侧稳健条件状态 h^(s)_cond。
3) 联合表征 z^(s)=concat(h_q, h^(s)_cond)；两个轻量 MLP 预测器（隐层 256-128、ReLU、dropout 0.2、逐特征标准化、AdamW 1e-3、weight decay 1e-4、batch 256、BCE-with-logits、最多 50 epoch、验证 AUROC 早停 patience 8、seed 42）以 [z^(PK); z^(CK)] 为输入（共享输入、独立输出）分别输出 p̂_PK、p̂_CK，两个预测器独立用基准中的 y_PK、y_CK 以 BCE 训练。
4) 阈值 τ 划分四格：C10 输出 PK 答案、C01 输出 CK 答案、C11 取信念更高者（均不再调用 LLM）；C00 提供两种部署模式——默认回退到信念较高的候选（保覆盖），或弃答模式返回 "I don't know"。τ 扫描 [0.05,0.95] 产生连续风险-覆盖曲线，默认 τ=0.5 无需按骨干调参。

【实验】对比 10 个基线分四类：Vanilla（Closed-Book、Vanilla RAG）、言语自评（Internal-Eval、Context-Eval、Implicit-SCR、Explicit-SCR）、概率/探针启发式（TPC、TACS-LR）、训练类（CR-DPO、R-Tuning）。另做消融（Prior、C1、C3、P+C1）、层敏感性网格扫描、留一数据集（LODO）跨数据集泛化与计算成本对比。
AI.result: 主结果（20 个骨干-数据集设定）：SABER 在除一处外所有设定取得最佳 Acc，在全部设定取得最佳 MFS；相对最强推理期基线平均 Acc +3.4%、MFS +15.4%；最大增益为 Llama-3.1-8B/ConflictBank 的 +10.6% Acc 与 Llama-3.1-8B/ConflictQA 的 +27.3% MFS。SABER 与全量 LoRA 微调的 CR-DPO 相当甚至更优（在两个 3B 骨干的全部数据集与指标上严格占优）；MFS 增益远大于 Acc 增益，说明优势来自冲突消解而非单纯准确率；Llama 家族 Acc 增益更大（+4.9% vs Qwen +2.0%），MFS 增益跨族稳定（+14%~+16%）。弃答实验（τ=0.5，全基准）：SABER 在四个骨干上均取得最高 Score、最低 R_C、最高弃答 F1（如 Llama-3.1-8B：Score 43.9、Coverage 65.0、R_C 16.2、F1 72.5；Qwen-2.5-3B：39.6/60.0/17.0/76.6），领先幅度随骨干变小而扩大（+18.5% 至 +32.0%）；基于判断式提示的基线（Context-Eval、Explicit-SCR、Internal-Eval）几乎不作答、弃答 F1 极低，结构性失败。风险-覆盖曲线上 SABER 帕累托支配所有提示型弃答器，在与 Implicit-SCR 相同 Coverage 下 R_C 相对下降 19%~53%；Score 在 τ∈[0.40,0.55] 内波动不超过 0.009。消融：各变体均低于完整方法；条件推理表征贡献最大（仅条件变体较仅先验变体平均 +2.8% Acc、+13.4% MFS）；多链均值池化收益最大者在最小骨干（Qwen-2.5-3B 的 P+C1→P+C3 使 MFS 从 84.1% 升到 87.3%）。层敏感性：最优层对落在中后段深度（占总深度约 40%~70%）的宽阔高准确率高原上，非孤立峰值。LODO：Acc 差距约 ±3%、MFS 差距约 10% 以内（ConflictBank 与 ConflictQA 因冲突格式独特而例外），LODO SABER 在 28 格中 19 格 Acc、20 格 MFS 优于各格最强提示型零样本基线。计算成本：预测器约 5M 参数、峰值显存 <2GB、单卡 A5000 训练 <0.6 GPU-h（对比 R-Tuning 约 13、CR-DPO 约 72 GPU-h）。
AI.conclusion: 将 RAG 知识冲突从"选源"问题重述为真值对齐的"决策+弃答"问题，并证明忠实 RAG 需要模型具备自我觉察：先用 PK-only/CK-conditioned 双路径标注构建模型特定的四格可靠性基准（每骨干约 69K），再用冻结 LLM 的隐状态构造知识边界自我先验与源条件推理可靠性自评估，训练两个轻量预测器输出 PK/CK 信念，驱动"信 PK / 信 CK / 信两者 / 弃答"的四格决策。结果显示 SABER 无需微调即可在端到端准确率与冲突忠实度上稳定超越强基线，并在四个骨干上以风险-覆盖曲线帕累托支配所有提示型弃答器，τ 提供无需重训的部署级覆盖率-风险调节旋钮。局限：仅四个开源指令模型（未覆盖更大骨干）、假设上下文已给定而不涉及检索本身、基准为静态快照（新模型需重新标注）。更广启示：以自我觉察为基础的 RAG 有望在证据不足时选择诚实弃答而非强行作答。

title: Towards LLM-Assisted Architecture Recovery for Real-World ROS~2 Systems: An Agent-Based Multi-Level Approach to Hierarchical Structural Architecture Reconstruction
summary:
Explicit software architecture models are essential artifacts for communicating, analyzing, and evolving complex software-intensive systems. In ROS~2-based robotic systems, however, structural (de-)composition and integration semantics are often only implicitly encoded across distributed artifacts such as source code and launch files, making recovery of hierarchical architecture particularly difficult. Existing approaches mainly focus on node-level entities and communication wiring, while providing limited support for recovering hierarchical structural (de-)composition across multiple abstraction levels.
  In this paper, we extend our previously proposed blueprint-guided LLM-assisted architecture recovery pipeline for ROS~2 systems through two major enhancements: (1) refined prompting to improve the consistency and controllability of architecture synthesis, and (2) a staged recovery strategy based on multi-level intermediate architectural representations that incorporate the atomic ROS node list and launch file dependencies, thereby enabling structurally constrained reconstruction across multiple abstraction levels.
  The approach is evaluated on a real-world automated product disassembly system based on cooperative robotic arms and heterogeneous ROS~2 artifacts. Compared to our previous work, the considered case study exhibits substantially higher integration complexity and richer functionality. The results demonstrate improved structural consistency, scalability, and robustness of architecture recovery, while also revealing remaining challenges related to dynamic integration semantics in large-scale ROS~2 systems.

AI.tldr: 本文提出一种基于蓝图引导的LLM辅助ROS~2架构恢复管道的改进方案，通过精细化提示策略和多层中间表示实现跨抽象层次的层级结构恢复，并在协作机械臂产品拆解系统上验证了架构恢复的一致性、可扩展性和鲁棒性。
AI.motivation: ROS~2系统中，结构（解）组合和集成语义通常隐式编码在源代码、启动文件等分布式工件中，导致层级架构恢复困难。现有方法主要关注节点级实体和通信连接，缺乏跨多抽象层次的结构恢复支持。
AI.method: 两大核心改进：(1) 精细化提示策略，提升架构合成的一致性和可控性；(2) 基于多层次中间架构表示的分阶段恢复策略，融合原子ROS节点列表和启动文件依赖，支持跨多抽象层次的结构约束重建。
AI.result: 在协作机械臂自动产品拆解系统上验证，相比前序工作，该案例具有更高的集成复杂度和更丰富的功能。结果表明架构恢复的结构一致性、可扩展性和鲁棒性均有所提升。
AI.conclusion: 所提方法有效改善了ROS~2系统的架构恢复能力，但在大规模ROS~2系统中，动态集成语义相关的挑战仍有待解决。

title: Not All Tokens Are Worth Caching: Learning Semantic-Aware Eviction for LLM Prefix Caches
summary: Prefix caching is a key optimization in Large Language Model (LLM) serving, reusing attention Key-Value (KV) states across requests with shared prompt prefixes to reduce expensive prefill computation. However, its benefit depends critically on the eviction policy as GPU memory is scarce, and existing policies such as LRU largely treat cached blocks uniformly. This view ignores a fundamental property of LLM prompts: not all tokens are equally worth caching. We show that different token types within a prompt, including system prompts, user queries, tool outputs, model responses, and chain-of-thought reasoning, exhibit up to 756x variation in reuse rates, yet no existing eviction policy exploits this signal. In this paper, we present SAECache (Semantic-Adaptive Eviction for prefix caches), a semantic-adaptive prefix cache eviction policy that addresses this gap through three innovations: (1) a multi-queue architecture that routes KV blocks to task-specific queues with tailored priority metrics, capturing both session reuse in multi-turn requests and structural reuse in templated single-turn requests; (2) a semantic-aware token weighting mechanism that learns the reuse value of different token types online through eviction feedback; and (3) a fully adaptive online learning schema for all parameter updates, including log-normal timing parameters, position decay power, queue weights, and meta-parameters, which eliminates manual tuning and enables automatic adaptation to deployment-specific workload characteristics. Through extensive evaluation across heterogeneous workloads, we demonstrate that SAECache achieves 1.4x-2.7x TTFT improvement over production-style baselines, while fixed-parameter alternatives can degrade by up to 2.7x under workload mismatch -- a failure mode our adaptive approach avoids entirely.

AI.tldr: SAECache提出了一种语义自适应的前缀缓存淘汰策略，通过多队列架构、语义感知token权重机制和全自适应在线学习，解决现有策略忽视不同token类型复用率差异的问题，在异构工作负载下实现1.4x-2.7x的TTFT提升，并避免了固定参数方法在负载失配时高达2.7x的性能退化。
AI.motivation: Existing prefix cache eviction policies (e.g., LRU) treat all cached blocks uniformly, ignoring that different token types (system prompts, user queries, tool outputs, model responses, chain-of-thought) exhibit up to 756x variation in reuse rates. This uniform treatment leads to suboptimal caching decisions when GPU memory is scarce.
AI.method: (1) Multi-queue architecture routing KV blocks to task-specific queues with tailored priority metrics; (2) Semantic-aware token weighting mechanism learning reuse value online through eviction feedback; (3) Fully adaptive online learning schema for all parameters including log-normal timing, position decay power, queue weights, and meta-parameters.
AI.result: SAECache achieves 1.4x-2.7x TTFT improvement over production-style baselines, while fixed-parameter alternatives degrade by up to 2.7x under workload mismatch -- a failure mode SAECache avoids entirely through its adaptive approach.
AI.conclusion: SAECache eliminates manual tuning through fully adaptive online learning, making it robust to workload changes and suitable for diverse deployment scenarios.

title: How Faithful Is Trajectory-Based Data Attribution? Error Sources, Remedies, and Practical Guidelines
summary: Trajectory-based data attribution methods estimate the influence of training samples on model predictions by unrolling the training trajectory. They are widely used in applications such as data selection, data valuation, and model diagnosis, but there is a lack of comprehensive error analysis of these methods, raising concerns about method faithfulness and hindering reliable deployment. In this work, we provide the first systematic analysis of error sources in trajectory-based data attribution, together with concrete remedies to mitigate them and practical guidelines for downstream use. We organize the total error into three categories, config-level, algorithm-level, and system-level. We make three contributions. First, we identify optimizer mismatch as the dominant config-level error: existing methods derive their attribution under the assumption of SGD, even for models trained with the modern de facto optimizer AdamW. We propose AdamW-influence to fully account for AdamW's optimization dynamics, yielding improvements from 10% to over 300% in Spearman correlation between estimated and ground-truth influence across four settings spanning MLP, CNN, GPT-2, and Llama 3.2-1B. Second, we isolate the remaining algorithm-level error arising from the first-order Taylor approximation, identify the learning rate and trajectory length as factors governing the error magnitude, and derive a closed-form error proxy that can be evaluated along the original trajectory without retraining. Third, we translate these insights into practical guidelines for data selection by unifying offline and online strategies under a K-step look-ahead framework. Under this framework, online selection with a short horizon often matches or exceeds offline, and the optimal horizon can be tuned jointly with the learning rate. Together, these results turn the framework into an actionable selection recipe for practitioners.

AI.tldr: 本文首次对基于轨迹的数据归因（trajectory-based data attribution，如 SGD-influence、TracIn、SOURCE、DVEmb）做了系统的误差分析，并将总误差划分为 config-level（配置级，如优化器失配）、algorithm-level（算法级，如一阶泰勒近似）和 system-level（系统级，浮点精度/GPU 非确定性）三类。作者提出的核心方法是 AdamW-influence：在梯度级注入扰动，通过对参数与一阶/二阶动量构成的增广状态做线性动力学反向递推（O(T) 复杂度），准确展开 AdamW 的动量与逐坐标自适应缩放；该方法在与 TSLOO 真值的 Spearman 相关上相对 SGD-influence 提升 10%–300% 以上。作者进一步指出：一阶泰勒带来的"更新估计误差"是剩余主要误差，其大小由学习率（逐步误差幅度）与轨迹长度 T−t*（误差累积深度）共同支配，并推导了可在原轨迹上无重训计算的闭式误差代理（与真值误差范数的 Spearman ρ∈[0.83,0.89]）；最终将离线/在线数据选择统一到 K 步前瞻框架，给出"在线 + 短horizon 常不劣于离线、最优 K 随学习率减小而增大"的可操作配方。
AI.motivation: 轨迹式数据归因（SGD-influence、TracIn、SOURCE、DVEmb）通过展开训练轨迹估计单个训练样本对模型预测的影响，已被广泛用于数据清洗、数据选择、数据估值与模型诊断。但随着该方法从概念工具走向实用工具，实务者在部署时无法回答三个基本问题：(1) 一次训练中的归因误差有多大？(2) 误差来自归因公式与真实训练动态的失配（如优化器），还是来自算法自身的近似？(3) 常规训练选择（优化器、学习率）如何影响误差？此前没有任何系统性分析回答这些问题，导致下游应用暴露在来源与量级均未知的误差之下，阻碍了方法的可靠落地。同时，现有方法（SGD-influence、TracIn 等）均在 SGD 假设下推导归因公式，而现代模型几乎普遍使用 AdamW 训练，形成了每一步都存在的系统性偏差。
AI.method:
**1. 误差分类体系。** 将总归因误差（估计值与 TSLOO 真值之差）拆为三类：config-level error（归因公式未忠实反映真实训练过程，如优化器、batch 组成、数据课程、学习率调度）、algorithm-level error（为效率引入的近似，如参数轨迹的一阶泰勒展开）、system-level error（浮点精度与 GPU 非确定性，属算法设计不可约减部分，实测占比相对很小）。

**2. AdamW-influence（修正 config-level 主导误差）。** 难点在于 AdamW 的两点特性：动量/二阶矩状态跨步携带扰动，以及逐坐标自适应缩放使更新对梯度非线性——因此 SGD 推导中"参数级扰动 ≡ 从 batch 中移除样本"的等价关系在 AdamW 下失效。作者改为在**梯度级注入扰动**（g_{t*}(ε)=g_{t*}−ε·g_{t*,z*}，ε=1 恰好移除样本 z*），并把状态提升为增广向量 Z_t=(θ̇_t, ṁ_{t−1}, v̇_{t−1})∈R^{3p}，使扰动满足线性动力系统 Z_{t+1}=A_t Z_t。转移矩阵分解为 A_t=M_t+R_t H_t P（M_t 收集动量衰减与权重衰减等无 Hessian 项，R_t 收集经 Hessian 的耦合项，H_t 用 GGN 近似），从而得到与 SGD-influence 同构的反向递推 W^{(t)}=W^{(t+1)}M_t+(W^{(t+1)}R_t)H_tP，逐样本得 AdamW-influence_{z*}=W^{(t*+1)}Z_push(z*)，复杂度 O(T)。由于 D_t、S_t 的逐坐标非线性破坏了 Johnson–Lindenstrauss 随机投影性质，改用**固定二值随机掩码**（全步共享掩码）压缩维度，LLM 规模下用多掩码集成平均。

**3. 算法级误差的解剖。** 把 SGD-influence 的绝对误差按"优化器失配（绿）+ 更新估计误差（蓝）+ 高阶与系统残差（灰）"作可加分解，显示修正优化器后更新估计误差占绝对多数；用参数空间误差范数 ‖Δθ_{z*}−AdamW-influence_{z*}‖₂ 与步内 Spearman 相关（intra-step ρ）扫描学习率与轨迹位置，证明误差幅度随学习率增大而单调上升、随剩余轨迹长度 T−t* 缩短而下降。

**4. 闭式误差代理。** 定义 e_t=[θ_t(1)−θ_t(0)]−θ̇_t、r_t=[U_t(1)−U_t(0)]−U̇_t，推出 e_T=−Σ_t [Π_k(I−A_k^eff)] r_t(0)；再由 f_{t,i}=m̂_{t,i}/(√v̂_{t,i}+ε) 的二阶导展开得 |r_{t,i}| ~ η_t(‖θ̇_t‖²/√v̂_{t,i} + [H_tθ̇_t]_i²/v̂_{t,i})，即逐坐标残差代理，含区分样本的项 ‖θ̇_t‖²+[H_tθ̇_t]_i²。该代理复用 AdamW-influence 已有量，仅需每步一次 HVP，总成本 O(T)。

**5. 数据选择的 K 步前瞻统一框架。** 在第 t 步对候选样本 z 打分 s_t^(K)(z)=∇ℓ(θ_t,z^(val))^T·θ̇_{t+K+1}(z)，保留 top-B 作为训练 batch。K=0 复现 GREATS 的逐步打分；K=T−t 为全轨迹horizon（不可在线执行，由离线选择在已完成参考轨迹上近似）。据此统一离线与在线策略，并分析"最优 K 随学习率变化"的权衡。
AI.result:
**保真度（对 TSLOO 重训真值的 Spearman ρ）。** AdamW 训练下 AdamW-influence 在四种设定全面优于 SGD-influence，相对提升 10%–500%（如 MNIST+MLP η=1e-3：0.205 vs 0.075，+173%；MNIST+CNN η=1e-3：0.090 vs 0.015，+500%；WikiText+GPT-2 η=1e-4：0.734 vs 0.372，+97%；Alpaca+Llama3.2-1B η=5e-7：0.665 vs 0.330，+102%），且提升在高学习率下最大（此时 SGD 最不能代表 AdamW 更新）。反向对称验证：当实际训练用 SGD 时，SGD-influence 反过来大幅占优，说明增益源于"归因公式与训练优化器匹配"而非方法本身优劣。

**误差分解。** 修正优化器失配后，更新估计误差（一阶泰勒）占剩余误差的绝大多数，高阶残差（含系统级）始终很小；优化器失配份额随学习率降低、随训练推进而增大，即"低学习率/短轨迹"这类最贴近数据选择的场景中，优化器对齐最为关键。

**两因素规律。** 误差范数随学习率单调增大、步内 Spearman 相应下降（η=1e-5 最高、1e-3 最低）；随剩余轨迹长度 T−t* 缩短，误差范数下降、步内相关上升，AdamW-influence 在极短轨迹下步内相关接近完美，说明短horizon归因即使在高学习率下也可靠。

**误差代理。** 闭式代理与 TSLOO 重训得到的真实误差范数在 MLP/CNN × 两个学习率共四种设定下 Spearman ρ∈[0.83,0.89]，成本 O(T)，可用于逐样本的无重训误差感知。

**数据选择。** 在线 AdamW-influence 在四个设定（MNIST+MLP/CNN 错误率、Llama3.2-1B 在 Tulu3 与 Alpaca 上的困惑度）均优于在线 SGD-influence，并与离线 AdamW-influence 持平或更优（离线对应最长 horizon、累积误差最大）；最优 K 随学习率减小而增大（η=1e-2→K=5，1e-3→K=10，1e-4→K=25），验证了"信息量 vs 近似误差"的权衡预测。附录 Tulu3 实验中，在全量微调/LoRA × 选中比例 0.5/0.8 共 8 种配置下，在线 AdamW-influence 的验证与测试困惑度均为最低，优于离线 AdamW-influence、在线 SGD-influence 与离线 TracIn 基线。

**成本。** AdamW-influence 相对 SGD-influence 的摘要矩阵 W∈R^{p×3p} 与逐步计算带来 3× 工作内存与计算开销，逐样本嵌入尺寸不变；随机掩码保持 3× 比例并将 p² 成本降为 |S|²。实验总耗时约 400 A100 GPU 小时。
AI.conclusion: 本文给出轨迹式数据归因的首个系统性误差分析：三级误差分类（配置级/算法级/系统级）、针对主导配置级误差的 AdamW-influence 修正方案、对剩余一阶泰勒算法级误差的两因素（学习率、轨迹长度）刻画与闭式误差代理，以及统一离线与在线数据选择的 K 步前瞻实用指南。核心实践建议是：(1) 归因公式必须与实际训练优化器对齐（AdamW 训练必须用 AdamW-influence，反之亦然）；(2) 关注归因保真度时应同时考虑学习率与轨迹长度，小学习率与短轨迹对近似误差更宽容；(3) 数据选择优先采用在线 + 小到中等 K 的前瞻，且 K 应与学习率联合调优（学习率越小最优 K 越大），不宜固定；作者也指出在极小学习率、短训练或后期微调场景下离线策略仍具竞争力。作者认为这标志着归因方法正从"黑盒打分函数"转向"可诊断的估计器"。局限：分析仅覆盖使用一阶泰勒的轨迹式归因（SGD-influence/TracIn 等），向 MAGIC、Simfluence 等其他归因方法的推广仍待研究；LLM 实验受算力限制仅到 Llama 3.2-1B；任务限于监督分类与语言建模，是否迁移到强化学习、扩散模型等场景是开放问题。

title: Not all uncertainty is alike: volatility, stochasticity, and exploration
summary: Adaptive decision-making in biological and artificial intelligence requires balancing the exploitation of known outcomes with the exploration of uncertain alternatives. Although prior work suggests that uncertainty generally promotes exploration, it has typically treated distinct sources of environmental uncertainty as equivalent. We consider environments with latent reward states that drift over time (volatility) and are observed through noisy outcomes (stochasticity). Both increase posterior uncertainty, yet we show they drive optimal exploration in opposite directions: volatility enhances it, stochasticity suppresses it. We establish this asymmetry formally by extending the Gittins index framework to Gaussian state-space bandits with latent dynamics. We further derive Cause-Aware Uncertainty-Sensitive Exploration (CAUSE), a closed-form exploration bonus obtained via control-as-inference that inherits the same monotonicities. CAUSE outperforms standard exploration strategies in environments with heterogeneous noise structure, and also improves on a Gittins-per-arm policy whose rested-bandit optimality does not transfer to restless settings. Learning and exploration are governed by the same noise-inference asymmetry, and the framework predicts that pathological noise inference produces \emph{reversed} rather than merely impaired exploration, with implications for computational accounts of psychiatric conditions.

AI.tldr: 本文揭示了环境不确定性的两种来源（波动性和随机性）对探索行为具有相反影响：波动性促进探索，而随机性抑制探索。通过将Gittins指数框架扩展到具有潜动态的高斯状态空间 bandit 问题，并推导出因果感知的不确定性敏感探索（CAUSE）算法，证明了这一不对称性。实验表明CAUSE在异构噪声环境中表现优异，且该框架对精神疾病的计算建模具有启示意义。
AI.motivation: 传统决策理论将环境不确定性视为统一概念，忽略了不同类型不确定性对探索行为的差异化影响。然而现实中，奖励可能因环境变化而漂移（波动性），也可能因信号噪声而模糊（随机性）。这种区分对于构建更真实的人工和生物智能系统至关重要。
AI.method: 1. 将Gittins指数框架扩展到具有潜动态的高斯状态空间 bandit 模型；2. 通过控制即推理（control-as-inference）框架推导出闭环形式的探索奖励 CAUSE；3. 在具有异构噪声结构的多种环境中进行算法对比实验。
AI.result: 形式化证明波动性增强探索而随机性抑制探索的不对称性；CAUSE 算法在异构噪声环境中优于标准探索策略，且在 restless bandit 设置中优于传统 per-arm Gittins 策略；发现异常的噪声推理会导致"反转"而非仅仅是受损的探索行为。
AI.conclusion: 学习与探索受相同的不确定性-推理不对称性支配。该框架为理解精神疾病中的探索缺陷提供了计算模型，暗示某些精神障碍可能源于噪声推理机制的异常，而非简单的探索能力缺失。

title: RecoAtlas: From Semantic Plausibility to Set-Level Utility in LLM Recommendation Agents
summary: LLM recommendation agents increasingly produce structured recommendation reports: sets of items accompanied by natural-language justifications. Yet existing evaluations often reduce this setting to reranking small shortlisted candidate sets or judge reports mainly by semantic plausibility. We introduce Recommendation Atlas (Agentic Tool-Level Assessment for Shopping), or RecoAtlas, a benchmark and toolkit for evaluating shopping agents with behavior-grounded metrics. RecoAtlas complements held-out interaction metrics with learned utility proxies for relevance, complementarity, and diversity derived from interaction data, while separately measuring semantic coherence and explanation quality. Its controlled tool environment exposes agents to either semantic, behavior-aligned, or faulty tools, enabling diagnosis of whether performance gains arise from stronger reasoning, better signals, or more effective tool-use policies. Across controlled experiments, we show that RecoAtlas exhibits key properties of a meaningful benchmark for agentic systems: performance scales with model capacity and test-time compute, improves with stronger and better-aligned tools, degrades under noisy or misaligned signals, and reveals that semantic plausibility does not necessarily capture behavior-grounded utility. RecoAtlas provides a foundation for developing and evaluating shopping assistants that optimize not only for plausible recommendations, but also for coherent, behaviorally grounded recommendation sets.

AI.tldr: RecoAtlas（Recommendation Atlas，Criteo AI Lab 提出）是一个面向"LLM 购物推荐代理"的、行为数据对齐的**集合级（set-level）**评测基准与工具套件。其核心主张是：LLM 代理输出的是"商品集合+自然语言理由"的结构化报告，因此评测不应停留在语义合理性（semantic plausibility），而应度量集合的真实效用。RecoAtlas 用三组互补视角评测同一份报告：(1) 基于留出交互数据的精确召回 SetHit@K；(2) 从交互数据训练的学习型 reward model，分别给出相关性（relevance）、互补性（complementarity）、多样性/非冗余（diversity）三个分量；(3) 独立于行为指标的 LLM-judge 语义与解释质量打分。并配套三类受控工具（semantic / behavior-aligned / faulty 版本）以诊断性能增益来自更强推理、更好信号还是更优工具调用策略。核心发现：LLM-judge 与行为效用指标几乎不对齐甚至排序反转；集合效用随模型规模与测试时计算显著上升；互补性工具是 bundle 任务的关键瓶颈；工具质量下降不仅降低召回，还改变集合结构。
AI.motivation: LLM 推荐代理的输出形态已从"排序商品列表"变为"结构化推荐报告"——一组商品 ID 及其自然语言理由，因此评测目标从 item-level 精度变为 set-level 效用：一份好报告不是若干相关商品，而是一个能共同满足用户需求、内部结构良好的集合（例如"我想学吉他"应给出琴+调音器+拨片+背带+琴盒+琴弦的组合，而非多把吉他；对比购物应给出有实质差异的替代品而非近似重复品）。而现有评测存在三类缺口：(1) 候选集重排类基准（如 AgentRecBench、RecMind）只给模型一个含单个留出真值的小候选集，评估的是局部重排，既不检验大目录搜索能力，也不检验多物品组合能力；(2) LLM-judge 类评测主要度量语义合理性，一份流畅、论证充分的报告完全可能推荐用户很少购买或很少同时搭配的商品；(3) 在线 A/B 测试虽是金标准，但需要生产基础设施与真实流量，无法作为开放基准的基础。作者因此需要一个可复现、离线、行为对齐、集合级、可诊断的评测框架。
AI.method:
**任务与环境**：在 Amazon 三个品类（Musical Instruments、Electronics、Video Games）各构建一个目录环境，含商品文本、细粒度子类标签、用户-物品交互、PPMI 共购图与预训练/训练后的嵌入（Qwen3-Embedding-0.6B，final-token pooling，L2 归一化，FAISS HNSW 索引）。两个任务族：**comparative shopping**（需相关但非冗余的替代品，留出真值为单物品）与 **bundle shopping**（需角色互补、构成整体配置的商品，留出真值为 3–7 件商品集合）。代理输入自然语言 query，输出固定长度 K=20 的报告 S=((i1,e1),…,(iK,eK))，最多 10 次工具调用轮次，禁止编造商品 ID；输出校验后缺失位、重复位、越界 ID 均按零贡献计入分母。每类每任务固定 250 条 query，即每种被测方法 3×2×250=1500 个 episode。

**三视图评测**：(1) **SetHit@K**：对留出真值集合的精确召回（对比任务退化为全目录 Hit@20，而非短list重排）；(2) **学习型 reward model**（均为 item 级打分后按 1/K 聚合）：Relevance 用 query–item 双塔（item 塔冻结、query 塔 LoRA，multi-negative BPR 损失，含同子类硬负例），推理时按该 query 的全目录分数分布做归一化；Complementarity 用 item–item 双塔（anchor/complement 两个 MLP 投影头 R^d→R^256→R^128，InfoNCE，τ=0.05，训练于 PPMI 正向共购图），推理时把每个返回项作 anchor 与其余不同子类的返回项打分并按 anchor 的全目录分布归一化；Diversity 由嵌入空间中"可比范围"（与邻近子类质心余弦>0.90）内的 in-report 相似度归一化后取 1−substitutability，且当可比范围为空时该项记 0（不自动给多样性分）。三个分量分别报告而非合成单一标量，以便诊断错误来源；(3) **LLM-judge**：与上述轴对齐的二值打分（relevance/complementarity/diversity）+ 解释质量（specificity/faithfulness/justification，及报告级 strategy_coherence、overall_report_quality），且与行为指标严格分开报告。

**工具套件**（均提供 semantic / utility / faulty 三个版本）：search_products(query,K)（预训练 vs 行为训练 query 编码器排序）；get_complementary_products(item_ids,K)（预训练嵌入+跨子类过滤 vs 学到的 anchor-complement 投影）；get_substitute_products(item_ids,thr)（同子类内余弦阈值默认 0.95 的确定性近重复剪枝，clean 语义与 utility 设定一致）。**故障注入**采用子类对抗式破坏：按比例 round(Kρ) 替换槽位，保留显示分数但换成同子类中相关度/互补性后 25% 的"貌似合理但行为差"的商品（池大小限 3–50），替代品剪枝工具则以假阴性方式把已删重复项放回；污染对同一工具名与输入是确定性的。

**基座与设置**：比较 GPT-4.1 mini、Grok 4.1 Fast、Gemini 2.5 Flash、Claude Haiku 4.5，以及 Qwen3（0.6B–32B，用于受控规模缩放）、xLAM-2 32B、Nemotron 49B、Mistral Small 24B；所有模型共享同一提示协议、输出 schema、解码设置、工具预算与目录访问（主榜使用 utility-aligned 工具）。
AI.result:
**LLM-judge 与行为效用严重错位（核心发现）**：使用 semantic 工具的代理获得更高的 LLM-judge 分，却取得显著更低的 SetHit@20，即语义评测会**反转**下游效用给出的模型排序，语义合理性不是潜在购物目标的可靠代理。

**工具消融（GPT-4.1-mini）**：无工具的纯上下文基线几乎无法召回（对比 0.010 / bundle 0.028）；仅加 search 工具使对比任务升至 0.492，但 bundle 仅 0.156，说明 bundle 需要跳出初始 query 匹配去扩展互补品；search+substitutability 保持对比性能却把 bundle 拉低到 0.124（只剪冗余无法造出完整篮子，反而可能误删有效替代品）；search+complementarity 把 bundle 提升到 0.460；完整工具集最佳（对比 0.508 / bundle 0.540）。结论：集合级推荐不能被当作纯相关性检索来评测。

**规模与测试时计算缩放（Qwen3）**：开启推理时 SetHit@20 从 0.6B 的约 0.05 升到 32B 的约 0.61（趋势非严格单调但整体明显）；关闭推理的曲线较弱，在约 14B 达峰后不再上升；两者差距在 32B 处最大（绝对差约 0.31），说明规模提供解读工具输出的容量，而推理用于决定何时调用、何时多样化、何时寻求互补、如何组装 20 件集合。

**主榜**：对比购物前沿被压缩——GPT-4.1 mini 与 Grok 4.1 Fast 最强，Gemini 2.5 Flash、Claude Haiku 4.5、Qwen3 32B、xLAM-2 32B、Nemotron 49B 紧随其后，说明有了强检索工具后，众多 LLM 都能拼出有用的替代集合；bundle 购物则 sharply 拉开差距——Nemotron 49B 与 Mistral Small 24B 拿下最高 bundle SetHit@20，其 bundle 成绩显著高于自身对比成绩并**反超最强闭源模型**，表明 bundle 表现不由通用模型强度单独决定，而取决于是否用互补性工具把种子商品扩展成功能连贯的集合。Reward-model 分解印证：强 bundle 模型的优势不仅在 query-item 相关性，更在 item-item 互补性得分（开源模型使用互补信号更激进）；对比任务则由相关性主导、profile 更扁平。作者提醒主榜衡量的是"完整提示化代理"而非纯 backbone 排序。

**鲁棒性**：50% 故障率下的 SetHit@20 保留率显示，开源模型激进使用互补工具在坏工具下暴露更大，闭源模型（尤其 GPT-4.1 mini、Gemini 2.5 Flash）保留比例略高（bundle 场景更明显），存在"上限 vs 稳健性"的权衡。故障率从 25% 升到 75% 时，对比 SetHit@20 从 0.406 降至 0.205，bundle 从 0.392 降至 0.124；分解显示相关性与互补性同时下降而多样性反而上升——这不是好事，而是集合变得松散、不聚焦（更少冗余但也更不相关、更不互补）。即坏工具不仅减少精确召回，还改变推荐集合的内在结构。
AI.conclusion: RecoAtlas 确立了一个新的评测范式：把 LLM 推荐代理的评测单位从"单个物品/排序列表"提升到"经工具选择、带自然语言论证的结构化报告集合"，并用三条正交维度（留出行为精确召回 / 行为对齐的学习型 reward model / 独立的语义与解释 judge）分别刻画，而非压缩成单一标量。实验证据表明这三个维度刻画的是不同性质：跨任务类型模型排序会改变；行为对齐工具能提升召回却不必然提升语义分；互补性与可替代性工具对两类任务作用不同；故障工具暴露出被聚合指标掩盖的失败模式。据此，RecoAtlas 是一个可复现的离线测试床，而非线上实验的替代品——它既可用于评测，也可作为优化环境：任务生成器可无限产出新实例，评测器暴露行为对齐指标，未来可据此做提示优化、监督式工具使用微调、强化学习或微调，并保留留出划分做最终验证。局限与说明：实验仅在三个 Amazon 品类与固定 250 条 query 划分上实例化（框架本身可迁移）；共购标签可能混淆真实互补性与曝光/流行度/打包等目录伪影，故只作为行为代理而非真值；LLM-judge 存在偏差与不稳定，故与行为指标严格分离；主榜受提示与工具使用策略影响，不能等同于纯 backbone 能力排名；主榜对 Gating 使用的工具质量较为敏感。

title: INAR-VL: Input-Aware Routing for Edge-Cloud Vision-Language Inference
summary: Edge deployment of Vision-Language Models (VLMs) faces a tradeoff between latency and accuracy: cloud execution provides high-quality predictions but incurs communication delay and energy cost, while edge-only execution is faster but less accurate due to limited model capacity. This trade-off is further complicated by heterogeneity in image quality and reasoning complexity, making static placement suboptimal. We present INAR-VL, a lightweight edge-cloud routing system for multimodal inference in a two-tier deployment. INAR-VL maintains complementary VLMs across edge and cloud and uses lightweight image and text complexity signals to guide routing and model selection, executing simple queries locally while offloading complex ones when beneficial. Evaluation on visual question answering shows that INAR-VL executes 36% of requests on the edge, reduces latency by 24%, lowers energy by 26%, and preserves 97% of cloud-level accuracy.

AI.tldr: INAR-VL是一种用于多模态推理的轻量级边缘-云路由系统，通过复杂度信号智能调度VLM请求，在边缘执行简单任务、云端处理复杂任务，实现精度损失仅3%的同时显著降低延迟和能耗。
AI.motivation: VLM边缘部署面临延迟与精度的权衡：云端执行质量高但有通信延迟和能耗代价，边缘执行速度快但因模型容量有限精度较低。图像质量和推理复杂度的异质性使静态放置策略次优。
AI.method: INAR-VL采用轻量级图像和文本复杂度信号引导路由和模型选择，在两级部署架构中执行简单查询于本地，复杂查询适时卸载至云端。
AI.result: 在视觉问答任务上，INAR-VL实现36%请求边缘执行率，24%延迟降低，26%能耗降低，同时保留97%云端精度。
AI.conclusion: INAR-VL通过在边缘和云端部署互补的VLM，利用轻量级复杂度信号实现智能路由，在保持97%云精度的情况下，实现了36%边缘执行率、24%延迟降低和26%能耗降低，有效平衡了边缘-云端部署的性能与效率。

title: How Do Document Parsers Break? Auditing Structural Vulnerability in Document Intelligence
summary: Document Layout Analysis (DLA) pipelines provide structured page representations for retrieval-augmented generation, long-document question answering, and other document intelligence systems, yet their robustness evaluation remains largely area-centric. We identify this Footprint Bias and propose a lightweight output-level auditing framework that decouples probe construction, policy-driven targeting, and structure-aware diagnosis. The framework combines Block-level Structural Loss Rate (B-SLR), granularity-aware exposure descriptors, and pathway attribution to analyze where perturbations interact with layout structure and how failures propagate. Across MinerU and PP-StructureV3 on 1,000 pages, affected area weakly tracks perturbation-induced OCR instability (R^2=0.384/0.110), whereas B-SLR aligns much more closely with it (R^2=0.727/0.916). Exposure descriptors further separate occlusion- and topology-dominant pathways, and small structurally targeted probes cause downstream QA/retrieval degradation comparable to larger-footprint perturbations. These results shift DLA robustness evaluation from footprint-based stress testing toward structure-aware vulnerability auditing.

AI.tldr: 本文识别了文档布局分析(DLA)流水线鲁棒性评估中的"足迹偏差"(Footprint Bias)，提出轻量级输出层审计框架，结合B-SLR、粒度感知暴露描述符和路径归因方法，揭示受影响区域与OCR不稳定性的相关性较弱(R²=0.384/0.110)，而B-SLR与OCR不稳定性高度相关(R²=0.727/0.916)，推动DLA鲁棒性评估从足迹压力测试转向结构感知漏洞审计。
AI.motivation: 当前DLA流水线的鲁棒性评估主要采用面积中心法(area-centric)，这种方法存在"足迹偏差"，无法准确评估布局结构对扰动的敏感性及其失败传播机制。
AI.method: 提出轻量级输出层审计框架，包含三个核心组件：(1)Block级结构损失率(B-SLR)用于量化布局结构破坏程度；(2)粒度感知暴露描述符用于区分遮挡和拓扑主导路径；(3)路径归因用于追踪失败传播。框架解耦了探针构建、策略驱动定位和结构感知诊断。
AI.result: 在MinerU和PP-StructureV3的1,000页文档上，受影响区域与扰动诱导的OCR不稳定性相关性弱(R²=0.384/0.110)，而B-SLR与OCR不稳定性高度相关(R²=0.727/0.916)。暴露描述符成功分离了遮挡和拓扑主导路径。小规模结构化探针造成的下游QA/检索性能下降与大规模扰动相当。
AI.conclusion: 研究结果将DLA鲁棒性评估范式从基于足迹的压力测试转变为结构感知漏洞审计，为文档智能系统的鲁棒性评估提供了更准确的方法论框架。

title: SimGym: A Framework for A/B Test Simulation in E-Commerce with Traffic-Grounded VLM Agents
summary: A/B testing remains the gold standard for evaluating modifications to e-commerce storefronts, yet it diverts traffic, requires weeks to reach statistical significance, and risks degrading user experience. We present SimGym, a framework for simulating A/B tests on e-commerce storefronts using vision-language model (VLM) agents operating in a live browser. The framework comprises three key components: (a) a traffic-grounded persona generation pipeline that derives per-shop buyer archetypes and intents from production clickstream data; (b) a live-browser agent architecture that combines multimodal perception over visual and browser-structured observations with episodic memory and guardrails to conduct coherent shopping sessions across control and treatment storefronts; and (c) an evaluation protocol that compares simulated outcome shifts with observed shifts in real buyer behavior. We validate SimGym on A/B tests of visually driven UI theme changes from a major e-commerce platform across diverse storefronts and product categories. Empirical results show that SimGym agents achieve strong agreement with observed outcome shifts, attaining 77% directional alignment with add-to-cart shifts observed across interface variants in real-buyer traffic. It reduces experimental cycles from weeks to under an hour, enabling rapid experimentation without exposing real buyers to candidate variants.

AI.tldr: SimGym 是一个面向电商店铺的「合成 A/B 测试」框架：用由真实点击流数据驱动的 persona 生成管线构造合成买家画像，再由 VLM 智能体在真实浏览器中访问线上店铺的 control/treatment 两个版本，完成完整购物会话，最后把智能体模拟出的加入购物车（A2C）变化与真实买家观测到的 A2C 变化做对比，检验预测效度。在来自某主流电商平台的 50 个真实店铺（16 国、11 个行业）主题改版实验上，基于 Gemini 3 Flash（视觉+文本）的智能体取得 77% 的方向一致性（alignment rate）与 0.55 的 Pearson 相关系数，单店 600 个智能体的模拟耗时约 5.3 分钟，把原本需数周的实验周期压缩到 1 小时以内，且不将真实流量暴露给候选变体。
AI.motivation: 传统 A/B 测试是评估店铺前端改版的黄金标准，但存在三重成本：需分流真实流量（把可能次优的体验暴露给用户）、达到统计显著性往往需要数周、失败变体在被发现回滚前已损害用户体验。其结果是商家倾向只做低风险增量改动，抑制创新。已有的 LLM/VLM 智能体研究虽能在浏览器中操作网页、能以 persona 条件化模拟用户，但缺少把「流量对齐的 persona 生成 + 真实浏览器交互 + 预测效度验证」整合起来的端到端框架；而已有工作多停留在离线基准（WebShop、ShoppingBench）、点击流行为相似度、静态截图 A/B 模拟（无幅度验证）或无人类干预效应校验的可用性模拟上，从未检验模拟结果是否与真实逐店 A/B 干预下的行为位移一致。因此核心问题是：能否用合成买家在真实上线前预测界面改动对转化的影响？
AI.method: 框架由三个可独立替换的模块构成。(1) 流量对齐的 persona 生成管线（六阶段）：会话级聚类（z-score 标准化 + k-means++，k=5，由惯性/簇均衡的肘部分析选定）→ 产品偏好抽取（GPT-5 从 shop 元数据+簇内浏览/购买商品摘要中抽取 JSON：至多 10 类通用品类、至多 10 个商品及理由）→ 购物意图生成（产品目标从所属簇的品类中采样，配固定的「默认推迟购买、仅在契合画像且具备足够购买信心时才加购」决策指南）→ 买家行为聚合（取距簇心最近的 n 个会话，聚合会话数、漏斗事件、客单价与交互历史）→ 买家原型构建（五个连续维度：行为维度含价格敏感度（类目归一化后浏览最高价与购买均价之差：>50% 为 budget、30–50% 为 mid-range、<30% 为 premium）、探索深度（0–1，由会话时长/搜索/浏览量映射 shallow/moderate/deep）；价值维度含 premium focus、performance focus、ethics focus，用关键词集（handcrafted、organic、commercial grade 等）比较浏览与购买商品的占比以区分显性兴趣与实际购买偏好，由 GPT-5 输出各维度分数与理由）→ Prompt 组装（意图与同簇原型配对，合并簇级产品偏好）。为防评估泄漏，persona 构建所用历史点击流与用于构造 ground truth 的 A/B 会话不相交。(2) 多模态 live-browser 智能体架构：每个决策步同时提供 DOM 派生的可访问性树（元素层级 + 唯一 ref ID）与页面截图；采用 observe–plan–act 循环，规划上下文包含购物目标、buyer persona（探索深度、价格敏感度、产品偏好、价值取向）、会话记忆、当前浏览器状态（URL/树/截图）与 guardrails；模型输出 schema 约束的推理、终止决策与下一动作（类型/目标元素/参数），交由浏览器控制器（Stagehand）在真实页面执行；episodic session memory 累积完整轨迹以保证多步一致性；guardrails 包括 loop protection、步数与时间预算、模型重试、错误回传给智能体而非盲目重试。(3) 评估协议：ground truth 构造要求 control/treatment 双侧流量充足、视觉/布局差异显著，并用 Gemini 3 Pro 联合检视截图与 DOM 刻画改动幅度、按改动量分层，同时剔除受促销重叠、陈列/选品变化、定价变动、新店爬坡期等非主题因素主导的配对，得到 50 店 golden set；预测效度用 A2C 变化衡量，方向效度为符号一致率（alignment rate），幅度效度为跨店 Pearson 相关，各报 95% CI（alignment 用 B=10,000 的商店级 percentile bootstrap；相关系数用 Fisher z 变换，n=50）。实验在 skimmers 队列（最大非跳出簇，占 26.4% 会话，A2C 率 9.5%，与剔除跳出者后的整店 ΔA2C 相关 r≈0.89）上报告，每店 600 个智能体、每店重复两次取平均；消融包括 persona 组成（Full Persona / Shopping Intent Only / Product Only）与有无记忆；另用 1000 次 bootstrap 做 50–700 智能体预算的敏感性分析。
AI.result: 主结果（50 店）：Gemini 3 Flash（视觉）alignment 77.0%（CI 66–87）、corr 0.55（CI 0.32–0.72）、5.3 分钟/店；同模型纯文本 70.0%（58–82）、0.49（0.25–0.68）、4.5 分钟；GPT-OSS（纯文本，内部 40×B200 集群）59.0%（47–71）、0.41（0.15–0.62）、12.8 分钟。消融：完整 persona 77%/0.55，仅购物意图 44%/0.02，仅产品目标 51%（接近随机）/-0.14；移除 episodic memory 后 alignment 降至 42%、相关归零，失效分析显示 70.7% 的偏离智能体陷入导航循环，说明记忆是维持轨迹连贯性并到达产品评估阶段的关键。敏感性：alignment 从 50 智能体的 67% 升至 300 智能体的 73% 后趋于平台，corr 从 0.48 升至 0.54 后平台，10–90 百分位带宽从 0.17 收窄至 0.05（600 智能体时），故最终采用 600 智能体预算。轨迹案例显示 persona 一致性行为（高端偏好使智能体跳过 4–7 美元系列、选定 33.18 美元商品并加购，适度探索深度避免过度浏览）。
AI.conclusion: SimGym 证明：以流量对齐 persona + 多模态 live-browser 智能体可以在真实电商环境下以前所未有的速度（分钟级 vs 数周）预演界面改版，其模拟的 A2C 位移与真实人类位移达到较强的方向一致（77%）与中等幅度相关（0.55），可作为商家实验前的「内循环」用于候选变体的提出、筛选与优先级排序，而无需将真实买家暴露于未验证设计。有效性主要来自两点：完整的 buyer archetype 刻画人群异质性、以及 episodic memory 维持多步购物轨迹的连贯性；多模态视觉输入相对纯文本带来额外增益，说明视觉显著性特征（图像质量、布局密度、信任线索）携带 DOM 结构无法捕捉的行为信号。局限与未来工作：仅在单一平台验证、仅以 A2C 为结果指标、未做基于人类轨迹的后训练对齐；需扩展到多平台与更广行为目标（乃至以人类轨迹后训练提升智能体保真度），并将预测效度目标与伦理、可用性、用户体验约束结合，避免被用于操纵性/欺骗性设计模式。此外需注意模拟流量与真实流量隔离以免污染分析、归因与推荐训练，且点击流 persona 构建须在数据协议、去标识化、聚合与最小队列阈值下合规进行。

title: Towards FairRAG: Preventing Representational Harm in Retrieval-Augmented Generation by Enforcing Fair Exposure at Retrieval Time
summary: As Large Language Model (LLM) integration has accelerated in high-stakes domains, model hallucination is a critical issue. Retrieval-augmented generation (RAG) is a technique for addressing hallucination; however, RAG's multi-component pipeline introduces vulnerabilities where biases can be introduced. This study considers two previously developed utility-focused ranking strategies (Standard and Stochastic) alongside two proposed exposure-aware approaches (Forced-Exposure and Representative Stochastic). Using the TREC 2022 Fair Ranking Dataset, which contains Wikipedia articles annotated as protected or non-protected, the LLM was asked to identify relevant articles with citations for four scenario-based Q&A prompts. The retrieval rankings and the generated outputs were evaluated for exposure bias and utility across all ranking methods. Overall, the Representative Stochastic ranker resulted in a statistically significant near-parity average exposure, acknowledging that relevance scores initially produced during retrieval are already shaped by representational bias, whereas the other rankers assume those scores are unbiased. Across all the methods of document ranking, generation demographic parity closely mirrored the exposure parity, reinforcing that representational bias in RAG systems is driven by retrieval and propagates to generation. These findings highlight that retrieval ranking is a critical point for mitigating downstream bias and propose a Representative Stochastic ranker that reintroduces fairness in RAG systems.

AI.tldr: 该论文研究RAG系统中检索排序对偏差传播的影响，提出Representative Stochastic排序器，通过考虑检索阶段已存在的表示偏差来恢复公平性，验证了检索是缓解下游偏差的关键环节。
AI.motivation: LLM集成到高风险领域时，模型幻觉是关键问题；RAG虽能缓解幻觉，但其多组件流水线会引入偏差；现有排序策略未考虑检索阶段已存在的表示偏差。
AI.method: 使用TREC 2022公平排序数据集（包含标记为受保护或非受保护的维基百科文章），针对四个场景问答提示让LLM识别相关引文文章；对四种排序方法（Standard、Stochastic、Forced-Exposure、Representative Stochastic）的检索排名和生成输出进行暴露偏差和效用评估。
AI.result: Representative Stochastic排序器实现了统计显著的近乎平等的曝光率；所有排序方法的生成人口统计 parity与曝光 parity高度一致；证明RAG系统中的表示偏差由检索阶段引入并传播到生成阶段。
AI.conclusion: Representative Stochastic排序器可恢复RAG系统中的公平性；RAG系统的表示偏差由检索阶段引入并传播到生成阶段；检索排序是缓解下游偏差的关键干预点。

title: MOCHA: Multi-Objective Chebyshev Annealing for Agent Skill Optimization
summary: LLM agents organize behavior through skills - structured natural-language specifications governing how an agent reasons, retrieves, and responds. Unlike monolithic prompts, skills are multi-field artifacts subject to hard platform constraints: description fields are truncated for routing, instruction bodies are compacted via progressive disclosure, and co-resident skills compete for limited context windows. These constraints make skill optimization inherently multi-objective: a skill must simultaneously maximize task performance and satisfy platform limits. Yet existing prompt optimizers either ignore these trade-offs or collapse them into a weighted sum, missing Pareto-optimal variants in non-convex objective regions. We introduce MOCHA (Multi-Objective Chebyshev Annealing), which replaces single-objective selection with Chebyshev scalarization - covering the full Pareto front, including non-convex regions - combined with exponential annealing that transitions from exploration to exploitation. In our experiments across six diverse agent skills - where all methods share the same multi-objective mutation operator and baselines receive identical per-objective textual feedback - existing optimizers fail to improve the seed skill on 4 of 6 tasks: 1000 rollouts yield zero progress. MOCHA breaks through on every task, achieving 7.5% relative improvement in mean correctness over the strongest baseline (up to 14.9% on FEVER and 10.4% on TheoremQA) while discovering twice as many more Pareto-optimal skill variants.

AI.tldr: 本文提出MOCHA方法解决LLM Agent技能的多目标优化问题。现有提示优化器在处理技能设计的多目标权衡（任务性能 vs. 平台约束）时存在不足，尤其是无法覆盖非凸Pareto前沿区域。MOCHA采用Chebyshev标量化替代加权求和以覆盖完整Pareto前沿，并结合指数退火实现从探索到利用的过渡。实验表明，在6个多样化Agent技能任务中，当现有方法在4个任务上1000次rollout后无改进时，MOCHA在所有任务上均实现突破，平均正确率相对提升7.5%（最高14.9%），并发现约两倍的Pareto最优变体。
AI.motivation: LLM agents rely on "skills" - structured natural-language specifications that control reasoning, retrieval, and responses. Skill optimization faces inherent multi-objective challenges: skills must simultaneously maximize task performance while satisfying platform constraints (description truncation for routing, compact instruction bodies, and limited context windows for co-resident skills). Existing prompt optimizers either ignore these trade-offs or use weighted-sum scalarization, which fails to discover Pareto-optimal variants in non-convex objective regions.
AI.method: MOCHA (Multi-Objective Chebyshev Achievement) employs two key innovations: (1) Chebyshev scalarization instead of weighted sum for multi-objective selection, enabling coverage of the full Pareto front including non-convex regions; (2) exponential annealing that transitions from exploration to exploitation during optimization. All methods in the experiment share the same multi-objective mutation operator and receive identical per-objective textual feedback.
AI.result: MOCHA achieves 7.5% relative improvement in mean correctness over the strongest baseline, with improvements reaching 14.9% on FEVER and 10.4% on TheoremQA. It also discovers approximately twice as many Pareto-optimal skill variants compared to existing optimizers.
AI.conclusion: MOCHA consistently outperforms existing optimizers across all six agent skills, achieving 7.5% average relative improvement in task correctness (up to 14.9% on FEVER, 10.4% on TheoremQA), and discovers approximately twice as many Pareto-optimal skill variants. The method effectively solves the multi-objective optimization problem for LLM agent skills by leveraging Chebyshev scalarization to cover the full Pareto front, including non-convex regions, combined with exponential annealing to balance exploration and exploitation. This breakthrough is significant given that existing methods fail to improve over the seed skill on 4 out of 6 tasks despite 1000 rollouts.

title: Data-Free Client Contribution Estimation via Logit Maximization for Federated Learning
summary: Federated learning (FL) enables collaborative learning of computer vision models, where privacy and regulatory constraints prevent centralizing data across devices or organizations. However, practical FL deployments often exhibit severe class imbalance and label skew, causing standard aggregation protocols to overfit dominant clients and degrade minority-class performance. We propose a data-free, class-wise contribution estimation and aggregation framework based on logit maximization (CELM) that does not require sharing raw data, client metadata, or auxiliary public datasets. The FL server probes client updates to obtain class-wise evidence scores and assembles a cross-client evidence matrix, which quantifies both per-class competence and class coverage. Using this matrix, we compute contribution weights that upweight clients providing strong, discriminative evidence for underrepresented classes. The resulting aggregation is stable due to simplex constraints and momentum smoothing, and it remains compatible with standard FL training pipelines. We evaluate the approach on representative vision benchmarks under controlled non-IID and pathological label splits, demonstrating that CELM-based aggregation improves robustness to imbalance and statistical heterogeneity, while yielding better performance without requiring any additional data exchange.

AI.tldr: 提出基于logit最大化的数据无关类别贡献估计与聚合框架(CELM)，通过跨客户证据矩阵量化类别能力与覆盖度，使用 simplex 约束和动量平滑实现稳定聚合，在非IID条件下提升模型性能。
AI.motivation: Practical federated learning deployments suffer from severe class imbalance and label skew, causing standard aggregation to overfit dominant clients and degrade minority-class performance.
AI.method: Data-free class-wise contribution estimation via logit maximization; cross-client evidence matrix; simplex constraints and momentum smoothing for stable aggregation.
AI.result: CELM-based aggregation improves robustness to imbalance and statistical heterogeneity compared to baseline methods.
AI.conclusion: CELM-based aggregation improves robustness to imbalance and heterogeneity; better performance without additional data exchange.

title: Symmetry in the Wild: The Role of Equivariance in Neural Fluid Surrogates
summary: Neural surrogates enable orders-of-magnitude acceleration of computational fluid dynamics (CFD) simulations, with the potential to transform engineering and healthcare workflows. Neural surrogate use in real-world applications requires addressing scalability to large, high-resolution surface and volume meshes, as well as to bespoke architectures, and accounting for limited training data through the use of inductive biases. Group-equivariant architectures are a principled way to introduce such bias, yet they can be detrimental when the learning problem itself breaks symmetry, for example, due to strong distributional alignment in the dataset. In this work, we investigate under which conditions equivariance improves generalization in neural CFD surrogates across tasks with increasing levels of distributional alignment and realism, covering automotive aerodynamics and blood flow (hemodynamics). To systematically assess the added value of equivariance at the limit of problem scaling, we introduce the Anchored-Branched Geometric Algebra Transformer (AB-GATr), a neural surrogate that integrates scalability and symmetry preservation to efficiently model coupled surface and volume quantities in an $E(3)$-equivariant manner. We find that on strongly aligned aerodynamics datasets, i.e., those that break symmetry, enforcing equivariance can degrade in-distribution performance. In contrast, across hemodynamic benchmarks with diverse geometries and varying alignment, equivariance is consistently beneficial. Moreover, across all benchmarks, the explicit equivariance of AB-GATr reliably outperforms implicit symmetry learning through data augmentation. Our findings showcase that equivariance is not universally beneficial across domains, yet it brings tangible advantages in problems lacking strong data regularities.

AI.tldr: 本研究探讨了神经CFD替代模型中等变性的价值，发现等变性效益与数据分布特性密切相关：在对称性被破坏的强对齐空气动力学数据上可能有害，但在多样化的血液动力学数据上始终有益；AB-GATr通过显式等变建模在所有任务中优于隐式方法。
AI.motivation: 神经替代模型在现实应用中需要解决大规模高分辨率网格的可扩展性问题，同时处理有限训练数据问题。虽然群等变架构是引入归纳偏置的原则性方法，但当学习问题本身破坏对称性时（如数据集中存在强分布对齐），等变性可能是有害的。
AI.method: 引入Anchor-Branched Geometric Algebra Transformer (AB-GATr)，一种集成可扩展性与对称性保持的神经替代模型，以E(3)等变方式高效建模耦合表面和体积量；通过跨汽车空气动力学和血液动力学（血流动力学）任务的基准测试，系统评估等变性在问题规模化极限下的附加价值。
AI.result: 在强对齐的空气动力学数据集（即破坏对称性的数据）上，强制等变性可能降低分布内性能；而在几何多样且对齐变化较大的血液动力学基准上，等变性始终有益；AB-GATr的显式等变性在所有基准测试中一致地优于通过数据增强的隐式对称性学习。
AI.conclusion: equivariance并非在所有领域都普遍有益，在缺乏强数据规律性的问题中具有明显优势；AB-GATr通过显式等变性学习在所有基准测试中可靠地优于通过数据增强的隐式对称性学习。

title: A Multi-Agent Framework for Feature-Constrained Difficulty Control in Reading Comprehension Item Generation
summary: Recent studies in difficulty-controlled reading comprehension item generation have leveraged large language models (LLMs) to produce items by adjusting difficulty-related features. However, existing methods typically rely on a single-agent prompting approach, which often fails to consistently satisfy specified feature constraints, resulting in items that deviate from the target difficulty level. To address this limitation, we introduce MAFIG, a Multi-agent Framework for Feature-constrained Item Generation, where multiple LLM agents and feature-specific evaluators collaborate to generate and iteratively revise items based on intended constraints. Furthermore, to verify the efficacy of MAFIG in difficulty control, we propose a method for constructing a sequence of feature constraint sets that yield items with monotonically increasing difficulty. Experimental results demonstrate that MAFIG generates items that adhere to target constraints at a significantly higher rate than baselines, achieving robust difficulty control through the difficulty-calibrated constraint sequence.

AI.tldr: 本文提出MAFIG框架，通过多智能体协作和迭代修订解决LLM生成阅读理解题目时难以精确控制难度的问题，并设计难度校准的约束序列验证框架有效性。
AI.motivation: 现有基于LLM的阅读理解题目生成方法采用单智能体提示策略，难以持续满足指定的特征约束，导致生成题目偏离目标难度水平。
AI.method: 提出MAFIG（Multi-agent Framework for Feature-constrained Item Generation）框架，包含多个LLM智能体和特征特定评估器，协作生成并基于目标约束迭代修订题目。此外，设计一套特征约束集序列，使生成题目呈现单调递增的难度特征。
AI.result: 实验表明，MAFIG生成的题目以显著更高的比率符合目标约束，通过难度校准的约束序列实现了稳健的难度控制。
AI.conclusion: 多智能体协作框架结合特征评估器的迭代修订机制可有效提升LLM在约束满足和难度控制方面的表现。

title: Can Large Language Models Revolutionize Survey Research? Experiments with Disaster Preparedness Responses
summary: Survey research faces mounting structural challenges: declining response rates, sample bias, block-wise missingness among at-risk respondents, and AI-assisted fraudulent completions in online panels. Large language models (LLMs) have been proposed as a remedy, yet rigorous evaluations across the full survey workflow remain scarce, particularly in disaster contexts where data quality matters most. We present and evaluate a five-stage framework for LLM integration covering questionnaire design, sample selection, pilot testing, missing-data imputation, and post-collection analysis, using the 2024 Hurricane Milton preparedness survey of Florida residents (n=946) as a shared empirical testbed. We introduce a Protection Motivation Theory (PMT)-constrained co-occurrence knowledge graph and develop seven LLM configurations spanning zero-shot inference, retrieval-augmented baselines, and novel theory-informed variants. Our proposed Anchored Marginal Theory-Informed LLM (A-TLM) outperforms all three classical imputation baselines (IPW/MI, MICE+PMM, missForest) on RMSE under disaster-relevant block-wise MNAR conditions (S4 RMSE 1.439 vs. 1.496 for the next-best), while achieving near-zero signed bias (-0.121) where the random-forest imputer produces the largest absolute bias (-0.631). Organizing retrieval around PMT causal structure and integrating all evidence in a single model call outperforms unstructured retrieval and staged sequential inference (MAE 0.993 vs. 1.097 for standard RAG). We document that near-zero aggregate bias can mask opposing subgroup errors and propose subgroup-stratified bias auditing as a reporting standard. A retrieval-constrained knowledge-graph chatbot demonstrates that hallucination is architecturally manageable through grounded refusal.

AI.tldr: The paper presents a five-stage LLM integration framework for survey research, proposes A-TLM (Anchored Marginal Theory-Informed LLM) that achieves superior imputation performance under MNAR conditions, and establishes PMT-based causal structure integration and subgroup-stratified bias auditing as key methodological contributions.
AI.motivation: Survey research faces structural challenges: declining response rates, sample bias, block-wise missingness (MNAR), and fraudulent completions; existing LLM evaluations are not rigorous across full workflow, especially in disaster contexts
AI.method: Five-stage LLM integration framework; PMT-constrained co-occurrence knowledge graph; seven LLM configurations (zero-shot, RAG, theory-informed); comparison with IPW/MI, MICE+PMM, missForest baselines
AI.result: A-TLM outperforms all three classical baselines under block-wise MNAR conditions (RMSE 1.439 vs 1.496); achieves near-zero signed bias (-0.121); PMT causal structure retrieval outperforms unstructured RAG (MAE 0.993 vs 1.097); near-zero aggregate bias can mask opposing subgroup errors
AI.conclusion: A-TLM achieves best performance with near-zero signed bias and manageable hallucination; subgroup-stratified bias auditing proposed as standard; PMT causal structure integration outperforms unstructured retrieval

title: Multi-Token Residual Prediction
summary: Diffusion Language Models (DLMs) generate text by iteratively denoising masked token sequences, offering a tradeoff between parallelism and quality compared to autoregressive models. In current practice, the number of tokens decoded per step is controlled by a confidence threshold, and quality degrades monotonically as more tokens are denoised per step. We introduce Multi-token Residual Prediction (MRP), a lightweight module that enables dependency-aware multi-token denoising within a single backbone forward pass. MRP exploits a key property of the denoising process: the logit distributions at adjacent denoising steps are remarkably similar. Rather than running the backbone a second time to obtain the next-step logits, MRP predicts the residual between steps from the backbone's hidden states, effectively denoising more tokens per backbone forward at a fraction of the cost. We deploy MRP in two inference modes: direct decoding, which uses the corrected logits without verification for a tunable quality--speed tradeoff; and speculative decoding, which verifies MRP's proposals against the backbone for lossless acceleration. Experiments on SDAR models at the 1.7B, 4B, and 8B scales across reasoning and code generation benchmarks demonstrate up to $1.42\times$ lossless speedup in SGLang.

AI.tldr: 提出多token残差预测（MRP）：一个轻量模块从冻结的块扩散语言模型（SDAR）的隐状态中预测相邻去噪步之间的logit残差δ_t = ℓ_{t-1} − ℓ_t，从而在一次主干前向内近似"第二次前向"的输出，以远低于成本的方式一次解码更多token。该方法支持三种推理模式：直接解码（可调质量-速度权衡）、推测解码（主干校验，无损最高1.40×加速）、重掩码解码（在低阈值动态去噪下撤销过早揭示，最高恢复22.6点准确率）。
AI.motivation: 扩散语言模型（DLM）以并行去噪换取吞吐，但每步同时解掩码的token之间缺乏依赖感知，导致质量随每步解掩码数量增加而单调下降（阈值解码本质上是同一条质量-吞吐帕累托前沿上的移动）。核心问题是：能否在DLM中一步解码多个token的同时保留token间依赖？论文的关键观察是：扩散主干在相邻去噪步产生的logit分布极为相似——当只解掩少量token时主干输出几乎不变，而两次输出之差（残差）的幅值显著小于输出本身幅值（r=1时约为logits幅值的20%），因此残差是比"下一完整分布"低动态范围、复杂度低得多的学习目标（类似残差学习原理，零函数已是合理近似）。理论上，论文利用去噪过程的马尔可夫链结构与骨干网络对输入嵌入的κ-Lipschitz假设，证明了一步收缩界（Proposition 1）：D_TV(π^i_{t-1}, π^i_t) ≤ κ·|R_t|/L·max_j‖e_{v_j} − e_[MASK]‖_2，并由此推论残差沿链单调衰减（Corollary 3.1），说明小模块足以捕获残差中的绝大部分信号。
AI.method: 架构：MRP是类似EAGLE/MTP的轻量头（D=3层transformer，类EAGLE-1：输入主干末层隐状态+已揭示序列的token嵌入，经投影融合与少量transformer层，复用主干LM head输出残差logits δ_t与隐状态残差 Δ_t），主干/LM head/词嵌入全部冻结。训练：随机以Uniform(0,1)概率掩码响应token得到x_t，再按块揭示r个ground-truth token得到x_{t-1}；冻结主干在x_t上产生(h, ℓ_t)作为学生侧，在x_{t-1}上无梯度产生教师logits ℓ_{t-1}；损失为仍被掩码位置上的KL(softmax(ℓ_{t-1}) ‖ softmax(ℓ_t + δ_t))（前向KD，温度1.0，K=2次MRP展开，均匀加权，AdamW，峰值lr 1e-3，cosine调度，1 epoch，序列长4096，数据为SFTDatasetV3的12.4M对话语料）。推理三种模式：(1) 直接解码——主干前向后运行K次MRP，累加 h←h+Δ、ℓ←ℓ+δ，每步按修正后置信度解掩r个token，无校验；(2) 推测解码——MRP起草额外token，随后一次主干前向做逐位置argmax校验，不匹配位置重掩码，接受的token即主干自身输出故完全无损，且校验前向的隐状态/输出可复用于下一步摊销开销（借鉴SSD的验证框架）；(3) 重掩码解码——低阈值τ下主干解掩码集合R后，用一次MRP前向估计下一步logits ℓ+δ，对低于τ的位置重新掩码（双阈值确认原则，同一τ无需额外调参；实验另沿用WINO的max-accept上限）。实验基于SDAR-Chat 1.7B/4B/8B（块大小16），在SGLang中单张H100上评测GSM8K、MATH500、HumanEval、MBPP。
AI.result: 1) 残差vs直接建模消融（GSM8K）：K=1时两者接近（+0.2/+3.8/−0.4），但随K增大差距急剧拉开，K=2时4B领先+68.0、8B领先+17.2，K=4时直接蒸馏在全部规模上崩溃（残差分别+12.9/+55.3/+73.1），证明直接蒸馏需在每次迭代复现完整log-density导致误差累积。2) 静态去噪：推测模式（K=3）质量无损，吞吐加速1.17–1.40×，最大为8B/GSM8K的1.40×；直接模式K=1时质量接近主干（4B 88.6 vs 90.3；8B 90.1 vs 90.9）而加速1.43–1.61×，K=2加速1.53–1.91×但精度小幅下降（主要在HumanEval等代码任务）。3) 动态去噪重掩码：τ=0.5时各任务/规模至少+11点，最高8B HumanEval +22.6（32.3→54.9）、4B GSM8K +17.7（63.4→81.1）、1.7B MATH500 +11.4；τ升高增益递减至近零。推理任务（GSM8K/MATH500）所有操作点均提升无例外；代码任务在保守阈值下有少量小幅回退（4B HumanEval −1.8/−1.2，4B MBPP −0.8），因代码token步间分布漂移更剧烈。代价是吞吐约为Dynamic的0.76–0.88×。4) 深度消融（1.7B，D∈{1,2,3,4,8}）：直接模式精度随深度提升且收益递减（K=2时四任务均值D=1→D=3约+4点），推测模式精度基本持平而吞吐持续下降，故浅层更优——直接模式宜用较深模块，推测模式宜用浅模块以保无损加速。
AI.conclusion: MRP以"预测步间logit残差"这一轻量参数化，把DLM的并行解码从"同一步内token互相不可见"的困境中部分解放出来：在静态去噪下配合主干校验可获得最高1.40×的无损加速（SGLang实现，1.42×为摘要口径），直接解码则在匹配吞吐下优于阈值解码的质量-速度前沿；在动态低阈值去噪下，重掩码机制用一次轻量前向替代WINO的第二次主干前向，恢复了大部分因激进解掩码损失的精度（最高+22.6点），使实践者能在激进阈值下运行而保留接近保守阈值的准确率。局限与未来工作：阈值调度与MRP联合设计以获取更强加速；MRP步数K目前固定，需按步自适应分配；代码生成上残差结构与推理任务不同、精度退化更明显，需域感知训练或结构改进。训练数据、代码与模型权重均已开源。

title: HalluWorld: A Controlled Benchmark for Hallucination via Reference World Models
comment: HalluWorld benchmark (code and data) at github.com/DegenAI-Labs/HalluWorld
summary: Hallucination remains a central failure mode of large language models, but existing benchmarks operationalize it inconsistently across summarization, question answering, retrieval-augmented generation, and agentic interaction. This fragmentation makes it unclear whether a mitigation that works in one setting reduces hallucinations across contexts. Current benchmarks either require human annotation and fixed references that may be memorized, or rely on observations in settings that are difficult to reproduce. To study root causes, we introduce HalluWorld, an extensible benchmark grounded in an explicit reference-world formulation: a model hallucinates when it produces an observable claim that is false with respect to this world. Building on this view, we construct synthetic and semi-synthetic environments in which the reference world is fully specified, the model's view is controlled, and hallucination labels are generated automatically. HalluWorld spans gridworlds, chess, and realistic terminal tasks, enabling controlled variation of world complexity, observability, temporal change, and source-conflict policy, and disentangling hallucinations into fine-grained error categories. We evaluate frontier and open-weight language models across these settings and find consistent patterns: perceptual hallucination on directly observed information is near-solved for frontier models, while multi-step state tracking and causal forward simulation remain difficult and are not generally solved by extended thinking. In the terminal setting, models also struggle with when to abstain. The uneven profile of failures across probe types and domains suggests that hallucinations arise from distinct failure modes rather than a single capability. Our results suggest that controlled reference worlds offer a scalable and reproducible path toward measuring and reducing hallucinations in modern language models.

AI.tldr: HalluWorld proposes a new benchmark with controlled synthetic environments to study LLM hallucinations. Findings reveal frontier models handle direct perception well but struggle with multi-step reasoning and causal simulation, indicating hallucinations stem from multiple distinct failure modes.
AI.motivation: Hallucination is a central failure mode of LLMs, but existing benchmarks operationalize it inconsistently across different settings, making it unclear whether mitigations generalize across contexts.
AI.method: Introduced HalluWorld, an extensible benchmark grounded in an explicit reference-world formulation where models hallucinate when producing observable false claims. Constructed synthetic and semi-synthetic environments with fully specified reference worlds, controlled model views, and automatically generated hallucination labels spanning gridworlds, chess, and realistic terminal tasks.
AI.result: Perceptual hallucination on directly observed information is near-solved for frontier models, while multi-step state tracking and causal forward simulation remain difficult and are not generally solved by extended thinking. Models also struggle with knowing when to abstain. The uneven failure profile suggests hallucinations arise from distinct failure modes rather than a single capability.
AI.conclusion: Controlled reference worlds offer a scalable and reproducible path toward measuring and reducing hallucinations in modern language models.

title: Causal Evidence for Attention Head Imbalance in Modality Conflict Hallucination
summary: Modality-conflict hallucination occurs when multimodal large language models (MLLMs) prioritize erroneous textual premises over contradictory visual evidence. To understand why visual evidence fails to prevail during generation, we take a mechanistic perspective and examine which internal components drive or resist this failure. We perform head-level causal analysis using path patching across five open-source MLLMs and identify two groups of attention heads with opposing causal roles: hallucination-driving heads and hallucination-resisting heads. We find a consistent asymmetry: driving effects are more broadly distributed and carry greater aggregate weight, whereas resisting effects concentrate in a small number of high-importance heads. Ablation experiments further confirm that these groups exert opposing effects during generation: distributed driving influence and localized resistance together form an imbalanced routing structure that biases generation toward the erroneous premise. Motivated by this finding, we propose MACI (Modality-conflict-Aware Causal Intervention), a conditional intervention that suppresses causally identified hallucination-driving heads only when conflict is detected. Across five MLLMs, MACI achieves the largest hallucination reduction among compared inference-time baselines on the MMMC benchmark with a favorable hallucination-accuracy trade-off, and transfers zero-shot to the SCI-SemanticConflict test.

AI.tldr: 本文研究多模态大语言模型(MLLMs)在视觉与文本信息冲突时产生幻觉的机制，通过因果分析发现了"驱动-抵抗"注意力头的不对称结构，并提出MACI干预方法有效缓解冲突幻觉。
AI.motivation: 多模态大语言模型在视觉与文本信息冲突时，往往优先考虑错误的文本前提而非正确的视觉证据，导致幻觉问题。理解这一现象的内部机制对于提升模型可靠性至关重要。
AI.method: 使用path patching对5个开源MLLMs进行头部级别的因果分析，识别出两类因果角色相反的注意力头：幻觉驱动头和幻觉抵抗头。并通过消融实验验证其作用机制。
AI.result: 发现因果效应存在系统性不对称：驱动效应分布广泛且总体权重较大，而抵抗效应集中于少数高重要性头部。这种不均衡的路由结构使生成偏向错误前提。
AI.conclusion: 提出的MACI方法通过在检测到冲突时抑制幻觉驱动头，在5个MLLMs上于MMMC基准测试中实现最大幻觉降低，且可零样本迁移到SCI-SemanticConflict测试，兼顾幻觉减少与准确率权衡。

title: optimize_anything: A Universal API for Optimizing any Text Parameter
summary: Can a single LLM-based optimization system match specialized tools across fundamentally different domains? We show that when optimization problems are formulated as improving a text artifact evaluated by a scoring function, a single AI-based optimization system-supporting single-task search, multi-task search with cross-problem transfer, and generalization to unseen inputs-achieves state-of-the-art results across six diverse tasks. Our system discovers agent architectures that nearly triple Gemini Flash's ARC-AGI accuracy (32.5% to 89.5%), finds scheduling algorithms that cut cloud costs by 40%, generates CUDA kernels where 87% match or beat PyTorch, and outperforms AlphaEvolve's reported circle packing solution (n=26). Ablations across three domains reveal that actionable side information yields faster convergence and substantially higher final scores than score-only feedback, and that multi-task search outperforms independent optimization given equivalent per-problem budget through cross-task transfer, with benefits scaling with the number of related tasks. Together, we show for the first time that text optimization with LLM-based search is a general-purpose problem-solving paradigm, unifying tasks traditionally requiring domain-specific algorithms under a single framework. We open-source optimize\_anything with support for multiple backends as part of the GEPA project at https://github.com/gepa-ai/gepa .

AI.tldr: A single LLM-based optimization system achieves state-of-the-art results across six diverse domains (ARC-AGI, cloud scheduling, CUDA kernels, circle packing, etc.) by treating optimization as text artifact improvement, demonstrating that LLM-based search is a general-purpose problem-solving paradigm replacing domain-specific algorithms.
AI.motivation: Investigating whether a single LLM-based optimization system can match specialized tools across fundamentally different domains.
AI.method: Formulating optimization problems as improving text artifacts evaluated by a scoring function, using an AI-based optimization system supporting single-task search, multi-task search with cross-problem transfer, and generalization to unseen inputs.
AI.result: Across six diverse tasks: discovered agent architectures that nearly triple ARC-AGI accuracy (32.5% to 89.5%), found scheduling algorithms cutting cloud costs by 40%, generated CUDA kernels where 87% match or beat PyTorch, and outperformed AlphaEvolve's circle packing solution. Ablations show actionable side information yields faster convergence and higher scores, and multi-task search outperforms independent optimization through cross-task transfer.
AI.conclusion: Text optimization with LLM-based search is a general-purpose problem-solving paradigm that unifies tasks traditionally requiring domain-specific algorithms under a single framework. They open-source optimize_anything with support for multiple backends.

title: Towards Multi-Model LLM Schedulers: Empirical Insights into Offloading and Preemption
comment: The 2026 Mediterranean Artificial Intelligence and Networking Conference (MAIN 2026)
summary: Modern deployments of Large Language Models (LLMs) increasingly require serving multiple models with diverse architectures, sizes, and specialization on shared, heterogeneous hardware. This setting introduces new challenges for resource allocation, dispatching, and scheduling, particularly under GPU memory constraints where partial CPU-GPU offloading and preemption become necessary. While existing systems primarily optimize throughput for a single model, comparatively little work addresses multi-model scheduling under these conditions. In this paper, we present an empirical study of how different LLMs behave across hardware platforms, focusing on the performance implications of layer offloading and preemption. We show that offloading leads to strongly non-linear and model-dependent degradation in decode throughput, with smaller models exhibiting sharper sensitivity to reduced GPU residency. We further demonstrate that preemption incurs substantial overhead, largely dominated by model state reload rather than key-value cache transfer, and that this cost varies significantly across models and hardware platforms. Additionally, we highlight the role of sequence length and interconnect bandwidth in amplifying data movement and execution inefficiencies. Based on these findings, we identify a set of key features that future schedulers must consider, including model-specific offloading sensitivity, workload characteristics, and the cost structure of preemption and data transfer. These insights provide guidance for the design of next-generation LLM serving systems capable of efficiently managing heterogeneous, multi-model workloads with hybrid CPU-GPU execution.

AI.tldr: This paper empirically studies multi-model LLM serving under GPU memory constraints, revealing that offloading leads to non-linear throughput degradation (smaller models more sensitive), preemption overhead is dominated by model state reload, and sequence length/interconnect bandwidth significantly impact performance. The findings guide the design of next-generation schedulers for heterogeneous multi-model workloads.
AI.motivation: Existing LLM serving systems primarily optimize throughput for a single model, while multi-model scheduling under GPU memory constraints (requiring CPU-GPU offloading and preemption) remains underexplored.
AI.method: Empirical study of different LLMs across hardware platforms, focusing on performance implications of layer offloading and preemption.
AI.result: Offloading causes strongly non-linear, model-dependent decode throughput degradation (smaller models more sensitive to reduced GPU residency); preemption overhead is dominated by model state reload rather than KV cache transfer, varying across models and hardware; sequence length and interconnect bandwidth amplify data movement and execution inefficiencies.
AI.conclusion: Future schedulers must consider model-specific offloading sensitivity, workload characteristics, and preemption/data transfer cost structure to efficiently manage heterogeneous multi-model workloads with hybrid CPU-GPU execution.

title: Efficient Conditioning Why Pseudo Observation Batch Bayesian Optimization Works When It Does not
summary: Constant Liar (CL), Kriging Believer (KB), and fantasy models are widely used for batch selection in parallel Bayesian Optimization, yet a unified theory explaining their effectiveness and conditions under which they fail has been lacking. We identify efficient conditioning as the key surrogate property the ability to update predictions in closed form when data is augmented. We prove that Gaussian Processes satisfy this requirement, producing provably distinct batch points with separation of order l, and that this holds for any acquisition function monotonically non decreasing in posterior uncertainty (EI, UCB, PI), with qualitatively similar behavior for Thompson Sampling. We unify CL, KB, and fantasy models as instances of a single conditioning mechanism differing only in the lie value distribution, and draw quantitative connections to Local Penalization (LP) and qualitative connections to Determinantal Point Processes (DPPs). To disentangle model structure from optimizer randomness, we introduce the Structural Diversity Diagnostic (SDD), a reusable methodology for testing surrogate compatibility. Experiments on Hartmann6D, Ackley 8D, Levy10D, and SVM hyperparameter tuning validate all theoretical predictions: CL or KBs implicit penalty matches or outperforms explicit LP greedy conditioning achieves convergence on par with joint qEI efficient conditioning extends to Multiquadric RBF networks; and parametric surrogates produce degenerate batches even when fully retrained (random forests), while neural networks regain diversity only at 15x the wall clock cost of GP conditioning. Robustness is confirmed across multiple initial datasets and under observation noise.

AI.tldr: 本文提出并形式化「高效条件化（efficient conditioning）」——即代理模型在增广数据后能以闭式/快速线性代数更新预测——作为伪观测批量贝叶斯优化（Constant Liar、Kriging Believer、fantasy models）产生批次多样性的结构性根源。论文证明 GP 满足该性质，可产生两两分离度为 Ω(ℓ) 的不同批次点，且结论对任何关于 σ 单调不减的采集函数（EI/UCB/PI）成立；CL/KB/fantasy 被统一为同一条件化机制、仅在「谎值」分布上不同，并与 Local Penalization 建立定量联系、与 DPP 建立定性联系。作者进一步提出可复用的结构多样性诊断（SDD），用固定优化器重启点消除优化器随机性，实证显示 GP 与 MQ-RBF 产生多样批次，而神经网络与随机森林产生退化（重合）批次。
AI.motivation: 批量贝叶斯优化（batch BO）需要在一次迭代中同时选出 q>1 个评估点以获得并行加速，但直接取采集函数前 q 个极大值会导致候选点几乎重合。Constant Liar（CL）、Kriging Believer（KB）与 fantasy models 是被 BoTorch 等主流框架广泛采用的伪观测（pseudo-observation）批量选择方案，但既有理论（Desautels 等的 batch GP-UCB 遗憾界、Contal 等的 UCB-PE、Ginsbourger 等的原始工作）几乎全部以 GP 代理为前提假设，未回答「代理模型需要具备什么结构性质才能与伪观测批量选择兼容」这一问题。经验上这些方法在 GP 上可靠、在神经网络等参数化代理上批次点会塌缩到同一位置，但缺乏统一的理论解释，导致这些方法被当作黑盒使用、适用边界不清。此外，这些方法与显式多样惩罚方法（Local Penalization）和基于行列式点过程（DPP）的方法之间的定量关系也未被厘清。
AI.method: 理论部分：(1) 定义 efficient conditioning——数据增广后预测可闭式更新、无需迭代参数优化；(2) 利用 GP 标准条件化恒等式给出均值更新与方差缩减公式（方差在条件点处严格下降、邻域内下降，并可由秩一 Cholesky 更新以 O(n²)/步、O(qn²+n³)/批实现）；(3) 命题 1 给出无重复保证（归纳：条件点处方差严格下降 → 采集值下降 → 邻域抑制 → 下一点必异），命题 2 给出方差抑制半径下界 r_τ ≥ ℓ√log(σ_f⁴/(τ σ²_D(x*)(σ²_D(x*)+σ_n²)))，低噪声高方差处 r_0.5 ≥ 0.83ℓ，Lemma 1 证明 KB 下均值完全不变（多样性纯由方差缩减产生），推论 1 证明任何参数固定型代理在确定性优化器下产生 x₁=…=x_q 的退化批次，命题 3 将结论推广到任意 σ 单调不减的采集函数（TS 仅定性成立）；(4) 推导 EI 比值作为隐式惩罚器 ψ(x;x*)≈σ'/σ 及其与 LP 惩罚项的对应，给出 DPP 定性类比（不主张 L-ensemble 精确等价）；(5) 讨论 Ω(ℓ) 分离与亚线性遗憾界中「批内有界幻觉信息」条件的衔接。方法论部分：提出 Structural Diversity Diagnostic（SDD），固定三个 L-BFGS-B 起始点（0.2/0.5/0.8 沿对角线）并跨批次迭代保持不变，以剥离优化器随机性、暴露代理模型的结构响应；配套分析 MQ-RBF 的幂函数不确定性代理（与 GP 后验方差的结构类比）、SVM、稀疏 GP、各谎值变体（CL-min/max/mean、KB、fantasy）。实验部分：在 Hartmann-6D、Ackley-8D、Levy-10D 与 SVM 超参调优（Breast Cancer, 4D）上对比 CL-min/CL-max/CL-mean/KB/随机批/顺序 BO/LP/q-EI，测量批次内平均成对欧氏距离，q∈{2,3}（附加 q=10），多随机种子，并检验噪声鲁棒性与计算开销。
AI.result: 理论结果：GP 满足 efficient conditioning，CL/KB 产生的批次点两两不同且分离度为 Ω(ℓ)（抑制半径随长度尺度缩放）；结论与采集函数具体形式无关（EI 与 UCB 下 SDD 模式完全一致，Table 8），仅依赖 σ 单调性；KB 的均值不变性表明多样性完全由方差缩减驱动；CL/KB/fantasy 因方差更新与谎值无关而具有相同的抑制几何，仅均值偏移方式不同（零/确定/随机）；CL/KB 等价于通过 GP 后验实现的隐式 Local Penalization，EI 比值在探索主导区与 σ'/σ 近似吻合；参数化代理（NN、固定中心 RBF、SVM、RF）满足推论 1 的退化结论，末层贝叶斯 NN 与固定诱导点稀疏 GP 仅部分兼容。实证结果：SDD 显示 GP 与 MQ-RBF 在 q=2、3、10 下均产生多样批次（Hartmann-6D q=3 最小距离 0.157/0.421，q=10 时 GP 最小距离 0.459），NN 集成与随机森林距离恒为 0，5 个种子下分类 100% 一致；即使完全重训，RF 仍因自助采样将单个伪观测稀释到 200 棵树而退化，重训 NN 可恢复多样性但耗时为 GP 条件化的约 15×（0.60s vs 0.04s）；GP 条件化比 NN 重训快约 250×、MQ-RBF 重解约 3000×，端到端 BO 循环 4–6 秒，与 BoTorch q-EI 同量级；收敛上 CL-min/KB 在同等评估预算下接近顺序 BO（Hartmann-6D q=3：CL-min −2.95±0.29、KB −2.90±0.50 vs 随机批 −1.88±0.35，Wilcoxon p<0.001），同等墙钟时间下批量方法严格占优；CL/KB 的隐式惩罚匹配或优于显式 LP（无需估计惩罚形状与 Lipschitz 常数）；KB 与 BoTorch q-EI 表现相当（−2.99±0.29 vs −2.97±0.39，差异在噪声内）；SVM 调优中 GP+CL-min 误差最低（0.0188±0.0014）并带来 2× 墙钟并行加速；加入 σ_noise=0.1·std(y) 后多样性与优势保持。
AI.conclusion: 论文主张 efficient conditioning 是伪观测批量 BO 的核心组织原则：只要代理模型支持闭式条件化更新（GP、MQ-RBF 等），CL/KB 就会通过后验方差缩减产生结构性多样批次，其分离尺度由核长度尺度 ℓ 支配；反之参数化代理即使完全重训也易产生退化批次，NN 需付出约 15× 成本才恢复多样性。这为「为何只有 GP 上可靠」提供了首个形式化刻画，并把 CL、KB、fantasy 统一到同一条件化机制下，与 LP（定量）和 DPP（定性）置于同一「排斥式多样性」谱系上。SDD 作为可复用的兼容性诊断工具，可用于快速判断新代理是否适合伪观测批量选择。局限：分析假设批次构造期间核超参固定；MQ-RBF 的不确定性基于幂函数启发式而非概率后验，缺乏 GP 级校准；主要实验限于 q∈{2,3}（q=10 显示机制可扩展但后期成员收敛效率下降）与 d=6–10 及一个真实任务，d>20 与极高噪声情形仍待研究；将遗憾分析推广到其他支持高效条件化的代理被指为自然的下一步。

title: Retrieval-Augmented Linguistic Calibration
summary: Linguistic cues such as "I believe" and "probably" offer an intuitive interface for communicating confidence, yet a generalisable, principled calibration framework for linguistic confidence expressions remains underexplored. In particular, co-occurring linguistic cues, contextual variation, and subjective audience interpretation pose unique challenges. We therefore model linguistic confidence as a distribution over plausible perceived probability values that a statement is correct, capturing interpretation variability that scalar representations discard. Within this distributional framework, we introduce faithfulness as a complementary evaluation dimension and present Faithfulness Divergence (FD), an information-theoretic metric quantifying the surprise induced in audience beliefs upon truth revelation. Building on these foundations, we present Retrieval-Augmented Linguistic Calibration (RALC), a lightweight post-hoc pipeline that propagates calibrated confidence signals back into natural language via retrieval-augmented rewriting. Across three QA benchmarks and five LLM families, RALC improves in-domain faithfulness and calibration up to 66% and 58%, respectively, outperforming black-box and grey-box calibration baselines.

AI.tldr: 论文针对大语言模型中"I believe"、"probably"等语言置信度表达提出分布建模框架，引入faithfulness概念和信息论度量FD，并开发RALC系统通过检索增强重写提升校准性能。
AI.motivation: 现有语言置信度表达（如"I believe"、"probably"）缺乏通用化、原则性的校准框架；共现语言线索、上下文变化和主观受众解读带来独特挑战，标量表示无法捕捉解释变异性。
AI.method: 1) 将语言置信度建模为正确概率的分布，捕捉解释变异性；2) 提出可信度 faithfulness 作为互补评估维度；3) 设计Faithfulness Divergence (FD)——基于信息论的度量；4) 开发RALC管道：检索增强的后处理重写pipeline。
AI.result: 域内faithfulness提升达66%，校准提升达58%，优于黑盒和灰盒校准基线。
AI.conclusion: RALC通过检索增强重写将校准后的置信度信号传播回自然语言，在三个QA基准和五个LLM家族中，域内可信度和校准分别提升高达66%和58%，优于黑盒和灰盒校准基线。

title: The 99% Success Paradox: When Near-Perfect Retrieval Equals Random Selection
comment: 12 pages, 2 figures, 7 tables. Accepted at ICLR 2026 Blog Track, https://iclr-blogposts.github.io/2026/blog/2026/bits-over-random/
summary:
For most of the history of information retrieval (IR), search results were designed for human consumers who could scan, filter, and discard irrelevant information on their own. This shaped retrieval systems to optimize for finding and ranking more relevant documents, but not keeping results clean and minimal, as the human was the final filter. However, LLMs have changed that by lacking this filtering ability.
  To address this, we introduce Bits-over-Random (BoR), a chance-corrected measure of retrieval selectivity that reveals when high success rates mask random-level performance. We measure selectivity as $BoR = \log_{2}\left(\frac{\mathrm{P}_{obs}}{\mathrm{P}_{rand}}\right)$, where $\mathrm{P}_{rand}$ is the hypergeometric baseline for the chosen success rule (here, coverage: $ \geq1 $ relevant in top-$K$).
  On the 20 Newsgroups dataset, BM25 and SPLADE both report $>99$% success at $K=100$ (coverage), yet $BoR \approx 0$, indicating random-level selectivity at that depth. When the expected coverage ratio $\left(\frac{K \cdot \bar{R}_{q}}{N}\right)$ exceeds 3-5, the baseline dominates and selectivity collapses. Downstream retrieval-augmented generation (RAG) evaluation confirms this pattern: LLM accuracy can degrade substantially at $K=100$, consistent with the near-zero BoR ceiling. In contrast, BoR remains positive on BEIR/SciFact and on MS MARCO (where 41 systems cluster within 0.2 bits of the theoretical ceiling despite a 13-point recall gap), confirming baseline predictions across sparse and large-scale settings. We further show that the collapse boundary applies to LLM agent tool selection, where small catalog sizes cause selectivity to vanish even with perfect selectors. These findings suggest reporting BoR alongside traditional metrics and reconsidering depth choices when additional retrieval provides negligible selectivity gains while inflating computational costs.

AI.tldr: 本文揭示了传统检索指标（如成功率）在LLM时代可能产生误导——表面高成功率可能掩盖随机级选择性。通过引入机会校正指标BoR，证明了在高召回深度下检索增益趋于消失，并建议将BoR与传统指标联合报告以指导检索深度选择。
AI.motivation: 传统信息检索系统假设人类能自行过滤不相关信息，因此优化目标聚焦于找到更多相关文档，而非保持结果的简洁性。然而大语言模型（LLM）不具备这种过滤能力，导致传统指标（如成功率>99%）可能掩盖实际的选择性不足。
AI.method: 提出了Bits-over-Random (BoR)指标，公式为BoR = log₂(P_obs/P_rand)，其中P_rand是所选成功规则的超几何基线（如覆盖率规则：top-K中至少1个相关文档）。BoR通过机会校正来揭示隐藏在表面高成功率下的随机级性能。
AI.result: 在20 Newsgroups数据集上，BM25和SPLADE均报告K=100时覆盖率>99%，但BoR≈0，说明此时性能等同于随机基线。仅当期望覆盖率比(K·R̄_q/N)超过3-5时，基线效应主导，选择性崩溃。RAG下游任务的LLM准确率在K=100时显著下降，而BEIR/SciFact和MS MARCO上BoR保持正值（41个系统在0.2 bits内聚类，尽管召回率差距达13点）。工具选择场景同样显示小规模目录下选择性消失。
AI.conclusion: 建议将BoR与传统的召回率、精确率等指标一起报告；在选择检索深度K时需要重新考虑——当额外检索带来的选择性收益微乎其微却徒增计算成本时，应慎选K值。

title: Emergence of Frontier Superposition: Möbius attractor and Cascade Supervision
summary:
Superposition allows Transformers to reason in depth, carrying an entire reasoning frontier in parallel through a bounded-depth forward pass instead of unrolling serial chain-of-thought tokens. While Zhu et al. (2025) hand-crafted an equal-weight breadth-first frontier in a single residual stream for graph reachability, it remained open whether gradient descent could ever find this target amidst permutation-symmetric saddles.
  We close this gap on Reachability-by-Superposition over Erdős-Rényi graphs by isolating architectural and supervisional contributions. Architecturally, we identify a Möbius attractor: under $S_n$-symmetry in the tree regime, layerwise dynamics reduce to a 1D Möbius map whose zero set is a codimension-one manifold of global optima containing the equal-weight superposition state.
  On the supervision side, we identify Cascade Supervision: a loss class whose backward pass simultaneously delivers (A) selectivity bootstrap, (B) gradient persistence across depth, and (C) per-step discrimination (e.g., \mathcal{L}_{sup} and \mathcal{L}_{node}). End-to-end supervision fails condition (B) and is provably insufficient: internal gradients at layer c decay as (np)^{-(D-c-2)/2} in the graph fan-out and stall before the manifold is reached.
  Our thesis: Möbius attractor + Cascade Supervision = emergence of superposition reasoning. The parameter-free decay law predicts a final-step cosine of 0.35 vs. 0.71 (end-to-end vs. cascade) at depth D=3; experiments confirm 0.37 vs. 0.69, matching within 0.02 at every step.

AI.tldr: 本文研究Transformer中的叠加(superposition)推理机制，证明梯度下降可在特定架构和监督条件下发现等权叠加状态，并给出了可验证的参数无关衰减定律。
AI.motivation: Zhu等人(2025)提出了单一残差流中等权重广度优先前沿的叠加推理概念，但尚不清楚梯度下降在置换对称环境中是否能收敛到该目标状态。本文旨在填补这一理论空白。
AI.method: 在Erdős-Rényi图上研究Reachability-by-Superposition问题，从架构和监督两方面分析。架构上，将层间动态简化为1D Möbius映射；监督上，提出Cascade Supervision损失类，同时满足选择引导、梯度持久化和逐步判别三个条件，并与端到端监督进行对比。
AI.result: 证明端到端监督在深度c处的内部梯度以(np)^(-(D-c-2)/2)衰减，无法到达全局最优流形；Cascade Supervision可解决梯度衰减问题。理论预测D=3时最终步余弦相似度为0.35(端到端)vs 0.71(级联)，实验结果为0.37 vs 0.69，每步误差不超过0.02。
AI.conclusion: 叠加推理的涌现需要Möbius吸引子与级联监督的共同作用：Möbius吸引子提供架构支撑，级联监督确保梯度持久性，二者缺一不可。参数无关衰减定律具有高度可预测性，理论预测与实验结果高度吻合。

title: Prior Knowledge or Search? A Study of LLM Agents in Hardware-Aware Code Optimization
summary: LLM discovery and optimization systems are increasingly applied across domains, implementing a common propose-evaluate-revise loop. Such optimization or discovery progresses via context conditioning on received feedback from an environment. However, as modern LLM agents are increasingly complex in their structure, it is difficult to evaluate which components contribute the most, and when and how this exploration may fail. We answer these questions through three controlled experiments. Our findings: (1) In pure black-box optimization, LLMs act as greedy optimizers. (2) In zero-shot kernel generation, providing explicit input-size information has no measurable effect, models converge to the same kernel parameters regardless of size or temperature, as though the size instruction were invisible. Moreover, when tasked to perform kernel optimization for uncommon kernel sizes, performance sharply degrades regardless of the language used. (3) In feedback-loop kernel optimization, CUDA improves monotonically under iterative feedback, while TVM IR actively degrades, which demonstrates that kernel optimization degrades when models operate with low-density language. Our results conclude that LLMs in code optimization tasks highly depend on pretrained priors rather than provided feedback or agentic structure.

AI.tldr:
这篇论文通过三组受控实验，把 LLM 智能体的「propose→evaluate→revise」循环与黑盒优化（BBO）放在同一形式框架下比较，核心论点是：**LLM 在代码优化中是「强先验利用者、弱开放式搜索者」**，其性能主要由预训练先验（prior）决定，而非反馈信号或智能体结构。

关键发现有三：(1) 纯黑盒优化中 LLM 表现为贪心局部精修，路径归一化长度 L 高（0.42–0.72）、覆盖率低（10.9–37.7%），在需真正探索的 Physical/BBOB/BBOB-5D 上全面败给 CMA-ES 与 Centaur 混合方法；MCTS 则走向另一极端（覆盖率 93–99% 但几乎不利用）。(2) 零样本 kernel 生成中，无论显式/隐式给出输入尺寸还是采样温度 T∈{0.1,0.5,0.8}，模型都收敛到同一组硬件参数模式（threads=256、BLOCK_SIZE=256、shared_shape=256、TILE_K/M/N=32），pass-rate 曲线在整个尺寸网格上近乎平坦，尺寸指令「如同不可见」；小尺寸下加速 kernel 占比从 59% 跌至 31%，而 TVM MetaSchedule 反而从 41% 升至 69%。(3) 反馈环中 CUDA 的编译正确率随迭代单调上升，而先验稀疏的 TVM IR（预训练 token 量约为 CUDA 的 1/100）每步退化，尽管其初始参考程序语义上更强——说明退化源于先验密度而非参考质量；尺寸分布偏移时 MetaSchedule 反超，在 69%（gpt-oss）与 67%（Qwen3-Coder）kernel 上获胜。
AI.motivation:
现代 LLM 发现/优化系统（如矩阵乘法、方程发现、GPU kernel 优化）普遍采用 propose→evaluate→revise 循环，与黑盒优化（BBO）结构相同，但关键差异在于：代理模型更新目标景观的后验，而 LLM 将先验编码在冻结权重中，仅通过上下文（context）条件化来适应。

论文由此提出精确问题：**LLM 驱动的发现究竟在哪里、以何种方式失效？** 现有智能体流水线把上下文操纵、迭代反馈、种群进化与随机搜索混在一起，难以归因到单一因素；已有工作（如 KernelEvolve、KernelEvo、CUDA Agent）要么闭源要么缺少消融。因此作者在受控、最小化的环境中隔离各因素。

形式化框架（Section 2）把两者置于同一外循环：LLM 智能体的提案分布 q_k^llm 由冻结权重 θ 与上下文 c_k 决定，权重冻结施加了一个与 c_k 无关的**熵下界 H(q_k^llm) ≥ H_θ > 0**；而 BBO 通过更新内部状态 φ_k 获得逐步**熵缩减保证** E[H(q_{k+1})|D_k] ≤ H(q_k)（由塔式法则直接推出）。先验在目标表示上稠密时反馈有效，先验稀疏时无论累积多少反馈都无法突破该下界。这正是混合方法（LLM 提案 + 结构化搜索）与 RL 微调（更新权重以降低 H_θ）兴起的理论依据。
AI.method:
三组受控实验：

**实验一：纯黑盒优化（BBO）**。任务集四组：100 个含多局部极小的合成 2D 函数（Functions）、100 个基于物理系统方程的 2D 参数辨识问题（Physical）、BBOB 的 48 个 2D 与 48 个 5D 问题，搜索域均为 [-5,5]^d。统一 50 次评估预算，比较四种设置：纯 LLM 顺序提案器（gpt-oss-120b、DeepSeek-V3.2）、CMA-ES（Optuna 实现）、Centaur（CMA-ES+LLM 双向协同适应）、LLM-MCTS（UCB1 扩展 + 并行 k 候选 + 最小子节点损失回传）。三项指标：best step（首次取得最优的步号）、coverage（Cov_50 = πr²/S，即以采样点质心为心、最远点为半径的包围盘面积占比）、归一化轨迹长度 L（端点位移/路径总长，L=1 为直线，K=50 各向同性随机游走约 0.14）。另设「greedy-gradient 探针」：先均匀随机采 10 点并评估，再要求模型提 5 步，分别用黑盒提示与追加「Optimize like Bayesian optimization!」的 BO 提示，检验锚定对象。

**实验二：形状偏置分析（零样本 kernel 生成）**。对 Softmax、Matmul with Aᵀ、融合卷积三个 kernel 构造 10 个尺寸的 shape 网格；提示分为 implicit（尺寸仅在任务描述中给出）与 explicit（额外显式指令关注尺寸）。每格采样 20 个零样本 kernel，温度 T∈{0.1,0.5,0.8}，记录 pass-rate 与主导分块参数（threads、BLOCK_SIZE、shared_shape、TILE_K/M/N）。模型为 gpt-oss-120b 与 Qwen3-Coder-Next (80B)，代码生成温度 0.1、辅助调用 0.7。

**实验三：带反馈的迭代式硬件感知 kernel 优化**。两种表示：CUDA（模型把 PyTorch 参考译为 CUDA kernel）与 TVM IR（由 PyTorch 经 ONNX→Relax→TIR 去调度注解生成的无调度 TensorIR，LLM 需改写为带调度的 TVMScript）。先验密度以 The Stack 中 cl100k token 量衡量，TVM 相关语料约为 CUDA 的 1/100。尺寸区间：KernelBench level 1/2 的 native 与 small-input（如 matmul 2048×8192×4096 → 128×512×256），每级每区间 100 个 kernel。基线：torch.compile（速度比参照）与 TVM MetaSchedule（无预训练先验的 BBO 家族代表）。两种智能体流水线：Sampling Agent（独立生成 5 个候选→各自编译/正确性/profiling→结构化反馈聚合→生成第 6 个候选，共 11 次 LLM 调用）与 Feedback Loop（advisor/diagnoser + coder 顺序迭代 ≤5 步，始终保留参考与当前最优，共 10 次调用）。硬件为 8×A100-80GB、CUDA 12.6、PyTorch 2.9.0。

**理论部分（附录 B）**：证明 BBO 满足逐步熵缩减不等式；而 LLM 因 (i) 无贝叶斯更新、(ii) 冻结权重使可达分布集 Q_θ = {p_θ(·|c, G)} 有限，从而存在熵地板 H_∞(θ, X_τ) > 0——当预训练语料对 X_τ 覆盖稀疏时该地板显著（TVM IR），当覆盖稠密时很小（CUDA）。
AI.result:
