**（1）LLM 是贪心优化器，需外部探索编排。** Functions 任务上 LLM 胜（gpt-oss 75–83%、DeepSeek 80–88%），因多局部极小使贪心下降足够；但 Physical（gpt-oss 29–49%）与 BBOB、BBOB-5D（5D 上 gpt-oss 11 vs 37、DeepSeek 9 vs 39）上全面落败。诊断指标吻合：LLM 的 Cov_50 仅 10.9–37.7%，L 高达 0.60–0.72（局部受限、近直线轨迹）；CMA-ES/Centaur 覆盖与轨迹长度最均衡、综合表现最佳；MCTS 覆盖 93–99% 却耗尽预算于探索、极少利用（部分归因于超参选择）。CoT 显示模型自称以「gradient descent 近似」来解释每次局部扰动——即使在 BO 风格提示下亦然（推测源于 next-token 训练目标或训练数据中数值优化程序的偏见）。锚定探针显示：在 2D 球面 10 个随机点后再提 5 步，两个模型在两种提示下都总是最接近**历史最优点**而非最近一步，证实「锚定最优 + 局部梯度式移动」。用 MCTS 智能体做外部探索编排即可弥补差距并超过任一单独方法。

**（2）零样本生成的先验坍塌（尺寸无关）。** 两个模型、三个温度下 pass-rate 曲线在整个尺寸网格上近乎平坦，explicit 与 implicit 条件曲线几乎不可区分；控制性能的参数（block size、tile size、vector width、unroll factor）在所有尺寸与温度下固定为少数几个模式（Softmax threads/BLOCK_SIZE=256 各约 36–43%、shared_shape=256 约 6.5–11.5%；Matmul TILE_K/M/N=32 各约 25.5–27.5%；融合卷积 threads=256 约 79–82%），仅变量名与循环顺序变化——即生成了通用配置而非按形状特化。由此产生分布偏移退化：小输入下 LLM 加速 kernel 比例从 59% 降至 31%，而 BBO 式的 TVM MetaSchedule 不降反升，从 41% 升至 69%。

**（3）反馈的有效性以表示（语言先验）为条件。** Feedback Loop 中，gpt-oss-120b 的 CUDA「编译且正确」率随迭代稳步上升；而 TVM IR 上「编译且正确」与「正确且更快」两项比率随反馈累积而**逐轮下降**。值得注意的是 TVM IR 从语义上更强的起点出发（已是合法的无调度程序），pass-rate 仍下降，证明该效应由**先验密度**而非参考质量驱动；作者解释为编译器报错与 profiling 只告知「是否失败/多快」，却不提供构造有效高效调度所需的模式知识，反馈无法填补该缺口。尺寸分布偏移下优势反转：MetaSchedule 在 small-input 区间于 69%（gpt-oss）与 67%（Qwen3-Coder）kernel 上获胜，效应在 Level 2 最强，原因是 LLM 反馈策略携带了对基准原生形状校准的尺寸特定参数偏置，工作负载尺度一变这些偏置即具误导性，而无先验的 MetaSchedule 可自由搜索。

**（4）顺序反馈优于并行采样。** 在匹配 LLM 预算下，Feedback Loop 始终优于 Sampling Agent；仅在最稠密先验角落（原生尺寸 CUDA）两者接近，因为此时聚合上下文足够丰富可有效条件化。作者归因于采样智能体的上下文过载，以及外部先验无关的多个小修正优于来自杂乱上下文的单次大更新。注意 TVM IR 的相对改进更大只是因为 CUDA 基线起点更强、余量更小，与绝对退化并不矛盾（改善与退化的 kernel 并非同一子集）。

**共同模式**：零样本生成忽略给定尺寸（强代码先验压过提示）；迭代反馈在 CUDA 上有益、在训练数据稀疏的 TVM IR 上有害；尺寸偏移下 MetaSchedule 反超 LLM 智能体；智能体结构与反馈只能在先验已与目标解空间对齐时放大性能，无法弥补其缺失。
AI.conclusion:
核心论点：决定智能体优化表现的关键变量不是「是否存在反馈」，而是「反馈能否被模型的先验吸收」。

三条结论：(1) **反馈具有表示条件性**——在先验稠密域（CUDA）有益，在先验稀疏域（TVM IR）可能使生成失稳；因此增加反馈轮数往往不足以改善 TVM 类低密度语言的调度质量。(2) **对具体外部信号的顺序条件化优于在同等预算下对多条采样轨迹的一次性聚合**。(3) **鲁棒的优化流水线应自适应路由**：先验覆盖稠密处用 LLM 精修，分布偏移或先验稀疏处依赖任务自适应搜索（CMA-ES/MetaSchedule/MCTS 等）。

改进方向有三：领域专用 RL 适配先验（降低 H_θ）、推理时检索含信息性模式的示例、以外部智能体脚手架强制探索。附录 A 的相关工作梳理印证了该定位：CoT 行为反映分布内结构化偏置、有效性受训测不匹配程度制约；纯 LLM 优化器常表现为「局部精修器」，高新颖性往往导致语义漂移而无适应度增益；CMA-ES 在固定超参空间上稳定优于纯 LLM，而共享内部状态的混合框架（Centaur）达到 SOTA。

局限与影响：仅覆盖少数模型族与标准基准（KernelBench、The Stack token 统计），The Stack 作为预训练语料代表存在近似性；尽管内核生成可降能耗，自动生成代码投产前需严格验证，论文亦不涉及安全相关场景的使用建议。

title: Quantum Adversarial Machine Learning: From Classical Adaptations to Quantum-Native Methods
summary: Machine learning has revolutionized numerous industrial domains. Despite recent advances, machine learning models remain vulnerable to adversarial threats. Adversarial machine learning is a field that studies these vulnerabilities to build robust machine learning models. Quantum machine learning is an interdisciplinary field that bridges quantum computing and classical machine learning. While quantum machine learning shows potentials to outperform classical machine learning in complex tasks such as regression, classification, and generative modeling, it remains vulnerable to adversarial attacks. Given the recent advancements in quantum computing and machine learning, the quantum adversarial machine learning field has emerged to study the vulnerabilities of quantum machine learning, possible attacks, and novel quantum-enhanced defense strategies. In this survey, we provide a detailed overview on quantum adversarial machine learning and explore the existing attacks and countermeasures. We also review the theoretical underpinnings of this area, emerging trends, and critical challenges.

AI.tldr: 本文是一篇关于量子对抗机器学习的综述论文，探讨了量子机器学习模型面临的对抗性攻击威胁、现有攻击与防御方法，并展望了该新兴交叉领域的研究趋势与关键挑战。
AI.motivation: 机器学习模型易受对抗性威胁，而量子机器学习虽然有超越经典机器学习的潜力，但也存在安全漏洞。随着量子计算和机器学习的发展，量子对抗机器学习作为一个新兴交叉领域需要系统性的研究总结。
AI.method: 本文采用综述方法，全面梳理了量子对抗机器学习领域的现有攻击方法与防御策略，分析了该领域的发展脉络与理论基础。
AI.result: 该综述详细梳理了量子对抗机器学习领域的攻击方法、对抗措施、理论基础及最新发展趋势。
AI.conclusion: 量子对抗机器学习领域处于快速发展阶段，需要跨学科协作来解决安全性挑战，量子增强的防御策略有望成为重要研究方向。

title: SciCustom: A Framework for Custom Evaluation of Scientific Capabilities in Large Language Models
summary: Large language models (LLMs) are increasingly applied to scientific research, yet existing evaluations often fail to reflect the fine-grained capabilities required in practice. Most benchmarks are manually curated or domain-generic, limiting scalability and alignment with real scientific use cases. In this paper, we propose a new framework named SciCustom to address the problem. It enables the custom construction of benchmarks from large-scale scientific data to evaluate application-specific scientific capabilities in LLMs. SciCustom first organizes scientific knowledge into ontology-grounded knowledge units with controlled granularity and trains a tagger to map large-scale data instances into this knowledge space. Given a custom requirement, relevant knowledge units are identified via voting-based multi-model consensus. These units enable relevance-aware benchmark retrieval via binary search, followed by proxy subset selection and data-grounded benchmark generation for efficient evaluation. Experiments in chemistry and healthcare demonstrate that SciCustom reveals fine-grained differences in LLM scientific capabilities that standard benchmarks overlook, while requiring neither expert annotation nor synthetic question generation. This work provides a scalable and application-aware foundation for benchmarking scientific capabilities in LLMs. The source code is available at https://github.com/yjwtheonly/SciCustom.

AI.tldr: SciCustom 是一个“本体驱动”的自动化基准构建框架：把复杂科学应用分解为可复用的细粒度“知识单元”，用打标器把百万级真实科学语料一次性映射到知识单元空间，再按用户需求通过多模型投票选出相关单元，用二分搜索做相关性截断、按内在难度/质量分布做代理子集采样，最终把真实数据转化为多选题基准，从而无需专家标注或纯合成问题即可构建“应用感知”的科学能力评测集。
AI.motivation: LLM 在科学研究中的落地日益广泛，但现有评测难以反映实际科研场景所需的细粒度能力：主流基准多为人工构建或面向宽泛领域，通用/领域基准的模型排序常与专家在具体子领域上的判断明显偏离；且科学应用高度交叉（药物发现同时涉及有机化学、分子生物学、药理学），逐场景人工构建会造成巨大冗余、难以扩展；同时高质量科学评测数据依赖昂贵的湿实验或仿真，通用合成数据方法缺乏事实接地性。核心诉求是：既能自动、规模化地针对任意自定义科学需求生成基准，又保持 ground-truth 有效性与可验证性，且不需要专家标注或纯合成题目。
AI.method: 离线阶段：①构建本体知识空间——融合 OBO、BioPortal、OLS 等权威仓库得到覆盖 227 个子学科的 DAG 本体，用 DFS 遍历并由 LLM 按“教材章节级”粒度标准（coarse/moderate/fine）筛选出 641 个知识单元，外加 1 个 Non-Scientific 边界单元，共 642 个；②训练打标器（tagger）——在 5 万条合成数据（按 1–5 个知识单元组合采样、以本体后代节点关键词为提示由 GPT-4o 生成查询）与 3 万条真实指令数据（LLM 标注标签，含非科学查询）上微调 LLaMA-3-8B，把每条 QA 映射为知识单元子集，实现“一次标注、多需求复用”；语料共 2,000,367 条来自 SciRIFF/SciInstruct/Mol-Instruct/MultiMedQA/SciEval/MMLU-Pro/GPQA/IfBench/SimpleQA，并剔除与专家基准重叠样本。在线阶段：①投票式多模型共识（GPT-5、Claude-opus-4.5、Gemini-3-pro-preview），按平均排名取 Top-K1=10 个相关知识单元；②层级数据选择——先按 |T_r∩T_q| 与单元平均排名对候选集预排序，再以二分搜索（多数投票判定相关性）寻找相关性截断点，将 LLM 判定次数从线性降到 O(log|D'|)，假设排序列表的相关性近似单调递减；③代理子集选择——用基于困惑度的 hardness score 与 Flesch 可读性 quality score 刻画样本，最小化子集与全集的 Wasserstein 距离，沿用 SubLIME 的 RoBERTa 嵌入聚类采样 K2=100；④数据接地的 MCQ 生成——由 LLM 为每个样本生成科学上合理的干扰项，输出标准化单选基准。
AI.result: 在 6 个化学子领域（ChemBench）与 5 个医疗健康子领域（MMLU-Pro health 子集，共 11 个任务）与专家排序的一致性上，SciCustom 在 11 个任务中的 10 个取得最高 Spearman 相关系数（化学：分析化学 0.86、无机 0.67、材料 0.42、有机 0.89、物理 0.74、技术化学 0.86；健康：病毒学 0.55、衰老 0.49、医学遗传 0.42、解剖 0.62、营养 0.78），Kendall 同样全面领先，并在 11 个任务中的 8 个选中与专家基准相同的 top-1 模型。基线对比显示通用基准（IfBench、SimpleQA 多次为负相关）、GPQA、MMLU、MedQA 均不稳定；纯合成 GPT-5（多为负相关）与 k-NN 的 Embedding 基线更弱，说明接地数据与本体单元化缺一不可；GPT-5-RAG 与 Embedding-filtering 有小幅提升但仍全面低于完整管线。打标器在 1000 条未见组合查询上 Macro-F1 75.2%、Micro-F1 78.6%。消融显示去掉二分截断（w/o cutoff）与改为随机采样（w/o selection）均明显下降排序一致性；相比贪心 Top-K 选择（健康任务 Spearman 仅 0.16–0.34），二分截断显著更优（作者归因于绕过“教科书式高频题”的天花板饱和效应）。人工评测（50 道化学 MCQ，3 名 AI4Chemistry 硕士生）Correctness 均值 0.92、Relevance 均值 0.70；干扰项自动评测 HTS 8.7 / SPS 7.9，无上下文基线准确率降至约 22%。案例研究显示针对无现成基准的“周环反应（Pericyclic Reaction）”，框架自动定位的高相关知识单元（Cyclization、Aromatic hydrocarbon、Ring compound 等）与专家判断高度一致，检索数据与转化后的 MCQ 也获专家认可。
AI.conclusion: SciCustom 通过本体锚定的可复用知识单元，把零散科学语料重组为可组合的知识空间，从而在不依赖专家标注与纯合成题目的前提下，自动化构建可扩展、应用感知的科学能力基准；实验证明其在化学与健康领域与专家基准高度对齐，并能评测此前无基准的新兴科学场景（如周环反应）。局限包括：本体覆盖主要限于生物医学与化学（来自 OBO/BioPortal/OLS），数学、理论物理等尚缺；基准质量受源语料覆盖度限制，部分知识单元存在数据稀疏（可通过打标器监控频率）；二分搜索依赖相关性近似单调的假设；材料科学等宽泛交叉领域一致性偏低（与另一专家基准之间本身也只有 ρ=0.31），需进一步细粒度统一。代码开源：https://github.com/yjwtheonly/SciCustom

title: Understanding Wacky Weights: A Dissection of SPLADE's Learned Term Importance
summary: Learned sparse retrieval models such as SPLADE combine the effectiveness of neural architectures with the efficiency of inverted indices. As these models assign weights to terms from a fixed vocabulary, interpretability is often touted as a major benefit of these models. However, the emergence of wacky weights, i.e., expansion terms that appear semantically unrelated to the input, limits interpretability. While prior research has anecdotally observed this phenomenon, there is a lack of systematic understanding regarding their origins, prevalence, and contribution to retrieval effectiveness. In this paper, we reproduce SPLADE-v2 to systematically investigate wacky weights across the SPLADE family of models. We present a comprehensive dissection of wacky weights, providing a formal definition of wackiness based on the lexical utility of expansion terms. Furthermore, we introduce a novel measure to compare the prevalence of these tokens across models with varying vocabularies and sparsity levels. Beyond reproducing the original SPLADE-v2, we train it with various loss functions, datasets, and backbone transformers to isolate the factors contributing to wackiness. Our results show that larger vocabularies are associated with a higher prevalence of wacky tokens, while stricter sparsity regularizers are associated with lower prevalence. Finally, we find that wacky weights are used primarily for in-domain effectiveness rather than out-of-domain generalization.

AI.tldr: 系统研究了SPLADE模型中怪异权重的来源、流行程度及其对检索有效性的贡献，发现词表规模和稀疏正则化是关键影响因素。
AI.motivation: SPLADE模型中的怪异权重现象限制了模型可解释性，但缺乏系统性研究。
AI.method: 复现SPLADE-v2并通过改变损失函数、数据集和骨干Transformer进行消融实验；提出怪异性形式化定义和新度量指标。
AI.result: 较大词表增加怪异token流行率；严格稀疏正则化降低流行率；怪异权重主要用于域内效能而非泛化。
AI.conclusion: 怪异权重是SPLADE模型实现域内检索效能的代价之一，可通过调整词表规模和稀疏正则化来控制其流行程度。

title: A Methodology for Selecting and Composing Runtime Architecture Patterns for Production LLM Agents
comment: 25 pages, 2 figures, 6 tables. Companion repo at https://github.com/vasundras/agent-runtime-patterns
summary:
Production LLM agents combine stochastic model outputs with deterministic software systems, yet the boundary between the two is rarely treated as a first-class architectural object. This paper names that boundary the stochastic-deterministic boundary (SDB): a four-part contract among a proposer, verifier, commit step, and reject signal that specifies how an LLM output becomes a system action. We argue that the SDB is the load-bearing primitive of production agent runtimes.
  Around this primitive, we organize agent runtime design into three concerns: Coordination, State, and Control. We present a catalog of six runtime patterns that compose the SDB differently across conversational, autonomous, and long-horizon agents: hierarchical delegation, scatter-gather plus saga, event-driven sequencing, shared state machine, supervisor plus gate, and human in the loop. For each pattern, we trace its lineage to distributed-systems concepts and identify what changes when the worker is stochastic.
  The paper contributes a five-step methodology for selecting runtime patterns, a diagnostic procedure that maps production failures to pattern weaknesses, and a failure mode called replay divergence, in which LLM-based consumers of a deterministic event log produce different downstream outputs under model-version or prompt changes. A stylized reliability decomposition separates per-call model variance from architectural momentum, motivating the claim that as model variance decreases, pattern choice and SDB strength become increasingly important levers for long-run reliability. We apply the methodology to five workloads and provide one runnable reference implementation for a 90-day contract-renewal agent.

AI.tldr: 本文提出了随机-确定性边界（SDB）作为生产级 LLM 智能体运行时的核心原语，将其形式化为提议者、验证器、提交步骤和拒绝信号的四部分契约。在此基础上，将智能体运行时设计组织为协调、状态和控制三个维度，梳理了六种运行时模式（分层委托、散聚加Saga、事件驱动排序、共享状态机、监督加门、人在回路），追溯其与分布式系统概念的渊源，并分析随机工作节点带来的变化。文章还提出了五步选型方法论、故障诊断流程、以及"重放分歧"这一新型失败模式，通过可靠性分解论证了模型方差降低后，模式选择和SDB强度将成为长期可靠性的关键杠杆。
AI.motivation: The boundary between stochastic model outputs and deterministic software systems in production LLM agents is rarely treated as a first-class architectural object, creating a gap in understanding and designing reliable agent systems.
AI.method: Organized agent runtime design into three concerns (Coordination, State, and Control) around the SDB primitive; presented a catalog of six runtime patterns (hierarchical delegation, scatter-gather plus saga, event-driven sequencing, shared state machine, supervisor plus gate, and human in the loop); traced each pattern's lineage to distributed-systems concepts; provided a stylized reliability decomposition separating per-call model variance from architectural momentum.
AI.result: Six runtime patterns were identified and cataloged for conversational, autonomous, and long-horizon agents; a five-step methodology for pattern selection and a diagnostic procedure for mapping failures to pattern weaknesses were developed; a new failure mode called "replay divergence" was identified; the methodology was applied to five workloads with a runnable reference implementation for a 90-day contract-renewal agent.
AI.conclusion: SDB is proposed as the load-bearing primitive of production agent runtimes, and as model variance decreases, pattern choice and SDB strength become increasingly important levers for long-run reliability. A five-step methodology for selecting runtime patterns and a diagnostic procedure for mapping production failures to pattern weaknesses are provided, along with a failure mode called replay divergence.

title: Hybrid-LoRA: Bridging Full Fine-Tuning and Low-Rank Adaptation for Post-Training
summary: Post-training has become essential for adapting large language models (LLMs) to complex downstream behaviors, including instruction following, preference alignment, and multi-step reasoning. Reinforcement learning with verifiable rewards (RLVR) has recently emerged as a particularly effective post-training paradigm for improving reasoning capabilities, with critic-free algorithms such as GRPO and GSPO enabling scalable optimization. However, RLVR post-training with full fine-tuning (FFT) requires substantial GPU memory and incurs high training costs. Although parameter-efficient fine-tuning (PEFT) methods, such as Low-Rank Adaptation (LoRA), effectively reduce computational costs, they often suffer from a noticeable performance gap compared to full fine-tuning in post-training for complex reasoning tasks. In this paper, we propose Hybrid-LoRA, an efficient hybrid post-training framework that selectively applies full fine-tuning to a small subset of modules less suited to low-rank adaptation, while adapting the remaining components with LoRA. We introduce a novel Hybrid-LoRA Score to rank candidate modules according to their sensitivity to low-rank adaptation under a fixed parameter budget. Experiments show that Hybrid-LoRA closely matches full fine-tuning performance under a 10% full fine-tuning module budget, with the remaining candidate modules adapted by LoRA, consistently outperforming four state-of-the-art PEFT post-training baselines, achieving improvements of up to 5.65% and on average 4.36% over the best baseline.

AI.tldr: Hybrid-LoRA 是一种面向 RLVR 后训练（GRPO/GSPO）的"混合参数高效微调"框架：先用 LoRA 探针阶段给 Transformer 各线性模块打分（Hybrid-Score，基于一阶梯度加权敏感度 μ·σ），再把低分模块（多为后层注意力投影）改为全参数微调、其余模块保留 LoRA。在 Qwen-2.5 1.5B/3B/7B Instruct 上，仅用约 10% 的全参模块预算即可逼近甚至略超全量微调，并稳定优于 LoRA/AdaLoRA/AutoLoRA/LoRA-Drop 四个 PEFT 基线（最高 +5.65%，平均 +4.36%）。
AI.motivation: RLVR（GRPO、GSPO 等无 critic 方法）已成为提升 LLM 复杂推理能力的核心后训练范式，但全参微调（FFT）显存与训练成本高昂；LoRA 等 PEFT 虽大幅降本，却在复杂推理后训练上与 FFT 存在明显性能差距。已有变体（AdaLoRA、AutoLoRA、SoRA、ALoRA）仅在低秩空间内部重新分配 rank 预算，无法弥补"某些模块所需的任务更新本身不是低秩可表达"这一根本局限。作者的核心假设是：Transformer 各模块对低秩适配的适配性并不相同——部分模块需要全参数更新以保住后训练性能，其余模块用 LoRA 即已足够。因此需要解决两个问题：(1) 如何在固定可训练参数预算下高效估计各模块是否"适合"低秩适配并分配 FFT/PEFT；(2) 如何在有限可训练参数下实现稳定的 RL 优化。作者进一步指出，仅仅堆多可训练参数并不能弥合与 FFT 的差距，"参数如何跨模块分配"才是关键。
AI.method:
框架为两阶段（Algorithm 1+2），并给出组合优化形式化：候选集 𝒰 = {1..L} × {W_q,W_k,W_v,W_o,W_gate,W_up,W_down}，划分 𝒮_fft ∪ 𝒮_lora = 𝒰 且满足 ∑_{𝒮_fft} P / ∑_{𝒰} P ≤ R_fft（实验中 R_fft=10%），目标是最大化后训练性能 J，该问题搜索空间指数级故用贪心近似。

(1) 探针/评分阶段：在全部候选模块上挂 LoRA（rank r=16，采用 AdaLoRA 式 SVDLinear 参数化 x' = xW+b+α·xAEB，其中 E=diag(e) 为奇异值样式系数向量），冻结原权重，仅训 LoRA 参数预热 500 步。Hybrid-Score 计算：验证集每个 batch 随机把候选模块二分为互补桶 𝒰_A/𝒰_B（受 Shapley-NAS、R-Drop 启发），做两次"掩码"反向传播（分别屏蔽 A 桶、B 桶），因每个模块恰好在一次前向中启用，故只有启用那次产生非零梯度；取 g_{l,m} = ∇_{e_{l,m}}[L_A + L_B]，batch 级敏感度 s = (1/r)‖e ⊙ g‖₁（衡量一阶扰动对验证损失的影响）；跨 T 个 batch 聚合为 H(l,m) = μ_{l,m}·σ_{l,m}，其中 μ 为平均 LoRA 侧敏感度、σ 为在随机共激活上下文下的波动（反映模块间交互与上下文依赖性）。H 高 ⇒ LoRA 已足够；H 低 ⇒ 低秩适配不足。

(2) 分配与正式训练：将所有模块按 H 升序排序，贪心地把最低分模块加入 𝒮_fft 直到触及预算约束，其余划入 𝒮_lora。随后从原始预训练 checkpoint 重新初始化模型（避免探针阶段污染），对 𝒮_fft 解冻全参数、对 𝒮_lora 挂 LoRA，并用标准 GRPO/GSPO 后训练目标优化；每 50 步评估并保留验证损失最低的 checkpoint。

对比基线设计亦为"受控"式：把 AdaLoRA/AutoLoRA/LoRA-Drop 的低秩侧准则（分配 rank、学习到的架构权重 α、LoRA 输出贡献）改作模块选择依据，各取最低 10% 模块做 FFT，以匹配可训练参数量；另有启发式混合基线 LoRA-FFN（FFN 用 LoRA、注意力全参）、FFT 上界参考、IO/CoT 纯推理基线。
AI.result:
实验设置：8×A800 80GB；基座 Qwen-2.5 1.5B/3B/7B Instruct；统一训练语料 Mixture-of-Thoughts（约 35 万条源自 DeepSeek-R1 的验证推理轨迹）；六个基准 Math-500（pass@1）、AIME-24/25（pass@4）、MMLU-Pro、GPQA（accuracy）、LeetCodeDataset（pass@4）；FFT 模块学习率 1e-6、LoRA 2.5e-5，group size 4，clip ±0.2，KL 系数 0.01，K=20 次随机划分估计分数。

主要结果：Hybrid-LoRA 在所有模型规模与基准上稳定优于最强 PEFT 基线，平均相对提升 4.36%、最高 5.65%。1.5B 上仅用约 105M 可训练参数（FFT 需 1544M）即在 GRPO/GSPO 下达到与 FFT 相当或更优的表现（如 GRPO：Math-500 80.2 vs 80.6、AIME-24 38.0 vs 40.0、GPQA 37.3 vs 37.2、LeetCode 48.0 vs 48.3）；3B 上 192M 参数接近 3086M 的 FFT（如 GRPO Math-500 91.4 vs 91.2、MMLU-Pro 71.9 vs 71.8）；7B 上 449M 参数在 GRPO/GSPO 全面领先 AutoLoRA（如 GSPO：Math-500 94.4、GPQA 77.9、LeetCode 74.5），提升主要体现在数学密集型基准上。

模块分布分析：被选为全参微调的低分模块集中在网络后部的注意力块（q/k/v/o 投影），而绝大多数 FFN（gate/up/down）仍由 LoRA 适配，说明后层注意力投影对适配方式更敏感、其低秩更新空间表达力不足。

消融：可训练参数预算增大时 Hybrid-LoRA 提升速度显著快于 AutoLoRA；Hybrid-Score 聚合变体（μ/σ、σ/μ、μ+0.5σ）均略低于原始 μ·σ（81.6/47.6）；从 FFT 配置反向剪枝的 Hybrid-LoRA-4 性能相当但因需从全参起步而成本、时延与显存开销高得多，故原始 LoRA 探针式设计更实用。
AI.conclusion: Hybrid-LoRA 通过打破"全参微调 vs LoRA"的二元对立，在模块级别做异质化适配分配：低 Hybrid-Score 模块用 FFT 承担表达力、其余用 LoRA 承担效率，从而在 10% 全参模块预算下逼近全量微调的后训练性能，同时显著降低显存与训练成本，证明"参数跨模块的分配方式"比"参数总量"更能决定 PEFT 在 RLVR 复杂推理后训练中的表现。局限：受算力限制实验仅做到 7B 规模；方法为两阶段（探测→训练）流水线，尚未实现端到端或动态更新的自适应分配，未来可朝此方向扩展。

title: Agentic Trading: When LLM Agents Meet Financial Markets
summary: A growing body of work explores how Large Language Models (LLMs) can be embedded in trading systems as agents that perceive market information, retrieve context, reason about decisions, emit tradable actions, and adapt under market feedback. This paper reframes LLM-based trading agents as expert-system decision pipelines and presents an audit-oriented evidence map of 77 included studies in a protocol-coded snapshot screened through 2026-03-09. A primary empirical subset (n=19) satisfies the minimum boundary of Action Output plus Closed-Loop Evaluation; the remaining 58 included studies are retained as background and design context. The central empirical finding is protocol incomparability: within the primary subset, only 2/19 studies report extractable time-consistent split protocols, 1/19 reports an explicit transaction-cost model, 1/19 documents universe or survivorship handling, 11/19 report execution timing or semantics, 15/19 are coded as R0, and no study reaches R3 reproducibility. We therefore use Architecture-Capability-Adaptation as a working analytical lens rather than a validated taxonomy, and we foreground the evidence ledger, reproducibility audit, and reporting checklist as the main contributions. The resulting survey shows that architectural experimentation is expanding rapidly, while comparable evaluation protocols, execution semantics, and reproducible artifacts remain the field's immediate bottlenecks.

AI.tldr: 本文是一项系统性文献综述，考察了77篇将大型语言模型(LLM)作为交易智能体的研究。核心发现是这些研究之间存在严重的"协议不可比性"问题：19项核心实证研究中，仅2项报告了时间一致的分割协议，仅1项报告了明确的交易成本模型，无一项达到R3可复现性标准。研究认为架构实验正在快速扩展，但可比较的评估协议和可复现的实验构件仍是该领域的主要瓶颈。
AI.motivation: 随着LLM在金融交易系统中的应用迅速增长，亟需对该领域现有研究的质量和可比性进行系统评估，以识别关键的方法论差距和标准化需求。
AI.method: 采用系统性综述方法，通过协议编码对截至2026年3月9日的文献进行快照筛选，从77篇纳入研究中划分出19项满足"行动输出+闭环评估"最小边界的主实证子集，其余58项作为背景和设计上下文保留。采用"架构-能力-适应"作为分析透镜。
AI.result: 核心发现为协议不可比性：主实证子集中仅2/19项研究报告了可提取的时间一致分割协议，1/19报告了显式交易成本模型，1/19记录了宇宙或生存偏差处理，11/19报告了执行时间或语义，15/19被编码为R0无可复现性，无一项研究达到R3可复现性水平。
AI.conclusion: LLM交易智能体的架构实验正在快速扩展，但可比较的评估协议、执行语义和可复现构件仍是该领域的当务之急。研究贡献包括证据账本、可复现性审计和报告清单，旨在为该领域建立更规范的评估标准。

title: Multi-Pedestrian Safety Warning at Urban Intersections Use Case of Digital Twin
summary: Digital twins (DTs) for urban transportation systems have gained increasing attention; however, their systematic evaluation in safety-critical scenarios remains limited. This paper presents a multi-pedestrian safety warning system at urban intersections enabled by a tightly coupled physical-digital twin framework. Built upon the COSMOS city-scale wireless testbed in New York City, the proposed system integrates camera and ultra-wideband (UWB), edge-cloud computing, predictive trajectory modeling, and MQTT-based communication to deliver real-time safety alerts to vulnerable road users (VRUs). The system is evaluated through both field deployment and virtual reality (VR) experiments. Results demonstrate high warning generation accuracy, localization accuracy, efficient end-to-end latency under different model configurations, and significant reductions in user response time when warnings are issued. The proposed DT framework provides a scalable, modular, and generalizable solution for real-time multi-pedestrian safety enhancement at complex urban intersections.

AI.tldr: 本文提出并实测了一个基于数字孪生（DT）框架的城市交叉口多行人安全预警系统：在纽约 COSMOS 城域无线测试床上融合摄像头、超宽带（UWB）定位、边云计算、轨迹预测与 MQTT 通信，向弱势道路使用者（VRU）实时推送告警，并通过实车/实地部署、CARLA 仿真与 VR 用户实验从定位精度、告警准确率、端到端时延和人类响应时间四个维度验证。结果显示：UWB 单用户定位误差约 8 cm，TTC=1.1 s 与危险距离 30 px 阈值下碰撞预测混淆矩阵为 [[66,45],[2,119]]，且告警使行人平均响应时间缩短 0.62 s（滑板车场景）和 1.11 s（车辆场景）。
AI.motivation: 数字孪生在交通管理领域备受关注，但其在安全攸关场景（如交叉口行人-车辆交互）中的系统性评估仍然不足。现有基于基础设施的行人安全预警系统多依赖摄像头/激光雷达/雷达，属于被动反应式，易受遮挡、光照变化和感知噪声影响；且大多仅关注检测精度，缺乏预测性风险建模与闭环干预。已有基于数字孪生的边缘视频分析工作（如 Fu 等的 DT 预警框架、PAVE）主要依赖纯视觉定位和预设危险区，缺乏精细多用户定位与物理-数字状态的同步对齐。UWB 相关研究多停留在室内/工业环境的独立定位或接近告警，未与多模态基础设施感知、预测性轨迹建模和孪生框架结合。因此本文旨在构建紧耦合（物理-数字双向交互）的城市交叉口多行人安全预警孪生系统，并在真实环境与 VR 中评估其时延、精度与人类行为收益。
AI.method: 系统架构：以 COSMOS（Cloud enhanced Open Software defined mobile wireless testbed for city-Scale deployment）城市级无线测试床为物理层，部署于纽约 Columbia 附近 Amsterdam Ave 与 120th St 交叉口，含摄像头（H264/I 帧间隔 10、4K@30fps RTSP）、LiDAR、UWB 锚点与无线节点；数字层基于 Unreal Engine 构建 SUMO-CARLA 集成仿真平台，车辆位置由真实 MQTT 消息同步。关键技术包括：(1) 资源优化组件——按分辨率/帧率/码率动态自适应，使用轻量 YOLOv8s 检测车辆与轨迹确定危险区（RoI Specifier），仅在关键危险区触发大模型 YOLOv8x 行人检测；(2) 轨迹预测模型——比较 InfoSTGCAN、PI-NeuGODE、UQ、卡尔曼滤波与 Trajectron++，以 ADE/FDE 指标选型；(3) UWB 多用户定位——原生 TWR（无时钟同步，LOS 下亚 10 cm），3 个路边锚点 responder 模式 + Raspberry Pi 携带 Qorvo UCI 固件 tag 作 initiator，采用时分调度（周期 N·T，每用户独占 T 时隙）避免信道冲突，再以最小二乘多边定位求解 2D 位置，并用常速模型在测距窗口间插值；(4) 风险评估——基于 TTC 与 PET，通过 ROC 曲线选择 TTC 阈值（0.1–1.2 s）与危险距离阈值（5–100 px）；(5) 通信——MQTT 消息生成与分发；(6) 用户端——Meta Quest 3 头显上的语音与文本告警。
AI.result: 端到端时延（表 I）：接收（以太网/Wi-Fi/LTE/5G）1.94/0.108/4.034/7.216 ms，预处理 11.14 ms，检测 0.973/3.21/6.86 ms（YOLOv8s/m/x），跟踪 45.72/39.21 ms 级，MQTT 创建与获取各在毫秒至十毫秒级，识别出跟踪与网络环节为主要瓶颈。UWB 定位：单用户平均误差 7.983±4.071 cm、测量频率 10 Hz；双用户误差 22.456±6.897 cm、0.3 Hz（主因用户切换重连耗时）。轨迹预测：Trajectron++ 优于卡尔曼滤波（ADE 0.77 vs 0.91，FDE 1.34 vs 1.92）。告警生成准确率：3 轮共 10 分钟、232 个虚拟行人的 CARLA 仿真中，最优 TTC 阈值 1.1 s（TPR 0.958、FPR 0.4）、危险距离阈值 30 px（TPR 0.958、FPR 0.345），碰撞预测混淆矩阵 TP=66、FP=45、FN=2、TN=119。VR 实验：告警使平均响应时间在滑板车场景下降 0.62 s、在车辆场景下降 1.11 s；问卷显示参与者认可 VR/交通真实度，认为告警重要且佩戴舒适。局限：室外 UWB 受车辆遮挡与 Wi-Fi 干扰影响（密集城区更明显），双用户时序信道管理仍待改进。
AI.conclusion: COSMOS 上的实地部署证明该数字孪生框架在密集多模态城市环境中具有可推广性：曼哈顿高交通密度、有限空间与多样出行方式提供了真实而严苛的车-人交互场景。系统强调可扩展性——感知与分析模块资源高效、模块化、可分布式部署于边云，支持从单路口向全网扩展；框架与模型无关，可替换 AI 组件适配不同摄像头配置与城市环境；同时不依赖定制 C-V2X 硬件，而是复用既有交通摄像头与无线网络，以低成本快速落地。未来工作将探索 C-V2X 与先进 V2P 协议以进一步降低时延、提升可靠性，并开展多路口协同、大规模部署评估、隐私保护通信及密集城区多设备可靠同步等研究。

title: EmbGen: Teaching with Reassembled Corpora
summary: Adapting small instruction-tuned models to specialized domains often relies on supervised fine-tuning (SFT) on curated instruction-response examples, which is expensive to collect at scale. Synthetic training examples generated by a teacher LLM from a domain corpus can reduce this cost, but existing pipelines can produce homogenized outputs and do not consistently capture cross-passage or cross-document dependencies. We introduce EmbGen, a synthetic data generation pipeline that decomposes a corpus into entity-description pairs, reassembles them using semantic structure inferred from embedding similarity, and then generates question-answer (QA) pairs via proximity, intra-cluster, and inter-cluster sampling with cluster-specialized system prompts. We evaluate EmbGen against EntiGraph, InstructLab and Knowledge-Instruct on three datasets of varied semantic heterogeneity, under fixed token budgets (5 and 20 million tokens). We use lexical overlap metrics, an LLM-as-a-judge rubric, and Binary Accuracy, a composed metric combining Factual Accuracy and Completeness for evaluation. EmbGen improves Binary Accuracy on the most heterogeneous dataset by 12.5% at 5M and 88.9% at 20M tokens budget, relative to the strongest baseline, while remaining competitive across other datasets with lower heterogeneity.

AI.tldr: EmbGen提出了一种合成数据生成管道，通过嵌入相似性推断语义结构，将语料库分解为实体-描述对并重新组合，使用聚类专用系统提示生成多样化QA对。在异质性最高的数据集上，EmbGen在500万令牌预算下将二进制准确率提升12.5%，在2000万令牌预算下提升88.9%。
AI.motivation: Current synthetic training data generation for domain adaptation has two main limitations: (1) Supervised fine-tuning (SFT) on curated examples is expensive at scale, (2) Existing synthetic pipelines produce homogenized outputs and fail to capture cross-passage or cross-document dependencies.
AI.method: EmbGen is a synthetic data generation pipeline that: (1) Decomposes a corpus into entity-description pairs, (2) Reassembles them using semantic structure inferred from embedding similarity, (3) Generates QA pairs via proximity, intra-cluster, and inter-cluster sampling with cluster-specialized system prompts.
AI.result: On the most heterogeneous dataset, EmbGen improves Binary Accuracy by 12.5% at 5M tokens budget and 88.9% at 20M tokens budget, relative to the strongest baseline.
AI.conclusion: EmbGen remains competitive across other datasets with lower heterogeneity while significantly outperforming baselines on heterogeneous data. The pipeline effectively generates diverse synthetic training examples that capture cross-document dependencies through semantic structure-based reassembly of entity-description pairs.

title: Generative Recursive Reasoning
summary: How should future neural reasoning systems implement extended computation? Recursive Reasoning Models (RRMs) offer a promising alternative to autoregressive sequence extension by performing iterative latent-state refinement with shared transition functions. Yet existing RRMs are largely deterministic, following a single latent trajectory and converging to a single prediction. We introduce \emph{Generative Recursive reAsoning Models (GRAM)}, a framework that turns recursive latent reasoning into probabilistic multi-trajectory computation. GRAM models reasoning as a stochastic latent trajectory, enabling multiple hypotheses, alternative solution strategies, and inference-time scaling through both recursive depth and parallel trajectory sampling. This yields a latent-variable generative model supporting conditional reasoning via $p_θ(y \mid x)$ and, with fixed or absent inputs, unconditional generation via $p_θ(x)$. Trained with amortized variational inference, GRAM improves over deterministic recurrent and recursive baselines on structured reasoning and multi-solution constraint satisfaction tasks, while demonstrating an unconditional generation capability. \href{https://ahn-ml.github.io/gram-website/}{https://ahn-ml.github.io/gram-website}

AI.tldr: GRAM（Generative Recursive reAsoning Models）是一种将递归潜在推理转化为概率多轨迹计算的框架，通过随机潜在轨迹建模替代传统确定性轨迹，实现多个假设探索和替代策略尝试。该模型支持条件推理 $p_θ(y \mid x)$ 和无条件生成 $p_θ(x)$，通过摊余变分推断训练，在结构化推理和约束满足任务上展现优越性能，并通过递归深度和平行轨迹采样实现推理时计算扩展。
AI.motivation: 现有递归推理模型（RRMs）大多是确定性的，遵循单一潜在轨迹并收敛于单一预测。这种局限性无法满足需要探索多个假设、尝试替代解决方案策略的复杂推理任务，也难以通过扩展计算来提升推理质量。
AI.method: GRAM通过以下技术实现概率多轨迹推理：（1）将推理建模为随机潜在轨迹，而非确定性轨迹；（2）采用共享转换函数实现迭代潜在状态细化；（3）支持并行轨迹采样以探索多个假设和替代解决方案策略；（4）使用摊余变分推断（amortized variational inference）进行训练；（5）通过递归深度和并行轨迹采样实现推理时扩展。
AI.result: 实验结果表明，GRAM在结构化推理任务和多解约束满足任务上优于确定性递归基线模型，同时展示了无条件生成能力。
AI.conclusion: GRAM是一个潜在变量生成模型，通过将递归潜在推理转化为概率多轨迹计算，为神经推理系统提供了一种新颖的扩展计算范式。该框架既支持条件推理 $p_θ(y \mid x)$，也支持无条件生成 $p_θ(x)$，展示了在结构化推理和多解约束满足任务上的优越性能，同时具备推理时扩展计算的能力。

title: PRISM: A Benchmark for Programmatic Spatial-Temporal Reasoning
summary: Programmatic video generation through code offers geometric precision and temporal coherence beyond pixel-level diffusion models, yet rigorously evaluating whether language models can produce spatially correct animated outputs remains an open problem. We introduce PRISM, a large-scale benchmark of 10,372 human-calibrated instruction-code pairs (20 times larger than prior programmatic video generation benchmarks), grounded in real-world knowledge visualization scenarios across English and Chinese and spanning 437 subject categories. We further propose a funnel-style evaluation framework with four complementary metrics: Code-Level Reliability for executability, Spatial Reasoning for layout correctness over full animation sequences, and Prompt-Aware Dynamic Visual Complexity (PADVC) and Temporal Density (TD) for diagnosing dynamic expression and temporal activity. Systematic evaluation of seven mainstream LLMs reveals a striking Execution-Spatial Gap: the average drop from execution success rate to spatial pass rate is approximately 41%, showing that runnable code does not necessarily yield spatially coherent visual output. These findings show that programmatic video generation evaluation should go beyond executability. PRISM provides a principled benchmark for advancing spatially coherent code generation.

AI.tldr: PRISM 是一个面向"程序化视频生成"（用代码渲染动画）的大规模双语评测基准，包含 10,372 条人工校准的"指令—代码"对，规模为已有程序化视频基准的 20 倍，覆盖 437 个细分学科类别；作者同时提出漏斗式四维评测框架（代码级可靠性、空间推理、PADVC、时间密度），并在 7 个主流 LLM 上评测，发现平均约 41% 的"执行—空间落差"：代码能跑 ≠ 画面空间正确。
AI.motivation: 程序化（代码驱动）视频生成在几何精度、时序一致性与可控性上优于像素级扩散模型，尤其适合教育动画、知识可视化等强调空间布局与符号语义的场景，但缺乏严格评测手段衡量 LLM 生成代码是否"空间正确"。现有评测存在三处空白：(1) 视觉代码生成任务多聚焦静态输出（图表、网页、SVG、单帧布局），未考察跨连续帧的对象位置、相对关系与运动轨迹一致性；(2) 已有程序化视频数据集规模过小，难以覆盖真实场景中多样的对象构成与空间关系；(3) 评测协议存在盲区：可执行性只判断"能否运行"，粗粒度 VLM-as-judge 只给整体印象，都无法捕获只在少数关键帧出现的细粒度渲染缺陷（布局错位、元素出界、层级遮挡）。因此需要一个大规模、细粒度、以空间一致性为核心的大规模基准与评测框架。
AI.method: 1）任务形式化：将 PRISM 定义为受约束代码生成 fθ: I=⟨S,X⟩ → O=(C,V)，S 为渲染环境约束，X 为教学大纲语境，C 为 Manim 程序，V 为渲染视频（失败则 V=⊥）；执行成功后视频被分解为原子动画事件序列供评估。2）分层数据构建：采集中英文知识大纲片段→智能体生成草稿代码→标注者修订→专家预筛，得到 3 万余候选；质量控制采用"人在环"的半自动流程：Step1 对 Manim 渲染管线做底层解析，用确定性规则按精确坐标剔除任意帧存在几何违规的样本；Step2 构建 3,000 条专家标注的金标准子集，分析误报并迭代放宽豁免规则与容差阈值；Step3 人工抽检语义匹配与教学适切性。最终保留 10,372 对（英 5,199 / 中 5,173），平均提示长度 1,169（英）/432（中）字符，参考代码平均 93 行、32 次对象构建、62 次 API 调用。3）漏斗式四指标框架：Code-Level Reliability（执行成功率 + 六类错误归因：API 幻觉、API 误用、文本渲染错误、格式污染、语法错误、其他；并报告平均渲染耗时）；Spatial Reasoning（在完整动画序列上判定布局重叠、元素出界、布局泄漏三类互斥空间错误，通过层级感知图解析 + 误报抑制模块判定样本级 Spatial Pass）；PADVC（用 OCR 文本掩码与帧差构造性像素提取计算几何演化能量，以输入大纲结构/动作标记数构造 PVD 为分母，用 p∈(0,1) 凹指数惩罚一次性展示，并给出原始值 PADVC_r 与以参考分布拟合的中心化 PADVC_c）；Temporal Density（以帧间灰度差超阈像素比例衡量每秒视觉变化率 TD_r 与中心化 TD_c）。PADVC/TD 为诊断维度而非排序主指标。
AI.result: 对 7 个主流开源与闭源 LLM 的系统评测揭示了显著的"Execution-Spatial Gap"：从执行成功率到空间通过率的平均落差约 41%，说明"可运行的代码并不必然产生空间连贯的视觉输出"。进一步分析显示：(a) 过高的动态强度（PADVC 过高、冗余装饰性运动）会显著降低空间质量，过低则产出近似静态的幻灯片式视频；(b) 延长思考（extended thinking）模式并未带来可靠的空间性能增益，表明空间规划（layout planning）才是当前模型的关键瓶颈。据此作者主张程序化视频生成的评测不应止步于可执行性。
AI.conclusion: PRISM 提供了首个大规模、双语、以空间一致性为核心的 程序化视频生成评测基准与自动化多维评测框架，并通过公开数据集与代码（github.com/positionprivacy/PRISM、datasets/posprivacy/PRISM）推动"空间连贯的代码生成"研究。其结论是：现有模型的主要短板不在语法可执行性，而在长序列动画中的二维空间布局规划与动态程度校准；后续需改进模型的布局推理与动态表达匹配能力，而非单纯追求可运行代码。

title: Backtracking When It Strays: Mitigating Dual Exposure Biases in LLM Reasoning Distillation
summary: Large language models (LLMs) have achieved remarkable success in complex reasoning tasks via long chain-of-thought (CoT), yet their immense computational overhead hinders real-world deployment. LLM reasoning distillation addresses this by transferring reasoning capabilities from formidable teacher models to compact student models. However, existing distillation paradigms face a fundamental dilemma. Typical off-policy distillation strictly utilizes teacher-generated golden trajectories, suffering from an exposure bias due to the mismatch between training distributions and student-generated inference contexts, which leads to error cascades in long CoT reasoning. To address this, on-policy distillation allows students to explore their own trajectories, but we demonstrate that it inherently introduces a reciprocal reversed exposure bias: the teacher model also struggles to provide positive guidance when conditioned on student-generated sub-optimal contexts. To resolve this dual exposure biases problem, we propose Monitoring Trajectories and Backtracking when it strays (MOTAB), a new LLM reasoning distillation pipeline. Specifically, MOTAB dynamically monitors the student's on-policy generation against an adaptive safety boundary. When the generation strays and exceeds this threshold, MOTAB backtracks to the last safe state and leverages teacher intervention to correct the course. This approach inherently tolerates minor student errors to mitigate exposure bias, while preventing sub-optimal contexts to circumvent reversed exposure bias. Extensive experiments on the LIMO-v2 and AceReason datasets demonstrate that MOTAB effectively alleviates the dual exposure biases, yielding a roughly 3% average performance improvement in reasoning tasks.

AI.tldr: MOTAB addresses the dual exposure bias problem in LLM reasoning distillation by dynamically monitoring student trajectories against an adaptive safety boundary, backtracking when necessary, and leveraging teacher intervention to correct course—this approach balances tolerating minor student errors with preventing sub-optimal contexts from degrading teacher guidance.
AI.motivation: LLMs face deployment challenges due to computational overhead, and existing knowledge distillation methods suffer from a fundamental dual exposure bias dilemma: off-policy distillation creates exposure bias from training-inference distribution mismatch, while on-policy exploration introduces reversed exposure bias where teachers struggle with sub-optimal student contexts.
AI.method: MOTAB employs dynamic trajectory monitoring with an adaptive safety boundary. When student generation exceeds the threshold, it backtracks to the last safe state and leverages teacher intervention for correction. This approach tolerates minor student errors while preventing sub-optimal contexts from degrading teacher guidance quality.
AI.result: MOTAB achieves approximately 3% average performance improvement across LIMO-v2 and AceReason datasets, effectively alleviating both exposure bias and reversed exposure bias in long chain-of-thought reasoning tasks.
AI.conclusion: MOTAB effectively resolves the dual exposure bias problem in LLM reasoning distillation by dynamically monitoring and backtracking, achieving approximately 3% average performance improvement on LIMO-v2 and AceReason benchmarks.

title: Conflict-Resilient Multi-Agent Reasoning via Signed Graph Modeling
summary: LLM-based multi-agent systems (MAS) have demonstrated strong reasoning and decision-making capabilities that consistently surpass those of single LLM agents. However, their performance often suffers from naive aggregation mechanisms that assume uniformly cooperative interactions. Upon close inspection, we observe that existing graph-based MAS frameworks (1) propagate errors when conflicting signals arise without control, and (2) lack explicit modeling of conflicting inter-agent relations as well as structural awareness, failing to identify reliable interaction patterns. To bridge this gap, we introduce SIGMA, a novel SIgned Graph-informed Multi-Agent reasoning framework that explicitly captures trust, conflict, and neutral relations among agents via a signed relational graph. Specifically, given a query, SIGMA first selects a set of relevant and diverse agents, then constructs a structured signed interaction graph with confidence-weighted edges. Reasoning proceeds through conflict-aware signed message passing, which reinforces information from trustworthy agents while suppressing conflicting signals, and terminates with a structure- and conflict-aware weighted aggregation to yield globally consistent and conflict-resilient predictions. Extensive experiments on six benchmark datasets, across multiple LLM backbones and diverse multi-agent configurations, demonstrate that SIGMA consistently outperforms state-of-the-art baselines, achieving notable gains in both accuracy and conflict-resilient performance.

AI.tldr: SIGMA 是一套面向 LLM 多智能体系统的“符号图（signed graph）感知”推理框架。它把智能体响应实例作为节点，显式区分支持(+)、矛盾(−)与不确定(?)三类关系，用三元平衡（triadic balance）诊断高阶结构冲突，在预算内重新评估争议关系，再以社区（community）形式保留竞争假设与原始证据，进行有限的跨社区交叉质询，最后由基于证据的裁决器给出答案。六个基准（MMLU、MMLU-Pro、GPQA、GSM8K、MultiArith、HumanEval）上全面优于 CoT/SC/PHP/MoA/Self-MoA/DyLAN/AutoGen/GPTSwarm/G-Designer/GoA 等基线，平均 89.37%，较 G-Designer、GoA 分别高 0.84 与 1.07 个百分点。
AI.motivation: LLM 多智能体系统（MAS）虽常优于单体，但主流聚合机制隐含“所有交互都是合作性”的朴素假设，导致两类问题：(1) 图式 MAS 在出现冲突信号时会无控制地传播与放大错误；(2) 缺少对智能体间“支持/矛盾/不确定”关系的显式建模与结构感知，无法识别可靠的交互模式——具体表现为高阶不一致被掩盖（A 支持 B、B 支持 C 但 A 与 C 矛盾，两条支持边会把不兼容假设合并成表面共识），以及共享模型/提示导致的重复错误被误当作独立证据，使少数派中的正确异议被压制。作者因此提出“disagreement-aware aggregation（分歧感知聚合）”这一问题设定：关系应附着于响应实例而非智能体身份，聚合过程须显式组织响应关系、保留竞争证据、并在有限交互预算内分配质询机会。
AI.method:
**第1阶段 查询引导的智能体选择**：沿用 GoA 的模型卡（model-card）选择器，按领域匹配、任务专精与是否包含通才模型排序，返回至多 k 个响应槽（允许同一模型占多槽）；各槽独立生成 x_i=(答案 a_i, 响应文本 ρ_i, 自报置信度 c_i)，互不可见。若所有解析答案有效且完全一致（Unanimous），直接返回首个原始响应，跳过后续流程以节省推理。

**第2阶段 符号关系图构建**：对所有无序响应对做关系评估，输出 (ℓ_ij∈{+,−,?}, γ_ij∈[0,1], ξ_ij 理由)；标签判定基于可识别的兼容/不兼容主张，证据不足或混合则判为不确定；空理由或 γ<τ=0.5 的判定降级为不确定，得到对称带符号矩阵 A_ij（+γ / −γ / 0）。高阶检查用三元平衡（s_ij·s_ih·s_jh=+1 为平衡），仅对“全决定性”三元组计算，不做符号传播；不平衡三元组只是重新评估的线索，而非“哪条边错了”。预算化重评估优先级 π_ij=u_ij+t_ij+b_ij+2d_ij（不确定性/低置信、不平衡三元组参与度、边界诊断、答案是否不同），在预算 B_rel（默认 1）内独立重评；初评与复评冲突时保守取“不确定”（标签不一致→?，置信取 min）。此外有答案一致性安全阀：当两答案有效但不同却被判为支持时降级为不确定，以保留分歧。

**第3阶段 冲突感知社区交互**：以加权分歧目标 L_cc 最小化社区划分（惩罚“拆开支持对”与“合并矛盾对”，不确定对不罚），小规模下枚举集合划分，平局时偏好更多社区；社区代表用带符号连接度最大的 medoid（graph medoid）选取，输出社区包 P_m=(代表, 未被代表覆盖的、带来源标注的原文摘录)，每条 ≤500 字符且需通过“来源归属+原文逐字包含”校验，抽取失败时退化为保留非代表成员的原文片段。跨社区调度优先级 ω_mn=归一化的(矛盾强度+不确定性)+答案集是否不同，至多选 B_debate（默认 1）对社区，每对进行一次 challenge–reply（两次生成调用），小社区发起；质询要求指出具体争议假设/计算/主张并说明何种证据会改变自身答案；证据包不进入质询提示，原响应缓存不被修改，交换后不重建关系图。

**第4阶段 证据式裁决**：裁决器接收各社区一份原始代表响应、保留的证据摘录、交叉质询记录、以及仍不确定的配对集合，提示中把社区当作“替代性推理线索”而非票数，明确不提供社区规模、带符号度数、投票数作为正确性权重；默认不调用外部执行/验证工具。

**实现要点**：骨干为 gpt-5.4 / gpt-5.4-mini（采样温度 0.7，确定性基线 0）；关系评估器结合 all-MiniLM-L6-v2 余弦相似度（384 维）、答案一致性与置信度；智能体档案由 gpt-5.4 生成；实现为文本式 LLM 交互与带符号权重聚合，未使用嵌入级神经消息传递。
AI.result:
**主结果（RQ1）**：SIGMA 在全部 6 个基准上取得最佳，MMLU 93.12、MMLU-Pro 95.82、GPQA 55.03、GSM8K 96.30、MultiArith 98.75、HumanEval 97.17，平均 89.37%，领先 G-Designer 0.84、GoA 1.07 个百分点；相对最强基线的最大增益出现在 MMLU(+1.39) 与 GPQA(+1.87)，数学与代码任务增益较小。表 1 同时对基线做了“多智能体协作/关系建模/冲突处理”三维能力标注，SIGMA 是唯一三项全支持的方法。

**消融（RQ2）**：在 DeepSeek-V3.2 上于 HumanEval 与 MMLU-Pro 做四组消融——w/o QAS（同预算下随机选择）、w/o Polarity（社区形成前把已审计矛盾降级为不确定）、w/o Audit（B_rel=0 关闭关系重评估）、w/o Evidence（去掉补充证据仅保留代表）——完整版在两数据集均最优，各组件均有正贡献。

**分歧与修订（RQ3）**：MMLU/MMLU-Pro 上按初始答案构成分组的最终结果显示 SIGMA 能恢复正确的少数派答案，同时保留正确多数派，决策能力超越简单多数投票；轨迹分析显示交叉质询既可纠正初始错误，也可能把正确答案改错，提示交互存在需要控制的修订风险。

**敏感性（RQ4）**：k∈{1,2,3,4} 时准确率从 k=1 升到 k=3、在 k=4 回落，k=3 最优，说明增加智能体并不必然提升性能；默认 B_rel=B_debate=1 以约束推理成本。

**案例（RQ5）**：MMLU-Pro dev #40 初始为 B/G/B（参考答案 G），GoA-Max 变为 B/B/B 并错答 B，SIGMA 变为 G/G/B 并答对 G，说明“支持关系不等于正确性”，也体现对称带符号关系优于单向相关性打分。

**需要注意的文本不一致**：摘要中的流程描述为“冲突感知符号消息传递 + 结构/冲突感知加权聚合”，与正文第 3、4 节及实现说明（纯文本式 LLM 交互、带符号权重聚合、无嵌入级神经消息传递）存在措辞落差；标题在摘要与 arXiv 正文（Conflict-Aware vs. Conflict-Resilient）也不一致；此外文中部分基线标注的会议年份（CoT 标 NeurIPS’22 等）与常识引用不一致，部分参考文献（如 gpt-5.4 骨干、Wei et al., 2026）时间异常，读者需自行核验。
AI.conclusion:
结论是：LLM 多智能体系统需要在响应层面显式区分支持、矛盾与不确定，并通过保守的关系审计、基于社区的证据保留与定向辩论来支撑最终裁决。SIGMA 表明“带符号证据图 + 有限质询 + 证据式裁决”这一组合能在六个推理基准上稳定提升准确率，并有效处理冲突场景。局限方面：评测仅限答案清晰可验证的推理任务（开放生成、多轮对话中分歧可能是互补视角而非事实错误），框架不依赖外部执行/验证工具，故无法保证关系判定正确、推理有效或最终答案正确；此外作者提示潜在风险——更强的多智能体协作可能放大共享错误或助长有害自动化，落地需权限控制与人工监督。

可改进之处：摘要与正文的实现描述不一致应予澄清；社区划分依赖集合划分枚举，扩展到更大响应池时需近似算法；可引入外部验证器（执行代码、查证证据）替代纯模型裁决，以真正解决“支持≠正确”的核心缺陷；修正历史错误带来的自我强化则可引入交互轮次的正确性稳定性约束与“禁止无证据改票”的守恒规则。

title: The Routing and Filtering Structure of Attention
summary: The attention interaction matrix $QK^{\top}$ contains two entangled computations: a skew-symmetric component that redistributes information between positions (routing) and a symmetric component that scales mutual relevance (filtering). We decompose 1776 heads across five pretrained transformers and find routing operating at low rank, well below the routing capacity allocated by the weight kernel. We introduce $S$-$D$ attention as a diagnostic parameterization that disentangles routing from filtering by construction with guaranteed stability ($\mathrm{Re}(λ) \le 0$) and trains stably without layer normalization. When disentangled and unnormalized, routing self-organizes into a spectral cascade, effective rank $2$ at the first layer, expanding with depth across six scales from 7M to 355M parameters. The cascade predicts where attention can be simplified: linearizing the first seven layers of 125M $S$-$D$ attention costs ${<}5\%$ perplexity, whereas standard attention collapses under the same intervention. The linearizable region widens with depth. Replacing the first four layers with ELU+1 linear attention reaches within $1.4\%$ of baseline at full head dimension. Cascade-allocated architectures trade attention parameters for perplexity ($47\%-65\%$ fewer attention parameters at $+3.9\%$ to $+8.4\%$ PPL). The routing-filtering decomposition makes the spectral budget legible; the cascade makes it actionable.

AI.tldr: 这篇论文将注意力机制的交互矩阵 $QK^{\top}$ 分解为路由（偏斜对称，重分配位置信息）和过滤（对称，缩放相关性）两个解耦的组成部分。通过分析1776个注意力头，发现路由操作以低秩运行，并自组织成光谱级联结构。S-D注意力参数化实现了稳定训练且无需层归一化，可将前七层的注意力线性化（困惑度损失<5%），同时可减少47%-65%的注意力参数。
AI.motivation: Standard attention mechanism entangles two distinct computations—routing (redistribution of information between positions) and filtering (scaling of mutual relevance)—making it difficult to analyze, simplify, or optimize either component independently.
AI.method: Decomposed attention interaction matrix $QK^{\top}$ into skew-symmetric (routing) and symmetric (filtering) components; analyzed 1776 heads across 5 pretrained transformers; introduced S-D attention parameterization with guaranteed stability constraint ($\mathrm{Re}(λ) \le 0$); tested linearization of attention layers as diagnostic intervention.
AI.result: Routing operates at low rank well below allocated capacity; routing self-organizes into a spectral cascade (effective rank 2 at first layer, expanding with depth across 6 scales from 7M to 355M); linearizing first 7 layers of 125M S-D attention costs <5% perplexity while standard attention collapses; cascade-allocated architectures achieve 47%-65% fewer attention parameters at +3.9% to +8.4% perplexity overhead.
AI.conclusion: S-D attention enables stable training without layer normalization; routing self-organizes into a spectral cascade with effective rank expanding with depth; 47%-65% attention parameter reduction at +3.9% to +8.4% perplexity cost; first 7 layers of 125M models can be linearized with <5% perplexity penalty.

title: Drifting Objectives for Refining Discrete Diffusion Language Models
summary: Discrete diffusion language models (DDLMs) generate text by iteratively denoising categorical token sequences, while recent drifting methods for continuous generators suggest that part of this sampling-time correction can instead be absorbed into training through an anti-symmetric fixed-point objective. We study how to transfer this principle to DDLMs, where the main challenge is the interface with discrete text: hard token samples are non-differentiable, and categorical predictions do not directly provide continuous samples to drift. We formulate TokenDrift, a drifting objective that lifts categorical predictions to soft-token features, applies anti-symmetric drifting in a frozen semantic space, and backpropagates the resulting stop-gradient feature target to DDLM logits. In controlled continual-training experiments with masked and uniform-state diffusion backbones, TokenDrift improves fixed-NFE generation quality over matched continuation baselines, reducing Gen.-PPL at 4 NFEs by 89% on MDLM and 86% on DUO. These results suggest that drifting can provide a practical refinement objective for DDLMs.

AI.tldr: 本文提出TokenDrift方法，将连续扩散中的漂移校正思想迁移至离散扩散语言模型，通过软标记特征空间和非对称漂移目标实现训练-采样协同优化，在保持架构不变的前提下显著提升低采样步数下的生成质量。
AI.motivation: 连续生成器中的漂移校正可吸收至训练阶段，但离散扩散模型面临挑战：硬标记样本不可微分，分类预测无法直接提供连续漂移样本。
AI.method: 将分类预测提升为软标记特征，在冻结语义空间中应用非对称漂移，通过停止梯度机制将特征目标反向传播至DDLM logits。
AI.result: 在MDLM和DUO上，4 NFE下的Gen.-PPL分别降低89%和86%，证明漂移可作为DDLM的实际改进目标。
AI.conclusion: TokenDrift可作为离散扩散语言模型的有效训练目标，在保持模型架构不变的情况下显著提升采样效率。

title: What and When to Distill: Selective Hindsight Distillation for Multi-Turn Agents
summary: Reinforcement learning can train LLM agents from sparse task rewards, but long-horizon credit assignment remains challenging: a single success-or-failure signal must be distributed across many actions. Existing methods rely on trajectory-level rewards or proxy signals, without fully leveraging per-step environmental feedback. Multi-turn agent settings are underexplored, where feedback can include error messages, page changes, observations, or reference trajectories. We systematically study five feedback sources and two insertion granularities and introduce SERL, a selective environment-reweighted learning framework. SERL uses the task reward to determine update direction, while environment feedback adjusts placement and magnitude, focusing on critical actions. On ALFWorld and WebShop, SERL achieves 90.0% and 80.1% success, outperforming strong RL and distillation baselines. Analysis shows that grounded, action-relevant feedback at meaningful points consistently outperforms indiscriminate use of longer or richer context.

AI.tldr: 本文研究长程LLM智能体的信用分配问题，首次系统性地考察了「用哪些环境反馈」（5种反馈来源）与「反馈插在哪里」（step-level / anchor-level两种粒度）这两个设计维度对智能体RL的影响，并据此提出SERL（Selective Environment-Reweighted Learning）：任务奖励决定更新方向，环境后见（hindsight）反馈仅调整更新的位置与幅度（对可执行动作token的优势做有界、符号感知、随训练衰减的重加权），辅以轻量的动作级蒸馏项。在ALFWorld与WebShop上分别达到90.0%与80.1%的成功率，优于GRPO、HGPO、GIGPO、SDPO、RLSD等基线。
AI.motivation: 长程交互式LLM智能体可用GRPO等组相对方法从稀疏任务奖励中训练，但奖励分配（credit assignment）是核心瓶颈：一条ALFWorld轨迹包含十余个动作，只有两三个真正改变环境，其余是例行导航或格式填充；轨迹级优势被广播到所有token，导致高价值决策与惰性token受到同等更新。环境本身在每步动作后都会返回密集信号（错误提示、页面变化、新观察、参考成功轨迹），天然适合做信用分配。以此做在线自蒸馏（OPSD/OPD）可获得token级密集监督，但教师不可避免地接触到特权信息（后验反馈、未来观察、成功参考轨迹），无差别模仿会造成特权信息泄漏、风格偏好放大与训练不稳定。已有SDPO、RLSD等混合方法主要在单轮推理任务上验证，多轮智能体场景下「反馈来源是什么」与「反馈插入到哪里」这两个轴尚未被系统研究。
AI.method: 1）设计空间研究：将环境反馈解耦为两个轴。来源轴含5类：即时反馈r_t、下一观察s_{t+1}、未来轨迹τ_>t、成功轨迹τ^+、当前轨迹前缀τ_≤t及其组合；位置轴含step-level（每个transition都注入）与anchor-level（按环境状态相同/语义相似将步骤分组成语义锚，聚合组内反馈后注入）。后见信息只提供给教师，学生决策时不可见。2）SERL机制：以GRPO为骨架，用stop-gradient的环境条件教师对学生的动作token分别计算「含后见」与「不含后见」的对数概率差Δ_{t,i}，并以sign(A_t)对齐符号，得到有界权重 w=clip(exp(sign(A_t)·stopgrad(Δ)), w_min, w_max)；该权重仅作用于可执行动作span（推理/格式token保持原GRPO权重），最终优势 Ã=A_t·((1-α_k)+α_k·w̄)，其中α_k随训练线性衰减。3）附加轻量动作级KL蒸馏项L_act（仅在动作span上），总损失L_SERL=L_rw+λ·L_act。实现基于VeRL、Qwen2.5-7B-Instruct、8×H200，组大小8，λ=0.5在50步内线性衰减，教师每10步同步。
AI.result: ALFWorld：SERL平均成功率90.0%（Pick 92.3、Look 100.0、Clean 88.9、Heat 100.0、Cool 76.2、Pick2 82.6），WebShop分数89.5、成功率80.1%。相对GRPO分别提升14.7与16.0个百分点，相对最强纯RL基线HGPO提升4.2与2.3个百分点；显著优于SDPO（33.3/0.0）及GRPO+SDPO、RLSD（Pick2上GRPO+SDPO(Advantage)仅21.7，说明密集教师监督会过度强调与最终成功非因果对齐的局部信号）。反馈来源结论：即时反馈已很强（90.0/80.1），「成功轨迹+即时反馈」最佳（ALFWorld 90.4、WebShop成功率81.3）；下一观察得分最高（90.5）但成功率低（77.7），未来轨迹与多源组合更差，说明特权上下文越多并非越好，关键是局部因果对齐。位置结论：即时反馈下anchor-level将分数从89.5提升到91.5；成功轨迹+即时反馈下anchor-level将成功率从81.3提升到81.9（表中最佳）；但下一观察/未来轨迹单独使用时step-level更优，说明粒度须与来源匹配。LLM-judge消融：Kimi-K2.6（256K上下文）判当前轨迹+成功轨迹时WebShop成功率81.8%，而Qwen2.5-7B（32K上下文）在WebShop上明显退化（69.2/68.8），说明评判者需足够上下文覆盖。计算开销：SERL(step) 272.5 s/step、MFU 0.2907，与RLSD/SDPO+GRPO同量级，低于GIGPO的295.8 s/step；anchor-level因语义分组开销略高（295.9 s/step），但收敛更快。
AI.conclusion: 环境反馈不应被当作无限制的辅助监督；有效的智能体RL需要对齐三件事：用什么反馈源、在哪里插入、以及允许多强地影响策略更新。SERL以奖励定向、以后见做有界动作级信用调整，兼顾密集信用分配与优化稳定性，并通过教师信号衰减在训练早期利用密集后见、后期回归纯奖励驱动。局限：仅在ALFWorld与WebShop两个环境验证，扩展到更多智能体环境仍受算力与基础设施限制。

title: Lossless Anti-Distillation Sampling
summary: Frontier commercial generative models face a growing threat from distillation, whereby a distiller harvests generated responses and trains a competing model of its own at drastically lower cost. Existing defenses either rely on modifying the models outputs, thereby sacrificing response quality for benign users, or on behavioral detection methods, which can be readily circumvented by distributing queries across multiple accounts. In this work, we propose Lossless Anti-Distillation Sampling (LADS), a novel sampling scheme specifically designed to counter multi-account distillation while maintaining a lossless experience for benign users. Concretely, LADS derives the randomness underlying each generation from a private seed determined by the semantic content of the query and the number of times the user has queried the model. By construction, every benign user receives a response independently sampled from the original model at each visit, and thus experiences no distortion. In contrast, for a distiller, different accounts share latent randomness whenever their queries fall in the same semantic bucket. As a result, the harvested data becomes correlated, potentially reducing sample diversity and degrading generalization. Using uniform convergence theory, we show that LADS provably degrades the convergence rate of the distillers generalization gap relative to standard i.i.d. sampling in both unconditional and conditional generation settings. Experiments on image generation, mathematical reasoning, and code generation confirm that LADS substantially degrades the performance of distilled students while preserving exact statistical fidelity for individual users.

AI.tldr: LADS是一种新型采样防御方案，通过语义哈希与查询计数生成私有随机种子，使良性用户获得无损体验，同时通过语义桶共享机制使攻击者采集的数据产生相关性，从而在理论上证明能降低蒸馏攻击的泛化收敛速度，实验验证其在多个领域的有效性。
AI.motivation: 前沿商业生成模型正面临蒸馏攻击的严重威胁。攻击者通过收集模型输出训练低成本竞争模型。现有防御存在根本性缺陷：修改输出防御会损害良性用户体验，行为检测方法可被多账户分发轻易绕过。需要一种既不牺牲用户体验、又能有效对抗分布式蒸馏攻击的防御机制。
AI.method: LADS通过语义内容哈希与用户查询计数生成私有随机种子，使每个良性用户每次访问获得独立采样的原始模型响应。不同账户若查询落入相同语义桶则共享潜在随机性，导致采集数据相关。理论部分利用统一收敛理论证明LADS能降低蒸馏器泛化差距的收敛速率。
AI.result: 实验覆盖图像生成、数学推理和代码生成三个领域，证实LADS显著降低蒸馏学生模型性能，同时对单个用户保持精确的统计保真度。
AI.conclusion: LADS成功实现了"双赢"：对良性用户完全无损（精确统计保真），对蒸馏攻击者造成可证明的性能退化。理论分析基于统一收敛理论，证明了LADS在无条件生成和有条件生成场景下都能降低蒸馏模型的泛化收敛率。

title: Base Models Look Human To AI Detectors
summary: As AI-generated text enters the real-world at scale, institutions increasingly use commercial AI-text detectors, especially in education and academic-integrity workflows. We report a surprising empirical finding about such systems: when evaluated by GPTZero and Pangram, generated text from base models is often judged overwhelmingly human, whereas text generated by their instruction-tuned counterparts is not. Building on this observation, we propose Humanization by Iterative Paraphrasing (HIP), a detector-agnostic pipeline that minimally fine-tunes a base model into a paraphraser and applies it iteratively. Compared with the baselines we test, HIP yields a stronger trade-off between semantic preservation and detector evasion on commercial detectors. Across Llama-3 and Qwen-3 families, spanning model sizes from 0.6B to 70B, HIP consistently improves detector human-likeness. Our findings suggest that current detectors are tracking artifacts of instruction tuning and local context more than any invariant notion of machine-generated text. This, in turn, calls for detector designs that model these factors more explicitly.

AI.tldr: 论文发现当前商业AI文本检测器存在关键漏洞：它们检测的是"指令微调"特征而非"机器生成"本质。作者提出HIP方法，通过微调基础模型并进行迭代 paraphrasing，能有效绕过GPTZero等商业检测器，同时保持语义。
AI.motivation: Commercial AI-text detectors (GPTZero, Pangram) exhibit a critical asymmetry—base model outputs are often misclassified as human, while instruction-tuned model outputs are detected as AI-generated—suggesting these detectors may be tracking spurious artifacts rather than genuine machine-generated text properties.
AI.method: Proposed Humanization by Iterative Paraphrasing (HIP): (1) minimally fine-tune a base model into a paraphraser, (2) apply it iteratively as a detector-agnostic pipeline to "humanize" AI-generated text.
AI.result: HIP achieves a stronger trade-off between semantic preservation and detector evasion compared to baselines, with consistent improvements across model families (Llama-3, Qwen-3, 0.6B–70B).
AI.conclusion: HIP consistently improves detector evasion across Llama-3 and Qwen-3 (0.6B–70B), without significant semantic distortion, demonstrating that current AI-text detectors are brittle and track artifacts of instruction tuning rather than invariant machine-generated text signatures.

title: Generative Auto-Bidding with Unified Modeling and Exploration
summary:
Automated bidding is central to modern digital advertising. Early rule-based methods lacked adaptability, while subsequent Reinforcement Learning approaches modeled bidding as a Markov Decision Process but struggled with long-term dependencies. Recent generative models show promise, yet they lack explicit mechanisms to balance exploration and safety, relying solely on action perturbations or trajectory guidance without a safety fallback. This results in inefficient exploration and elevated financial risk for advertising platforms.
  To address this gap, we propose GUIDE (Generative Auto-Bidding with Unified Modeling and Exploration), a framework that synergistically integrates directed exploration with a safe fallback mechanism. GUIDE employs a Decision Transformer (DT) to jointly model historical bidding actions and environmental state transitions. A Q-value module guides the DT's exploration via regularization constraints, while an Inverse Dynamics Module (IDM) leverages DT-predicted future states to infer robust, behaviorally consistent actions as a safe policy fallback. The Q-value module then adaptively selects the final action between these two options, balancing exploration and safety. Together, these components form an integrated "explore-safeguard-select" pipeline that unifies efficiency and safety.
  We conduct extensive experiments on public datasets, in simulated auction environments, and through large-scale online deployment on Taobao, a leading Chinese advertising platform. Results show GUIDE consistently outperforms state-of-the-art baselines across all scenarios. In real-world deployment, GUIDE achieves notable gains: +4.10% ad GMV, +1.40% ad clicks, +1.66% ad cost, and +3.52% ad ROI, demonstrating its effectiveness and strong industrial applicability.

AI.tldr: GUIDE 是一个面向自动出价（auto-bidding）的统一生成式框架：用一个 Decision Transformer 同时建模历史出价动作序列与环境状态转移，用 Q 值模块（twin-critic）以正则项引导 DT 进行定向探索，再用逆向动力学模型（IDM）依据 DT 预测的未来状态反推动作，作为安全的保底策略，最后由 Q 值模块在两个候选动作间自适应选择，形成"探索—保障—选择"（explore–safeguard–select）一体化流水线。在 AuctionNet 公开数据集与仿真环境上全面超越 BC/IQL/CQL/TD3-BC/DT/AIGB/GAS/GAVE 等基线，并在淘宝大规模线上 A/B 测试中取得广告 GMV +4.10%、点击 +1.40%、成本 +1.66%、ROI +3.52%。
AI.motivation: 自动出价经历了规则控制（PID）→ 强化学习（MDP，USCB/SORL/IQL/CQL）→ 生成式模型（GAS/GAVE 基于 DT，AIGB/EGDB 基于扩散）三条路线，但后两类生成式模型在探索与安全之间存在根本张力：它们仅依赖动作扰动或价值/轨迹引导来促进探索，缺乏显式的"安全回退"机制，一旦探索进入未知或危险的策略空间无法退回到稳健基线策略，导致探索效率低、平台资金风险高。核心问题是：能否设计一个统一框架，将定向高效的探索与稳健的安全回退结合起来，同时兼顾高性能与可运营的可靠性？
AI.method:
问题定义为在预算硬约束与 CPA 软约束下最大化获流价值（b* = λ*v_i），并把出价刻画为条件序列生成问题：状态 s_t（剩余预算、剩余时间、偏离目标 CPA 等 19 维特征）、动作 a_t=λ_t、奖励 r_t、return-to-go R_t。

（1）统一建模：以 Decision Transformer 为骨干，输入历史 (R, s, a) 序列，一次性同时生成下一动作 â_t 与下一状态 ŝ_{t+1}（相较 GAS/GAVE 仅生成动作，多了状态监督信号）；训练损失 L_dt = E[(â_t-a_t)^2 + (ŝ_{t+1}-s_{t+1})^2]。

（2）逆向动力学模块（IDM）：MLP f_idm(s_t, ŝ_{t+1}) 反推能产生该状态转移的动作，以真实动作为监督做 MSE。IDM 既是第二路动作来源，也隐式正则化 DT 的状态预测——若 DT 幻觉出不可达的未来状态，IDM 无法重建正确动作，损失回传迫使 DT 学习物理可达的环境演化。

（3）两阶段训练：Phase 1 分离训练，IDM 用 stop_grad(ŝ_{t+1}) 训练，防止早期梯度不稳定；Phase 2 联合训练，L = L_dt + L_idm，梯度可贯通，兼顾稳定与收敛。

（4）Q 值模块：twin-critic（Q1、Q2 及各自目标网络，EMA 更新，min 取保守估计），用 TD 目标训练；再以 Q 正则项 −min(Q1,Q2)(s,â) 加入 DT 损失引导其探索高价值动作（IDM 不参与 Q 优化，只模仿数据中的行为策略）。

（5）推理期动作选择：分别计算 Q_dt = min(Q1,Q2)(s,â_t) 与 Q_idm = min(Q1,Q2)(s,â_t^idm)，取 argmax 作为最终出价。线上还以过去 2 小时窗口平均对出价系数做平滑以抑制抖动。

（6）训练/评测设置：AuctionNet 决赛轮离线数据（48 广告主、每期约 50 万次曝光、48 决策步）与官方仿真环境；指标为带 CPA 惩罚的 Score = P(CPA;C)·Σx_i v_i；基线含 BC、IQL、CQL、TD3-BC、DT、AIGB、GAS、GAVE；消融覆盖 w/o IDM Action、w/o DT Action、w/o Q 优化、w/o Q 选择、w/o 动作建模、原始 DT。线上为淘宝 8 天 A/B、约 16 万商品，DT 为主干（6 层 Transformer，8 头，隐层 512；IDM/Q 的 MLP 隐层 256）。
AI.result: 离线：GUIDE 在 50%–150% 各预算档下得分 20.3/29.1/37.6/43.3/48.3，全面超过次优 GAVE（19.6/28.3/37.2/42.7/47.4）与 GAS、RL 基线；仿真环境得分 8345 量级（表中 8343），高于 GAS 7454、CQL 7138、TD3-BC 7008、DT 6920，AIGB 最差（6248，长序列+稀疏奖励下扩散难学合理策略）。消融：去掉任一路动作、随机选择、去掉 Q 正则、去掉动作建模均显著下降，其中去掉 Q 正则降幅最大但仍优于原始 DT；两阶段训练的损失下降更快、峰值更少且得分最好，优于全程联合训练与完全分离训练。协同分析：48 个广告主均同时使用两路动作，多数在 70% 以上时间偏好 DT 动作；偏好的 4 个广告主（24、29、31、38）均处于"高预算+低约束"或"低预算+高约束"的极端错配配置，说明 DT 探索在此类情形易出错而回退到保守的 IDM；IDM 动作方差/标准差显著低于 DT，验证其保底稳定性。线上 8 天 A/B：Ad Click +1.40%、Ad Cost +1.66%、Ad GMV +4.10%、Ad ROI +3.52%；成本轨迹与理想（按流量比例构造的 oracle）轨迹的 Pearson 相关达 96.31%，优于基线 93.73%，说明支出节奏贴合流量波动、峰值时段过支更少。
AI.conclusion: GUIDE 通过 DT（探索）+ IDM（安全回退）+ Q 值模块（价值驱动的自适应选择）三组件协同，在统一框架内同时建模环境动态与出价动作序列，化解了高风险广告拍卖中"探索 vs 可靠性"的矛盾，在离线数据、仿真与真实工业部署三个层面一致优于 SOTA，具备强工业落地价值（代码开源 github.com/M2C-Tech/GUIDE）。局限与展望：缺乏应对突发流量骤变（热点、活动）的细粒度机制，且主要依赖离线数据与现有模型架构；未来可引入 LLM 进行轨迹级控制与动态优化，以增强对 evolving 市场环境的鲁棒性与适应性。

title: In-Context Learning Operates as Concept Subspace Learning
summary: Regression and Bayesian accounts of in-context learning (ICL) explain how demonstrations can induce predictors, while mechanistic analyses often identify compact activation directions that steer prompted behavior. However, it remains unclear whether structured demonstrations induce low-dimensional concept inference. We study this question through a concept-subspace view of ICL, in which tasks vary only along intrinsic concept coordinates, although inputs are observed in a high-dimensional ambient space. For ridge and least-squares ICL proxies, prediction decomposes exactly into concept-coordinate regression and off-subspace leakage. Under block-diagonal or near-block-diagonal covariance assumptions, the leading estimation and nuisance-sensitivity terms scale with the dimension of the concept subspace, while residual effects are controlled by cross-subspace coupling. This separation gives a mechanistic prediction: recoverable task information should concentrate in a low-dimensional, task-aligned activation subspace. On CounterFact-derived multi-relation prompts with Llama-3-8B, a 68--73-dimensional subspace of the 4096-dimensional residual stream restores 78.8% of the clean--corrupted accuracy gap, whereas patching the complementary subspace restores 0%. Concept swaps redirect predictions toward injected relations, while random and cross-task matched-rank controls are largely ineffective. Additional experiments on Qwen2.5-7B and a controlled cross-lingual rule task show the same qualitative pattern. These results support concept subspaces as compact, task-aligned mediators of recoverable ICL behavior in structured task families, without implying full-circuit recovery.

AI.tldr: 论文研究了语境中学习（ICL）是否通过低维概念子空间实现任务推理。通过数学分析和实验验证，发现任务相关信息确实集中在低维、任务对齐的激活子空间中，而跨子空间耦合的残余效应影响较小。
AI.motivation: 现有回归和贝叶斯框架解释了演示如何诱导预测器，但机制分析尚未明确验证结构化演示是否诱导低维概念推理。研究旨在通过概念子空间视角回答这一核心问题。
AI.method: 1) 建立ICL的概念子空间数学框架，将预测分解为概念坐标回归与子空间泄漏；2) 在块对角协方差假设下分析维度依赖性；3) 在Llama-3-8B、Qwen2.5-7B及跨语言规则任务上进行实验验证。
AI.result: Llama-3-8B中，68-73维的残差流子空间恢复了78.8%的干净-损坏准确率差距，而补空间修补无效果；概念交换实验显示低维子空间可重定向预测；随机和跨任务对照实验表明效应具有特异性。
AI.conclusion: 概念子空间作为紧凑的、任务对齐的ICL行为中介得到支持，但并不意味着全电路恢复。该发现为ICL的机制性理解提供了新视角。

title: Investigating Cross-Modal Skill Injection: Scenarios, Methods, and Hyperparameters
summary: Vision-Language Models (VLMs) have demonstrated remarkable proficiency in general multi-modal understanding; yet they struggle to efficiently acquire continually evolving domain-specific skills. Conventional approaches to enhancing VLM capabilities, such as Supervised Fine-Tuning (SFT), require extensive dataset curation and substantial computational resources. Model merging has emerged as an efficient alternative that enables the transfer of domain-specific expertise from Large Language Models (LLMs) to VLMs without incurring additional training data requirements or significant computational overhead. Unlike conventional merging of homogeneous LLMs, which mainly aggregates existing capabilities, cross-modal skill injection aims to induce emergent cross-modal capabilities by integrating a domain-expert LLM into a VLM. However, existing research lacks a systematic analysis of the applicability and methodology of cross-modal skill injection. In this study, we investigate cross-modal skill injection across three main aspects: scenarios, methods, and hyperparameters. For scenarios, we find that cross-modal skill injection generally performs well in instruction-following and cross-lingual settings, yet struggles with mathematical reasoning. For methods, we find that classic approaches such as TA and DARE consistently achieve superior performance over alternative merging methods. We also provide a systematic and quantitative analysis of the hyperparameter tuning that these classic methods critically depend on.

AI.tldr: 本研究系统性地探究了将大型语言模型（LLM）领域专家知识迁移到视觉-语言模型（VLM）的跨模态技能注入技术，从场景适用性、方法和超参数三个维度进行了深入分析，为模型融合提供了系统性指导。
AI.motivation: 视觉-语言模型（VLM）难以高效获取持续演进的领域特定技能，传统监督微调方法需要大量数据整理和计算资源，亟需一种无需额外训练数据和显著计算开销的替代方案。
AI.method: 从场景、方法、超参数三个维度对跨模态技能注入进行系统性研究和定量分析，通过对比实验评估不同合并方法在不同应用场景下的表现。
AI.result: 跨模态技能注入在指令遵循和跨语言任务中表现优异，但在数学推理任务中效果不佳；经典方法（如TA和DARE）在性能上始终优于其他合并方法。
AI.conclusion: TA和DARE等经典方法在跨模态技能注入中表现最优，且该方法在指令遵循和跨语言场景中效果良好，但在数学推理场景中效果受限。研究成果为跨模态模型融合提供了系统性的实践指导。

title: Beyond Mode Collapse: Distribution Matching for Diverse Reasoning
summary: On-policy reinforcement learning methods like GRPO suffer from mode collapse: they exhibit reduced solution diversity, concentrating probability mass on a single solution once discovered and ceasing exploration of alternative strategies. We show this stems from reverse KL minimization's mode-seeking behavior, which reinforces the first high-reward trajectory found rather than maintaining a distribution over multiple diverse solutions. We propose DMPO (Distribution-Matching Policy Optimization), which prevents mode collapse through principled approximation of forward KL minimization. DMPO constructs a group level target distribution over sampled trajectories proportional to their rewards, then aligns the policy distribution to this target. This provides mode-covering behavior without requiring sampling from the intractable global target distribution, enabling sustained exploration throughout training. We validate DMPO on NP-hard combinatorial optimization, where exponentially many feasible solutions exist but only a few approach optimality, an ideal testbed for evaluating exploration. DMPO achieves 43.9% Quality Ratio on text-based NP-Bench (vs. GRPO's 40.1%) and 43.1% on vision-based NP-Bench (vs. 38.4%), demonstrating 9% and 12% relative improvements respectively. These gains generalize to mathematical reasoning (+2.0%) and out-of-domain tasks (+2.3%), showing that diversity-preserving training enhances general reasoning capabilities across modalities. Our work establishes distribution matching as a practical, principled approach to preventing mode collapse in on-policy RL, with consistent quality improvements demonstrating sustained exploration across diverse reasoning tasks.

AI.tldr: DMPO通过前向KL分布匹配防止RL训练中的模式崩溃，在NP-hard组合优化、数学推理等任务上实现稳定的质量提升。
AI.motivation: GRPO等on-policy强化学习方法存在模式崩溃问题：一旦发现高奖励轨迹便将概率质量集中于单一解，停止对替代策略的探索。
AI.method: 通过构建组级别的目标分布（基于采样轨迹的奖励比例）并对齐策略分布，实现前向KL近似的原则性近似，避免从难解的全局目标分布中采样。
AI.result: 在NP-Bench文本版和视觉版上分别提升9%和12%的相对质量比；数学推理任务提升2.0%；域外任务提升2.3%。
AI.conclusion: DMPO通过前向KL近似的原则性方法有效防止了模式崩溃，在NP-hard组合优化、数学推理和跨模态任务中实现了持续的质量提升，证明了分布匹配作为on-policy RL防模式崩溃的实用且原则性方法的可行性。

title: Precision Tracked Transformer via Kalman Filtering, Kriging and Process Noise
summary: The Transformer is the foundational building block of modern AI, yet offers no principled handling of \emph{uncertainty}, which is prevalent in real applications: cold-start tokens with sparse histories in sequential recommendation, heterogeneous signal quality in language models, and attention sinks induced by unconstrained softmax. Every token is treated with uniform confidence. We show this uniformity is a degenerate case of our \emph{Bayesian Filtering Transformer} (BFT): attention becomes precision-weighted kriging, the residual connection becomes a Kalman update with adaptive gain, and the FFN becomes a dynamics model propagating precision via a Jacobian--plus--process-noise rule. Observation precision comes from a parameter-free Restricted Maximum Likelihood (REML) estimator with a conjugate Bayesian prior. BFT replaces any Transformer layer with negligible overhead. On sequential recommendation, BFT applied to three major architectures yields significant gains on six benchmarks, with the largest improvements on cold-start users and rare items where uncertainty is highest. On supervised fine-tuning of large language models with noisy data, BFT improves robustness in two regimes: noisy supervision (token-label corruption in question answering) and noisy context (retrieval-augmented QA with real RAG distractors). A single principled modification -- restoring precision -- unlocks substantial headroom across both classical sequence-modeling and modern LLM regimes.

AI.tldr: 本文提出 Bayesian Filtering Transformer（BFT）：把 Transformer 层重写为"观测→更新→预测"的三步贝叶斯滤波——注意力变为精度加权 kriging、残差连接变为带自适应增益的卡尔曼更新、FFN 变为用 Jacobian 加过程噪声传播精度的动力学模型；观测精度由无参数的 REML（共轭贝叶斯先验）估计。BFT 可即插即用替换任意 Transformer 层，参数增量 <0.1%、峰值显存与标准注意力一致。在三种推荐骨干、六个数据集上取得显著提升（增益集中在冷启动与稀疏场景），并在 TinyLlama-1.1B 噪声监督/噪声上下文微调中提升鲁棒性。
AI.motivation: 标准 Transformer 对所有 token 施加统一置信度（隐含精度 λ_t≡1），无法以模型化方式表达"这个 token/位置不可靠"。这一退化假设同时造成四类现实失败：推荐中的冷启动与噪声点击、LLM 微调中低质量 token 获得与高质量 token 同等梯度权重、attention sink（无约束 softmax 强迫注意力集中到低范数的早期 token）、长上下文 RAG 中位置不确定性随检索深度增长。现有修补方案（去噪 mask、注意力校准、sigmoid 门控、sink token）均为孤立补丁，缺乏统一的信息几何基础；MC dropout、深度集成等不确定性方法又需多次前向传播。
AI.method: 框架（§2）：每个 token 附加逐维精度向量 λ_t∈R^d_{>0}。Observe：注意力权重与先验精度相乘后重归一化得 kriging 权重 α̃_tj = α_tj λ̄_j / Σα λ̄，等价于在 QK logit 上加 log λ̄_j 的偏置；e_t = Σ α̃ v_j。Update：卡尔曼增益 K_t = λ^obs⊘(λ+λ^obs)，h' = h + K⊙e，λ' = λ + λ^obs。Predict：FFN 作为动力学模型，delta method 得 λ'' = λ'⊘(1+J_FFN)²，并加过程噪声 Q：λ'' = ((1+J)²/λ' + Q)⁻¹；J_FFN 的对角可由 C=W2⊙W1ᵀ 的 rank-16 SVD 预计算（推理时用滑动平均近似，零开销）。估计量（§3）：λ^obs 用 REML（Bessel 型修正 + 共轭逆 χ² 先验，ν=1、σ0²=1/d_k 固定不学习）并用 Kish 有效样本量 n_eff=1/Σα̃² 修正，规避 n_eff→1 的奇异与残差塌缩；对非行归一化的权重（HSTU 的 SiLU 门控）改用 sandwich 估计量 Var̂ = Σα̃²(v_j−e)²/(Σα̃)²。初始精度由 item embedding 经小型 MLP（≈800 参数，与词表无关）给出 τ_i = τ_range·τ_base,i + softplus(MLP_τ(h_i))，推荐中 τ_base,i 由交互频次分位数设定，LLM 中统一为 1。过程噪声 Q 为逐层逐维可学习参数，Q=softplus(logits)·Q_max。扩展性：多头各自估计 λ^obs，精度跨头拼接后逐元素做卡尔曼更新。附加论证：K=λ^obs/(λ+λ^obs)=σ(log(λ^obs/λ)) 形式上等价于 gated attention 的 sigmoid 门，但参数来自残差几何而非 token 本身；Lemma 1 证明 K=1 时残差保持状态需 Σα_j v_j≈0，单纯形约束迫使注意力集中到低范数位置（sink 必要条件）。
AI.result: 推荐（6 数据集 × 3 骨干 × 20 种子，配对 t 检验）：SASRec HR@10 提升约 +1.0%~+5.1%；BERT4Rec 在稀疏 Amazon 上最高 +7.8%（Sports）/ +7.1%（Instruments），Games 上 −0.4%（不显著）；HSTU 最高 +15.1% HR@10（Instruments），pooled p<10⁻¹³。冷启动分层验证了框架预测：Sports 最稀有 item 五分位 HR@10 +14.5%（p<10⁻⁴），热门仅 +0.4%；冷用户 +6.6%（Sports）；ML-1M 热门项 +3.7% 的例外被解释为用户–物品频次混淆（r=−0.204）。机制验证：Layer 2 上稀有物品运行于更低增益 K≈0.77 与更高先验精度 λ̂≈16（Spearman p<10⁻²⁷），说明增益来自 predict 步（FFN 动力学）而非注意力。HSTU+FFN 消融显示精度通道独立贡献 +3.3%~+19.1% HR@10（5/6 数据集）。LLM 微调（TinyLlama-1.1B，20 配对种子）：SQuAD token 标签腐蚀下 pooled +3.87%（p<0.001），干净数据 +8.3%（p=0.001）；focal loss 基线在 pooled 上不显著（vs SFT p=0.77）且在干净数据上受损 −6.85%，排除"等价于 token 重加权"的解释；NQ-Open 真实 RAG 干扰下 k=5/10/15/20 均提升 +10.3%/+7.5%/+4.3%/+4.5%，pooled +7.8%（p=0.013）。理论诊断（Qiu 等 1B 门控检查点、零训练）：n_eff 随上下文 32.5→70.7（×2.2），REML 预测的 K_opt 与实测 K_BFT 在 5 个外推长度误差 <0.28%，448 个 (层,头) 单元的 BOS 注意力质量与 K_BFT 正相关 r=+0.25 (p=1.3e-7)。开销：参数 <0.1%，训练壁钟 +8~12%，推理 +2%，峰值显存与标准注意力相同。敏感性：K₀、Q_max、σ0²、ρ₀ 不敏感；仅 warmup 步数、精度学习率倍数、λ_max 需调。
AI.conclusion: BFT 证明"精度退化（λ≡1）"是 attention sink、噪声污染与冷启动退化的共同结构成因，用统一的贝叶斯滤波配方一次性解决：恢复精度即可在经典序列建模与现代 LLM 两个场景释放可观增益，且增益集中在信噪比最低处。标准 Transformer 是 BFT 在 λ≡1、Q→0 时的严格退化特例，因此 BFT 是对原架构的严格推广而非替代。局限：仅在推荐规模充分验证，LLM 部分为 TinyLlama 规模的概念验证；18 个 HR@10 单元中 3 个未达显著（如 SASRec/Beauty +1.0%，经数据集特定调参可达 +2.55%）；采用对角精度近似，低秩非对角扩展是有前景方向；预测 3（推理时以 K_BFT 替换冻结门控可改善外推长度表现）尚未验证。作者认为每 token 精度可为更安全的 LLM 部署提供基础。

title: m3BERT: A Modern, Multi-lingual, Matryoshka Bidirectional Encoder
summary: Embedding models are pivotal in industrial information retrieval systems like search and advertising. However, existing pretrained models often exhibit fixed architectures and embedding dimensionalities, posing significant challenges when adapting them to diverse deployment scenarios with varying business-driven constraints. A common practice involves fine-tuning with partial parameter initialization from larger pretrained models for resource-constrained tasks. This method is often suboptimal as the misalignment between pretraining and downstream usage prevents full realization of pretraining benefits. To address this limitation, we introduce m3BERT: a Modern, Multi-lingual, Matryoshka Bidirectional Encoder, which features a novel pretraining strategy that jointly optimizes representations across both transformer layers and multiple embedding dimensions. This enables a single model to be tailored to varied resource and accuracy targets while maintaining consistency with pretraining. Incorporating recent architectural improvements, m3BERT uses a three-stage pretraining: monolingual pretraining, multilingual adaptation to serve diverse user bases, and crucial continual pretraining on a massive web domain corpus to enhance utility in commercial retrieval. m3BERT significantly outperforms state-of-the-art embedding models in Bing-Click, a large-scale industrial retrieval dataset, showcasing its practical versatility as an efficient foundation for resource-aware industrial retrieval systems. Further experiments on public datasets also confirm the general effectiveness of our multigranular Matryoshka pretraining strategy.

AI.tldr: m³BERT 是微软推出的多语言双向编码器，核心是把 Matryoshka 表示学习（MRL）扩展到「Transformer 层深 + 嵌入维度」两个维度联合预训练，并融合 SwiGLU / RMSNorm / Pre-Norm / 去 Bias 去 Dropout / FlashAttention 等现代架构，配合「单语→多语→网页域」三阶段预训练（末段用 Inf-CL 做百万级批量的对比学习）。在 Bing-Click 工业检索集上全面超越 mBERT、mE5、ModernBERT；已在 Bing 线上部署（>25K QPS、1.2 亿关键词索引），年化营收影响约 5000 万美元。
AI.motivation: 工业检索/广告中的预训练嵌入模型架构与输出维度固定（多为 base 规模、768 维），难以同时满足不同链路的延迟、显存与效果约束。常见做法是「截断层数+部分参数初始化」再微调，但由于预训练目标与下游用法不一致，模型无法完全继承预训练收益，收益随维度/深度增加迅速衰减（图1 显示 64→128 提升明显，128→768 几乎无增益而延迟与存储线性增长）。已有 MRL 工作主要作用于输出嵌入维度、且多用于微调阶段，未覆盖模型深度，也未融入基础模型预训练。作者的目标是让单一预训练模型原生对齐「不同层数 × 不同嵌入维度」的部署形态。
AI.method:
1) 多粒度 Matryoshka 预训练：设层集合 L（Stage1/2 取 {4,8,12}，Stage3 取 {4,12}）与维度集合 D（{32,64,128,768}，Stage3 为 {32,64,128}），对每个 (l, d) 组合取该层隐状态的前 d 维，共享 MLM 头并用对应的 W[:d,:] 子矩阵投影，损失为所有组合 MLM 损失之和（L_total = ΣΣ L_MLM），共 |L|×|D| 个表征联合优化。
2) 现代架构（BERT-base 规格：12 层、hidden 768）：SwiGLU 替代 GeLU、RMSNorm 替代 LayerNorm、Post-Norm 改 Pre-Norm、去掉注意力与 FFN 的 bias、去掉层间 hidden dropout、采用 FlashAttention。
3) 三阶段预训练：Stage1 用 Nemotron-CC 高质量子集约 1000 亿英文 token 做 MLM（mask 率 0.15，因高层/子维学习会加剧不稳定性而未采用 0.3）；Stage2 用 top100 语言 Wikipedia 约 200 亿 token，按 P'(L) ∝ P(L)^0.7 指数平滑平衡语种；Stage3 在 100 亿 query-doc 广告点击对（Query-Keyword / Ad Creative / Landing Page）上用 Inf-CL 分块对比学习做持续预训练，batch 扩至 100 万、约 2 万亿 token，学习率 2e-4。AdamW、cosine 衰减、1 万步 warmup、bf16，约 4 万 A100 GPU 小时。
4) SFT：in-batch 负样本的 InfoNCE 损失（温度 0.05），Bing-Click 用 batch 1024/lr 5e-4，公开集 batch 32/lr 2e-5。
5) 附加探索：Matryoshka Distillation（以深层/高维 LM 头输出为 teacher，对 student 分布做 KL，损失加到 MRL 损失上，τ_D=1、λ_D=1，需在 30 万步后再开启否则不稳）；MRL SFT（对多个维度同时求和对比损失）。
6) 评测：Faiss IndexFlatIP 精确内积搜索、L2 归一化，Recall@100/1000；Bing-Click 测试集含 1000 万候选文档与 100 万正例对，训练/测试时间严格分离。
AI.result: Bing-Click 主结果：m³BERT-s3 在 Full 配置下 D=32 时 R@100 达 63.30（R@1000 85.50），显著高于 mBERT 的 59.74、mE5 59.31、ModernBERT 59.44；D=128 时 68.94 vs 基线 66.76–67.97。Lite（1/3 层）下 m³BERT-s3 D=32 即达 62.06，已超过基线在 768 维的 65 左右水平中的多数；m³BERT-s2 相对基线亦全面领先（如 Lite D=32：58.34 vs 57.10–57.46）。Matryoshka vs 标准预训练消融（Table 2）：单一 MRL 模型在低维上普遍更优（Bing-Click D=32 57.53 vs 57.19；MS MARCO 51.55 vs 50.08；NQ 83.74 vs 81.17；TREC-COVID 79.23 vs 76.07），最高维 768 略有下降（NQ 91.32 vs 91.80），体现「低维收益高、满维略损」的取舍。架构消融（Table 4）：去掉 SwiGLU 掉到 60.18、去掉 Pre-Norm 61.42，RMSNorm/去 Dropout/去 Bias 影响接近中性但有效率收益。Matryoshka Distillation：针对性蒸馏（L12-D64→L4-D64 63.12、L12-D768→L4-D64 63.14）略优于继续 MRL 预训练（63.00），而「L12-D768 蒸馏到全部组合」无增益，说明过宽蒸馏目标会引入冲突信号。MRL SFT（Table 3）：各模型均出现轻微下降，但 m³BERT 降幅最小（m³BERT-s2 D=64 反而 +0.09，s3 D=64 仅 -0.02），说明 MRL 预训练已为多维 SFT 做好准备。线上部署：2025 年 6 月起成为 Bing 查询-关键词选择流程核心组件，稳定处理 >25K QPS，索引 1.2 亿+关键词，ANN 检索 top-100，年化营收影响约 5000 万美元。
AI.conclusion: m³BERT 通过把 MRL 从「仅输出维度」扩展到「层深 × 嵌入维度」的联合预训练，并结合 LLM 时代的现代架构与三阶段（单语—多语—网页域）预训练，让一个模型同时服务多档延迟/资源约束的工业检索链路，显著优于同规模 SOTA 基线且在 Bing 线上验证了显著商业价值；低维嵌入增益尤为明显，表明 MRL 预训练对资源受限部署尤其有效。局限与后续方向：Stage3 只优化到 128 维故未评估 768；满维性能存在轻微折损；Matryoshka 蒸馏需在预训练中后期才稳定启动且收益有限；该方法与剪枝、量化等效率技术正交，可叠加使用。

title: Attention-Guided Reward for Reinforcement Learning-based Jailbreak against Large Reasoning Models
summary: Large Reasoning Models (LRMs) have demonstrated remarkable capabilities in solving complex problems by generating structured, step-by-step reasoning content. However, exposing a model's internal reasoning process introduces additional safety risks; for example, recent studies show that LRMs are more vulnerable to jailbreak attacks than standard LLMs. In this paper, we investigate jailbreak attacks on LRMs and reveal that the attack success rate (ASR) is closely correlated with LRMs' attention patterns. Specifically, successful jailbreaks tend to assign lower attention to harmful tokens in the input prompt, while allocating higher attention to those tokens in the reasoning content. Motivated by this finding, we propose a novel jailbreak method for LRMs that leverages reinforcement learning (RL) to enhance attack effectiveness, explicitly incorporating attention signals into the reward function design. In addition, we introduce diverse persuasion strategies to enrich the RL action space, which consistently improves the ASR. Extensive experiments on five open-source and closed-source LRMs across three benchmarks demonstrate that our method achieves substantially higher ASR, outperforming existing approaches in terms of effectiveness, efficiency, and transferability.

AI.tldr: 本文研究了大推理模型的越狱攻击问题，发现攻击成功率与模型注意力模式密切相关，并提出利用强化学习和注意力信号增强越狱攻击效果的新方法。
AI.motivation: LRM暴露内部推理过程带来额外安全风险，且现有研究显示LRM比标准LLM更易受越狱攻击
AI.method: 提出基于强化学习的越狱攻击方法，将注意力权重信号融入奖励函数，并引入多样化说服策略扩展动作空间
AI.result: 攻击成功率与注意力模式高度相关：成功越狱时，输入提示中的有害token注意力较低，而推理内容中的注意力较高
AI.conclusion: 方法在五个开源和闭源LRM上验证，有效性、效率和迁移性均优于现有方法

title: Automated Big Data Quality Assessment using Knowledge Graph Embeddings
summary:
Automated data quality assessment is crucial for managing big data, but existing solutions face challenges in achieving accurate context-aware assessment. This paper presents a novel knowledge-based approach to enhance automated data quality assessment. Our approach utilizes knowledge graph embeddings to predict missing edges between the input dataset's context representation and the relevant quality rules and dimensions within a knowledge graph representing contextual data characteristics and the required quality assessment operations. We surpass conventional practices by integrating diverse representations within the knowledge graph, drawing insights from contextual information from a thorough literature investigation. This integration allows us to develop a comprehensive and context-specific data quality assessment plan tailored to each context. Leveraging the knowledge graph improves our understanding of the input dataset's context, overcoming the limitations of traditional methods that rely solely on strict matching and overlook contextual characteristics. By injecting numerical edge attributes, we assign corresponding weights to each predicted quality measurement, providing a comprehensive data quality assessment plan for the input dataset.
  To evaluate our approach, we leverage AmpliGraph, a framework developed and benchmarked by AccentureLabs. The evaluation involves employing a real-world radiation sensors dataset provided by the Lebanese Atomic Energy Commission (LAEC-CNRS). The results obtained from this evaluation demonstrate the capability of our solution to generate a comprehensive data quality assessment plan for the given input dataset.

AI.tldr: 本文提出一种基于知识图谱嵌入（KGE）的自动化大数据质量评估方法：用文献综述归纳的完整数据上下文特征（数据类型、模式、数据源、规模、领域、文件格式、组织/资源上下文等）构建 Neo4j 知识图谱，并利用 Accenture Labs 的 AmpliGraph（集成 FocusE 的数值边属性注入与开放世界假设）预测输入数据集属性与质量规则/质量维度之间缺失的边及权重，从而自动生成上下文专属的数据质量评估计划，并在黎巴嫩原子能委员会的辐射传感器真实数据集上验证其优于 BIGQA 的 Node2Vec+K-NN 上下文分析器方案。
AI.motivation: 大数据环境下人工数据质量检查成本高、效率低，自动化质量评估成为必需。既有方案（含作者此前提出的 BIGQA 框架）依赖精确的模式/schema 字符串匹配与最相似上下文的检索（Node2Vec + K-NN），只能取回单一最相近上下文的质量评估计划，容易因输入数据集与知识图谱中已有上下文的模式差异而遗漏部分属性（如电池电量、传感器 ID），导致评估计划不完整、自动化程度低、依赖人工干预。因此需要一种能综合知识图谱中多个上下文信息、对未知数据集进行上下文感知且可解释权重化质量测度生成的自动化方法。
AI.method: 1) 文献调研：梳理 Even、Taleb、Merino、Immonen、Batini、Helfert 等对数据上下文的不同定义，归纳出数据上下文（类型/模式/数据源/规模/分析范围/领域/内容类型/文件格式）、组织上下文（标准、业务规则、安全权限）、资源上下文（资源消耗、时间）三类特征，并给出知识抽取、用户指定、计算三种上下文获取方式。2) 构建数据上下文知识图谱（Neo4j）：上下文节点 + schema/属性/类型层级，质量规则（base measures）节点与质量维度（derived measures）节点，边带百分比权重表示重要性；质量评估计划以边集合表示。3) 采用 AmpliGraph（TensorFlow 实现）的知识图谱嵌入模型：输入为 (s,p,o,w) 四元组集合，corruption 层生成负样本，嵌入层查表得到 k 维向量，ComplEx 打分层计算 Hermitian 内积实部，FocusE 模块按数值权重调制打分并将低数值三元组视为伪负样本；配合 OWA 开放世界假设处理缺失事实。损失采用 pairwise margin hinge loss（γ=0.5），参数经网格搜索确定（Adam、negative sampling=All、L4 正则、batch=64、K=50、ETA=5、lr=1e-5），训练 5000 epoch，测试集占 20%。4) 工作流：新数据集注册 → 抽取上下文并并入图谱 → 抽取带权三元组并训练 → 预测属性↔质量规则、质量规则↔质量维度的链接及权重 → 生成完整质量评估计划。5) 对照实验：实现 BIGQA 上下文分析器（Node2Vec + K-NN 余弦相似度）作为基线。知识图谱含 41 个上下文、ISO/IEC 25012 全部质量维度节点、10 个质量测度节点，共 5877 条带权三元组。
AI.result: 模型在测试集上 Loss=9.45、MRR=0.19、MR=38.99、Hits@1=0.21、Hits@3=0.26、Hits@10=0.66，作者认为属可接受水平并指出受限于知识图谱规模较小与精度有限。对辐射传感器数据集：BIGQA 基线仅检索到含 7 条规则、8 个维度的部分覆盖计划（遗漏 battery level 与 sensor ID 属性）；新方法生成的评估计划同样包含 7 条质量规则与 8 个质量维度，但输入数据集的全部属性均链接到相应质量规则，且所有相关边均带有预测权重，因而更完整、更易自动化（无需精确 schema 匹配，降低用户干预与人为错误风险）。局限为嵌入模型可解释性弱、训练计算开销大（网格搜索约 60 小时 V100，后续训练约 30 分钟）。
AI.conclusion: 本文通过文献驱动的数据上下文表征构建 + 知识图谱嵌入（数值边属性注入）的组合，替代 BIGQA 中的 Node2Vec/K-NN 上下文分析器组件，可在不依赖严格模式匹配的前提下自动生成覆盖全部属性、带权重的上下文特定数据质量评估计划，显著提升评估的完整性与自动化程度。作者建议以该方案替换原上下文分析器，并指出未来方向：构建更大更精确的知识图谱、提升嵌入模型可解释性、优化训练流程、纳入更多上下文特征与质量维度、探索实时机器学习以实现实时的质量评估计划生成。

title: A Data-Driven Approach to Idiomaticity Based on Experts' Criteria in Theoretical Linguistics
summary: The article observes data analysis of 286 multi-word expressions (MWEs) based on 16 lexical, grammatical and other criteria described in theoretical books and papers on the notion of idiomaticity. MWEs were collected from the same theoretical sources, and a set of experts in linguistics annotated them with these categories. The distribution of categories shows that there are no absolutely idiomatic expressions. Lexical criteria seem to be the most influential; grammatical criteria are bound to certain conditions; presence of obsolete words and grammar influence ability of an MWE to be replaced with one word.

AI.tldr: 研究通过对286个多词表达式（MWEs）基于16个词汇、语法及其他标准进行数据分析，发现不存在绝对习语化的表达式。词汇标准影响最大，语法标准受特定条件约束，古语词和语法特征影响MWE被单词替代的能力。
AI.motivation: 习语性（idiomaticity）研究是词汇学和句法学的重要课题，但现有理论对习语化程度的量化评估尚不充分。该研究旨在通过系统化的多维标准分析，揭示多词表达式在不同习语性维度上的分布特征及其相互关系。
AI.method: 研究样本：286个多词表达式，来源于理论文献；标注方式：由语言学专家团队基于16个词汇、语法及其他标准进行标注分类。
AI.result: 研究结果显示：（1）不存在绝对习语化的表达式，所有表达式都具有一定的可分析性；（2）词汇标准对习语性的影响最大；（3）语法标准的影响受特定条件约束；（4）古语词（obsolete words）和语法特征的存在会降低多词表达式被单词替代的可能性。
AI.conclusion: 习语性是一个多维度的连续统概念，而非二元对立的状态。词汇层面是判断习语性的核心维度，语法层面的习语性特征具有条件依赖性。研究为多词表达式的系统分类和习语性理论提供了实证基础。
