title: Position: The Turing-Completeness of Real-World Autoregressive Transformers Relies Heavily on Context Management
comment: Accepted to the ICML 2026 Position Paper Track
summary: Many works make the eye-catching claim that Transformers are Turing-complete. However, the literature often conflates two distinct settings: (i) a fixed Transformer system setting, in which a fixed autoregressive Transformer is coupled with a fixed context-management method to process inputs of different lengths step by step, and (ii) a scaling-family setting, in which a family of different models (with increasing context-window length or numerical precision) is used to handle different input lengths. Existing proofs of Transformer Turing-completeness are frequently established in setting (ii), whereas real-world LLM deployment and the standard notion of Turing-completeness correspond more naturally to setting (i). In this paper, we first formalize the fixed-system setting, thereby providing a concrete characterization of how real-world LLMs operate. We then argue that results proved in the scaling-family setting provide theoretically meaningful resource bounds but do not establish Turing-completeness, thereby clarifying a common misinterpretation of existing results. Finally, we show that different context-management methods can yield sharply different computational power, and we advocate the position that context management is a central component that critically determines the computational power of real-world autoregressive Transformers.

AI.tldr: 本文澄清了关于Transformer图灵完备性的常见误解，区分了"固定系统设置"（固定模型逐步处理不同长度输入）和"缩放家族设置"（不同模型处理不同长度输入）两种场景，指出现有证明多在后者中进行，而实际LLM部署对应前者。作者进一步论证上下文管理方法是决定真实世界自回归Transformer计算能力的关键组件。
AI.motivation: 当前文献中关于Transformer图灵完备性的声明存在概念混淆，固定模型的真实部署场景与理论证明场景不一致，需要明确区分和重新审视这些声明的实际意义。
AI.method: 首先形式化固定系统设置的定义，提供真实世界LLM运行方式的精确刻画；然后分析两种设置的区别，证明在缩放家族设置中的结果只提供有理论意义的资源边界而非真正的图灵完备性；最后研究不同上下文管理方法对计算能力的影响。
AI.result: 论证了现有Transformer图灵完备性证明多在缩放家族设置下成立，与实际固定系统部署不符；揭示了不同上下文管理方法可产生截然不同的计算能力，上下文管理是决定真实世界自回归Transformer计算能力的关键因素。
AI.conclusion: 上下文管理方法应被视为决定Transformer计算能力的核心组件，图灵完备性声称需要根据具体部署场景（固定系统设置）重新评估。

title: StampFormer: A Physics-Guided Material-Geometry-Coupled Multimodal Model for Rapid Prediction of Physical Fields in Sheet Metal Stamping
summary: Traditional sheet metal forming relies on time-consuming and expensive Finite Element Analysis (FEA) for design validation, a process that significantly prolongs design cycles. While surrogate models offer faster iteration, current approaches have limitations: scalar-based methods cannot capture comprehensive field-based FEA results, while existing image-based models often ignore the critical role of material properties by focusing solely on geometry. To address this gap, we develop a physics-guided deep learning framework, namely StampFormer, which simultaneously uses component geometry and material stress-strain responses to predict FEA outcomes. The StampFormer framework uses three core components to process data. A Material-Augmented Geometric Network (MAGN) first fuses geometric and material data. This information is then integrated at various levels by a Hierarchical Material Embedding Injection Unit (HMEIU) before being processed by the primary network backbone, an adapted Swin-UNet. We evaluated our model on the stamping of a crossmember panel with two simulation datasets for steel and aluminium panels, and results demonstrate that StampFormer provides high-fidelity predictions of critical physical fields - including thinning, major strain, minor strain, plastic strain, and displacement - in under a second. Compared with ground truth FEA, our model achieved an average relative error of less than 8.5% on the four 2D fields and a mean squared error of less than 1.2 mm2 for the 3D displacement field. In summary, we introduce a practical and efficient framework that integrates multimodal information, namely geometry and material properties, to provide fast and accurate predictions, enabling designers to perform real-time manufacturability assessments.

AI.tldr: StampFormer是一种物理引导的“材料—几何”耦合多模态深度学习代理模型，用于钣金冲压成形物理场的秒级预测。它将1D材料应力—应变曲线与2D零件几何高度图融合，预测减薄、主应变、次应变、塑性应变与3D位移场；相比需数小时的FEA推理仅需不到1秒，2D场平均相对误差<8.5%，位移场MSE<1.2 mm²。
AI.motivation: 钣金成形设计验证依赖FEA，单次仿真需数小时至数天，严重拖慢设计迭代。现有代理模型有两类缺陷：(1) 标量型代理只回归单一指标（如最大减薄率），无法给出完整空间场分布；(2) 图像型代理虽能输出全场，但仅以几何为输入，完全忽略材料本构（应力—应变响应）对成形响应的决定性作用，无法有效融合1D材料曲线与2D几何这两种异构模态，难以匹配工业实践中“几何+材料共同决定性能”的真实情形。因此需要一个既输出全场、又显式建模材料影响的高效代理模型。
AI.method: 提出StampFormer三段式框架：(1) MAGN（Material-Augmented Geometric Network）——1D应力—应变曲线经线性投影+可学习位置编码+Transformer编码器，再平均池化得到全局材料嵌入E_mat；经MLP映射为条件向量，空间广播后与1×1卷积提取的几何嵌入相加，再经卷积层与原始几何通道拼接（保留边界信息），经3×3卷积块生成X^(0)；(2) HMEIU（Hierarchical Material Embedding Injection Unit）——作为并行塔，以专用Transformer层逐级精炼材料token，输出维度与PGSU各编码器阶段通道数对齐，平均池化为各级E_mat^(l)，在Swin块与Patch Merging之后以广播加法（外积形式1_N (E)^T）注入主数据流，实现多尺度材料—几何耦合；(3) PGSU——改编Swin-UNet（四阶段Swin块+Patch Merging/Patch Expanding编解码、W-MSA注意力、对称跳跃连接）作为骨干。数据侧：3D CAD经保信息Z向投影生成608×768单通道高度图输入；FEA变形网格结果利用位移场反投影回初始毛坯平面并插值生成目标图（2D场单通道、位移场3通道）；材料库钢101条→人工扩充至200→上采样至600条，铝11条实曲线经±10%、2%步长乘性缩放至110条，各分5个簇；LHS采样600组几何参数（R1~R5、筋条直径、拔模角等）；DoE按几何8:1:1划分，每几何配5簇材料，钢/铝各3000次仿真（PAM-STAMP：1.6mm板、各向同性查表、250mm/s、800kN压边力、摩擦0.12，三阶段重力/压边/冲压）。共训练10个模型（5场×2材料），Adam，初始lr 1e-4，StepLR每100轮×0.4，物理量纲MSE损失。
AI.result: 测试集MSE：钢——减薄2.64E-05、主应变3.87E-05、次应变7.78E-05、塑性应变7.20E-05、位移0.605 mm²；铝——4.37E-05、1.48E-04、5.17E-05、9.62E-05、0.342 mm²。基于“top 0.1%均值”代表最大值的相对误差：钢均值4.5%–7.2%（95分位多低于15%），铝均值3.5%–8.2%（主应变/塑性应变尾部更重，因铝延性低、应变梯度更尖锐）；位移MSE均值钢1.115 mm²、铝0.856 mm²。可视化上，top-0.3%减薄区重叠图显示预测能准确定位最大减薄位置与幅值；FLD点云与GT形状/密度/离散度高度吻合；由位移重建的成形件表面及其塑性应变分布与GT高度一致；推理速度亚秒级，较FEA提速三个数量级以上。
AI.conclusion: StampFormer通过MAGN初步融合、HMEIU多尺度注入材料嵌入与PGSU骨干，在多尺度特征提取中保持材料—几何紧耦合，能高保真预测减薄、应变、FLD与3D位移/形状等关键成形响应，2D场平均相对误差低于8.5%、位移MSE约1.2 mm²，将“数小时FEA”降为“亚秒推理”，支持设计早期实时可制造性评估与材料—几何—工艺筛选。所考察的钢/铝属性范围覆盖工业常用冷成形合金设计包络；局限在于跨零件族族的迁移泛化能力仍待未来工作验证。此外，工程上由于FEA有效域非矩形需零填充，边界会产生数值伪影，论文采用仅用于可视化的去噪/高斯滤波后处理去除边缘噪声。

title: GoLongRL: Capability-Oriented Long Context Reinforcement Learning with Multitask Alignment
summary: We present GoLongRL, a fully open-source, capability-oriented post-training recipe for long-context reinforcement learning with verifiable rewards (RLVR). Existing long-context RL methods often treat data construction as a matter of designing increasingly complex retrieval paths, leading to homogeneous task coverage and reward formulations that inadequately reflect practical long-context requirements. Our work offers two contributions. (1) Capability-oriented data construction with full open release. We openly release a dataset of 23K RLVR samples, the complete construction pipeline, and all training code. Guided by a taxonomy of long-context capabilities, the dataset spans 9 task types, each paired with its natural evaluation metric. It comprises curated open-source samples from established corpora and synthetic samples whose QA pairs are generated from real source documents such as books, academic papers, and multi-turn dialogues. Under the same vanilla GRPO setup, our dataset alone outperforms the closed-source QwenLong-L1.5 dataset. Moreover, our Qwen3-30B-A3B model trained on this data delivers long-context performance comparable to DeepSeek-R1-0528 and Qwen3-235B-A22B-Thinking-2507, suggesting that broader coverage and greater reward diversity substantially benefit long-context capability improvement. (2) TMN-Reweight for heterogeneous multitask optimization. To address optimization challenges from heterogeneous rewards, we propose TMN-Reweight, which combines task-level mean normalization for cross-task reward scale alignment with difficulty-adaptive weighting for more reliable advantage estimation. TMN-Reweight further improves average performance over vanilla GRPO, with general capabilities preserved or improved across reported evaluations.

AI.tldr: GoLongRL proposes an open-source post-training recipe for long-context RLVR with two key innovations: (1) a capability-oriented 23K dataset covering 9 task types that outperforms closed-source alternatives, enabling a 30B-A3B model to match 235B models; (2) TMN-Reweight for handling heterogeneous rewards through task normalization and difficulty-adaptive weighting.
AI.motivation: Existing long-context RL methods treat data construction as designing complex retrieval paths, leading to homogeneous task coverage and reward formulations that inadequately reflect practical long-context requirements. This limits the diversity and effectiveness of training signals.
AI.method: The paper proposes: (1) A capability-oriented data construction pipeline spanning 9 task types with natural evaluation metrics, combining curated open-source samples and synthetic QA pairs from real documents (books, papers, dialogues); (2) TMN-Reweight combining task-level mean normalization for cross-task reward scale alignment and difficulty-adaptive weighting for reliable advantage estimation, all under vanilla GRPO setup.
AI.result: The released 23K RLVR dataset alone outperforms the closed-source QwenLong-L1.5 dataset under the same vanilla GRPO. Qwen3-30B-A3B trained on this data achieves performance comparable to DeepSeek-R1-0528 and Qwen3-235B-A22B-Thinking-2507. TMN-Reweight further improves average performance over vanilla GRPO while preserving general capabilities.
AI.conclusion: GoLongRL demonstrates that capability-oriented data construction with broader coverage and greater reward diversity significantly benefits long-context capability improvement. The combination of open-sourced 23K RLVR dataset and TMN-Reweight optimization achieves comparable performance to much larger models (DeepSeek-R1-0528, Qwen3-235B), while preserving or improving general capabilities across evaluations.

title: BLINKG: A Benchmark for LLM-Integrated Knowledge Graph Generation
summary: Generating Knowledge Graphs (KGs) remains one of the most time-consuming and labor-intensive tasks for knowledge engineers, as they need to identify semantic equivalences between input data sources and ontology terms. While declarative solutions (e.g., RML, SPARQL-Anything) have helped to generalize this process, aligning input schema elements with ontology terms still involves intricate transformations and requires considerable manual effort. With the advent of Large Language Models (LLMs), there is growing interest in leveraging their capabilities to assist KG engineers. Although some studies have explored using LLMs to automate KG construction, there is still no standardized framework for assessing how effectively they establish correspondences between data schemes and ontology concepts. Therefore, in this paper, we propose BLINKG, a benchmark designed to evaluate the mapping capabilities of LLMs in constructing KGs from heterogeneous data sources. The benchmark includes a set of scenarios with increasing complexity, based on real-world use cases. We conduct an extensive experimental evaluation of several stateof-the-art LLMs using BLINK and observe that they already offer promising solutions. However, their performance remains limited in complex scenarios. Thanks to this benchmark, we can already assess the current capabilities of LLMs for KG construction. Additionally, we define a set of requirements for achieving (semi)automated (LLM-driven) KG construction, opening new research lines in this area.

AI.tldr: 本文提出BLINKG基准测试，用于评估LLM从异构数据源构建知识图谱时的映射能力。实验表明现有LLM在简单场景表现良好，但在复杂场景仍有不足。该基准为推动(半)自动化知识图谱构建提供了评估基础和未来研究方向。
AI.motivation: 知识图谱构建过程中，将输入数据源与本体术语对齐以识别语义等价性仍需大量人工工作，现有的声明式解决方案（RML、SPARQL-Anything）虽有助于泛化，但手工劳动和复杂转换问题仍未解决。
AI.method: 基于真实场景设计了具有递增复杂度的评估场景，对多个前沿LLM进行了广泛实验评估。
AI.result: 当前前沿LLM已展现出有前景的解决方案，但在复杂场景下性能仍有限。
AI.conclusion: BLINKG为评估LLM在知识图谱构建中的映射能力提供了标准化框架，揭示了当前LLM在复杂场景中的局限性，并为实现(半)自动化LLM驱动的知识图谱构建定义了未来研究方向。

title: LLMEval-Logic: A Solver-Verified Chinese Benchmark for Logical Reasoning of LLMs with Adversarial Hardening
summary: Evaluating large language models (LLMs) on natural-language logical reasoning is essential because rule-governed tasks require conclusions to follow strictly from stated premises. Many existing logical-reasoning benchmarks are generated by templating natural-language items from sampled formulas, provide only coarse or unaudited formal annotations, and are now quickly saturated by frontier reasoning models. We present LLMEval-Logic, a Chinese logical reasoning benchmark built from realistic situational scenarios. Its pipeline forward-authors and expert-audits natural-language items together with their reference formalizations, verifies annotated answers with Z3, constructs expert rubrics for natural-to-formal grading, and hardens selected items through a closed-loop adversarial workflow. The benchmark is released in two paired subsets: a 246-item Base subset shipped with 1,400 expert-developed rubric atoms, and a 190-item Hard subset with 938 multi-step sub-questions over closed model spaces. Evaluating 14 frontier LLMs on LLMEval-Logic reveals substantial gaps in current models: the best model reaches only 37.5% Hard Item Accuracy, and even with reference symbols the highest joint Z3+Rubric formalization score among evaluated models reaches only 60.16%. Our benchmark is publicly available at https://github.com/llmeval/LLMEval-Logic.

AI.tldr: 提出了一个中文逻辑推理基准LLMEval-Logic，包含两个配对子集，通过严格的形式化标注和专家审核流程构建；评估14个前沿模型显示当前LLM在复杂逻辑推理任务上存在显著不足，最佳模型Hard准确率仅37.5%。
AI.motivation: 评估LLM在自然语言逻辑推理方面至关重要，因为规则支配任务要求结论严格遵循前提；现有基准测试存在问题：通过对采样公式模板化生成自然语言项目、仅提供粗粒度或未审核的形式化注释、且很快被前沿模型饱和。
AI.method: 提出了LLMEval-Logic基准测试，包含246项Base子集（含1400个专家评分原子）和190项Hard子集（含938个多步骤子问题）；流程包括前向创作自然语言项目与形式化参考、Z3验证答案、专家评分标准构建、以及闭环对抗工作流强化项目。
AI.result: 评估14个前沿LLM后发现显著差距：最佳模型Hard Item Accuracy仅37.5%；即使提供参考符号，最高联合Z3+Rubric形式化得分也仅60.16%。
AI.conclusion: 该基准测试公开可用，为推进自然语言逻辑推理研究提供了重要资源；现有前沿模型在此任务上存在显著差距，Hard Item Accuracy最高仅37.5%，即使有参考符号最高联合Z3+Rubric得分也仅60.16%。

title: Efficient Elicitation of Collective Disagreements
summary: We analyze the structure of the disagreement among a population of voters over a set of alternatives. Surveys typically ask either for pairwise comparisons, simple and intuitive for participants, or full rankings over alternatives, eliciting the entire voters' preferences. Building on the observation that pairwise comparisons cannot distinguish structural disagreement from noise, we propose a stratified framework to identify the minimal aggregated preference information needed to compute a number of disagreement measures from the literature. Specifically, we introduce the plurality matrix, a generalization of pairwise comparisons that records, for every subset $S$ of alternatives, the probability that each $a \in S$ ranks first in $S$. We define the level of a disagreement measure as the smallest subset size needed to express it, showing that many existing notions, including rank-variance and divisiveness, sit at level $3$, proving that pairwise comparisons are not enough. In addition, we demonstrate the interest of going beyond level $3$ both theoretically and experimentally. To make these results actionable, we design two elicitation protocols to estimate the plurality matrix, exploring the trade-off between the number of required participants and the cognitive load requested to each of them.

AI.tldr: 本文研究了选民群体在多备选方案上的分歧结构，揭示了传统的成对比较方法在捕捉分歧方面的局限性，并提出了「 plurality matrix 」作为更一般的偏好信息表示框架，能够根据不同粒度的子集大小识别和计算多种分歧度量。
AI.motivation: 现有调查方法要么收集成对比较（简单直观但无法区分结构性分歧与噪声），要么收集完整排名（信息完整但认知负担大）。作者观察到成对比较存在根本性缺陷——无法区分真实偏好结构与随机噪声，因此需要建立一个分层框架来明确不同偏好信息聚合程度下能计算哪些分歧度量。
AI.method: 提出「plurality matrix」（复数矩阵），其核心思想是：对每个备选方案子集S，记录S中各方案排名第一的概率。作者定义了分歧度量的「层级」（level）概念——即表达该度量所需的最小子集大小。通过数学分析证明：包括rank-variance和divisiveness在内的多种经典分歧度量均处于第3层级，从而从理论层面证明成对比较（第2层级）是不够的。
AI.result: 主要理论结果：（1）许多现有分歧度量无法由成对比较计算，必须至少到第3层级的子集比较；（2）超越第3层级既有理论价值也有实验价值；（3）设计了两个信息采集协议，在参与者数量与个体认知负荷之间进行权衡。实验部分验证了框架的实用性。
AI.conclusion: 成对比较在分歧测量中具有根本性局限；plurality matrix提供了一个可扩展且具有实践意义的替代方案；该框架在理论层面统一了多种分歧度量，在实践层面通过灵活的采集协议降低了大规模应用的门槛。

title: VCR: Learning Valid Contextual Representation for Incomplete Wearable Signals
summary: Wearable devices enable continuous health monitoring from multimodal signals, but real-world deployment is hindered by limited labeled data and pervasive sensor incompleteness. While large-scale self-supervised pretraining reduces label dependence, most existing methods assume full modality availability. Current approaches for handling modality missingness often reconstruct entire absent signals, which can encourage hallucinating modality-specific details that are not inferable from the observed sensor signals and degrade robustness. We propose VCR, a self-supervised framework that learns to extract valid representations robust to modality missingness. VCR employs an orthogonal tokenizer to enforce strict orthogonal disentanglement by rectifying latent manifolds and applying a geometric projection, separating each modality into shared semantics and modality-specific residuals. This design preserves complete information integrity while serving as a structural foundation for robust learning under modality missingness. The resulting tokens are processed by a missing-aware mixture-of-experts backbone that adapts to varying patterns of modality availability. By constraining the objective to reconstruct only the shared components of missing modalities, VCR effectively mitigates hallucinations of non-inferable modality-specific details. Across multiple health monitoring tasks, VCR consistently improves performance and robustness under full, single-missing, and multiple-missing modality settings compared with strong supervised and self-supervised baselines.

AI.tldr: VCR 是一个面向可穿戴多模态信号的自监督预训练框架，通过"正交分词器（几何投影实现共享/专属成分的严格解耦）+ 缺失感知混合专家骨干网络"，在结构化模态缺失时只重建可推断的共享成分、拒绝重建不可推断的模态专属细节，从而抑制"幻觉式补全"；在4个健康监测任务（情感、活动、睡眠分期、VO₂回归）全模态与单/多模态缺失设置下均优于监督与自监督基线（推理时50.7M参数，与基线容量匹配）。
AI.motivation: 可穿戴设备通过PPG、EDA、ACC、TEMP等模态实现连续健康监测，但实际部署面临两大耦合难题：(1) 多任务标签稀缺；(2) 由硬件限制、固件故障、用户省电关闭传感器等导致的"整窗结构性模态缺失"。现有自监督预训练方法大多默认全模态可用；而处理缺失的主流做法（掩码重建整条缺失信号，如LSM-2）会迫使模型补全从观测信号中不可辨识的模态专属细节（如PPG形态学），形成"幻觉式补全"并向表征注入虚假信息；对比学习（CMC、MSN）虽能对齐共享表征但会压制模态专属线索；任务特定的模态路由方法（FlexMoE、FuseMoE）又难以跨任务复用。作者由此提出核心技术问题：缺失模态的专属信息不可辨识（non-identifiability），缺失模式决定可观测的跨模态依赖，以及各模态采样率/方差/语义差异造成的SSL目标失衡。论文还指出第二个缺口：现有工作缺少"全模态训练、缺失模态测试"的通用预训练框架与对"表征有效性（validity）"的重视。
AI.method: 形式化：将每个模态的潜信息分解为模态共享成分 s^m（与其他模态相关的语义，如PPG中的心率模式与ACC微振动的关联）与模态专属成分 p^m（如EDA的皮阻抗漂移），并假设 I(s;p)=0。整体为两阶段自监督框架。（1）正交分词器：对可学习矩阵 W 做前向 QR 分解，取 Q 前 r 列构成基 B，构造正交投影算子 P=BBᵀ（对称且幂等）；用轻量残差适配器 f_θ 校正非线性潜流形后做白化得 h=W(h̃+f_θ(h̃))，再令 s=Ph、p=(I−P)h；在白化协方差近似单位阵且潜变量近似高斯的条件下可证 Cov(s,p)≈0，从而以几何构造实现严格解耦（无显式解耦损失）。混合优化目标：跨模态对比对齐（仅用于 s，正样本为同步的其他模态 token）、模态内重建（仅用 p 重建原始信号，保证 p 保留全部非共享信息）、白化正则（协方差非对角 Frobenius 范数惩罚）。输入缺失模态在推理时用带"缺失标志"的零填充占位以保持张量形状。（2）缺失感知 MoE 骨干：Transformer 早期层（第2层，0-indexed）插入稀疏 MoE（8专家、top-2路由、容量因子1.25），用可学习分区嵌入编码"模态身份+成分类型(s/p)"语义，缺失模态 token 在输入层直接丢弃（而非零填充/特殊 token）。骨干在潜空间做掩码重建：随机掩码 L_rand 重建 s 与 p；结构性掩码（样本级随机丢弃1–3个模态）中，仅当恰好缺失1个模态时重建其共享成分 s（显式排除不可辨识的 p），缺失≥2个模态时二者均不重建。损失 L_backbone = L_rand + λ_struct·L_struct。预训练数据为 BIG IDEAs、UE4W、CAN-STRESS（非 cannabis 用户子集），共3565小时/56名受试者，与下游数据集无受试者重叠。
AI.result: （1）全模态：分类任务 Macro-F1 相对最优监督基线在 WESAD/AAUWSS/DaLiA 上分别至少提升 0.097/0.038/0.024，相对最优自监督基线至少提升 0.060/0.006/0.002；WEEE 回归 MAE 至少降低 0.406、R² 提升 0.198（对监督）与 MAE 降低 1.105、R² 提升 0.282（对自监督）。（2）单模态缺失：32 项主指标对比中 VCR 胜出 23 项；88 项总指标中 65 项最优、20 项次优。ACC 缺失时 DaLiA 上 VCR 仍保持 F1 0.416(FT)/0.428(LP)，对监督/自监督基线的优势分别由 0.024/0.002 扩大到 0.060/0.048。（3）多模态缺失（2–3个模态，10种模式）：分类 30 个设定中对预训练基线 Top-1 20/30、Top-2 25/30；对监督基线 Top-1 24/30、Top-2 28/30；回归 MAE/R² 对预训练基线 Top-1 各 7/10，对监督基线 8/10 与 7/10。（4）解耦质量：HSIC（高斯核）VCR 各模态 0.0033–0.0048（均值0.0042），优于软解耦基线 FOCAL 的 0.0108，尤其显著改善低频模态 EDA/TEMP 的解耦。（5）幻觉案例：DaLiA 上缺失 ACC 后重建信号引起的嵌入偏移，LSM-2 的嵌入余弦相似度为 0.732，VCR 为 0.813（偏移更小）；LSM-2 中表征偏移与真实类别概率下降显著正相关（Pearson r=0.561, p<0.001）。（6）消融：60 项指标中除1例外，各变体（软解耦替代、去掉 MoE、固定正弦位置编码替代可学习分区嵌入、重建 p 或都不重建）均明显掉分；专家数 1（退化为稠密）明显变差，8 专家最优；MoE 置于第2层最优；λ_recon/λ_align=0.1 最优（过大则 s 退化为噪声）；共享子空间初始秩比 r/d=0.9 最优且训练中有效秩收敛至>0.8；特征类型消融显示 s+p 组合在三个任务上均优于仅 s 或仅 p。
AI.conclusion: VCR 通过几何正交分词器（严格划分共享语义与模态专属残差）+ 缺失感知 MoE 骨干，确立了"表征有效性优先"的预训练范式：在结构性模态缺失下只重建可推断的共享成分，不生成不可观测的模态专属细节，从而在保留信息完整性的同时获得对缺失的鲁棒性，且在全模态下也不牺牲表征质量。局限：全部数据来自单一设备 Empatica E4，未涵盖跨设备差异，尽管框架本身与具体传感器无关，跨设备泛化验证留作未来工作；代码将在接收后开源。

title: Generative-Evaluative Agreement: A Necessary Validity Criterion for LLM-Enabled Adaptive Assessment
summary: When the same LLM generates assessment items, simulates student responses, and scores them, the validation loop is self-referential. We introduce Generative-Evaluative Agreement (GEA), a validity criterion measuring whether an LLM's scoring function recovers the skill levels its generative function was instructed to produce. In the first direct measurement of GEA on a two-stage adaptive assessment, the model recovers roughly half the intended variance r = 0.698 with systematic positive bias. GEA is strong r > 0.7 for syntactically verifiable skills but near zero for design-level skills, and low-skill overestimation inflates scores near the routing threshold. We argue that granular, skill-decomposed rubrics are the principal proposed mechanism for strengthening GEA and outline complementary mitigations.

AI.tldr: 研究引入"生成-评估一致性"（GEA）指标，评估 LLM 生成评分能力与评分能力的一致性。在自适应评估中发现，仅能恢复约50%的目标方差，且存在系统性正向偏差；GEA 在句法可验证技能上表现良好（r>0.7），但在设计级技能上几乎无效。
AI.motivation: 当同一 LLM 同时生成评估题目、模拟学生作答并评分时，验证循环存在自我参照问题，需要新的效度标准来评估这一过程
AI.method: 在两阶段自适应评估中直接测量 GEA，将 LLM 生成技能水平与评分函数恢复该水平的能力进行对比
AI.result: 模型仅能恢复约一半的预期方差（r=0.698），存在系统性正向偏差；句法可验证技能 GEA 强（r>0.7），但设计级技能 GEA 接近零；低技能高估会抬高路由阈值附近的分数
AI.conclusion: 细粒度、技能分解的评分 rubric 是加强 GEA 的主要机制，并需配合其他补充缓解措施

title: Lying Is Just a Phase: The Hidden Alignment Transition in Language Model Scaling
comment: 15 pages, 8 figures, 2 tables. Companion paper: "The Growing Pains of Frontier Models: When Leaderboards Stop Separating and What to Measure Next." Code: https://github.com/adilamin89/cape-scaling. Dashboard: https://zehenlabs.com/cape/
summary: Scaling laws predict loss from compute but not how capabilities interact. We measure the coupling between reasoning and truthfulness across 63 base models from 16 families and find a regime change invisible to loss curves: below a family-dependent critical scale $N_c$, capabilities anticorrelate; above it, they cooperate. $N_c \approx 3.5$B parameters [2.9B, 13.4B] (bootstrap 95% CI), but model size is not the only variable that determines phase. Architecture, data curation, and training recipe each shift $N_c$ independently: curated training eliminated the coupling dip between Qwen generations ($0.025 \to 0.830$ at matched scale), Gemma-4 at 4B achieves coupling 0.871, characteristic of 13B+ standard-trained models, through distillation and architectural innovation, and Phi at 1B matches web-trained coupling at 10B through data curation alone. Width normalization eliminates the anticorrelation across all tested families, supporting an output-projection bottleneck. Internally, 38 of 40 models show zero competing attention heads. A sparse-regression ODE cross-predicts held-out Llama-2 at 5.6% error. The diagnostic requires no model internals -- only public benchmark scores across a model family. The cooperative regime extends to the frontier ($r = +0.72$, 34 models, 10 labs). Code, data, and an open-source activation-steering tool for any open-weight model are released alongside an interactive dashboard that diagnoses any model's coupling phase, suggests concrete interventions (data curation, width, benchmark rotation), and provides ODE scaling predictions, frontier diagnostics, and eigenstructure analysis: https://zehenlabs.com/cape/.

AI.tldr: 本文揭示了语言模型能力耦合中的"相变"现象：存在一个临界规模N_c（约3.5B参数），低于此规模时推理能力与真实性负相关，高于此规模时正相关。这一相变受模型大小、架构、数据策划和训练方法的共同调节，且可通过宽度归一化或减少注意力竞争头来改善。
AI.motivation: 传统scaling laws仅能预测损失值，无法揭示模型能力之间的交互模式。论文旨在量化推理能力与真实性之间的耦合关系，识别其随规模变化的相变规律。
AI.method: 对63个基座模型（来自16个模型家族）测量推理与真实性能力的耦合度；采用bootstrap方法估计临界规模N_c的置信区间；使用ODE稀疏回归建模能力演化；分析注意力头的竞争模式；测试宽度归一化等干预手段。
AI.result: 发现临界规模N_c ≈ 35亿参数（95%CI: 29-134亿）；低于N_c时能力负相关，高于N_c时正相关。数据策划可将Qwen系列耦合度从0.025提升至0.830；Gemma-4通过蒸馏和架构创新在4B参数规模达到13B+模型的耦合水平；Phi-1B通过纯数据策划匹配10B web训练模型的耦合度。宽度归一化可消除所有测试家族的负相关；38/40模型显示零竞争注意力头。ODE模型对Llama-2的交叉预测误差为5.6%。
AI.conclusion: 能力耦合存在相变现象，临界规模N_c受多重因素调节；宽度瓶颈和注意力竞争是负相关的机制来源；数据策划和架构创新可有效降低N_c阈值；合作机制延伸至前沿模型（34模型10实验室，r=+0.72）。

title: K-Quantization and its Impact on Output Performance
summary: Recent advancements in large language models (LLMs) have shown their remarkable capacities in many NLP tasks. However, their substantial size often presents challenges for deployment. This necessitates efficient techniques for model compression, with quantization emerging as a prominent solution. Despite its benefits, the exact impact of quantization (from 2- to 6-bit) on the performance and accuracy of LLMs remains an active area of research. This paper investigates the performance of eight LLMs at various quantization levels, focusing on tasks such as MMLU-Pro for knowledge processing and reasoning, CRUXEval for code comprehension, and MuSR for reading comprehension. Our results show a consistent trend where higher precision (e.g., 8-bit Q8\_0) yields improved performance, albeit with diminishing returns. Aggressive quantization (e.g., 2-bit Q2\_K) usually retains acceptable accuracy, though some models show a substantial loss in performance. Our findings indicate that while lower bit precision generally reduces performance, the impact varies across models and tasks. Larger models show greater resilience to aggressive quantization, but can still undergo significant drops at lower precision levels. Mid-sized models in the 7-9 billion parameter range strike an optimal balance between efficiency and resource usage. Such results provide insights into the trade-offs between model size, quantization, and performance.

AI.tldr: 该研究系统评估了8个LLM在不同量化级别（2-6bit）下的表现，发现高精度带来性能提升但边际效益递减，大模型对量化更鲁棒，7-9B参数模型是效率与性能的最佳平衡点。
AI.motivation: LLM规模庞大导致部署困难，量化是主要压缩手段，但2-6bit量化对不同模型性能和精度的影响尚不明确。
AI.method: 对8个LLM在2-6bit多种量化级别下进行系统评估，涵盖知识推理（MMLU-Pro）、代码理解（CRUXEval）和阅读理解（MuSR）三类任务。
AI.result: 更高精度（如Q8_0）性能更优但收益递减；激进量化（如Q2_K）通常可接受但存在显著性能下降；大模型对量化更具鲁棒性，但低精度下仍会明显退化。
AI.conclusion: 7-9B参数的中等规模模型在效率和性能间达到最优平衡；低位量化虽有明显缺点，但大模型展现出更强的抗性，为实际部署提供了参考。

title: Library Drift: Diagnosing and Fixing a Silent Failure Mode in Self-Evolving LLM Skill Libraries
summary: Self-evolving skill libraries face a silent failure mode we term \emph{library drift}: unbounded skill accumulation without outcome-driven lifecycle management causes retrieval degradation, false-positive injections, and performance stagnation. Recent evaluation confirms the symptom--LLM-authored skills deliver +0.0pp gain while human-curated ones deliver +16.2pp (SkillsBench)--yet the underlying mechanism has not been isolated. We provide (1) a reproducible trigger: ablations that isolate drift--one disables skill injection (flat floor, +0.002), one imposes premature retirement (active harm, $-$0.019); (2) trace-level diagnostics: an append-only evidence log with per-skill contribution scores, attribution verdicts, and router engagement metrics that make the failure visible before it reaches end-task scores; and (3) a verified fix: a minimal governance recipe (outcome-driven retirement + bounded active-cap + meta-skill authoring prior) that lifts held-out pass@1 from a 0.258 baseline to a late-window mean of 0.584 (rolling gain $+$0.328) on MBPP+ hard-100 over 100 rounds. Eight ablations decompose which governance mechanisms are load-bearing and which are subsumed, providing a concrete playbook for diagnosing library drift in any self-evolving agent.

AI.tldr: 本文识别并解决了自我进化技能库中的"库漂移"问题：技能无节制积累导致性能停滞。通过消融实验定位触发条件，设计可观测的证据日志实现早期诊断，并验证"基于结果退休+活跃上限+元技能优先"的治理方案，在MBPP+ hard-100上实现pass@1从0.258到0.584的提升。
AI.motivation: 自我进化技能库存在"库漂移"（library drift）问题：技能无限制积累但缺乏基于结果的生命周期管理，导致检索降级、误注入和性能停滞。实验发现LLM生成的技能仅带来+0.0pp增益，而人类策展技能带来+16.2pp增益（SkillsBench），但潜在机制尚未被隔离和理解。
AI.method: 通过三类实验设计：（1）消融实验隔离漂移触发条件——禁用技能注入（平底+0.002）和强制提前退休（主动危害-0.019）；（2）引入追加式证据日志，包含技能贡献评分、归因裁决和路由参与度指标，可在性能指标恶化前诊断失败；（3）验证最小治理方案：基于结果的退休机制+有界活跃上限+元技能编写优先级。
AI.result: 治理方案在MBPP+ hard-100的100轮实验中，将held-out pass@1从0.258基线提升至后期窗口均值0.584，滚动增益达+0.328。
AI.conclusion: 提出可验证的治理方案：outcome-driven retirement + bounded active-cap + meta-skill authoring prior，该方案在MBPP+ hard-100基准上使pass@1从0.258提升至0.584（100轮滚动增益+0.328），并通过8个消融实验验证各治理机制的有效性。

title: An Integrated Forecasting Prototype for Emergency Department Boarding Time to Support Proactive Operational Decision Making
summary: Overcrowding in emergency departments (ED) remains a persistent operational challenge worldwide, causing delays in care delivery and downstream congestion. ED boarding time, defined as the duration admitted patients remain in the ED while awaiting inpatient bed placement, is a key indicator of this congestion. Predicting ED boarding time in advance enables proactive operational decision making before congestion escalates. We developed and evaluated a multi-horizon time series forecasting framework to predict ED boarding time at 6, 8, 10, 12, and 24-hour horizons. Real-world data from a university-affiliated urban hospital in the United States were utilized and integrated with external contextual data sources, including weather, holidays, and major local events. Decomposition-based Linear (DLinear) and Normalization-based Linear (NLinear) time series forecasting deep learning models showed superior performance across multiple horizons. Models were also evaluated under extreme congestion scenarios characterized by elevated boarding times. In addition, a Machine Learning Operations (MLOps) web application prototype was developed to support translation of the forecasting framework into practice through integrated data ingestion, forecast visualization, experimentation, and retraining.

AI.tldr: 研究开发了多时域时间序列预测框架，用于预测急诊室6-24小时滞留时间，整合天气、节假日等外部数据，DLinear和NLinear模型表现优异，并构建MLOps原型验证实践可行性。
AI.motivation: 急诊室过度拥挤是全球性运营挑战，导致护理延误和下游拥堵；急诊滞留时间（boarding time）是关键拥堵指标，提前预测可支持主动式运营决策。
AI.method: 采用多时域时间序列预测框架，使用分解线性模型(DLinear)和归一化线性模型(NLinear)；整合天气、节假日、当地重大事件等外部上下文数据；开发MLOps Web应用原型，实现数据接入、预测可视化、实验追踪和模型再训练功能。
AI.result: 分解线性模型(DLinear)和归一化线性模型(NLinear)在多个预测时域(6/8/10/12/24小时)表现优越；在极端滞留场景下模型依然有效。
AI.conclusion: DLinear和NLinear在多预测时域上表现优异，极端拥堵场景下模型同样有效，MLOps原型验证了框架的实践可行性，为ED运营决策提供了可落地的预测工具。

title: Can Large Language Models Reliably Correct Errors in Low-Resource ASR? A Contamination-Aware Case Study on West Frisian
summary: Automatic speech recognition (ASR) has improved substantially in recent years, yet performance remains limited for low-resource languages. Large language models (LLMs) have shown promise for improving ASR through generative error correction (GER), but their effectiveness in low-resource settings remains underexplored. In addition, it remains unclear to what extent data contamination influences the reported improvements in LLM-based GER. This study investigates LLM-based GER for low-resource Frisian. In addition to a public corpus, we construct and use a Frisian offline dataset with non-public texts for evaluation to control for potential data contamination. Results show that GER improves ASR performance in most settings, with the best GPT-5.1 results surpassing oracle WERs. Comparable gains on the offline dataset indicate that improvements reflect true correction ability. We further provide a detailed error analysis revealing model correction patterns.

AI.tldr: 针对低资源弗里斯兰语ASR系统，研究了基于LLM的生成式错误纠正(GER)效果。通过构建离线数据集控制数据污染问题，实验证明GER能有效改善ASR性能，GPT-5.1模型超越oracle WER，且改进来源于真正的纠错能力。
AI.motivation: ASR在低资源语言上性能受限；LLM在低资源场景的生成式错误纠正(GER)效果尚不明确；数据污染对LLM-GER改进的影响程度未知
AI.method: 针对低资源语言弗里斯兰语构建LLM生成式错误纠正系统；使用公开语料库和自建离线数据集进行评估，以控制数据污染问题
AI.result: GER在多数设置下提升ASR性能；GPT-5.1最佳结果超越oracle WER；在离线数据集上取得可比增益
AI.conclusion: 在离线数据集上取得可比增益，证明改进源于真正的纠错能力而非数据污染；提供了详细的错误分析以揭示模型纠错模式

title: SceneCode: Executable World Programs for Editable Indoor Scenes with Articulated Objects
summary: Indoor scene synthesis underpins embodied AI, robotic manipulation, and simulation-based policy evaluation, where a useful scene must specify not only what the environment looks like, but also how its objects are structured. Existing pipelines, however, typically represent generated content as static meshes and inherit articulation only from curated asset libraries, which limits object-level controllability and prevents new interactable assets from being produced on demand. We address this gap by formulating physically interactable indoor scene synthesis as programmatic world generation, and present SceneCode, a framework that compiles a natural language prompt into an executable, code-driven indoor world rather than a collection of opaque meshes. A room-level agentic backbone first turns the prompt into a structured house layout and emits per-object AssetRequests through a planner--designer--critic loop. Each request is then routed to one of five code-generation strategies and converted into a synthesized part-wise Blender Python programs that are validated through an execution-guided repair-and-refine loop. The resulting programs are compiled into simulation-ready assets, and exported as SDF for physics simulation. A persistent scene-state registry links object requests, executable programs, rendered geometry, and simulation assets, turning scene assembly into a traceable and locally editable world-building process. We evaluate SceneCode across scene-level synthesis, object-level asset quality, human judgment, and downstream robot interaction. Results show that executable world programs improve prompt-faithful indoor scene generation and produce assets with cleaner mesh structure, and simulator-loadable articulation metadata. Project page: https://scene-code.github.io/.

AI.tldr: SceneCode将室内场景合成重新定义为编程式世界生成问题，通过自然语言提示生成可执行的Blender Python程序来创建物理可交互的室内场景，而非传统的静态网格。
AI.motivation: 现有室内场景合成流程仅将生成内容表示为静态网格，且仅从策划的资产库继承关节，限制了物体级可控性，无法按需生成新的可交互资产。
AI.method: SceneCode框架包含三个核心模块：1）房间级智能主干，通过规划器-设计器-评论家循环将自然语言提示转换为结构化房屋布局并生成每物体资产请求；2）五类代码生成策略，将每个请求转换为可执行的Blender Python程序；3）执行引导的修复-精炼循环验证程序并编译为模拟就绪资产。系统采用持久场景状态注册表链接对象请求、可执行程序、渲染几何体和模拟资产。
AI.result: 实验表明：可执行世界程序显著提升了提示忠实性的室内场景生成质量；生成的资产具有更清晰的网格结构；可导出具有模拟器可加载的关节元数据的SDF格式资产。
AI.conclusion: SceneCode通过将自然语言提示编译为可执行的代码驱动室内世界，显著提升了提示忠实性（prompt-faithful）的室内场景生成质量，生成的资产具有更清晰的网格结构和可加载到模拟器的关节元数据，为具身AI和机器人操作提供了可追溯且局部可编辑的世界构建流程。

title: The Growing Pains of Frontier Models: When Leaderboards Stop Separating and What to Measure Next
comment: 13 pages, 5 figures, 4 tables. Companion paper: "Lying Is Just a Phase: The Hidden Alignment Transition in Language Model Scaling." Code: https://github.com/adilamin89/cape-scaling. Dashboard: https://zehenlabs.com/cape/
summary: Leaderboards rank frontier models on independent axes but do not reveal whether capabilities reinforce or trade off across releases -- and at the frontier, this interaction is the more informative signal. We decompose paired SWE-bench and GPQA Diamond scores into a population coupling trend and per-release residual ($h$-field) that diagnoses capability emphasis and identifies which measurement or stress test is most informative next. Across 34 models from 10 labs (2024--2026), capabilities cooperate ($r = +0.72$, $p < 10^{-6}$), but cooperation varies by lab and over time: DeepSeek reversed from reasoning-rich to coding-first ($h$: $+11.2 \to -4.7$, 15.9-pp swing); Google maintains consistent reasoning emphasis; Anthropic oscillates between coding excursions and recovery. Cooperation is not static -- it cascades. Six open-weight architectures confirm a second capability transition at 30--72B, and SWE-bench is now saturating while HLE and instruction-following retain discriminatory spread -- signaling the next axis rotation. We provide a three-level playbook (locate, diagnose, rotate), a per-lab measurement-priority table, and seven falsifiable predictions with timestamped criteria for the next 12 months of frontier releases. Per-lab coupling slopes vary $5\times$ (Google $1.15$ vs. DeepSeek $0.23$), quantifying how efficiently each recipe converts coding gains into reasoning. Five April 2026 releases confirm the diagnostic out of sample ($r$ rises from $+0.72$ to $+0.75$). An interactive dashboard provides phase classification with actionable recommendations, $h$-field diagnostics, per-lab coupling trajectories, ODE-based scaling predictions, benchmark rotation guidance, self-steering demo, and live tracking of all seven predictions: https://zehenlabs.com/cape/.

AI.tldr: 本研究通过分解34个模型（来自10个实验室）的SWE-bench和GPQA Diamond得分，诊断各实验室的能力侧重点差异。研究发现编码与推理能力总体呈正相关(r=+0.72)，但各实验室的合作模式随时间动态变化，并识别出30-72B参数区间存在第二次能力跃迁。
AI.motivation: 当前排行榜仅展示独立维度的排名，无法揭示能力之间的增强或权衡关系。而在前沿领域，这种交互作用才是更关键的信息信号。
AI.method: 将配对的SWE-bench和GPQA Diamond得分分解为人口耦合趋势和每次发布的残差($h$-场)。$h$-场可诊断能力侧重点，识别哪些测量或压力测试最具信息量。分析涵盖34个模型、10个实验室（2024-2026），并用6个开源架构验证30-72B参数区间的第二次能力跃迁。
AI.result:
1. 编码与推理能力总体合作(r=+0.72, p<10⁻⁶)
2. 合作程度因实验室和时间而异：DeepSeek从推理优先反转至编码优先(h场：+11.2→-4.7)；Google保持一致的推理侧重；Anthropic在编码探索与恢复间振荡
3. 30-72B参数区间存在第二次能力跃迁
4. 各实验室耦合斜率差异达5倍（Google 1.15 vs DeepSeek 0.23）
5. 2026年4月的5个发布验证了诊断的样本外有效性(r升至+0.75)
AI.conclusion: 能力合作非静态，而是级联的。SWE-bench正在饱和，而HLE和指令遵循仍保持区分度，预示下一轴旋转。提供三层次 playbook（定位、诊断、旋转）、实验室测量优先级表、7个可证伪预测及12个月时间戳标准，并建立交互式仪表盘追踪预测状态。

title: LLM-Based Financial Sentiment Analysis in Arabic: Evidence from Saudi Markets
comment: Accepted at the 7th Workshop on Open-Source Arabic Corpora and Processing Tools (OSACT7), co-located with LREC 2026, Palma de Mallorca, Spain, May 2026. ISBN: 978-2-493814-52-4
summary: Investor sentiment shapes financial markets, yet modeling sentiment in Arabic financial contexts remains challenging due to linguistic complexity and limited resources. We present an Arabic NLP framework for large-scale financial sentiment analysis tailored to the Saudi market, integrating official financial news and social media to capture institutional and public investor sentiment. The framework constructs a large Arabic financial corpus through a multi-stage pipeline encompassing data collection, cleaning, deduplication, entity linking, and sentiment annotation. Transformer-based NER combined with a curated company lexicon links textual mentions to canonical company identifiers, with sentiment labels assigned using a five-class scheme. The resulting dataset of 84K samples supports company-level sentiment aggregation and analysis of sentiment dynamics relative to stock market behavior on the Saudi Exchange. Experimental results demonstrate reliable and scalable Arabic financial sentiment analysis.

AI.tldr: 本文提出了一个针对沙特市场的阿拉伯语金融情感分析NLP框架，整合官方金融新闻和社交媒体数据，通过多阶段流程构建84K样本的大规模阿拉伯金融语料库，采用Transformer NER和企业词典进行实体链接，实现公司级情感聚合分析，验证了该方法的可靠性和可扩展性。
AI.motivation: 投资者情绪影响金融市场运行，但阿拉伯金融语境下的情感建模面临语言复杂性高和资源匮乏的挑战，亟需针对阿拉伯语金融文本的大规模情感分析工具。
AI.method: 构建包含数据收集、清洗、去重、实体链接和情感标注的多阶段流程管线；采用基于Transformer的命名实体识别（NER）结合企业词典将文本提及与规范公司标识符关联；使用五分类方案进行情感标注，实现公司级别的情感聚合分析。
AI.result: 构建了84K样本规模的阿拉伯金融语料库，支持公司级情感聚合；实验验证了该框架在阿拉伯金融情感分析任务上具有可靠性和可扩展性。
AI.conclusion: 该框架在阿拉伯金融情感分析任务上展现出可靠且可扩展的性能，为沙特市场的投资者情绪建模提供了有效工具。

title: From Cumulative Constraints to Adaptive Runtime Safety Control for Nonstationary Reinforcement Learning
summary: Safety in reinforcement learning is often specified through cumulative cost constraints, but these trajectory-level guarantees do not directly prevent unsafe individual decisions, especially under nonstationarity. In continual and nonstationary settings, the difficulty is amplified because the risk associated with the same action can vary across contexts, while a fixed state-level threshold may be either too conservative or too weak. We propose Constraint Projection Safety Shield (CPSS), a runtime mechanism that converts a cumulative safety budget into adaptive state-level control constraints during execution. CPSS tracks the remaining safety budget, projects it into a time-varying admissible risk threshold, and filters policy actions whose predicted safety cost exceeds the active threshold. The threshold is adjusted online using contextual signals so that enforcement becomes stricter in more demanding or rapidly changing regimes and less restrictive when the available safety budget is sufficient. We analyze the resulting shielded policy and show that the mechanism guarantees per-state threshold satisfaction for executed actions, induces finite-horizon cumulative cost bounds, and yields a performance degradation bound in terms of intervention frequency and per-step reward distortion. We evaluate CPSS in nonstationary highway merging scenarios using highway-env. Across multiple seeds, CPSS substantially reduces proximity-based safety violations and increases separation margins while intervening selectively rather than dominating the learned policy. These results support adaptive budget-to-threshold projection as a practical way to transform cumulative safety specifications into effective local safety control for continual reinforcement learning systems.

AI.tldr: CPSS（约束投影安全护盾）是一种运行时安全机制，将累积安全预算自适应地转换为状态级控制约束，在非平稳环境中动态调整安全阈值，以在保持策略性能的同时确保局部决策安全。
AI.motivation: 现有轨迹级安全约束无法防止个体决策的不安全行为；在持续和非平稳环境中，相同动作的风险会随上下文变化，固定状态级阈值过于保守或过于宽松。
AI.method: CPSS跟踪剩余安全预算，将其投影为时变允许风险阈值，过滤预测安全成本超过阈值的行为；阈值根据上下文信号在线调整，在高风险或快速变化环境中收紧，在安全预算充足时放松。
AI.result: 理论证明：执行动作的状态阈值满足性、有限时域累积成本界限、干预频率和单步奖励偏差的性能下降界限；实验验证：显著减少近距离安全违规，增加安全距离，同时选择性干预而非主导学习策略。
AI.conclusion: 自适应预算-阈值投影是将累积安全规范转化为持续强化学习系统有效局部安全控制的实用方法，在非平稳高速公路并线场景中验证有效。

title: CAIT: A Syntactic Parsing Toolkit for Child-Adult InTeractions
summary: CHILDES is a paramount resource for language acquisition studies -- yet computational tools for analyzing its syntactic structure remain limited. Leveraging the recent release of the UD-English-CHILDES treebank with gold-standard Universal Dependencies (UD) annotations, we train a state-of-the-art dependency parser specifically tailored to CHILDES. The parser more accurately captures syntactic patterns in child--adult interactions, outperforming widely used off-the-shelf English parsers, including SpaCy and Stanza. Alongside the parser, we also release a Part-of-Speech tagger and an utterance-level construction tagger, which together form the open-source Syntactic Parsing Toolkit for Child--Adult InTeractions (CAIT). Through a detailed error analysis and a case study tracking the distribution of syntactic constructions across developmental time in CHILDES, we demonstrate the practical utility of the toolkit for large-scale, reproducible research on language acquisition.

AI.tldr: 本文针对CHILDES语料库开发了一套句法分析工具包CAIT，包含专门训练的依存解析器、词性标注器和构式标注器，性能优于SpaCy和Stanza等通用工具，旨在支持大规模、可重复的儿童语言习得研究。
AI.motivation: CHILDES是语言习得研究的核心资源，但缺乏针对其特点的句法分析工具。现有通用英文解析器（如SpaCy、Stanza）无法准确捕捉儿童-成人互动中的句法模式。
AI.method: 利用新发布的UD-English-CHILDES树bank（包含黄金标准的Universal Dependencies标注），训练了一个专为CHILDES定制的最先进的依存解析器，并同时开发了词性标注器和话语级构式标注器。
AI.result: 该解析器能更准确地捕捉儿童-成人互动中的句法模式，在性能上优于SpaCy和Stanza等广泛使用的通用英文解析器。
AI.conclusion: 发布了开源工具包CAIT（Syntactic Parsing Toolkit for Child-Adult Interactions），通过详细错误分析和追踪CHILDES中句法构式随发育时间分布的案例研究，证明了该工具包在支持大规模、可重复语言习得研究方面的实用价值。

title: Formal Skill: Programmable Runtime Skills for Efficient and Accurate LLM Agents
summary: Large Language Model (LLM) agents increasingly act inside real workspaces, where tools and skills determine whether model reasoning becomes reliable action. Existing skills remain largely informal: Markdown skills and instruction packs encode procedures as long natural-language documents, while function calling, Model Context Protocol (MCP) servers, and framework tools structure individual actions but usually leave workflow state, policy enforcement, and completion discipline outside the skill itself. We introduce Formal Skill, a runtime-native abstraction that represents reusable capability with JSON metadata and action schemas, reliable Python executors, hook-governed control logic, Formal Skill routing, and skill-local runtime state. By moving reusable procedure from repeated prompt text into executable state machines and hook policies, Formal Skill gives agents a token-efficient and enforceable control surface. We implement the abstraction in FairyClaw, an open-source event-driven runtime for executable, observable, and composable Formal Skills. On Harness-Bench, FairyClaw obtains highly competitive average scores while using substantially fewer tokens, with especially strong results on tasks that expose the role of Formal Skill.

AI.tldr: 本文提出「Formal Skill」——把智能体可复用技能从长篇自然语言提示（SKILL.md 类）升级为运行时原生的可执行对象，由 JSON 元数据与动作模式、可靠 Python 执行器、生命周期钩子、Formal Skill 路由与技能本地运行时状态五部分构成。作者在开源事件驱动运行时 FairyClaw 中实现该抽象，并以 CodeRepairOps 技能做案例。在 Harness-Bench（75 任务、6 个 harness、gpt-5.4 与 gemini-3.1-pro 两个模型族）上，FairyClaw 平均综合分 0.690，跨六框架按均值排名第三，在 gpt-5.4 组排名第一，总 token 7.35M、每任务均 49.0K，比其余五个框架均值低约 48%、比次优 token 效率框架低约 33%；在代表性代码调试任务上两个模型族均取得最高分。
AI.motivation: LLM 智能体已从聊天助手演变为能在真实工作区读写文件、执行命令、调用外部服务的行动者，技能与工具成为其"手脚"。但现有可复用能力组织方式存在两类缺陷：(1) 文本封装技能（Claude 风格 SKILL.md、指令包）把流程写成半结构化长文，需逐轮按 token 付费，且排序约束、安全规则、完成判据只是"软建议"；(2) schema 级工具接口（function calling、MCP 工具、框架工具）虽类型化了单个动作，却把阶段顺序、恢复状态、副作用策略与完成门禁留在提示或外层编排中。作者将此统称为"Informal Skill"，并指出四重代价：昂贵（长流程文本占 token）、歧义（自然语言对机器仅半结构化）、脆弱（排序/安全/完成条件仅为软约束）、易碎（恢复状态隐含在对话轨迹而非技能本地状态中）。作者也坦承 Formal Skill 提高了技能编写门槛，需要写 schema、执行器与钩子代码，但认为现代 LLM 可从人类可读的 Skill.md 自动合成这些形式化组件，提供自举路径。
AI.method: Formal Skill 作为运行时契约，包含五个组件：JSON 元数据与动作 schema（模型可见接口）、确定性校验与受限副作用的 Python 执行器、生命周期钩子（before_llm_call / after_llm_response / before_tool_call / after_tool_call）、技能本地运行时状态（phase、verification_passed、produced/required_artifacts、gate_fail_reasons、last-tool 状态）、以及决定技能何时暴露的路由元数据。核心机制有三层：动作面（把"修复代码"这类粗粒度操作拆成证据收集、统一补丁、验证、产物写入等细粒度工具，JSON 侧声明参数合法性，Python 侧做路径检查、命令白名单、补丁形状校验）、控制面（钩子在 LLM 与工具边界上过滤可见工具、注入阶段化引导、拦截不安全调用、阻止过早结束）、状态面（使流程成为执行对象而非对话约定）。FairyClaw 是支撑实现：单步规划器、类型化历史 IR、能力注册表、钩子流水线、持久会话状态、子智能体委派与 Formal Skill 路由；关键机制为子智能体技能路由算法——按任务类型、触发元数据与策略约束对候选技能打分，仅向子会话暴露被路由技能的工具集与钩子，同时保留编排工具。案例 CodeRepairOps 实现代码修复/测试驱动调试技能，含 reproduce、diagnose（可选）、patch、verify、report 五阶段，注入的默认工作流为 reproduce→patch→verify→report；各阶段可见工具不同（reproduce 仅证据收集、patch 阶段只允许统一补丁工具并拦截受保护路径与追加式编辑、verify 阶段只允许验证、report 阶段允许产物写入与完成），并强制"验证未通过与必需产物缺失即阻塞完成"。实验在 Harness-Bench 上用 75 个任务，通过本地 usage 代理记录请求/响应并重建紧凑调用链用于流程评分，最终分数 combined = outcome_effective × process_effective × security。
AI.result: 1) 总体分数具竞争力：FairyClaw 在 gpt-5.4 组取得最高综合分 0.746（75 任务），与 Moltis 0.744、Hermes 0.740 接近，优于 OpenClaw 0.693、NullClaw 0.685、ZeroClaw 0.587；在 gemini-3.1-pro 组为 0.635，低于 OpenClaw 0.689、NullClaw 0.645、Moltis 0.643，但两模型族平均 0.690，跨六框架按均值排名第三。2) Token 效率显著领先：gpt-5.4 组总 3.51M、每任务 46.8K，为该组最低；gemini 组总 3.84M、每任务 51.2K，同样远低于其他框架（NullClaw 高达 12.70M）。两族合计 7.35M、平均 49.0K/任务，比其余五框架均值低约 48%、比次优者低约 33%；由于运行中关闭了自动上下文压缩，token 节省可归因于 Formal Skill 路由、紧凑阶段引导与更窄的工具暴露，而非摘要压缩。3) 机制相关任务表现突出：在代表性分层代码调试任务（buggy_code.py 五层缺陷、每轮只暴露当前层、需通过当前层后停止）中，FairyClaw 在两个模型族均获最高分（gpt-5.4 0.865、gemini 0.843），token 消耗也低于多数基线；其轮数（48/54）多于部分基线，但轨迹由钩子控制的状态转移支配而非无结构对话堆积。
AI.conclusion: 论文主张智能体技能应是 token 效率高、由运行时治理的可编程协议，而非纯自然语言文档。Formal Skill 把自然语言保留在"任务相关推理"这一合适角色，让模型在结构化动作中选择，而运行时以 schema、执行器、钩子、状态与门禁拥有流程不变量，从而同时降低 token 成本并提升约束可执行性与可观测性。证据显示：在 Harness-Bench 上 FairyClaw 综合分具竞争力（gpt-5.4 组第一、跨框架均值第三），token 用量显著更低，在暴露 Formal Skill 价值的程序性任务上优势明显。局限方面，作者承认技能编写门槛提高、案例仅覆盖代码修复类任务、gemini 组非最优、代表性任务为单一案例，且任务级结果不应被解读为"每个任务都由 CodeRepairOps 解决"。后续方向包括由 Skill.md 自动编译出形式化组件的自举机制、更多领域技能实例化与更广泛的跨框架消融分析。

title: Safe Continual Reinforcement Learning under Nonstationarity via Adaptive Safety Constraints
summary: Safe reinforcement learning in nonstationary environments requires safety mechanisms that adapt as environmental conditions change. Standard safe reinforcement learning methods often assume fixed constraints or stable environmental conditions, which can become inadequate under distribution shift. We propose LILAC+, a framework for safe continual reinforcement learning under nonstationarity that combines three adaptive safety mechanisms: context-based safety constraints, adaptation-speed constraints, and budget-to-state safety enforcement. Context-based constraints adjust safety requirements using inferred and predicted environmental context. Adaptation-speed constraints tighten safety requirements when the rate of environmental change exceeds the agent's ability to adapt safely. Budget-to-state enforcement converts cumulative safety requirements into local state-level control constraints that can be enforced at decision time. Together, these mechanisms provide a unified approach for proactive and reactive safety adaptation in continual reinforcement learning. We evaluate the framework in simulated driving environments under stationary, seen nonstationary, and unseen nonstationary conditions. The results show that adaptive safety constraints substantially reduce safety violations under distribution shift while maintaining competitive task performance compared with unconstrained and fixed-constraint baselines. These findings suggest that safe continual reinforcement learning requires adaptive constraint mechanisms that respond not only to current state information but also to predicted environmental context, adaptation demand, and remaining safety budget.

AI.tldr: LILAC+ addresses safe reinforcement learning under environmental nonstationarity by combining three adaptive safety mechanisms—context-based constraints, adaptation-speed constraints, and budget-to-state enforcement—to proactively and reactively adapt safety requirements, demonstrating substantial reduction in safety violations while maintaining task performance in simulated driving scenarios.
AI.motivation: Standard safe reinforcement learning methods assume fixed constraints or stable environmental conditions, which become inadequate under distribution shift caused by environmental nonstationarity.
AI.method: LILAC+ framework combining three adaptive safety mechanisms: (1) context-based safety constraints that adjust safety requirements using inferred and predicted environmental context; (2) adaptation-speed constraints that tighten safety requirements when the rate of environmental change exceeds the agent's adaptation capacity; (3) budget-to-state safety enforcement that converts cumulative safety requirements into local state-level control constraints for decision-time enforcement.
AI.result: In simulated driving environments under stationary, seen nonstationary, and unseen nonstationary conditions, adaptive safety constraints substantially reduced safety violations under distribution shift while maintaining competitive task performance compared with unconstrained and fixed-constraint baselines.
AI.conclusion: Safe continual reinforcement learning requires adaptive constraint mechanisms that respond not only to current state information but also to predicted environmental context, adaptation demand, and remaining safety budget.

title: Mathematical Reasoning in Large Language Models: Benchmarks, Architectures, Evaluation, and Open Challenges
summary: Mathematical reasoning is essential for problem-solving in education, science, and industry, serving as a crucial benchmark for evaluating artificial intelligence systems. As Large Language Models (LLMs) improve their reasoning capabilities, understanding how well they perform mathematical reasoning has become increasingly important. This survey synthesizes recent advancements in mathematical reasoning with LLMs through a structured analysis of datasets, architectures, training strategies, and evaluation protocols. Our systematic review encompasses approximately 120 peer-reviewed studies and preprints, examining the evolution of this research area and providing a unified analytical framework to understand current progress and limitations. Our study particularly introduces a unified taxonomy of mathematical datasets, distinguishing between pretraining corpora, supervised fine-tuning resources, and evaluation benchmarks across varying levels of reasoning complexity. A systematic analysis of reasoning architectures and training strategies, including tool integration, verifier-guided reasoning, and parameter-efficient adaptation, is presented to assess their effects on reasoning robustness and generalization. Moreover, a comparative evaluation of existing metrics highlights the gap between final-answer accuracy and process-level reasoning verification. By synthesizing insights across these areas, our analysis identifies recurring failure modes, such as reasoning faithfulness issues, benchmark biases, and generalization limitations, and outlines key research directions toward improving symbolic grounding, evaluation reliability, and the development of more robust and trustworthy LLM-based reasoning systems.

AI.tldr: 该综述系统性分析了大语言模型在数学推理领域的最新进展，涵盖约120项研究，从数据集、架构、训练策略和评估协议四个维度构建统一分析框架，识别了当前研究中的关键失败模式和未来改进方向。
AI.motivation: 随着大语言模型推理能力的提升，评估其在数学推理任务中的表现变得越来越重要。数学推理是教育、科学和工业问题解决的关键基准，也是评估人工智能系统能力的重要指标。
AI.method: 对约120项同行评审研究和预印本进行系统性综述，采用统一分析框架从数据集、架构、训练策略和评估协议四个维度进行结构化分析，构建了数学数据集的统一分类体系。
AI.result: 系统性梳理了数学数据集的分类（预训练语料、监督微调资源、评估基准）；分析了推理架构和训练策略（工具集成、验证器引导推理、参数高效适配）对推理鲁棒性和泛化能力的影响；揭示了最终答案准确性与过程级推理验证之间的差距。
AI.conclusion: 该综述为LLM数学推理研究提供了系统性的分析框架，识别了推理忠诚度问题、基准偏差和泛化限制等反复出现的失败模式，并指出了改进符号接地、评估可靠性和开发更鲁棒可信的LLM推理系统的关键研究方向。

title: EMO-BOOST: Emotion-Augmented Audio-Visual Features for Improved Generalization in Deepfake Detection
summary: With every advancement in generative AI models, forensics is under increasing pressure. The constant emergence of new generation techniques makes it impossible to collect data for each manipulation to train a deepfake detection model. Thus, generalizing to deepfakes unseen during training is one of the major challenges in current deepfake detection research. To tackle this challenge, we employ high-level semantic cues and argue that these cues can support low-level focused approaches in generalizing to unseen types of manipulations. In this work, we study emotions as a high-level semantic cue. We propose Emo-Boost, a multimodal deepfake detection framework that fuses an off-the-shelf RGB- and acoustic-focused deepfake detector with our emotion-based deepfake detector EmoForensics. EmoForensics utilises vision and audio emotion recognition modules and models intra- and inter-modal temporal consistency in emotion representations from an audio-visual stream. We found that EmoForensics and the low-level focused method capture complementary signals. Consequently, combining both signals in EmoBoost enhances the average cross-manipulation generalization AUC by 2.1% on FakeAVCeleb.

AI.tldr: 该研究提出利用高层语义线索（情绪）弥补传统低层特征检测方法在泛化能力上的不足，通过构建Emo-Boost多模态框架融合情绪检测与RGB/声学检测，实现了对未见深度伪造类型检测性能的提升。
AI.motivation: 深度伪造技术不断演进，新生成方法持续涌现，针对每种操纵技术收集训练数据不切实际，导致模型泛化能力不足成为深度伪造检测领域的核心挑战。
AI.method: 提出Emo-Boost多模态深度伪造检测框架，融合RGB/声学低层检测器与情绪检测器EmoForensics。EmoForensics利用视觉和音频情绪识别模块，对视听流中的情绪表示进行模态内和模态间的时间一致性建模。
AI.result: 在FakeAVCeleb数据集上，Emo-Boost相比单一方法平均跨操纵泛化AUC提升2.1%，验证了情绪检测与低层特征检测的信号具有互补性。
AI.conclusion: Emo-Boost通过融合情绪语义线索与低层特征检测方法，成功实现了对未见过的深度伪造类型的泛化能力提升，在FakeAVCeleb数据集上跨操纵泛化AUC平均提升2.1%，证明了高层语义线索与低层方法之间的互补性。

title: TEMPO: Temporal Enforcement via Mode-Separated Policy Optimization for Trustworthy LLM Backtesting
summary: Backtesting large language models on historical events requires reasoning exclusively from information available before a specified cutoff date. Yet models routinely leak post-cutoff knowledge from pre-training into their reasoning, inflating apparent accuracy and undermining evaluation validity. Prompt-based constraints fail when suppressed content is causally related to the prediction, and knowledge unlearning cannot address this problem because temporal compliance is instance-specific: the same fact may be legitimate evidence for one cutoff date and a violation for another. Rather than erasing knowledge, the model must learn temporal discipline: selecting evidence conditioned on each instance's cutoff date. We propose TEMPO (Temporal Enforcement via Mode-separated Policy Optimization), which trains this discipline via two contributions: (1) a two-mode reward where a leakage mode drives post-cutoff claims to zero as a hard prerequisite before a performance mode optimizes task performance; and (2) a GRPO-based training pipeline that enables the model to discover temporally valid reasoning strategies. We prove that training monotonically decreases leakage, converges to the leak-free optimum, and improves task performance once compliance is achieved. On three prediction tasks and two models, TEMPO reduces leakage from 2~13% to 0.6~3.7% across all conditions, with task performance improving 6~13% where strong pre-cutoff signals exist and maintained where the prediction task is inherently difficult from valid information alone.

AI.tldr: TEMPO是一种解决LLM时序泄漏问题的新训练方法，通过双模式奖励机制（先消除泄漏、再优化性能）和GRPO训练流程，使模型学会基于实例截断日期选择合法证据，在保持时序合规的同时提升预测表现。
AI.motivation: 大型语言模型在历史事件回测评估中会从预训练数据中泄露后截断日期的知识，导致评估准确性虚高，评估有效性受损。现有方法（基于提示的约束和知识遗忘）无法解决此问题，因为时序合规具有实例特异性：同一事实对于不同截断日期可能分别是合法证据或违规内容。
AI.method: TEMPO提出双模式奖励机制：(1)泄漏模式作为硬约束，将后截断日期信息的使用推向零；(2)性能模式在合规达成后才优化任务表现。采用GRPO(Group Relative Policy Optimization)训练管道，使模型能够自主发现符合时序约束的推理策略。理论证明训练过程单调减少泄漏并收敛至无泄漏最优解。
AI.result: 在三个预测任务和两个模型上的实验表明：泄漏率从2%~13%降至0.6%~3.7%；任务性能在存在强前截断信号时提升6%~13%，在仅靠有效信息难以预测时保持稳定。
AI.conclusion: TEMPO通过两阶段训练实现了有效的时序合规性，在消除泄漏的同时保持或提升任务性能。该方法为LLM评估的时序完整性提供了可证明收敛的理论保证和实证验证。核心价值在于将"知识擦除"问题转化为"时序纪律学习"，解决了实例级时序合规的难题。

title: ContextRAG: Extraction-Free Hierarchical Graph Construction for Retrieval-Augmented Generation
summary: Graph-structured retrieval-augmented generation (RAG) systems can improve answer quality on multi-hop questions, but many current systems rely on large language models (LLMs) to extract entities, relations, and summaries during indexing. These calls add token and wall-clock costs that grow with corpus size. We present ContextRAG, a graph RAG system whose graph topology is constructed without LLM-based entity or relation extraction. ContextRAG derives a fuzzy concept graph over chunk embeddings using residual-quantization k-means and Formal Concept Analysis with Lukasiewicz residuated logic. Bridge-like and meet-derived context nodes are induced by soft fuzzy join and meet operations, rather than by LLM-written graph edges. On a 130-task UltraDomain subset, ContextRAG builds its index with 30 LLM calls and 22,073 tokens. In contrast, a local HiRAG reproduction stress test required 870 indexing calls and 3.54M tokens on a 20-task subset before failing during graph construction; linear extrapolation to 130 tasks implies over 23M indexing tokens. ContextRAG obtains 33.6% F1 overall and 36.8% F1 on multi-hop tasks. An activation analysis shows that queries retrieving at least one lattice-derived node in the top five achieve +3.9 percentage points F1 over queries that do not; this association is diagnostic rather than causal.

AI.tldr: ContextRAG是一种无需LLM提取实体/关系即可构建图拓扑的图RAG系统，使用残差量化k-means和形式概念分析（Lukasiewicz逻辑）构建模糊概念图。在130任务UltraDomain子集上仅需30次LLM调用和22,073 tokens，远优于需要大量LLM调用的传统方法。
AI.motivation: 当前图结构RAG系统依赖LLM进行实体提取、关系提取和摘要，导致索引阶段token成本和时钟时间成本随语料库规模增长而显著增加。
AI.method: ContextRAG通过残差量化k-means和形式概念分析（Lukasiewicz残差逻辑）在chunk嵌入上构建模糊概念图；通过软模糊连接和meet操作诱导桥接节点和meet派生上下文节点，而非LLM生成的图边。
AI.result: 在130任务UltraDomain子集上，ContextRAG索引仅需30次LLM调用和22,073 tokens；HiRAG在20任务子集上需870次调用和3.54M tokens（且失败），外推至130任务需超23M tokens。ContextRAG整体F1达33.6%，多跳任务F1达36.8%。检索到lattice派生节点的查询F1提升+3.9个百分点。
AI.conclusion: 无需LLM提取实体/关系即可构建有效的图RAG系统；模糊概念分析与形式概念分析的结合为低成本图索引提供了可行路径；lattice派生上下文节点对多跳问答具有诊断价值。

title: When Tabular Foundation Models Meet Strategic Tabular Data: A Prior Alignment Approach
summary: Tabular foundation models based on pretrained prior-data fitted networks~(PFNs) have shown strong generalization on diverse tabular tasks, but they are typically designed for \emph{non-strategic} settings where data distributions are independent of deployed classifiers. In many real-world decision scenarios, however, individuals may strategically modify their features after deployment to obtain favorable outcomes, inducing a post-deployment distribution shift. This paper studies whether PFN-style tabular foundation models can generalize to such \emph{strategic} tabular data. We show that strategic manipulation creates a mismatch between the non-strategic prior learned during pretraining and the post-manipulation strategic prior, which leads to systematic prediction bias. To address this issue, we propose \textbf{Strategic Prior-data Fitted Network}~\textit{(SPN)}, an inference-time strategy-aware framework that adapts tabular foundation models to strategic environments without retraining. SPN constructs strategic in-context examples to approximate post-manipulation inputs and aligns PFN predictions with the induced strategic distribution. Experiments on real-world and synthetic tabular datasets show that SPN consistently improves robustness and predictive performance under strategic manipulation compared with both tabular foundation models and classical tabular methods.

AI.tldr: 本文研究了PFN风格表格基础模型在战略环境中的泛化能力，揭示了战略操纵如何导致预训练分布与实际部署分布不匹配，进而提出SPN框架，通过构建战略上下文示例在推理时自适应调整PFN预测，无需重训练即可适应战略环境。
AI.motivation: 现有PFN模型基于非战略假设设计，但实际场景中个体可能在部署后策略性地修改特征以获取有利结果，导致后验分布偏移，造成系统性预测偏差。
AI.method: SPN constructs strategic in-context examples to approximate post-manipulation inputs and aligns PFN predictions with the induced strategic distribution through inference-time adaptation.
AI.result: SPN在真实和合成表格数据上均优于基线PFN模型和经典表格方法，显著提升战略操纵环境下的鲁棒性和预测性能。
AI.conclusion: SPN successfully bridges the gap between non-strategic pretraining and strategic deployment, enabling tabular foundation models to maintain robustness against feature manipulation without costly retraining.

title: TERGAD: Structure-Aware Text-Enhanced Representations for Graph Anomaly Detection
summary: Graph Anomaly Detection (GAD) aims to identify atypical graph entities, such as nodes, edges, or substructures, that deviate significantly from the majority. While existing text-rich approaches typically integrate structural context into the data representation pipeline using raw textual features, they often neglect the structural context of nodes. This limitation hinders their ability to detect sophisticated anomalies arising from inconsistencies between a node's inherent content and its topological role. To bridge this gap, we propose TERGAD (Structure-aware Text-enhanced Representations for Graph Anomaly Detection), A novel data augmentation framework that enriches structural semantics for GAD via the semantic reasoning capabilities of Large Language Models (LLMs). Specifically, TERGAD translates node-level topological properties into descriptive natural language narratives, which are subsequently processed by an LLM to derive high-level semantic embeddings. These embeddings are then adaptively fused with original node attributes through a gated dual-branch autoencoder to jointly reconstruct both graph structure and node features. The anomaly score is computed based on the integrated reconstruction error, effectively capturing deviations in both observable attributes and LLM-informed semantic expectations. Extensive experiments on six real-world datasets demonstrate that TERGAD consistently outperforms state-of-the-art baselines. Furthermore, our ablation studies validate the indispensable role of structural semantic guidance and the efficacy of the gated fusion mechanism. Code is available at https://github.com/Kantorakitty/TERGAD-main.

AI.tldr: TERGAD是一种利用大语言模型增强图异常检测结构语义的框架，通过将拓扑属性转化为自然语言描述并生成语义嵌入，结合门控双分支自编码器实现结构与特征的联合重建，在多数据集上验证了有效性。
AI.motivation: 现有文本增强方法虽然将结构上下文整合到数据表示管道中，但通常忽视了节点的结构上下文。这限制了它们检测由节点内在内容与其拓扑角色之间不一致所产生的复杂异常的能力。
AI.method: TERGAD工作流程包括：(1) 将节点级拓扑属性翻译为描述性自然语言叙事；(2) 利用LLM处理这些叙事生成高级语义嵌入；(3) 通过门控双分支自编码器自适应融合嵌入与原始节点属性；(4) 联合重建图结构和节点特征；(5) 基于综合重建误差计算异常分数。
AI.result: 在六个真实世界数据集上，TERGAD一致性地优于最先进的基线方法。消融实验验证了结构语义指导的不可或缺性以及门控融合机制的有效性。
AI.conclusion: TERGAD proposes a novel data augmentation framework that leverages LLMs to enrich structural semantics for graph anomaly detection. The framework uses gated dual-branch autoencoders to fuse LLM-derived semantic embeddings with original node attributes, achieving state-of-the-art performance on six datasets. Ablation studies confirm the critical importance of structural semantic guidance and the gated fusion mechanism.

title: Pseudocode-Guided Structured Reasoning for Automating Reliable Inference in Vision-Language Models
summary: Vision-Language Models (VLMs) are becoming the cornerstone of high-level reasoning for robotic automation, enabling robots to parse natural language commands and perceive their environments. However, their susceptibility to hallucinations introduces critical failures in decision-making, posing significant safety and reliability risks in physical deployments. This challenge is exacerbated by the open-ended nature of real-world tasks, where questions vary vastly in difficulty and modality, demanding robust and adaptable reasoning strategies. To tackle this, we propose the Pseudocode-guided Structured Reasoning framework (PStar), which adaptively selects structured pseudocode reasoning paths to help VLMs perform flexible and step-by-step reasoning. We first design a set of abstract reasoning functions and formulate a structured pseudocode library to represent modular reasoning strategies. Crucially, we design a Difficulty Feature Vector (DFV) that allows the model to assess question complexity and adaptively choose appropriate reasoning strategies-enhancing robustness and interpretability. Extensive experiments demonstrate that PStar significantly reduces hallucination rates, achieving state-of-the-art scores of 87.1% on POPE and 68.0% on MMStar, outperforming even GPT-4V. By providing a validated mechanism to reduce visual-language errors, PStar offers a critical step toward deploying more trustworthy and deterministic VLMs for real-world automated systems, where such errors can lead to catastrophic outcomes.

AI.tldr: PStar是一个伪代码引导的结构化推理框架，通过难度特征向量自适应选择推理策略，显著降低VLMs幻觉率，在视觉语言基准测试中达到领先性能，为真实世界机器人自动化部署提供更可靠、可解释的VLMs。
AI.motivation: 视觉-语言模型(VLMs)虽然成为机器人自动化的核心推理引擎，但其容易产生幻觉(hallucinations)导致决策失败，在现实物理部署中存在重大安全和可靠性风险。此外，现实世界任务的开放性使得问题难度和模态差异巨大，需要稳健且适应性强的推理策略。
AI.method: PStar框架通过三个核心设计实现：首先设计抽象推理函数库，其次构建结构化伪代码库表示模块化推理策略，最后设计难度特征向量(DFV)来评估问题复杂度并自适应选择合适的推理策略，使VLMs能够进行灵活且逐步的推理。
AI.result: PStar显著降低了幻觉率，在POPE上达到87.1%、在MMStar上达到68.0%的SOTA分数，性能超过GPT-4V。
AI.conclusion: PStar provides a validated mechanism to reduce visual-language errors, representing a critical step toward deploying more trustworthy VLMs in real-world robotic automation where hallucinations can lead to catastrophic outcomes.

title: First-Passage Prediction of Grokking Delay: ACalibrated Law under AdamW with Causal Validation
summary:
We give the first quantitative prediction of grokking delay under AdamW. Treating the delay as a first-passage time, we derive a closed-form law T_grok - T_mem = (1 / 2 kappa_LL eta lambda) log(V_mem / V_star), where V_t = ||theta_t||^2 is the squared parameter norm, V_star is an architecture-dependent threshold, and kappa_LL absorbs the AdamW correction to the clean-SGD contraction rate 2 eta lambda. Calibrating (kappa_LL, V_star) on a single hyperparameter cell predicts grokking delays on 26 held-out runs with MAPE 17.7% over a 41x delay range; the law generalises to MLPs (MAPE 18.0%, N=34) and degrades to 23.3% on cross-task extension (N=46, 43.5x range), with a structured residual in which V_star / V_mem stays comparatively stable within architecture (CV about 14% on the 1L transformer).
  First-passage of V_t is necessary but not sufficient. A quantile-margin theorem establishes that positive delay requires both norm separation V_mem > V_post and angular reachability of a threshold alpha_star = arcsin(C / V_T_mem^(1/2)), where C is computable from the empirical NTK feature map and the validation-margin quantile. Calibrating C on modulus p=89 predicts alpha_star = 47.2 degrees at p=97 (observed 47.8 degrees, error 1.3%) as a prior cross-cell prediction. Causal interventions that freeze the norm or remove weight decay at memorisation eliminate grokking (0/6 vs. 3/3 baseline), trapping the angular displacement near 12 degrees.
  kappa_LL is empirically measured per architecture rather than derived from (beta_1, beta_2, epsilon); within-architecture CV stays at most 15% across four architectures, but values differ by about 2x between architectural variants beyond depth alone. Empirical scope is algorithmic tasks (modular arithmetic, sparse parity) under AdamW; whether the law transfers to natural-language scale models is open.

AI.tldr: 本文给出首个针对 AdamW 的 grokking 延迟（grokking delay）定量预测：将 T_grok − T_mem 视为参数平方范数 V_t=‖θ_t‖² 的首次穿越（first-passage）时间，推导出闭式定律 T_grok − T_mem ≈ (1/(2κ_LL·η·λ))·log(V_mem/V_star)，其中 κ_LL 是 AdamW 相对干净 SGD 收缩率 2ηλ 的经验修正因子、V_star 是架构相关的范数阈值。在单一超参元胞上标定 (κ_LL, V_star) 后，可预测 26 条留出运行的延迟，MAPE 17.7%（覆盖 41× 延迟范围），跨架构 18.0%（N=34），跨任务 23.3%（N=46，43.5× 范围），接近单元格内约 20% 的随机噪声底。进一步提出"范数–方向联合必要性"定理（量化边缘分位 + NTK 线性化 + 齐次性），给出角阈值 α* = arcsin(C/V_Tmem^{1/2})，并以 p=89 标定 C 后对 p=97 做出先验预测（47.2° vs 实测 47.8°，误差 1.3%）。因果消融（冻结范数 / 去掉权重衰减）使 grokking 完全消失（0/6 对 3/3 基线），角位移被卡在约 12°，远低于 α*≈47°。结论：grokking 延迟是 (V_t, α_t) 联合空间中的几何穿越问题，径向收缩是较慢的速率限制轴。
AI.motivation: 核心问题：grokking（从记忆到泛化的延迟相变）在标准优化器 AdamW 下何时发生、延迟多久、机制是否具有因果性。此前的文献或只回答"是否发生"（Power 2022；Lyu 2024；Mohamadi 2024；Varma 2023；Merrill 2023），或只刻画记忆后动力学（Boursier et al. 2025 的两阶段梯度流；Muşat et al. 2025 的受约束 ℓ2 范数最小化；Prieto et al. 2025 的径向朴素损失最小化方向），或只从早期训练振荡做定性预测（Notsawo et al. 2023）而不给延迟量级；并发的 Truong et al. (2026) 给出的是 SGD 下记忆后流形状的 log-scaling，缺少可观测量的定量预测、校准与因果检验。已有工作也未回答"范数分离"（V_mem > V_post）这一记忆后机制的必要性（Liu et al. 2023 仅作经验相关），更未把角度方向作为独立轴纳入分析。本文主张：把延迟当作首次穿越时间来处理，可得到可操作的闭式定律，并在标准优化器下对延迟本身做出定量预测。
AI.method: 理论与实证方法如下。(1) 观测量的选择：以参数平方范数 V_t=‖θ_t‖² 为"保速率"的可观测量（Lemma 1：d log V_t/dt 与 d log D_t/dt 仅差 O(ε_t)，故可由 log V_t 拟合恢复收缩率），以 α_t=arccos(⟨θ_t,θ_Tmem⟩/(‖θ_t‖‖θ_Tmem‖)) 为角度轴。(2) 命题 1–2（重述 SGD+WD 的梯度流结果为离散可操作形式）：在小梯度区间（Assumption 4: ‖∇L‖≤c₁ηλ‖θ‖, c₁<1）下，V_{t+1}=(1−ηλ)²V_t+R_t, |R_t|≤Cη²λV_t，给出 log V 的每步递减 −2ηλ(1+O(η)) 与首次到达目标范数的上/下界，从而 Θ(log(V_mem/V_target)/(ηλ))；Corollary 1 由 V_mem ≤ V_post 推出不存在正延迟。(3) 定义 AdamW 经验修正因子 κ_LL=|r_empirical|/(2ηλ)（对 log V_t 最小二乘拟合斜率），代入得预测律（Method B，仅需早期可观测量 V_mem 与标定常数）。(4) Theorem 1（联合范数–方向必要性）：在 Assumption 1–6（T_mem 处的经验 NTK 线性化 ε_lin、近似正齐次 ε_hom）下，用边缘分位论证给出 α* = arcsin((M_{qΔ}−2(ε_lin+ε_hom))/(G·V_Tmem^{1/2}))，等价 sin α* = C/V_Tmem^{1/2}，C:=M_{qΔ}/G_eff。(5) 实验：1 层/2 层 Transformer、MLP，模加、模乘、稀疏奇偶任务；AdamW 全批量，扫 η∈[1e−4,2e−3]、λ∈[0.01,2]、p∈{53,67,89,97,113}，共约 103 条轨迹；标定在头条元胞 (η=1e−3, λ=1, p=97) 一次完成，再在留出单元格上评估（Method A 用 ρ=log(V_mem/V_post) 的基线 vs Method B 的架构级 V_star 门控）；留一交叉验证稳定性。(6) 因果干预 Block F：F1 基线、F2 在 T_mem 处整体缩放 θ←0.9θ、F3 逐步投影冻结 ‖θ‖、F4 将 weight_decay 置零，各 3 seed。(7) 跨单元格角轴验证 Block H（12 元胞×3 seed=36 run）与 Kosson 形式 V_t=V∞+A·exp(−r_kos t) 重拟合、越冲（overshoot）动力学分析。
AI.result: 预测律：标定 κ_train=0.252、V*_train=2501 后，Method B 在 Tier-1 超参留出（N=26，41× 延迟范围）MAPE 17.7%，Tier-2 跨架构 1L→MLP（N=34）18.0%，Tier-3 跨任务尺度（N=46，43.5×）23.3%；对照 Method A（需事后 V_post）为 32.8%/34.3%/37.4%。Tier-1 误差已达单元格内随机底（CV(T_grok)≈20%），LOOCV 显示 V* 波动约 6.0%、κ 约 7.4%。残差是结构化的：V* 本身跨单元格 CV≈24%（p=53 为 1203、p=113 为 3345），而归一化比 V*/V_mem 在架构内稳定（1L：0.195±0.027, CV≈14%，15 元胞；MLP：0.272±0.012, CV≈4%），跨架构差约 40%，提示 V*≈c(arch)·V_mem 的精细化标定方向；最大误差集中在 p=53（67%）。κ_LL：1 层 0.24（pooled CV 27%，within-cell 中位 CV 14%，N=39），MLP 0.21（N=9），paper-2L 0.370±0.056（N=29），alt-2L（LayerNorm+bias）0.175±0.018（N=30），within-arch CV≤15%，跨架构差约 2×，p<1e−9 显著；AdamW 收缩比干净 SGD 慢约 4×。Kosson 分解 κ_LL=f_window·κ_kos：κ_kos=0.668±0.041（CV 6.2%，R²=0.994，优于 log 线性 R²=0.980），但 f_window 跨架构 CV 29.2%（0.19–0.62）——作者明确披露的"零结果"，说明架构依赖被重新定位而非消除。角轴：Block H 中 α* 均值 52.8°±7.9°（CV 15%），τ_V/τ_α=0.278±0.049（CV 17.5%，方向受限）；C 在 p-sweep 上 CV 1.7%，以 p=89 标定预测 p=97 的 α*=47.2°（实测 47.8°，误差 1.3%），以 p=53 预测 p=113 得 43.5° vs 44.3°；α* 随 p 单调下降（幂律 p^{-0.71}, R²=0.985，bootstrap CI 宽），终角 α_final≈79°（CV 3.1%）几乎不变。因果结果：F3 范数冻结 0/3、F4 去权重衰减 0/3（合计 0/6），α_final 分别为 13.1°/10.4°（≈12°≪α*≈47°），F1 3/3 grok；F2 缩放使 V 瞬降 19% 却几乎不改变延迟（配对中位 +80 步，95% CI [−353,+419]），"F2 悖论"说明幅度本身不足够、角度轴仍需自身演化时间（但 N=3 只排除 ≥30% 变化）。任务层面：模乘复现 κ=0.23；稀疏奇偶出现范数反转 V_post>V_mem、延迟为 0，与 Corollary 1 一致；同超参下 vanilla SGD 3/3 无法记忆（train_acc 上限 1.9% vs 随机 1.0%），属前提条件违反而非命题违反（仅 1 组配置）。2 层 transformer 中约 31% 种子越过 V* 后下冲再回长，额外延迟/延迟 0.95 = 0.025·ρ_drop^{−5.51}（R²=0.87），使 T_grok^{0.99} 呈双峰；以 T_grok^{0.95} 为目标时该架构 MAPE 15.1%。
AI.conclusion: 核心结论：grokking 延迟在 AdamW 下可视为 (V_t, α_t) 联合空间中的首次穿越问题——V_t 以速率 2κ_LLηλ 向架构相关阈值 V* 收缩，而泛化还需方向达到角阈值 α*，二者同时满足才发生 grokking；径向收缩是较慢、速率限制的轴。延迟定律在单一元胞一次标定即可跨超参（MAPE 17.7%）外推，跨架构仅轻微退化，跨任务尺度的剩余误差集中于小 p 单元格且残差结构化（V*/V_mem 比值稳定）。机制上，Theorem 1 给出"范数分离 + 角可达性"的联合必要性，因果干预确认权重衰减驱动的收缩是 grokking 的必要环节，F2 的近零效应进一步排除"仅幅度"的解释。本文的定位是给 AdamW（而非 SGD）提供带可观测量的延迟预测理论，区别于同期只刻画记忆后流形状的工作。局限与开放问题：κ_LL 仍为按架构经验测量、尚未从 (β1,β2,ε) 与架构细节（归一化位置、偏置、残差结构）第一性推导，开放问题被分解为 κ_kos 的推导与 f_window 的刻画；Theorem 1 依赖 T_mem 处的线性化（ε_lin ≤1450，约 logit 量级的 1.5%）与最坏情形 Cauchy–Schwarz 界，结构化扰动下 α* 可能偏保守；实证范围限于算法性任务（模运算、稀疏奇偶），能否迁移到自然语言规模模型尚未验证；F2 仅 N=3、SGD 对照仅单一配置；α* 与 V* 的任务尺度函数形式（仅 5 个 p 值）与角轴上的因果"角度陷阱"干预仍待补充；信息论下界与统一涵盖"无范数分离"与"不满足小梯度假设"两类失败情形的定理亦留待未来工作。

title: Synthesis and Evaluation of Long-term History-aware Medical Dialogue
summary: An effective healthcare agent must be able to recall and reason over a patient's longitudinal medical history. However, the absence of datasets with realistic long-term dialogue timelines limits systematic evaluation. Real clinical text is constrained by privacy and ethics, while existing benchmarks focus on isolated interactions, failing to capture cross-session reasoning. We introduce a framework for synthesizing high-quality, long-term medical dialogues with LLMs. Our approach entails a knowledge-guided decomposition into three stages: constructing synthetic patient profiles with diverse disease and complication trajectories, generating multi-turn dialogues per encounter, and integrating them into a coherent longitudinal history dataset, MediLongChat. We establish three benchmark tasks-In-dialogue Reasoning, Cross-dialogue Reasoning, and Synthesis Reasoning-to evaluate the memory capabilities of healthcare agents. To assess data quality, we introduce a multi-dimensional evaluation framework combining vector-based metrics with LLM-as-a-judge assessments. Specifically, we define automatic measures-Faithfulness, Coherence, and Diversity-together with two LLM-based evaluations: Correctness and Realism. Benchmark experiments show that even state-of-the-art LLMs struggle with MediLongChat. These findings highlight the benchmark's applicability and underscore the need for tailored methods to advance healthcare agents.

AI.tldr: 本文提出了一个基于LLM的医疗对话合成框架，构建了MediLongChat纵向医疗对话数据集，并设计了三个基准任务评估医疗agent的记忆能力。实验表明现有LLM在该任务上仍有显著局限性。
AI.motivation: 现有医疗数据集缺乏真实的长期对话时间线用于系统性评估。真实临床文本受隐私和伦理限制，而现有基准测试仅关注孤立的交互，无法捕捉跨会话推理能力。
AI.method: 采用知识引导的三阶段分解方法：1）构建具有多样化疾病和并发症轨迹的合成患者档案；2）为每次就诊生成多轮对话；3）整合为连贯的纵向历史数据集。评估采用向量度量与LLM-as-judge结合的多维度框架，包括自动指标（Faithfulness、Coherence、Diversity）和LLM评估（Correctness、Realism）。
AI.result: 即使是最先进的LLM在MediLongChat上也表现挣扎，表明该基准测试有效暴露了当前模型在医疗记忆和推理能力方面的不足。
AI.conclusion: MediLongChat揭示了现有LLM在医疗agent长期推理方面的显著不足，强调需要开发针对性方法来增强医疗agent的性能。

title: Transforming Constraint Programs to Input for Local Search
comment: Unpublished paper accepted and presented at the Fourteenth International Workshop on Constraint Modelling and Reformulation (ModRef) in 2015
summary: Applying local search algorithms to combinatorial optimization problems is not an easy feat. Typically, human intervention is required to compile the constraints to input data for some metaheuristic algorithm. In this paper, we establish a link between symmetry properties of constraint optimization problems and local search neighborhoods, and we use this link to automatically generate neighborhoods from a constraint specification in the context of the IDP system. We evaluate the obtained neighborhoods for six classical optimization problems. The resulting observations support the viability of this technique.

AI.tldr: 本文解决了组合优化问题中局部搜索算法应用困难的问题，通过建立对称性与邻域的联系，实现了从约束规范自动生成邻域，降低了对人工干预的依赖。
AI.motivation: 将局部搜索算法应用于组合优化问题并非易事，通常需要人工干预来将约束编译为元启发式算法的输入数据。
AI.method: 建立约束优化问题的对称性性质与局部搜索邻域之间的联系，在IDP系统框架下从约束规范自动生成邻域。
AI.result: 对六个经典优化问题进行了邻域评估实验。
AI.conclusion: 实验结果表明该技术是可行的，为组合优化问题的局部搜索提供了一种自动化生成邻域的方法。

title: Towards Trust Calibration in Socially Interactive Agents: Investigating Gendered Multimodal Behaviors Generation with LLMs
summary: As Socially Interactive Agents (SIAs) become increasingly integrated into daily life, the ability to calibrate user trust to an agent's actual capabilities would help ensure appropriate usage of these agents. In this paper, we explore the capacity of Large Language Models (LLMs) to generate multimodal behaviors (verbal, vocal, gestural, and facial expression modalities) that reflect varying levels of ability and benevolence, two key dimensions of trustworthiness. We propose a novel method for automatically generating behaviors aligned with specific levels of these traits, a first step towards enabling nuanced and trust-calibrated interactions. By analyzing a large dataset of multimodal transcripts generated by LLMs, we demonstrate that GPT-5.4 is able to produce coherent behavior across different modalities (text, intonation, facial expression, and gesture). Using Random Forest feature importance analysis, we show that the generated behaviors align with theoretical expectations for ability and benevolence. However, we also find that when gender is specified in the prompt, LLMs tend to reproduce societal gender stereotypes, associating male agents' behaviors with high ability and female agents' behaviors with high benevolence. To validate our approach, we conducted a user study on Prolific using a within-subjects design. Participants perceived different levels of ability and benevolence in the generated behaviors align with the intended instructions.

AI.tldr: 本文探索了大语言模型生成多模态行为以反映信任维度（能力和善意）的能力，提出了一种自动生成方法，验证了GPT-5.4能产生连贯的多模态行为且符合理论预期，但发现模型会复制性别刻板印象，这一发现对信任校准社交智能体的设计具有重要的伦理和应用启示。
AI.motivation: 随着社交智能体日益融入日常生活，需要将用户信任校准到智能体的实际能力水平，以确保对这些智能体的适当使用。
AI.method: 提出一种自动生成多模态行为的方法，使行为与能力和善意两个信任维度的特定水平对齐；利用随机森林特征重要性分析验证行为与理论预期的一致性；通过Prolific平台进行被试内设计的用户研究进行验证。
AI.result: GPT-5.4能够生成跨文本、语调、面部表情和手势等模态的一致行为；生成的行为符合能力与善意的理论预期；但当提示中指定性别时，LLM倾向于复制社会性别刻板印象，将男性智能体行为与高能力关联，女性智能体行为与高善意关联；用户研究验证了参与者能感知到生成行为中不同水平的能力和善意。
AI.conclusion: LLMs能够生成反映能力和善意水平的连贯多模态行为，为信任校准的社交互动奠定基础；但需警惕模型在性别指定时复制社会刻板印象，这需要在实际应用中加以约束和引导。

title: Transformers Linearly Represent Highly Structured World Models
summary: Do transformers, when trained on sequential reasoning traces, build internal models of the underlying task? And if so, does the structure of those internal representations mirror the structure of the domain? We train an 8-layer transformer on Sudoku solving traces and perform a mechanistic analysis of its internal computation. We establish two results. First, the model builds a substructure world model: it does not represent the board state cell by cell, as a human analyst would expect, but organizes information around the rows, columns, and boxes that Sudoku's constraints act on. Second, we identify a naked-single circuit: a small set of dedicated neurons in the final MLP layer, each individually detecting when exactly one digit remains possible for a specific cell, and reliably promoting that digit. These findings show that the geometry of an emergent world model is shaped by the constraint algebra of the domain, not its surface presentation, and that the resulting decision circuit is sparse, monosemantic, and fully interpretable. More broadly, they demonstrate that mechanistic interpretability tools can recover an end-to-end algorithmic account of how a transformer solves a combinatorial reasoning task.

AI.tldr: 该论文通过对8层Transformer在Sudoku求解轨迹上的训练，揭示了Transformer内部计算的机制。核心发现：(1) 模型构建的世界模型结构与Sudoku约束代数一致（按行列宫组织），而非按表面呈现的格子形式；(2) 识别出"裸单格(naked-single)电路"——MLP层中每个专用神经元独立检测特定单元格的唯一可能数字。这些结果表明，Transformer的内部表示几何结构由领域约束代数塑造，决策电路呈现稀疏、单义、完全可解释的特性，机制可解释性可恢复组合推理任务的端到端算法。
AI.motivation: 理解Transformer在序列推理任务中是否建立内部世界模型，以及其表示结构是否反映底层任务结构。
AI.method: 机制分析（Mechanistic Analysis）：对8层Transformer进行因果追踪分析，通过激活干预和神经元消融实验定位功能组件。
AI.result: 1）模型以行、列、宫为组织单元而非逐单元格表示棋盘状态；2）发现"裸单格电路"——MLP层中一小群专用神经元，每个神经元独立检测特定格子的唯一可能数字。
