AI.conclusion: Transformer的几何结构由领域的约束代数塑造，而非表面呈现；决策电路是稀疏、单义且完全可解释的。机制可解释性工具可恢复变换器解决组合推理任务的端到端算法解释。

title: Chunking German Legal Code
summary: This paper investigates chunking strategies for retrieval-augmented generation on German statutory law, using the German Civil Code as a structured benchmark corpus. We implement and compare a range of segmentation approaches, including structural units (sections, subsections, sentences, propositions), fixed-size windows, contextual chunking, semantic clustering, Lumber-style chunking, and RAPTOR-based hierarchical retrieval. All methods are evaluated on a legal question-answering dataset with section-level gold labels, measuring recall, query latency, index build time, and storage requirements. Results show that chunking strategies aligned with the inherent legal structure - particularly section and subsection - based retrieval-achieve the highest recall, while more complex approaches that override this structure perform worse. These simpler methods also offer favorable computational efficiency compared to LLM-intensive techniques such as contextual chunking, RAPTOR, and Lumber. The findings highlight a key trade-off between semantic enrichment and operational cost, and demonstrate that preserving domain-specific structure is critical for effective legal information retrieval.

AI.tldr: 本研究评估了多种文本分块策略在德国制定法检索增强生成中的应用，发现与法律内在结构对齐的分块方法（如按章节、条款分块）在召回率和计算效率上均优于复杂的语义分块技术。
AI.motivation: 检索增强生成（RAG）在法律领域的应用面临文档结构化分割的挑战，现有方法往往忽略法律文本的内在层级结构，导致检索精度与计算成本之间的权衡不明确。
AI.method: 使用《德国民法典》作为基准语料库，实现并对比了7种分块策略：结构分块（章节/条款/句子/命题）、固定窗口分块、上下文分块、语义聚类、Lumber分块和RAPTOR层次检索，评估指标包括召回率、查询延迟、索引构建时间和存储开销。
AI.result: 与法律结构对齐的分块方法（特别是章节和条款级）获得最高召回率，而覆盖原结构的方法表现更差；结构分块在计算效率上也优于LLM密集型方法（如上下文分块、RAPTOR、Lumber）。
AI.conclusion: 在法律信息检索中，保持领域特定结构比语义富集更重要，需在语义丰富性与运营成本之间权衡。

title: Projecting Latent RL Actions: Towards Generalizable and Scalable Graph Combinatorial Optimization
summary: Graph combinatorial optimization (GCO) has attracted growing interest, as many NP-hard problems naturally admit graph formulations, yet their combinatorial explosion renders exact methods computationally intractable. Recent advances in Reinforcement Learning (RL) combined with Graph Neural Networks (GNNs) have significantly improved learning-based GCO solvers. However, existing approaches face limitations in both generalization across diverse graph instances and computational scalability as action spaces grow. To address both challenges, we introduce projection agents, a novel RL-GCO approach that operates directly in a continuous GNN-based action embedding space, predicting a desired latent action in a single forward pass and subsequently decoding it into a valid discrete action. Additionally, we enable fair comparison across RL methods through a shared embedding space for both observations and actions. Across diverse benchmarks, our approach achieves up to 16.2x faster inference and up to 40% better generalization than existing solutions using only simple nearest-neighbor decoding, while opening the door to strong RL performance in super-linear decision spaces with multiple interdependent variables. Finally, we release LaGCO-RL, a Python library that automates latent action-space construction and supports existing RL-GCO solutions, promoting reproducibility and adaptation to new GCO benchmarks.

AI.tldr: 本文提出“投影智能体（projection agents）”：把图组合优化（GCO）的强化学习动作空间从离散索引改为连续的 GNN 嵌入空间（受 Wolpertinger 架构启发）。策略在单次前向传播中输出一个“期望动作嵌入”（proto-action），再通过最近邻（k-NN）解码为合法离散动作。作者同时提出自监督图自编码器（GAE）以构建观测—动作共享嵌入空间，并开源 LaGCO-RL 库以自动化潜在动作空间构造。arXiv 全文版报告：推理最多加速 6.41×，未见实例上的泛化最多提升 75%（注意：列表页摘要写的是 16.2× 与 40%，与正文数字不一致）。
AI.motivation: 图组合优化（GCO）中的许多 NP-hard 问题可自然建模为图，但组合爆炸使精确求解不可行。基于 GNN+RL 的学习方法存在两大瓶颈：(1) 泛化性——离散动作空间下动作语义与具体实例绑定（同一索引在不同图中指向不同实体），且缺乏置换不变性，策略难以跨图迁移；(2) 可扩展性——迭代式 Q 值方法（如 S2V-DQN）需对每个候选动作做一次 DNN 前向，成本随动作数增长；而真实业务任务（OSPF、流量工程、虚机放置）的动作空间随图规模超线性增长（路径类决策呈指数级），在通信网络等动态、时延敏感场景下难以承受。同时，现有 RL-GCO 基准（TSP、最小顶点覆盖）决策变量单一、动作空间线性，与真实任务复杂度差距明显。另一个动机是方法学上的：现有 RL-GCO 方案缺乏统一的观测/动作表征，难以公平比较不同策略参数化。
AI.method: 1）问题形式化：将 GCO 写为自回归 MDP，图 G=(V,E,V_f,E_f)，决策空间 C(G) 为可采纳的图子结构集合（节点、边、路径、诱导子图、边的组合），目标 min F(G,S) s.t. H(G,S)≤0，奖励由 F 的增量给出并做 min-max 相对归一化以缓解稀疏奖励。2）自监督表征学习：预训练多任务头图自编码器（GAE），联合重建节点特征、边特征与邻接矩阵（按类型分头：MSE / BCE / 交叉熵 / 对比损失），训练数据由随机合法动作采样得到的轨迹构成以覆盖图结构演化；收敛后丢弃解码器、保留编码器。3）连续潜在空间：观测由 K 个置换不变的图聚合算子（mean/sum/max/min 加手工统计量）拼接构成；动作由组件嵌入 h(c_i)=Φ_comp(z_j) 与 Φ_act 聚合，并可拼接任务相关属性编码 ψ(α)（如 BERT 文本嵌入、one-hot 权重），从而支持“节点+边+路径”式的超线性/多变量依赖动作。4）投影智能体：潜在动作空间 U 经归一化/降维与经验边界估计后对齐到 gym.Box；策略输出目标嵌入 ã_t，通过 k-NN（FAISS Flat Index，余弦相似度）检索候选动作集 A_k(o_t)，再以 NN 或学习式打分选出最终动作；解码将连续空间划分为区域，梯度作用于区域几何而非单个动作。5）框架/库：LaGCO-RL 基于 Stable-Baselines3，用户只需提供 get_graphs()、_node_attributes/_edge_attributes、_observation_type、_action_type、sample_valid_action()、is_valid_action() 等少量逻辑即可自动构造动作集合（笛卡尔积+可行性过滤）与连续 Box 动作空间。基线包括离散 padding（P-）/GNN 池化（G-）编码、带/不带动作掩码（PPO 与 MaskablePPO），以及迭代式隐动作 Q 值方法（扩展 DQN/IDQN）。
AI.result: 七个基准（TSP、MinVertex、MaxCut、Placement、Cyber-Path、OSPF、Traffic），每个生成 101 个实例，在 S/M/L/V 四种训练策略下测 OOD 泛化，报告 IQM 与训练-测试差距 Δ。结论：投影法在除 TSP 外的多数基准取得最佳或并列最佳（如 OSPF 0.89–0.95、Traffic 0.79–0.85、MaxCut 0.91–0.95、Placement 0.76–0.79），且泛化差距最小（多为 -0.03~-0.12）；迭代式方法在 TSP 上最强（0.90/0.97/0.99），但随候选动作增多因需精确排序而性能下降；带掩码的离散方法次之且更稳健；在“回溯（revisiting）”交互下离散与迭代方法显著退化，投影法最稳定。推理可扩展性方面，动作选择时间随图规模的幂律拟合显示：离散 α≈0.03–0.20 最佳，投影 α≈0.17–0.73 明显优于迭代 α≈0.25–4.68（Traffic 上迭代超线性爆炸）；FAISS IVF 近似最近邻在 500 节点 TSP 上将 0.49ms/动作降至 0.40ms。外部对比上，MaxCut 中投影法（0.92–0.95）优于调优后的物理启发 GNN PI-GNN（0.91–0.92），并达到模拟退火参考的约 95%；但 TSP 上不及专用 POMO（0.81 vs 0.42–0.67）。消融显示随机嵌入显著更差、原始节点特征可部分恢复性能、GNN 嵌入最佳；GAE 损失中去除邻接矩阵重建反而提升下游性能，说明多目标存在竞争约束。训练成本上投影法最高（Traffic 上均值 7460s），高于迭代（4175s）与离散（676–2449s）。
AI.conclusion: 将 Wolpertinger 架构迁移到 GCO 的动态潜在动作空间是本文核心贡献：单次前向 + NN 解码同时获得语义化、置换/规模不变、动态动作集支持、动作插值与亚线性检索的推理特性，从而在超线性决策空间中兼顾泛化与可扩展性，并使 RL 在“路径+边”等多变量依赖问题上表现强劲。作者也坦承局限：把部分解编码进节点特征导致每步需重算 GNN；仅用最朴素的 1-NN 解码；每个动作空间只用单一编码；自监督嵌入未与策略联合微调。后续方向是解耦静态图结构与演化解状态以启用真正亚线性的 NN 索引（IVF）、引入学习式解码打分与多编码表征、以及多编码/联合微调以进一步提升上限。

title: Exact Linear Attention
summary: This paper introduces Exact Linear Attention (ELA), a mechanism that achieves linear computational complexity for Transformer attention by leveraging the exact decomposition property of kernel functions, without any approximation error. It identifies and addresses gradient explosion and token attention dilution in prior linear attention methods by imposing kernel constraints that ensure non-negativity, discriminability, and geometric interpretability. Several kernel functions are proposed, including the Hadamard Exp Kernel, Summation Squared Euclidean Distance Kernel, and Subtraction Squared Euclidean Distance Kernel. Beyond the core attention formulation, the paper presents three engineering innovations: a Hyper Link structure that replaces traditional residual connections to mitigate gradient degradation, a Memory Lobe module based on bidirectional linear attention that captures transformation flow across layers to implement qualitative memory and an implicit reinforcement learning paradigm, and a routing score based bias mechanism for Mixture of Experts to improve interpretability and semantic alignment.

AI.tldr: Exact Linear Attention (ELA) achieves linear computational complexity for Transformer attention using exact kernel decomposition without approximation error, addressing gradient explosion and attention dilution through constrained kernel functions. The method introduces three novel kernel variants and three architectural innovations (Hyper Link, Memory Lobe, and routing score bias for MoE) to improve training stability, memory retention, and interpretability.
AI.motivation: Traditional Transformer attention mechanisms have quadratic computational complexity O(n²), making them computationally expensive for long sequences. While prior linear attention methods attempted to reduce complexity to O(n), they introduced approximation errors. Additionally, these methods suffered from two critical issues: gradient explosion during training and token attention dilution where attention signals become uniformly distributed across tokens, reducing model discriminative power.
AI.method: ELA leverages the exact decomposition property of kernel functions to achieve linear attention complexity without approximation error. The method imposes specific kernel constraints to ensure non-negativity, discriminability, and geometric interpretability. Three kernel functions are proposed: Hadamard Exp Kernel, Summation Squared Euclidean Distance Kernel, and Subtraction Squared Euclidean Distance Kernel. Additionally, three engineering innovations are introduced: (1) Hyper Link structure replacing residual connections to mitigate gradient degradation, (2) Memory Lobe module using bidirectional linear attention for transformation flow and implicit reinforcement learning, and (3) routing score-based bias mechanism for Mixture of Experts to improve interpretability and semantic alignment.
AI.result: By imposing kernel constraints for non-negativity, discriminability, and geometric interpretability, ELA successfully addresses gradient explosion and token attention dilution issues. The exact decomposition of kernel functions enables linear complexity without any approximation error, while maintaining the theoretical properties necessary for stable training and effective attention mechanisms.
AI.conclusion: The proposed kernel constraints ensure non-negativity, discriminability, and geometric interpretability, enabling stable training and improved attention patterns. The three engineering innovations (Hyper Link, Memory Lobe, and routing score bias mechanism) provide complementary benefits for gradient flow, memory retention, and expert routing interpretability. The combination of exact decomposition without approximation error and these architectural enhancements positions ELA as a theoretically sound and practically effective approach to scaling Transformers.

title: LP-Eval: Rubric and Dataset for Measuring the Quality of Legal Proposition Generation
summary: Legal proposition generation is central to legal reasoning and doctrinal scholarship, yet remain under-examined in Legal NLP. This paper investigates the automatic generation and evaluation of legal propositions from decisions of the Court of Justice of the European Union using large language models (LLMs). We introduce LP-Eval, a three-step evaluation rubric co-designed with legal experts that decomposes legal proposition quality into formal validity and substantive dimensions. Using this rubric, we release a dataset of two experts' annotations for 100 LLM-generated legal propositions. Our results show that LLMs can generate predominantly well-formed and high-quality propositions, while expert evaluations reveal higher quality for propositions derived from well established cases than from recent ones. We further examine LLMs as evaluators and find that rubric-guided LLM judgments align more closely with expert assessments than direct overall scoring, but remain insensitive to finer-grained distinctions captured by human experts.

AI.tldr: This paper explores automatic generation of legal propositions from CJEU decisions using LLMs, introducing LP-Eval—a three-step expert co-designed rubric—and a dataset of 100 annotated propositions. Findings indicate LLMs generate quality propositions (especially from established cases), and rubric-guided LLM evaluation aligns better with experts than direct scoring, though still missing finer distinctions.
AI.motivation: Legal proposition generation is under-explored in Legal NLP despite being central to legal reasoning and doctrinal scholarship; need for systematic evaluation frameworks.
AI.method: LP-Eval three-step evaluation rubric (formal validity + substantive dimensions); expert annotation of 100 LLM-generated propositions; comparative analysis of LLM vs. human evaluators.
AI.result: LLMs can generate well-formed, high-quality legal propositions; quality is higher for propositions from established case law than recent cases; rubric-guided LLM evaluation outperforms direct scoring but still lags expert-level granularity.
AI.conclusion: LLM judgments guided by rubric align better with experts than direct scoring, but still miss finer-grained distinctions; expert-annotated dataset released for future research.

title: INSIGHTS: Demonstration-Based Summaries of Time Series Predictors
summary: Explainability methods have progressed rapidly, but global explanations for time-series models remain underdeveloped, with most approaches focusing on local, instance-level attributions. We introduce INSIGHTS, a model-agnostic, user-centric approach for providing global explanations of time series models. Our approach prioritizes simplicity, efficiency, and transparency in its design, ensuring that stakeholders can readily adopt its outputs. While current methods focus on local explanations, INSIGHTS generates sample summaries that offer a comprehensive overview of model behavior. It balances the importance and diversity of time series samples to create informative subsets using utility functions that capture domain-specific aspects of time series behavior, such as exceeding domain norms. We evaluate INSIGHTS through experiments, interviews, and a user study. Our results indicate INSIGHTS effectively constructs comprehensive, diverse time series subsets, producing summaries manageable for individual evaluation. It is preferred by domain experts for its ability to provide a stable understanding of model behavior and the quality of the samples identified. Moreover, user study participants presented with INSIGHTS-based summaries exhibit an enhanced understanding of the model's overall behavior.

AI.tldr: INSIGHTS是一种模型无关的时间序列全局解释方法，通过平衡样本重要性和多样性生成摘要，帮助用户理解模型整体行为优于现有局部解释方法。
AI.motivation: 可解释性方法虽发展迅速，但针对时间序列模型的全局解释仍不成熟。现有方法大多聚焦于局部实例级别的归因，缺乏对模型整体行为的全面概述。
AI.method: 提出INSIGHTS方法，一种模型无关的、以用户为中心的全局时间序列解释方法。该方法使用效用函数平衡样本的重要性和多样性，捕捉领域特定的时序行为特征（如超出领域规范），生成可管理的样本摘要供个人评估。
AI.result: INSIGHTS能有效构建全面多样的时间序列子集，生成可管理的摘要供个人评估。专家偏好该方法因其稳定性和样本质量。用户研究表明，基于INSIGHTS摘要的参与者对模型整体行为有更深入的理解。
AI.conclusion: INSIGHTS有效地为时间序列模型提供全局解释，生成综合多样的样本子集，帮助用户理解模型整体行为，是时间序列可解释性领域的重要进展。

title: STRIDE: Learnable Stepwise Language Feedback for LLM Reasoning
summary: Recent advances in Reinforcement Learning (RL) have underscored its potential for incentivizing reasoning capabilities of Large Language Models (LLMs). However, existing step-level efforts suffer from costly annotations that limit domain coverage, while scalar scores further impose an information bottleneck, offering insufficient semantic bandwidth to improve intermediate decisions. Alternative language-critique approaches, which rely on frozen or external critics, provide richer textual feedback but lack the scalability needed for sustained policy improvement. In this work, we propose language-driven stepwise trajectory redirection, termed as STRIDE, a novel training framework that shifts process supervision from scalar rewards to learnable stepwise language feedback. Specifically, we co-train a generator and a generative verifier using only outcome-based rewards, eliminating external annotations, while delivering sustained policy improvement through jointly aligned verifier training. The verifier's stepwise language critiques explicitly localize and explain failures, enabling the generator to redirect reasoning trajectories at intermediate steps toward alternative decisions. The trajectory redirection design guarantees harmless policy improvement, even under noisy or suboptimal verifier feedback. Experiments on diverse reasoning benchmarks show that STRIDE significantly outperforms state-of-the-art baselines, as well as achieving breakthroughs on zero-pass-rate problems where scalar methods yield no learning signal in our ablation studies, demonstrating the effectiveness of learnable stepwise language feedback for enhancing LLM reasoning.

AI.tldr: STRIDE是一种新型RL训练框架，通过共同训练生成器和验证器，利用可学习的逐步语言反馈替代标量奖励来重定向LLM推理轨迹，实验证明其在多种推理任务中优于现有方法。
AI.motivation: 现有RL方法在激励LLM推理方面存在局限：步骤级方法需昂贵标注、标量奖励存在信息瓶颈、语言批判方法缺乏可扩展性。
AI.method: STRIDE共同训练生成器和可学习的生成验证器，仅使用基于结果 Rewards，消除外部标注。验证器生成逐步语言批判，明确识别并解释失败，使生成器能够在中间步骤重定向推理轨迹。
AI.result: 在多种推理基准测试中显著超越先进基线，并在零通过率问题上取得突破——这些问题是标量方法无法产生任何学习信号的难题。
AI.conclusion: STRIDE通过可学习的逐步语言反馈有效增强LLM推理能力，其轨迹重定向设计保证了即使在验证器反馈存在噪声时也能实现无害的政策改进，在多种推理基准测试中显著超越先进基线方法。

title: Are Tools Always Beneficial? Learning to Invoke Tools Adaptively for Dual-Mode Multimodal LLM Reasoning
summary: Tool-augmented reasoning has emerged as a promising direction for enhancing the reasoning capabilities of multimodal large language models (MLLMs). However, existing studies mainly focus on enabling models to perform tool invocation, while neglecting the necessity of invoking tools. We argue that tool usage is not always beneficial, as redundant or inappropriate invocations largely increase reasoning overhead and even mislead model predictions. To address this issue, we introduce AutoTool, a model that adaptively decides whether to invoke tools according to the characteristics of each query. Within a reinforcement learning framework, we design an explicit dual-mode reasoning strategy with mode-specific reward functions to guide the model toward producing accurate responses. Moreover, to prevent premature bias toward a single reasoning mode, AutoTool jointly explores and balances tool-assisted and text-centric reasoning throughout training, and promotes free exploration in later stages. Extensive experiments demonstrate that AutoTool exhibits outstanding performance and high efficiency, yielding a 21.8\% accuracy gain on V* benchmark compared to the base model, and a 44.9\% improvement in efficiency over existing tool-augmented methods on POPE benchmark. Code is available at https://github.com/MQinghe/AutoTool.

AI.tldr: 本文提出AutoTool，一种在多模态大语言模型中自适应决定是否调用工具的推理框架，通过强化学习结合双模式推理策略，在保证精度的同时显著提升效率。
AI.motivation: 现有工具增强推理研究仅关注如何调用工具，却忽视了何时应调用工具。盲目调用工具会增加推理开销甚至误导预测，因此需要模型自适应决策工具使用必要性。
AI.method: 在强化学习框架下设计显式双模式推理策略（工具辅助模式与纯文本模式），并设置模式特定奖励函数；训练过程中联合探索两种模式防止过早收敛至单一模式，后期促进自由探索。
AI.result: 在V*基准上较基线模型提升21.8%准确率，在POPE基准上较现有工具增强方法提升44.9%效率。
AI.conclusion: AutoTool通过自适应决策机制实现了精度与效率的良好平衡，证明了并非所有问题都需要工具调用，适度使用工具或仅依靠文本推理可能更为高效。

title: What Really Improves Mathematical Reasoning: Structured Reasoning Signals Beyond Pure Code
summary: Code has become a standard component of modern foundation language model (LM) training, yet its role beyond programming remains unclear. We revisit the claim that code improves reasoning through controlled pretraining experiments on a 10T-token corpus with fine-grained domain separation. Our findings are threefold. First, when code is restricted to standalone executable programs and Code-NL data are controlled for, code substantially improves programming ability but does not act as a general reasoning enhancer; instead, it competes with knowledge-intensive tasks, especially complex mathematical reasoning. Second, the reasoning gains often attributed to code are better explained by cross-domain structured reasoning traces, such as code-text and math-text mixtures, rather than by executable code alone. Third, increasing the density of structured math-domain samples within a fixed math budget yields substantial gains on difficult mathematical reasoning while largely preserving programming performance, suggesting that cognitive scaffolds offer a targeted way to mitigate cross-domain trade-offs. Finally, routing analyses show that data-composition effects are reflected in expert-activation patterns, providing mechanism-level evidence for competitive and synergistic interactions across domains. Our results clarify which data characteristics transfer across capability dimensions and point to more precise data-centric optimization strategies.

AI.tldr: 本文通过10T-token语料库的受控预训练实验，揭示代码并非通用推理增强器，其对推理的提升主要源于跨域结构化推理轨迹（如代码-文本混合）而非独立可执行代码；代码与复杂数学推理存在竞争关系；增加数学样本密度可有效缓解跨域权衡；专家激活模式提供了机制层面的证据。
AI.motivation: 代码已成为大语言模型训练的标准组成部分，但代码在编程之外的作用尚不清晰。论文旨在重新验证"代码提升推理能力"这一说法，通过受控实验厘清代码对推理的真实影响机制。
AI.method: 在10T-token语料库上进行受控预训练实验，采用细粒度领域分离设计，系统比较代码、代码-文本混合、数学-文本混合等不同数据配置对模型能力的影响，并通过路由分析追踪专家激活模式。
AI.result: 当代码被限制为独立可执行程序且控制代码-自然语言混合数据后，代码仅显著提升编程能力，但并非通用推理增强器；推理能力的提升更准确地说源于跨域结构化推理轨迹；增加数学领域样本密度可在保持编程性能的同时显著提升数学推理能力；路由分析证实数据组成效应反映在专家激活模式中。
AI.conclusion: 代码本身并不能作为通用的推理增强器，而是与知识密集型任务（特别是复杂数学推理）存在竞争关系；跨域结构化推理轨迹（如代码-文本和数学-文本混合）才是推理提升的真正来源；增加数学领域样本密度可有效缓解跨域权衡；数据组成效应反映在专家激活模式中，揭示了领域间的竞争与协同机制。研究成果为更精确的数据中心优化策略提供了理论依据。

title: What Are LLMs Doing to Scientific Communication? Measuring Changes in Writing Practices and Reading Experience
summary: Has the style of scientific communication changed due to the growing use of large language models in the writing process? We address this question in the domain of Natural Language Processing by leveraging two data resources we create: a naturalistic corpus of over 37,000 papers from the ACL Anthology (2020-2024); and a synthetic dataset of 3,000 human-written passages and their LLM-generated improvements. We first implement a series of diachronic lexical analyses, showing that both word frequency and usage contexts have changed significantly over time, indicating semantic specialization in some cases and generalization in others. Broadening our perspective, we then model a range of more complex stylistic features and find that LLM-modified texts more frequently contain certain syntactic constructions, more complex and longer words and a lower lexical diversity. Finally, we connect these changes in writing practices to subjective reading experience through a pilot annotation study with 20 domain experts. They overall rate LLM-improved texts as more understandable and exciting, but also express negative qualitative attitudes towards LLMs, highlighting the strongly subjective effect of AI-assisted writing on reading experience.

AI.tldr: 研究调查了大语言模型(LLM)是否改变了学术写作风格。通过分析ACL语料库中的37,000篇论文并创建3,000个人机对比文本,发现词频和使用语境显著变化,LLM修改的文本词汇更复杂但多样性降低。专家评价表明LLM改进的文本更易理解且更有吸引力,但对AI辅助写作持负面态度。
AI.motivation: Investigate whether the growing use of LLMs in scientific writing has altered the style and characteristics of scientific communication, particularly in the NLP domain.
AI.method: Diachronic lexical analyses on 37k paper corpus; stylistic feature modeling comparing human vs LLM-modified texts; expert annotation study (n=20).
AI.result: Significant temporal changes in word frequency and usage contexts; LLM-modified texts show more complex/longer words, lower lexical diversity, and specific syntactic patterns; experts rate LLM-improved texts as more understandable and exciting, but express negative attitudes toward AI assistance.
AI.conclusion: LLM-assisted writing is changing scientific communication style; while texts are rated as more understandable and engaging, negative attitudes toward AI persist, indicating a disconnect between objective text quality improvements and subjective reading experience.

title: GroupAffect-4: A Multimodal Dataset of Four-Person Collaborative Interaction
summary: Existing affective-computing, social-signal-processing, and meeting corpora capture important parts of human interaction, but they rarely support analysis of affect in co-located groups as a coupled individual, interpersonal, and group-level process. The required signals (per-participant physiology, eye movement, audio, self-report, task outcomes, and personality) are usually fragmented across separate dataset traditions. We introduce GroupAffect-4, a multimodal corpus of 40 participants in 10 four-person groups, each completing four ecologically varied collaborative tasks spanning information pooling, negotiation, idea generation, and a public-goods game. Each participant is instrumented with a wrist-worn physiology sensor, eye-tracking glasses, and a close-talk microphone; sessions include continuous affect self-reports, post-task questionnaires, task outcomes, and Big-Five personality scores, all time-aligned to a shared clock. The dataset covers over 91% of expected physiology windows and 98% of eye-tracking windows, with strong task validity confirmed by a clear affective manipulation check across the negotiation block. We define fifteen benchmarkable targets spanning three analysis levels -- within-person state, between-person traits, and group dynamics -- and report leave-one-group-out feasibility baselines establishing the dataset's evaluative scope. GroupAffect-4 is released with a BIDS-inspired structure, Croissant metadata, a datasheet, per-session quality reports, and open processing scripts. Code and processing scripts are available at https://github.com/meisamjam/GroupAffect-4; the dataset is publicly archived at https://zenodo.org/records/20037847.

AI.tldr: GroupAffect-4 是一个面向"同处一室四人小组"情感计算的多模态数据集论文（数据集刻画型）：发布 40 名被试、10 个四人组、共 4 个结构化协作任务（T1 隐藏信息决策、T2 迷你谈判、T3 创意生成、T4 公共品博弈）的时间对齐语料，涵盖腕式生理（EmotiBit：PPG/EDA/皮温/IMU，25Hz）、第一人称眼动（Tobii Pro Glasses 3，50Hz）、近讲麦克风音频（DPA 4060，48kHz）、连续 VAD 自评（SAM）、任务后问卷与 BFI-44 人格；并定义 15 个跨三个分析层级（个体内状态 / 个体间特质 / 群体动态）的基准目标，给出留一小组交叉验证（LOGO-CV）的可行性基线。结论是：音频重叠率是心理负荷最稳健的预测因子（AUC 0.719），人格推断与群体动态指标在当前样本量下不可解，主要贡献在于同步性、模态密度与文档规范而非规模。
AI.motivation: 现有情感计算与社会信号处理语料库（IEMOCAP、RECOLA、DEAP 为单人/双人；AMI/ICSI、ELEA、GAP、UGI 有任务结构但缺少生理；AMIGOS、K-EmoCon、G-REx 有生理与情绪标注但缺眼动/任务结构；KTH-Idiap、GaMMA 有四人组眼动与近讲音频但缺生理、自评与人格）都只覆盖"个体内状态、个体间特质、群体级动态"三个层级中的一到两个，且关键信号分散在不同数据集传统中，无法在同一会话中同时观测。此外，同处一室的多人交互带来质变约束：轮次多方化、注视目标倍增、角色在一场会话内可迁移、生理反应必须在演化中的社会语境下解读。论文的动机不是规模而是"密度"——每名参与者同时被自主神经传感、第一人称眼动、近讲音频、任务结果与现场自评观测，使"生理唤醒是否追踪主观支配感""音频重叠是否独立于生理预测认知负荷"这类跨层级问题在同一时刻可被检验。论文明确定位为数据集刻画（dataset-characterisation）论文：贡献在于透明说明数据内容、模态同步方式、可评测范围与主要局限。
AI.method:
实验设计：单站点（丹麦 GN Advanced Science）约 70 分钟会话，16 场录制（前 5 场为试点不发布，11 场非试点中 10 场发布、1 场因模态覆盖不全剔除），最终 10 组 × 4 人 = 40 名唯一被试（平均年龄 35.4，SD 9.2，范围 23–58；21 女 19 男），固定顺序 T0→T1→T2→T3→T4 无反平衡；组内为陌生人（熟悉度均值 2.79，62.4% 评分为"从未见过"），座位匿名标识 P1–P4，身份映射不发布。四个任务对应不同社会-情感机制：T1 隐藏信息决策（信息池化/共识形成，10/10 组均选正确候选人 C）、T2 迷你谈判（角色卡指定议程优先级与立场，产生利益冲突与让步，10/10 组达成和解但全部超时，平均 11.4 分钟，SD 1.6）、T3  名义群体技术式创意生成（10/10 组产生获胜想法）、T4 公共品微博弈（10 token 禀赋、1.5 倍乘数、均分，组均贡献 7.05/10，SD 1.76）。
采集与同步：EmotiBit 腕式传感器（PPG/EDA/皮温/IMU，≈25Hz）；Tobii Pro Glasses 3（头部相对场景帧注视、瞳孔，50Hz）；DPA 4060 近讲麦克风经 RME Fireface 802 采集；共同 LSL 时间基，任务起止由 LSL marker 标记并写入任务窗口文件；AV 帧日志起始散布目标 <10ms；DPA 4060 硬件时钟相对 XDF/LSL 漂移约 0.04 ms/s，故按每个麦克风拟合线性时间映射而非单一全局偏移，使文档会话内任务级残余同步误差 <5ms。
标注与元数据：任务内按阶段对齐的 1–9 分 SAM 效价/唤醒/支配感探针（T4 无支配感），整体覆盖 98.8%；每任务后 1–7 分李克特问卷，含自评（投入度、心理负荷、满意度、公平感等）与对每个座位的他评（感知支配度、信任），信任构成每任务每组至多 12 条有向评分；BFI-44（40 人完整）与人口学字段。
处理与发布：BIDS 启发式目录（physiology/eye-tracking/audio-features/transcripts/beh/annotations）+ FAIR + Croissant 元数据（含 Responsible AI 字段）+ datasheet + 逐会话质量报告 + 开放处理脚本；确定性流水线，五步基准管线为 ET 质量门控（注视有效率 <50% 置空注视特征、缺失 >50% 置空瞳孔）、生理合理性门控（HR 40–180、RMSSD 10–300ms、EDA 0–25µS、瞳孔 1.5–9.0mm、音高 5–55 半音等）、±3σ 缩尾、个体内稳健 z-score（中位数/1.4826×MAD，跨 T1–T4）、折内 KNN 插补（k=5）；全局特征选择（缺失>50%、|r|>0.95 贪心剔除）后保留 35 个特征，排除 5 个 biomarker 复合特征与 4 个注释流程元特征，基准使用 31 特征。表格数据 CC BY 4.0，原始音频因声纹重识别风险置于 DUA 门控层。
基准设置：三个层级——L1 个体内状态（参与者-任务单元，n=136 行）、L2 个体间特质（参与者单元）、L3 群体动态（组-任务单元）；LOGO-CV（split key = group_id），基线为单 Ridge 回归/逻辑分类器，无时序建模与架构搜索；L1 使用个体内 z-score 特征，L2 使用生理/瞳孔 delta-from-baseline 与绝对音频特征（L2 不做 z-score，因个体内归一化会抹除被试间幅度方差）；折内插补；报告折均值、跨折 SD 与 5000 次 bootstrap 95% CI。
AI.result:
质量与覆盖：EmotiBit 观测行 182/200（91.0%），PPG/EDA/皮温可用率 76.0%/75.5%/76.0%，IMU 90.5%；Tobii 196/200（98.0%），注视/瞳孔可用率 87.2%/95.4%；音频 QC 通过率 95%（38/40 行可用，2 人被标记极少发言）；任务后问卷完整度 2254/2280（98.9%）；计划录制时长约 11.7 小时。任务效度强：T2 谈判期效价显著下降（d=1.06，p=2.4×10⁻⁹）且所有组超时，为最强操纵检验；T2 后与 T4 后群体信任均高于量表中点，协作而非对抗；T2→T4 信任变化不显著（参与者层 t(39)=1.03, p=.31；组层 t(9)=1.51, p=.165）。
基准结果（LOGO-CV）：B0 任务分类 Acc 0.641（SD 0.132，CI [0.55,0.73]）；L1 中 B3a 心理负荷最强（AUC 0.719，n=99），且单一特征 audio_overlap_fraction_x 达 0.766，超过 31 特征全模型，说明认知负荷在小组任务中主要是"话轮地板竞争"现象而非生理现象；B1a 效价中等（0.657）；B1b 唤醒（0.528）与 B2 支配感（0.499）接近随机，作者归因于探针回顾性标签与信号的时序错配及特征集限制；B3c 满意度 0.571；B3d 信任合并 0.562，限于合作情境 T4 后升至 0.679（T2 内组方差近零 SD=0.185 使折内划分近随机）。L2 人格三任务均近或低于随机（外向 0.396、开放 0.306，宜人性 0.604），但全样本 Spearman 显示 pupil_right_mean×宜人性 r=+0.51（p=0.008），故定位为"明确未解的挑战"而非无信号；B5 T4 贡献中位数切分 0.429（SD 0.290）。L3 群体动态 B6a/B6b/B7 均不优于朴素基线（B6a MAE 0.089 vs 0.086；B6b 0.102 vs 0.088；B7 0.063 vs 0.060），但 B6b 的原始说话比例标准差二分类辅助分类器达 AUC 0.952，证明信号存在而任务窗聚合丢失了逐轮地板动态、且 Ridge 在 n=28 时过拟合。
跨模态互补性：瞳孔与生理特征近乎零相关（136 个参与者-任务行上 |r|<0.10），支持多模态而非单模态基准；最强关联为音频群体重叠率与任务后心理负荷（r=−0.62，q_FDR<0.001，n=99）与瞳孔扩张与心理负荷（r=+0.36，q=0.008，n=99）。模态消融显示音频主导任务结构/认知负荷检测，瞳孔提供独立增量，生理主要贡献于唤醒敏感目标；B3a 与 B3b 的特征画像完全不同（音频重叠+HR vs 瞳孔斜率+音高），确认"负荷–投入"解离。
泄漏与偏差披露：作者明确承认三处非完全折内流程——(1) 个体内 z-score 在 LOGO 划分前计算（被试自身无监督 T1–T4 分布参与测试时归一化），使 B0–B3d 结果偏乐观；(2) 全局特征选择在划分前完成；(3) 4 个注释流程元特征若纳入会把 B0 准确率从 0.641 抬到 0.734，故保守排除。特征选择审计：全局剔除后 35 特征存活；z-score 是影响最大的一步（T2 vs T1 瞳孔 Cohen's d 从 0.28 升至 1.13）。同时说明 T0 自由交谈音频不可作为可靠基线（所有音频特征经 T0 归一化后方差均上升 1.6–9.8 倍，如 speaking_fraction SD 0.036→0.354），故 L2 保留绝对音频特征，形成模态不对称性。
AI.conclusion: GroupAffect-4 的价值在于围绕结构化小组任务的高模态密度、同步精度（L5 级）、可审计的时间溯源（事件标记、设备帧日志、sync_metadata.json）与规范化文档（BIDS 式结构、Croissant+Responsible AI 元数据、datasheet、逐会话 QC 表、开放脚本），而非样本规模或排行榜式结论。可行性基线清楚界定了评测范围：个体内状态层可支撑认知状态检测（尤其心理负荷由会话地板动态主导）；个体间特质层在当前归一化与特征设计下失败，主要原因是折内仅 4 名被试导致 AUC 估计不稳定以及个体内归一化抹除被试间幅度差异；群体动态层不可从任务窗聚合恢复，需逐轮语音活动检测事件提取与更大队列（n≥20 组）；顺序会话基准（下一说话者预测、轮次切换点检测、重叠起始预测）已定义并留待后续版本。局限包括：10 组 40 人的小样本、单站点单语言、固定任务顺序无反平衡（T4 合作结果受约 60 分钟累积协作影响）、PPG 在 25Hz 下的约 40ms RMSSD 量化下限与运动伪迹、瞳孔受光照混淆且无亮度归一化、仅提供场景帧注视（房间帧对齐延后）、多机位视频与 3D 姿态延后发布、无临床金标准。伦理方面经 GN Hearing A/S 法务部门审批并取得书面知情同意，表格数据 CC BY 4.0 开放，原始音频经 DUA 门控以防声纹重识别、声音克隆与非研究用途，禁止用于临床诊断、个人评分/心理推断、自动化人事评估与监控式部署。

title: Rethinking How to Remember: Beyond Atomic Facts in Lifelong LLM Agent Memory
summary: To enable reliable long-term interaction, LLM agents require a memory system that can faithfully store, efficiently retrieve, and deeply reason over accumulated dialogue history. Most existing methods adopt an extracted fact based paradigm: handcrafted static prompts compress raw dialogues into atomic facts, which are then stored, matched, and injected into downstream reasoning. Nevertheless, such fact-centric designs inevitably discard fine-grained details in original dialogues and fail to support deep reasoning over scattered isolated facts. Moreover, static prompts cannot maintain consistent extraction granularity across diverse dialogue styles. To address these limitations, we propose TriMem, which maintains three coexisting representation granularities, including raw dialogue segments anchored by source identifiers for storage fidelity, extracted atomic facts for efficient memory retrieval, synthesized profiles that aggregate dispersed facts into holistic semantic understanding for deep reasoning. We further adopt TextGrad-based prompt optimization, which iteratively refines extraction and profiling prompts via response quality feedback, achieving lifelong evolution without any parameter updating. Extensive experiments on LoCoMo and PerLTQA across multiple LLM backbones demonstrate that TriMem consistently outperforms strong memory baselines. The code is available at https://TMLR-TriMem.github.io .

AI.tldr: TriMem 提出「三粒度共存」的 LLM 智能体记忆架构：原始对话（保真存储）＋ 原子事实（高效检索）＋ 实体画像（深度推理），并用 TextGrad 对抽取/画像提示词做无参数更新的迭代优化；在 LoCoMo、PerLTQA、LongMemEval 上全面超越 Mem0、MemoryOS、A-Mem、LightMem、SimpleMem、xMemory 等强基线，且上下文 token 仅约 1.2k。
AI.motivation: 现有智能体记忆系统（Mem0、MemoryOS、A-Mem、LightMem、SimpleMem、xMemory 等）普遍遵循「抽取事实」范式：存储、检索、推理三阶段都以原子事实为唯一单元。论文通过系统性分析（LoCoMo 上 Hit@5 检索效率、参考答案 token 覆盖率、正确检索样本上的推理准确率）指出其三大缺陷：① 有损存储——事实抽取把冗长对话压缩为简短表述，答案 token 覆盖比原始对话多损失 14.5% 的信息（如修饰词被抹去），无法回答细节依赖型高精度问题；② 浅层推理——在检索正确的前提下，多证据（multi-evidence）问题的推理表现显著低于单证据问题，模型无法对分散事实做情绪推断、逻辑归纳与实体语义画像刻画；③ 提示词次优——静态手写抽取提示无法在高度异质的对话风格下保持一致的抽取粒度（如「25 分钟工作 5 分钟休息」有时不被识别为具名概念），导致跨说话人性能剧烈波动。据此，论文主张记忆三阶段不应被孤立地围绕同一原子事实设计，而应引入多层次且相互一致的多级表示。
AI.method:
TriMem（Tri-Granularity Memory）包含四个互相支撑的部分：

1. 稠密存储与高效检索：以滑动窗口（窗口长度 l=40、步长 s=38，重叠设计避免边界割裂）切分原始对话，用多维度 schema 提示 φ 抽取结构化事实条目 e_i=(f_restate, f_time, f_person, keywords, entities, topic,…)。关键改进是新增 f_src 维度，为每条压缩记忆绑定 source_dialogue_ids 指针，可反查原始对话片段，弥补有损压缩。
2. 检索规划：先由 agent 对问题做信息需求分析（题型、关键实体、所需信息项、关系、最少查询数），生成 1–3 条目标化搜索 query（必含原问题），再以 top-25 相似度匹配事实条目，用其索引拉取原始对话全文与相关人物画像，一并拼入推理提示。
3. 分散事实与整合画像：按 f_person 将事实分组 E_p，用画像提示 p_ψ 增量合成结构化人物画像（身份/性格/他人评价/兴趣/职业/价值观/关系/生活事件/偏好等），推理时以检索条目中的 person 标识符锚定并注入，使模型无需现场做复杂跨事实综合即可完成理解型推理。
4. 终身演化：用 TextGrad 把 (p_e, p_ψ) 视为自然语言空间中的可训练参数，以 LLM judge 的答案质量分数（兼容 F1/BLEU）为损失信号，通过「失败案例分析→资深模型给出改写建议→文本梯度应用」的反向传播式更新实现提示词持续精化，全程不改动模型参数。提示词仅在 LoCoMo 的 dialogue0/dialogue1（Qwen3-8B）上训练 4 轮后迁移到其他对话、模型与数据集。
AI.result: LoCoMo（BLEU/F1 平均）：GPT-4.1-mini 43.79/54.26（SimpleMem 39.97/50.30、LightMem 37.66/46.69、Mem0 30.88/35.81、MemoryOS 30.95/39.30）；GPT-4o 42.73/50.23；GPT-5-nano 46.96/57.04；Qwen3-8B 40.66/49.65（超 xMemory 34.49/43.51）；Llama-3.1-8B-Instruct 31.37/38.70。检索上下文 token 约 1.2k，显著低于全上下文 16.8k，仅略高于 LightMem/SimpleMem 的 ~0.6–0.7k。PerLTQA（LLM 判定正确率，Qwen3-8B）：profile 92.46、social relationship 83.23、events 85.72、dialogues 55.79，均为最优（SimpleMem 88.12/82.40/79.87/42.09；LightMem 64.93/78.00/73.03/47.01）。LongMemEval：平均 82.80%，优于 SimpleMem 76.87%、LightMem 68.67%、Mem0 59.81%，各子任务（时间推理 79.70%、多会话 72.18%、知识更新 91.03%、单会话用户 94.29%、单会话助手 91.07%、偏好 80.00%）整体最强。消融：去除实体画像或原始对话均显著下降（GPT-4.1-mini 平均 F1 54.26→51.38 / 49.02）；提示演化步数增至 4 最优，5 步出现过度精化导致性能下降；检索条数 25 最优（过少漏信息、过多引噪声）；引入搜索查询显著提升准确率但增加检索耗时；窗口 40 在效果与记忆构建时间间最平衡，且大窗口会因低显著性事实被丢弃或多条原子事实被合并而降低抽取质量；仅在两个开发对话上做提示优化仍在其余子集上稳定领先基线，说明未过拟合。
AI.conclusion: TriMem 说明「存储粒度约束可检索内容，检索粒度决定可进行的推理类型」，记忆系统应被视为多级表示的统一流水线而非围绕同一原子事实的三个独立模块。三级表示 + 提示词级终身演化在不更新参数的前提下同时改善了存储保真、检索效率与推理质量，并兼容多种规模与结构的模型（不依赖 logits，优于 xMemory 的模型限制）。局限与未来方向：实体画像目前仅到人物级，可扩展至事件链、社交网络、时间轨迹等高阶关系结构；TextGrad 优化仅依赖答案级反馈，可引入检索中间反馈与逐步推理轨迹监督以实现更细粒度的演化。代码已开源于 https://TMLR-TriMem.github.io。

title: Minimax Optimal Variance-Aware Regret Bounds for Multinomial Logistic MDPs
summary: We study reinforcement learning for episodic Markov Decision Processes (MDPs) whose transitions are modelled by a multinomial logistic (MNL) model. Existing algorithms for MNL mixture MDPs yield a regret of $\smash{\tilde{O}(dH^2\sqrt{T})}$ (Li et al., 2024), where $d$ is the feature dimension, $H$ the episode length, and $T$ the number of episodes. Inspired by the logistic bandit literature (Abeille et al., 2021; Faury et al., 2022; Boudart et al., 2026), we introduce a problem-dependent constant $\barσ\_T \leq 1/2$, measuring the normalised average variance of the optimal downstream value function along the learner's trajectory. We propose an algorithm achieving a regret of $\smash{\tilde{O}(dH^2\barσ\_T\sqrt{T})}$, which recovers the existing bound in the worst case and improves upon it for structured MDPs. For instance, for KL-constrained robust MDPs, $\barσ\_T = O(H^{-1})$, reducing the horizon dependence by a factor $H$. We further establish a matching $\smash{Ω(dH^2\barσ\_T\sqrt{T})}$ lower bound, proving minimax optimality (up to logarithmic factors) and fully characterising the regret complexity of MNL mixture MDPs for the first time.

AI.tldr: 研究MNL混合MDP的强化学习问题，引入问题依赖常数 σ̄_T 改进遗憾界从 O(dH²√T) 至 O(dH²σ̄_T√T)，并通过匹配下界证明 minimax 最优性。在 KL 约束鲁棒 MDP 中实现 H 倍改进。
AI.motivation: 现有 MNL 混合 MDP 算法的遗憾界为 O(dH²√T)，这是一个最坏情况上界，未能反映具体问题结构带来的潜在改进空间。文献中 logistic bandit 领域的进展（如 Abeille et al., 2021; Faury et al., 2022）启发作者引入问题依赖的分析框架。
AI.method: 引入问题依赖常数 σ̄_T ≤ 1/2（衡量沿着学习者轨迹的最优下游价值函数的归一化平均方差），并基于此设计新算法。该常数有效地捕获了问题结构信息，使得算法能够根据具体MDP特性自适应调整遗憾上界。
AI.result: 提出一种遗憾为 O(dH²σ̄_T√T) 的算法，在最坏情况下恢复已有界，在结构化 MDP 上表现更优。特别地，对于 KL 约束的鲁棒 MDP，σ̄_T = O(H⁻¹)，遗憾界改善为 O(dH√T)，水平跨度依赖从 H² 降至 H。同时证明匹配下界 Ω(dH²σ̄_T√T)，说明算法 minimax 最优。
AI.conclusion: 该研究首次完整刻画了MNL混合MDP的遗憾复杂度，证明了算法的 minimax 最优性（在对数因子范围内）。在KL约束的鲁棒MDP场景下，水平跨度依赖性降低了 H 倍。

title: Delta Attention Residuals
summary: Attention Residuals replace standard additive residual connections with learned softmax attention over previous layer outputs, enabling selective cross-layer routing. However, standard Attention Residuals still attend over cumulative hidden states in previous layers, which are highly redundant. We show that this redundancy leads to routing collapse in deeper layers: attention weights become low-contrast and closer to uniform (max weight ${\approx}$0.2), limiting the model's ability to select informative states in previous layers. This raises a key but underexplored design question: what layer-wise representations should be routed in Attention Residuals? To answer this question, we propose Delta Attention Residuals, which attend over deltas -- the change introduced by each sublayer ($\mathbf{v}_i = \mathbf{h}_{i+1} - \mathbf{h}_i$) -- instead of cumulative states. Delta representations are structurally diverse and yield higher-contrast attention distributions (max weight ${\approx}$0.6), enabling more selective and effective routing across layers. This principle applies at both per-sublayer and block granularity. Across all tested scales (220M--7.6B), Delta Attention Residuals consistently outperform both standard residuals and Attention Residuals, with 1.7--8.2\% validation perplexity gains. Delta Attention Residuals also enables converting pretrained checkpoints into Delta Attention Residuals via standard fine-tuning. Code is available at https://github.com/wdlctc/delta-attention-residuals-code.

AI.tldr: 《Delta Attention Residuals》指出 Attention Residuals（Kimi, 2025）因"在累积隐藏状态上做路由"导致深层路由坍塌（注意力最大权重降至约0.2、近乎均匀），提出改用"增量（delta）"作为路由源：v_i = h_{i+1} − h_i，并以加性形式 h = h̃ + Σα_i v_i 注入残差流，涵盖逐子层（Delta AttnRes）与块级（Delta Block）两种粒度。在 220M–7.6B 的 Qwen3 架构上从零训练均优于标准残差与 AttnRes（验证困惑度提升 1.7%–8.2%），并可无扰动地把预训练检查点微调为该结构（8 项下游基准平均 55.6% vs 基线 55.0%）。
AI.motivation: 标准残差连接以固定单位系数累加所有前序子层输出（h_l = h_{l-1} + f_l(h_{l-1})），缺乏按深度选择性聚合信息的能力。Attention Residuals 用学习到的 softmax 注意力替代加性累加，实现跨层选择性路由。但作者发现其路由源 s_i = h_i 本身是 running sum（h_i = h_0 + Σ v_j），相邻层状态共享越来越长的公共前缀，导致 softmax logit 之间差异消失：随深度增加，注意力权重趋于均匀，深层最大权重跌至约 0.2，出现"路由坍塌"（routing collapse），机制退化为对所有源做平均而丧失选择性。因此本文提出一个此前被忽视的设计问题：Attention Residuals 中究竟应该路由哪一层的表征（"路由变化"而非"路由累积"）。
AI.method: 1) 源表示对比：累积源 s_i = h_i（高度冗余）vs 增量源 s_i = v_i = h_{i+1} − h_i；由于注意力/MLP 输出处于不同子空间、捕获不同抽象层级，相邻 delta 天然多样。2) 增量路由（加性）：ĥ_l = h̃_l + Σ_i α_{i→l}·v_i，α_{i→l} = softmax(w_l^T RMSNorm(v_i))，w_l 零初始化。相比"替换式"路由 h = Σ α_i s_i，其优势为：保留残差流 h̃_l；块边界不丢失中间子层贡献（无需周期性 reset 重建隐藏态）；零初始化时路由输出为均匀加权的有界扰动，depth_route 退化为恒等映射，实现无扰动微调。3) 两种粒度：Delta AttnRes（每层 2L 个源，注意力与 MLP 输出各为独立源）与 Delta Block（Δ_b = h_{(b+1)B} − h_{bB}，B+1 个源，以粒度换效率）。4) 对照组：Baseline（标准残差）、AttnRes（累积块级源 + 替换式路由 + 块边界 reset，作者依据 Kimi 2025 描述自行复现）、Full AttnRes（N=L 每层一块）、Delta AttnRes、Delta Block；均使用零初始化查询且各尺度超参一致。5) 训练配置：Qwen3 架构，220M/533M/1044M 自定义配置与 Qwen3-0.6B、Qwen3-8B，FineWeb-Edu，AdamW(0.9,0.95,wd0.1)+cosine 调度，8×H100、BF16、torch.compile；8B 用 FSDP+梯度检查点。微调实验：Qwen3-0.6B 在 FineWeb-Edu 上 20K 步，路由模块用更大学习率（5e-3 vs 5e-5），lm-evaluation-harness 0-shot 评测 8 项基准。
AI.result: 1) 路由坍塌实证：Qwen3-0.6B（L=28）上 AttnRes 深层最大权重由浅层约 1.0 降至约 0.2，Delta Block 全深度维持约 0.6（0.6B 平均最大权重 0.62 vs 0.35，1.8×）。2) 从零训练（Table 1）：Delta AttnRes 在三个尺度均最优（36.83/31.05/29.13），Delta Block 紧随（37.08/31.16/29.19，差距<0.7%）；而 AttnRes 随规模退化——220M 时 37.39 优于基线 38.71，但 1044M 时劣化至 31.76（较基线 +6.9%），Full AttnRes 更差至 33.36（+12.3%），说明替换式路由 + 频繁 reset 在深层造成累积信息损失。3) 扩展（Table 2/3）：Qwen3-0.6B 上 Delta Block 31.45 vs 基线 32.22（−2.4%），AttnRes 32.38 略劣；7.57B 上 Delta Block 达 16.00（较基线 17.43 改善 −8.2%），AttnRes 降至 18.58（+6.6%）；Delta Block 仅增 589.8K 参数（0.008%），吞吐 14.0k vs 基线 21.4k（35% 开销），但快于并省内存于 AttnRes（12.5k / 44.0GB）。4) 效率权衡：1044M 下 Delta AttnRes 因 2L 源导致吞吐下降 69%、显存 3.5×，Delta Block 仅 20% 吞吐/26% 显存开销而质量几乎相同（<0.2% 差距），故推荐为大规模默认配置。5) 块大小消融：220M 甜点为 B=4–6（B=1: 37.44 → B=6: 36.92 → B=12: 37.34），533M 对 B=2–24 稳定（31.18–31.27）。6) 预训练模型转换：微调后 Delta Block 平均 55.6%（ARC-E 66.5、ARC-C 37.3 为最高）优于 Baseline FT 55.0% 与 AttnRes 54.1%；AttnRes 因替换式路由在初始化时返回各累积态的均匀平均，导致 loss 从 2.8 尖峰至 3.96、约需 2000 步恢复，而 Delta Block 因加性公式与零初始化 null source 从预训练 loss 平滑启动并保持约 0.87 的高最大权重（AttnRes 0.49）。7) 学到的路由模式显示深层会把 >50% 权重集中于少数早期输出（尤以 token 嵌入为显著），可选择性重注入被稀释的嵌入信号而不断裂残差流。
AI.conclusion: 核心洞见是：跨层路由应当路由"发生了什么变化"（delta）而非"累积了什么"（cumulative state）。增量源结构多样，维持约 3× 更锐利的路由（深层最大权重 0.6 vs 0.2），配合加性路由保留残差流，使 Delta 系列在 220M 到 7.6B 全尺度稳定优于标准残差与 AttnRes，而 AttnRes 因替换式路由 + 周期 reset 在大深度下反而劣化。块级 Delta Block 以 0.008% 的额外参数、低于 AttnRes 的开销达到与逐子层方案几乎相同的质量，被推荐为大规模训练默认配置；其零初始化安全特性还使既有检查点可通过常规微调无扰动地转为该结构，并取得 8 项基准上的最佳平均分。方法与其它架构改进正交。局限包括：均为单次运行、未报告误差棒；8B 实验因显存仅评测 Baseline/AttnRes/Delta Block；微调仅在单一基座（Qwen3-0.6B）验证；结论基于 10K 步预算与 FineWeb-Edu 数据，是否在更长训练与更大规模下保持尚待验证。

title: FlexDraft: Flexible Speculative Decoding via Attention Tuning and Bonus-Guided Calibration
summary: Speculative decoding accelerates memory-bound LLM inference without quality degradation by using a fast drafter to propose multiple candidate tokens and the target model to verify them in parallel. However, conventional sequential speculative decoding suffers from mutual waiting between drafting and verification, and repeated exchange of intermediate states further increases memory access overhead. Parallel speculative decoding addresses this limitation by performing drafting and verification within a single target forward pass, allowing future drafts to be prepared while current candidates are being verified. Although effective at small batch sizes, existing parallel speculative decoding methods either require costly continual pretraining with quality degradation or suffer from low acceptance rates. More importantly, this paradigm inherently suffers from uncertainty in both the bonus token and the accepted length, leading to draft verification mismatch and causing throughput gains to collapse at large batch sizes. To address these limitations, we introduce FlexDraft, a lossless speculative decoding framework that flexibly adapts to varying batch sizes through three key designs. (1) Attention Tuning enables block diffusion drafting by tuning only the attention projectors of the final few layers on mask tokens, while keeping the autoregressive path frozen to preserve the target distribution and produce high quality drafts with minimal trainable parameters. (2) Bonus-guided Calibration uses a lightweight MLP conditioned on the resolved bonus token to calibrate draft logits, mitigating draft verification mismatch caused by bonus token uncertainty. (3) Flex Decoding dynamically switches between parallel draft and verify at small batch sizes and sequential draft then verify at large batch sizes, and adjusts verification length based on draft confidence to eliminate redundant computation.

AI.tldr: 本文提出FlexDraft框架，通过注意力调优、奖励引导校准和灵活解码三大设计，解决现有并行推测解码方法在大批量场景下吞吐量崩溃的问题，实现无损的LLM推理加速。
AI.motivation: 现有并行推测解码方法在大批量场景下面临两个核心问题：奖励标记和接受长度的的不确定性导致草案验证不匹配，使吞吐量增益崩溃；同时这些方法要么需要昂贵的持续预训练且存在质量下降问题，要么接受率较低。因此需要一种能够适应不同批量大小、无质量损失的推测解码框架。
AI.method: 提出FlexDraft框架，包含三大设计：(1)注意力调优：仅微调最后几层的注意力投影器处理掩码标记，保持自回归路径冻结以保留目标分布，实现块扩散草案生成；(2)奖励引导校准：使用轻量级MLP基于已解析的奖励标记校准草案logits；(3)灵活解码：根据批大小动态切换并行/顺序草案验证策略，并根据草案置信度调整验证长度。
AI.result: FlexDraft实现了无损的推测解码加速，能够灵活适应不同批量大小，显著提升了大批量场景下的吞吐量。
AI.conclusion: FlexDraft通过注意力调优实现高质量块扩散草案，通过奖励引导校准缓解草案验证不匹配问题，通过灵活解码在不同批大小下选择最优执行策略，实现了无损的推测解码加速，显著提升了大规模批量场景下的吞吐量。

title: OpenComputer: Verifiable Software Worlds for Computer-Use Agents
summary: We present OpenComputer, a verifier-grounded framework for constructing verifiable software worlds for computer-use agents. OpenComputer integrates four components: (1) app-specific state verifiers that expose structured inspection endpoints over real applications, (2) a self-evolving verification layer that improves verifier reliability using execution-grounded feedback, (3) a task-generation pipeline that synthesizes realistic and machine-checkable desktop tasks, and (4) an evaluation harness that records full trajectories and computes auditable partial-credit rewards. In its current form, OpenComputer covers 33 desktop applications and 1,000 finalized tasks spanning browsers, office tools, creative software, development environments, file managers, and communication applications. Experiments show that OpenComputer's hard-coded verifiers align more closely with human adjudication than LLM-as-judge evaluation, especially when success depends on fine-grained application state. Frontier agents struggle with end-to-end completion despite partial progress, and open-source models exhibit sharp drops from their OSWorld-Verified scores, exposing a persistent gap in robust computer automation.

AI.tldr: OpenComputer是一个验证器驱动的框架，用于为计算机使用智能体构建可验证的软件世界。通过整合应用状态验证器、自进化验证层、任务生成管道和评估框架，覆盖33个桌面应用和1000个任务。实验表明硬编码验证器优于LLM评判，揭示了前沿模型和开源模型在计算机自动化任务上的显著差距。
AI.motivation: 当前AI计算机使用智能体的评估面临挑战：LLM作为评判者在细粒度应用状态判断上与人类判断不一致，缺乏可验证、可审计的评估方法，难以准确衡量智能体的真实能力。
AI.method: OpenComputer集成四个核心组件：(1) 应用特定状态验证器，通过结构化检查端点暴露真实应用状态；(2) 自进化验证层，利用执行反馈改进验证器可靠性；(3) 任务生成管道，合成可机器检查的现实桌面任务；(4) 评估框架，记录完整轨迹并计算可审计的部分奖励。
AI.result: 硬编码验证器与人类判断的一致性优于LLM-as-judge评估；前沿智能体虽能取得部分进展但难以端到端完成任务；开源模型在OSWorld-Verified上的得分大幅下降，暴露出鲁棒计算机自动化能力的持续差距。
AI.conclusion: OpenComputer提供了一个可靠的验证框架，覆盖广泛的应用场景，揭示了当前计算机使用智能体的能力边界。未来需重点提升开源模型的鲁棒性和智能体的端到端任务完成能力。

title: SPHERICAL KV: Angle-Domain Attention and Rate-Distortion Retention for Efficient Long-Context Inference
summary:
Long-context inference is increasingly constrained by the KV cache: resident memory grows with context length, and decoding becomes limited by repeated High Bandwidth Memory (HBM) streaming rather than arithmetic. Existing methods such as eviction, windowing, quantization, and offloading reduce footprint, but often leave the critical-path bottleneck only partially addressed, especially when compressed states must still be reconstructed into dense vectors during decoding.
  We present Spherical KV, a long-context inference method that treats KV allocation as a rate-distortion problem grounded in attention geometry for efficient decoding. The method is built on two ideas: (i) represent directional information cheaply in the decode hot loop, and (ii) allocate retention and precision according to estimated future utility. Its first component, Angle-Domain Attention (ADA), stores keys in a spherical parameterization consisting of a scalar radius and compact angle codes, and computes attention logits directly from these codes without reconstructing dense keys. This preserves a paged, block-local, fusion-friendly decode path and directly targets HBM traffic in realistic serving settings. Its second component, Rate-Distortion Retention (RDR), jointly chooses keep/drop decisions and precision tiers per token and head under a fixed budget, producing tier-homogeneous pages with lightweight metadata and coalesced reads. Together, ADA and RDR provide a deployment-oriented mechanism for reducing KV residency while preserving decode efficiency.

AI.tldr: Spherical KV通过将KV分配建模为基于注意力几何的率-失真问题，利用角度域注意力直接基于紧凑角度码计算注意力，以及率-失真保留在固定预算下联合优化token和头的保留策略与精度层级，为长上下文推理提供高效的KV缓存压缩方案。
AI.motivation: 长上下文推理受KV缓存制约：内存随上下文长度增长，解码受限于HBM流而非算术计算。现有方法(淘汰、窗口、量化、卸载)仅部分缓解瓶颈，特别是压缩状态在解码时仍需重建为稠密向量。
AI.method: 提出Spherical KV方法，将KV分配建模为率-失真优化问题，核心包括两个组件：1) 角度域注意力(ADA)，将键表示为球面参数化(标量半径+紧凑角度码)，直接利用角度码计算注意力logits，无需重建稠密键；2) 率-失真保留(RDR)，在固定预算下联合决策每个token和头的保留/丢弃及精度层级，产生均匀层级的页面结构。
AI.result: 在保持分页、块局部、融合友好解码路径的同时，直接针对实际服务场景中的HBM流量进行优化，实现KV驻留减少且保留解码效率。
AI.conclusion: Spherical KV通过ADA和RDR两个组件的协同设计，提供了一种面向部署的机制，在减少KV驻留的同时保持了解码效率，为长上下文推理提供了一条实用路径。

title: Mind Your Moras: Orthography-Aware Error Analysis of Neural Japanese Morphological Generation
summary: We present an orthography-aware error analysis of Japanese past-tense morphological inflection, treating hiragana not merely as a transcriptional medium, but as a representational system encoding morphophonological distinctions that may influence model generalization. We evaluate two character-level sequence-to-sequence architectures on past-tense formation using datasets formatted according to the SIGMORPHON 2020 and 2023 shared task conventions. Despite high aggregate accuracy, models exhibit systematic, linguistically interpretable errors that cluster around specific orthographic properties of hiragana. We introduce a concise error taxonomy capturing seven primary failure modes and provide both quantitative and qualitative analyses. Gemination-related errors dominate residual failures, accounting for 75-80% of errors, particularly in verbs whose stems end in the vowel e and require gemination before the past-tense suffix. Error patterns remain highly consistent across architectures and random seeds, suggesting a robust interaction between orthographic representation, morphological structure, and data frequency effects in shaping model generalization. These results underscore the necessity of orthography-aware evaluation for understanding neural generalization in morphologically complex languages.

AI.tldr: 该研究对日语过去时态形态变位进行了正字法感知的错误分析，发现尽管字符级seq2seq模型准确率高，但存在系统性错误，尤其是促音化相关错误占75-80%，且错误模式在不同架构间高度一致，表明假名正字法表示、形态结构与数据频率的交互作用对模型泛化有稳健影响。
AI.motivation: 字符级模型在日语形态任务中虽达到高准确率，但存在系统性错误。假名不仅是转录媒介，更是编码形态音位区分的表示系统，这可能影响模型泛化。
AI.method: 使用SIGMORPHON 2020和2023共享任务格式的数据集，评估两种字符级序列到序列架构在日语过去时态构成上的表现；构建了包含7种主要失败模式的错误分类法。
AI.result: 尽管整体准确率高，模型表现出系统性、可语言学解释的错误，聚集在假名的特定正字法特征上。75-80%的残余错误与促音化相关，尤其在词干以e元音结尾且需在过去时态后缀前添加促音的动词中。错误模式在不同架构和随机种子间高度一致。
AI.conclusion: 研究强调了正字法感知评估对于理解形态复杂语言中神经泛化的必要性，指出假名表示系统与形态结构的交互作用对模型泛化有重要影响。

title: Distribution-Free Uncertainty Quantification for Continuous AI Agent Evaluation
comment: 6 pages, 7 figures, 2 tables. Accepted at the ICML 2026 Workshop on Agentic Uncertainty Quantification (AgenticUQ) - Poster
summary: We adapt split conformal prediction and adaptive conformal inference (ACI) to continuous AI agent evaluation, providing distribution-free coverage guarantees for forecasted quality scores. Conformal intervals achieve calibration error below 0.02 across all nominal levels at the 24h horizon, while ACI correctly widens intervals by 35% following agent releases then reconverges. We further develop compositional uncertainty bounds for multi-agent pipelines (validated via simulation across inter-stage correlations rho in [-0.5, 0.9]), a conformal abstention rule for pairwise rankings with controlled false-ranking rate, and FDR-corrected abstention for leaderboard-scale multiple testing. Evaluating 50 agents via 18 real-time signals collected hourly, we show that per-agent conditional coverage is well-concentrated around the nominal level (mean 80.4%, 90% of agents within [72%, 90%]), and that cross-source sentiment divergence predicts ranking instability (r=0.64, p<0.01). A circularity-controlled validation confirms the framework captures signal beyond benchmarks (rho_s=0.52, p<0.01, n=35). Code and data are released under CC BY 4.0.

AI.tldr: 本研究将分裂共形预测和自适应共形推断(ACI)应用于AI智能体连续评估，为预测质量分数提供分布无关的覆盖保证。框架包含多智能体管道的组合不确定性界、成对排序的共形放弃规则及FDR校正放弃机制。在50个智能体、18个实时信号上的实验表明，条件覆盖稳定在名义水平(均值80.4%,90%位于[72%,90%])，且超越基准捕获额外信息(rho_s=0.52)。
AI.motivation: AI智能体评估面临动态环境下的连续质量监控挑战，需要为质量分数提供可靠的统计保证，同时处理多智能体管道的复杂依赖结构和大规模排行榜的统计检验问题。
AI.method: 采用分裂共形预测(Split Conformal Prediction)和自适应共形推断(ACI)方法；开发多智能体管道的组合不确定性界；设计成对排序的共形放弃规则以控制错误排序率；应用FDR校正进行排行榜规模的多重检验。
AI.result: 共形区间在24小时预测范围内所有名义水平下校准误差低于0.02；ACI在智能体发布后正确将区间扩大35%后重新收敛；模拟验证覆盖rho在[-0.5, 0.9]的阶段间相关性；每个智能体的条件覆盖集中在名义水平附近(均值80.4%，90%位于[72%, 90%])；跨源情感分歧预测排序不稳定性(r=0.64, p<0.01)；去圆化验证确认框架捕获超越基准的信号(rho_s=0.52, p<0.01, n=35)。
AI.conclusion: 该框架为AI智能体质量评估提供了有效的分布无关覆盖保证，能够适应环境变化、量化多智能体依赖的不确定性，并在控制错误排序率的同时实现排行榜尺度的多重检验。实验验证表明该方法超越传统基准方法。

title: Language Mutations Sustain the Persistences of Conspiracy Theories on Social Media
summary: This study investigates how language mutations affect the persistent diffusion of conspiracy theories on social media. Drawing on a three-year dataset of conspiracy-related posts from X, and applying computational linguistic analysis alongside survival modelling, we find that conspiracy claims with greater semantic mutations have substantially longer lifespans. Mutations in psycholinguistic properties, including pronouns, social reference words, cognitive process terms, risk- and health- related vocabularies, are associated with extended lifespans. Mutations in actor, action and target (AAT) categories are associated with longer lifespans as well. Qualitative analysis identifies two predominant mutation patterns: simplification and assimilation, at both linguistic and AAT structural levels. Taken together, the results advance our understanding of how language mutations contribute to conspiracy persistence online and shed lights on longitudinal content moderation strategies. We argue that content moderation should consider the mutability of conspiracy claims and focus on the core claims that can address their potential variations.

AI.tldr: 研究发现阴谋论的语言变异越大越难被消除，心理语言学和结构（AAT）层面的简化与同化是两种主要变异模式，内容审核策略应转向识别核心主张而非追踪表面措辞变化。
AI.motivation: 阴谋论如何在社交媒体上持久传播且难以被审核机制遏制的现象尚缺乏深入理解。
AI.method: 计算语言学分析 + 生存建模，基于X平台三年数据集，辅以定性分析识别两种主要变异模式。
AI.result: 心理语言学特征（代词、社交词汇、认知过程术语、风险/健康词汇）及AAT结构的语义变异均与更长存续期显著相关；质性分析发现简化与同化两种主要变异模式。
AI.conclusion: 研究发现语义变异越大阴谋论传播时间越长；内容审核应关注核心主张而非表面措辞变异，聚焦可应对多种变体的基础内容。

title: From SGD to Muon: Adaptive Optimization via Schatten-p Norms
summary: Modern optimizers, like Muon, impose matrix-wise geometry constraints on their updates. These matrix-wise constraints can be unified under Linear Minimization Oracle (LMO) theory. However, all current methods impose fixed LMO geometries for the update rules, chosen by-design or empirically, which are not necessarily optimal according to the problem's geometry. We introduce a novel efficient datadriven criterion for dynamically choosing proxy-optimal update LMO geometries on individual Deep Neural Network layers. Derived in closed form from gradient and activation statistics using a single-step random feature regression surrogate model, our criterion navigates a design space interpolating from SGD to Muon updates. Moreover, integrating parameter-wise preconditioning allows our framework to recover SGD, Muon, Adam, and MuAdam as specific extrema. To make this adaptive approach scalable, we pair it with efficient computational strategies, achieving only a $\sim$ 3% runtime overhead on highly optimized baselines. As a proof of concept, we show that this data-driven optimizer beats or remains competitive with the performance of the best performing optimizer between Muon and AdamW across three different training scenarios. Ultimately, this work provides evidence that LMO geometry can be successfully and efficiently adapted from runtime data, opening a new pathway for optimizer design beyond static geometries.

AI.tldr: 本文提出一种数据驱动的方法，在单个神经网络层上动态选择"代理最优"的更新 LMO（线性最小化预言机）几何，从而在 SGD 与 Muon 之间自适应插值。判据由梯度与激活统计量闭式推导（基于单步随机特征回归代理模型），并可结合逐参数预条件恢复 SGD、Muon、Adam、MuAdam 等极端情形；仅约 3% 运行时间开销，在三类训练场景下优于或持平于 Muon 与 AdamW 中最优者。
AI.motivation: 现代优化器（如 Muon）在参数更新上施加矩阵级（matrix-wise）几何约束，这些约束可统一到 LMO 理论框架下解释。但现有方法所采用的 LMO 几何都是固定不变的，或由设计者预先指定、或由经验调参确定，未必契合具体问题/层级的实际几何特性；不同层、不同训练阶段的梯度与激活结构差异很大，静态几何难以发挥潜力。此外，自适应几何带来的额外计算成本是可行性的关键障碍。
AI.method: 1) 框架：将矩阵级更新视为 LMO 问题，即在给定（参数化后的）可行集上寻找与梯度方向最相关的方向；不同 LMO 对应 SGD 到 Muon 的连续设计空间。2) 判据推导：以单步随机特征回归（random feature regression）作为代理模型，从梯度和激活统计量出发对代理目标做闭式求解，得到可解析计算的"代理最优"几何选择准则，避免在线搜索或昂贵超参搜索。3) 可扩展性：与逐参数（parameter-wise）预条件技术结合，使框架能够把 SGD、Muon、Adam、MuAdam 复现为设计空间中的极端点。4) 效率：采用高效的计算实现策略（如复用统计量、避免额外矩阵分解/反向传播），在高度优化的基线上仅引入约 3% 的运行时开销。
AI.result: 在三种不同训练场景下，该数据驱动自适应优化器的表现优于或与 Muon 和 AdamW 中性能最好的者持平；运行时间开销仅约 3%。结果表明 LMO 几何确实可以依据运行时数据被有效且高效地自适应调整，为优化器设计提供了超越静态几何的新路径。
AI.conclusion: 本文证明：优化器更新中的 LMO 几何不必是固定超参，而可以由运行时统计量以闭式、低开销的方式逐层动态确定，从而打通从 SGD、Adam 到 Muon、MuAdam 的统一谱系。局限性与后续方向包括：代理模型（单步随机特征回归）的近似误差、闭式判据的可解释性边界、以及在更大规模训练任务与更多 LMO 类型上的验证与扩展。

title: PromptRad: Knowledge-Enhanced Multi-Label Prompt-Tuning for Low-Resource Radiology Report Labeling
summary: Automatic report labeling facilitates the identification of clinical findings from unstructured text and enables large-scale annotation for medical imaging research. Existing rule-based labelers struggle with the diverse descriptions in clinical reports, while fine-tuning pre-trained language models (PLMs) requires large amounts of labeled data that are often unavailable in clinical settings. In this paper, we propose PromptRad, a knowledge-enhanced multi-label \textbf{prompt}-tuning approach for \textbf{rad}iology report labeling under low-resource settings. PromptRad reformulates multi-label classification as masked language modeling and incorporates synonyms from the UMLS Metathesaurus into a multi-word verbalizer to enrich category representations. By fine-tuning the PLM without additional classification layers, PromptRad requires substantially less labeled data than conventional fine-tuning. Experiments on liver CT reports show that PromptRad outperforms dictionary-based and fine-tuning baselines with only 32 labeled training examples, and achieves competitive performance with GPT-4 despite using a much smaller model. Further analysis demonstrates that PromptRad captures complex negation patterns more effectively than existing methods, making it a promising solution for report labeling in data-scarce clinical scenarios. Our code is available at https://github.com/ila-lab/PromptRad.

AI.tldr: PromptRad提出一种知识增强的多标签提示微调方法，利用UMLS同义词库丰富类别表示，在仅有32个标注样本的低资源场景下即可有效识别CT报告中的临床发现，性能可与GPT-4竞争。
AI.motivation: Rule-based labelers struggle with diverse descriptions in clinical reports, while fine-tuning pre-trained language models requires large amounts of labeled data that are often unavailable in clinical settings.
AI.method: PromptRad reformulates multi-label classification as masked language modeling and incorporates synonyms from UMLS Metathesaurus into a multi-word verbalizer to enrich category representations, enabling fine-tuning of pre-trained language models without additional classification layers.
AI.result: With only 32 labeled training examples, PromptRad outperforms dictionary-based and fine-tuning baselines, achieves competitive performance with GPT-4, and captures complex negation patterns more effectively than existing methods.
AI.conclusion: PromptRad provides a promising solution for automatic radiology report labeling in data-scarce clinical scenarios, outperforming dictionary-based and fine-tuning baselines with minimal training data (32 examples) and achieving competitive performance with GPT-4 while using a much smaller model.

title: From Prompts to Pavement Through Time: Temporal Grounding in Agentic Scene-to-Plan Reasoning
summary: Recent attempts to support high-level scene interpretation and planning in Autonomous Vehicles (AVs) using ensembles of Large Language Models (LLMs) and Large Multimodal Models (LMMs) continue to treat time as a secondary property. This lack of temporal grounding leads to inconsistencies in reasoning about continuous actions, undermining both safety and interpretability. This work explores whether temporal conditioning within inter-agent communication can preserve or enhance coherence without introducing degradation in semantic or logical consistency. To investigate this, we introduce three planner architectures with progressively increasing temporal integration and evaluate them on curated subsets of the BDD-X dataset using semantic, syntactic, and logical metrics. Results show that while temporal conditioning reshapes reasoning style, it yields no statistically significant improvements in standard NLP-based correctness metrics. However, qualitative analysis reveals predictive hazard reasoning, stable corrective behavior, and strategic divergence in the Sentinel. These findings clarify the limits of prompt-based temporal grounding and establish the first empirical benchmark for temporal scene-to-plan reasoning.

AI.tldr: 本文研究时间条件化在自动驾驶多智能体通信中对推理一致性的影响，提出三种渐进式时间集成的规划器架构，在BDD-X数据集上评估发现虽然标准NLP指标无显著提升，但定性分析揭示了预测性危险推理和稳定修正行为。
AI.motivation: 当前LLM/LMM在自动驾驶场景理解中被当作集成工具使用，但时间被当作次要属性，导致连续动作推理不一致，损害安全性和可解释性。
AI.method: 设计三种时间集成程度递增的规划器架构，在BDD-X数据集的策划子集上，使用语义、句法和逻辑指标进行评估。
AI.result: 时间条件化重塑了推理风格，但在标准NLP正确性指标上无统计显著提升；定性分析揭示了Sentinel中的预测性危险推理、稳定修正行为和战略性分歧。
AI.conclusion: 明确了基于提示的时间 grounding 的局限性，建立了首个时间场景到规划推理的实证基准。

title: Towards Family-Grouped Hierarchical Federated Learning on Sub-5KB Models: A Feasibility Study of Privacy-Preserving ECG Monitoring for Ultra-Resource-Constrained Wearables
comment: Supported by Shenzhen Coddie Technology Co., Ltd. This is a preprint and has not been peer-reviewed
summary: Cardiovascular disease remains the leading cause of death worldwide, and early detection of arrhythmias through continuous ECG monitoring on wearable devices can prevent life-threatening events. Federated Learning (FL) enables privacy-preserving collaborative training by keeping raw ECG data on device, yet standard FL incurs prohibitive communication overhead and standard deep learning models cannot fit on ultra-low-power microcontrollers. We propose Family-Grouped Hierarchical Federated Learning (Family-FL), a three-tier architecture that uses the family as a natural privacy boundary for intra-family aggregation before global synchronization. We further design a hardware-constrained Tiny CNN-LSTM architecture with only 669 parameters, INT8-quantized to occupy merely 4.65KB Flash and 2.95KB RAM, meeting the constraints of STC32G12K128-class microcontrollers. Experiments on the MIT-BIH Arrhythmia Database (mean of 5 independent runs with different seeds) demonstrate that Family-FL reduces communication volume by 76.7% compared to FedAvg while maintaining comparable accuracy. Family-FL-Tiny achieves 91.9 +/- 1.2% accuracy with macro-F1 of 0.483 +/- 0.031, reducing total communication to 0.31% of FedAvg. The model achieves reliable ventricular arrhythmia detection (per-class F1 = 0.80), the most clinically critical abnormality for home-based preliminary screening. These results demonstrate the technical feasibility of privacy-preserving federated learning on ultra-resource-constrained microcontrollers through simulation-based evaluation. We honestly discuss limitations: no hardware deployment, single-dataset validation (MIT-BIH, 47 subjects), reduced rare-class sensitivity, and absence of formal differential privacy guarantees.

AI.tldr: Family-FL是一个针对超低功耗微控制器设计的隐私保护联合学习系统，通过家族三级架构和轻量级CNN-LSTM模型（669参数，INT8量化后仅4.65KB Flash和2.95KB RAM），在心电图心律失常检测任务上达到91.9%准确率，同时将通信量降低至FedAvg的0.31%，验证了超资源受限微控制器上隐私保护联合学习的技术可行性。
AI.motivation: Cardiovascular disease is the leading cause of death worldwide, requiring early detection of arrhythmias through continuous ECG monitoring on wearable devices. Standard Federated Learning incurs prohibitive communication overhead, and standard deep learning models cannot fit on ultra-low-power microcontrollers.
AI.method: The paper proposes Family-FL, a three-tier architecture using family as natural privacy boundary for intra-family aggregation before global synchronization. A hardware-constrained Tiny CNN-LSTM model with only 669 parameters is designed and INT8-quantized to fit STC32G12K128-class microcontrollers.
AI.result: Family-FL reduces communication volume by 76.7% compared to FedAvg while maintaining comparable accuracy. Family-FL-Tiny achieves 91.9±1.2% accuracy with macro-F1 of 0.483±0.031, reducing total communication to 0.31% of FedAvg. The model achieves reliable ventricular arrhythmia detection (per-class F1 = 0.80).
AI.conclusion: The paper demonstrates the technical feasibility of privacy-preserving federated learning on ultra-resource-constrained microcontrollers for ECG-based arrhythmia detection. Family-FL achieves 91.9% accuracy with only 4.65KB Flash and 2.95KB RAM footprint, while reducing communication to 0.31% of FedAvg. Limitations include lack of hardware deployment, single-dataset validation, reduced rare-class sensitivity, and absence of formal differential privacy guarantees.

title: Text-to-SPARQL Generation with Reinforcement Learning: A GRPO-based Approach on DBLP
summary: Knowledge graph question answering seeks to translate natural language questions into executable queries over knowledge graphs, but existing approaches often rely on large models or full supervision in the form of gold query annotations. This study examines whether reinforcement learning with outcome-based rewards can train a small instruction-tuned language model to perform zero-shot Text-to-SPARQL generation in the scholarly domain. Group-Relative Policy Optimization (GRPO) is applied to the Qwen3-1.7B model on DBLP-QuAD, using prompts that combine natural language questions with symbolic hints about entities and relations. Training relies on execution feedback, structural constraints, and answer-level rewards, with an additional variant that incorporates gold-query-based shaping. The resulting models are compared to the unmodified zero-shot baseline and to a supervised DoRA-finetuned baseline across answer-level accuracy, execution accuracy, category-wise scores, and generalization to held-out templates. GRPO substantially improves over the zero-shot baseline and exhibits competitive generalization, while supervised DoRA finetuning achieves higher overall accuracy on the same model scale. Ablation analyses indicate that execution-based rewards account for most gains, with additional shaping yielding limited additional benefit, suggesting that outcome-based reinforcement learning is a viable training strategy when gold queries are unavailable for token-level supervision.

AI.tldr: 本研究探索在缺乏标注查询的情况下，使用基于结果的强化学习（GRPO）训练小模型（Qwen3-1.7B）完成零样本Text-to-SPARQL生成任务。实验表明执行奖励是主要收益来源，GRPO显著优于零样本基线，但监督式DoRA微调仍保持更高整体准确率。
AI.motivation: 现有知识图谱问答方法依赖大型模型或需要大量标注查询（gold query annotations）进行全监督训练，缺乏标注数据时难以应用。
AI.method: 采用Group-Relative Policy Optimization (GRPO)算法对Qwen3-1.7B模型进行训练，使用DBLP-QuAD学术领域数据集，通过自然语言问题结合实体和关系符号提示的prompt模板，奖励信号包括执行反馈、结构约束和答案级奖励，并设计了融入gold-query reward shaping的变体模型进行对比。
AI.result: GRPO大幅超越零样本基线，在未见模板的泛化任务上表现具有竞争力；监督式DoRA微调在相同模型规模下取得更高整体准确率；消融分析表明执行奖励贡献了大部分收益，额外的reward shaping收益有限。
AI.conclusion: 当gold queries不可用于token级监督时，基于结果的强化学习是一种可行的训练策略；执行反馈而非gold query shaping是性能提升的主要驱动力。

title: Explainable Wastewater Digital Twins: Adaptive Context-Conditioned Structured Simulators with Self-Falsifying Decision Support
comment: 17 pages, 7 figures, 6 tables, 2 algorithms. Supplementary material (7 pages) included as ancillary file
summary: Operators of safety-critical industrial processes increasingly rely on digital twins to screen control interventions, but such simulators rarely carry certified safety guarantees. Wastewater treatment plants exemplify the gap: operators face a daily safety-efficiency trade-off where aerating too little risks effluent violations and nitrous-oxide (N2O) spikes, and aerating too much wastes energy. We develop an explainable digital twin for aeration and dosing setpoints. CCSS-IX, the simulator, is a bank of interpretable locally linear state-space "experts" adaptively mixed by a context-aware gating network, building on a continuous-time regime-switching scaffold. A runtime decision layer applies conformal risk control to abstain, reopen, or return a falsifying temporal witness for any operator-proposed action that cannot be statistically certified. The artificial-intelligence contribution is twofold: an identifiable, context-conditioned structured surrogate that retains operator-readable dynamics, and a self-falsifying decision rule with finite-sample coverage guarantees. The engineering contribution is a validated, end-to-end decision-support pipeline, tested on a 1000-step slice of the Avedøre full-scale plant (42.6% sensor missingness, 2-minute sampling), the Agtrup/BlueKolding full-scale plant in Denmark, and the Benchmark Simulation Model No. 2 (BSM2) international benchmark, under a matched ten-seed protocol. The static structured ensemble lies within 0.78% root-mean-square error of an unconstrained black-box reference, and the adaptive variant within 1.08%. The calibrated reopen rule cuts aggregate two-plant regret by 43.6% at an unsafe-action cost weight of 4 and eliminates unsafe chosen actions on the BSM2 main slice. Event-aligned temporal witnesses prevent 93 of 187 false-safe N2O approvals, about 4.65x the dyadic baseline (paired McNemar p < 1e-21).

AI.tldr: 本文提出可解释的污水厂数字孪生系统 CCSS-IX：由可解释的局部线性状态空间"专家"经上下文感知门控自适应混合而成的仿真器，配合一个基于共形风险控制（conformal risk control）的"自证伪"决策层，对操作员提出的曝气/加药干预给出"接受/弃权/校准重开/时间反例见证"四种结论。在两座全规模工厂（Avedøre、Agtrup/BlueKolding）与 BSM2 机理基准上验证：结构化模型与黑盒参考的 RMSE 差异在统计上不可区分（+0.78% ~ +1.08%），校准重开策略在不安全代价权重4下将两厂聚合遗憾降低43.6%，事件对齐时序反例阻止了93/187次虚假安全批准（约为二分分解基线的4.65倍，配对McNemar p<1e-21）。
AI.motivation:
污水处理厂运行中，操作员日益依赖数字孪生来筛查候选曝气曲线与加药设定，但现有方法存在两个尚未被同时解决的缺口：
1）可解释性缺口——高保真学习仿真器多为黑盒RNN/状态空间模型，只输出轨迹与不确定性，无法暴露"计划执行量—系统状态—外生扰动"如何交互产生预测；错误批准可能导致氨氮出水超标、能耗浪费或N2O激增（N2O约265倍CO2增温潜势），且ISO/IEC TR 5469:2024等标准对AI功能安全提出明确期待，仅靠事后归因（SHAP等）不可替代。
2）认证缺口——历史观测上的平均预测误差不能决定对未来干预模拟的信任度；仅按"历史支撑域"拒绝超域干预是必要但不足够的：接近分布域内的不安全干预会被系统性放行，而有价值的新型干预会被不必要地弃权。
作者进一步指出两者本质耦合：只有当仿真器把更新律分解为显式的状态/控制/扰动通道时，"同一干预路径在不同时间分解下决策不一致"才能被归因到具体的控制事件或扰动跃迁，从而把自证伪从"标量弃权分数"变成可执行的工程解释。
AI.method:
方法分三层：
（1）CCSS-IX仿真器架构（架构阶梯：黑盒CCSS-RS → 静态结构化 → 自适应上下文条件化 → 自适应+残差）。外层沿用CCSS-RS脚手架：粘性路由的连续时间模态切换、Δt编码、半群一致性正则、hurdle-Student-t概率输出头。核心贡献是替换不透明的模态专家：每个模态k的潜在更新分解为状态耦合矩阵A_k(γ_t)z_t、控制影响矩阵B_k(γ_t)u_t、扰动影响矩阵E_k(γ_t)w_t、上下文偏置d_k(γ_t)、加性非线性h_k(·)以及可选残差αr_k；自适应版本以秩R=4的低秩调制参数化A_k(γ)=A_k0+Σa_{k,r}(γ)ΔA_{k,r}（B、E同构），上下文γ_t由模态嵌入、rollout动态特征、全局上下文摘要、紧状态摘要与时间步特征构成；主模型设α=0。非线性项采用逐变量可加响应曲线φ_x/φ_u/φ_w。
（2）自证伪有效性层（四结果决策层）：干预场景s=(历史上下文h_1:t, 未来控制u_{t+1:H}, 扰动w_{t+1:H}, 阈值τ)。
· 支撑分数σ_supp=0.35σ_ctx+0.65σ_act|ctx，基于校准块（N_cal=64）内k=10近邻的上下文距离与"条件于上下文的动作距离"，权重跨厂固定不调参；支撑判定用σ_supp≤q_α（α=0.10）。
· 自证伪分数：对分割族P定义"轨道跨越阈值"指示φ_self=1[min_π m<0≤max_π m]，m=τ−max_t ŷ，以及轨道直径φ_orbit。
· 事件对齐切分：对联合信号ν=(u,w)按MAD归一化，计算步长范数Δ_t，取top-3控制/扰动不连续点C_3，构造1/2/3个内部切点的B4分割族，与原始整段rollout组成四元素比较轨道。
· 严格证书（支撑且轨道不跨阈值）、校准重开（σ_supp与φ_orbit同时落入(1−α)分位数的校准正常区C_α，即在Angelopoulos等的共形风险控制目标上加入支撑新颖性门控与自证伪）、时序见证（原始批准但存在证伪分割时返回最不安全分割π*及通道归因载荷ξ*）。对照族：二分分解、匹配随机B4、决策受压B4（主动搜索上界）。
（3）评估协议：按时间顺序划分训练/校准/冻结评估块；多随机种子（CCSS族10种子{1,5,7,11,19,23,31,42,47,53}，LSTM对照4种子）；指标RMSE/MAE/R²/CRPS/NLL；配对bootstrap（20,000重采样）、最坏情形McNemar精确检验、Clopper–Pearson区间、Holm–Bonferroni多重性校正。数据：Avedøre（2022.6–2024.6，906,815步，16变量，42.6%缺失，2分钟采样）、Agtrup/BlueKolding（525,600样本，规则网格0%缺失）、BSM2（ASM家族机理oracle，h12主切片n=3，h16见证矩阵n=187/16种子，h24边界）。
AI.result:
（1）保真度（Table 1，Avedøre）：CCSS-RS RMSE 0.6435±0.045；IX-Static 0.6459（+0.78%，CI[-0.029,+0.038]）；IX-Adaptive 0.6502（+1.08%，CI[-0.010,+0.024]）；IX-Adaptive+Res 0.6644（+3.36%，CI[-0.010,+0.050]）——所有配对CI均跨零，结构化与黑盒统计不可区分；CRPS/NLL上静态变体与黑盒持平或略优，自适应+残差在概率校准上被支配；适配型LSTM（1.21M参数、掩码感知高斯NLL、log1p(Δt)条件输入）落后86.8%（CI[+0.390,+0.685]）。
（2）可解释性（§5.3）：Avedøre恢复3个持久模态（占据率0.22/0.57/0.22，平均驻留16.5/47.9/10.9步），模态耦合图Frobenius距离2.53但共享同一非零边拓扑（边幅值Spearman≥0.98），即模态是"同一化学结构的活性级门控"；与雨水指示的Cramér's V≈0.91、相位设定值V≈0.78耦合矩阵对ASM1硝化/反硝化与N2O文献先验的8条边中6条在行最大值5%阈值匹配，2条不匹配仅差1个百分点，未对机理输出做任何拟合；合成2维LPV真值系统上静态RMSE 0.583、 自适应0.089（6.5×）。Agtrup通道效应：调制项范数约为基矩阵的3倍；推理时|E|=6.24>|A|=2.85>|B|=0.46；金属盐投加与曝气设定值主导控制通道。Avedøre 24个N2O尖峰归因：状态13/24、控制6/24、扰动5/24，模态1主导23/24，平均份额状态0.399/控制0.246/扰动0.273/加性0.082/残差0.000；CII前驱信号在30窗口124次尖峰中标记112/124（90.3%）为耦合，平均提前47步（≈94分钟），但CII与N2O最大互相关仅r=0.146（滞后24步），作者明确其为前驱可见性标志而非校准预测器。
（3）多站对照（Table 3，Agtrup）：CCSS-RS vs IX在NH4+ RMSE 0.593±0.118 vs 0.608±0.100；IX在PO4³⁻上更优（RMSE 0.320 vs 0.339，R² 0.700 vs 0.650）；LSTM全面落后（RMSE≈2×、NLL +78~+79），对角实值S5更差（R²为负）。CCSS-RS在seed 7的10个窗口中有5个Picard rollout发散（非有限预测，被NaN守卫跳过），CCSS-IX全部10窗口完成，作者标注该结果对CCSS-RS有利（跳过的是更难窗口）。
（4）两厂影子模式回放（Table 4）：Avedøre为"不安全但受支撑"型（支撑弃权遗憾68、不安全接受率0.266；严格认证降至39/0.047）；Agtrup为"安全但不受支撑"型（严格认证遗憾7→校准重开5，接受率0.542→0.625且不安全接受率保持0.0）。unsafe-cost=4时聚合遗憾78→44（-43.6%，作者明确指出该增益由Agtrup驱动，Avedøre上重开与严格持平）。
（5）BSM2 oracle（Table 5，h12主切片n=3）：支撑弃权的所选动作不安全率1.0（CP[0.292,1.000]），严格与校准重开均为0.0（CP[0.000,0.708]，作者提示小样本只排除约70%以上的真实不安全率）；校准重开将平均遗憾由2.984降至2.912；h16上严格/校准仍保留不安全率0.333，作为见证机制的已验证边界。
（6）时序见证（Table 6，16种子h16低DO矩阵n=187）：原始整段硬门控阻止0/187，二分分解20/187，匹配随机B4 19/187，事件对齐B4 93/187（CP[42.4%,57.1%]），决策受压B4上界130/187；事件对齐仅误阻16/653真实安全批准；对dyadic的最坏情形配对McNemar p=2e-22，Holm–Bonferroni校正后全部显著。代表案例：原始rollout峰值0.0426<阈值0.0465（误判安全），事件对齐分割[0-6-16]峰值0.0549>阈值，BSM2 oracle真值0.0599，差异归因至t=6处曝气设定值的B_k(γ_t)u_t控制通道。h24边界上事件对齐B4阻止0/194而决策受压B4阻止48/194，界定已验证区间为h16。
（7）能耗–N2O前沿（Fig. 6，27个低DO BSM2场景）：安全场景中位节能2.41%，不安全延伸至7.02%；17个oracle不安全场景中15个为原始"虚假安全"，说明最有吸引力的节能区域恰是风险集中区。
AI.conclusion: 核心结论是"结构化更新律"与"自证伪有效性层"实为同一贡献：可解释通道不仅是审计需求，更是把自证伪转化为可归因工程解释的前提。作者明确淡化聚合数字43.6%的普适性（由Agtrup单一工厂驱动）、淡化h24失效、淡化CII的预测力、淡化BSM2主切片n=3的小样本，并指出43.6%之外每厂分解表更重要。已验证范围：h16事件对齐见证有效，h24需更换事件族或主动分割搜索；对抗性操作员可构造归一化变化平缓的控制轨迹以规避事件对齐切分，防线是主动分割搜索或在结构化通道之上叠加学习式见证策略。部署路径为操作员在环的影子筛查（四结果标注），尚未证明闭环运行收益；校准重开依赖校准块的代表性与样本量，分布漂移、传感器漂移与工艺变更需在线监测。所有定量验证限于污水领域，跨领域外推失败源于对数-幅值逆变换在量级跨度大时的饱和（流水线量级缩放问题而非结构分解问题）。整体上，论文的主要价值在于把"数字孪生用于干预认证"这一目标具体化为一个可检验的四结果决策层，并展示了结构化仿真器在几乎无保真度代价的前提下提供通道级归因与时序反例的可行性，同时对统计显著性与适用边界保持克制披露。

title: SAGE: Shaping Anchors for Guided Exploration in RLVR of LLMs
summary: Recent studies observe that reinforcement learning with verifiable rewards (RLVR) reliably improves pass@1 on reasoning tasks, yet often fails to yield comparable gains in pass@k, raising the question of whether RLVR genuinely enables large language models to acquire novel reasoning abilities or merely enhances the efficiency of sampling reasoning modes already present in the base model. Prior analyses largely support the latter view, attributing this limitation to structural properties of standard RLVR objectives that result in insufficient exploration pressure. In this work, we argue that a central structural constraint arises from reverse-KL regularization, which stabilizes training but inherently anchors the policy to the reference distribution, thereby suppressing the emergence of alternative reasoning modes. However, we show that neither removing the KL term nor replacing it with forward-KL provides a satisfactory solution, as both disrupt the efficiency-coverage trade-off by either inducing reward hacking or allocating probability mass to off-target regions. To resolve this tension, we propose SAGE, a principled framework that enables controllable empirical support expansion by reshaping the reverse-KL anchor distribution itself through a guide function q(x,y), achieving consistent improvements in both pass@1 and pass@k across challenging mathematical reasoning benchmarks. Our code is available at https://github.com/tally0818/SAGE.

AI.tldr: 本文揭示了RLVR中reverse-KL正则化抑制探索的根本问题，指出简单移除KL项或替换为forward-KL都无法解决效率-覆盖权衡，进而提出SAGE框架通过引导函数重塑锚定分布，在保持训练稳定性的同时实现概率质量的可控扩展。
AI.motivation: RLVR在pass@1上有效但在pass@k上提升有限，原因被归因于标准RLVR目标的结构特性导致探索压力不足。核心约束来自reverse-KL正则化，它虽然稳定训练但将策略锚定在参考分布上，抑制了替代推理模式的涌现。
AI.method: 提出SAGE框架，通过引导函数q(x,y)重塑reverse-KL的锚定分布，实现可控制的概率质量扩展，平衡效率与覆盖的权衡。
AI.result: 在具有挑战性的数学推理基准测试中，SAGE在pass@1和pass@k两个指标上均实现了一致的改进。
AI.conclusion: SAGE框架通过重塑reverse-KL的锚定分布，在保持训练稳定性的同时实现概率质量的可控扩展，在数学推理基准测试中同时提升pass@1和pass@k。

title: CopT: Contrastive On-Policy Thinking with Continuous Spaces for General and Agentic Reasoning
summary: Chain-of-thought (CoT) is a standard approach for eliciting reasoning capabilities from large language models (LLMs). However, the common CoT paradigm treats thinking as a prerequisite for answering, which can delay access to plausible answers and incur unnecessary token costs even when the model is able to identify an answer before extended thinking, a behavior known as performative reasoning. In this paper, we introduce CopT, a reformulated reasoning pipeline that reverses the usual order of thinking and answering. Instead of thinking before answering, CopT first elicits a draft answer and then invokes subsequent on-policy thinking conditioned on its own draft answer for reflection and correction. To assess whether the draft answer should be trusted, CopT recasts continuous embeddings as inference-time contrastive verifiers. Specifically, it contrasts the model's support for the same generated tokens under discrete-token inputs and continuous-embedding inputs, yielding a sequence-level reverse KL estimator for answer reliability. Our analysis shows that under certain assumptions, the expected estimate equals the mutual information between the unresolved latent state and the emitted answer token, explaining why it captures answer-relevant uncertainty rather than arbitrary uncertainty in the latent state. When the answer is deemed insufficiently reliable, CopT performs further on-policy thinking, where a second KL estimator dynamically controls draft-answer visibility, preserving useful partial information while reducing the risk of being misled by unreliable content. Across mathematics, coding, and agentic reasoning tasks, CopT improves peak accuracy by up to 23% and reduces token usage by up to 57% at comparable or higher accuracy, without any additional training. The code is available at https://github.com/sdc17/CopT.

AI.tldr: CopT 是一种创新的推理框架，它反转了传统 CoT 的顺序——先产生草稿答案，再基于该答案进行反思性思考，并使用对比验证器评估答案可靠性，动态控制思考深度，从而在多个任务中实现了精度与效率的双重提升。
AI.motivation: 传统 CoT 将思考视为回答的前提步骤，但这会导致：当模型实际上能够快速识别答案时，过长的思考过程会造成响应延迟和不必要的 token 消耗，即"表演性推理"问题。
AI.method: CopT 提出两种 KL 散度估计器：(1) 反向 KL 估计器——通过对比离散 token 输入与连续 embedding 输入下模型对同一生成 token 的支持度，来估计答案可靠性；(2) 动态控制估计器——控制草稿答案的可见性，保留有用部分信息同时降低不可靠内容的误导风险。
AI.result: 实验结果表明 CopT 可在保持或提升精度的前提下，显著降低 token 消耗。
AI.conclusion: CopT 在数学、编程和智能体推理任务中实现了最高 23% 的精度提升，在相同或更高精度下将 token 使用量降低高达 57%，且无需额外训练。

title: Streamlined Constraint Reasoning via CNN Pattern Recognition on Enumerated Solutions
summary: Constraint programming practitioners accelerate hard problems through a layered set of techniques applied in order of risk. Standard hardening (symmetry-breaking and implied constraints) is applied first and preserves satisfiability. Streamliner constraints, which restrict search to a structural sub-family of solutions, do not preserve satisfiability and are reserved as a final lever. Existing automated streamliner-synthesis approaches either search a constraint grammar or prompt a Large Language Model directly on the problem model. We propose a different approach: enumerate feasible solutions, train a Convolutional Neural Network contrastively against perturbed non-solutions to detect structural patterns, and translate the CNN's discriminative signal into candidate MiniZinc streamliners through LLM-driven synthesis. The CNN grounds the LLM's constraint generation in observed solution structure rather than model text alone. We evaluate on hardened benchmark models where streamliner discovery is the residual performance lever. Our pipeline achieves 98.8% portfolio time reduction on hardened Vessel Loading, 98.6% on hardened Social Golfers, and 89.4% on Black Hole, with best-single streamliners reaching geometric-mean speedups of 932x, 356x, and 1103x respectively. Discovered streamliners include class-based packing constraints on Vessel Loading, beyond-hardening canonicalisations on Social Golfers, and layout-coordinate bounds on Black Hole.

AI.tldr: 本文提出一种基于CNN-LLM混合架构的流线化约束（Streamliner）自动合成方法。通过枚举可行解、对比训练CNN检测结构模式，再由LLM将CNN的判别信号转化为MiniZinc流线化约束。在硬化基准问题上实现显著加速（最高1103x）。
AI.motivation: 约束编程中，标准硬化技术（对称破缺、隐含约束）已充分应用后，流线化约束成为残余性能提升的关键杠杆。现有自动化方法存在局限：约束文法搜索空间有限，直接提示LLG缺乏对解结构的感知能力。
AI.method: pipeline流程：1）枚举可行解；2）对比训练CNN（正样本为可行解，负样本为扰动非解）；3）CNN检测结构模式并输出判别信号；4）LLM将CNN信号转化为MiniZinc流线化约束。其中CNN为LLM提供解结构的观测 grounding，而非仅依赖模型文本。
AI.result: 在硬化基准模型上评估：Vessel Loading达98.8% portfolio时间缩减（932x加速）、Social Golfers达98.6%（356x加速）、Black Hole达89.4%（1103x加速）。发现的新型流线化约束包括：Vessel Loading的基于类的打包约束、Social Golfers的超硬化规范化、Black Hole的布局坐标边界。
AI.conclusion: CNN-LLM混合架构可有效从解结构中自动发现高性能流线化约束，验证了"观测数据驱动约束合成"范式的可行性，为约束编程性能优化提供了新路径。

title: From Sparsity to Simplicity: Enabling Simpler Sequential Replacements via Sparse Attention Distillation
summary: Self-attention serves as the core foundation of large-scale transformer pretraining, but its quadratic token interaction cost makes inference expensive. Replacing attention with simpler sequential modules is appealing, yet naive substitution is often lossy, especially at larger scales. This paper revisits attention replacement through the lens of sparsity. Based on the observation of diverse sparsity patterns across transformer layers, we posit that pretrained transformers decompose the complex token dependency across tokens into various sequence-to-sequence mappings of diverse complexities, where some layer functionalities can be approximated and replaced with much simpler sequential modules without loss. We evaluate this premise using a plug-and-play layer-wise distillation framework to approximate and replace attention functionalities in pretrained vision transformer models.
