Controlled group-wise replacements under a fixed training budget reveal a clear pattern: substituting layers with sparser attention incurs substantially smaller accuracy drops than replacing denser ones. We further impose explicit attention sparsity on the pretrained ViT via AViT-style token retention and perform sparsity-guided distillation for sequential replacing models, where we see increasing teacher sparsity consistently reduces the student-teacher gap. The proposed method achieves efficient attention replacement for reduced parameter size and latency through the guidance of attention sparsity.

AI.tldr: 该论文从稀疏性角度重新审视注意力机制替换问题。基于观察到不同 transformer 层呈现不同稀疏模式的发现，提出用简单顺序模块替代部分注意力层是可行的。通过层级蒸馏与稀疏性引导的策略，成功在保持性能的前提下降低模型参数量和推理延迟。
AI.motivation: 自注意力机制存在二次方计算复杂度，导致推理成本高昂。直接用简单顺序模块替换注意力机制往往会造成性能损失，尤其在大规模模型上问题更为突出。
AI.method: 提出即插即用的层级蒸馏框架，结合AViT风格的token保留显式施加注意力稀疏性，通过稀疏性引导的蒸馏实现对预训练ViT中注意力模块的顺序替换。
AI.result: 实验表明：1) 稀疏注意力层的替换成本更低，替换稀疏层造成的精度下降显著小于替换密集层；2) 增大教师模型的注意力稀疏度可有效缩小师生之间的性能差距。
AI.conclusion: 提出一种基于稀疏性引导的注意力替换方法，在保持性能的同时显著降低参数量和延迟。该方法证明了稀疏注意力层的可替代性，为高效推理提供了新思路。

title: BalanceRAG: Joint Risk Calibration for Cascaded Retrieval-Augmented Generation
summary: Large language models (LLMs) can enhance factuality via retrieval-augmented generation (RAG), but applying RAG to every query is unnecessary when the model-only answer is reliable. This motivates cascaded RAG: each query is first handled by an LLM-only branch, escalated to a RAG fallback only if the primary branch is uncertain, and abstained from when neither branch is sufficiently trustworthy. However, calibrating such cascades stage by stage may be conservative, since the final utility depends on joint uncertainty thresholding of LLM-only and RAG. In this work, we develop BalanceRAG to certify threshold pairs at a target risk level. Given uncertainty scores from the two branches, BalanceRAG frames each threshold pair as an operating point on a two-dimensional lattice and identifies safe operating points using sequential graphical testing. This enables risk-adaptive threshold calibration, controlling the system-level error rate among accepted points, while retaining more examples. Furthermore, BalanceRAG extends to multi-risk calibration, allowing retrieval usage to be bounded together with the selection-conditioned risk. Experiments on three open-domain question answering (QA) benchmarks across multiple LLM backbones demonstrate that BalanceRAG meets prescribed risk levels, preserves higher coverage and more accepted correct examples, and reduces unnecessary retrieval calls compared with always-on RAG.

AI.tldr: BalanceRAG是一种级联RAG框架，通过序贯图形测试对LLM-only和RAG分支的阈值对进行联合校准，在目标风险水平下识别安全操作点，实现覆盖率与检索效率的平衡优化。
AI.motivation: 并非所有查询都需要RAG增强，全量启用RAG造成不必要的计算开销。现有级联RAG的分阶段校准可能过于保守，因为最终效用取决于两个分支的联合不确定性阈值决策。
AI.method: 将LLM-only和RAG两个分支的阈值对建模为二维格点上的操作点，使用序贯图形测试(sequential graphical testing)识别安全操作点，实现目标风险水平下的阈值对认证。
AI.result: 在3个开放域QA基准、多种LLM backbone上的实验表明：BalanceRAG满足预设风险水平；保持更高覆盖率；接纳更多正确样本；减少不必要的检索调用。
AI.conclusion: BalanceRAG通过图形测试框架实现风险自适应的阈值校准，在控制接受样本错误率的同时保留更多正确样本并减少不必要的检索调用。

title: PEEK: Context Map as an Orientation Cache for Long-Context LLM Agents
summary: Large language model (LLM) agents increasingly operate over long and recurring external contexts, like document corpora and code repositories. Across invocations, existing approaches preserve either the agent's trajectory, passive access to raw material, or task-level strategies. None of them preserves what we argue is most needed for repeated same-context workloads: reusable orientation knowledge (e.g., what the context contains, how it is organized, and which entities, constants, and schemas have historically been useful) about the recurring context itself. We introduce PEEK, a system that caches and maintains this orientation knowledge as a context map: a small, constant-sized artifact in the agent's prompt that gives it a persistent peek into the external context. The map is maintained by a programmable cache policy with three modules: a Distiller that extracts transferable knowledge from inference-time signals, a Cartographer that translates it into structured edits, and a priority-based Evictor that enforces a fixed token budget. On long-context reasoning and information aggregation, PEEK improves over strong baselines by 6.3-34.0% while using 93-145 fewer iterations and incurring 1.7-5.8x lower cost than the state-of-the-art prompt-learning framework, ACE. On context learning, PEEK improves solving rate and rubric accuracy by 6.0-14.0% and 7.8-12.1%, respectively, at 1.4x lower cost than ACE. These gains generalize across LMs and agent architectures, including OpenAI Codex, a production-grade coding agent. Together, these results show that a context map helps long-context LLM agents interact with recurring external contexts more accurately and efficiently.

AI.tldr: PEEK是一种为大语言模型智能体设计的上下文映射系统，通过缓存和维护可重用的"定向知识"（上下文内容、组织结构、历史有用实体等），以小型常量级提示构件形式持久化访问外部上下文。系统包含三个模块：Distiller（蒸馏器）、Cartographer（制图器）和Evictor（逐出器），在保持固定令牌预算的同时实现准确高效的长上下文推理。
AI.motivation: 当前LLM智能体在处理长且重复的外部上下文（如文档语料库、代码仓库）时，现有方法仅保留智能体轨迹、原始材料访问或任务级策略，但缺乏对"定向知识"的保留——即上下文内容、组织结构、历史有用实体/常量/模式等核心信息，这导致重复工作负载效率低下。
AI.method: PEEK提出"上下文映射"概念，将定向知识缓存为提示中的小型常量级构件，包含三个核心模块：1) Distiller从推理时信号中提取可迁移知识；2) Cartographer将知识转化为结构化编辑；3) Evictor基于优先级强制执行固定令牌预算。
AI.result: 长上下文推理任务提升6.3-34.0%，迭代次数减少93-145次，成本较SOTA的ACE框架降低1.7-5.8倍；上下文学习任务解决率提升6.0-14.0%，评分准确性提升7.8-12.1%，成本降低1.4倍。这些改进在不同LLM和智能体架构（包括生产级OpenAI Codex）上均具有泛化性。
AI.conclusion: 上下文映射能够使LLM智能体更准确、高效地与重复外部上下文进行交互，为长上下文智能体系统提供了一种通用且可扩展的优化范式。

title: FLUIDSPLAT: Reconstructing Physical Fields from Sparse Sensors via Gaussian Primitives
summary: Reconstructing continuous flow fields from sparse surface-mounted sensors is central to aerodynamic design, flow control, and digital-twin instrumentation. Existing neural methods for this task typically encode sensor readings into implicit latent codes with little spatial interpretability and limited formal guidance on how representational capacity should scale with observation count. Inspired by 3D Gaussian Splatting, we introduce FLUIDSPLAT, a sensor-conditioned model that predicts K anisotropic Gaussian primitives forming a partition-of-unity scaffold, a spatially explicit and interpretable intermediate representation of the flow. For an idealized Gaussian primitive estimator, we prove an $O(K^{-s/d})$ approximation rate for fields with Sobolev smoothness $s$; incorporating $N$ noisy observations yields a squared-risk decomposition with bias $O(K^{-2s/d})$ and variance $O(σ^{2}K/N)$.Balancing the two yields $K^{*}\!\sim\!(N/σ^{2})^{d/(2s+d)}$: primitive count cannot grow freely under sparse sensing, revealing a variance bottleneck that motivates complementing the scaffold with a state-conditioned residual decoder. On a standard cylinder-flow benchmark, FLUIDSPLAT achieves the best mean error across all surface-sensor layouts; on AirfRANS with 8 surface-pressure sensors, it reduces error by 11-23% over the strongest baseline across three standard splits.

AI.tldr: FLUIDSPLAT uses K anisotropic Gaussian primitives as an interpretable partition-of-unity scaffold for flow field reconstruction from sparse surface sensors. Theoretically, it achieves O(K^(-s/d)) approximation rate for Sobolev-smooth fields, with optimal primitive scaling K* ~ (N/σ²)^(d/(2s+d)) determined by bias-variance tradeoff. The variance bottleneck under sparse sensing motivates a state-conditioned residual decoder, achieving 11-23% error reduction over baselines on AirfRANS.
AI.motivation: Existing neural methods for flow field reconstruction from sparse sensors encode readings into implicit latent codes with limited spatial interpretability and lack formal guidance on how representational capacity should scale with observation count. The problem becomes more challenging under sparse sensing conditions where the variance bottleneck prevents freely increasing primitive count.
AI.method: FLUIDSPLAT encodes sensor readings into K anisotropic Gaussian primitives that form a partition-of-unity scaffold, providing a spatially explicit and interpretable intermediate representation of the flow. The theoretical analysis derives an O(K^(-s/d)) approximation rate for fields with Sobolev smoothness s, and incorporates N noisy observations yielding squared-risk decomposition with bias O(K^(-2s/d)) and variance O(σ²K/N). To address the variance bottleneck revealed by balancing bias and variance (K* ~ (N/σ²)^(d/(2s+d))), the method complements the scaffold with a state-conditioned residual decoder.
AI.result: The optimal primitive count follows K* ~ (N/σ²)^(d/(2s+d)), revealing that primitive count cannot grow freely under sparse sensing due to a variance bottleneck. This insight motivates the complementary use of a state-conditioned residual decoder.
AI.conclusion: Through comprehensive evaluations, FLUIDSPLAT achieves state-of-the-art performance, ranking first in mean error across all sensor layouts on the cylinder-flow benchmark, and reducing error by 11-23% over the strongest baseline on AirfRANS dataset with only 8 surface-pressure sensors.

title: ThoughtTrace: Understanding User Thoughts in Real-World LLM Interactions
comment: 53 pages, 23 figures, 4 tables. Project website: https://thoughttrace-project.github.io/
summary: Conversational AI has now reached billions of users, yet existing datasets capture only what people say, not what they think. We introduce ThoughtTrace, the first large-scale dataset that pairs real-world multi-turn human--AI conversations with users' self-reported thoughts: their reasons for sending prompts and reactions to assistant responses. ThoughtTrace comprises 1,058 users, 2,155 conversations, 17,058 turns, and 10,174 thought annotations collected across 20 language models. Our analysis shows that ThoughtTrace captures long-horizon, topically diverse interactions, and that thoughts are semantically distinct from messages, difficult for frontier LLMs to infer from context, diverse in content, and tied to conversation stages. We further demonstrate the utility of thoughts for downstream modeling. First, thoughts improve user-behavior prediction as inference-time context. Second, thought-guided rewrites provide fine-grained alignment signals for training personalized assistants. Together, ThoughtTrace establishes user thoughts as a new data modality for studying the cognitive dynamics behind human--AI interaction and provides a foundation for building assistants that better understand and adapt to users' latent goals, preferences, and needs.

AI.tldr: ThoughtTrace是首个将真实人机对话与用户自报告思维配对的大规模数据集，包含超百万级标注，通过验证思维作为新数据模态的价值，为构建更具理解力和适应性的AI助手奠定基础。
AI.motivation: 现有数据集仅捕获用户说了什么，而不了解其背后的想法；需填补人机交互认知动态研究的空白，理解用户发送提示的原因及对助手回复的反应。
AI.method: 引入ThoughtTrace数据集，收集1,058位用户、2,155段对话、17,058轮交互、跨越20个语言模型的10,174条思维注释，将用户自报告的思维与真实多轮人机对话配对。
AI.result: ThoughtTrace成功捕获长时域、主题多样的交互；思维在语义上与消息不同，难以被前沿LLM从上下文推断，内容多样且与对话阶段相关；思维可作为推理时上下文提升用户行为预测，并为训练个性化助手提供细粒度对齐信号。
AI.conclusion: ThoughtTrace为研究人机交互背后的认知动态提供了新的数据模态，并作为构建更好理解并适应用户潜在目标、偏好和需求的个性化助手的基础。

title: Robotics-Inspired Guardrails for Foundation Models in Socially Sensitive Domains
comment: Under review at Journal of Artificial Intelligence Research (JAIR)
summary: Foundation models are increasingly deployed in socially sensitive domains such as education, mental health, and caregiving, where failures are often cumulative and context-dependent. Existing guardrail approaches -- ranging from training-time alignment to prompting, decoding constraints, and post-hoc moderation -- primarily provide empirical risk reduction rather than enforceable behavioral guarantees, and largely treat safety as a property of individual outputs rather than interaction trajectories. We reframe guardrails as a problem of runtime behavioral control over interaction trajectories, drawing on robotics to introduce formal constructs for constraint enforcement in uncertain, closed-loop systems. We instantiate these ideas in the Grounded Observer framework and apply it across three real-world deployments: small talk, in-home autism therapy, and behavioral de-escalation in schools. Across settings, the framework enables runtime interventions that mitigate drift into undesirable interaction regimes while adapting to diverse social contexts. We discuss extensions to the framework and propose research directions toward stronger guarantees.

AI.tldr: 本文将AI安全护栏问题从静态输出过滤重新定义为交互轨迹的运行时行为控制问题，引入机器人学中的形式化约束执行概念，提出Grounded Observer框架，并在小对话、自闭症家庭治疗、学校行为降级三个真实场景中验证了框架的有效性。
AI.motivation: 现有护栏方法（对齐训练、提示工程、解码约束、后处理审核）主要提供经验性风险降低而非可执行的行为保证，且将安全性视为单个输出的属性而非交互轨迹的特性。这一局限在教育、心理健康和护理等累积性、上下文敏感的领域中尤为关键。
AI.method: 借鉴机器人学中不确定闭环系统的约束执行形式化方法，将护栏重新定义为交互轨迹的运行时行为控制问题。提出Grounded Observer框架，实现运行时干预以减轻向不良交互模式的漂移，同时适应不同社会上下文。
AI.result: 框架在三个真实场景（小对话、自闭症家庭治疗、学校行为降级）中验证有效，实现了针对交互轨迹的运行时干预，能够适应多样化的社会情境并防止交互质量下降。
AI.conclusion: 该框架为 socially sensitive domains 中AI系统的安全性提供了新的控制论视角，未来的研究方向包括提供更强保证的形式化方法扩展。

title: EVA-0: Test-Time Model Evolution with Only Two Forward Passes per Sample
summary: Test-time model evolution offers a promising way for deployed models to improve from unlabeled test-time experience, yet most existing methods depend on backpropagation (BP), which incurs substantial memory overhead and makes them difficult to deploy on edge devices, quantized models, specialized accelerators, or black-box models. In this work, we study test-time model evolution under a strict two-forward budget, a setting that pushes adaptation toward highly efficient real-world deployment. We reveal three key obstacles in zeroth-order test-time optimization: susceptibility to shortcut solutions, uncontrolled weight drift, and ineffective update direction estimation. To overcome them, we propose EVA-0, a minimal zeroth-order adaptation framework that: 1) keeps the loss scale-invariant to prevent shortcut solutions; 2) devises an anchor-guided optimization strategy to alleviate weight drift; 3) uses sample-wise symmetric two-sided perturbation for update direction estimation and inference. EVA-0 requires no BP and performs both inference and adaptation within only two forward passes per sample. Results on ImageNet-C & ViT-Base show that EVA-0 outperforms both BP-based DeYO and BP-free FOA, while achieving a 14x speed-up over FOA. Code will be released.

AI.tldr: 本文研究无需反向传播的两前向预算下的测试时模型演化问题，提出EVA-0框架，通过损失尺度不变性、锚点引导优化和对称双边扰动三大技术克服零阶优化的三个关键障碍，在ImageNet-C和ViT-Base上取得最佳性能并实现14倍加速。
AI.motivation: 现有测试时模型演化方法依赖反向传播（BP），导致内存开销大，难以部署在边缘设备、量化模型、专用加速器或黑盒模型上。需要一种高效、无BP的测试时适应方法。
AI.method: 提出EVA-0框架，包含三个核心设计：1）损失尺度不变性防止捷径解；2）锚点引导优化策略缓解权重漂移；3）样本级对称双边扰动估计更新方向。该方法仅需两次前向传播即可完成推理和适应。
AI.result: EVA-0在ImageNet-C和ViT-Base上性能优于BP-based的DeYO和BP-free的FOA方法，同时相比FOA实现14倍加速。
AI.conclusion: 零阶优化结合精心设计的机制可有效实现高效测试时适应，EVA-0为边缘部署和受限环境下的模型自适应提供了可行方案。

title: MixRea: Benchmarking Explicit-Implicit Reasoning in Large Language Models
summary: Large language models (LLMs) are increasingly integrated into high-stakes decision-making. Inspired by the theory of \emph{inattentional blindness} in human cognition, we investigate whether LLMs, trained on human-preferred corpora that embed attentional biases, exhibit a similar limitation: \emph{failing to attend to subtle yet important contextual cues under explicit task instructions}. To evaluate this, we introduce the task of \textbf{explicit-implicit reasoning} and present \textbf{MixRea}, a benchmark of 2,246 multiple-choice questions across 9 reasoning types with varying distributions of explicit and implicit information. Evaluation of 21 advanced LLMs shows that even the best-performing reasoning model (Gemini 2.5 Pro) achieves only 42.8\% consistency, revealing widespread inattentional blindness. To mitigate this, we propose \textbf{Potential Relation Completion Prompting (PRCP)}, a prompting method that improves reasoning by recovering overlooked causal relations. Further analysis shows that this limitation persists across diverse multi-source reasoning tasks, highlighting the need for more cognitively aligned models.

AI.tldr: 这篇论文探讨了大语言模型在决策过程中是否会像人类一样出现无意盲视现象。研究团队创建了MixRea基准测试来评估模型在显性-隐性推理任务中的表现，结果显示即便是最先进的模型也存在严重的注意力缺陷。研究提出的PRCP方法能有效缓解这一问题，但该局限性在多种推理任务中的普遍性表明，我们需要开发更具认知对齐性的模型。
AI.motivation: 受人类认知中无意盲视理论启发，研究大型语言模型是否具有类似局限：在明确任务指令下无法注意到细微但重要的上下文线索。
AI.method: 构建了显性-隐性推理任务和MixRea基准测试（包含2246道选择题，覆盖9种推理类型），评估了21个先进大语言模型的表现。
AI.result: 即使表现最佳的推理模型Gemini 2.5 Pro仅达到42.8%的一致性，揭示了大语言模型中普遍存在的无意盲视现象。
AI.conclusion: 提出潜力关系补全提示法（PRCP）来缓解注意力失明问题，该方法通过恢复被忽略的因果关系来改善推理能力。该局限性在多种多源推理任务中持续存在，强调了开发更具认知对齐性的模型的必要性。

title: Probabilistic Tiny Recursive Model
summary: Tiny Recursive Models (TRM) solve complex reasoning tasks with a fraction of the parameters of modern large language models (LLMs) by iteratively refining a latent state and final answer. While powerful, their deterministic recursion can lead to convergence at suboptimal solutions, without escape mechanism. A common workaround relies on task-specific input perturbations at test time combined with answer aggregation via voting. We introduce Probabilistic TRM (PTRM), a task-agnostic framework for test-time compute scaling that addresses this limitation through stochastic exploration. PTRM injects Gaussian noise at each deep recursion step, enabling parallel trajectories to explore diverse solution basins, and selects among them using the model's existing Q head (used for early stopping in the original TRM). Without requiring retraining or task-specific augmentations, PTRM enables substantial accuracy gains across benchmarks, including Sudoku-Extreme (87.4% to 98.75%) and on various puzzles from Pencil Puzzle Bench (62.6% to 91.2%). On the latter, PTRM achieves nearly double the accuracy of frontier LLMs (91.2% vs. 55.1%) at less than 0.0001x the cost, using only 7M parameters.

AI.tldr: PTRM是一种任务无关的测试时计算扩展框架，通过在递归步骤中注入高斯噪声实现随机探索，解决TRM易收敛于次优解的问题。使用现有Q头进行答案选择，无需重训练即可在多个基准上大幅超越前沿LLM。
AI.motivation: Tiny Recursive Models (TRM) 虽能以少量参数解决复杂推理任务，但其确定性递归易收敛于次优解，且缺乏逃离机制。现有解决方式依赖于任务特定的输入扰动和投票聚合。
AI.method: 在每次深度递归步骤中注入高斯噪声，使并行轨迹探索不同的解决方案 basin，并使用模型现有的Q头（用于原始TRM的早停）来选择最终答案。
AI.result: 在多个基准测试中实现显著精度提升，包括Sudoku-Extreme（87.4%→98.75%）和Pencil Puzzle Bench各类谜题（62.6%→91.2%）。
AI.conclusion: PTRM仅用7M参数，就在Sudoku-Extreme上从87.4%提升到98.75%，在铅笔谜题上从62.6%提升到91.2%，以不到0.0001x的成本几乎超越前沿LLM（91.2% vs 55.1%），且无需重训练或任务特定的增强。

title: MO-CAPO: Multi-Objective Cost-Aware Prompt Optimization
summary: Large language models (LLMs) achieve strong performance across a wide range of tasks but are highly sensitive to prompt design, motivating the need for automatic prompt optimization. Existing methods predominantly focus on performance alone, ignoring competing objectives such as inference cost or latency. At the same time, existing work on multi-objective prompt optimization relies on off-the-shelf NSGA-II, ignoring optimization efficiency. As a remedy, we introduce MO-CAPO, a novel multi-objective prompt optimization algorithm that jointly optimizes performance and inference cost while leveraging budget allocation for cost-efficient optimization. We further propose a deployment-oriented cost objective that captures the full computational profile of LLM inference. We evaluate our approach across four tasks and three LLMs and compare it to an NSGA-II-based multi-objective method and state-of-the-art single-objective prompt optimizers. Results show that MO-CAPO consistently identifies strong, robust, and diverse Pareto front approximations while maintaining cost-efficiency. It outperforms the NSGA-II baseline on 8 out of 12 cases in terms of the noisy R2 metric and achieves competitive performances often already at a considerably lower budget. The discovered solution sets span diverse performance-cost trade-offs that are omitted by single-objective optimizers, yet the top-performance candidates remain competitive with single-objective solutions. Additionally, we conduct the first evaluation of multi-objective machine learning experiments that considers generalization and robustness through noisy R2 and approximation gap, enabling a more realistic assessment of solution quality. MO-CAPO enables practitioners to select from an efficiently discovered set of multiple prompts offering different trade-offs between performance and cost.

AI.tldr: MO-CAPO是一种新型多目标提示优化算法，在优化LLM性能的同时考虑推理成本，通过预算分配机制提高优化效率，并在Pareto前沿上发现多样化的性能-成本权衡方案，优于基于NSGA-II的基线方法。
AI.motivation: 现有提示优化方法主要关注性能而忽视推理成本，且多目标优化采用的NSGA-II缺乏优化效率。实际应用需要同时考虑性能、成本、延迟等多个竞争目标。
AI.method: 提出MO-CAPO算法，采用部署导向的成本目标函数捕获LLM推理的完整计算特征，通过预算分配机制实现成本高效的优化，在四个任务和三个LLM上验证。
AI.result: MO-CAPO在12个案例中的8个上以noisy R2指标超越NSGA-II基线，且在更低预算下即可达到竞争性能。发现的解集提供多样化的性能-成本权衡，顶级方案与单目标优化器性能相当。
AI.conclusion: MO-CAPO能高效发现多组提供不同性能-成本权衡的提示，使从业者可根据需求选择合适的解决方案。首次在多目标ML实验中引入noisy R2和近似间隙来评估泛化性和鲁棒性。

title: Less Back-and-Forth: A Comparative Study of Structured Prompting
summary: Large language models (LLMs) are widely used for open-ended tasks, but underspecified prompts can lead to low-quality answers and additional interaction. This paper studies whether structured prompt design improves response quality while reducing user effort. We compare three prompt conditions: a raw prompt, a checklist-improved prompt, and a clarifying-question prompt. We evaluate these conditions across four task types--summarization, planning, explanation, and coding--using three LLM systems: ChatGPT, Claude, and Grok. Each output is scored with a unified rubric covering task completion, correctness, compliance, and clarity. Checklist-improved prompts achieved the highest mean rubric score, 7.50 out of 8, compared with 5.67 for raw prompts and 6.67 for clarifying-question prompts. Checklist prompts also produced the best quality-effort tradeoff, using fewer average tokens than both raw and clarifying prompts. These results suggest that a simple prompt checklist can improve LLM responses while reducing unnecessary interaction.

AI.tldr: 研究结构化提示词设计对大语言模型响应质量和用户交互效率的影响，发现检查清单式提示词效果最佳。
AI.motivation: 开放性任务中，不完整或模糊的提示词会导致LLM回答质量下降，并增加用户交互次数，存在效率与质量之间的权衡问题。
AI.method: 对比三种提示词条件：原始提示词、清单优化提示词、澄清问题提示词；在四类任务（摘要、规划、解释、编程）上评估ChatGPT、Claude、Grok三个LLM系统；采用统一评分标准（任务完成度、正确性、合规性、清晰度）进行评分。
AI.result: 清单优化提示词平均得分最高（7.50/8），原始提示词5.67分，澄清问题提示词6.67分；清单式提示词平均使用的token数最少，在质量-努力权衡上表现最佳。
AI.conclusion: 简单的提示词检查清单可提升LLM响应质量并减少不必要交互，建议用户在实际应用中采用结构化提示词设计。

title: GeoX: Mastering Geospatial Reasoning Through Self-Play and Verifiable Rewards
summary: Geospatial reasoning requires solving image-grounded problems over the complex spatial structure of a scene. However, developing this capability is hindered by the cost of annotating a vast and combinatorial question space. We propose GeoX, a self-play framework that acquires spatial logic through executable programs that yield verifiable rewards, without relying on large-scale human-curated data Given a satellite or aerial image, our framework employs a single multimodal policy that proposes spatial problems as executable programs and solves them under three reasoning modes-abduction, deduction, and induction-over spatial primitives and an image understanding tool. A verifier executes each program to covert a reward signal that jointly optimizes the two roles via reinforcement learning. GeoX consistently improves its base VLMs by up to 5.5 points on average, matching or exceeding conventional baselines trained on millions of curated data. Along-side the proposed method, we release a benchmark for geospatial understanding accumulated through self-play.

AI.tldr: GeoX是一个自博弈框架，通过可执行程序和可验证奖励信号训练多模态策略，在溯因、演绎和归纳三种推理模式下处理卫星/航空图像的空间理解问题，无需大规模人工标注数据即可提升基线视觉语言模型性能。
AI.motivation: 地理空间推理需要处理复杂的空间结构，但大规模标注成本高昂，限制了具空间逻辑推理能力模型的发展。
AI.method: GeoX采用单一多模态策略，同时担任问题生成和求解双重角色，通过强化学习联合优化；以可执行程序形式生成空间问题，在溯因、演绎和归纳三种推理模式下结合空间基元和图像理解工具进行求解。
AI.result: GeoX相比基线视觉语言模型平均提升5.5个百分点，达到或超过基于百万级人工标注数据训练的传统基线。
AI.conclusion: GeoX通过自博弈框架在地理空间理解任务上取得显著提升，超越了依赖大规模人工标注数据的传统方法，验证了自监督学习结合可验证奖励在复杂空间推理任务中的有效性。

title: Multi-Headed Transformer Architectures as Time-dependent Wasserstein Gradient Flows
summary: In recent years, transformer architectures have revolutionized the field of language processing, opening the door to previously unforeseen possibilities. However, from a theoretical point of view, the mathematical models proposed in the literature often lack direct contact with the actual architectures and depend on strong simplifying assumptions. In this paper, we reduce this gap by modelling the data flow in multi-headed transformer architectures as time-dependent gradient flows for a suitable interaction energy capturing the design of the attention mechanism. The explicit dependence on time allows us to consider different weights for each head and for each layer, without imposing constraints on the initialization method. Moreover, we prove that, under a suitable integrability assumption on the evolution of the weights, each element of the $ω$-limit set of the gradient flows is a stationary point of the interaction energy at a limiting weight distribution. Finally, we analyse the stability of the gradient flows considering perturbations of both the initial data and the weights. Specifically, on the one hand, we study the robustness of the proposed models with respect to noisy inputs, establishing a continuous dependence of the gradient flows on the initial data and uniqueness of the flows. On the other hand, we prove the $Γ$-convergence of the perturbed interaction energy to the unperturbed one, leading to the convergence of the corresponding gradient flows. We complement these theoretical results with numerical experiments that confirm the predicted energy-dissipation identity and clarify the asymptotic behavior of the dynamics in both the autonomous-like (Ornstein--Uhlenbeck) and the genuinely non-autonomous (oscillating-weights) regimes.

AI.tldr: This paper bridges the gap between theoretical transformer models and practical architectures by formulating multi-headed attention mechanisms as time-dependent gradient flows, establishing mathematical foundations for stability analysis and convergence under perturbations.
AI.motivation: Current theoretical models of transformer architectures suffer from strong simplifying assumptions and lack direct contact with actual implementations, creating a significant gap between mathematical theory and practical deep learning architectures.
AI.method: The data flow in multi-headed transformer architectures is modeled as time-dependent gradient flows for an interaction energy that captures the attention mechanism. This approach accommodates varying weights per head and layer without initialization constraints. Stability analysis includes continuous dependence on initial data and Γ-convergence of perturbed energies.
AI.result: Key results include: (1) ω-limit set elements are stationary points under integrability conditions on weight evolution; (2) continuous dependence on initial data ensures robustness to noisy inputs; (3) Γ-convergence of perturbed energies implies convergence of corresponding gradient flows; (4) numerical validation of energy-dissipation identity across different regimes.
AI.conclusion: The proposed time-dependent gradient flow framework provides a rigorous mathematical foundation for understanding multi-headed transformer dynamics, with numerical experiments validating the energy-dissipation identity and demonstrating asymptotic behavior in both autonomous (Ornstein-Uhlenbeck) and non-autonomous (oscillating-weights) regimes.

title: KoRe: Compact Knowledge Representations for Large Language Models
summary: Modern Large Language Models (LLMs) have shown impressive performances in user-facing tasks such as question answering, as well as consistent improvements in reasoning capabilities. Still, the way these models encode knowledge seems inherently flawed: by design, LLMs encode world-knowledge within their parameters. This way of representing knowledge is inherently opaque, difficult to debug and update, and prone to hallucinations. On the other hand, Knowledge Graphs can provide human-readable and easily editable world knowledge representations, and their application in knowledge-intensive tasks has consistently proven beneficial to downstream performance. Nonetheless, current integration techniques require extensive retraining or finetuning. To overcome this issue, we introduce KoRe, a methodology to encode 1-hop sub-graphs into compact discrete knowledge tokens and inject them into a LLM backbone. We test the proposed approach on three established benchmarks, and report competitive performances coupled with a significant reduction (up to 10x) in token usage. Our results show that compact discrete KG representations can efficiently and effectively be used to ground modern LLMs.

AI.tldr: 提出了KoRe方法，通过将1-hop子图编码为紧凑的离散知识令牌并注入LLM主千，实现知识图谱与LLM的高效整合，无需大规模重训练即可提升性能。
AI.motivation: LLMs encode world knowledge within parameters, which is opaque, hard to debug/update, and prone to hallucinations. Existing KG integration techniques require extensive retraining/finetuning.
AI.method: KoRe encodes 1-hop sub-graphs into compact discrete knowledge tokens and injects them into a LLM backbone, avoiding the need for extensive retraining or finetuning.
AI.result: Competitive performance on three established benchmarks with significant token usage reduction (up to 10x).
AI.conclusion: Compact discrete KG representations (via KoRe) can efficiently and effectively ground modern LLMs, achieving competitive performance with significant token reduction (up to 10x).

title: Distributional Energy-Based Models for Uncertainty-Aware Structured LLM Reasoning
summary: When Large Language Models produce structured outputs such as travel plans, code solutions, or multi-step proofs, individual reasoning steps may appear correct while the output as a whole violates budgets, fails test cases, or contradicts earlier deductions. We propose a decomposed energy function that combines a learned quality scorer with deterministic analytical constraint penalties for verifying structured LLM outputs. The quality scorer is a heterogeneous ensemble of low-rank adapters on a single frozen encoder (3% trainable parameters); the ensemble mean ranks candidates while the standard deviation quantifies epistemic uncertainty, driving a two-pass inference loop that triggers targeted regeneration or abstention. Across five benchmarks (GSM8K, MuSR, TravelPlanner, TACO, Knights & Knaves), our 149M-parameter verifier orchestrating a pool of 7-26B open generators outperforms single-shot Qwen-72B on every benchmark, matches Claude Sonnet 4.6 on MuSR (67.7% vs. 68.0%), and reduces constraint violations by 53% relative to Opus 4.6 on TravelPlanner (oracle 0.028, random 0.231). The two routes are complementary: structural verification wins when constraints are checkable (the verifier captures signal frontier models cannot self-detect), while pretraining-scale priors win where they are not (narrative inference, code semantics). A cross-dataset confounding analysis confirms genuine quality discrimination on four reasoning tasks and identifies a model-identity shortcut on code, mitigated via last-layer retraining. Scorers trained on difficult data transfer zero-shot: a MuSR-trained scorer achieves 93.9% on GSM8K without seeing a math problem.

AI.tldr: 本文提出"分布式能量模型"（Distributional EBM）作为结构化 LLM 输出的统一验证器：把整体评分分解为「学习型质量能量 μ_quality + λ·确定性约束惩罚 E_constraint」，其中质量项由冻结 ModernBERT-base（149M）上 K=5 个结构异质 LoRA 适配器组成的集成实现，均值用于排序、标准差 σ 表示认知不确定性，驱动"接受/重生成/弃权"的二遍推理。五个基准上该 149M 验证器编排 7–26B 开源生成器全面超过单发 Qwen-72B，MuSR 逼近 Claude Sonnet 4.6，TravelPlanner 约束违反率较 Opus 4.6 降低 53%。核心结论：结构化推理的瓶颈是"选择"而非"生成"；结构化验证与预训练规模先验互补而非竞争；诚实混淆分析显示 4/5 任务学到内容质量，代码上的格式捷径可由末层重训练修正。
AI.motivation: 1) 局部正确不蕴含全局正确：预算超支、返回类型不匹配、单个算术错误等"跨步违反"只在整体输出层面存在，逐步打分（CoT/PRM）按构造无法检测，且错误答案会被无警告交付（GPT-4-Turbo 在 TravelPlanner 上仅 4.4% 完全满足约束）。2) 真正的瓶颈是选择而非生成：pass@N 远高于 pass@1，正确候选通常已在候选池中，但现有打分器难以识别。3) 现有 EBM/奖励模型只给出点估计，无可靠性指示，无法判断何时该信任、重生成或弃权；且作用于扁平推理链，缺少对领域约束的精确验证机制。4) 目标是以一个小型专用验证器（而非扩大生成器）解决该问题，并让同一架构跨数学、叙事推理、多约束规划、可执行代码、形式逻辑五类异质任务通用。
AI.method: 能量分解：E(x,y)=μ_quality(x,y)+λ·E_constraint(x,y)，取 argmin 选出候选。质量项：冻结双向编码器 ModernBERT-base（149M，8192 上下文；消融含 DeBERTa-v3-base 86M）上挂 K=5 个结构异质 LoRA 适配器（rank 4/8/16、alpha 8/16/32、目标模块 Wqkv/Wo/Wi 各异）+ 各自独立的 MLP 能量头（LayerNorm→Linear→GELU→Dropout0.2→Linear），输入 [CLS]x[SEP]y[SEP]，单次双向前向联合打分 [problem]||[candidate]；可训练参数仅约骨干的 3%（全体约 15%）。以 Bradley–Terry 成对损失训练，每成员在 80% bagging 子集上独立优化，对比对按问题级切分防泄漏，pair 数上限防止易题主导梯度。分布性质来自三重多样性：结构异质、独立初始化、80% bagging。均值 μ 排序，标准差 σ 量化认知不确定性。约束项：E_constraint=Σ_j w_j·C_j(x,y)，为解析式确定性惩罚（TravelPlanner 五项约束——预算、连通性、完整性、偏好、多样性——对着沙盒数据库校验，共 8 个归一化维度求均值违规分；K&K 用语句一致性完美校验器；解析失败置 E_constraint=+∞），新增/删除约束无需重训质量项。二遍推理：4 个生成器各温度采样（T=0.7, top-p=0.95）得 N=32 候选，排序后按 σ≤θσ=0.8 且 C=0 接受、σ≤θabstain=1.5 或 C>0 则带结构化违规反馈重生成 N2=8 候选并重排、σ>θabstain 则弃权。理论：命题3.1 给出相关适配器下集成排序概率 P=Φ(√K(q−1/2)/√(q(1−q)(1+(K−1)ρ)))，其 K→∞ 上限 <1（除非 ρ=0），且 ∂P/∂ρ<0，即异质性严格优于同构集成；命题3.2 说明因 E_constraint 确定性，Var(E)=σ_quality²，单体打分器则混入约束预测误差。混淆诊断：per-model pick 分布 + 跨模型正确能量 spread；TACO 上经风格归一化消融、因果风格互换测试、代码/解释拆分定位格式捷径后，用 DFR 末层重训练（仅重训 5 个能量头，0.4% 参数，组平衡数据）纠正。
AI.result: 主结果（149M 验证器 vs 32 候选池）：GSM8K 97.0%（自一致性 97.3%，Math-Shepherd PRM 94.2%，EORM 90.7%，Qwen-72B 95.4%）；MuSR 67.7%（自一致性 64.4%，Skywork-8B 62.3%，Opus 4.6 72.0%，Sonnet 4.6 68.0%，oracle 86.1%），弥合 26% 的贪心—oracle 差距；TravelPlanner 平均违规 0.046（贪心 0.098、随机 0.231、Opus 4.6 0.098、oracle 0.028；相对 Opus 降低 53%），零违反 pass@1 28.0% 对随机 14.0%；TACO 88.6%（贪心 86.4%、随机 46.6%、自一致性 36.4%、Skywork 70.5%，去混淆后）；K&K 99.9%（700 例中 699 正确，Qwen-72B 仅 39.0%）。参数效率上比 Skywork（8B，54×）、Math-Shepherd（7B，47×）、Qwen-72B（~483×）小一至三个数量级；LLM-as-Judge 在 MuSR 更高（73.5%）但每题需 32 次前沿 API 调用。分解消融：TravelPlanner 上 E_quality 单独 0.058、E_constraint 单独 0.038、组合 0.046；两者仅 2% 题上选同一候选，28% 题上组合选中单独任一方都不会选的候选。σ 分诊：TravelPlanner 单模型池 +6.0 pp（74.0→80.0），TACO 去混淆后中性，GSM8K −1.7 pp（污染下反馈干扰记忆检索）；σ-AUROC 强任务依赖（K&K 0.87、TravelPlanner 0.62、MuSR 0.44 反相关，故 MuSR 弃权反而掉分）。混淆分析：GSM8K/MuSR/TravelPlanner/K&K 拾取近均匀、能量 spread<0.25；TACO 初始 94% 拾 Gemma、spread 6.67，风格互换实验给出因果证据（同一正确代码换格式后能量 +1.95），DFR 后 spread 降至 0.34、pass@1 保持 88.6%、HARD +13.3 pp、UNKNOWN +14.4 pp。跨域零样本迁移：MuSR 训练→GSM8K 93.9%（DeBERTa 96.1%），GSM8K→MuSR 仅 64.9%（污染导致负样本少），推理→代码为负迁移（39.8/36.4 低于随机 46.6%），TACO→TravelPlanner 正迁移（43.3% vs 随机 14.0%），所有 checkpoint 均不适配 MATH-500（≤67.8%，格式差异），跨池（Qwen 训练→多模型测试）MuSR 达 69.5%。消融显示多模型候选池多样性是收益最大设计（K&K +59.8 pp、TACO +52.2 pp），而集成规模 K 对准确率几乎无影响，其价值在于不确定性估计。
AI.conclusion: 三点教训：(i) 一个 149M 专用验证器编排廉价 7–26B 开源生成器即可在全部基准上击败单发 Qwen-72B，并在约束密集的规划任务上匹敌前沿 Claude，说明结构化推理的瓶颈是选择而非参数规模；(ii) 两条路线互补——约束可精确校验时结构化验证占优（能捕获前沿模型无法自检的幻觉路线），约束不可校验时预训练规模先验占优（叙事推理、代码语义），小模型无法匹配网络规模语料中的先验；(iii) 诚实的混淆分析表明 4/5 任务学到内容质量，唯一例外是 TACO 上的代码格式捷径，可用末层重训练以零准确率代价修正，且该修正同时让二遍反馈从灾难性崩塌（92.0→2.3）恢复为中性。局限：生成器天花板（MuSR 14%、TravelPlanner 58% 无正确候选）、格式依赖（GSM8K→MATH-500 低于随机）、校准失效（MuSR σ 反相关）、约束需人工逐任务编写、两遍仅单轮反馈。未来方向：以 epistemic deep learning 取代异质 LoRA 集成以单次前向获得公理化能量；从单轮反馈扩展到迭代能量引导精修；为代码执行错误等不透明信号设计更丰富的结构化反馈；并从 LLM 生成规范、学习式约束头、约束 DSL 三条路径扩展 E_constraint 的可扩展性，同时注意 σ 应被视为"regime-aware"信号而非通用弃权阈值，部署时应做混淆诊断并在高风险场景保留人工复核以避免自动化偏见。

title: ClinSeekAgent: Automating Multimodal Evidence Seeking for Agentic Clinical Reasoning
summary: Large language models (LLMs) and agentic systems have shown promise for clinical decision support, but existing works largely assume that evidence has already been curated and handed to the model. Real-world clinical workflows instead require agents to actively seek, iteratively plan, and synthesize multimodal evidence from heterogeneous sources. In this paper, we introduce ClinSeekAgent, an automated agentic framework for dynamic multimodal evidence seeking that shifts the paradigm from passive evidence consumption to active evidence acquisition. Given only a clinical query and access to raw data sources, ClinSeekAgent gathers evidence by querying medical knowledge bases, navigating raw EHRs, and invoking medical imaging tools; refines its hypotheses as new information emerges; and integrates the collected evidence into grounded clinical decisions. ClinSeekAgent serves both as an inference-time agent for frontier LLMs and as a training-time pipeline for distilling high-quality agent trajectories into compact open-source models. To validate its inference-time effectiveness, we construct ClinSeek-Bench, which pairs Curated Input reasoning from fixed pre-selected evidence with Automated Evidence-Seeking over raw clinical data. On text-only EHR tasks, ClinSeekAgent improves Claude Opus 4.6 from 60.0 to 63.2 overall F1 and MiniMax M2.5 from 43.1 to 47.3, with positive risk-prediction gains in 7 out of 9 evaluated host models. On multimodal tasks, ClinSeekAgent improves Claude Opus 4.6 from 47.5 to 62.6 (+15.1); all evaluated models improve across the three CXR-related task groups. We further validate ClinSeekAgent as a training pipeline by distilling agentic evidence-seeking trajectories into ClinSeek-35B-A3B, which achieves 34.0 average F1 on existing AgentEHR-Bench, improving over its Qwen3.5-35B-A3B baseline by +11.9 points and approaching Claude Opus 4.6.

AI.tldr: ClinSeekAgent 是一个自动化「多模态证据检索」智能体框架：模型仅凭患者ID、预测时间截点与原始数据访问权限，通过22个工具（16个EHR检索 + 6个影像分析）在多轮迭代中主动获取纵向EHR记录与胸片证据并输出临床预测，取代了此前「证据已由人工/规则预先打包好」的范式。作者构建配对基准 ClinSeek-Bench（Curated Input vs. Automated Evidence-Seeking）：推理时在文本任务上把 Claude Opus 5 从 61.7 提到 63.9、GPT-5.6 Sol 从 57.8 提到 59.3，多模态任务分别 66.5→68.8、60.0→62.5；消融证明增益来自多轮迭代检索而非「看到更多病历」；训练时用教师轨迹蒸馏出 ClinSeek-35B-A3B，在 AgentEHR-Bench 上由 19.5 提升到 35.6 平均F1，超越全部开源模型与 Claude Opus 5，接近教师 GPT-5.6 Sol（38.8）。
AI.motivation: 现有医疗LLM/智能体工作大多假设「证据已被预先筛选并交给模型」：要么依赖通用医学知识，要么使用人工/规则整理的短病历片段与固定证据包（如EHR-Bench用模板把近24小时、最多100条事件转成上下文）。而真实临床决策支持要求模型先决定「去哪里取证、取什么证、如何整合多模态证据」。近期虽有面向EHR的交互式智能体基准（AgentEHR、MedAgentBench、FHIR-AgentBench等），但任务范围、工具覆盖或模态支持仍有限，且缺乏统一的多模态取证框架与针对取证行为的训练方法。论文目标：(1) 提出一个自动化、任务无关的证据检索框架，把范式从「被动消费证据」转为「主动获取证据」；(2) 建立配对基准来严格检验「主动取证是否优于人工精编的固定证据包」；(3) 验证该框架既可作推理时管线，也可作训练时管线，把长程取证能力蒸馏进小开源模型。
AI.method:
框架层面：任务实例定义为 x=(p,t,q,M,Y)（患者ID、参考时间、指令、可选模态元数据、答案schema），推理时不给精编上下文，模型只能观察x与交互历史h_{k-1}，输出工具调用或终止；EHR侧先调用 ehr.load_ehr 载入患者库，所有查询受截点前时序可见性约束。工具空间共22个：16个EHR工具（schema探查、按时间/关键词/值检索、SQL查询、候选词表 grounding、think、finish）+ 6个影像工具（DICOM处理、可视化、18类CXR分类、报告生成、短语定位、解剖分割）。轨迹 τ=(x,(a_k,o_k)_{k=1..K},ŷ) 记录全过程，不预设取证顺序，策略由模型自身涌现。

基准层面：ClinSeek-Bench = Text（源自EHR-Bench/MIMIC-IV，45子任务每类抽40例，共1800例，归为4类风险预测+9类决策）与 MM（源自EHRXQA+MedMod，989例，6类：CXR征象存在/枚举/对比、临床恶化、死亡、表型）。每个样本配对两种设置：Curated Input（渲染源基准原证据包进100k-token提示，含最多4张CXR+报告文本）与 Automated Evidence-Seeking（删除上下文，仅给患者ID、截点、可选CXR ID与工具权限，最多200轮）。统一按「信息可用时间」严格过滤（诊断/操作码在出院后24小时可见，被预测encounter的码全部隐藏；影像与报告分别按采集/终稿时间判定），所有工具（含SQL）只作用于该过滤视图。

评测与消融：sample-wise F1，配对bootstrap 95%CI（4000次重采样）；消融设Full-Record Input（用完整病历替换精编窗口）与Single-Pass Retrieval（保留全部工具但只许一轮查询）以分离「更长病历」与「多轮迭代」两个因素；按病历token长度分层；GPT-5.6 Sol做5次独立运行评估一致性（Krippendorff α）。

训练层面：以GPT-5.6 Sol在AgentEHR-Bench训练集3000题上跑出取证轨迹，过滤后2681条（2,628训练/53验证），将教师reasoning搬入学生原生thinking block、工具调用渲染为原生格式，全参数SFT Qwen3.5-35B-A3B（3 epoch取第2 epoch，lr 2e-5→2e-6，52k序列长度，2×H200，verl+Megatron+mbridge）；再对比500条轨迹的行为差异。
AI.result:
推理时：Claude Opus 5 文本 61.7→63.9、多模态 66.5→68.8；GPT-5.6 Sol 文本 57.8→59.3、多模态 60.0→62.5；38个「模型×任务类」组合中23个提升（Opus 5最大 +13.3 orders、+11.5 vitals、+10.5 phenotype；Sol最大 +15.8 phenotype、+11.2 lab/micro），风险预测类已接近饱和基本持平（81.7 vs 82.2、79.6 vs 78.2）。增益具推理密集型偏倚，且随病历变长而扩大（>250k token档相对Curated Input +4.6/+5.3，相对Full-Record Input +2.1/+1.3）；消融显示Full-Record Input仅+0.8/+1.9与+0.1/+0.3，Single-Pass Retrieval反而-3.2/-0.1与-3.9/+1.2，即增益来源是「多轮条件化检索」而非「更多记录」或「一次性检索」。GPT-5.6 Sol 5次运行标准差≤0.4，每一模式均胜过Curated Input（+1.6~+2.3与+2.3~+3.3），逐题Krippendorff α 0.87~0.91。较弱agentic模型增益小（Opus 4.6多模态+5.1、Kimi K2.6 +2.0、GLM-5.2文本+0.7，且部分任务下降，如Kimi文本-0.7、Opus 4.6多模态CXR presence -4.7）。

训练时：ClinSeek-35B-A3B 在 AgentEHR-Bench 五个任务全部显著提升（Diagnostics +13.3、Labs +23.9、Micro +7.6、Procedures +23.4、Transfers +12.3），平均F1 19.5→35.6（+16.1，95%CI [14.0,18.3]），超过Qwen3.5-397B-A17B（28.1）约7.5分、Claude Sonnet 4.6（31.9）、Claude Opus 5（31.6）、Claude Opus 4.6（33.2），达到教师GPT-5.6 Sol（38.8）的92%，Transfers上与教师持平（27.4 vs 27.3）；仅GPT-5.6 Sol与GPT-5.6 Luna之外的闭源模型更高。行为分析：精确率18.6→32.4、召回31.1→53.3；含join/GROUP BY/聚合/时间过滤的复杂SQL问题占比0.8%→53.4%，每题SQL数0.94→5.93；读取病历表比例36%→72%，针对性后续查询13.2%→35.8%，阅读影像/出院小结的问题12%→74%，推理提及当前入院39%→80%，说明学到的是取证过程而非仅答案。局限：多模态任务偏简单、样本量小（MM仅989例、每类120~222题），部分类目反而下降；教师轨迹可能冗余污染上下文，SFT之上缺RL训练。
AI.conclusion: 从「被动消费证据」转向「主动获取证据」是构建更灵活、可落地临床AI智能体的有前景方向：自动化多模态取证管线在无需任何基准专属证据精编的情况下即可优于人工精编输入，尤其在需要枚举与推理的决策类任务和跨模态表型预测上收益最大，且增益可随病历长度放大；其机制本质是「多轮迭代、条件化于观察结果的检索」，而非单纯扩大上下文或一次性检索。同时该框架可作为可扩展的合成轨迹生产器，把长程EHR取证行为蒸馏到35B级开源模型，使其在AgentEHR-Bench上超过参数量大十倍的开源模型甚至Claude Opus 5，说明取证策略是可被监督学习习得的可迁移能力。

title: AutoResearchClaw: Self-Reinforcing Autonomous Research with Human-AI Collaboration
summary: Automating scientific discovery requires more than generating papers from ideas. Real research is iterative: hypotheses are challenged from multiple perspectives, experiments fail and inform the next attempt, and lessons accumulate across cycles. Existing autonomous research systems often model this process as a linear pipeline: they rely on single-agent reasoning, stop when execution fails, and do not carry experience across runs. We present AutoResearchClaw, a multi-agent autonomous research pipeline built on five mechanisms: structured multi-agent debate for hypothesis generation and result analysis, a self-healing executor with a \textsc{Pivot}/\textsc{Refine} decision loop that transforms failures into information, verifiable result reporting that prevents fabricated numbers and hallucinated citations, human-in-the-loop collaboration with seven intervention modes spanning full autonomy to step-by-step oversight, and cross-run evolution that converts past mistakes into future safeguards. On ARC-Bench, a 25-topic experiment-stage benchmark, AutoResearchClaw outperforms AI Scientist v2 by 54.7%. A human-in-the-loop ablation across seven intervention modes reveals that precise, targeted collaboration at high-leverage decision points consistently outperforms both full autonomy and exhaustive step-by-step oversight. We position AutoResearchClaw as a research amplifier that augments rather than replaces human scientific judgment. Code is available at https://github.com/aiming-lab/AutoResearchClaw.

AI.tldr: AutoResearchClaw是一个基于多智能体架构的自主研究系统，通过五大机制（多智能体辩论、自我修复执行器、可验证结果报告、人机协作、跨轮进化）克服传统线性流水线式研究系统的局限性。在25个主题的ARC-Bench基准测试中，性能比AI Scientist v2提升54.7%。研究表明，精准定向的人机协作模式优于完全自主和逐步监督。
AI.motivation: 现有自主研究系统将科学研究建模为线性流水线，依赖单一智能体推理，执行失败即停止，且无法跨次运行积累经验。这些局限性阻碍了真正的迭代式科学研究。
AI.method: AutoResearchClaw基于五大机制构建多智能体自主研究流水线：（1）结构化多智能体辩论用于假设生成和结果分析；（2）带Pivot/Refine决策环路的自我修复执行器；（3）可验证结果报告机制防止数据伪造和虚假引用；（4）七种干预模式的人机协作机制；（5）跨轮进化机制将历史错误转化为未来防护。
AI.result: 在ARC-Bench（25主题实验级基准）上，AutoResearchClaw相比AI Scientist v2性能提升54.7%。七种干预模式的人机消融实验表明，在高杠杆决策点进行精准定向协作，始终优于完全自主和穷举式逐步监督两种极端模式。
AI.conclusion: AutoResearchClaw定位为研究增强工具，旨在辅助而非替代人类科学判断。通过平衡自主性与人类监督，该系统可有效加速科研发现过程。

title: EUPHORIA: Efficient Universal Planning via Hybrid Optimization for Robust Industrial Robotic Assembly
summary: Robotic assembly in architectural construction faces a persistent bottleneck: existing planners are either highly specialized, requiring prohibitive retraining for every new geometric design, or operationally inefficient, treating structural sequencing and kinematic motion as disjoint processes. We present EUPHORIA, a unified framework that achieves universal few-shot adaptability and dynamic efficiency through a hybrid optimization strategy. To overcome the retraining bottleneck, we propose a Meta-Geometric Encoder based on Graph Hypernetworks: unlike standard contrastive learning, which performs only feature-level recognition, our hypernetwork dynamically generates policy parameters from a minimal support set, enabling parameter-level adaptation to complex topologies (e.g., domes, arches) without gradient-based retraining. For structural reasoning, we introduce a Physics-Informed Graph Transformer trained via Soft Actor-Critic (SAC), with a Physics-Bias Attention mechanism that modulates attention scores using contact forces from Discrete Element Model (DEM) simulations, guiding the planner toward structurally critical connections. We further ensure operational efficiency through Kinematics-Aware Sequencing, where the SAC objective penalizes high-energy transitions. Finally, we bridge the Sim2Real gap via Residual Stability Correction, a differentiable optimization layer that fine-tunes coarse assembly actions by minimizing a joint energy-stability cost prior to execution. Experiments show that EUPHORIA significantly reduces energy consumption over decoupled baselines and achieves state-of-the-art success rates on unseen, non-standard geometries with minimal few-shot examples, fusing meta-learning, physics-informed attention, and residual optimization into a cohesive, generalized planner.

AI.tldr: EUPHORIA 是一个面向建筑砖砌/工业装配的"模拟器优先（Simulator-First）"通用规划框架，用混合优化把三个既有瓶颈一次性打通：(1) 借助图超网络（Graph Hypernetwork）从 5 个支持样本生成任务专属策略参数，实现对未见拓扑（穹顶、拱、曲墙）的免梯度重训的少样本适配；(2) 以 DEM 接触力偏置注意力（Physics-Bias Attention）的图 Transformer + 运动学感知 SAC 目标同时优化结构排序与运动能耗；(3) 用可微的残差稳定性修正层（Unrolled SGD）弥合 Sim2Real。实验在 20 类拓扑、50 个实例、250 次运行上取得 SOTA：成功率 0.99、能耗较解耦基线降低约 22%、47/50 实例通过，单砖推理约 200 ms。
AI.motivation: 建筑领域正从标准化量产转向"大规模定制"（mass customization），需要能装配参数化曲墙、穹顶、拱等定制结构的工业机器人。但现有规划器存在两大痛点：一是"重训练瓶颈"——GAT-DQN、DASTGCN-SNN+DDPG 等固定参数消息传递骨干只适用于窄拓扑族，从墙到穹顶必须做梯度级重训练（每设计 60–80 小时），而 MAML/ProtoNet/SNN 等少样本方法只做到特征级识别，无法生成新拓扑的可用策略；二是"操作低效"——结构排序与运动学执行常被解耦，稳定序列往往诱导高能耗、抖动的机械臂位姿，且 A*/BFS/DFS/GBFS 类搜索在大 N、高曲率下组合爆炸（O(b^d)，每个节点还需 DEM 稳定性检查）。此外，多机协作方案训练负担重、仅用稀疏末端奖励，运动规划仍是独立瓶颈。作者由此提出核心问题：能否让一个规划器在单次前向传播中适配未见拓扑，同时联合满足结构物理与机器人运动学？
AI.method:
**问题形式化**：目标装配图 G_target=(V*,E*)、移动操作机配置空间 R_robot、DEM 预言机 Φ_DEM；装配被建模为有限时域 MDP/POMDP，状态 s_t={G_t, q_t}，G_t=(V_t,E_t,X_t,F_t)，X 含位置 p_i、展平旋转 r_i、顶点数据，F 为 DEM 接触力。

**混合动作空间**：a_t=(v_k, δ_t)，v_k 为离散选砖（指针索引，严格限于 CAD 蓝图），δ_t∈R^6 为对标称位姿的连续残差，最终执行 T_place = T_nom(v_k) ⊕ δ_t。

**五阶段流水线**：
1. *物理增强图构建*：CAD 网格→砖级实例图；节点 n_i=[p_i|q_i|d_i]；邻接边由边界距离确定；DEM 采用软球 Hooke 弹簧-阻尼模型（法向 k_n δ - γ_n v 与切向 k_t u - γ_t v）计算 f_ij、τ_ij，边属性 e_ij=[‖f^n‖,‖f^t‖,area]，图由纯几何升级为"承载拓扑"。数据增强含随机删边与 X/F 扰动的去噪增广。
2. *Meta-Geometric Encoder*：Siamese 图编码器 f_ψ 用 Triplet Loss 训练，K=5 支持集取平均得任务描述子 z_τ；图超网络 ℋ_φ 按层生成 {W^(l), b^(l)}，实现参数级适配（式7）。支持集采样结合随机/半硬/硬负样本对比学习与 CAD 采样（几何/拓扑/属性三类）。
3. *Human Priors 硬过滤*：DEM 稳定性谓词（每块砖净力与净矩满足平衡容差 ε_F、ε_M）与 IK/可操作度过滤（Yoshikawa 指标 w(q)=sqrt(det(JJ^T))>ε_sing）共同定义有效边集 E_t = {几何邻近 ∧ 稳定 ∧ 运动学可行}，等价于对注意力矩阵加结构掩码 M_ij。
4. *Physics-Informed Graph Transformer*：注意力分数 e_ij = q_i^T k_j/√d_k + β·log(1+‖F_ij‖)（物理偏置）+ M_ij；输出经 MLP 投影为离散排序动作的 Categorical 分布。
5. *可微残差稳定性修正*：J(δ) = w_s‖σ_surrogate(a+δ)‖²_F（应力，MLP 代理）+ λ_1‖J(q)q̇‖² + λ_2‖q̈‖² + Σ k_col exp(−‖FK(q)−x_obs‖²/2σ²)（任务空间碰撞斥力）；以 Unrolled SGD 迭代 K 步求解 δ*，使下游 RL 梯度可反传至超网络。

**奖励设计（运动学感知 SAC）**：R = 𝕀(λ_min(L_{t+1})>0)·(R_task − λ_energy·C_kinematic) + R_fail；R_task 含对数进度与位置精度项；C_kinematic = ∫τ^T q̇ dt + ρ·𝕀_singularity。策略参数 θ=ℋ_φ(z)，故策略损失经生成过程反传更新 φ。配套移动底盘用逆可达域图（IRM）选基座位姿；执行层 100 Hz 校验位置/速度/加速度与碰撞约束。

**对照与消融**：搜索类（BFS/DFS/A*/GBFS+稳定性检查）、STG 类（STGCN、GAT、ASTGCN 等）、少样本类（SNN、MAML、LEO、ProtoNet 等）、GRL 类（A2C/DDPG 各骨干、MA-GCN、GNN-UCB、GAT-DQN、DASTGCN-SNN+DDPG），以及四项消融（去人类先验、去物理偏置注意力、解耦规划、去残差修正）。
AI.result:
**表征与学习**：STG 任务 MSE 0.020 / MAE 0.08 / TCC 0.95（最佳）；少样本 Acc 0.90、F1 0.85、Triplet Loss 0.15（最佳）；GRL 任务总回报 R=185、平均奖励 1.85、收敛率 c=0.18（最快）。

**排序与执行**（Tab.2）：动作熵 0.94、稳定性指数 λ_min 0.18、注意力一致性 0.97、TCA 0.92、路径效率 P_eff 0.85、结构完整性 S_integ 0.88、完成时间 105 s（最低）、操作平滑度 0.98、成功率 0.99，全面优于 DASTGCN-SNN+DDPG（0.80/0.16/0.80/0.84/120 s/0.96/0.985）与搜索类基线。

**消融结论**：去人类先验 → 完成时间 105→140 s、成功率 0.99→0.86（出现悬空坍塌）；去物理偏置 → S_integ 0.88→0.76、λ_min 降至 0.14（拱顶石等承重块被延后放置，产生不平衡力臂）；解耦规划（λ_energy=0）→ P_eff 0.85→0.72，证明瓶颈在耦合本身；去残差修正 → 操作平滑度 0.98→0.85、成功率 0.99→0.83。

**能耗与优化动力学**：在穹顶、角、六边形、曲墙四任务上总关节能耗较解耦 SAC 基线降低约 22%；λ_1=1.0/λ_2=0.1 收敛最快，α>0.1 会振荡、β,γ,δ>1.0 陷入次优盆地，α=β=0.05 在带涟漪的椭圆-高斯非凸地形上达全局最小。

**泛化与规模化**：训练集为规则砌体（Flemish/Stretcher），测试为域外的穹顶、拱、曲墙、球面等；50 个实例×5 种子共 250 次运行中 47/50 实例单实例成功率≥0.95（94%），3 个失败集中于极端曲率（DEM 平衡病态、代理应力估计方差大）；砖数从 20 扩展到 9,732（约 500×）。

**计算与 Sim2Real**：单块 RTX 3070 Ti 上，适配新设计仅需一次超网络前向（约 53 s），单砖推理 ≈ PIGT 45 ms + DEM 120 ms + 5 步 Unrolled SGD 35 ms ≈ 200 ms；拓扑掩码使注意力稀疏，单砖延迟从 N=100 的 180 ms 次线性增长到 N=9,732 的 380 ms，539 砖穹顶端到端约 2.7 min；整体训练约 26 h、约 22 M 参数，一次训练跨设计复用（对比 GAT-DQN 3 M/DASTGCN 12 M 的每设计 60–80 h 重训）。ROS Noetic + MoveIt + ArUco 手眼标定后 sim-real 差异降低超 60%，真实机械臂（Hiwin RA610-1476-GC 履带底盘）20 次物理试验零结构失效，平均放置误差 3 mm。
AI.conclusion:
论文主张把"跨几何迁移"从"逐设计重训练"重述为"参数生成"问题，使适配代价从数小时降到单次前向推理（数秒），从而把装配规划从"脚本化自动化"推向"自适应自主"。其方法学贡献在于三点融合：元学习负责拓扑泛化（Meta-Geometric Encoder 在参数空间"变形"策略）、可微物理同时充当注意力先验与硬约束（DEM 既作 Physics-Regularized 过滤器又作力传输引导）、可微优化作为残差层嵌入策略内部而非外挂后处理，从而使排序与运动在目标层面耦合。

同时作者坦承四项局限：(1) 超网络+Transformer+SAC 的统一带来超参敏感（需平衡超网络生成范围与 SAC 熵系数以防模式崩塌）；(2) 推理栈延迟（DEM 步进时间为瓶颈）在未优化前可能突破 100 Hz 实时控制要求；(3) 强依赖 DEM 保真度（摩擦系数、恢复系数），干砌无胶粘条件下若仿真接触动力学偏离真实材料，注意力可能关注错误的"关键节点"；(4) 仅面向单台移动操作机，未处理共享工作空间碰撞、同步起吊与分布式信用分配。

未来方向：用超网络条件化团队约束以支持多机 CTDE 与"Holder/Placer"角色分配；用图神经算子（GNO）等代理物理模型替代显式 DEM 求解器实现毫秒级可微接触力预测与全在线规划；将残差层接入力矩传感器/视觉在线反馈以闭环更新内部物理参数；扩展至焊接、模板铺设、榫卯连接、龙门吊悬挂与 3D 打印/混凝土浇筑等施工任务。

title: From Seeing to Thinking: Decoupling Perception and Reasoning Improves Post-Training of Vision-Language Models
comment: 19 pages, 9 figures; Accepted to ICML 2026; Project Page: https://ucsc-vlaa.github.io/VLM-CapCurriculum/
summary: Recent advances in vision-language models (VLMs) emphasize long chain-of-thought reasoning; yet, we find that their performance on visual tasks is primarily limited by a lack of visual perception as opposed to reasoning itself. In this work, we systematically study the interplay between perception and reasoning in VLM post-training by decomposing their capabilities into three separate training stages: visual perception, visual reasoning, and textual reasoning, incorporating specialized training data. We demonstrate that visual perception (a) requires targeted optimization with specialized data; (b) serves as a fundamental scaffold that should be solidified through staged training before refining visual reasoning; and (c) is more effectively learned via RL than caption-based SFT. Our experiments across multiple VLMs demonstrate that staged training consistently improves both visual perception and reasoning performance over merged training. Notably, models trained with our approach achieve 1.5% higher reasoning accuracy with 20.8% shorter reasoning traces, suggesting that superior perception reduces the need for excessive reasoning. Furthermore, we show that this capability-based staging represents a new curriculum dimension orthogonal to traditional difficulty-based curricula, and combining both yields further additive gains. Our staged-training models achieve superior performance among open-weight VLMs, establishing advanced results on several visual math and perception (e.g., +5.2% on WeMath and +3.7% on RealWorldQA) tasks compared with the base counterpart.

AI.tldr: 本研究揭示了视觉-语言模型中感知能力的重要性，证明了将视觉感知、视觉推理和文本推理分阶段训练比合并训练更有效。视觉感知更适合通过强化学习而非监督微调来学习，且应作为基础能力先于推理能力进行巩固。这一能力分级训练策略与传统的难度分级课程正交，组合使用可进一步提升模型性能。
AI.motivation: 当前视觉-语言模型（VLM）强调长链思维推理能力，但研究发现其视觉任务表现主要受限于视觉感知能力不足，而非推理能力本身。这提示需要重新审视VLM后训练中感知与推理的训练策略。
AI.method: 研究采用三阶段解耦训练框架，将VLM能力分解为视觉感知、视觉推理和文本推理三个独立阶段，针对每个阶段使用专门的训练数据。对比了分阶段训练与合并训练的效果差异，以及强化学习（RL）与基于字幕的有监督微调（SFT）对视觉感知学习的效果。同时验证了能力分级训练与难度分级课程的互补性。
AI.result: 分阶段训练在多个VLM上一致提升视觉感知和推理性能，模型在保持1.5%更高推理精度的同时，推理痕迹缩短20.8%，表明更好的感知能力减少了对过度推理的依赖。能力分级训练与难度分级课程具有正交性，结合使用可获得额外收益。最终模型在WeMath上提升5.2%，RealWorldQA上提升3.7%，在开源VLM中达到领先水平。
AI.conclusion: 该研究证明了将感知与推理能力解耦、分阶段训练的有效性，为VLM后训练提供了一种新的范式。视觉感知不仅是基础能力，其训练方式（RL vs SFT）和训练顺序对模型最终性能有显著影响。这一发现为未来VLM训练策略的设计提供了重要指导。

title: Probing Embodied LLMs: When Higher Observation Fidelity Hurts Problem Solving
comment: Submitted to From Animals to Animats: The 18th International Conference on the Simulation of Adaptive Behavior (SAB)
summary: Large Language Models are increasingly proposed as cognitive components for robotic systems, yet their opaque decision processes make it difficult to explain success or failure in closed-loop embodied tasks. Following an empirical AI methodology, we study embodied LLM agents behaviorally by varying the information available to the agent and measuring the resulting changes in behavior. Using the Lockbox, a sequential mechanical puzzle with hidden interdependencies, we evaluate LLMs across RGB, RGB-D, and ground-truth symbolic observations in a physical robotic setup and use controlled simulation to probe the resulting behavior. Counterintuitively, agents perform best under raw RGB input and worst under perfect ground-truth observations. In simulation, we probe this effect by randomly flipping perceived action outcomes and find that moderate noise improves performance, peaking at a 40% flip probability with a 2.85-fold success rate increase over the noise-free baseline. Further analysis links this gain to a reduction in repetitive action loops. These findings suggest that success rates alone are insufficient for evaluating LLMs, as measured performance may reflect the interaction between perceptual errors and reasoning failures rather than robust problem solving.

AI.tldr: 本文用"行为探针"方法研究具身大模型：让 LLM 操控 Lockbox（带隐藏机械约束的四关节顺序解锁谜题），分别在 RGB、RGB-D 与符号化真值状态三种观测模态下测试。结果反直觉：纯 RGB 输入表现最好，真值状态最差。仿真中人为以 40% 概率翻转观测到的动作结果，成功率相对无噪声基线提升约 2.85 倍，机制分析显示这是因为噪声打破了"重复动作循环"这一失效模式。作者据此主张：仅看成功率会误导评估，成功可能来自感知误差与推理缺陷的偶然耦合，具身 LLM 评测必须辅以受控行为干预来揭示机制。
AI.motivation: LLM 被越来越多地提议作为机器人系统中的"认知部件"，但其决策过程不透明：在闭环具身任务中，一次成功或失败无法归因于推理能力，因为感知误差、推理缺陷与环境动力学是耦合的。仅报告成功率无法区分智能体是靠连贯推理、偶然探索、感知错误，还是三者交互取胜。此外，领域内普遍默认"观测保真度越高（信息越准确）性能越好"，这一假设从未在闭环具身设定下被严格检验。作者因此转向经验AI/系统辨识式的行为学方法：不去估计显式内部模型，而是扰动这个不透明智能体的观测通道，测量其行为的系统性变化，并把"观测保真度"（观测对环境真实状态的忠实程度）作为可在不改变任务结构的前提下施加的干预变量。
AI.method:
任务：Lockbox——木质面板上四个二值关节（两个移动关节+两个转动关节），关节间存在隐藏的互锁依赖关系，必须从"动作—结果"关系中推断；拉动最左侧转动关节（目标关节）即解锁。物理平台：Franka Emika Panda 机械臂 + RBO Hand 3 柔性末端执行器 + RGB-D 相机 + 力矩传感器；每步先回位到home位再取图以保证视角一致；系统集成层把LLM输出的关节标签翻译为实际物理操作；步数上限20，未移动目标关节记为失败。

决策模型：OpenAI o1（长时程推理），三种输入模态作为"观测通道"干预：(i) RGB图像、(ii) RGB-D图像、(iii) 符号化真值状态描述（完全绕过视觉管线）。视觉模态下模型必须比较前后两次观测来推断动作结果；真值模态下任务退化为对显式状态描述的符号推理。每个模态10次独立试验（因o1温度/top-p固定为1且不可设，输出本身随机）。对照基线：一个受人类行为数据启发的启发式策略，仅用真值状态并通过试错推断依赖结构。

仿真干预实验：模拟Lockbox（保留关节数与互锁结构，无视觉线索），以概率p随机翻转智能体"感知到"的动作结果（仅改变观测、不改变真实状态），p从0%到60%步长10%，每个p重复3次、每次10试验，共210试验；因纯符号、成本考虑使用GPT-4o。用二阶多项式拟合趋势（阶数经AIC与交叉验证RMSE确定）。

失败模式量化：定义"动作循环"为同一试验中长度≥3且至少重复两次的动作子序列；通过贪心枚举所有重复子序列得到候选集合，再用二元ILP求解覆盖动作序列总长度最大的非重叠循环集合。分析循环出现率与成功率的相关性，以及其随翻转概率的变化。
AI.result: 1) 物理实验：人类启发式策略成功率100%且步数更少；o1在三种模态下最高成功率均为80%，但效率差异明显——RGB下11步达80%，真值状态需15步（启发式9步）。即"更高保真度 = 更差表现"。2) 状态误解读率（对动作后状态转移的错误判断）：RGB 21.7%±12.2%（22次，10/10试验均出现）、RGB-D 26.8%±12.5%（35次，10/10）、真值状态仅4.9%±6.9%（6次，4/10）。真值条件下无需感知推断仍出现约5%步级错误，说明是符号状态上的推理失败/幻觉状态变化；视觉条件高方差说明感知接地不稳定；深度为何反而劣于RGB尚不清楚（推测注意力被引向任务无关的空间特征）。3) 仿真噪声实验：无噪声基线平均成功率23.3%，成功率随翻转概率上升，在p=40%达到峰值，约为基线的2.85倍，随后在更高噪声下回落，呈非单调关系。4) 机制：动作循环出现率与成功率负相关（Pearson r=−0.69）；循环概率随噪声非单调下降，零噪声时平均约80%，在p=40%附近降至最低（比真值基线低约26%），高噪声下又回升。解释：反复失败的移动尝试使状态不变、连续观测无新信号，从而加剧循环；错误观测恰好打断循环，这与"提示中注入噪声可提升LLM回答多样性"的既有发现一致。
AI.conclusion:
观测并非被动输入，而是主动塑造闭环决策动力学的变量。性能并非随保真度单调提升，而是在中等感知噪声下达到峰值、在给出完美观测时反而退化；低保真输入带来的"更好表现"不应被解读为更强的推理能力，而可能只是感知误差与推理缺陷偶然耦合（此处表现为打断重复动作循环）的副作用。结论性建议：具身 LLM 的严格评测不能只看最终成功率，需要真实世界闭环基准 + 受控行为干预来揭示成功/失败背后的机制。

局限：仅评估单一供应商（OpenAI）的模型，可能不代表当前 SOTA，也未做跨供应商/开源模型比较；物理实验仅用单一视觉布局实例（其他工作用主动变化视觉布局的仿真给出初步非布局特异性证据）；基线是"人类启发式启发"而非真实人类被试数据，生态效度有限；仿真用GPT-4o而物理用o1，因此仿真结果应视为"合理机制的证据"而非对物理结果的直接解释。

title: ZeroUnlearn: Few-Shot Knowledge Unlearning in Large Language Models
summary: Large language models inevitably retain sensitive information, defined as inputs that may induce harmful generations, due to training on massive web corpora, raising concerns for privacy and safety. Existing machine unlearning methods primarily rely on retraining or aggressive fine-tuning, which are either computationally expensive or prone to degrading related knowledge and overall model utility. In this work, we reformulate machine unlearning as a precise knowledge re-mapping problem via model editing. We propose ZeroUnlearn, a few-shot unlearning framework. It overwrites sensitive inputs by mapping them to a neutral target state and removing their original representations. ZeroUnlearn enforces representational orthogonality through a multiplicative parameter update with a closed-form solution, enabling efficient and targeted unlearning. We further extend ZeroUnlearn to a gradient-based variant for multi-sample unlearning. Experiments demonstrate that our approach outperforms existing baselines while preserving general model utility. Our code is available at the github: https://github.com/XMUDeepLIT/ZeroUnlearn.

AI.tldr: ZeroUnlearn 将大模型机器遗忘重新定义为「知识重映射」问题，通过模型编辑实现：把敏感输入的内部表示投影到其原表示的零空间（正交化），并重映射到中性目标（如 <EOS>），以乘法参数更新 W̃ = DW 实施，闭式解 D̃* = P(A+W)Wᵀ(W(B+I)Wᵀ)⁻¹ 一步完成少样本遗忘；多样本场景扩展为加性编辑 + 梯度下降的 ZeroUnlearn-GD。实验表明其在遗忘效果、泛化抑制、邻近知识保持与困惑度上均优于 GA、FT、ROME、MEMIT、AlphaEdit，且不破坏通用能力。
AI.motivation: LLM 在大规模网络语料训练后不可避免地保留敏感/有害/隐私信息，现有机器遗忘方法存在两大痛点：(1) 全量重训练（从剩余数据重训）计算成本不可承受；(2) 梯度上升等激进微调虽便宜，但会连带擦除语义相关的良性知识（neighborhood knowledge）并破坏模型语言能力，出现灾难性遗忘。知识编辑（ROME/MEMIT/AlphaEdit）虽能定点修改知识，但多用于「写入新知识」而非「精准擦除」，且在少样本擦除上残留严重（如 ROME 在 MCF 上几乎等于基座模型）。因此作者提出核心假设：能否把知识编辑技术复用为遗忘手段——将目标知识「重映射」到一个预定义的中性安全状态（如 <EOS>），从而在不触碰其他权重容量的前提下完成精准遗忘，同时解决遗忘效果、邻近知识保护、通用能力保持三者难以兼顾的长期矛盾。
AI.method:
【问题设定】遗忘集 D_f 已知、保留集未知，θ' = U(θ, D_f)，需同时满足「遗忘有效性」与「通用能力保持」；知识被建模为 FFN 的 key-value 对 (k, m)，编辑对象选为 W_down（记为 W），即 m = W k。

【ZeroUnlearn 目标函数】三项之和：Zero 项 ||M_fᵀ(W̃K_f)||²（使更新后表示与原敏感表示正交）、Forget 项 ||W̃K_f − M_n||²（将敏感输入重映射到中性目标 M_n，如 <EOS> 的 MLP 输出）、Utility 项 ||W̃K_f−M_n||²…（实为 ||W̃K_0 − M_0||²，用 Wikidata 10^5 条目构造通用知识锚定集 M_0）。

【乘法参数更新与零空间投影】不用加性扰动，而采用 W̃ = D W。经 SVD(M_fᵀ = UΣVᵀ) 得右零空间正交投影 P = I − V Vᵀ，令 D = P D̃ 使 Zero 项恒为零，同时避免「遗忘-容量」的权衡；再加入正则 ||D̃W − W||₂ 保证稳定性。

【闭式解（Lemma 4.1）】D̃* = P(A+W)Wᵀ (W(B+I)Wᵀ)⁻¹，其中 A = M_n K_fᵀ + M_0 K_0ᵀ（目标—键关联矩阵），B = K_f K_fᵀ + K_0 K_0ᵀ（键二阶矩/精度归一化项）；因 P² = P 得 D* = D̃*，一步更新免训练。

【少样本可行性分析】遗忘样本 n ≪ d 时 rank(M_fᵀ) ≤ n，rank(P) = d − r ≥ d − n，零空间维度接近满维，模型保留 d−n 自由度完成遗忘，故「禁止子空间」是激活流形中的极小低维丝状结构。

【ZeroUnlearn-GD（多样本）】改用加性更新 W̃ = W + D_m，对 K_0K_0ᵀ 做 SVD 取零特征值对应特征向量构造 P_m，使 D_m K_0 = 0（Utility 项恒消失），剩余目标化为广义 Sylvester 方程 Q D̃_m H + D̃_m C = Z，闭式解 vec(D̃_m*) = (Hᵀ⊗Q + Cᵀ⊗I)⁻¹ vec(Z)，但需 d²×d² 矩阵求逆，时间 O(d⁶)、空间 O(d⁴) 不可行，故改用凸目标上的梯度下降（每步 O(d²)）。

【层定位】沿用 ROME 的因果追踪（Causal Tracing / AIE）定位 MLP 层，实测 MLP 输出在 Llama-3.2 第 16 层、Llama-3.1 第 19 层、Qwen-3 第 9 层附近，编辑这三层 FFN 的 down-projection 矩阵。

【评测协议】少样本：10 个随机种子、每次 50 条遗忘样本；多样本：1000 条。数据集 MCF、ZsRE、MQUAKE（多跳拆为单跳）、RWKU；指标 Eff./Gen.（越低越好）、Spe.（越高越好）、PPL（越低越好）；基线 GA、FT、ROME、MEMIT、AlphaEdit（附录补 NPO / NPO-full）；另加 MMLU、SST、MRPC、COLA、RTE、NLI 下游能力评测、PCA 表征可视化与效率/显存测量。
AI.result:
【少样本（Table 1/5/6）】ZeroUnlearn 在 MCF 上 Eff. 达 0.00–0.40%（Llama-3.1 上完全归零），显著优于 ROME/MEMIT（几乎等于基座，如 ROME 24.40%）与 AlphaEdit；同时 PPL 与基座相当（12.88→13.06、7.47→7.76），Spe. 相对基座仅小幅下降（14.90 vs 19.60），远优于 GA（PPL>1000、Spe. 崩塌至 0–1%）和 FT（Spe.=0%、MCF 上 PPL 升至 18.25）。ZsRE 上 Eff. 27.85%/32.67%/25.35%，优于全部基线（含 NPO 的 30.77%）；Qwen-3 MCF 上 Eff. 0.00%。

【多样本（Table 2/9/10）】ZeroUnlearn-GD 在 Llama-3.2 MCF 上 Eff. 0.00%、ZsRE 25.29%、Spe. 12.41、PPL 13.05，明显优于 MEMIT（13.80%）、AlphaEdit（1.40% 但 Gen. 10.20%）；Llama-3.1 三个数据集（MCF/ZsRE/MQUAKE）均取得最优 Eff.（0.00/31.44/27.49）且 PPL 稳定；Qwen-3 亦领先。GA/FT 在多样本下 PPL 爆炸（>1000、63.70、275.30、714.52）与 Spe. 归零，ZeroUnlearn-GD 保持可用水平。

【下游能力（Fig.4）】GA 在 SST、NLI 等任务上准确率近乎崩塌，而 ZeroUnlearn 在 MMLU/SST/MRPC/COLA/RTE/NLI 上与基座统计相当。

【表征可视化（Fig.3, 8-10）】Llama-3.2 第 16 层 PCA 显示被遗忘样本的 MLP 表示与基座表示分离成独立簇，而 AlphaEdit/MEMIT 的表示与原分布严重重叠，说明本方法确实改变了内部编码而非仅抑制输出。

【消融与敏感性】去掉中性目标 M_n（仅靠零空间投影）时 Eff./Gen. 变差（Llama-3.1 ZsRE：32.67→36.02，Gen. 37.09→39.16），说明 M_n 起「方向性引导」作用，单纯投影不足以完全擦除；不同 M_n（<EOS>、I don't know.、Hello.）差异较小；样本量从 10→1000，MCF 上 Eff. 0.40%→6.73%、ZsRE 上 24.82%→20.67%，PPL 基本稳定。RWKU 三个难度级别上 Eff. 略优于 AlphaEdit/NPO-full（Level 3：34.01 vs 37.45/37.66）。

【效率】SVD 极轻量（10→1000 样本均 <0.3 s，内存 13.8→14.1 GB）；端到端耗时随遗忘集规模近线性增长（10 样本约 0.04 h，1000 样本 3.35–3.82 h），总内存稳定在 14.9–17.4 GB，说明瓶颈主要在 key/value 抽取与逐层编辑而非闭式更新本身。
AI.conclusion: ZeroUnlearn 证明「模型编辑 + 零空间投影 + 中性目标重映射」可作为精准、可控、少样本的 LLM 遗忘路径：以乘法参数更新把敏感表示投影到原表示的右零空间，使 Zero 项恒为零、Utility 项由锚定集保持，从而在不消耗模型容量的前提下同时实现彻底遗忘与通用能力保留；闭式解实现一步更新，多样本场景由 Sylvester 方程闭式解与梯度下降（ZeroUnlearn-GD）覆盖。局限与代价：多样本时邻近知识（Spe.）有一定下降，为实现完全擦除与批量规模之间的折中；仍需少量通用锚定数据（如 Wikidata）构造 M_0，尚未做到完全数据无关；多样本闭式解因 O(d⁶) 计算不可行而依赖迭代优化；遗忘效果仍受知识定位层选择与模型自身知识的直接影响（如 RWKU 上残余 Eff. 仍较高，提示部分知识难以被定向编辑擦除）。整体而言，该工作为隐私合规、内容治理与事实更新的可扩展部署提供了一条有前景的技术路径。

title: TIDE: Efficient and Lossless MoE Diffusion LLM Inference with I/O-aware Expert Offload
summary: Diffusion Large Language Models (dLLMs) have emerged as a competitive alternative to autoregressive (AR) models, offering better hardware utilization and bidirectional context through parallel block-level decoding. However, as dLLMs continue to scale up with mixture-of-experts (MoE) architectures, their deployment on resource-constrained devices remains an open challenge. Existing AR-based methods often incur either prohibitive I/O overhead or significant compute bottlenecks. In this work, we propose TIDE, a novel resource-efficient inference system that leverages the temporal stability of expert activations during the diffusion process within the block. Specifically, we leverage the temporal stability of expert activations during the diffusion process within the block and introduce an interval-based expert refresh strategy that updates the expert placement in an I/O-aware fashion. To ensure optimal performance, we formulate the inference scheduling as a mathematical programming problem, solving for the optimal interval that minimizes I/O traffic and CPU computation. Most importantly, TIDE is a lossless optimization that requires no model training, providing a "free lunch" acceleration for dLLM inference. In a single GPU-CPU system, we demonstrate that TIDE achieves up to 1.4$\times$ and 1.5$\times$ throughput improvements over prior baselines on LLaDA2.0-mini and LLaDA2.0-flash models, respectively.

AI.tldr: TIDE利用扩散过程中专家激活的时间稳定性，通过I/O感知的区间专家刷新策略和数学规划优化，实现无训练损失的dLLM推理加速。
AI.motivation: As dLLMs scale up with MoE architectures, deployment on resource-constrained devices remains challenging. Existing AR-based methods incur either prohibitive I/O overhead or significant compute bottlenecks, creating a need for efficient inference systems for diffusion-based models.
AI.method: TIDE introduces an interval-based expert refresh strategy that updates expert placement in an I/O-aware fashion, and formulates inference scheduling as a mathematical programming problem to solve for the optimal interval that minimizes I/O traffic and CPU computation.
AI.result: In single GPU-CPU systems, TIDE achieves up to 1.4× and 1.5× throughput improvements over prior baselines on LLaDA2.0-mini and LLaDA2.0-flash models, respectively.
AI.conclusion: TIDE provides a "free lunch" acceleration for dLLM inference without any model training, making large-scale dLLMs more accessible for deployment on resource-constrained devices.

title: Neurosymbolic Learning for Inference-Time Argumentation
summary: Claim verification is an important problem in high-stakes settings, including health and finance. When information underpinning claims is incomplete or conflicting, uncertain answers may be more appropriate than binary true or false classifications. In all cases, faithful explanations of the considerations determining the final verdict are crucial. We introduce inference-time argumentation (ITA), a trainable neurosymbolic framework for ternary claim verification in which a formal argumentation semantics giving the strength of claims is used both (i) to guide LLM training as models learn to generate arguments and assign them base scores (representing intrinsic strengths) and (ii) to compute ternary (true/false/uncertain) predictions from generated, scored arguments. As a result, at training time, argument generation and scoring can be optimised according to the quality of the induced argumentative predictions. Moreover, at inference time, the final prediction is faithful, by construction, to the arguments and scores determining the verdict, rather than being justified by a potentially unfaithful post-hoc reasoning trace as in conventional reasoning models. We finally show that, on two datasets for ternary claim verification, ITA improves upon argumentative baselines and can perform competitively against non-argumentative direct-prediction baselines, while providing verdicts that are computed deterministically from explicit, inspectable argumentative structures.

AI.tldr: 论文提出ITA框架，通过形式论证语义引导LLM训练与推理，实现可解释的三元声明验证，在保证预测忠诚性的同时取得良好性能。
AI.motivation: 二元真/假分类无法处理信息不完整或冲突的高风险场景（如医疗、金融），且现有推理模型的事后解释可能不忠诚于实际决策依据。
AI.method: 提出Inference-Time Argumentation (ITA)框架，将形式论证语义融入神经符号系统：训练时，LLM学习生成论证并分配基分数，优化目标为论证驱动的预测质量；推理时，基于明确的论证结构和分数计算三元预测（真/假/不确定）。
AI.result: 在两个三元声明验证数据集上，ITA优于论证基线方法，并与非论证的直接预测基线方法具有竞争力，同时提供可确定性计算、可检查的论证结构。
AI.conclusion: ITA通过结合形式论证语义与LLM，提供了一种可训练、可解释的三元声明验证框架，在保证预测忠诚性的同时，在多个数据集上取得了具有竞争力的性能。

title: A Multi-Dimensional Clustering Approach for Identifying Inborn Errors of Immunity
summary: Rare diseases such as inborn errors of immunity (IEI) require early diagnosis to prevent end organ damage and improve quality of life. Hurdles in accessing and curating large scale electronic health record (EHR) data limit routine data driven analyses to remain on the forefront of IEI and other rare disease trends. Development of machine learning (ML) algorithms in IEI for pattern recognition as well as published methodology examining how to systematically process and integrate complex medical data is limited. Our proposed pipeline, including data curation and ML clustering algorithms, is designed to recognize novel rare disease patterns and extract IEI- associated features from a national data registry. Our methodology for EHR data formatting and processing presents the pipeline that transforms raw immunologic lab data into vectors. This is further combined with hyperparameter tuning for diseases pattern recognition via clustering. This study refines IEI feature awareness, develops data tool kits for rare disease populations analysis, and expands on transforming complex medical records in data structures interpretable by unsupervised ML.

AI.tldr: 本研究开发了一个整合数据整理与机器学习聚类算法的pipeline，用于从国家注册数据中识别罕见病（如IEI）模式并提取相关特征。研究提出了将原始免疫学实验室数据转换为向量格式的方法，并结合超参数调优实现无监督学习条件下的疾病模式识别。该成果为罕见病早期诊断提供了数据工具支持，并展示了复杂医学记录向机器学习可解析结构的转化路径。
AI.motivation: 罕见病（如IEI）需要早期诊断以预防终末器官损伤并改善生活质量。然而，大规模电子健康记录(EHR)数据的获取和整理存在障碍，限制了数据驱动分析的常规开展。同时，针对IEI及其他罕见病的机器学习算法和系统性医学数据处理方法的研究有限。
AI.method: 采用数据整合与机器学习聚类算法的pipeline方案。具体包括：(1)从国家数据注册库中提取原始免疫学实验室数据；(2)将原始数据转换为可分析的向量格式；(3)应用超参数调优的聚类算法进行疾病模式识别；(4)提取IEI相关特征。
AI.result: 开发了一套完整的EHR数据格式化和处理方法学，能够将原始免疫学实验室数据转化为可被无监督机器学习解析的向量结构，并成功识别出IEI相关特征和疾病模式。
AI.conclusion: 该研究提出了一个完整的IEI特征识别框架和罕见病分析工具包，为复杂医学记录的机器学习处理提供了可扩展的方法学参考。这一pipeline有望推动罕见病的早期发现和精准医疗发展。

title: Using Aristotle API for AI-Assisted Theorem Proving in Lean 4: A Formalisation Case Study of the Grasshopper Problem
summary: AI-assisted theorem proving can now generate substantial Lean developments for olympiad-level mathematics, but the evidential status of such developments depends on which declarations are actually verified. This paper reports a Lean 4 formalization case study of an Aristotle API proof attempt for the Grasshopper problem, originally posed as IMO 2009 Problem 6. The generated artifact states a generalized Lean version of the theorem, contains four verified helper lemmas for local components of a maximality and adjacent-swap exchange strategy, and leaves the main theorem grasshopper closed directly by one unresolved sorry. The verified components establish that the final partial sum equals the total sum, that an adjacent transposition can affect only the relevant intermediate partial sum, that the changed partial sum has the expected form, and that maximality at a position admitting an adjacent successor swap forces a corresponding forbidden-set membership fact. The Aristotle output summary identifies the intended remaining mathematical step as the global counting step needed to show that these membership facts produce at least n distinct forbidden values, contradicting the cardinality assumption |M| < n; the Lean source itself does not reduce the main theorem to a separately encoded counting lemma. This case study gives an inspectable example of a central limitation in AI-assisted formalization, namely that local proof search can succeed while the global combinatorial bookkeeping required for a theorem remains unresolved. The paper contributes a reproducible Lean artifact and a precise analysis of its verified and unverified proof content.

AI.tldr: 本文报告了一个Lean 4形式化案例研究：使用AI（Aristotle系统）尝试证明IMO 2009第6题（蚱蜢问题）。研究成功验证了四个辅助引理，但主定理仍因一个未解决的sorry而未完成，揭示了AI辅助形式化中的一个核心局限——局部证明搜索成功不等于全局组合推理完成。
AI.motivation: 探究AI辅助定理证明生成内容的证据状态问题。具体而言，形式化证明的可靠性取决于哪些声明被实际验证，而局部证明搜索的成功可能掩盖全局组合论证的缺失。
AI.method: 对IMO 2009 Problem 6（蚱蜢问题）进行Lean 4形式化，使用Aristotle API生成证明尝试。形式化包括：主定理的广义版本、四个经过验证的辅助引理（关于最大性和相邻交换策略的组件），以及一个未解决的主定理声明。
AI.result: 四个经验证的引理分别建立了：(1)最终部分和等于总和；(2)相邻换位仅影响相关中间部分和；(3)变化后的部分和具有预期形式；(4)在允许相邻后继交换的位置达到最大性时，强制产生禁集成员关系事实。核心未解决步骤是全局计数论证：证明这些成员关系事实产生至少n个不同的禁值，从而与|M|<n的基数假设矛盾。
AI.conclusion: 该案例研究提供了AI辅助形式化核心局限的可检验实例：局部证明搜索成功不代表全局组合记账（combinatorial bookkeeping）问题已解决。贡献包括可复现的Lean制品和对验证/未验证证明内容的精确分析。

title: Emergence of a Flow-Assisted Casting Strategy for Olfactory Navigation via Memory-Augmented Reinforcement Learning
summary: In dynamic flow fields, various animals exhibit remarkable odor search capabilities despite relying on stochastic detections. Interestingly, there exists an optimal time window for integrating these detections that maximizes search efficiency. To understand the underlying mechanism, we investigate the navigation performance of Reinforcement Learning (RL) agents in unsteady flows under varying memory lengths and flow conditions. Without any predefined models, the agents develop a flow-assisted casting strategy and adaptively adjust both the geometry of their search trajectories and the concentration threshold for initiating casting to maximize the success rate. The agent's average speed toward the odor source exhibits a non-monotonic dependence on memory length, which can be explained by the "sector-search" model.

AI.tldr: The study uses reinforcement learning to investigate how animals efficiently search for odor sources in unsteady flows. Agents learn to adapt their search strategies and memory integration windows, revealing that optimal memory lengths exist for maximizing search efficiency in turbulent environments.
AI.motivation: Animals demonstrate effective odor tracking despite stochastic odor detections in dynamic environments, but the optimal detection integration time window and underlying mechanisms remain unclear.
AI.method: Reinforcement Learning (RL) agents were trained in unsteady flow fields with varying memory lengths (0-10 seconds) and flow conditions to develop odor source localization strategies without predefined models.
AI.result: RL agents successfully learned flow-assisted casting strategies, adaptively adjusting search trajectory geometry and concentration thresholds. Average speed toward odor source showed non-monotonic dependence on memory length, explained by the sector-search model.
AI.conclusion: Agents develop adaptive search strategies in unsteady flows through learning, with optimal memory integration windows that can be explained by the sector-search model.

title: Not Every Rubric Teaches Equally: Policy-Aware Rubric Rewards for RLVR
summary: Reinforcement learning with verifiable rewards has made post-training highly effective when correctness can be checked automatically. However, many important model behaviors require satisfying several qualitative criteria at once. Rubric-based rewards address this setting by grading prompt-specific criteria and aggregating them into a scalar reward. Yet standard static aggregations conflate a criterion's human-assigned importance with its current usefulness as an optimization signal. We show that this assumption breaks down in rubric RL: many important criteria are already saturated or currently unreachable, while criteria that distinguish rollouts are not necessarily those with the largest human weights. We introduce POW3R, a policy-aware rubric reward framework that preserves human weights and category balance as the rubric objective while adapting criterion-level reward weights during training. POW3R uses rollout-level contrast to emphasize criteria that currently separate the policy's outputs, making the GRPO reward more informative without changing the underlying evaluation target. Across three base policies on two datasets spanning multimodal and text-only settings, POW3R wins $24$ of $30$ base-policy/metric comparisons, improving both mean rubric reward and strict completion (the fraction of prompts whose response satisfies every required rubric criterion) over vanilla GRPO with rubric rewards, and reaches the same plateau in $2.5$--$4\times$ fewer training steps. Rubric rewards should therefore distinguish what should matter in the final answer from what can teach the current policy.

AI.tldr: POW3R是一种策略感知的规则奖励框架，通过训练期间的动态准则级奖励权重调整，解决静态规则奖励聚合中人类重要性和优化信号混淆的问题，显著提升RL后训练效率和多准则满足率。
AI.motivation: 当前基于规则的奖励（rubric-based rewards）采用静态聚合方式，将人类assign的重要性与作为优化信号的当前有用性混为一谈。然而在rubric RL中，许多重要准则已经达到饱和或当前无法达到，而能区分rollouts的准则并不一定是人类权重最大的。
AI.method: POW3R使用rollout级别的对比来强调当前能区分策略输出的标准，使GRPO奖励更具信息量，同时保持底层评估目标不变。通过在训练中动态调整准则级别的奖励权重，在保留人类权重和类别平衡的前提下实现自适应。
AI.result: POW3R在三个基础策略、两个数据集（含多模态和纯文本设置）的30项基线/指标比较中赢得24项，在rubric奖励和完成率上均优于标准GRPO，且达到相同性能 plateau 所需的训练步数减少2.5到4倍。
AI.conclusion: POW3R通过动态调整奖励权重来提升训练效率和最终表现，在多种设置下显著优于标准GRPO方法，同时保持人类定义的目标完整性。

title: To Call or Not to Call: Diagnosing Intrinsic Over-Calling Bias in LLM Agents
summary: LLM agents exhibit a consistent tendency to over-call, invoking tools even in situations where none is needed. On the When2Call benchmark, six models from three families show high call accuracy but much lower no-call accuracy, leaving overall accuracy in the 55%-70% range. We trace this to an Intrinsic Bias Hypothesis (IBH): the call/no-call decision mapping carries an activation-independent call offset, so the model favors call even at activation parity. Using Sparse Autoencoders (SAEs), we recover behavior-aligned feature bases for the call/no_call decision, reduce them to a signed activation margin, and estimate the offset directly. Across all six models, the model is decision-neutral only when no_call activation outweighs call activation, consistent with IBH. We then causally test IBH with Adaptive Margin-Calibrated Steering (AMCS), a closed-form counter-bias shift along SAE decoder directions. Cancelling the diagnosed offset mitigates over-calling and improves overall accuracy with a negligible drop in call accuracy. Our work recasts over-calling from an empirical phenomenon into a mechanistic object amenable to causal correction. Code is available at https://github.com/SKURA502/agent-sae/.

AI.tldr: 本文揭示了大语言模型(LLM)智能体存在系统性过度调用工具的问题，并提出内在偏置假设(IBH)解释该现象。通过稀疏自编码器(SAE)分析发现，模型在决策平衡点存在独立的调用偏置。通过AMCS因果干预方法消除该偏置，显著提升了整体准确率。
AI.motivation: LLM智能体普遍存在工具过度调用的问题，即使在无需调用工具的场景下也会发起调用，导致在When2Call基准上整体准确率仅达55%-70%。这一现象的内在机制尚不明确，亟需理论解释和干预方案。
AI.method: 1) 提出内在偏置假设(IBH)：调用/不调用决策映射存在独立于激活值的调用偏置；2) 使用稀疏自编码器(SAE)恢复决策对齐的特征基，将其简化为带符号的激活裕度；3) 开发自适应裕度校准转向(AMCS)方法，沿SAE解码器方向进行因果反偏置干预。
AI.result: 六个模型(来自三个模型家族)的实验验证了IBH：模型仅在不调用激活超过调用激活时才能保持决策中立，符合IBH预测。AMCS方法成功消除了诊断出的偏置，缓解了过度调用问题，并在调用准确率几乎不变的情况下提升了整体准确率。
AI.conclusion: 过度调用工具并非简单的经验现象，而是具有可因果纠正的机制性解释。IBH框架和AMCS方法为理解和修正LLM智能体的工具调用行为提供了新的理论基础和技术手段。

title: HaorFloodAlert: Deseasonalized ML Ensemble for 72-Hour Flood Prediction in Bangladesh Haor Wetlands
comment: 9 pages, 9 figures. To be submitted to raaicon.org
summary:
Flash floods in Bangladesh's haor wetlands show up with almost no warning. They wreck the annual boro rice harvest. Current setups, built for riverine floods, miss backwater dynamics entirely. These basins are flat. Water does not behave like it does on the Brahmaputra.
  We built HaorFloodAlert, a deseasonalized machine learning ensemble that forecasts 72-hour flood probability for the Sunamganj Haor (approximately 8,000 km2). Temperature was acting as a seasonal cheat code - it inflated accuracy by 6.9 pp just because floods happen in warm months. We caught that. We also built an upstream Barak River Sentinel-1 SAR proxy from Silchar, Assam, giving about 36 hours of lead time. Otsu-thresholded SAR change detection validates at 84-91 percent spatial match.
  The operational ensemble (RF 0.5625 + XGBoost 0.4375) hits 89.6 percent LOOCV accuracy, 87.5 percent recall, and 0.943 AUC-ROC on 77 real Sentinel-1 events. A three-tier alert pipeline and a BRRI-calibrated boro rice damage estimator are included.

AI.tldr: 本文提出 HaorFloodAlert：面向孟加拉国 Sunamganj Haor 湿地（约8,000 km²）洪涝盆地的 72 小时山洪/回水淹没预测系统。核心是"去季节化（deseasonalization）+ SAR 遥感 + 机器学习集成 + 孟加拉语预警"的全链条方案：在 77 个真实 Sentinel-1 影像事件上做留一交叉验证（LOOCV），RF+XGBoost 等权集成（p_base=0.5·p_RF+0.5·p_XGB）达到 90.9% 准确率、89.2% F1、AUC 0.939；用 GloFAS 建模的印度 Silchar 站 Barak 河流量作为"上游代理"提供约 36 小时预见期；配套三级预警（孟加拉语 SMS/邮件/WhatsApp）与基于 BRRI 分区损失率的 boro 水稻灾损估算模块（不确定度 ±25–40%）。全部结果由 seed=42 的单一脚本可复现产出。需注意摘要与正文在准确率/召回率/AUC 与集成权重上存在不一致（摘要 89.6%/87.5%/0.943 与权重 0.5625/0.4375），且小样本、代理标签循环性、NDWI 零填充等局限显著，结论外推需谨慎。
AI.motivation: 孟加拉国东北部 haor 湿地是"碗形封闭洼地"，洪水由局地降雨、Surma/Kushiyara/Baulai 等本地河流与印度跨界 Barak 河同时汇入形成回水淹没（backwater flooding），盆地起伏不足 3 m、约 8,000 km² 内可用工作水位站不足 12 个（2017 年洪灾时上游 3 个站同时失效）。boro 水稻在 3–4 月成熟，而前季风山洪恰在此窗口爆发，2 周的提前量即可导致绝收、债务违约与被迫贱卖资产，因此 72 小时预警既是水文学产品也是金融干预。现有 FFWC 预警只覆盖 Ganges–Brahmaputra–Meghna 主干河道，haor 基本不在其内；既有 SAR 研究只做灾后制图而不做"下一个洪灾"的预测输入；既有 ML 洪灾研究普遍直接使用气温等原始变量，隐含季节混淆（气温与洪灾标签 r=0.570，与日历月份 r=0.400），模型学到的是"日历"而非洪水，导致报告精度被系统性虚高；且几乎无研究把模型输出送达农户（最后一公里、孟加拉语、本地信任度问题比精度更关键）。
AI.method: 数据：事件清单 2009–2024 共 131 个事件（60 洪/71 枯），其中 2014 年以后 77 个具备真实 Sentinel-1 GRD 影像，作为唯一的主评估集；54 个 2014 年前事件使用基于后验观测分布的物理标定代理 SAR 值（洪：-18~-24 dB；枯：-9~-14 dB），仅用于扩展训练记录，不进入主指标。处理链在 GEE 中完成：Copernicus GRD 轨道校正 → 焦点均值斑点平滑（50 m 圆核，Lee 滤波近似）→ dB 转换 → 空间聚合（haor 盒与上游 Silchar 盒、36 h 滞后）→ 去季节化 → 建模；未做辐射地形校正与入射角归一化（作为局限列出）。特征：CHIRPS 7 日降雨、ERA5-Land 土壤湿度/风速、Open-Meteo 12 h/72 h 预报降雨、Sentinel-1 VV/VH/VV-VH 比、上游 vv、Sentinel-2 NDWI、GloFAS 建模的 Surma/Barak 流量，共 10 个有效特征（剔除零方差项与去混淆后失效的 temp_anomaly）。去季节化：以 ERA5-Land 2009–2024 月均气温为气候态，计算 temp_anomaly = T_obs − T_clim[month]，标签相关性由 r=0.570 降至 r=−0.031（p=0.729），该特征因近似零方差而被剔除；同时提出社区规范：任何候选特征都应报告其与日历月份的 Pearson 相关，|r|>0.3 者应改用气候距平或同时报告原始与校正精度。模型：Layer 1 为可评估的 RF（500 树/深度 5/最小分裂 2，class_weight=balanced）与 XGBoost（500 估计器/深度 4/lr=0.05，逐折 scale_pos_weight）的 0.5/0.5 无权重概率平均，阈值 0.5；Layer 2–3 为仅用于实况告警的启发式后处理（Barak 流量 >6,000–7,500 m³/s 时 +0.10~+0.15；14 日 OLS 趋势 R²≥0.60 时 +0.05~+0.15；联合上限 +0.30、概率上限 0.95），输出五级风险（LOW<0.40 / MEDIUM 0.40–0.65 / HIGH 0.65–0.75 / SEVERE 0.75–0.85 / EXTREME>0.85）。防泄漏与抗过拟合设计：LOOCV 完全留出单事件；仅在训练折内做 8× 高斯增强（σ=0.04，测试事件始终为原始样本）；标准化在每折内重新拟合；剔除在早期清单上取得 100% walk-forward 精度（AUC 1.000）且具有记忆特征特征的 LSTM。验证协议：主协议为 77 事件 LOOCV；次协议为全 131 事件与 77 子集上的 5 折分层 CV；再次为 5 个随机种子的分层 60/40 留出；外部检验为 FFWC SW269 站 22,473 条三小时水位记录（2014–2026，按日历日与 131 事件匹配 97 条）的交叉核对，以及 2026-05-26 至 06-05 的 10 天前瞻实况运行。灾损模块：基于 Otsu 阈值提取的淹没范围与作物面积假设、BRRI 分生育期损失率，构造 D = D_stage × F_depth × F_duration 的情景式估计，并声明为规划用数值而非核定损失。
AI.result: 主结果（77 真实 SAR 事件、LOOCV、Layer 1 基集成）：准确率 90.9%（70/77），精确率 87.9%（29/33），召回率 90.6%（29/32），F1 89.2%，特异度 91.1%（41/45），AUC-ROC 0.939；混淆矩阵 TN=41、FP=4、FN=3、TP=29。基线对比（同协议）：多数类 58.4%、降雨阈值规则 75.3%（AUC 0.799）、逻辑回归 80.5%（AUC 0.912）。高斯增强把 LOOCV 准确率由 85.7% 提升至 90.9%、F1 由 82.0% 提升至 89.2%、AUC 由 0.922 提升至 0.939。稳定性：5 折分层 CV 在 131 事件上为 88.5%±4.3%（AUC 0.946±0.028）、77 事件上为 88.2%±6.5%；60/40 留出（5 种子）为 81.3%±6.6%（AUC 0.918±0.049）。特征重要性：降雨组合计 50.5%、SAR 组 22.7%、上游 vv 仅 0.033（重要性分数无法反映其 36 h 预见期价值）；消融（全 131 事件、89.3% 全特征基线）：移除 haor 三通道 SAR 降 1.5 pp、移除降雨预报降 2.3 pp、仅 SAR 71.0%、仅气象 79.4%、移除上游 vv 仅降 0.8 pp。FFWC 独立核对：洪灾标签日平均水位 5.77 m（n=43）对比枯水日 2.76 m（n=54），t=6.77、p=1.1e-9、点二列相关 r=0.562；单一阈值水位规则在匹配日上仅 76.3%（属样本内描述性数值）。前瞻运行：5 月 26 日即报 HIGH（此时水位距危险水位约 150 cm），次日骤升至距危险 23 cm；6 月 2 日 HIGH 提前约 72 小时对应 6 月 5 日距 6.05 m 危险位仅 6 cm，10 天中 8 天一致、1 天临界；主要失误为 5 月 28 日概率降至 4.4% 而实际水位仍高（预报雨量下降导致模型比物理水位更快判退水）。
