AI.conclusion: VRPO通过Q-boosting有效解决了均衡自博弈中方差放大的瓶颈，为不完全信息博弈中的多智能体强化学习提供了新的解决思路。

title: KadiAssistant: A conversational AI Agent for information retrieval in Kadi4Mat
summary: We introduce KadiAssistant, a privacy-by-design AI assistant integrated into the Kadi research data ecosystem, enabling researchers to efficiently access, aggregate, and synthesize information from heterogeneous, privacy-sensitive research data. Interdisciplinary fields such as materials science bring together disciplines with their own terminology and standards. While this convergence fuels innovation, it also makes it increasingly difficult to connect and access knowledge, as data are distributed across disciplines, organizations, and individuals. For example, battery research combines electrochemical measurements, materials characterization data, physics-based simulations, and manufacturing parameters, each using different formats, vocabularies, and standards. Efficiently storing and sharing such heterogeneous data via research data platforms, such as Kadi4Mat, demands domain knowledge, technical expertise, and familiarity with metadata schemas and interfaces. Research data also vary in sensitivity: newly generated 'warm' data are often private, whereas published 'cold' data are usually openly accessible. The Kadi ecosystem offers fine-grained access control needed for sensitive data. A solution for efficient information retrieval in Kadi must therefore respect the fine-grained access permissions. To address these intertwined challenges of information retrieval, strong data privacy, and complex access control, KadiAssistant combines a self-hosted large language model (LLM) with a privacy-preserving semantic search, inspired by retrieval-augmented generation, that can access files and record metadata on Kadi. This allows the assistant to screen, aggregate, and structure information into a highly informative answer. KadiAssistant therefore bridges terminology and standards, lowers access barriers for researchers, and strengthens the Findable pillar of FAIR data principles.

AI.tldr: KadiAssistant是一个隐私优先的AI助手，集成了自托管大语言模型和隐私保护语义搜索功能，使研究者能够高效访问、聚合和综合来自异构、隐私敏感型研究数据平台的信息，同时尊重细粒度访问权限。
AI.motivation: 跨学科领域（如材料科学）的研究数据分布在不同组织、格式、词汇和标准中，导致知识连接和访问困难；研究数据隐私敏感度各异（私有"热数据"与公开"冷数据"），且高效存储和共享需要领域知识和技术专长；现有数据平台缺乏兼顾隐私保护与高效信息检索的解决方案。
AI.method: KadiAssistant结合自托管大语言模型(LLM)与隐私保护语义搜索（受检索增强生成RAG启发），可访问Kadi平台上的文件和记录元数据，具备跨术语和标准的筛选、聚合和信息结构化能力。
AI.result: 该助手能够尊重细粒度访问权限，将信息筛选聚合为高度可用的答案，有效弥合术语和标准差异，降低研究者访问门槛。
AI.conclusion: KadiAssistant强化了FAIR数据原则中"可发现性"(Findable)支柱，为隐私敏感型研究数据生态系统提供了高效、安全的AI辅助信息检索方案。

title: Euclidean Embedding of Data Using Local Distances
summary: We study the problem of recovering a globally consistent Euclidean embedding of data, given only a local distance graph and propose a method that optimally represents these distances. The method operates solely on a neighborhood graph weighted by pairwise distances, without requiring any prior vector representation of the data. The embedding is obtained by solving a variational problem that matches local, on-graph distances to the Euclidean metric, induced by the differentials of the embedding functions. The resulting Euler-Lagrange equations are derived in a coordinate-free form, enabling direct evaluation of all operators from the distance graph alone. Though non-linear and missing an explicit expression for their non-linearity, these equations are shown to be resolved as an iteratively updated sparse linear problem. The main contributions of the proposed approach are (a) the derivation of the functional equations governing the optimal Euclidean embedding in the continuum, (b) a representation-free formulation that requires only a neighborhood distance graph and no feature vectors and (c) an estimation procedure based exclusively on local graph operations. We experimentally evaluate the resulting non-parametric algorithm on synthetic manifolds and real datasets, demonstrating consistent preservation of local metric structure and neighboring relations, while approximating the global isometric embedding.

AI.tldr: 本文研究从局部距离图恢复全局一致的欧几里得嵌入问题，提出一种仅依赖邻域图加权距离而无须先验向量表示的优化方法，将非线性变分问题转化为迭代稀疏线性问题求解。
AI.motivation: 现有度量嵌入方法通常需要预计算的向量特征表示，且难以保证全局等距嵌入的一致性。本文旨在从纯局部距离图出发，无需特征向量即可获得全局一致的欧几里得嵌入。
AI.method: 通过变分方法将图上局部距离与嵌入函数的微分诱导的欧几里得度量相匹配；采用无坐标形式推导Euler-Lagrange方程，仅需从距离图计算算子；将隐式非线性方程转化为迭代稀疏线性问题求解。
AI.result: 实验表明该非参数算法在合成流形和真实数据集上能一致保持局部度量结构和邻域关系，同时近似实现全局等距嵌入。
AI.conclusion: 该方法实现了三大贡献：(a)给出了连续统中最优欧几里得嵌入的泛函方程；(b)提出仅需邻域距离图的无表示形式；(c)建立了完全基于局部图操作的估计程序。

title: Beyond Extrapolation: Knowledge Utilization Paradigm with Bidirectional Inspiration for Time Series Forecasting
summary: Time-series forecasting is critical in various scenarios, such as energy, transportation, and public health. However, most existing forecasters rely primarily on one-way inference, \textit{i.e.}, mapping \textbf{history} to \textbf{target}, and overlook the structural information provided by a revised natural chain (``\textbf{history} (model input) -- \textbf{target} (ground-truth output) -- \textbf{post-target continuation}''). The post-target continuation records how trajectories evolve after the target, which can help stabilize forecasting, but it is not observable at inference time. In this work, we aim to obtain an approximate proxy of the post-target continuation for the current input, providing structural knowledge for bidirectional forecasting. This idea is instantiated as KUP-BI (Knowledge Utilization Paradigm with Bidirectional Inspiration), a new time-series modeling paradigm that distills continuation-style knowledge (as an approximate post-target continuation proxy) from a \emph{train-only} historical library and integrates it into standard forecasting backbones. The input stream and the continuation-proxy stream are fused via a lightweight feature-level gating module. This design does not introduce information beyond what is already contained in the training trajectories; instead, it provides a structured inductive bias that helps backbones exploit typical continuation patterns rather than relying solely on parametric extrapolation. Experimental results on six public datasets show that KUP-BI consistently improves the forecasting performance of state-of-the-art models, with small additional overhead.

AI.tldr: This paper proposes KUP-BI, a novel time-series forecasting paradigm that leverages "continuation-style knowledge" from historical training data as an approximate proxy for unavailable post-target continuation information. By distilling this knowledge into standard forecasting backbones via a feature-level gating module, the method provides structured inductive bias that helps models exploit typical continuation patterns rather than relying solely on parametric extrapolation.
AI.motivation: Existing time-series forecasters rely on one-way inference (history → target) and ignore the structural information from the natural chain "history -- target -- post-target continuation". The post-target continuation (how trajectories evolve after the target) can stabilize forecasting but is unobservable at inference time.
AI.method: KUP-BI distills continuation-style knowledge from a train-only historical library (as proxy for post-target continuation) and integrates it into standard forecasting backbones via a lightweight feature-level gating module. This provides structured inductive bias without introducing new information.
AI.result: KUP-BI achieves consistent improvements over state-of-the-art baselines on six public datasets, validating the effectiveness of incorporating continuation-style knowledge as a structured inductive bias for bidirectional forecasting.
AI.conclusion: KUP-BI consistently improves forecasting performance of state-of-the-art models across six public datasets with small additional overhead.

title: ExECG: An Explainable AI Framework for ECG models
summary: Deep learning has enabled ECG diagnostic models with strong performance in tasks such as arrhythmia classification and abnormality detection. However, accuracy alone is insufficient for clinical deployment because it does not explain why a specific output was produced, limiting justification, error analysis, and trust. Although ECG XAI has been extensively investigated and steadily improved, practical pipelines and reporting conventions vary across studies, hindering reuse and reproducibility. To address these issues, we present Explainable AI framework for ECG models (ExECG), a Python framework that provides a three-stage pipeline: Wrapper standardizes access across heterogeneous ECG formats and intermediate representations, Explainer unifies diverse XAI methods under a shared execution protocol, and Visualizer supports consistent cross-method comparison within a unified interface. We demonstrate end-to-end usage with concise examples and two case studies, highlighting interoperable and reproducible ECG explainability.

AI.tldr: ExECG是一个用于心电图可解释人工智能的三阶段Python框架，通过Wrapper-Explainer-Visualizer架构统一异构ECG格式和多种XAI方法，实现可重复和可互操作的ECG可解释性分析。
AI.motivation: Deep learning ECG models lack transparency despite strong performance. Existing ECG XAI methods have inconsistent pipelines and reporting conventions, hindering reuse, reproducibility, and clinical adoption.
AI.method: Proposes ExECG, a three-stage Python pipeline: (1) Wrapper standardizes heterogeneous ECG formats, (2) Explainer unifies diverse XAI methods under shared execution protocol, (3) Visualizer enables consistent cross-method comparison.
AI.result: Demonstrated end-to-end functionality through concise examples and two case studies, confirming framework's interoperability and reproducibility for ECG explainability.
AI.conclusion: ExECG provides a standardized, reproducible, and interoperable approach to ECG explainability, enabling easier adoption and comparison of XAI methods in clinical ECG analysis workflows.

title: When Individually Calibrated Models Become Collectively Miscalibrated
comment: 42 pages, 1 main figure, multiple tables. Accepted at ProbML 2026
summary:
Probabilistic prediction systems often aggregate probability estimates from multiple models into a single decision. A common assumption is that if each model is individually calibrated, the aggregate prediction will also be well calibrated. We show that this assumption fails in multi-agent settings: individually calibrated predictors can become collectively miscalibrated when their predictions interact strategically, in the game-theoretic sense of Brier-optimal local response, even without deliberate coordination.
  This phenomenon arises naturally when agents are independently trained on overlapping data. We prove that under Brier-score-based aggregation with positively correlated beliefs, each agent's individually optimal report systematically underestimates the positive-class probability, yielding a Price of Anarchy greater than one whenever Cov(b_i, b_j) > 0.
  In a canonical setting (n = 5 agents, pairwise correlation = 0.5, base rate = 0.3), the empirically measured PoA in false-negative rate reaches 7.25x. In contrast, VCG-based aggregation aligns incentives by rewarding marginal contribution, achieving dominant-strategy incentive compatibility and near-optimal performance.
  Experiments on three real-world datasets (NSL-KDD, UNSW-NB15, Credit Card Fraud) show that VCG provides strong robustness while maintaining comparable accuracy. It performs particularly well in data-sparse and adversarial settings, and adaptive weighting further improves performance under distribution shift.

AI.tldr: 本文指出"个体校准 ≠ 集体校准"：在多智能体概率预测聚合中，即使每个模型单独完美校准，基于 Brier 分数（及其他 proper scoring rule）的聚合也会因信念正相关而系统性低估正类概率，产生严格大于 1 的无政府代价（PoA），在标准设定下假阴性率恶化 7.25×。作者提出以 VCG（边际贡献）为核心的机制设计聚合方案，证明其满足占优策略激励相容（DSIC），PoA≈1.0×，并在数据稀疏、分布漂移、对抗智能体等场景显著优于 stacking/多数投票/传统打分聚合，同时在特征高度可分的高信号场景下承认 VCG 不占优，给出分场景推荐。
AI.motivation: 概率预测系统（集成、联邦医疗、多厂商入侵检测、众包预测）常把多个模型的概率估计聚合为单一决策。学界长期默认"proper scoring rule（如 Brier）保证个体校准⇒聚合后仍校准"（Dawid 1982；Gneiting & Raftery 2007；深度集成、贝叶斯模型平均均建立在此假设上），而 opinion pooling 文献（线性池化、对数池化、supra-Bayesian）亦以"合作型代理如实报告"为前提。但在现实部署中，各代理（不同机构/厂商/联邦参与者）独立训练、共享重叠数据与信号、目标函数各不相同，Brier 最优报告 m_i* = E[y|b_i] ≠ b_i，导致"个体理性但集体有偏"的涌现式失准（类似 Braess 悖论），无需串谋即可发生。已有机制设计/同行预测工作或假设可验证真值、或处于数据收集阶段、或面向合作代理，均未覆盖"推理期、代价不对称（FN 远贵于 FP）、聚合校准"这一组合。论文要回答的核心问题是：如何在多主体可能存在激励不一致时，仍保证聚合后概率预测的可靠性？
AI.method:
形式化：n 个代理输出 m_i∈[0,1]，聚合机制 M=(w,u)，损失 L=α_FN·1{ŷ=0,y=1}+α_FP·1{ŷ=1,y=0}（α_FN≫α_FP），定义个体 IC/DSIC 与 Price of Anarchy（PoA=Loss(均衡)/Loss(如实报告)）。
理论与机制：
• Theorem 4/8（Brier 集体失准）：设 Pr(y=1|b_1..b_n)=(1/n)Σb_j，两代理时最优偏离 δ* = Cov(b_1,b_2)/[2(Var+Cov)]·(1−2E[b_i]) > 0（当 E[b_i]<1/2），即系统性低报，PoA>1；Conjecture 9 给出一般 n 的 δ*(n,ρ)=((n−1)ρ)/(1+(n−1)ρ)·(1−2μ)/(2n)（由单向随机效应模型的组内相关系数导出，仅经仿真验证）。
• 机制族：Brier（u=−(m−y)²）、Externality（惩罚偏离共识）、VCG（u_i=V(m)−V(m_{−i})，基于 Shapley 边际贡献）、Platt 缩放等后处理基线，以及 Majority Vote、置信度加权、Log-Odds、Stacking-LR/MLP、神经聚合器（MLP/DeepSets/Attention）。
• Theorem 6：VCG 下如实报告是占优策略（V(m_{−i}) 与 m_i 无关）。
• Theorem 7：乘性权重在线更新 w_i^{t+1}∝w_i^t·exp(ηΔ_i^t)（Δ_i 为留一法边际贡献），η=√(ln n/T)，Hedge 分析给出对最优固定权重的累积遗憾 ≤2√(T ln n)，漂移下建议 η*/2。
• 实验：5 个异构代理（LightGBM/CatBoost/XGBoost/RF/MLP），特征划分（各 60% 特征）与样本划分两种协议；数据集 NSL-KDD、UNSW-NB15、Credit Card Fraud，加 UCI Heart Disease、Pima Diabetes、12 类仿真入侵、CICIDS2017 真实流量、8 代理 sklearn+LLM 混合集成；指标 Recall/F1/FN/ECE/PoA，配对 t 检验（Bonferroni α=0.017）与 Bootstrap CI；并做相关度 ρ、代理数 n、可观测性、对抗比例、阈值、类别不平衡、异构性、延迟与 Jetson Orin 边缘部署的消融。
AI.result:
1) 集体失准被证实：标准设定（n=5, ρ=0.5, μ=0.3, τ=0.3）下 Brier 的 PoA=7.25×，均衡假阴性率由 0.028 升至 0.203，聚合偏差 −0.375；PoA 随 ρ 单调上升，log-score 更严重（PoA≥90×），说明非 Brier 特有；实测真实数据上代理信念相关高达 0.96–0.98（高于扫参上限 0.95），故 7.25× 是保守估计；增加代理并不消除失准（n=20、ρ=0.8 时均衡 FN 达 0.102，>5×）。个体 IC 与集体行为脱钩：Brier 个体偏离违规率 0% 却 PoA=7.25×。
2) VCG 有效：占优策略均衡下 PoA≈1.0×、|δ*|<0.01；且在所有机制中最低（有限轮最佳响应动态下为 6–9×，仍远低于 Brier/LogScore；ρ=0 时≈1.2× 属瞬态过冲）。VCG 在 NSL-KDD/UNSW-NB15 上 FN 与基线持平或更优（对 Brier ΔFN=0.030, p=3e−4；对置信度加权 p=9e−4），Heart Disease 上 FN 比多数投票低 23%（0.208 vs 0.269）、Pima 低 10%。
3) 数据效率与稀有类：n_train≤500 时 VCG 持续优于 stacking（如 NSL-KDD n=100 recall 0.923 vs 0.915/0.914，FN 低 68%）；12 类仿真中稀有类 recall 0.339（比多数投票高 70%）、F1-macro 0.577 最优；<1% 极稀有类所有方法均为 0%，属基分类器瓶颈。
4) 漂移与在线学习：自适应权重使 FN 在突变漂移降 22%（0.152→0.119）、周期漂移降 21%（0.160→0.127），渐进漂移静态权重相当；遗憾随 T 次线性（Regret/T 稳定 <0.1）。
5) 对抗鲁棒性：n=10 注入恒低报攻击，VCG 在 k=3 时 FN=0.180 vs 中位数法 0.276，k=5（50%）时 VCG 0.646 优雅退化而 Trimmed Mean/Median 达 0.845/0.926；label-flip 60% 时 VCG FN=0.017 而两者 0.973。
6) 负面/边界结果：Credit Card Fraud（PCA 特征高信息量）上多数投票与最佳单模型 FN 低于 VCG；CICIDS2017 真实流量上最佳单模型（F1-macro 0.884、稀有类 0.752）优于所有聚合方法，VCG 稀有类 recall 仅 0.563；合成高信噪数据中小样本 MLP 优于 VCG；VCG 对可观测性敏感（无观测时 PoA=0，完全观测时升至 0.07–0.12），而 Brier 完全不敏感；n=20 时 VCG PoA 异常升至 26.1（分母趋零与留一方差所致）。
7) 成本：VCG 留一法为 O(n)，5 代理 0.19–0.23 ms、50 代理 2.14 ms，端到端 >40K samples/s，Jetson Orin 上 0.35 ms；k-LOO 近似在 n=20、k=5 时 FN 误差仅 0.0011。
AI.conclusion: 聚合机制的选择与个体校准同等重要：当聚合体存在激励不一致且信念相关时，"个体校准→集体校准"的链条断裂，proper scoring rule 的适当性保证并不蕴含聚合层面的校准，而需要以机制设计显式对齐激励。VCG 通过边际贡献定价实现占优策略 IC，在 PoA、数据效率、漂移适应与对抗鲁棒性上提供最强保证，建议用于多主体/联邦/对抗环境、低数据（n_train≤500）与中等不平衡（1%–5%）场景；但在特征高度可分或单一代理已近乎完美的高信号任务上，简单多数投票/最佳单模型即足够，VCG 的平均化会稀释强信号，甚至因留一贡献估计噪声而受损（Credit Card 小样本、CICIDS2017）。局限：一般 n 的扩展仍为猜想而非证明；VCG 的 IC 依赖可观测结果与信息结构设计；n>100 需近似 Shapley 以保留有界松弛下的激励保证；<1% 稀有事件无机制可解；扩展到基础模型/多模态系统尚未完成。总体论断是"how 聚合与 how 校准同样决定系统级可靠性"。

title: Backdooring Masked Diffusion Language Models
summary: Masked diffusion language models (MDLMs) are emerging as a compelling new paradigm for text generation, but their training-time security remains largely unexplored. Existing backdoor attacks on Gaussian diffusion models or autoregressive language models do not directly apply to MDLMs because MDLMs rely on discrete state corruption and iterative denoising rather than continuous noising or left-to-right prediction. In this work, we present the first systematic study of training-time backdoor attacks on MDLMs. We propose SHADOWMASK, a backdoor attack that modifies the MDLM forward corruption process by replacing the standard all-mask terminal distribution with a trigger-mask mixture prior. This creates a dedicated denoising pathway from trigger-corrupted states to attacker-specified targets while preserving clean denoising behavior. We further provide a principled mathematical formulation by defining the backdoored forward process, deriving the reverse-time posterior, and obtaining the continuous-time training objective. Evaluations on DiT-based MDLM and LLaDA-8B-Instruct across WikiText-103, OpenWebText, and Alpaca show that SHADOWMASK achieves near-100% attack success, substantially outperforms standard data poisoning, largely preserves clean utility, remains effective under full-model and parameter-efficient fine-tuning, and is robust against representative defenses.

AI.tldr: This paper presents the first systematic study of training-time backdoor attacks on Masked Diffusion Language Models (MDLMs), proposing SHADOWMASK which modifies the forward corruption process to create a hidden denoising pathway for triggers. The method provides principled mathematical formulation and achieves near-100% attack success while preserving clean utility and resisting defenses.
AI.motivation: MDLMs are emerging as a compelling new paradigm for text generation, but their training-time security remains largely unexplored. Existing backdoor attacks on Gaussian diffusion models or autoregressive language models do not directly apply to MDLMs because MDLMs rely on discrete state corruption and iterative denoising rather than continuous noising or left-to-right prediction.
AI.method: SHADOWMASK modifies the MDLM forward corruption process by replacing the standard all-mask terminal distribution with a trigger-mask mixture prior. This creates a dedicated denoising pathway from trigger-corrupted states to attacker-specified targets while preserving clean denoising behavior. The method includes: (1) defining the backdoored forward process, (2) deriving the reverse-time posterior, and (3) obtaining the continuous-time training objective.
AI.result: Evaluations on DiT-based MDLM and LLaDA-8B-Instruct across WikiText-103, OpenWebText, and Alpaca show effectiveness of SHADOWMASK.
AI.conclusion: SHADOWMASK achieves near-100% attack success, substantially outperforms standard data poisoning, largely preserves clean utility, remains effective under full-model and parameter-efficient fine-tuning, and is robust against representative defenses.

title: TwinRouterBench: Fast Static and Live Dynamic Evaluation for Realistic Agentic LLM Routing
summary: LLM routing matters most in long-horizon applications such as coding agents, deep research systems, and computer-use agents, where a single user request triggers many model calls. Routing each call to the cheapest sufficient model can cut costs without sacrificing quality, yet existing router benchmarks evaluate routers only on one-shot prompts. They never expose the router-visible prefix at an intermediate agent step, never test whether a cheaper replacement preserves downstream task success, and often rely on online LLM judges at evaluation time. We introduce TwinRouterBench, a step-level routing benchmark with two tracks. The static track provides 970 router-visible prefixes from 520 instances across SWE-bench, BFCL, mtRAG, QMSum, and PinchBench, each paired with an execution-verified target tier estimated under a released downgrade-and-cascade protocol; scoring is deterministic arithmetic over tier labels, trajectory membership, and token costs, with no online evaluator-side LLM judge. The dynamic track supplies a harness that runs routers on the full 500-case SWE-bench Verified suite; in this paper we report a 100-case held-out evaluation disjoint from the static SWE supervision split. At each LLM call the router selects a concrete model from a locked pool, and success is measured by official task resolution and realized API spend. The two tracks support fast offline iteration followed by end-to-end validation under live agent execution. Code and data are available at https://github.com/CommonstackAI/TwinRouterBench.

AI.tldr: TwinRouterBench是一个针对多步Agent场景的LLM路由基准测试，通过静态和动态双轨设计评估路由器的成本-质量权衡能力，解决了现有基准测试在长时域应用中的评估缺陷。
AI.motivation: 现有路由基准测试仅在单次提示场景下评估路由器，从未在中间Agent步骤暴露路由可见前缀，也未测试廉价替代方案是否能保持下游任务成功，且常依赖在线LLM评判。在长时域应用（编码Agent、深度研究系统、计算机使用Agent）中，单个用户请求会触发大量模型调用，因此准确的路由决策至关重要。
AI.method: 提出了TwinRouterBench，一个步骤级路由基准测试，包含两个轨道：1) 静态轨道：来自SWE-bench、BFCL、mtRAG、QMSum和PinchBench的970个路由可见前缀，配合基于downgrade-and-cascade协议的执行验证目标层；2) 动态轨道：在完整的500-case SWE-bench Verified套件上运行路由器，并报告100个独立案例的评估结果。评分基于层标签、轨迹成员资格和令牌成本的确定性算术运算，无需在线LLM评判。
AI.result: 该基准测试支持快速离线迭代，随后在实时Agent执行下进行端到端验证。两个轨道设计使研究者能够在受控环境中快速迭代，同时通过动态轨道在实际Agent执行中验证路由策略的有效性。
AI.conclusion: TwinRouterBench通过静态和动态双轨设计，为LLM路由研究提供了全面的评估框架，有效解决了现有基准测试在多步Agent场景下的评估局限性。代码和数据已开源。

title: From Simple to Complex: Curriculum-Guided Physics-Informed Neural Networks via Gaussian Mixture Models
summary: Physics-informed neural networks (PINNs) offer a mesh-free framework for solving partial differential equations (PDEs), yet training often suffers from gradient pathologies, spectral bias, and poor convergence, especially for problems with strong nonlinearity, sharp gradients, or multiscale features. We propose the Curriculum-Guided Gaussian Mixture Physics-Informed Neural Network (CGMPINN), which integrates Gaussian mixture modeling with dynamic curriculum learning. Specifically, a GMM is periodically fitted to the PDE residual distribution to quantify spatially varying learning difficulty. A smooth curriculum schedule progressively shifts training focus from easy to harder regions, while precision-based variance modulation suppresses unreliable clusters during early optimization. This dual curriculum is governed by a shared curriculum parameter and can be combined with self-adaptive loss balancing. We further establish theoretical guarantees, including sublinear convergence of the gradient norm for the induced time-varying loss, uniform equivalence between the curriculum-weighted and standard PDE losses, and a generalization bound with an explicit weighting-induced bias characterization. Experiments on six benchmark PDEs spanning elliptic, parabolic, hyperbolic, advection-dominated, and nonlinear reaction-diffusion types show that CGMPINN consistently achieves the lowest relative $L_2$ and maximum absolute errors among all compared methods, reducing relative $L_2$ error by up to 97.8\% over the standard PINN at comparable cost. Our code is publicly available at https://github.com/Mathematics-Yang/CGMPINN.

AI.tldr: 本文提出 CGMPINN（课程引导高斯混合物理信息神经网络）：用高斯混合模型（GMM）周期性拟合 PDE 残差分布，量化空间上变化的"学习难度"，再通过共享的课程参数 τ 驱动"由易到难"的平滑加权重加权，并辅以基于精度（逆方差）的方差调制抑制早期不可靠簇；可与 ReLoBRaLo 自适应损失平衡叠加。理论上给出加权损失与标准 PDE 损失的统一等价性、时变损失的梯度范数次线性收敛（O(1/K)）以及带显式加权偏差项的 Rademacher 泛化界。六个基准 PDE（1D/2D Poisson、热方程、阻尼波动方程、对流扩散、Fisher-KPP）上，相对 L2 误差相对标准 PINN 最多下降 97.8%，且计算开销与 PINN 相当；消融实验表明 GMM 难度量与课程调度互补，缺一不可。
AI.motivation:
物理信息神经网络（PINN）无需网格即可求解偏微分方程，但存在三类公认缺陷：①PDE 残差项与初边值项之间的梯度失衡导致"梯度病态"、收敛到次优解；②网络本身的谱偏置与损失景观非凸性；③固定均匀的配点采样使优化器在训练早期被难区域的残差淹没，尤其在强非线性、陡峭梯度（对流锋面、行波前沿）、多尺度或强对流占优的问题上尤为严重。
已有的补救手段各有局限：梯度统计自适应学习率（Wang 等）、lbPINN/gPINN 的梯度增强与归一化、LNN-PINN/STAR-PINN 的架构改造、残差自适应采样（R3、重要性采样、GMM 采样）以及域分解、因果训练等。课程学习（CL）是一条有效路线，但 Krishnapriyan 等已证明固定步长 CL 并非普遍有效，且多数现有 CL 方法依赖人工预设的固定调度表、需大量问题相关调参；即便动态方案也只是调整全局 PDE 参数，未刻画"空间上变化"的学习难度。
GMM 已能有效刻画残差分布的多模态结构、异质性与不确定性，但此前主要用于自适应采样，尚未被用作 PINN 的显式课程机制。作者的核心洞察是：把 GMM 从残差分布中提取的概率信息（后验责任度、簇级残差难度、簇级精度）转化为课程学习的调度信号，即可实现数据驱动、无需人工调参的"由易到难"训练组织。
AI.method:
【问题设定】在有界 Lipschitz 区域 Ω⊂R^d、时段 [0,T] 上求解初边值问题 D[u]=f、B[u]=g、u(x,0)=u0，网络 û(x,t)=NN(x,t;θ) 经自动微分求导得到 PDE/边界/初值残差，标准复合 MSE 损失为 L_total = L_PDE + λ_BC L_BC + λ_IC L_IC。

【CGM 模块（核心）】每隔 k_upd 次迭代，用 EM 算法对上一迭代参数 θ_{k-1} 下的全部 N_Ω 个 PDE 残差标量 r_i 拟合 K 分量 GMM p(r)=Σ_m π_m N(r|μ_m, σ_m²)，提取三条信息通道：
(i) 后验责任度 γ_im（软隐变量分配）；
(ii) 簇级难度 d_m = Σ_i γ_im r_i² /(Σ_i γ_im + ε)，再归一化到 [0,1]：d̃_m = (d_m−d_min)/(d_max−d_min+ε)；
(iii) 簇级精度 v_m = (σ_m²+ε)^{-1} / max_l (σ_l²+ε)^{-1} ∈ (0,1]，作为可靠性指标。
课程参数 τ(k)=min(k/(k_max·c_sat),1) 单调递增，c_sat 为饱和比例。定义"易偏好"权重 w_m^easy=exp(−β d̃_m)、"难偏好"权重 w_m^hard=exp(−β(1−d̃_m))，并作 τ 控制的凸组合 w_m^CL=(1−τ)w_m^easy+τ w_m^hard；精度调制为 ṽ_m=(1−τ)v_m+τ（τ→0 时压制高方差簇，τ→1 时淡出为 1）。最终簇权重 w_m^comp = w_m^CL·ṽ_m，样本权重 w_i=Σ_m γ_im w_m^comp，再按 N_Ω/Σ_j w_j 归一化为单位均值，得到课程加权 PDE 损失 L^w_PDE = (1/N_Ω)Σ_i w_i r_i²（权重在当前梯度步内固定，由快照残差计算）。这构成"双课程"：难度维度由易到难，可靠性维度由低方差到高方差，二者由同一 τ 同步控制。

【损失平衡】可选集成 ReLoBRaLo：对每个损失分量维护 EMA，以概率 ρ 用 EMA、以 1−ρ 用随机回溯的历史迭代值作参考 L_ref，权重按相对比值 L_c/L_ref 经 κ-温度 softmax 归一化为 λ_c(k)=C·exp(ϱ_c/κ)/Σexp(ϱ_c'/κ)，替换固定罚权重。

【理论与证明要点】假设：(A.1) 时变总损失逐次 L-光滑且有统一下界；(A.3) GMM 方差双侧有界（由残差有界性 + reg_covar 协方差正则保证下界）；(A.5) 课程推进、GMM 重拟合、权重更新与损失平衡引起的"目标漂移"可求和（依据 τ 饱和后课程漂移恒为零、GMM 每 k_upd 步刷新且渐稳、ReLoBRaLo 的 EMA 稳定）。结论：定理 2.1/A.7 加权与标准 PDE 损失统一等价 c_-L_PDE ≤ L^w_PDE ≤ c_+L_PDE（常数仅依赖 β, ε, N_Ω, σ上下界），推论 A.8 给出与标准目标解的一致性；定理 2.3/A.9 用下降引理给出 min‖∇L_total‖² ≤ C/(K+1) 的次线性梯度收敛，推论 A.10 给出累积点的稳定性；Remark 2.7/定理 A.13 在 PL 条件下给出漂移邻域界 limsup E_k ≤ ξ̄/(ημ)，可求和漂移下精确收敛到 L*（推论 A.14），零漂移时线性收敛（推论 A.15）；定理 2.5/A.18 用"分裂样本"装置把权重构造与经验过程解耦，结合 Rademacher 复杂度与收缩不等式给出 E^w_PDE ≤ L^w_PDE + 2W·R_N(ℱ) + 3BW√(log(2/δ)/2N_Ω)，推论 A.19 给出原始（未加权）总体风险上界并附加显式偏差项 B‖w−1‖_{L1(ρ)}，推论 A.20 给出伪维形式。作者明确说明：分析针对理想化全批量梯度下降，未覆盖实际 Adam→L-BFGS 的逐迭代理论，也未证明 CGMPINN 严格优于标准 PINN 的泛化性。

【实验设置】六个基准：1D Poisson（多频正弦 + tanh(20x) 陡变）、2D Poisson（正弦×正弦 + 高斯局部项）、1D 热方程（抛物型）、1D 阻尼波动方程（双曲型，指数衰减振荡）、1D 对流扩散（a=1, ν=1e-2，对流占优）、Fisher-KPP（非线性反应扩散，Ablowitz–Zeppetella 行波）。除 Fisher-KPP 用 4×80 网络外，其余统一为 4 隐层×50 神经元的全连接网络，PyTorch 实现，同一架构与训练设置下与 PINN、lbPINN、gPINN、LNN-PINN、STAR-PINN 对比；先做优化器研究（Adam / L-BFGS / Adam→L-BFGS），再固定为两阶段策略；指标为训练损失 e_Loss、绝对 L2 误差 e2、相对 L2 误差、最大绝对误差 e∞ 与 CPU 时间；附录 B 消融对比 GMMPINN（仅 GMM 加权，无课程，静态 exp(βd̃_m) 上加权难簇）、CLPINN（仅课程，逐样本原始残差量度难度）与完整 CGMPINN。
AI.result:
【优化器】六个基准一致：Adam 单独使用误差高出 1–2 个数量级；两阶段 Adam→L-BFGS 全面优于纯 L-BFGS（1D Poisson 中 e2 降 37.8%、e∞ 降 23.7%、耗时省 18.5%；2D Poisson 中 e_Loss 降 98.0%、耗时省 24.1%；热方程 e_Loss 降 82.4%；阻尼波 e2 降 71.4% 且仅用 L-BFGS 27.3% 的时间；Fisher-KPP 中纯 L-BFGS 训练损失更低但 e2 更差，说明其收敛到过尖锐极小值、泛化更差）。

【主结果】CGMPINN 在全部六个基准上取得最低 e2、相对 e2 与 e∞，且 CPU 时间普遍最低或接近最低：
- 1D Poisson：e2=1.96e-4，较标准 PINN（8.83e-3）降 97.8%、较 LNN-PINN 降 56.4%、较 STAR-PINN 降 84.1%；e∞=3.74e-4 最低；CPU 895.9 s 为全场最低。lbPINN 未能收敛（误差比 PINN 高数个量级），gPINN 精度不如 PINN 却耗时高 5.6 倍。
- 2D Poisson：e2=4.65e-4（较 PINN 降 56.9%）、e∞=2.95e-3（降 59.5%）、相对 e2=5.83e-4 最低；CPU 1453.2 s，远低于 gPINN 6876.9 s 与 LNN-PINN 2775.1 s；但训练损失并非最低（与 STAR-PINN 相当）。
- 热方程：e2=4.04e-4（较 PINN 降 72.3%、较 LNN-PINN 降 57.8%）、e∞=2.86e-3（降 85.2%/73.5%），且训练损失 1.53e-5 最低。
- 阻尼波动：e2=3.37e-4（较 PINN 降 70.4%，较 lbPINN/LNN-PINN 降 27.5%/27.7%）、e∞=2.20e-3 最低；CPU 678.0 s 最低（较 gPINN 省 77.2%）。
- 对流扩散：e2=2.57e-4（较 PINN 降 64.0%、lbPINN 降 42.1%、STAR-PINN 降 41.7%）、e∞=7.14e-4 最低（较 PINN 降 65.5%），训练损失 1.54e-6 最低；CPU 532.4 s 仅比 PINN 高。
- Fisher-KPP：e2=7.64e-4（较 PINN 降 53.7%、较次优 STAR-PINN 降 30.5%）、e∞=4.00e-3 最低；CPU 1722.9 s（较 PINN 仅 +12.8%，远低于 lbPINN 5711 s、gPINN 7647 s）；LNN-PINN 训练损失虽低但 e2=4.66e-3，失败捕捉行波。
此外项平衡分析证实对流扩散中 u_t 与 −a u_x 主导、Fisher-KPP 中 u_t 与 r u(1−u) 主导，残差在 O(1e-3)–O(1e-4) 量级。

【消融】CGMPINN 在六个基准的 e2/相对 e2/e∞ 上一致最优，两个模块互补：仅 GMM 加权的 GMMPINN 在 1D Poisson 上直接发散（e2=2.17），因静态上加权难簇会在早期淹没优化器；仅课程的 CLPINN 在 1D Poisson 取得 3.29e-3 但不及完整方法一个数量级。Fisher-KPP 上 CLPINN 较 GMMPINN 降 59%、完整方法再降 39%；对流扩散上 CLPINN 已较 GMMPINN 降 51%（说明课程调度对锋面问题尤为关键），完整方法再降 24%。阻尼波与 2D Poisson 上增益相对温和（难度分布较均匀或以振荡为主）。
AI.conclusion:
CGMPINN 将 GMM 的概率建模能力从"自适应采样"拓展为"课程调度机制"，用单一共享课程参数 τ 统一控制"难度维"与"可靠性维"两条由易到难/由稳到险的过渡路径，并以 ReLoBRaLo 自适应损失平衡作为可插拔的补充。理论上给出了三条形式化保证：加权与标准 PDE 损失的统一等价性（保证不偏离原物理目标）、时变目标下梯度范数的次线性收敛（漂移可求和）、以及带显式加权诱导偏差 B‖w−1‖_{L1(ρ)} 的 Rademacher 泛化界（含 PL 条件下的漂移邻域与精确收敛推论）。实验表明其在椭圆、抛物、双曲、对流占优与非线性反应扩散六类问题上以相当代价取得一致最优精度（最多降 97.8%），消融验证两模块缺一不可。

【作者自述局限与未来工作】(1) 实验限于一维/二维，需评估高维下 GMM 难度量化的可扩展性；(2) 混合分量数 K 与更新频率 k_upd 仍需人工设定，期望用信息论准则自动选择；(3) 需与域分解结合并推广至含稀疏噪声观测的逆问题；(4) 理论需扩展到实际 Adam→L-BFGS 的逐迭代收敛，并给出能严格证明动态课程重加权优于标准 PINN 的更紧界。

【可商榷之处】(a) GMM 拟合的是残差"标量值"的一维分布，与空间坐标无显式耦合，所谓"空间变化难度"是通过样本索引的责任度间接传递的，对空间异质性的刻画不如在 (x,t) 特征空间聚类直接；(b) 摘要中"相对 L2 误差降低最多 97.8%"对应表中绝对 e2 的比较（8.83e-3→1.96e-4），而相对 e2 的降幅约为 77.8%，表述略有出入；(c) 泛化界仅覆盖"冻结权重"的单次刷新步骤，作者亦承认未处理跨迭代的全耦合自适应重加权，且在 τ→1 时终态权重仍依赖难度，偏差项并不自动消失，若需渐近无偏须额外强制终态权重趋于 1；(d) 若干基准上 CGMPINN 并非取得最低训练损失（如 2D Poisson、Fisher-KPP），说明其收益部分来自训练损失与测试精度之间的再平衡，而非纯粹的目标函数下降；(e) 2D Poisson 消融中三变体差距较小，表明当难度分布较均匀时结构化难度量化的增益有限。

title: CODA: Rewriting Transformer Blocks as GEMM-Epilogue Programs
summary: Transformer training systems are built around dense linear algebra, yet a nontrivial fraction of end-to-end time is spent on surrounding memory-bound operators. Normalization, activations, residual updates, reductions, and related computations repeatedly move large intermediate tensors through global memory while performing little arithmetic, making data movement an increasingly important bottleneck in otherwise highly optimized training stacks. We introduce CODA, a GPU kernel abstraction that expresses these computations as GEMM-plus-epilogue programs. CODA is based on the observation that many Transformer operators exposed as separate framework kernels can be algebraically reparameterized to execute while a GEMM output tile remains on chip, before it is written to memory. The abstraction fixes the GEMM mainloop and exposes a small set of composable epilogue primitives for scaling, reductions, pairwise transformations, and accumulation. This constrained interface preserves the performance structure of expert-written GEMMs while remaining expressive enough to cover nearly all non-attention computation in the forward and backward pass of a standard Transformer block. Across representative Transformer workloads, both human- and LLM-authored CODA kernels achieve high performance, suggesting that GEMM-plus-epilogue programming offers a practical path toward combining framework-level productivity with hardware-level efficiency.

AI.tldr: CODA是一个GPU内核抽象，将Transformer中的内存受限算子（归一化、激活、残差更新、归约等）重新参数化为GEMM+尾声程序，使这些操作在GEMM输出tile驻留在芯片上时执行，避免频繁的全局内存访问。
AI.motivation: 当前Transformer训练系统中，除注意力机制外的算子（如归一化、激活、残差连接、归约等）虽计算量小但需频繁移动大量中间张量通过全局内存，导致数据移动成为性能瓶颈。
AI.method: CODA基于核心观察：许多可分离的框架内核可以代数重参数化为GEMM输出tile仍驻留在芯片上时执行的计算。方法固定GEMM主循环，暴露一组可组合的尾声原语用于缩放、归约、成对变换和累加。
AI.result: 在代表性Transformer工作负载上，人工编写和LLM生成的CODA内核均达到高性能，证明GEMM+尾声编程能在保持专家级GEMM性能结构的同时覆盖几乎所有非注意力计算。
AI.conclusion: GEMM-plus-epilogue编程为结合框架级生产力和硬件级效率提供了实用路径。

title: Rethinking Muon Beyond Pretraining: Spectral Failures and High-Pass Remedies for VLA and RLVR
summary: Muon is a matrix-aware optimizer that leverages Newton-Schulz (NS) iterations to enforce spectral gradient orthogonalization by driving all singular values of the momentum matrix toward 1. While this uniform spectral whitening enhances exploration and outperforms AdamW in LLM pretraining, we show it could lead to fundamental limitations beyond pretraining in two regimes: (i) cross-modality vision-language-action (VLA) training, where inherently low-rank action-module gradients cause amplification of noisy tail directions, and (ii) reinforcement learning with verifiable rewards (RLVR), where low-SNR gradients and the need to preserve per-head specialization from prior training make whitening unstable. To address these challenges, we propose Pion, a drop-in replacement for Muon that preserves its computational efficiency while replacing uniform spectral whitening with a two-stage Promotion+Suppression mechanism, which we call the high-pass NS iteration. This design induces a sharp spectral high-pass effect, anchoring dominant singular values at 1 while suppressing noisy tail components toward 0, with controllable filter strength. To preserve pretrained per-head heterogeneity, Pion also supports a per-head mode that applies updates independently across attention heads via a simple reshape, at no extra cost. In VLA training on LIBERO and LIBERO-Plus, Pion consistently outperforms both baselines across l_1-regression (VLA-Adapter) and flow-matching (VLANeXt) architectures, e.g., reaching 100% success rate on LIBERO Object after 1,500 training steps with VLA-Adapter, vs. 97.0% for Muon and only 32.2% for AdamW. The advantage of Pion further extends to a real Franka Research 3 robot with a pi_0.5 backbone under the DROID setup on three grasp-and-place tasks. In RLVR post-training on Qwen3-1.7B/4B with GRPO and GMPO, Pion also outperforms AdamW on MATH and GSM8K while Muon collapses to zero.

AI.tldr: 本文首次系统性地指出 Muon 优化器在预训练之外的两个范式（跨模态 VLA 训练与 RLVR 后训练）中的根本局限——其"均匀谱白化"会把低秩/低信噪比梯度中的噪声尾部提升到与信息头同量级——并提出 Pion：用两阶段 Promotion+Suppression 的"高通 NS 迭代"将均匀白化替换为尖锐的谱高通滤波（主奇异值锚定在 1、噪声尾部压向 0），辅以 per-head 模式保留预训练后的多头异构性。Pion 每步计算开销与 Muon 完全相同，在 LIBERO/LIBERO-Plus、真实 Franka 机械臂与 Qwen3 的 GRPO/GMPO 后训练上全面优于 AdamW 与 Muon（Muon 在 RLVR 上直接崩溃归零）。
AI.motivation: Muon 通过 Newton-Schulz (NS) 迭代实现矩阵符号运算 msign，把动量矩阵的所有奇异值统一推向 1（"均匀谱白化"），从而在 LLM 预训练中强化探索并胜过 AdamW。但作者质疑这一归纳偏置在预训练之外是否仍然合适，并选取两个尚未充分探索的范式作为测试床：(i) 跨模态视觉-语言-动作 (VLA) 训练，动作头梯度天然低秩；(ii) 可验证奖励强化学习 (RLVR) 后训练，策略梯度信噪比低且需保留预训练形成的多头专门化。作者用有效秩 (erank) 分析证明 VLA 三模块（视觉/语言/动作）梯度秩异质性显著——动作模块 erank 最低（动作仅为 7 维）；用 SNR 闭式推导与实测证明 GRPO 梯度 SNR 远低于 SFT。由此得到两条统一诊断：Limitation 1（缺乏秩自适应：Muon 作用于动作模块反而不如 AdamW；Low-rank Muon 虽有效但 SVD/sketching 带来约 15× 训练开销）与 Limitation 2（缺乏噪声自适应：Muon 在低 SNR 的 GRPO 梯度下把噪声方向放大到与信号同量级，模型从初始 checkpoint 崩塌至近零准确率）。此外 Muon 把整个注意力投影当作单一 block 做 NS，抹平了预训练遗留的 per-head 权重范数异构性。
AI.method: 核心洞察：单步 NS 在 SVD 下等价于对每个归一化奇异值施加标量多项式 f(σ)=aσ+bσ³+cσ⁵（保持奇异向量不变），因此"矩阵级谱滤波设计"归约为"标量多项式设计"。作者据此把 5 步 NS 拆为两阶段：(1) Promotion 阶段 f_p = 1.875σ − 1.25σ³ + 0.375σ⁵，由约束 P1 f_p(1)=1、P2 f_p'(1)=0、P3 f_p''(1)≤0 及全局单调性推出 a_p∈[0,1.875]，取最大原点斜率 a_p=1.875（其导数为 1.875(1−σ²)²，为完全平方，保证单调、保序）；(2) Suppression 阶段 f_s = 0·σ + 2.5σ³ − 1.5σ⁵，由 S1 f_s(1)=1、S2 f_s'(1)=0、S3 f_s'(0)=0（原点处去线性项，即"谱滤波"条件）唯一确定，导数 7.5σ²(1−σ²)≥0。链式复合 f_s^{k_s}∘f_p^{k_p}（k=5 固定，k_p 为唯一超参，控制高通截止强度；经验上 k_s≥3 即 k_p≤2 最佳）产生"锚定主奇异值于 1、压制尾部落向 0"的尖锐高通谱形。Pion 继承 Muon 全部控制流与 5 步 matmul 成本，无 SVD/sketching 开销。两种应用模式：default 模式对整块权重矩阵做高通 NS（用于 VLA 动作头）；per-head 模式把注意力投影沿 head 维 reshape 成 H 个子矩阵、逐头独立归一化与迭代（用于 RLVR，以保留预训练后的 per-head 范数异构性，理论上 per-head 范数同时调制注意力锐度与梯度尺度，见 Proposition G.1）。此外作者给出 SNR 闭式推导（SFT: SNR=gT||s̄||²/σ_s²；GRPO 含 κ_g(p)=q_nd ρ_g²、退化组、重要性采样 χ² 放大、clipping 衰减因子 1/(1−α)），以及 reverse ablation 基线 LPMuon（用 15 个系数 L-BFGS-B 数值拟合带通/低通曲线的镜像低通版本，用以隔离"滤波方向"这一关键因素）。
AI.result: VLA（VLA-Adapter，Prismatic-Qwen2.5-0.5B，LIBERO）：Pion 平均 97.25%，Muon 94.95%，AdamW 72.00%；LIBERO Object 上 1,500 步即达 100%（500 步 95.4%），Muon 97.0%，AdamW 仅 32.2%。VLANeXt（flow-matching，Qwen3-VL-2B）：LIBERO 平均 96.35 vs Muon 93.65 vs AdamW 79.45；LIBERO-Plus 平均 75.93 vs 72.34 vs 64.57，语言/噪声/机器人扰动下分别领先 Muon 约 +9/+6/+6 个百分点，鲁棒性更强。真实机器人（π_0.5 + DROID + Franka Research 3，三抓放任务各 30 次随机试验）：平均成功率 85.6% vs Muon 38.9% vs AdamW 31.1%，且仅需 20k 步低预算训练。RLVR（Qwen3-1.7B/4B，GRPO/GMPO，MATH levels 3–5 与 GSM8K，共 8 组设定）：Muon 全部崩塌（准确率近零甚至低于初始 checkpoint），Pion 收敛更快且超过 AdamW；Pion 梯度 SNR 全程高于 AdamW。消融：Pion 在所有 top-k 上优于 LRMuon 且训练时间与 Muon 几乎一致（LRMuon 因逐步精确 SVD 慢约 15×）；per-head 与 default 在 VLA 上基本持平（default 略优，因动作头从零训练无遗留异构性），但 per-head 是 RLVR 稳定的关键（default 模式 Pion 在 RLVR 反而不如 AdamW）；模态级扫描显示动作头要 Pion（43.6→73.6 vs Muon 40.0）、视觉/语言要 Muon（S6 96.8 vs Pion 17.8），"视觉语言用 Muon + 动作头用 Pion"组合最优（100%）；低通反向消融 LPMuon 完全无法训练，验证增益确实来自高通方向而非迭代形式或 per-head reshape 本身。
AI.conclusion: Muon 的核心机制（驱动全部奇异值到 1 的均匀谱白化）在预训练之外存在根本性失效：VLA 中源于动作头梯度的低秩性（秩异质不匹配），RLVR 中源于策略梯度的低信噪比（噪声放大导致策略崩塌），二者共享同一"信息头 + 噪声尾"谱结构，因而可由单一"谱高通"补救。Pion 作为 Muon 的即插即用替代，仅通过重新设计 NS 多项式系数（Promotion + Suppression 两阶段）实现主方向保留与噪声尾部抑制，每步成本与 Muon 完全相同，并在 VLA 仿真/真机与 RLVR 后训练上稳定优于 AdamW 与 Muon，且无需 SVD/sketching。局限：Pion 面向"信息集中于少数前导奇异值"的低秩/低 SNR 场景，在 LLM 预训练中预计不如 Muon（预训练依赖均匀白化带来的最大谱探索），如何自适应调节高通截止以兼容两者留待未来工作。

title: EviTrack: Selection over Sampling for Delayed Disambiguation
summary:
Sequential prediction is challenging in regimes of delayed disambiguation, where early observations are ambiguous and multiple latent explanations remain plausible until sufficient evidence accumulates. Standard approaches based on marginal inference struggle in this setting, either collapsing uncertainty prematurely or failing to recover once informative evidence arrives.
  We introduce EviTrack, a test-time inference framework that operates over latent trajectories rather than marginal states. EviTrack maintains a set of competing trajectory hypotheses and applies evidence- and likelihood-ratio-based selection to delay commitment until supported by data, drawing inspiration from hypothesis management in multiple hypothesis tracking and track-before-detect.
  To evaluate this setting, we construct a controlled synthetic benchmark with known latent ground truth that explicitly exhibits delayed disambiguation. At matched inference budget, EviTrack substantially outperforms sampling-based baselines, achieving faster post-disambiguation recovery.
  These results show that, in delayed disambiguation regimes, moderate trajectory-level selection is more effective than increasing sampling coverage, highlighting selection over sampling as a key principle for reliable sequential inference.

AI.tldr: 论文提出测试时推断框架 EviTrack：不按"边缘状态"（如卡尔曼滤波、粒子滤波、摊销变分推断）做后验边缘化，而是在**潜在轨迹前缀**层面显式维护 K 条竞争假设，用累积证据（对数似然/似然比）打分，并做"局部选择"（每条父轨迹采样 C 个子节点、保留得分最高者）与可选的"全局剪枝"（每 G 步保留 Top-K）。在自建的"双井延迟消歧"合成基准上（潜变量为对称双井漂移、发射函数在 |z|≤d 内为偶函数 z² 造成不可观测性；a=3>d=2 保证消歧被真正推迟），在相同推断预算 N=K·C=64 下，EviTrack-J（K=32, C=2, G=∞）显著优于 64 粒子的 SIS 与 Bootstrap PF，消歧后滤波分支准确率 0.987 vs 0.912 vs 0.584，消歧后一步预测对数似然 −2.948 vs −54.254 vs −154.155；消融表明"适度选择优于扩大采样覆盖"（小 C=2/4 好、大 C≥16 差；G=∞ 优于频繁全局剪枝；评分函数影响很小；增加粒子数也无法弥合差距）。
AI.motivation: 序列预测中普遍存在"延迟消歧"（delayed disambiguation）现象：早期观测信息微弱，多条互不兼容的潜在解释都合理，只有在长时间跨度上累积足够证据后才能区分。现有的逐步边缘化推断（卡尔曼滤波、SIS/BPF 粒子滤波、现代摊销变分推断）都在每个时间步对潜变量局部边缘化，导致两个失效模式：(1) 过早坍缩/丢弃多模态、过早承诺于错误解释；(2) 证据到来后又缺乏机制恢复与细化竞争假设（BPF 的 ESS 重采样会提前把有效轨迹重采样掉，SIS 则出现权重退化）。作者指出经典信号处理中的 track-before-detect / 多假设跟踪（Reed & Gagliardi 1974；Bar-Shalom 等 2009）正是通过显式维护与打分竞争轨迹来应对该问题，但它们依赖手工动力学与领域似然，不与学习到的表征/摊销提议结合；而搜索类方法（beam search、MCTS）优化的是奖励/代价而非概率推断。因此需要一个面向现代序列潜变量模型的、轨迹级（而非状态级）的概率推断范式。作者还强调：要严格评估延迟消歧需要精确后验与真实消歧时刻，真实数据无法获得，故必须构造合成基准。
AI.method:
**问题设定**：序列潜变量模型 p(x_1:T, z_1:T)，按链式法则分解为因果形式（发射只依赖 z_{≤t}）；预测 p(x_{t+1}|x_{1:t}) 是对轨迹前缀后验的积分（Eq.1），早期该后验是多模态的。

**EviTrack 算法**（测试时推断，无训练）：
1. **假设集**：t 时刻保留 K 条潜轨迹前缀 ℋ_t = {z^{(i)}_{1:t}} 及未归一化分数 S_t^{(i)}。
2. **评分函数**（三种，可解释为不同零模型下的对数似然比）：联合分数 J_t = log p(x_{1:t}, z_{1:t})；证据分数 E_t = log p(x_{1:t}|z_{1:t})；背景归一化分数 J_t^tbd = log p(x_{1:t}|z_{1:t}) + log[p(z_{1:t})/p_0(z_{1:t})]，p_0 为高斯随机游走先验。所有分数沿时间可加累积。
3. **扩展**：每条前缀从转移 p(·|z_{1:t})（或摊销提议 q_φ）采样 C 个子节点，子节点继承父分数并加增量 Δ = S_{t+1} − S_t，形成 K·C 的候选池。
4. **局部剪枝（选择）**：每个父节点仅保留得分最高的子节点 argmax_j S_{t+1}，把 K·C 缩回 K。附录 C 给出其分布解释：所选子节点服从 p_C^* = C·p(z_{t+1}|z_{1:t})·F(S(z_{t+1}))^{C−1}，即一个**序统计量偏置分布**，C 越大越接近确定性 MAP 选择，C=1 退化为普通采样 —— 形式化了"探索 vs 贪心选择"的权衡；C=1 且无全局剪枝时 EviTrack 退化为 SIS。
5. **全局剪枝**：每隔 G 步在全体假设间做 Top-K 剪枝以控制指数增长，但过于激进会提前淘汰有效假设。
6. **预测**：以 π_t^{(i)} ∝ exp(S_t^{(i)}) 对保留假设做加权混合，未来用转移先验的 MC rollout 估计。

**基准（双井延迟消歧）**：潜动态 z_t ~ N(μ(z_{t−1}), σ_z²)，μ(z)=z−Δt·V₀·z(z²−a²)，稳定点在 ±a；发射 x_t ~ N(h(z_t), σ_x²)，h(z)=z²（|z|≤d）、h(z)=z（|z|>d）。因 h 在 |z|≤d 为偶函数，± 两井产生完全相同的观测分布；条件 a>d 使井位于不可观测区外，证据缓慢累积，只有当潜变量涨出 |z|>d、h 变单射后符号信息才可恢复 —— 这正是延迟消歧的成因。转移与发射均为高斯闭式，故推断在真实模型下精确进行（提议=转移先验）。通过求积计算精确后验 p(z_t|x_{1:t})，定义消歧时刻 t_DD 为正确盆地后验概率首超阈值 τ=0.8 的时刻；剔除 t_DD<30 或 >170 的样本，按 Early(30–80)/Mid(80–140)/Late(140–170) 三档各 100 条轨迹评测。

**基线与预算对齐**：EviTrack-J（K=32, C=2, G=∞）对比 N=64 粒子的 SIS（不重采样）与 BPF（ESS 触发重采样），总预算 N=K·C=64 严格匹配；所有方法在同一固定世界模型下仅测试时推断策略不同。评测指标：一步预测对数似然 PLL（主指标）、滤波分支准确率 BA、权重熵/ESS、隐变量 MSE 等，曲线按 t−t_DD 对齐（±20 步），跨 3 个种子与 3 个 DD 档位聚合。

**消融**：评分函数（E/J/TBD）、全局剪枝间隔 G∈{1,5,10,20,∞}、分支因子 C∈{2,4,8,16,32}（K 反向调整以固定预算）、假设数 K∈{2,…,64} 的预算扫描（每档配对 SIS/BPF 同粒子数）。
AI.result:
**主结果（预算 N=64）**：消歧前所有方法都接近固有歧义上限（BA≈0.50，接近随机）；消歧后急剧分化。EviTrack-J 消歧后 BA=0.987±0.005，PLL=−2.948±0.103；SIS 为 BA=0.912、PLL=−54.254；BPF 为 BA=0.584、PLL=−154.155（基本无法消歧）。分档看，Late 档差距最大（SIS BA 降至 0.806，PLL −131.2；BPF PLL −158.6），EviTrack 仍保持 BA 0.978 / PLL −6.43。

**权重行为**：消歧前 BPF 权重近乎均匀（退化未解决），EviTrack-J 已把质量集中到少量自洽轨迹上；消歧瞬间 EviTrack 迅速锁定正确盆地，BA 陡升，SIS 恢复滞后，BPF 始终未能有效消歧。

**消融结论**：(1) 评分函数影响很小 —— 三种变体消歧后 BA 均为 0.987–0.990，EviTrack-E 的聚合消歧后 PLL 略优（−2.459 vs J 的 −2.948），说明主要效应来自轨迹级选择本身而非打分函数；(2) 全局剪枝越少越好，性能随 G 单调提升，G=∞ 最佳，G=1/5 的频繁跨假设竞争会在证据到来前消灭有效假设 —— 表明"过早的跨假设淘汰"是延迟消歧下的首要失效模式；(3) 分支因子存在权衡，固定预算下小 C（2、4）最佳，C≥16 急剧退化，因过度局部选择在消歧前压掉了假设多样性；(4) 预算扫描显示 EviTrack 在中等 K 即达到强性能，而 SIS/BPF 即便提高粒子数也无法弥合差距，说明单纯扩大采样覆盖不足，结构化假设选择才是主导因素。
AI.conclusion:
核心结论：在延迟消歧情形下，**"选择优于采样"（selection over sampling）**——即在轨迹层面施加"适度的"证据驱动选择，比单纯增加采样覆盖更有效；"计算如何分配比计算多少更重要"。机制上，EviTrack 保留轨迹身份并推迟跨假设竞争，让有效假设存活到决定性证据到来；而 BPF 的 ESS 重采样会提前淘汰正确轨迹，SIS 出现权重退化。方法定位上，它弥合了经典假设树/TBD 推断与现代序列潜变量模型（后者此前几乎未涉及轨迹级推断），且在有学习到的世界模型时可直接替换为学到的转移/摊销提议。

**局限与展望**：性能依赖 K、C、剪枝调度与评分规则，自适应选择仍是开放问题；EviTrack 不是一致的蒙特卡洛估计量（剪枝近似的是后验支撑而非在其上积分）；评测依赖有潜变量真值的合成双井设定，推广到学习到的世界模型与高维观测是重要方向（作者将后者列为未来工作）。此外该工作为独立研究者单作者投稿（arXiv，Baltimore, MD），实验仅限一维合成任务，结论的外推性尚待验证。

title: Cross-Paradigm Knowledge Distillation: A Comprehensive Study of Bidirectional Transfer Between Random Forests and Deep Neural Networks for Big Data Applications
summary: The exponential growth of big data has intensified the need for efficient and interpretable machine learning models that can handle diverse data characteristics while maintaining computational efficiency. Knowledge distillation has primarily focused on neural network-to-neural network transfer, leaving cross-paradigm knowledge transfer largely unexplored. This paper presents the first comprehensive study of bidirectional knowledge distillation between Random Forests (RF) and Deep Neural Networks (DNN), addressing critical gaps in ensemble learning and model compression for big data applications. We propose novel methodologies including progressive multi-stage distillation, multi-teacher ensemble distillation from diverse tree models, and uncertainty-aware cross-paradigm transfer mechanisms. Through 144 comprehensive experiments across 6 diverse datasets encompassing classification and regression tasks, we demonstrate that bidirectional RF-DL distillation achieves competitive performance while providing complementary benefits: interpretability from tree models and expressiveness from neural networks. Our results show that multi-teacher ensemble distillation consistently outperforms traditional approaches, with NN-COMPACT achieving 98.13% classification accuracy and NN-WIDE reaching 92.6% R^2 score in regression tasks. The proposed framework enables deployment flexibility in big data environments, allowing optimal model selection based on computational constraints and interpretability requirements. This work establishes a new research direction in cross-paradigm knowledge transfer with significant implications for interpretable AI and scalable model deployment in resource-constrained big data systems.

AI.tldr: 本文提出首个双向跨范式知识蒸馏框架，在随机森林（RF）与深度神经网络（DNN）之间互相转移知识，包含渐进式多阶段蒸馏、多教师集成蒸馏与不确定性感知机制；在6个数据集上开展144组实验，NN-COMPACT 分类准确率达98.13%，NN-WIDE 回归 R² 达92.6%，蒸馏模型保持与基线相当的性能，同时保留树模型的可解释性与神经网络的表达能力，支持云-边灵活部署。
AI.motivation: 现有知识蒸馏研究几乎全部集中于"神经网络→神经网络"的同范式迁移，跨范式（树模型↔深度网络）迁移鲜有系统探索；而大数据部署面临四类现实缺口：范式孤立（两类模型优势无法互补）、部署灵活性不足（边缘设备与云端需要不同模型形态）、可解释性与性能被迫二选一（无法同时获得）、大模型部署与知识迁移的可扩展性需求（受LLM压缩与蒸馏启发）。此前工作如 fDNN（RF作为特征检测器）属特征提取而非蒸馏，Frosst & Hinton 的软决策树仅是早期零散尝试，缺少跨多种大数据场景的系统评估。
AI.method: 1) 形式化双向跨范式蒸馏：RF→DL 用温度缩放 softmax 的 KL 散度作为蒸馏损失 L_KD=τ²·KL(σ(S/τ),σ(T/τ))，与硬标签交叉熵按权重 α 混合；DL→RF 则用教师网络生成软标签，与真实标签按 β 混合后在增广数据上重训 RF。2) 渐进式多阶段蒸馏：阶段1 树集成→深层网络，阶段2（前一阶段学生+树集成）→标准网络，阶段3→紧凑网络，实现知识逐步精炼与架构简化。3) 多教师集成蒸馏：RF、XGBoost、LightGBM 等异质树模型共同指导单一网络，L_multi=Σw_i·L_KD(S,T_i)。4) 不确定性感知蒸馏：L_uncertain=L_KD+λ·Var(教师集成方差)，用树集成方差表征认知不确定性、MC Dropout 表征偶然不确定性，回归任务给出预测区间。5) 实验：6 个数据集（乳腺癌569、葡萄酒178、Digits 1797、合成不平衡1500、加州房价20640、非线性回归1200），4 类树模型与 5 类神经网络架构，24 种方法组合共 144 组实验，采用交叉验证与显著性检验，指标含 Accuracy/F1/AUC、RMSE/R²/MAE、不确定性、推理时间，并分析特征重要性保留情况。
AI.result: 分类任务中多种方法达到 1.000 准确率（含 Extra Trees、XGB、NN Deep/Wide/Compact、RF→NN Compact、Progressive）；回归任务最佳为 NN Wide 基线（Nonlinear Reg.，RMSE 0.553、R² 0.926），蒸馏方法中 LGB→NN Standard 达 R² 0.837，Extra Trees→NN 达 0.801。汇总统计显示 NN_COMPACT 分类均值 0.981（±0.013）、回归 R² 0.834，NN_WIDE 回归 R² 0.859，NN_to_RF 分类 0.957 优于 RF_to_NN 的 0.943，跨范式方法总体 0.936–0.957，与基线差距不大且具互补性。不确定性方面树模型 0.1348±0.0481、神经网络 0.0266±0.0091、蒸馏模型居中；推理时间树模型 0.0051s、神经网络 0.0325s、蒸馏模型 0.0307s。特征重要性跨范式保留良好（乳腺癌 worst perimeter 0.1473/worst area 0.1349；加州房价 MedInc 0.5294；葡萄酒类黄酮 0.1760、color intensity 0.1719）。分类任务的迁移一致性优于回归任务，紧凑网络架构最适配跨范式迁移。
AI.conclusion: 跨范式知识蒸馏在技术上可行且具有实用价值：RF 与 DNN 之间的双向知识流动可保持与单一范式基线相当的预测性能，同时在可解释性、不确定性量化与部署成本上提供互补选项。树模型适合边缘/可解释场景，蒸馏后的紧凑网络适合云端高算力与性能优先场景，形成统一的"云-边"知识流与失效安全备份模型机制。理论上表明学到的表征包含与架构无关的信息，且渐进式知识精炼优于单阶段迁移。局限与后续方向包括：超大规模（>1亿样本）验证、流式数据动态蒸馏、多模态扩展、与联邦学习结合以支持隐私保护分析，以及借鉴LLM微调与适配技术改进跨范式迁移。

title: A Two-Phase Adaptive Balanced Penalty Method for Controllable Pareto Front Learning under Split Feasibility Conditions
comment: 36 pages, 18 figures, 12 tables. Submitted to Neural Networks (Elsevier)
summary: We address the open problem of training hypernetworks for Controllable Pareto Front Learning (CPFL) under split feasibility conditions with rigorous theoretical guarantees. We reformulate the constrained Pareto problem as a Bi-Level Scalarized Split Problem (BSSP) and propose the Adaptive Balanced Penalty (ABP) algorithm, whose three gradient components -- optimality, set feasibility, and image feasibility -- are blended through an adaptive indicator driven by a computable lower bound. Using a novel convex surrogate technique, we prove full-sequence convergence under standard convexity and Robbins-Monro step-size assumptions. The ABP penalty structure is then translated into a two-phase, feasibility-first training strategy for Hyper-MLP and HyperTrans architectures (ABP-HyperNet). To evaluate constrained CPFL, we introduce the Expected Feasible Hypervolume (EFHV), which jointly captures solution quality and constraint satisfaction. Experiments on five multi-objective benchmarks validate the ABP solver against ground truth, while three multi-task learning datasets demonstrate that ABP-HyperNet achieves up to 2.3x higher EFHV than unconstrained baselines by raising feasibility from 36-49% to 87-100%.

AI.tldr: 本文针对"可控制帕累托前沿学习"(CPFL)中无法把解限制在决策者指定目标区域 Q 内这一开放问题，提出双层标量化分split可行性问题(BSSP)与自适应平衡惩罚算法(ABP)，并在凸性与Robbins–Monro步长等假设下证明全序列收敛；随后将惩罚结构转化为两阶段"可行性优先"超网络训练策略(ABP-HyperMLP/ABP-HyperTrans)，并提出期望可行超体积(EFHV)指标联合刻画解质量与约束满足度，实验显示可行性由36–49%提升至87–100%，EFHV最高提升2.3倍。
AI.motivation: 可控制帕累托前沿学习(CPFL)通过超网络把偏好向量映射为帕累托最优解，但现有方法(Hyper-MLP、HyperTrans、Navon等)只能逼近完整无约束帕累托前沿，缺乏将解限制在决策者指定目标空间区域 Q(如预算上限、质量阈值、监管边界)内的机制。Tuan et al. (2024b)虽建立了分裂多目标优化问题(SMOP)与结果空间松弛的理论联系，但其训练流程并未真正强制 F(x)∈Q，Q 仅作为启发式正则项出现。因此亟需一个形式化、可求解且具备可行性保证的约束 CPFL 优化问题与算法，同时在多任务学习等随机非凸神经场景中需要可落地的训练策略与统一的"质量—可行性"联合评价指标。
AI.method: 1) 形式化：沿 Censor–Elfving 分裂可行性(SFP)→SMOP→结果空间松弛→显式形式(ESP)的推导链，以扩展下包络 Q⁺=Q−ℝ₊ᵐ 消去辅助变量 y，提出 BSSP：min s(F(x),r) s.t. x∈C, F(x)∈Q⁺，其中 s 为加权 Chebyshev 标量化；给出 P_{Q⁺}(z̃)=min(z̃,y*) 的显式投影公式与自由处置性质。2) 算法：ABP(算法1)混合三梯度分量——最优性 wᵏ=r_{i*}∇f_{i*}、集合可行性 zᵏ=∇H(xᵏ)（x−P_C(x)）、像可行性 vᵏ=J_F^Tρᵏ（ρᵏ=F(xᵏ)−P_{Q⁺}(F(xᵏ))），并以可计算下界 φ_lb=inf_{x∈C}φ(x) 构造自适应指示 1_{Δ_k≥0} 与 Δ_k=φ(xᵏ)−φ_lb，步长 λ_k 满足 Robbins–Monro。3) 理论：核心是凸替代技术——以线性化半空间 Q_k⁺={y:⟨ρᵏ,y−pᵏ⟩≤0} 构造 δ_k(x)=½dist²(F(x),Q_k⁺)，使非凸的 G(x)=½dist²(F(x),Q⁺) 获得全局次梯度不等式 G(y)≥G_k+⟨vᵏ,y−xᵏ⟩；再构造 Lyapunov 不等式、准Fejér有界性，得到全序列收敛定理4.17；σ>0 时给出遍历(Cesàro)界与近似收敛定理4.22(可行性误差 O(√ε₀)、最优性误差 O(ε₀))。4) 落地：把三分量惩罚映射为两阶段训练——Phase 1 可行性预热 L=L_Q+εL_obj；Phase 2 权衡优化 L=L_obj+βL_Q，β 按可行性自适应增减(乘性因子 ρ、带上限 β_max、初值 β₀)；超网络为 Hyper-MLP(三层共享 MLP + 每参数线性头)与 HyperTrans(逐分量 token 嵌入 + 单个 Transformer 块 MHSA/FFN + 均值池化)，目标网络为无自有可学习参数的 Multi-LeNet。5) 指标：提出 EFHV=π·HV(P_feas)，π 为射线级可行率。
AI.result: 理论：ABP 在 A1–A7 假设(凸目标、闭凸 C 与 Q、Robbins–Monro 步长、有界惩罚权重、零间隙 σ=0)下全序列收敛到 Ω；若仅有 σ≤ε₀ 并假设有界性，则得到子序列收敛与三项近似界(dist(x̂,C)≤√(2C*ε₀/β̲)，dist(F(x̂),Q⁺)≤√(2C*ε₀/γ̲)，φ(x̂)≤φ*+C*ε₀/α̲)。MOP 基准(50 条偏好射线、CVX1–3、ZDT1–2)：ABP Solver 的 MED 为 0.0028–0.0101，ABP-HyperTrans 的平均 MED 在全部五个问题上不劣于求解器(如 ZDT1 0.0063 vs 0.0099)，且推理耗时仅 16–28 ms，比求解器快 2–3 个数量级；CVX1/CVX2 上 39/50、44/50 条射线零间隙成立，σ_max≤0.081。MTL 实验(Multi-MNIST、Multi-Fashion、Fashion+MNIST，10 折交叉验证)：基线可行率仅 36.5–49.1%，ABP-HyperNet 提升到 87.4–100%，EFHV 最高提升约 2.3 倍(Multi-MNIST Box: 1.282→2.958)，而全局 HV 损失最大仅 0.021(<1%)，个别情形 ΔHV≤0(约束起到隐式正则作用)；Sphere 约束因投影几何更平滑通常比 Box 可行率更高，ABP-HyperMLP 总体优于 ABP-HyperTrans。消融(跨三数据集平均)：Full(π=93.2%,EFHV=2.550) ≳ No-Phase1(92.5%,2.540) ≫ No-Adaptive-β(90.5%,2.424) > Single-Phase(82.9%,2.205) ≫ Hard-Switch(62.7%,1.740)。超参敏感性显示 ε∈[0.01,0.10]、ρ=1.05、β_max=10、β₀=1.0 为稳健默认。
AI.conclusion: 本文首次将约束 CPFL 形式化为良定义的优化问题并给出带可行性保证的求解器：BSSP 消除了 ESP 的辅助变量，ABP 的凸替代技术使非凸像可行性函数获得全局次梯度不等式，从而在零间隙条件下建立全序列收敛保证；其惩罚结构又被转化为"可行性优先"两阶段超网络训练启发式(作者明确承认该训练策略属受收敛理论启发但其自身收敛性仍是开放问题)。实验表明约束训练能以极小的前沿覆盖损失换取大幅可行的提升，EFHV 为质量—可行性联合评价提供了合适工具。主要局限与未来方向：零间隙假设 A7 结构性较强(可通过动态更新下界或拉格朗日对偶方法改善)；分析尚未扩展到随机非凸(深度网络)情形；未扩展到 m≥4 的多目标场景；且部分对比基于同族基线、约束区域由本文自行设定。

title: An Objective Performance Evaluation of the LSTM Networks in Time Series Classification
comment: Accepted in 2026 29th International Conference on Information Fusion
summary: The rapid adoption of deep learning has increasingly led to data-driven models replacing classical model-based algorithms, even in domains governed by well-understood physical laws. While data-driven models, such as long short-term memory (LSTM) networks, have become a popular choice for time-series analysis, their performance relative to model-based approaches in structured environments is rarely evaluated objectively. This paper presents a performance evaluation framework comparing an LSTM classifier against a model-based expectation maximization (EM) classifier for binary time-series classification. The evaluation is conducted on two scalar linear Gaussian state space models differing only in their noise statistics, where the Kalman filter likelihood ratio test with true parameters serves as a reference for the best achievable classification performance.Through Monte Carlo simulations, the classifiers are evaluated across three axes: task difficulty, controlled by the separation in process or measurement noise between the two models; sequence length; and training dataset size. The results show that the EM classifier, which exploits the known model structure, performs strongly when the data conform to the assumed model class. The LSTM classifier requires a larger separation in noise statistics to achieve reliable classification, and its performance saturates below the reference classifier when the models differ only in measurement noise, regardless of sequence length or training dataset size.

AI.tldr: 本文对比了LSTM深度学习分类器与基于模型的EM分类器在二元时间序列分类任务中的性能差异。研究表明，当数据符合假设的模型类别时，利用已知模型结构的EM分类器表现优异；而LSTM分类器需要更大的噪声统计差异才能实现可靠分类，且在仅测量噪声不同时，其性能始终低于参考分类器。
AI.motivation: 深度学习模型在时间序列分析中的应用日益广泛，但在已知物理定律的领域，数据驱动模型相对于基于模型的方法的性能优势很少被客观评估。
AI.method: 采用Monte Carlo仿真方法，在两个标量线性高斯状态空间模型上进行评估。实验从三个维度进行：任务难度（由过程噪声或测量噪声的分离程度控制）、序列长度、训练数据集规模。Kalman滤波器似然比检验作为理论最优参考。
AI.result: EM分类器在数据符合模型假设时表现强劲；LSTM分类器需要更大的噪声统计差异才能实现可靠分类；当两个模型仅在测量噪声上存在差异时，LSTM性能随序列长度或训练数据规模的增加仍无法达到参考分类器水平。
AI.conclusion: 在结构化环境中，当数据的生成过程符合假设的模型类别时，基于模型的分类方法优于数据驱动的深度学习方法。这表明模型先验知识的利用对于此类问题具有重要价值。

title: Inference-Time Scaling in Diffusion Models through Iterative Partial Refinement
comment: Accepted at the ICLR 2026 Workshop on AI with Recursive Self-Improvement
summary: Inference-time scaling has emerged as a major approach for improving reasoning capabilities, and has been increasingly applied to diffusion models. However, existing inference-time scaling methods for diffusion models typically rely on external verifiers or reward models to rank and select samples, limiting their scalability to settings where such evaluators are available and reliable. Moreover, while recent diffusion models perform sequential inference with region-wise, mixed-noise conditioning, inference-time scaling tailored to this setting remains relatively underexplored. We propose Iterative Partial Refinement (IPR), an inference-time scaling method for sequential diffusion that requires no external verifier. Starting from an already-generated sample, IPR re-noises a subset of regions and regenerates them conditioned on the remaining regions, enabling the model to revise earlier decisions under a richer context than was available during the initial generation. This iterative partial refinement produces more globally consistent samples without external verification. On reasoning tasks requiring global constraint satisfaction, IPR consistently improves performance: on MNIST Sudoku, the valid solution rate increases from 55.8% to 75.0%. These results show that iterative partial refinement alone can serve as an effective inference-time scaling strategy for diffusion models in sequential, mixed-noise settings. Code is available at: https://github.com/ahn-ml/IPR

AI.tldr: 本文提出Iterative Partial Refinement (IPR)，一种无需外部验证器的顺序扩散模型推理时扩展方法。IPR通过迭代式重噪声化并重新生成部分区域，在更丰富的上下文下修正早期决策，显著提升全局一致性。在MNIST Sudoku上有效解率从55.8%提升至75.0%。
AI.motivation: 现有扩散模型的推理时扩展方法通常依赖外部验证器或奖励模型进行样本排序和选择，限制了其在缺乏可靠评估器场景下的可扩展性。此外，针对具有区域级混合噪声条件的顺序推理扩散模型的推理时扩展方法尚未得到充分探索。
AI.method: IPR首先从已生成的完整样本出发，选择部分区域进行重噪声化，然后在保留其余区域的条件下重新生成被选中的区域。这种迭代式部分细化使模型能够在比初始生成更丰富的上下文信息下修正早期的决策，从而产生全局一致性更好的样本，无需外部验证器的参与。
AI.result: 在需要全局约束满足的推理任务中，IPR持续提升性能：在MNIST Sudoku任务上，有效解率从55.8%提升至75.0%。
AI.conclusion: IPR通过迭代部分细化策略，在无需外部验证器的情况下实现了扩散模型推理时的有效扩展，在MNIST Sudoku上从未知解率55.8%提升至75.0%，证明了该方法在需要全局约束满足的推理任务中的有效性。

title: BrainDyn: A Sheaf Neural ODE for Generative Brain Dynamics
summary: Efficient neural network models that generate brain-like dynamic activity can be a valuable resource for generating synthetic data, analyzing differences in brain transients under conditions such as testing perturbation activity or inferring the underlying generative dynamics. However, large language models (LLMs) or standard recurrent neural networks (RNNs) ignore the anatomical organization and therefore do not produce components that align with brain regions. On the other hand, graph-based networks often have very simple message passing rules that are not sufficiently expressive for brain-like dynamics. To address this, we introduce BrainDyn, a sheaf neural ordinary differential equation (neural ODE) model for continuous-time dynamics on structured brain graphs. BrainDyn encodes the recent activity history of each brain region using a long short-term memory (LSTM) model over a sliding temporal window to produce hidden states, or stalks, that are projected through learnable restriction maps into edge-specific shared spaces. Discrepancies between neighboring nodes in these shared spaces are characterized by a sheaf Laplacian that can facilitate message passing between neuronal units. The output of these messages is then fed to a neural ODE that governs the continuous-time evolution of neuronal activity. We evaluated BrainDyn on resting-state fMRI (PNC dataset), scalp EEG with focal epilepsy (TUSZ dataset), and simulated activity from the NEST spiking network simulator. BrainDyn achieves strong forecasting ability across modalities, and the resulting representations support downstream tasks including in silico perturbation prediction.

AI.tldr: BrainDyn 提出了一种基于细胞层（cellular sheaf）结构的动态图神经 ODE 模型，用于在结构化脑图上建模连续时间神经动力学。其核心创新是：由 MLP 根据相邻节点当前状态实时生成可学习的、随时间变化的限制映射（restriction maps），经归一化 sheaf Laplacian 完成边特定的异质消息传递，再由带可学习频率正弦时间嵌入的神经 ODE 积分生成未来活动。在 PNC 静息态 fMRI、LEMON 静息态 EEG 与 NEST 模拟数据上，BrainDyn 在短期预测与长程自回归生成任务中全面超越 CNN-LSTM、BIOT、BrainLM、EvolveGCN、ODEBRAIN、RiTINI 等基线，并能外推预测未见过的扰动动力学（fMRI 短期 MSE 降 45%、DTW 降 37%；EEG 短期 MSE 优于 ODEBRAIN 6.5%；NEST 扰动短期 MSE 降 8%、长程降 3%）。
AI.motivation: 计算神经科学长期追求数据驱动的"脑活动生成模型"，可用于合成数据、扰动响应预测（in silico perturbation）与推断底层生成动力学。但现有方法各有缺陷：LLM/标准 RNN 能捕捉时序依赖却完全忽略脑区的解剖组织结构，预测无法归因到具体脑区；标准 GNN 虽适配图结构，但所有节点被置于单一共享特征空间并以标量求和/平均聚合消息，这与神经生物学证据不符——不同脑区具有系统性的表征几何差异，跨区通信由可逆的几何变换介导，且反复平均会导致过平滑（over-smoothing），抹平区域异质的动力学特性。因此需要一种既尊重脑区解剖组织、又具备足够表达力以刻画异质、时变脑区通信的生成式模型。
AI.method: 模型基于四部分：(1) 历史累积——共享 LSTM 在滑动上下文窗口（Tc=32）上编码每节点近期活动，得到 stalk 表示 h_i(t)∈R^d；(2) 时变可学习限制映射——单一 MLP 接收相邻两节点的 LSTM 隐状态与学得的位置编码 p_i, p_j（每节点 8 维），输出 d×d 矩阵 ρ_{i→e_ij}(t)、ρ_{j→e_ij}(t)（保持非对称性），因依赖当前节点状态故随时间变化，是图注意力的推广（注意力值由标量扩展为整个向量空间结构）；(3) 消息传递——组装可学习 sheaf Laplacian L_F=δᵀδ 及度归一化形式 L_F^norm=D_F^{-1/2}L_F D_F^{-1/2}，迭代 L 轮 H^{(l)}=(I−L_F^norm)H^{(l−1)}，等价于归一化 sheaf Laplacian 热方程的前向欧拉离散/图扩散低通滤波；(4) 预测——带可学习频率（ω_k=2πc_max·σ(η_k)，几何序列初始化，周期上界 c_max 保证数值可分辨）的正弦时间嵌入 z(t)，与位置编码一同输入 MLP 参数化的导数网络，经 tanh 界约束后由四阶 Runge–Kutta 积分得到连续时间演化。短期预测直接解 ODE 未来 Tf=8 步；长程自回归从上下文末端 +33Δt 起，每次预测 8 步并滚动前推。训练用 AdamW（lr 1e-3，ReduceLROnPlateau），Xavier 初始化并缩放 γ=0.1 使限制映射从近零矩阵出发，混合精度 fp16，单张 H200。数据为 PNC 静息态 fMRI（Schaefer 400 图谱）、LEMON 62 通道头皮 EEG、NEST 100 神经元有向小世界网络模拟；按受试者 70/20/10 划分，5 次随机重复；指标为 MSE、MAE、归一化 DTW。消融包括去 sheaf、去 LSTM、去时间嵌入以及空间/功能连接/Granger 因果三种建图方式对比。
AI.result: fMRI（PNC）：短期预测 MSE 0.0531±0.0091、MAE 0.1238、DTW 0.0599 全面最优，较最强基线 CNN-LSTM 的 MSE 降 45%、DTW 降 37%；长程自回归 MSE 0.6374、DTW 0.2654 仍最优（较 CNN-LSTM 分别降 5.5%、2.8%）。EEG（LEMON）：短期 MSE 0.4001、MAE 0.4209、DTW 0.1905 均最优，较 ODEBRAIN 的 MSE 降 6.5%；长程 MSE 0.7199、MAE 0.6005 最优，DTW 0.3008 略逊于 ODEBRAIN（0.2522）。NEST 扰动（仅用未扰动数据训练，测试分布外扰动窗口）：BrainDyn 全部指标最优，短期 MSE 0.6649（较 ODEBRAIN 0.7197 降 8%）、MAE 降 6%、DTW 降 6%；长程 MSE 降 3%、DTW 降 2%。消融显示去掉 sheaf 结构、LSTM 或时间嵌入均导致各数据集性能下降；空间邻近建图优于功能连接，Granger 因果最差。解释性分析显示：限制映射的 Frobenius 范数随时间与边变化（动态调制区域通信）；学习到的奇异值谱相对初始化明显重塑且快速衰减，呈近似低秩结构，与"区域间通信经由低维通信子空间介导"的证据一致；极分解分析表明映射相对初始化更偏向"拉伸"而非纯旋转。
AI.conclusion: BrainDyn 是首个将动态（时变）sheaf 结构与图神经 ODE 相结合的模型，其贡献在于：可学习时变限制映射（推广图注意力）、sheaf 网络与图 ODE 的首次结合、以及引入可学习频率正弦时间嵌入以建模非自治动力学。它在 fMRI、EEG 与 NEST 模拟三种模态上均表现出强预测能力，能自回归生成长瞬变，并可外推到训练时未见的扰动动力学，同时学得的限制映射具备可解释性（低秩、近似线性拉伸/旋转几何）与生物学对齐性。局限与未来方向：应用于更大更多样的神经数据集与下游应用驱动任务，以及推广到其他领域的相关时间序列建模。

title: An Exterior Method for Nonnegative Matrix Factorization
summary: Nonnegative matrix factorization (NMF) seeks a low-rank approximation $X \approx UV^T$ with nonnegative factors and is commonly solved using interior methods that enforce feasibility throughout optimization. We show that such constraint-driven approaches can impede progress in the nonconvex landscape, leading to slow convergence or convergence to suboptimal stationary points. We propose an exterior framework for NMF (eNMF) that separates low-rank approximation from nonnegativity enforcement. Our method initializes from the optimal unconstrained factorization and introduces a rotation procedure that maps unconstrained factors to an exterior point closest to the nonnegative orthant. This viewpoint yields an algorithmic framework in which simple iterative updates converge to KKT-satisfying stationary points on the boundary of the positive orthant. The exterior formulation also enables a geometric interpretation of NMF solutions, clarifying equivalence classes of factorizations under permutation and orthogonal transformations. An intriguing numerical result, involving 400 NMF experiments across both real and synthetic datasets, show that in 99% of the cases, different algorithms tend to converge towards equivalent factor matrices. We benchmark eNMF against 9 state-of-the-art NMF algorithms with 9 initialization schemes across 3 real-world and 2 synthetic datasets. eNMF consistently outperforms all 81 competitors, achieving up to 30% lower reconstruction error under equal-time settings and up to 150% speedup under equal-error settings. The downstream experiments further demonstrate substantial performance gains in audio processing and recommendation tasks, corroborating the practical benefits of the proposed exterior optimization framework. Code is available at https://github.com/roychowdhuryresearch/eNMF

AI.tldr: 本文提出eNMF外部优化框架，通过分离低秩近似与非负性约束、旋转映射到非负象限边界的方式，解决了传统内点法NMF收敛慢、易陷入次优解的问题。实验证明其在重建误差和收敛速度上显著优于9种state-of-the-art算法，且99%的实验表明不同算法趋于收敛到等价解。
AI.motivation: 传统NMF使用内点法（interior-point methods）强制约束不可行性，但非负约束可能阻碍非凸优化景观中的进展，导致收敛缓慢或收敛到次优的驻点。
AI.method: 提出外部框架eNMF，将低秩近似与非负性约束分离。具体包括：(1) 从最优无约束分解初始化；(2) 引入旋转程序将无约束因子映射到非负象限的最近边界点；(3) 采用简单迭代更新收敛至满足KKT条件的边界驻点。该方法还提供了NMF解在置换和正交变换下的等价类几何解释。
AI.result: 在400次NMF实验（真实与合成数据集）中，99%的情况显示不同算法趋于收敛到等价的因子矩阵。eNMF在81个竞争配置（9种算法×9种初始化×3个真实数据集+2个合成数据集）中始终表现最优：在相同时间设置下重建误差降低30%，在相同误差设置下加速150%。下游任务（音频处理、推荐系统）也验证了其实用价值。
AI.conclusion: eNMF通过将低秩近似与非负性约束分离，提供了一种新的NMF优化范式。该框架不仅具有坚实的理论基础（KKT条件满足的边界解），还提供了对NMF解的几何解释（置换和正交变换下的等价类）。实验结果表明其在重建误差和收敛速度上均显著优于现有方法，并在下游任务（音频处理、推荐系统）中展现出实际应用价值。

title: What Makes a Representation Good for Single-Cell Perturbation Prediction?
summary: Single-cell perturbation modeling is fundamental for understanding and predicting cellular responses to genetic perturbations. However, existing approaches, from causal representation learning to foundation models, often struggle with an overlooked challenge: gene expression is dominated by perturbation-invariant information, while perturbation-specific signals are intrinsically sparse. As a result, learned representations either entangle invariant and perturbation-specific information, leading to spurious and non-generalizable predictors, or suppress perturbation-specific signals altogether, rendering them ineffective for prediction. To address this, we propose PerturbedVAE, a general framework designed to resolve this signal imbalance. The framework explicitly separates perturbation-specific information from dominant invariant structure and recovers causal representations to effectively utilize such information for prediction. We further provide an identifiability analysis that characterizes the conditions under which sparse perturbation effects can be reliably recovered, thereby clarifying how the framework can be concretely specified under such conditions. Empirically, PerturbedVAE achieves state-of-the-art performance on a widely used benchmark across multiple evaluation settings, yielding significant gains on out-of-distribution combinatorial predictions and uncovering interpretable perturbation-response programs.

AI.tldr: PerturbedVAE通过分离扰动特异性信息与不变结构来解决单细胞扰动建模中的信号不平衡问题，在基准数据集上取得最优性能，特别是在分布外组合预测任务上表现突出。
AI.motivation: 现有方法（包括因果表示学习和基础模型）在单细胞扰动建模中面临一个被忽视的挑战：基因表达数据中扰动不变信息占主导地位，而扰动特异性信号本质上是稀疏的。这导致学习到的表示要么纠缠了不变信息和扰动特异性信息（产生虚假且不可泛化的预测器），要么完全压制了扰动特异性信号（使其对预测无效）。
AI.method: PerturbedVAE采用变分自编码器框架，通过显式分离扰动特异性信息和主导的不变结构来恢复因果表示。框架包含可辨识性分析，刻画了在何种条件下可以可靠地恢复稀疏扰动效应，从而明确框架在何种条件下可具体实现。
AI.result: PerturbedVAE在多个评估设置的广泛使用基准数据集上达到最先进的性能，在分布外组合预测任务中获得显著提升，并揭示了解释性的扰动响应程序。
AI.conclusion: 本文提出了PerturbedVAE框架，通过显式分离扰动不变信息和扰动特异性信息，并恢复因果表示来解决单细胞扰动建模中的信号不平衡问题。理论分析提供了可辨识性条件，实验验证了在基准数据集上达到最优性能，特别是在分布外组合预测任务中表现突出，并揭示了解释性扰动响应程序。

title: Accurate, Efficient, and Explainable Deep Learning Approaches for Environmental Science Problems
summary: Environmental science plays a pivotal role in safeguarding ecosystems, a domain driven by large-scale, heterogeneous data. In the big data era, artificial intelligence (AI) has emerged as a transformative tool for learning patterns and supporting decision-making. This dissertation develops AI-based approaches tailored to complex environmental science problems to achieve Environmental Intelligence, studying three specific challenges. First, we focus on flood prediction and management in coastal river systems. Conventional physics-based models are computationally intensive, limiting real-time application. To overcome this, we propose a deep learning (DL)-based model, WaLeF, for water level forecasting, and a forecast-informed DL model, FIDLAr, to manage water levels. Evaluated in a flood-prone coastal system in South Florida characterized by extreme rainfall and sea level fluctuations, FIDLAr outperforms baselines in accuracy and efficiency while providing interpretable outputs. Second, we target global weather prediction, which is challenged by massive data scale. Traditional physics methods are deterministic and computationally heavy. We propose CoDiCast, a conditional diffusion model tailored for probabilistic weather forecasting. Adapted from generative AI for predictive tasks, experiments show CoDiCast achieves accurate, efficient forecasts with explicit uncertainty quantification. Lastly, we address scientific question-answering in environmental science. When answering in-domain questions, large language models (LLMs) often suffer from hallucinations due to out-of-date or limited knowledge. While retrieval-augmented generation (RAG) retrieves domain-specific knowledge, existing methods trade off accuracy, efficiency, or explainability. We propose Hypercube-RAG, built on a structured text cube framework, which successfully exhibits all three properties simultaneously.

AI.tldr: 本文是一篇关于环境智能的博士论文，通过开发三个AI驱动的方法解决环境科学中的洪水预测、天气预报和科学问答问题。
AI.motivation: 环境科学面临大数据挑战，AI技术虽已兴起但在环境科学领域的应用仍需深入探索，尤其是物理模型计算成本高、天气预报数据规模大、LLM存在幻觉问题等具体痛点。
AI.method: 针对三个不同问题采用了针对性方法：①FIDLAr采用预测引导的深度学习模型进行洪水管理；②CoDiCast采用条件扩散模型进行概率天气预报；③Hypercube-RAG基于结构化文本立方体框架结合检索增强生成。
AI.result: FIDLAr在准确性和效率上优于基线模型并提供可解释输出；CoDiCast实现了准确高效的天气预报并可量化不确定性；Hypercube-RAG同时具备准确性、效率和可解释性三个特性。
AI.conclusion: 本文通过WaLeF、FIDLAr、CoDiCast和Hypercube-RAG四个具体方法，分别解决了环境监测中的洪水预测、天气预报和科学问答三个核心问题，较为全面地展示了AI技术在环境科学领域的应用潜力。

title: The Evaluation Game: Beyond Static LLM Benchmarking
summary:
As jailbreaks, adversarially crafted inputs that bypass safety constraints, continue to be discovered in Large Language Models, practitioners increasingly rely on fine-tuning as a defensive strategy. Yet the theoretical foundations underlying this robustness fine-tuning remain underexplored. We introduce a game-theoretic framework in which the interaction between an evaluator (auditing the model for jailbreaks) and a trainer is formalized as a two-player game.
  A key feature of our approach is the use of group actions, a mathematical structure that captures symmetries and transformations, to formally represent data augmentation. The simplest non-trivial instance is the circle with cyclic translation groups, where we exhibit various regimes depending on the trainer's generalization range. Below a critical threshold, the evaluator maintains a constant miss ratio for linearly many rounds, whereas other settings can yield very different behaviors. We further provide empirical evidence supporting locality-dependence of the model: for the three model families we tested (Llama, Qwen and Mistral), we have significant evidence that fine-tuning on adversarial prompts induces only local generalization, with refusal rates on test examples highly correlated with the distance to the fine-tuning prompts. Our framework recasts the central object of adversarial evaluation: a benchmark is not a static set of prompts but an orbit under the evaluator's group action, and audit protocols that ignore trainer-side adaptation cannot distinguish a genuine fix from a memorized patch.

AI.tldr: 本文提出一个基于博弈论框架来理解大语言模型微调防御jailbreak的理论基础，利用群作用数学结构形式化数据增强，并在Llama、Qwen、Mistral三个模型族上验证了微调仅诱导局部泛化的假设，揭示了对抗评估基准应被视为评估者群作用下的轨道而非静态数据集。
AI.motivation: 当前LLM中jailbreak攻防实践主要依赖经验性微调策略，缺乏理论支撑。论文认为微调防御的理论基础尚未被充分探索，需要形式化框架来理解训练者与评估者之间的博弈动态。
AI.method: 1. 建立训练者与评估者（审计模型jailbreak）的两人博弈形式化模型；2. 利用群作用（group actions）数学结构形式化数据增强，将数据增强表示为对称性和变换；3. 最小非平凡实例采用圆与循环平移群进行分析；4. 在三个模型族（Llama、Qwen、Mistral）上进行拒绝率与训练提示距离相关性的实证研究。
AI.result: 1. 发现关键阈值现象：训练者泛化范围低于临界值时，评估者在线性多轮中保持恒定漏检率；其他设置下行为差异显著；2. 三个模型族均显示强证据支持微调的局域性假设：对抗提示微调后的拒绝率与到微调样本的距离高度相关。
AI.conclusion: 微调防御的效果取决于泛化范围，且呈局域性特征。对抗评估基准应被重新定义为评估者群作用下的轨道而非静态提示集。忽视训练者端适应的审计协议无法区分真实修复与记忆化补丁。

title: Understanding Dynamics of Adam in Zero-Sum Games: An ODE Approach
summary: The remarkable success of the Adam in training neural networks has naturally led to the widespread use of its descent-ascent counterpart, Adam-DA, for solving zero-sum games. Despite its popularity in practice, a rigorous theoretical understanding of Adam-DA still lags behind. In this paper, we derive ordinary differential equations (ODEs) that serve as continuous-time limits of the Adam-DA. These ODEs closely approximate the discrete-time dynamics of Adam-DA, providing a tractable analytical framework for understanding its behavior in zero-sum games. Using this ODE approach, we investigate two fundamental aspects of Adam-DA: local convergence and implicit gradient regularization. Our analysis reveals that the roles of the first- and second-order momentum parameters in zero-sum games are exactly the opposite of their well-documented effects in minimization problems. We validate these predictions through GAN experiments across multiple architectures and datasets, demonstrating the practical implications of this reversed momentum effect.

AI.tldr: 本文用 ODE（常微分方程）方法刻画零和博弈中 Adam 下降-上升算法（Adam-DA）的动力学，导出 O(h³) 局部误差的连续时间模型，并从「局部收敛性」与「隐式梯度正则化（IGR）」两个角度证明：Adam 的两个动量参数在零和博弈中的作用与经典极小化问题**恰好相反**——博弈中更小的第一阶动量 β、更大的第二阶动量 ρ 有利（更宽的收敛步长区间、轨迹更平坦、GAN 性能更好），且 Adam-DA 在双线性博弈中必发散。结论在多种架构与数据集的 GAN 实验中得到验证。
AI.motivation: Adam-DA 是 GAN、对抗训练等零和博弈任务的事实标准优化器，但其理论基础远落后于 Adam 在极小化问题上的研究。现有博弈理论工作（Heavy-ball/Nesterov 动量、GDA 的 IGR）几乎都沿用极小化中的「正动量有利于加速/正则化」结论；而 GAN 实践却显示**负动量**常能提升稳定性与性能（Gidel et al., 2019），理论与实践存在明显张力。由此提出两个核心问题：(1) 如何刻画 Adam 在零和博弈中的动力学？(2) Adam 的行为在哪些方面与极小化不同？作者选择局部收敛性（刻画平衡点附近轨迹）与隐式梯度正则化（刻画轨迹与损失面平坦度的相互作用）两个互补视角切入。
AI.method:
**1) 连续时间模型（Sec. 3）**：通过数值分析中的后向误差分析（Haier et al. 2006；思路源自 Cattaneo et al. 2024 的 Adam 极小化 ODE），对 Adam-DA 的偏差校正展开式逐坐标推导，得到「Continuous Adam-DA」ODE：x-玩家为自适应归一化梯度加上一个含 ||∇_x f||_{1,ε} − ||∇_y f||_{1,ε} 梯度的 IGR 修正项，其中 K(β,ρ)=(1+β)/(1−β)−(1+ρ)/(1−ρ)。定理 3.1：在四阶导数有界下，ODE 轨迹在 max{2log h/|log β|, 2log h/log ρ} 步后与 Adam-DA 以 O(h³) 局部误差一致；相较 SignGDA-flow（O(h²)）拟合更好（图 1、5、6 数值验证）。

**2) 局部收敛性（Sec. 4）**：在局部 Nash 均衡处构造 Jacobian 分解 J=S+A（对称/反对称），证明关键命题 4.1：J_Adam = (1/√ε)(I − h(1+β)/(2√ε(1−β))·J)J，即 Adam-DA 的 Jacobian 是 GDA Jacobian 的二次多项式，其特征值形如 (1/√ε)(1−γλ)λ。借助矩阵多项式特征值引理（Graham, 2018）与 Wang & Chizat (2024) 的 Lemma C.4（Re(λ)<0），在 Assumption 4.2（存在 |Im λ|>|Re λ| 的特征值且 EigVec(A)∩Ker(S)={0}）下得到 ODE 的步长条件（Thm 4.3）。离散算法侧（Thm 4.4）把 Adam-DA 写成时变离散动力系统 z_{n+1}=T̄(z_n)+R(n,z_n)，通过特征多项式与 Schur–Jury 型判据（Henrici Lemma C.7）证明 ρ(Jac(T̄))<1，并用等价范数/压缩映射（Elaydi Lemma C.8、C.9）与指数衰减扰动项（Lemma C.11）推出离散情形的局部指数收敛。

**3) 隐式梯度正则化（Sec. 5）**：取 ε→0 分析 ODE 的 IGR 项，比较 x-玩家对 ||∇_x f||_{1,ε} 的下降项（∝ −∇²_x f）与 y-玩家对其的上升项（∝ ∇_y x f）；在「玩家交互占主导」（∇_y x f ≫ ∇²_x f，Jacobian 特征值虚部占优，GAN 属此类）下，y-玩家的上升效应主导，因此降低 K(β,ρ) 即可抑制其放大平坦度破坏的效应——即更小 β、更大 ρ 使轨迹走向平坦区域（以 ||∇_x f||₁+||∇_y f||₁ 度量）。

**4) 实验**：WGAN 框架，CIFAR-10/STL-10 + ResNet/CNN，附加 CelebA 上的 self-attention GAN 与 optimistic 方法对比；学习率 2e-4、batch 64；指标为累积平均梯度范数 AvgS_{β,ρ}(t)、Inception Score、FID，以及 (β,ρ) 二维扫描。
AI.result: **局部收敛**：ODE（Thm 4.3）与离散算法（Thm 4.4）给出显式步长上界，且该上界随 β∈(−1,1) 单调递减 ⇒ 在博弈中**更小的 β 扩大可收敛步长区间**（Corollary 4.5，与极小化中需更大 β 相反）；对双线性博弈 f=xᵀAy，Adam-DA 无论 β,ρ,ε,h 如何取值**总是发散**（Corollary 4.6，推广了 GDA/MWU 的发散结论）；此外发现较大的 ε 可扩大收敛区间（图 7），这是此前 Heavy-ball 分析中没有的现象；且当 β 很小时连续模型与离散算法的匹配变弱（连续化方法的局限）。**IGR**：K(β,ρ) 随 β 增大、ρ 减小而增大，故更小 β + 更大 ρ 抑制 y-玩家对梯度范数的上升效应，使轨迹偏平——与极小化（Cattaneo et al. 2024：更大 β、更小 ρ 才正则化）完全相反。**实验**：小 β → 梯度范数更小、IS 更高（如 ResNet/CIFAR-10：β=0.5 时 IS 4.16，β=0/−0.3 时约 7.02–7.09）；大 ρ（0.9 vs 0.3）同样降低梯度范数并提升 IS；CelebA self-attention GAN 上小 β/大 ρ 同时改善 FID；且负 β 的 Adam 在 FID 上可优于 optimistic 方法；二维扫描显示 (β 小, ρ 大) 一角梯度范数与 FID 最低，验证平坦性与泛化性能的联系。
AI.conclusion: 本文建立了分析博弈中 Adam-DA 的 ODE 框架，并从局部收敛与隐式梯度正则化两方面证明：动量与自适应参数在零和博弈中的作用与极小化问题**完全相反**——第一阶动量 β 变小、第二阶动量 ρ 变大更有利，Adam-DA 在双线性博弈中必发散。这为 GAN 训练中负动量有益的经验现象提供了理论解释，也把此前仅针对无自适应、无动量方法的博弈-极小化分离结论（Bailey et al.）推广到 Adam-DA。局限：主要分析确定性设定（作者认为这是走向完整理论的第一步，虽实验用随机 Adam 且结论一致），且结论针对「交互占主导」的典型博弈；未来方向包括多玩家一般和博弈等更复杂场景中动量与自适应的角色。

title: TIDE: Asymmetric Neural Circuits for Stabilized Temporal Inhibitory-Excitatory Dynamics
summary: Recent Continuous Thought Machine architecture decouples internal computation from external inputs via neural dynamics, but relies on multi-layer perceptrons without stability guarantees. We propose to model neural dynamics using asymmetric Excitatory-Inhibitory (E-I) networks, which can be stabilized via principles from network theory and can be expressed as energy-based systems optimized through a game-theoretic loss. Building on this perspective, we introduce Temporal Inhibitory-Excitatory Dynamic Engine (TIDE), a neuro-inspired architecture that computes internal representations through neural dynamics stabilized by incorporating the Wilson-Cowan dynamics and lateral inhibition. TIDE balances biological realism by, for instance, using Hierarchical Receptive Fields and enforcing Dale's principle to ensure a realistic $80:20$ E-I balance ratio with an end-to-end trainable architecture. The aim of this paper is to introduce a new architecture that brings neuro-inspired learning to the forefront. We present proofs of convergence, stability, and complexity bounds, along with empirical ablation studies. Overall, TIDE surpasses CTM with under $50\%$ of the training time and improves $\texttt{top-1}$ accuracy by an average of $+1.65\%$ on ImageNet under various perturbations.

AI.tldr: TIDE 是一种神经启发的递归架构：在 CTM 的内部计算步框架上，用 Wilson–Cowan 兴奋-抑制（E-I）双群动力学替代无约束 MLP 循环连接，通过 Dale 原则（权重非负 + 抑制符号显式外置）保证可证明的稳定性，并结合侧向抑制（WTA）、三类同步读出、HRF 中心-环绕骨干、惊奇门控记忆及博弈论能量损失。它在 ImageNet-1K 上用 100K 步即达 68.74% top-1（超过 CTM 500K 步的 71.78% 同等对比下仅 51.0%@100K），在各类扰动下平均领先 CTM +1.65%，训练时间不足 CTM 的 50%；但 CIFAR-100 上仍落后 CTM（62.53 vs 64.75），且收敛定理仅在局部成立。
AI.motivation: CTM 通过把内部推理与外部输入解耦、用递归计算步替代静态激活来支持"连续思考"，但其递归连接仅由标准 MLP 表示，既不满足 Dale 原则，也缺乏任何稳定性保证，容易出现训练漂移与样本效率低的问题。另一方面，神经科学表明非对称兴奋-抑制（E-I）网络、80:20 的 E-I 群体比例、Dale 原则可显著提升鲁棒性与能效，且 Wilson-Cowan 动力学可经网络理论稳定化并写成能量系统、以博弈论损失优化。作者希望提出一个以神经动力学为主要原语、兼具理论保证与端到端可训练性的新架构（生物合理性优先于凑合复用 ResNet 主干）。
AI.method: **架构组件**：(1) HRF 骨干——可学习中心-环绕滤波器组（s∈{1,2,4,8}，含 DoG 特例）与 ResNet 式深层变体，替代 CTM 预训练 ResNet-152；(2) Wilson-Cowan E-I 递归——前向 Euler 离散，τ_E=20ms、τ_I=5ms（α_E=0.05、α_I=0.20），权重按 W=Σ⊙|M| 参数化并每步做 Π_Dale 投影；(3) 群体特异 NLM——指数时间核（AMPA/GABA_A 动力学），存储后激活以避免正反馈；(4) 三类同步读出（EE/EI/II），指数衰减协方差累积器；(5) 侧向抑制 WTA（K_WTA=5，零和博弈 Nash 均衡稀疏化）；(6) 惊奇门控记忆 + E-I 保持门（ρ_EI 偏离目标 4 时停止写入）；(7) 交叉注意力与 GLU 输出头。**损失**为五项加权和：CTM 双交叉熵任务损失 + E-I 比例正则 + 博弈 Nash 残差损失 + 同步正则 + Perron 谱正则。**理论**：Thm A.3（Dale 约束投影梯度收敛，局部 O(log 1/ε)）、Thm 4.2/C.4（LDS ⇒ 线性化动力学全局收敛到唯一 Nash 均衡 x*=(I−W_eff)^{-1}b）、Thm A.5（Brouwer 不动点存在）、Thm C.2（Schur 稳定与步长上界 Δt < 2Re(−μ)/|μ|²）、Prop C.7（可微 sum-ratio Perron 估计收敛至 Perron 特征值）及孤立 E/I 群体 Schur 界（λ_P(W_EE)<1、λ_P(W_II)<9）。
AI.result: **基准**：MNIST 99.67 vs CTM 99.59；Fashion-MNIST 94.24 vs 92.80；CIFAR-10 90.60 vs 86.16；ImageNet-1K 68.74%（100K 步、均值 67.22±1.34）vs CTM 51.0%（100K）/71.78%（500K）；CIFAR-100 上 TIDE 62.53 低于 CTM 64.75（作者归因于浅层 HRF 特征不足，换 ResNet-18 更降至 31.74%）。**鲁棒性**：ImageNet-C 平均 +1.65%（雾/雪等气溶胶类扰动 CTM 更优）；ImageNet-R 25.75 vs 25.46；Tiny-ImageNet 零样本 24.80 vs 20.60（+4.20）。**效率**：100K 步即达 68.74%，训练时间约为 CTM 的一半。**消融**：n_E/d=0.8 最优或接近最优；λ_game 必须 ≤1e-3，否则抑制群体完全沉默（ρ_EI→0.01）；τ_E∈[15,25]、τ_I∈[5,7] 稳定；内部步数 T∈[10,50] 稳定，T=75/100 崩塌（Fashion-MNIST 降至 24.45%）；K_WTA=10 优于默认 5（+1.14% F-MNIST），说明默认 WTA 配置处于局部最优；ImageNet 上 Perron 估计稳定收敛于 τ_EE=15、τ_II=7 的 hinge 边界（14.69±0.27 / 6.998±0.006）。**方法学限制**：CTM 仅单种子重训、TIDE 与 CTM 主干不同（跨架构而非同族对比）、ImageNet 对比采用 1:5 的训练步不对称设置。
AI.conclusion: TIDE 表明，用 Dale 约束的非对称 E-I 神经动力学替代无约束 MLP 循环，可在保留 CTM"内部计算步 + 同步读出"框架的同时获得可证明的稳定性（LDS/Schur/不动点）、更好的样本效率与 OOD 鲁棒性，且训练开销更低；作者还指出 CTM 可视为 TIDE 在 n_I=0 时的特例。作者规划的后续方向：以增广拉格朗日把 Nash 残差与 ρ_EI≈ρ* 耦合做流形优化、施加更严格的生物物理约束、扩展到序列建模与脉冲/神经形态实现。遗留问题包括：全损失非凸导致收敛率仅局部适用、收敛点处 LDS 尚未证明、HRF 仅 Stage-0 在 DoG 初始化下具备旋转等变性、以及顺序前处理带来的运行时间刚性。

title: A Bitter Lesson for Data Filtering
summary: We investigate data filtering for large model pretraining via new scaling studies that target the high compute, data-scarce regime. In spite of an apparently common belief that filtering data to include only high-quality information is essential, our experiments suggest that with enough compute, the best data filter is no data filter. We find that sufficiently trained large parameter models not only tolerate low-quality and distractor data, but in fact benefit from nominally ``poor'' data.

AI.tldr: 反对大模型预训练中常用的数据过滤策略，通过扩展性研究发现足够大的模型不仅能容忍低质量数据，还能从中受益，暗示在计算资源充足的情况下，最佳数据过滤策略是不过滤。
AI.motivation: Challenge the widely-held belief that data quality filtering is essential for training large models; investigate whether this assumption holds at scale.
AI.method: Scaling studies in the high compute, data-scarce regime, comparing filtered vs unfiltered training data across different model scales.
AI.result: Large parameter models not only tolerate low-quality data but actually benefit from it, contradicting the common practice of aggressive data filtering.
AI.conclusion: With sufficient compute and model capacity, data filtering may be counterproductive; the optimal filtering strategy is no filtering at all.

title: Unlocking the Potential of Continual Model Merging: An ODE Perspective
summary: Continual Model Merging (CMM) enables rapid customization of foundation models across sequentially arriving tasks, offering a scalable alternative to repeated retraining. However, existing merging rules lack explicit controllability over the allocation of learning capacity between previously learned capabilities and newly merged models. Consequently, as tasks are merged sequentially, this deficiency accumulates into severe forgetting, particularly in scenarios with heterogeneous task importance, where performance allocation becomes highly inconsistent. The key reason can be attributed to the fact that previous methods treat each task model as an isolated parameter point and apply fixed algebraic combinations, rather than explicitly constructing a transition that respects how independently trained models can be connected in parameter space. Motivated by mode connectivity, we assume that desirable merged models lie on low loss connecting paths, and that continual merging should follow such paths without crossing loss barriers that induce forgetting. Grounded in these insights, we propose a novel ODE-driven Merging (ODE-M) tailored for CMM that traces such a path by integrating a time-dependent velocity field and enforcing barrier constraints to prevent loss-increasing steps. Extensive experiments demonstrate that ODE-M achieves state-of-the-art performance compared to its competitors across mainstream CMM benchmarks.

AI.tldr: 论文针对持续模型合并(CMM)中遗忘严重的问题，提出基于ODE的ODE-M方法，通过时间依赖速度场追踪低损失路径并施加屏障约束，实现对合并过程的显式控制，在基准测试中取得最优效果。
AI.motivation: 现有合并规则缺乏对学习能力分配的显式可控性，导致任务顺序合并时遗忘严重且性能分配不一致。根本原因在于将各任务模型视为孤立参数点进行固定代数组合，未考虑独立训练模型在参数空间中的连通性。
AI.method: 提出ODE驱动的合并方法(ODE-M)，通过构建时间依赖的速度场追踪低损失连接路径，并施加屏障约束防止损失增加，实现任务模型沿最优轨迹逐步合并。
AI.result: 在主流CMM基准测试中达到最优性能，显著优于现有方法。
AI.conclusion: ODE-M通过ODE框架成功实现了对模型合并过程的显式可控引导，在主流CMM基准测试中达到最优性能，有效平衡了旧任务保留与新任务学习之间的关系。

title: When to Stop Reusing: Dynamic Gradient Gating for Sample-Efficient RLVR
summary: Reinforcement Learning with Verifiable Rewards (RLVR) has become the dominant paradigm for advanced reasoning in Large Language Models (LLMs), but rollout samples are expensive to obtain, making sample efficiency a critical bottleneck. A natural remedy is to reuse each rollout batch for multiple gradient updates, a standard practice in classical RL. Yet in RLVR, this amplifies policy shift, leading to severe performance degradation. Detecting the onset of degradation early enough to stop reuse remains an open and challenging problem. We close this gap by identifying the \textit{Disproportionate Weight Divergence (DWD)} phenomenon: performance degradation is synchronized with a sharp surge in the \texttt{lm\_head} weight change, while intermediate layers remain stable. Empirically, we verify that DWD emerges consistently across diverse LLMs and tasks. Theoretically, we prove that (i) harmful gradients concentrate at the \texttt{lm\_head} while intermediate layers are structurally attenuated, and (ii) the \texttt{lm\_head} gradient norm lower-bounds the policy divergence. These results establish the \texttt{lm\_head} gradient norm as a principled, real-time signal of catastrophic policy shift. Guided by this insight, we propose \textit{Dynamic Gradient Gating (DGG)}, a lightweight intervention that monitors the \texttt{lm\_head} gradient norm in real time and intercepts harmful gradients before they corrupt the optimizer. DGG consistently matches or exceeds the standard single-use baseline, achieving up to $2.93\times$ sample efficiency and $2.14\times$ wall-clock speedup across math, ALFWorld, WebShop, and search-augmented QA tasks.

AI.tldr: 本文发现RLVR中rollout复用导致的性能下降与lm_head层权重变化的急剧飙升同步(DWD现象)，理论证明lm_head梯度范数可作为策略偏移的实时信号，并提出DGG方法通过监控该信号实现高达2.93×样本效率提升。
AI.motivation: RLVR已成为LLM高级推理的主导范式，但rollout样本获取成本高昂，样本效率成为关键瓶颈。复用rollout批次进行多轮梯度更新虽为经典RL标准实践，但在RLVR中会放大策略偏移，导致严重性能下降，且难以早期检测。
AI.method: 识别了"权重不均衡发散(DWD)"现象：性能下降与lm_head权重变化的急剧飙升同步，而中间层保持稳定。理论证明了有害梯度集中在lm_head层。提出DGG方法，实时监控lm_head梯度范数并在有害梯度破坏优化器之前进行拦截。
