AI.result: DGG在数学、ALFWorld、WebShop和搜索增强QA任务中一致匹配或超越单次使用基线，实现了最高2.93倍的样本效率提升和2.14倍的wall-clock加速。
AI.conclusion: DGG通过实时监测lm_head梯度范数成功解决了RLVR中因 rollout 复用导致的策略偏移问题，为样本效率优化提供了可解释且轻量级的解决方案。

title: SynGR: Unleashing the Potential of Cross-Modal Synergy for Generative Recommendation
summary: Generative Recommendation (GR) has emerged as a promising paradigm by formulating item recommendation as a sequence-to-sequence generation task over item identifiers. Recent studies have incorporated multimodal signals to provide richer token-level evidence for generation. However, existing approaches largely rely on alignment-centric fusion and underexplore synergistic information across modalities. In practice, synergistic information plays a critical role in capturing emergent item properties that cannot be inferred from any single modality alone. Such properties encode intrinsic item semantics and guide user preferences, enabling models to move beyond surface-level feature matching. To address this limitation, we propose \textbf{SynGR}, a synergistic generative recommendation framework that explicitly encourages the exploitation of cross-modal dependencies during generation. By constraining overreliance on dominant modalities, SynGR enables the model to capture emergent item semantics beyond shared or modality-specific signals. Extensive experiments across three benchmark datasets demonstrate that SynGR achieves superior performance.

AI.tldr: SynGR是一个协同生成式推荐框架，通过显式建模跨模态依赖关系并约束对主导模态的过度依赖，捕获跨模态协同信息中蕴含的emergent item semantics（涌现性物品语义），从而超越表面特征匹配，实现更优的推荐性能。
AI.motivation: 现有生成式推荐方法虽引入多模态信号，但主要依赖alignment-centric fusion（对齐中心融合），未能充分探索跨模态协同信息。这类协同信息编码了emergent item properties（涌现性物品属性）——即无法从单一模态推断的跨模态组合特征，对用户偏好具有重要指导作用。
AI.method: SynGR的核心设计：(1) 显式鼓励在生成过程中利用跨模态依赖关系；(2) 约束模型对主导模态的过度依赖，防止单一模态主导生成过程；(3) 使模型能够捕获超越共享信号和模态特定信号的emergent item semantics。
AI.result: 在三个基准数据集上的广泛实验表明，SynGR实现了优越的推荐性能。
AI.conclusion: 该研究证明了跨模态协同信息在生成式推荐中的重要价值，为多模态生成推荐提供了新的范式：通过约束主导模态影响，显式建模模态间协同效应，可有效捕获物品的涌现性语义特征。

title: When the Majority Votes Wrong, the Intervention Timing for Test-Time Reinforcement Learning Hides in the Extinction Window
summary: Test-time reinforcement learning (TTRL) reports substantial accuracy gains on mathematical reasoning benchmarks using majority vote as a pseudo-label signal. We argue these gains are systematically misinterpreted: most reflect sharpening of already-solvable problems rather than genuine learning, while problems corrupted from correct to incorrect outnumber truly learned ones, and this damage is irreversible once majority vote locks onto a wrong answer. Per-problem tracking reveals that correct-answer signals in low-ability problems are briefly active before being permanently suppressed, a phenomenon we term the \textit{Correct-Answer Extinction Window}, with Flip Rate (FR) as its leading indicator. We thus propose \textbf{TTRL-Guard}, a lightweight framework with three mechanisms targeting the extinction window: Flip-Rate-Aware Reward Scaling (FRS) down-weights at-risk updates as FR declines, Minority-Preserving Sampling (MPS) retains gradient signal from minority correct answers, and Risk-Conditioned Sparse Updatings (RCSU) suspends updates on polarized problems. Experiments across three models and four benchmarks show that TTRL-Guard achieves the best average pass@1 on Qwen2.5-7B-Instruct and Qwen3-4B, improves relatively over TTRL by +54\% on AIME 2025. \footnote{Our code and implementation details are available at https://github.com/linhxkkkk/TTRL-Guard.

AI.tldr: 本文揭示了测试时强化学习(TTRL)中多数投票机制的严重缺陷：大多数所谓"学习增益"实际是对已可解决问题的强化，而错误答案的污染更新导致净损害且不可逆。发现"正确回答消失窗口"现象，其先行指标为翻转率(FR)。提出TTRL-Guard框架，通过三种机制(FRS、MPS、RCSU)针对性保护消失窗口期间的正确信号，显著提升数学推理性能。
AI.motivation: 现有TTRL方法使用多数投票作为伪标签信号存在系统性缺陷：多数增益来自已可解决问题而非真正学习；错误答案的污染更新超过真正学习；一旦多数投票锁定错误答案，损害不可逆。
AI.method: 提出TTRL-Guard框架，包含三种针对性机制：Flip-Rate-Aware Reward Scaling(FRS)根据FR下降动态降低风险更新权重；Minority-Preserving Sampling(MPS)保留少数正确回答的梯度信号；Risk-Conditioned Sparse Updatings(RCSU)暂停高极化问题的更新。
AI.result: 在三个模型和四个基准上验证，AIME 2025相对TTRL提升54%，Qwen2.5-7B-Instruct和Qwen3-4B达到最佳平均pass@1。
AI.conclusion: TTRL-Guard通过FRS、MPS和RCSU三种机制有效解决了正确回答消失问题，在多个模型和基准上取得了最先进性能，AIME 2025相对提升达54%。

title: Implicit Bias of Mirror Flow in Homogeneous Neural Networks: Sparse and Dense Feature Learning
summary: We study the max-margin solutions reached by mirror flow in deep neural networks with homogeneous activation functions. Extending classical results on gradient flow, we derive a novel balance equation for mirror flow from convex duality, enabling a characterization of the horizon function governing the induced margin. We further establish max-margin characterizations together with convergence rates and norm growth estimates. Finally, we support our theory through experiments on synthetic datasets and standard vision tasks. Concretely, we show that: (1) distinct non-homogeneous mirror maps can induce the same max-margin solution; (2) convergence can be extremely slow, including exponentially slow regimes; and (3) although all considered mirror maps exhibit feature learning, they can produce markedly different representations, ranging from sparse to dense neuron activations. Together, these results provide a unified perspective on sparse and dense feature learning in homogeneous neural networks, highlighting how mirror maps shape both optimization dynamics and the geometry of the learned classifiers.

AI.tldr: 本文首次给出同质（homogeneous）深度神经网络中镜像流（mirror flow）训练的隐式偏置（implicit bias）刻画：利用凸对偶与 Fenchel–Young 恒等式推导出镜像流的新"平衡方程"，定义 Q-边界（Q-margin），证明镜像流在方向上收敛到由"地平线函数"（horizon function）诱导的 max-margin 约束优化问题的 KKT 点。结果表明：不同的非齐次镜像势可产生相同的 max-margin 解；收敛可能极其缓慢（指数级）；且所有镜像流都发生特征学习，但可得到从稀疏到稠密差异极大的表征（双曲熵→稀疏，L_p, p≥2→稠密），并给出超参数 λ 的选择准则。
AI.motivation: 梯度流在同质神经网络上已被证明隐式偏向 L2 max-margin 分类器（Lyu & Li, 2020），但梯度流只是更广义的镜像流（mirror flow）家族的一个特例。镜像流用严格凸镜像势 R 诱导的几何取代欧氏几何，广泛用于重参数化梯度流、结构性参数约束（稀疏性、非负性）等问题。然而已有的镜像流隐式偏置结果仅限于线性模型（Sun et al., 2023；Pesme et al., 2024），在非线性同质网络上仍为空白。将其推广需要解决两个关键困难：(i) 为镜像流定义合适的边界（margin）概念；(ii) 在指数尾损失下参数必然发散，无法直接研究参数收敛，只能研究方向收敛到对应 max-margin 问题的 KKT 点。本文试图给出一个统一的理论框架，说明镜像几何如何同时决定优化动力学与所学习分类器的几何结构。
AI.method: 设定：同质激活的网络 f(θ,x)=W₁σ(W₂⋯σ(W_L x))，指数损失 ℓ(q)=exp(−q)，数据可分，损失采用 Clarke 次梯度与微分包含处理；镜像势 R 严格凸、二次可微、强制性（coercive）、∇²R 局部 Lipschitz。核心步骤：(1) 用 Fenchel–Young 恒等式 ⟨θ,∇R(θ)⟩=R(θ)+Q(∇R(θ))（Q 为凸共轭）结合 f 的齐次性推导出层间可分的镜像流平衡方程（Lemma 3.1）：Q_i(∇_i R_i(W_i,t)) − Q_{i+1}(∇_{i+1}R_{i+1}(W_{i+1,t})) = λ_{0,i}，是 GD 逐层范数平衡方程的镜像推广；(2) 定义 Q-margin（γ_Q = min_i y_i f(θ,x_i)/(αQ(∇R(θ)))^{L/α}）及基于 log-sum-exp 的 Q-soft margin（Lemma 4.3 证明二者相差 O((αQ)^{−L/α})）；(3) 用 Euler 恒等式与能量分解（径向/切向）证明 soft margin 单调增长、损失→0、Q(∇R(θ_t))→∞（Theorem 4.5）；(4) 通过 G(x)=∫(log u)^{α/L−2}du 的原函数给出损失与参数增长的收敛率（Theorem 4.6）；(5) 定义地平线函数 φ_α(θ)=lim_{η→0} η(αQ(∇R(θ/η)))^{1/α}，构造近似 KKT 点序列（利用角度 β_t、约束资格 MFCQ、Assumption G.1）证明归一化迭代方向收敛到 min ½φ_α²(θ) s.t. y_i f(θ,x_i)≥1 的 KKT 点（Theorem 4.7）；对 α=1 的双曲熵，用 2-齐次重参数化 (u⊙v) 与 GD 结果间接得到 L1 max-margin（Corollary 4.8）；(6) 两层网络下利用平衡方程与缩放不变性把问题改写为 min Σ_j|ã_j|^{α/2} s.t. ‖w̃_j‖_{L_α}=1（Theorem 4.9）；(7) 附录给出 NTK/RKBS 表述与逐层不同镜像的模块化推广。考察的势：双曲熵 R(θ)=Σθ_i arcsinh(θ_i/√λ)−√(θ_i²+λ)（α=1，地平线 ‖θ‖₁）与平滑齐次势 ⅓‖θ‖_p^p+(λ/2)‖θ‖₂²（α=p≥2，地平线 (p−1)^{1/p}‖θ‖_p）。
AI.result: 1) 平衡方程（Lemma 3.1）与 Q-margin（Theorem 4.5）：镜像流驱动 Q-soft margin 单调增长并趋近 Q-margin，损失→0，Q(∇R(θ_t))→∞；(αQ)^{L/α}=Θ(log 1/ℒ)。2) 收敛率（Theorem 4.6）：α∈[1,2] 时 ℒ(θ_t)=Θ(1/(t log(t)^{2−α/L}))、(αQ)^{L/α}=Θ(log t)；α>2 时损失仅得上界 O(1/(t log(t)^{2−α/L}))。3) 隐式偏置：归一化参数方向收敛到地平线函数诱导的 max-margin 约束问题的 KKT 点（p≥2 用 L_p 型，α=1 双曲熵用 L1 型）；不同非齐次镜像势可共享同一地平线函数从而得到相同 max-margin 解。4) 收敛可极慢：Lemma 4.10 给出 Q(∇R_λ) 与地平线函数的相对差为 O(1) 需时 Ω(exp((√λ n)^L))（双曲熵）与 Ω(exp(((pλn)/2)^{L/p}))（平滑齐次势），即 λ 相对 n 太大时 max-margin 实际不可达；建议 λ=1/n²（双曲熵）与 λ=1/(pn)（平滑势）。5) 稀疏 vs 稠密特征学习（Theorem 4.9）：α=1（双曲熵）偏向更少活跃神经元（稀疏），α≥2（平滑齐次势）偏向更多活跃神经元（稠密）；所有镜像都发生特征学习，但表征差异显著。6) 实验：两层/三层师生设置中各镜像达到各自最大边界（表 2、6），大 λ 时表征趋近 GD、边界更小且训练时间延长 10 倍仍不改变；CIFAR-10 上 VGG-16（SP 参数化、无 BN/weight decay/momentum）验证精度 GD 81.26%、p=10 81.26%、双曲熵 81.96%，权重分布显示稀疏/稠密差异且双曲熵可剪枝更多权重，末层分布因 SP 而几乎不变。附录还给出 mirror-μP 首步分析、宽度超参数迁移规则与 RKBS（非 RKHS）视角。
AI.conclusion: 本文建立了同质神经网络上镜像流的方向性晚期阶段隐式偏置理论，其核心是基于凸对偶（Fenchel–Young）的新平衡方程，由此引入 Q-margin 并刻画出由地平线函数诱导的 max-margin 解。结论指出：镜像几何是控制隐式偏置的统一机制——L1 型 max-margin 促进稀疏特征选择，而 p≥2 的 L_p 型 max-margin 促进稠密且尺度均匀的权重分布（有利于量化）；不同镜像势即便地平线函数相同（解相同），其收敛速度也可相差指数级，因此超参数 λ（及学习率）的选择对能否在有限时间内实现该隐式偏置至关重要。局限与展望：Theorem 4.7 的证明技术依赖 α≥2（双曲熵 α=1 需借助重参数化绕行），推广到 1≤α<2 仍是开放问题；有限学习率、early stopping 的影响以及这些 max-margin 解的泛化性质亦有待研究。

title: Quantifying the Pre-training Dividend: Generative versus Latent Self-Supervised Learning for Time Series Foundation Models
summary: The success of self-supervised learning (SSL) in vision and NLP has motivated its rapid adoption for time series. However, research has focused primarily on Generative paradigms and forecasting tasks, leaving the broader utility of learned representations unquantified. We establish a controlled framework to evaluate the "pre-training dividend": the value added by SSL across diverse temporal tasks. We systematically compare Generative paradigms against Latent Alignment architectures, introducing adaptations of LeJEPA and DINO for time series. These adaptations utilize Discrete Wavelet Transform (DWT) augmentations to enforce invariance to local fluctuations. Our analysis reveals that the pre-training dividend is highly asymmetric: SSL yields gains of up to 375% for anomaly detection and classification, yet remains marginal for forecasting. We demonstrate that representational utility is non-universal, governed by a precision-invariance trade-off where the specific signal resolution required by the task must align with the objective. Finally, we show that representation quality is largely independent of data origin and saturates at moderate architectural depths, suggesting a path to scaling via massive synthetic generation. Our code is available at: https://github.com/noammajor/Models

AI.tldr: 本文系统评估了自监督学习在时间序列领域的"预训练红利"价值，比较了生成式范式与潜在对齐架构，发现SSL在异常检测和分类任务上收益显著（高达375%），但在预测任务上效果有限。这一发现受精度-不变性权衡机制支配，且表征质量与数据来源无关、可在中等架构深度下饱和，为通过大规模合成数据实现扩展提供了路径。
AI.motivation: 自监督学习(SSL)在视觉和NLP领域已获成功，但其快速应用于时序数据时，研究主要聚焦于生成式范式和预测任务，对学习表征的更广泛效用缺乏量化评估。
AI.method: 建立了一个受控框架来评估"预训练红利"；系统比较了生成式范式与潜在对齐架构；引入LeJEPA和DINO的时间序列适配版本；采用离散小波变换(DWT)增强来强制局部波动不变性。
AI.result: 预训练红利高度不对称：在异常检测和分类任务上提升可达375%，但在预测任务上提升甚微；表征效用非普适，受精度-不变性权衡支配；表征质量与数据来源基本无关，在中等架构深度下趋于饱和。
AI.conclusion: 表示质量与数据来源基本无关，且在中等架构深度下趋于饱和，表明可通过大规模合成数据生成实现扩展。为时序SSL的超参数配置、架构选择和数据集构建提供了理论依据。

title: Sampling-Based Safe Reinforcement Learning
summary: Safe exploration remains a fundamental challenge in reinforcement learning (RL), limiting the deployment of RL agents in the real world. We propose Sampling-Based Safe Reinforcement Learning (SBSRL), a model-based RL algorithm that maintains safety throughout the learning process by enforcing constraints jointly across a finite set of dynamics samples. This formulation approximates an intractable worst-case optimization over uncertain dynamics and enables practical safety guarantees in continuous domains. We further introduce an exploration strategy based on constraining epistemic uncertainty, eliminating the need for explicit exploration bonuses. Under regularity conditions, we derive high-probability guarantees of safety throughout learning and a finite-time sample complexity bound for recovering a near-optimal policy. Empirically, SBSRL achieves safe and efficient exploration both in simulation and in real robotic hardware, and readily extends to practical deep-ensemble implementations that scale to high-dimensional continuous control problems.

AI.tldr: SBSRL is a model-based safe RL algorithm that uses sampling-based constraint enforcement over dynamics uncertainty to guarantee safety during learning, with theoretical bounds and practical scalability to robotic control tasks.
AI.motivation: Safe exploration is a fundamental challenge in reinforcement learning that limits real-world deployment of RL agents.
AI.method: SBSRL maintains safety by enforcing constraints jointly across a finite set of dynamics samples, approximating worst-case optimization over uncertain dynamics. Uses uncertainty-constrained exploration strategy to eliminate explicit exploration bonuses.
AI.result: High-probability safety guarantees throughout learning, finite-time sample complexity bound for near-optimal policy recovery, safe and efficient exploration in both simulation and real robotic hardware.
AI.conclusion: SBSRL provides a principled approach to safe RL with theoretical guarantees, successfully scaling to high-dimensional continuous control problems through deep ensemble implementations.

title: Automated Grading of Handwritten Mathematics Using Vision-Capable LLMs
comment: To be published in the International Conference on AI in Education (AIED), 2026
summary: Automated grading systems have enabled scalable assessment for many response types, but handwritten mathematics remains a barrier due to the complexity of multi-step solutions. Vision-capable large language models (LLMs) offer new opportunities here, yet their reliability in authentic instructional settings remains poorly understood. We present an empirical evaluation of an LLM-based grader for handwritten mathematical work using instructor-defined rubrics. Extending a prior pipeline for typed responses, we integrate transcription and rubric-based evaluation of photographic submissions within a single LLM call, evaluating on student work from two university STEM courses. Comparing AI grading decisions against human-assigned ground truth at the rubric-item level, we observe high overall accuracy, with most errors -- 87\% in the best model -- attributable to transcription failures rather than rubric misapplication. We categorize common error modes, including image quality issues, hallucinated content, and incorrect handling of equivalent expressions. These findings highlight both the promise and limitations of LLM-based grading for handwritten mathematics, providing guidance for system design, prompt refinement, and deployment in educational settings.

AI.tldr: 本文将原先面向打字作答的LLM评分流水线扩展为支持手写数学 photographed submissions 的单次多模态 LLM 调用（转写+基于评分细则的判定），并在两门大学STEM课程、5道开放题、685份学生手写作业上评测三个视觉型LLM（GPT-5-mini、GPT-5.1、Gemini-3-flash）。结果显示逐条细则项准确率高（Gemini-3-flash 最佳，约95%），且错误主要源自转写失败（最佳模型占87%），而非评分细则应用错误。
AI.motivation: 自动评分系统难以处理手写数学证明/推导类作答：多步解题过程复杂，且这类题目缺乏唯一的"标准答案"或确定性判分函数，规则式评分几乎不可行。虽然已有研究尝试用GPT-4V/MathPix转写手写数学或用GPT-5扫描件评分，但准确率仅约60%~0.85 R²，且未区分错误类型、在真实教学场景中的可靠性仍不清楚。因此需要评估视觉LLM在真实大学课程中基于教师自定义评分细则进行手写数学评分的可靠性，并定位错误的根因（转写 vs. 评分细则应用），以指导系统设计与提示工程。
AI.method: 在开源评测平台PrairieLearn上开发并部署了AI辅助评分原型工具：提示词中同时包含题目陈述、评分细则、可选参考解答与指令，要求模型在单次LLM调用中同时完成转写与逐条细则评估（受先前研究发现"合并优于分离"的结论驱动）。评测数据取自两门课程的最终提交图像：数值方法课（Course 1, n=440，课后三人小组加分活动，3题）与入门动力学课（Course 2, n=245，监考期中考试，2题）；学生自行拍照/使用文档摄像头提交，可预览、裁剪、重拍重交，且题目参数经PrairieLearn模板随机化（因此无法使用检索增强评分）。教师（亦为论文作者）对全部提交评分作为ground truth，学生从未看到AI评分结果。评价指标为细则项级准确率(RIA)、假阳性率(FP)、假阴性率(FN)，并对每一条AI–人不一致项做完整人工归因，区分转写错误(TE：漏字、幻觉文本、错抄表达式)与细则应用错误(RAE：未正确执行细则规则)，同时对成因做定性分析。测试模型为GPT-5-mini、GPT-5.1与Gemini-3-flash。
AI.result: Gemini-3-flash在所有题目上RIA最高，Course 1 达96%~99%，Course 2 为89%~93%，整体约95%；GPT-5-mini次之，GPT-5.1最低且在C1-Q1上出现唯一"细则错误超过转写错误"的情形（未识别学生给出的正确向量取负仍算有效）。错误归因显示转写失败占绝对多数（最佳模型87%），即提升图像采集/预处理比提示层面的改进收益更大；常见失效模式包括：模糊或低分辨率图像导致的转写错误、旋转文字、幻觉出原图中不存在的文本（常似参考解答，从而抬高分数）、复杂细则下在解答要素缺失时仍判正确、以及对等价表示（小数vs精确分数、非标准但有效解法）的错误推理。Gemini-3-flash误差偏假阳性（约2.5:1），GPT系列细则类错误更多（28% vs 13%）、FP与FN近乎持平。FP/FN比例与题目或模型之间未观察到一致规律，无法直接用模型分歧自动定分或筛出需人工复核的样本。
AI.conclusion: 基于视觉LLM的手写数学自动评分在精心设计的评分细则下可达约95%的细则项级准确率，在练习/形成性等低风险场景中已足够可用，前提是告知学生AI反馈可能出错；而在高风险（监考考试）场景部署则需要更高的解读可靠性。核心瓶颈是图像转写质量而非评分逻辑，因此改进方向应优先聚焦拍摄质量、截图上传、预览转写、旋转校正等输入侧措施，而非仅优化提示词；同时需警惕幻觉导致虚高分数与等价表达式误判等残余风险，并进一步研究是否存在可用于自动分流人工复核的系统性偏差模式。

title: Adynamical systems view of training generativemodels and the memorization phenomenon
summary: Using recent works of one of the authors (VSB) on collapse in generative models and two time scale dynamics in stochastic gradient descent in high dimensions, we give a system theoretic explanation of the memorization phenomenon in generative models. This relies purely on the dynamic aspects of the training phase. Specifically, we use a result of Austin [2016] to motivate a stylized model for the loss function for stochastic gradient descent (SGD) wherein the loss function has a strong dependence on some variables and weak dependence on the rest in a precise sense. This naturally leads to two distinct time scales in the constant step size SGD that is commonly used in machine learning. This fact has been used to explain the double descent phenomenon in SGD in Borkar [2026]. In conjunction with a mathematical model for collapse phenomenon in SGD developed in Borkar [2025a], we analyze the constant step size SGD using the recent results of Azizian et al. [2024] in order to explain the phenomenon of memorization wherein a generative model that is concurrently being tuned yields the same or similar outputs for significant stretches of time. This gives a novel perspective on the aforementioned phenomena reported in machine learning literature and their interrelationships, using a dynamical systems viewpoint.

AI.tldr: Explains memorization in generative models via two time scale dynamics in SGD, using a stylized loss function model with strong/weak variable dependence to connect memorization, collapse, and double descent phenomena through a dynamical systems framework.
AI.motivation: Provide a system theoretic explanation for memorization phenomenon in generative models—where models yield identical/similar outputs for extended periods during training—through dynamic rather than static analysis.
AI.method: Uses stylized loss function model with strong/weak variable dependence (Austin [2016]), analyzes constant step size SGD via results from Azizian et al. [2024], and combines with mathematical collapse model from Borkar [2025a].
AI.result: Demonstrates how two distinct time scales in constant step size SGD naturally arise from the loss function structure, explaining memorization as a dynamic phenomenon and connecting it to collapse and double descent.
AI.conclusion: Presents a novel dynamical systems perspective on memorization in generative models, unifying it with other reported phenomena (double descent, collapse) through a system theoretic lens based on two time scale SGD dynamics.

title: The Silent Hyperparameter: Quantifying the Impact of Inference Backends on LLM Reproducibility
summary: Progress in LLMs is increasingly measured through standardized benchmarks, where state-of-the-art improvements are often separated by fractions of a percentage point. At the same time, the computational cost of evaluating modern LLMs has driven widespread adoption of specialized inference backends, software systems that execute trained models efficiently at inference time. While critical for scalability, system-level optimizations, such as custom CUDA kernels and reduced-precision arithmetic, can alter token probabilities and introduce non-determinism, possibly cascading into divergent generation. In this work, we first survey the inference landscape, identifying 200 distinct engines, and analyze 35,000 ML publications, finding that the specific inference stack is rarely reported despite this widespread diversity. We then present a systematic empirical study of how inference backends affect LLM benchmark results. Holding model weights, decoding parameters, and hardware constant, we evaluate five widely used inference engines, including vLLM, SGLang, and llama.cpp, across multiple open-weight models and established benchmarks. We show that the choice of backend alone can shift benchmark scores by up to 16.6 percentage points and induce high rates of output disagreement. By isolating backend optimizations and tracing the execution pipeline, we find this divergence is driven by system-level optimizations like prefix caching and CUDA graphs, custom kernels, and engine-specific defaults in logit processing. Our findings identify the inference backend as a previously unreported but consequential hyperparameter in the evaluation of LLM and advocate standardized reporting of inference stacks to improve the reproducibility and interpretability of benchmark comparisons.

AI.tldr: 该研究首次系统性地揭示了LLM推理后端选择对基准测试结果的显著影响。研究发现不同的推理引擎（vLLM、SGLang、llama.cpp等）可能导致高达16.6个百分点的基准分数差异，这种差异源于前缀缓存、CUDA图等系统级优化。该研究强调推理后端是一个此前被忽视但至关重要的超参数，呼吁学界标准化报告推理技术栈以提升可重复性。
AI.motivation: 当前LLM的进步通过标准化基准测试来衡量，最先进改进往往只相差不到一个百分点。同时，现代LLM的评估计算成本推动了专门推理后端（用于高效执行训练模型推理的软件系统）的广泛采用。然而，系统级优化（如自定义CUDA内核和低精度算术）可能改变token概率并引入非确定性，可能导致生成结果发散。尽管业界存在约200种不同的推理引擎，但研究表明具体使用的推理技术栈很少被报告。
AI.method: 研究者首先对推理技术领域进行了全面调查，识别出200种不同的引擎，分析了35,000篇ML论文。然后在保持模型权重、解码参数和硬件不变的前提下，对5种广泛使用的推理引擎（包括vLLM、SGLang和llama.cpp等）进行了系统性实证研究，跨越多个开源模型和已建立的基准测试。通过隔离后端优化并追踪执行流水线来追溯差异来源。
AI.result: 研究发现推理后端的选择本身即可将基准测试分数偏移高达16.6个百分点，并导致高比例的输出分歧。这种差异由系统级优化驱动，包括：前缀缓存、CUDA图、自定义内核以及日志处理中的引擎特定默认设置。
AI.conclusion: 本研究揭示了推理后端作为LLM评估中一个此前未报告但至关重要的超参数。研究表明，推理引擎的选择可以导致基准测试分数高达16.6个百分点的差异，并引发高频率的输出分歧。基于此，研究者主张标准化报告推理技术栈，以提高基准测试比较的可重复性和可解释性。

title: TORQ: Two-Level Orthogonal Rotation for MXFP4 Quantization
summary: As Large Language Models (LLMs) advance toward practical deployment, the Microscaling FP4 (MXFP4) format has emerged as a cornerstone for next-generation low-bit inference, owing to its ability to balance high dynamic range with hardware efficiency. However, directly applying MXFP4 to LLM activation quantization inevitably leads to significant accuracy degradation. In this paper, we theoretically analyze the error structure of MXFP4 activation quantization, revealing that the root cause of this performance drop lies in two structural imbalances between activation distributions and the MXFP4 block floating-point format: (1) extreme inter-block variance imbalance and (2) intra-block codebook utilization imbalance. To address these challenges, we propose TORQ (Two-level Orthogonal Rotation for MXFP4 Quantization), a training-free Post-Training Quantization (PTQ) framework designed to reshape the geometric properties of the activation space through optimal coordinate transformations. At the macroscopic level, TORQ leverages the Schur-Horn theorem to redistribute activation energy via inter-block orthogonal rotation, preventing high-variance blocks from driving up shared scaling factors and thereby preserving the precision of small-magnitude elements. At the microscopic level, TORQ employs maximum-entropy-guided intra-block rotation to alleviate codebook collapse and maximize the MXFP4 codebook's information capacity. Experiments on mainstream LLMs such as LLaMA3 and Qwen3 show that TORQ significantly improves the accuracy of MXFP4 activation quantization compared to existing methods: on Qwen3-32B, the perplexity on WikiText is reduced to 8.43 (vs. 7.61 for BF16), and the average accuracy increases from 38.40% with direct RTN to 73.63% (vs. 74.82% for BF16), substantially narrowing the gap between 4-bit floating-point quantization and full-precision inference.

AI.tldr: 本文提出TORQ框架，通过理论分析MXFP4激活量化的误差结构，识别出两个结构性失衡问题，并采用双层正交旋转（块间和块内）来解决，在主流LLM上实现了接近全精度推理的4位浮点量化性能。
AI.motivation: 随着LLM向实际部署推进，MXFP4格式成为低比特推理的关键，但直接应用于激活量化会导致显著的精度下降。
AI.method: 提出TORQ框架，通过两层正交旋转重塑激活空间的几何属性：(1)宏观层面利用Schur-Horn定理进行块间正交旋转，重新分配激活能量，防止高方差块主导共享缩放因子；(2)微观层面采用最大熵引导的块内旋转缓解码本坍塌，最大化MXFP4码本的信息容量。
AI.result: 在LLaMA3和Qwen3等主流模型上，TORQ显著优于现有方法：Qwen3-32B在WikiText上的困惑度降至8.43（vs BF16的7.61），平均准确率从直接RTN的38.40%提升至73.63%（vs BF16的74.82%）。
AI.conclusion: TORQ通过双层正交旋转显著缩小了4位浮点量化的精度差距，在Qwen3-32B上达到接近全精度推理的性能。

title: Online Market Making and the Value of Observing the Order Book
summary:
We study an online market-making problem in which a learner sequentially posts bid and ask prices for a single asset while interacting with traders holding private valuations. Unlike existing online learning formulations that assume fully censored feedback, we introduce an action-dependent feedback model inspired by real limit order books: when a trade occurs, the trader's valuation remains hidden, whereas when no trade occurs, informative feedback about supply and demand is revealed.
  We show that this additional information fundamentally changes the learnability of the problem. In the stochastic setting with i.i.d. market prices, we propose an elimination-based algorithm that achieves $O(\sqrt T)$ regret with high probability, without requiring any smoothness assumptions on the distribution of trader valuations. We then extend this result to a broad class of mean-reverting price processes by considering both local, autoregressive dynamics and a weaker global drift condition based on cumulative deviations from the mean. Under either assumption, we establish high-probability $O(\sqrt T)$ regret bounds, relying on a new concentration inequality of independent interest. Finally, in the adversarial setting with oblivious prices, we design an explore-then-perturb algorithm that guarantees $O(T^{2/3})$ regret in expectation.
  Our results quantify the value of observing the order book in online market making and demonstrate that even limited, action-dependent feedback can substantially improve regret guarantees compared to standard bandit feedback models.

AI.tldr: 本文研究带动作依赖反馈的在线做市问题。当发生交易时交易者估值被隐藏（标准 bandit 反馈），未发生交易时则暴露供需信息。研究证明这种额外信息可根本性改善可学习性：随机环境下无需平滑假设即可达 O(√T) 最优后悔，均值回复价格过程和对抗环境分别达 O(√T) 和 O(T^{2/3}) 后悔界，贡献了新的浓度不等式。
AI.motivation: 传统在线学习做市问题采用全 censored 反馈模型（仅当交易发生时才有反馈），忽略了未交易时订单簿所蕴含的供需信息。本文认为这种 action-dependent 反馈模型更贴近真实限价订单簿场景，可能从根本上改变问题的可学习性。
AI.method:
1. 随机设置：设计基于消除法的算法（elimination-based algorithm），无需对交易者估值分布做平滑假设
2. 均值回复价格过程：分别考虑局部自回归动态和基于累积偏差的全局漂移条件，利用新的浓度不等式建立高概率 O(√T) 后悔界
3. 对抗设置：采用"探索-扰动"（explore-then-perturb）算法框架
AI.result:
1. 随机环境（i.i.d. 市价）：高概率 O(√T) 后悔界
2. 广泛均值回复价格过程：局部自回归动态或弱全局漂移条件下均建立高概率 O(√T) 后悔界
3. 对抗环境（oblivious 价格）：期望 O(T^{2/3}) 后悔界
AI.conclusion: 本文证明了在市场报价问题中，观察订单簿（而非仅依赖交易反馈）可从根本上改善学习算法的后悔界。在随机环境下达到 O(√T) 最优后悔界，在对抗环境下达到 O(T^{2/3}) 后悔界，且不需要对交易者估值分布做平滑性假设，为实际高频做市场景提供了理论支撑。

title: Physics-Informed Graph Neural Network Surrogates for Turbulent Nanoparticle Dispersion in Dental Clinical Environments
summary: Dental aerosol procedures produce sub-50 micrometre nuclei that can remain airborne for long periods in enclosed clinics, creating pathways for airborne pathogen transmission. Reynolds-Averaged Navier-Stokes (RANS) simulations with Euler-Lagrange particle tracking capture this transport accurately but require very long run times per scenario, which precludes real-time clinical decision support in 3D. We present the Eulerian-Lagrangian Graph Interaction Network (ELGIN), a physics-informed graph surrogate that jointly predicts carrier-flow dynamics on the OpenFOAM polyhedral mesh and the per-parcel motion of the polydisperse spray cloud. ELGIN couples a multi-head Graph Transformer with Jacobi-preconditioned learnable pressure projection and a turbulence-closure head to a sigmoid-gated Lagrangian Interaction Network through differentiable inverse-distance mesh-parcel coupling, and advances parcels with a symplectic Stormer-Verlet integrator. A four-stage physics-informed curriculum stabilises 260-step autoregressive rollouts without gradient explosion. A parameter sweep with foam-extend 4.1 OpenFOAM reactingParcelFoam across clinically relevant ventilation rates and handpiece spray speeds provides CFD ground truth. This article reports a single-case demonstration in which both ELGIN and a Lagrangian-only baseline (M0) are trained and evaluated on Sweep_Case_03 of a twenty-case sweep; full 16/2/2 retraining is in progress and will replace all reported metrics. On this case, ELGIN tracks the foam-extend particle cloud much more closely than M0: mean parcel displacement error falls from 19.56% to 16.20% of room width and cloud radius-of-gyration error from 9.85% to 6.58%. A 26-second rollout completes in ~64 s on a 4 GB GPU, approximately 37x faster than the foam-extend reference pipeline, toward per-appointment infection-risk screening once the multi-case checkpoint is in place.

AI.tldr: 本文提出 ELGIN（Eulerian–Lagrangian Graph Interaction Network）：一种物理信息约束的欧拉-拉格朗日图神经网络代理模型，用于预测牙科诊疗室内多分散生物气溶胶（0.5–50 µm）的湍流输运。Eulerian 分支在 OpenFOAM 非结构 polyMesh（7704 单元）上以多头 Graph Transformer + Jacobi-PCG 可学习压力投影 + 湍流闭合头求解 RANS 载流场；Lagrangian 分支用 sigmoid 门控注意力 Interaction Network 预测加速度，以辛 Störmer–Verlet 积分推进位置；两图通过可微逆距离加权（k=4）耦合，并注入边界条件语义嵌入、真实壁距/壁法向、每例入口速度等物理先验。四阶段课程（Eulerian 预训练→单步粒子监督→PDE 约束联合→BPTT rollout 微调，300 epoch）稳定 260 步自回归展开。在 20 算例 sweep 中仅单算例（Sweep_Case_03）演示：平均位移误差由纯拉格朗日基线 M0 的 19.56%（房间宽度）降至 16.20%，云团回转半径误差由 9.85% 降至 6.58%；26 s rollout 在 4 GB GPU 上约 64 s 完成，比 foam-extend 参考管线快约 37×。作者明确声明为概念验证，完整 16/2/2 多算例重训尚在进行并将替换全部指标。
AI.motivation: 牙科高速钻磨、超声洁治与气动抛光产生 0.5–50 µm 多分散液滴核，在通风不良的封闭诊室内可悬浮 30–90 分钟，构成空气传播感染路径，需要能在诊疗过程中实时给出“热点”位置的定量工具。RANS（k–ω SST）+ Euler–Lagrange parcel 追踪物理保真度高，但 foam-extend 4.1 单算例约需 40 min 单核时间，无法对通风速率、布局、喷射角度做 Monte Carlo 扫描，更无法实时输出个体化建议。过去十年 ML-CFD 代理（CNN、FNO、DeepONet、PINN）虽获得 10³–10⁵ 加速，但均依赖固定分辨率结构化网格或手工配点，无法处理临床几何的拓扑可变非结构网格；GNN 类工作（GNS、MeshGraphNets、Dynami-CAL、PIC-GNN、COGRI、DeepLag、PIGNN-CFD、GLAD）分别只覆盖干颗粒/自由液面/等离子体/大气微物理，或使用学习到的而非物理预计算的欧拉表示，缺少“以已算出的载流场为条件、在封闭临床空间做湍流生物气溶胶空间输运”的代理。牙科气溶胶还涉及多物理力（亚微米 Cunningham 滑移、Saffman 剪切升力、Brownian 扩散、DRW 湍流弥散）、障碍物绕流（牙医/患者）、通风格栅条件与呼吸带暴露等临床指标，此前工作未联合覆盖。
AI.method: ① CFD 真值：foam-extend 4.1 两段管线——simpleFoam 求稳态 RANS（k–ω SST），再 reactingParcelFoam 以 PIMPLE 求解 30 s 瞬态可压缩+反应 parcel 输运（含 Schiller–Naumann 阻力、DRW 随机弥散、Wells D² 律蒸发），粒子用简化 Maxey–Riley 方程；Cunningham 修正、McLaughlin–Saffman 升力与 Brownian 扩散在 CFD 端不内置，改由 GNN 侧解析提供。几何为 4.0 m×3.0 m 二维诊疗室断面（80×100 结构四边形网格，去除牙医/患者障碍后 7704 单元），含 0.2 m 顶部送风、侧向压力出口、3 mm 手机喷嘴（θ=20°）。20 个算例为 4×5 因子网格（Vin∈{0.10,0.20,0.35,0.50} m/s，Umag∈{10…50} m/s），每例 261 帧（Δt_save=0.1 s），按 origId 持久追踪 N_sub=1000 个 parcel，alive-mask 处理注入/沉积导致的数量变化；原计划 16/2/2 划分。② 架构：双图——静态 Eulerian 网格图（单元节点，特征含 z-score 化的 U_x,U_y,p,k,ω、bbox 符号距离、9 类语义边界条件的 8 维查表嵌入、每例 V_in 全局广播；边特征为法向/面积/距离/分离向量 + 面类型嵌入，共 10 维）与逐步重建的 Lagrangian 半径图（r_c=0.10 m，节点含 LSTM(H=4) 速度历史、bbox SDF、粒子类型嵌入、解析 Cunningham 阻力加速度、log d_p、插值 TKE、IDW 插值的壁距与壁法向；边特征为 log(1+ρ)、cosθ、sinθ 与全局系阻力通道）。Eulerian 处理器为 K_E=4、4 头的 Graph Transformer（softmax 缩放点积注意力），配湍流闭合头（向代数 SST 关系正则）与可学习压力投影：在图上解 ∇_h·(∇_h φ)=∇_h·Û，用 20/50 次 Jacobi 预处理共轭梯度求解，内嵌可微。Lagrangian 处理器为 K_L=4 的 Interaction Network，聚合用 sigmoid 门控注意力而非均匀求和，配可选 VAE 式加速度解码器（生产权重 λ_KL=10⁻³，实际关闭）；位置用辛 Störmer–Verlet kick-drift-kick 推进，边界盒裁剪，按壁距/边界距离阈值置位“粘附”标志并置零速度以模拟 stick 壁面作用；阻力、DRW 湍流 kick、Brownian 位移以解析量注入特征。跨图信息通过 k_IDW=4 的可微逆距离加权算子传递。③ 训练：AdamW（wd=1e-5）+ 余弦退火，四阶段 300 epoch 分配 60/60/120/60（M0 跳过阶段 1，改为 75/150/75）：Eulerian 预训练 → 单步教师强制粒子监督（含 σ_n=3e-4 噪声增广与 alive-masked MSE）→ PDE 约束联合（L_MSE+0.1·连续性+0.05·动量残差+0.02·SST 湍流+0.001·角动量）→ BPTT 展开微调（unroll 5 步、w_BPTT=0.7、注入 σ_roll=0.01 m 噪声模拟协变量漂移）。硬件为 Quadro P1000 4 GB。
AI.result: 单算例 Sweep_Case_03（Vin=0.10 m/s，Umag=30 m/s）上：MDE 由 M0 的 19.56% 降至 16.20%（≈0.65 m，相对降 17%），Rg-err 由 9.85% 降至 6.58%（降约 33%）；KE-ratio 为 M0 1.057、ELGIN 0.659，说明 ELGIN 后期系统性低估粒子速度幅值，其优势主要来自空间轨迹保真而非动能耗散。瞬时误差：t=5 s 时 7.19%（M0 7.81%），t=15 s 时 17.75%（M0 24.81%，M0 在 t≈25 s 后约 87% 帧出现 NaN 越界掩码），ELGIN 在 t≈28 s 时 MDE≈22.26%。呼吸带暴露 BZE：CFD 峰值约 0.50%（约 5 个 parcel），ELGIN 峰值约 1.00%，绝对偏差 0.5%、RMSE 0.25%，但 1000-parcel 评估子图处于 Poisson 计数噪声区（σ/⟨N⟩≈45%），仅具数量级意义。速度：26 s rollout 约 64 s（M0 约 27 s），峰值显存约 1.1 GB，比 40 min 的 simpleFoam+reactingParcelFoam 管线快约 37×。物理一致性检验：St∈[4.8e-5, 2.4e-4] 属示踪行为；Pe_T=49,690±10（CV<0.1%，源于 5% 固定入口湍流强度 BC 设计）；峰值 BZE 随 ACH 呈幂律下降，斜率约 −0.4（弱于充分混合的 −1，因障碍物回流区捕获颗粒）；无量纲 MSD 从弹道 (τ*²) 过渡到扩散 (τ*¹)，过渡在 τ*≈0.05–0.10，与 T_L=ω0⁻¹ 一致；D_L*/D_T* 落在 Li 等人室内参考区间；垂向漂移 12.7–14.0 mm/s 与 Stokes 沉降 14.1 mm/s 相差 10% 以内。局限与自相矛盾之处：当前权重仅在单一算例上训练与评估，验证集为算例内部随机 15% 快照切分而非算例不相交划分，故不构成泛化性证据；二维挤出几何；载流场冻结于稳态 RANS；仅与 CFD 校验、缺乏实验验证；Saffman 升力与 Brownian 项在生产权重中被关闭；MDE 仍有约 0.65 m 量级；正文与 SI 在 M0 连接半径（0.10 m vs 0.30 m）、BPTT 展开步数（5 vs 3）、训练用时“16 算例训练集”与仅单算例使用上不一致。
AI.conclusion: ELGIN 证明了一种物理信息混合欧拉–拉格朗日 GNN 代理可在保持可接受精度的前提下（单算例 MDE 16.2%、Rg-err 6.6%）以约 37× 加速复现临床牙科气溶胶的多尺度输运，其精度增益来自三点：在 polyMesh 上求解载流场并把 RANS 速度、TKE 与壁面邻近性逐粒子暴露给拉格朗日节点；九类语义边界编码、真实壁距/壁法向与每例入口速度广播的全局条件化；以及四阶段课程对长时程多物理 GNN 展开的稳定化。成果定位为“概念验证级保真度”而非泛化性研究，明确的下一批工作为：完成 16/2/2 训练/验证/测试重训以证明跨工况泛化、扩展到三维几何、耦合时变 LES 快照、重新启用 Saffman 与 Brownian 力学项、以及用光学粒子计数器或相位多普勒测速在临床模拟舱中做实验验证。作者称代码、foam-extend 参考算例与权重已以 MIT 许可开源，以支撑面向每次诊疗的感染风险筛查应用。

title: A Family of Divergence Measures for Evaluating the Reconstruction Quality of Explainable Ensemble Trees
summary: Validating interpretable surrogate models for ensemble learners requires measuring agreement between the ensemble's internal representation and its surrogate approximation, rather than mere association. Correlation-based approaches are scale-invariant and fail to detect systematic discrepancies in co-occurrence structure. We propose a statistical framework grounded in the agreement-association distinction, centered on the normalized Loss of Interpretability (nLoI). Rooted in the Cressie-Read power divergence family with lambda equal to 2, the nLoI admits a closed-form decomposition into within-node and between-node components, providing a unique diagnostic capability to identify precisely where and why reconstruction fails. The framework incorporates four complementary measures capturing distinct structural facets of approximation quality. A unified permutation testing procedure delivers valid inference for all measures within a single resampling pass. Theoretical properties, including boundedness and symmetry, are established for each metric. Monte Carlo simulations and empirical evaluations confirm exact Type I error control and demonstrate that these measures detect reconstruction fidelity gradients invisible to correlation-based alternatives. The framework is developed and illustrated in the context of Explainable Ensemble Trees (E2Tree), and empirical evaluation on three benchmark datasets illustrates the practical utility of the framework.

AI.tldr:
本文针对"可解释集成树"（E2Tree）重建保真度的验证问题，提出一个基于"一致性（agreement）vs. 关联性（association）"区分的统计度量族，核心是归一化可解释性损失 nLoI——一个稳健化的 Neyman 型统计量（λ=−2 的 Cressie–Read 幂散度族成员，用 max(o_ij, ô_ij) 替代经典分母）。其独特能力是可分解为"节点内"与"节点间"两部分，从而定位重建失败的具体来源。配套给出 Hellinger 距离、加权 RMSE、RV 系数与 SSIM 四个互补度量，以及基于同步行列置换的统一置换检验框架，并在三组基准数据上验证。

（注：摘要中写作 "lambda equal to 2"，与正文 λ=−2（Neyman χ²）不一致，应为笔误。）
AI.motivation:
集成模型（如随机森林）以精度换取了可解释性，E2Tree 试图用单棵可解释树重建集成内部的邻近结构。但在监管、临床、科研等场景中，若重建失真，解释性结论会主动误导人，因此必须严格度量保真度。

既有做法（Mantel 检验等）测的是两个邻近矩阵之间的"关联"而非"一致性"：相关系数对线性缩放与系统性偏移不变，当 ô_T = c·O（c≠1）时仍会给出完美相关 r=1，从而无法发现 O（连续模糊）与 ô_T（块对角、含大量零）之间的系统性数值偏差。这与 Bland–Altman 关于相关系数不适合评估测量方法一致性的经典批评同构——两个方法可以高度相关却系统性不一致。

因此需要一个尺度敏感（scale-sensitive）、可直接比较绝对数值吻合程度的度量，并且最好能指出"在哪里、为何"重建失败，而不仅是给出一个标量"好/坏"判定。
AI.method:
**1. 记号与背景**：集成共现矩阵 O=[o_ij]（式1，按 B 棵弱学习器累加同终端节点指示量 I(u_i∧u_j) 与局部拟合优度权重 W_ij|b^(t)，归一化后取值 [0,1]）；E2Tree 共现矩阵 ô_T=[ô_ij]（式2，同终端节点取节点权重，否则为 0），呈块对角结构；相似矩阵 D=1−O。

**2. nLoI**：LoI(O,ô_T)=Σ_{i<j} (o_ij−ô_ij)² / max(o_ij, ô_ij)，约定 0/0=0；归一化 nLoI = LoI/M，M=n(n−1)/2（式3–4）。分母取 max 而非 ô_ij 带来三重收益：避免经典 Neyman 统计量在 q_k=0 处的奇异性（ô_T 的零是常态）；恢复对称性；保留"按重要性归一"的加权直觉。Proposition 8 证明其为使用 min 作分母的 Neyman 型统计量的保守（低）估计。

**3. 理论性质**：非负性（Prop.2）、零当且仅当完美重建（Prop.3）、对称性（Prop.4）、上界 LoI≤M（Prop.5）、置换不变性（Prop.6）、以及关键的**可分解性**（Prop.7）：LoI = LoI_in + LoI_out，其中节点间对因 ô_ij=0 使贡献简化为 o_ij。为消除两类配对数量级差异（节点间对约为节点内的 K−1 倍），改用逐对平均 ℓ̄_in、ℓ̄_out 作诊断量（式15），并给出阈值指引（ℓ̄_out>0.3 提示需增加终端节点/放松剪枝；ℓ̄_in>0.1 提示节点内标定偏差）。

**4. 四个互补度量**：Hellinger 距离（式19，平方根变换对应方差稳定化，唯一满足全部度量公理者，对稀疏稳健，对应 λ=−1/2 的 Freeman–Tukey）；wRMSE（式20，权重作为重要性指示而非归一化因子）；RV 系数（式21，零对角化后的 Frobenius 内积余弦，全局结构相似但尺度不变）；SSIM（式22，滑窗局部亮度/对比/结构三项分解，L=1，O(n²) 累积和实现）。

**5. 统一置换检验**（算法1）：对 ô_T 施加同步行列置换以保留块结构与稀疏模式，检验零假设"E2Tree 标注与集成结构无对应关系"；单次重采样循环服务全部 K 个度量，复杂度 O(R·K·f(n))；含 Phipson–Smyth 修正、置换分位数置信区间（式23–24）与标准化 Z 统计量（式25）。作者强调 value-shuffle 置换会破坏块结构、检验更弱且在 H1 下可能膨胀 Type I 错误。
AI.result:
**模拟一（Type I 误差控制）**：n∈{50,100,200}×K∈{3,5,10} 共 9 配置，各 200 次重复、999 次置换、α=0.05，nLoI/Hellinger/wRMSE/RV/Mantel 拒绝率全部落在二项区间 [0.025, 0.070] 内，无系统膨胀或收缩。

**模拟二（统计功效）**：信号 s∈{0,0.1,…,1.0}、n∈{50,100,200}、K=5、稀疏度 0.3，各 200 次重复。各度量功效基本相当；n=50 时 s=0.4 功效≥0.95（nLoI 0.980 vs. Mantel 0.960），n≥100 时 s=0.3 即≥0.95，s≥0.5 功效统一为 1.0。低信号区（s∈[0.1,0.3]）差异有限——作者据此强调：Mantel 并非功效不足，而是"测错了量"。

**模拟三（稀疏稳健性）**：n∈{100,200}×K∈{5,10,20}×稀疏度∈{0,…,0.8}（K=20 时有效稀疏率约 0.95），在 s=0.6 下 30 个配置功效全部为 1.0，未见稀疏导致的衰减。

**实证（Iris 分类、mtcars 回归、Boston Housing 回归）**：所有度量 p<0.001。Iris（n=105）：nLoI=0.049、Hellinger=0.211、RV=0.960、SSIM=0.582，Z 值 −72.3 至 +110.2；mtcars（n=22）：nLoI=0.144、Hellinger=0.344、RV=0.845；Boston（n=354）：nLoI=0.176、Hellinger=0.373、wRMSE=0.892、RV=0.518、SSIM=0.220。三个数据集均落在理论界 [0,1] 内，说明归一化标定良好；重建保真度依任务结构排序（Iris 最优，Boston 最难），RV 亦呈现同序（0.960/0.845/0.518），表明其在跨数据集的全局结构排序上尤具信息量。

**诊断案例（Scenario A/B）**：当 E2Tree 正确识别三类但节点内取值系统性高估（0.8 vs 1.0）时，Mantel r>0.95 且 p<0.001 仍判"显著关联"，而 nLoI 的 ℓ̄_in 分量可暴露节点内标定偏差；当两相近类被错误合并时，分解同样能区分是节点内异质性而非节点间分离问题所致。
AI.conclusion:
E2Tree 的验证本质是一致性问题而非关联性问题：Mantel 等尺度不变的相关方法只能确认"模式共享"，无法量化数值还原程度，也无法定位失败来源。

本文的核心贡献是 nLoI：作为 λ=−2 Cressie–Read 幂散度族（Neyman χ²）的稳健化版本，它兼具有界性（[0,1]）、对称性、非负性、零当且仅当完美重建，以及唯一的"节点内/节点间"可分解诊断能力——通过 ℓ̄_in 与 ℓ̄_out 的逐对平均即可区分"分区边界不当"与"节点内标定不佳"两类失效模式，这是任何标量关联度量都无法提供的方向性指导。

由于各度量功效相当，度量选择应由分析问题而非统计效率驱动：nLoI + 分解用于诊断与模型改进，Hellinger 作为默认的可移植单一汇总统计（有界、满足度量公理、稀疏稳健），RV 用于仅关心结构模式保留的场景，SSIM 用于块结构（簇边界）保持的评估。统一的同步行列置换框架在单次重采样中为全部五个度量提供有效推断。

作者提出三点后续方向：n→∞、B→∞ 下的渐近理论行为仍未解决；分解量 ℓ̄_in、ℓ̄_out 可作为 E2Tree 自动超参数选择的驱动信号；框架可推广至梯度提升、XGBoost 等其他可解释代理模型，以成为集成学习近似保真度的通用工具。与 MMD 类无分布假设检验（Xu, 2025）及基于随机森林的两样本策略（Hediger et al., 2022）的正式比较亦属自然的后续工作。

title: MiMuon: Mixed Muon Optimizer with Improved Generalization for Large Models
summary: Matrix-structured parameters frequently appear in many artificial intelligence models such as large language models. More recently, an efficient Muon optimizer is designed for matrix parameters of large-scale models, and shows markedly faster convergence than the vector-wise algorithms. Although some works have begun to study convergence properties (i.e., optimization error) of the Muon optimizer, its generalization properties (i.e., generalization error) is still not established. Thus, in this paper, we study generalization error of the Muon optimizer based on algorithmic stability and mathematical induction, and prove that the Muon has a generalization error of $O\big(\frac{1}{Nκ^{T}}\big)$, where $N$ is training sample size, and $T$ denotes iteration number, and $κ>0$ denotes minimum difference between singular values of gradient estimate. To enhance generalization of the Muon, we propose an effective mixed Muon (MiMuon) optimizer by cautiously using orthogonalization of gradient, which is a hybrid of Muon and momentum-based SGD optimizers. Then we prove that our MiMuon optimizer has a lower generalization error of $O\big(\frac{1}{N}\big)$ than $O\big(\frac{1}{Nκ^{T}}\big)$ of Muon optimizer, since $κ$ generally is very small. Meanwhile, we also studied the convergence properties of our MiMuon algorithm, and prove that our MiMuon algorithm has the same convergence rate of $O(\frac{1}{T^{1/4}})$ as the Muon algorithm. Some numerical experimental results on training large models including Qwen3-0.6B and YOLO26m demonstrate efficiency of the MiMuon optimizer.

AI.tldr: 该论文研究了Muon优化器的泛化误差理论，证明其泛化界为O(1/(Nκ^T))，并提出混合优化器MiMuon将泛化误差改善至O(1/N)，同时保持O(1/T^(1/4))的收敛速度，实验验证了在Qwen3-0.6B和YOLO26m等大模型上的有效性。
AI.motivation: Muon优化器在矩阵参数模型上展现出显著的收敛速度优势，但其泛化性能尚未被理论刻画，存在研究空白。
AI.method: 基于算法稳定性(algorithmic stability)和数学归纳法(mathematical induction)分析Muon的泛化误差；通过谨慎使用梯度正交化将Muon与动量SGD混合，提出MiMuon优化器。
AI.result: 证明Muon的泛化误差为O(1/(Nκ^T))，其中κ为梯度估计奇异值最小差值；MiMuon的泛化误差改善为O(1/N)（因κ通常很小）；MiMuon保持与Muon相同的O(1/T^(1/4))收敛速率。
AI.conclusion: MiMuon优化器结合了Muon的梯度正交化技术和SGD的动量机制，在保持O(1/T^(1/4))收敛速度的同时，将泛化误差从O(1/(Nκ^T))降低到O(1/N)。实验验证了MiMuon在Qwen3-0.6B和YOLO26m等大模型训练中的有效性。

title: Optimal Reconstruction from Linear Queries
summary:
We study the problem of reconstructing an unknown point in $\mathbb{R}^d$ from approximate linear queries. This setting arises naturally in applications ranging from low-dimensional remote sensing and signal recovery to high-dimensional data analysis and privacy-sensitive inference. Our main goal is to characterize the optimal reconstruction error as a function of the number of queries $T$, the ambient dimension $d$, and the noise parameter $δ$.
  We first analyze the limit $T \to \infty$ and show that the optimal reconstruction error converges to the explicit value $\sqrt{2d/(d+1)} δ$, which plays a role analogous to the Bayes optimal error in supervised learning. When the dimension is fixed, we show that the excess error above this limit decays doubly exponentially fast as $T \to \infty$, a rate that is significantly faster than those typically encountered in learning curves. When the dimension grows, we show that a number of queries on the order of $\exp(d)$ is necessary and sufficient to achieve vanishing excess error. Finally, we introduce and analyze an improper variant of the reconstruction problem.
  From a technical perspective, our main contribution is a generalization of Jung's theorem (1901). The classical theorem bounds the maximum possible radius of a set of diameter 1 and characterizes extremal bodies. Our generalization provides a robust variant that characterizes near-extremal bodies and is proved via geometric and dynamical arguments exploiting symmetry and Lie group actions.

AI.tldr: 该论文研究高维空间中从近似线性查询重构未知点的问题。当查询数量趋于无穷时,最优误差收敛到√(2d/(d+1))δ这一显式极限;固定维度下误差以双指数速度衰减,而维度增长时需要指数级(约exp(d))查询才能实现误差趋零。核心技术贡献是将1901年的经典Jung定理推广为鲁棒变体。
AI.motivation: 该研究源于多个实际应用场景的需求,包括低维遥感与信号恢复、高维数据分析以及隐私敏感推理。这些场景共同面临的核心挑战是:如何在有限近似线性查询下最优重构高维空间中的未知点,并明确刻画重构误差与资源消耗之间的权衡关系。
AI.method: 采用几何与动力系统方法,利用对称性和李群作用进行分析。具体技术贡献是将Jung定理(1901)从经典的"直径为1的集合最大可能半径"问题推广到"近似极值体的鲁棒特征刻画",建立了估计误差与查询数量之间的精确关系。
AI.result: (1)极限误差:当查询数T→∞时,最优重构误差收敛至√(2d/(d+1))δ;(2)收敛速度:固定维度下超额误差以双指数速度衰减,快于典型学习曲线;(3)维度依赖:维度增长时,需要约exp(d)量级查询才能实现误差趋零;(4)理论工具:建立了Jung定理的鲁棒推广版本。
AI.conclusion: The paper establishes that the optimal reconstruction error converges to √(2d/(d+1))δ as query数量无限增长。当维度固定时,超额误差以双指数速度衰减;当维度增长时,需要约exp(d)数量级的查询才能实现误差趋近于零。该研究将经典的Jung定理(1901)推广为鲁棒变体,建立了近似线性查询下点重构的完整误差分析框架。

title: Agentic Discovery of Cryomicroneedle Formulations
summary: Cryomicroneedles offer a route to minimally invasive intradermal delivery of living cells, but their cryogenic formulations must reconcile cell protection with constraints on toxicity and device fabrication. Here we report an AI-assisted, closed-loop workflow for cryomicroneedle cryoprotectant discovery that combines literature curation, Gaussian-process surrogate modelling, Bayesian optimization, and sequential wet-lab validation. A curated dataset of 198 mesenchymal stem-cell cryopreservation formulations from 42 studies was converted into 21 ingredient features and used to train an uncertainty-aware literature prior. This model captured moderate structure in the literature data but failed prospectively, motivating iterative wet-lab correction. Across ten validation iterations and 106 wet-lab observations, the model progressively adapted to cryomicroneedle-specific outcomes: batch RMSE decreased from 41.21 to 6.86 percentage points, later-stage rank correlations became consistently positive, and the cumulative wet-lab predicted-versus-measured summary reached $R^2 = 0.942$. The best validated formulation achieved 95.15\% post-thaw viability with low DMSO, ectoin, ethylene glycol, and fetal bovine serum. However, high viability alone did not ensure intact cryomicroneedle formation, highlighting the need for future multi-objective optimization. These results demonstrate that agent-assisted computational infrastructure can make data-efficient formulation discovery more accessible to labs with minimal data expertise in-house. Project code is available at https://github.com/baitmeister/ML-for-CryoMN.

AI.tldr: 本文提出并验证了一套「AI 代理辅助的闭环式冷冻微针（cryomicroneedle）冷冻保护剂配方发现工作流」：先用人工策展的 198 个 MSC 冻存配方（42 项研究）训练带不确定性的高斯过程（GP）文献先验模型，再通过随机采样→贝叶斯优化（UCB，κ=0.5）分阶段生成候选，并在 10 轮、106 次湿实验（umbilical cord MSC、PDMS 模具冻针、CMFDA/Hoechst 双染计数）反馈中不断更新模型（文献先验 + 湿实验残差校正 + 加性偏差/乘性不确定度校准）。批次 RMSE 由 41.21 降至 6.86 个百分点，后期 Spearman ρ 稳定为正，106 次累计湿实验的预测-实测 R²=0.942；最佳配方 EXP5110（21.0 mM DMSO、291.1 mM ectoin、1.79 M 乙二醇、5.4% FBS）达 95.15% 复苏存活率。但多数 >70% 存活率的配方无法形成完整的微针贴片，说明单目标优化不足，需转向多目标（存活率+贴片完整性+断裂力+刺入性能）主动学习。整体定位为概念验证：LLM 代理（Claude Opus 4.5 / GPT-5.3-codex）在人工监督下搭建计算基础设施，降低实验室内无 ML 专业团队的门槛，而文献检索/抽取与湿实验仍依赖人工。
AI.motivation: 冷冻微针（cryomicroneedle）把活细胞直接嵌入冻造的微针尖端，兼具微针微创给药与活细胞冻存物流的优势，但其低温配方必须同时满足相互冲突的三类约束：(1) 冷冻保护（复苏存活率）；(2) 毒性与法规约束（希望降低 DMSO）；(3) 器件成形约束（需能形成可脱模、可穿刺、可快速溶解的机械稳定冻结基质）。配方空间是数十种候选成分（DMSO、乙二醇、蔗糖/海藻糖、ectoin、血清、PVP、HES、PEG 等）的非线性强组合交互空间，穷举实验不现实，经验直觉又容易反复回到熟悉的 DMSO 高配方而忽略不确定但有潜力的区域。机器学习/主动学习可在少量湿实验下高效导航该空间，但搭建"文献抽取→数据策展→代理模型→不确定性驱动的实验选择→迭代更新→可解释分析"整条流水线需要大量工程与计算专业能力，大多数湿实验组缺乏该人力与时间。LLM/AI 代理（可调用工具、生成代码、协调多步工作流）在人工监督下有可能把这一门槛显著降低。此外还需注意：冻存文献数据来源异质（不同 MSC 来源、冷却速率、检测终点、报告规范），存在强报告偏置，直接迁移到微针场景会失效，因此必须依赖闭环湿实验校正。
AI.method:
**（1）文献数据策展**：从 75 篇原始文献手工提取 499 个配方及即时复苏存活率 → 人工判定"有效独立数据点"（区分细胞类型、预处理/电穿孔、聚合物分子量差异、相对存活率、商业冻存液等）后剔除不可用条目得 393 → 自由文本配方经规则+代理解析为结构化矩阵：同义词合并（DMSO/Me2SO、ectoin/ectoine、FBS/FCS、HES、PVP 等），基础培养基/缓冲液（DMEM、α-MEM、PBS、HBSS）不作为变量，浓度统一为摩尔（可换算成分）或百分数（血清、蛋白、PEG、聚合物），PEG 按分子量分级；重复配方取平均，相对存活率（>100%）条目剔除，出现少于 3 次的成分删除 → 最终 198 个唯一配方、21 个有效特征（解析层共 34 维特征）。总体存活率均值 63.88%、中位 70%、范围 0–100%；DMSO 出现率 44.9%，含 DMSO 配方均值 71.90% vs 无 DMSO 57.33%；≥80% 的 59 个高性能配方中 71.2% 含 DMSO，说明文献先验会偏向 DMSO。

**（2）代理模型**：标准化输入 + Matérn 核（ν=2.5，含常数振幅与白噪声项）的高斯过程回归，因其适合稀疏数据并可给出均值与不确定性；超参用 10 次重启优化；文献模型五折交叉验证（shuffle、seed=42）。

**（3）两阶段候选生成**：前 5 轮为可行域随机采样后按 GP 预测均值排序（burn-in/广覆盖）；第 5 轮后转为贝叶斯优化，采集函数为校准尺度上的 UCB a_UCB(x)=μ(x)+κ·σ(x)，κ=0.5，用差分进化（maxiter=100、popsize=15、seed=42）在配料特定搜索边界内优化，边界随迭代收紧（如乙二醇≤2.5 M、海藻糖/蔗糖≤1.0 M、ectoin 类≤0.5 M、血清≤90%、透明质酸/甲基纤维素≤2%、DMSO 上限 5% 与 0.5% 两个池），目标函数含稀疏惩罚 0.35、支持域外惩罚 4.0、批内多样性惩罚 5.0（半径 0.05，支持半径=观测最近邻距离加权 90 分位×1.25）。

**（4）下一批推荐器**：每批固定 20 条（8 探索/12 开发默认，开发条数依上一阶段 RMSE/残差/1σ 覆盖率自适应在 4–12 间调整）；开发候选来自 BO 池剔除已测并加化学家族多样性上限；探索候选包含局部排名探针（围绕高分锚点扰动）、盲点探针（历史低估区域，正残差阈值 10/8/5/2/0 个百分点降序）、以及用贪心 k-center 选取的 2 个覆盖探针；并输出 6–12 条规模的推荐子集。

**（5）湿实验**：脐带来源人 MSC 第 7–8 代，DMEM+GlutaMAX 培养至 80% 融合、胰酶消化；SYLGARD 184（1:9）PDMS 负模，10×10 棱锥阵列（pitch 1200 μm、针基 500 μm、针高 1600 μm、每针≈0.133 μL、每贴≈13.3 μL）；700 μL 细胞悬液（≈1×10⁶ cells/mL）注入模具，400g 离心 3 min 排气，吸去针尖外液体后再加 700 μL；4 °C 30 min → −20 °C 2.5 h → −80 °C 2.5 h 梯度冷冻；37 °C 水浴 15 s 内解冻，400g 离心 4 min，PBS 中 1 μM CellTracker Green CMFDA + Hoechst 33342 染色 37 °C/5% CO₂ 45 min；取 18 μL 于 Countess 计数板，ImageJ 计数，存活率 = CMFDA+/Hoechst+，每配方 5 个图像重复取均值。

**（6）模型反馈更新（先验均值校正）**：预测 ŷ = ŷ_literature(x) + r̂_wetlab(x)，第二个 GP 拟合湿实验残差（实测 − 文献预测），方差相加开方；来源特异噪声 α_literature=1.0、α_wetlab=0.02（相当于给湿实验 50 倍局部影响）；仅对湿实验行做 K=min(5, n) 折交叉验证（每折保留全部文献行），用交叉验证残差估计加性偏差 b 与乘性不确定度尺度 s（迭代 10 检查点 b=−6.83 个百分点、s=0.78），应用到所有下游预测与采集评分（不裁剪至 0–100%）。

**（7）评估与可解释性**：采用"冻结检查点 + 前瞻性批次"评估（每阶段模型只对应该阶段自己提出的批次，避免后期模型改写早期证据）；指标含 RMSE、MAE、Spearman ρ、Kendall τ、平均预测标准差、±1σ/±2σ 经验覆盖率、50%/70% 阈值命中率；R² 采用"前瞻性累积"协议（阶段 k 的冻结模型对 0…k 累积湿实验集评估），因小批次下批内 R² 对离群点与响应方差极敏感、可能出现符号翻转，故不作为主终点。解释模块含加权置换重要性、SHAP（KernelExplainer，最多 100 背景/100 解释样本）、支持域感知的经验边际效应与两两交互等高线、采集景观、不确定度仪表板（覆盖率倍数 0.5–2.5）。

**（8）AI 代理基础设施构建**：一次性 prompt（目标：最大化存活率、最小化 DMSO、活性成分≤10、每轮可迭代更新）由 Claude Opus 4.5（Antigravity）生成四阶段模块化仓库骨架（数据解析/GP 训练/约束候选生成/验证更新循环）与文档，作者人工审阅后用 GPT-5.3-codex（Codex）执行并补充评估、可解释性、分阶段 R² 绘图与下一批设计功能。
AI.result:
**模型表现**：文献模型五折 CV RMSE 20.25±1.99、平均 R²=0.247±0.096，全量拟合训练 RMSE 14.55、R²=0.618——说明数据含可恢复结构但保真度中等。然而首个前瞻性湿实验批次（迭代 0，18 个候选）性能崩塌：RMSE 升至 41.21、R²=−2.52、秩相关性很差，归因于文献数据的异质性与报告偏置。

**闭环迭代效果**：10 轮迭代、106 次湿实验观测后，批次 RMSE 由 41.21 → 迭代 1 的 21.67 → 迭代 2 的 14.74 → 迭代 8 的 10.10 → 迭代 9 的 6.86 个百分点；迭代 5–9（BO 阶段）Spearman ρ 分别为 0.79、0.66、0.82、0.86、0.81，后期秩一致性稳定为正（迭代 0–4 随机搜索阶段秩行为不稳定，迭代 4 仍为负相关但 RMSE 已低，因该批响应范围窄）。迭代 9 检查点在 106 次累积湿实验上预测-实测 R²=0.942。

**最优配方**：文献首批最佳 72.93%，迭代 1 提升至 79.09%，迭代 5 找到 EXP5110（21.0 mM DMSO、291.1 mM ectoin、1.79 M 乙二醇、5.4% FBS）达 95.15% 存活率；高性能配方集中在低 DMSO 的 ectoin/乙二醇/FBS 区域。作者明确提示迭代 5 的高值需谨慎解读，可能混合了模型富集与批次级实验波动。

**可解释性变化**：初始模型 SHAP 由 DMSO、FBS 等文献常见/成功成分主导；更新后乙二醇与 ectoin 上升为主要贡献者，同时 DMSO 仍是重要特征。采集景观显示最高效用区仍集中在 ectoin/乙二醇 邻域，不确定度面板指出邻近最具信息量的测试位置；交互等高线（乙二醇/ectoin、乙二醇/DMSO、乙二醇/FBS）提示后续应做局部小网格与边界探针，而非重新全空间扫描。模型最终偏好二~三成分的稀疏配方（与 ≤10 成分限制下的预期不同，原因是小数据下高阶组合支撑差、属外推）。

**关键局限（实验层面）**：验证中多数存活率 >70% 的配方并不能形成完整可用的冷冻微针贴片——高浓度渗透型保护剂/血清/聚合物/渗透调节物降低冰点、增大未冻液相分数、改变冰晶结构与黏度、削弱冻结基质，使针体无法保持刚性连续阵列。即优化目标是"生物学成功"而非"微针配方成功"；模型只以 DMSO 上限和成分数为护栏，未优化机械强度、贴片完整性与刺入效率。

**流程层面**：AI 代理在单次 prompt 内产出可运行基线仓库，三天内经人工修订补齐差分进化 BO、可解释性、先验均值校正等；文献检索/抽取（Semantic Scholar、OpenAlex 等 API 无法保证语料完整、表格/扫描 PDF 解析、易混淆绝对存活率与相对存活率、单位缺失、成分误并、误把基础培养基当活性变量）与湿实验、以及科学写作与"能诚实主张什么"的判断仍必须由人承担。
AI.conclusion: 本研究证明：由 LLM 代理（Claude Opus 4.5、GPT-5.3-codex）在人类监督下搭建的计算基础设施，足以把"人工策展的文献表格"转化为可运行、可迭代、可复现的主动学习优化系统，从而让缺乏内部 ML 专长的实验组也能以数据高效的方式开展配方发现（累计湿实验 R²=0.942，批次 RMSE 41.21→6.86，发现低 DMSO 的高存活率配方 95.15%）。其意义在于"AI 代理不仅是更快地写代码，而是更快地把生物学意图转成可用的计算工作流"，且第一次产出的脚手架已足够作为真实实验campaign的可执行起点。作者同时明确该工作不是科学自主性的证明，也不是最终最优配方的宣称：文献抽取与湿实验仍是人类瓶颈；模型优化的是复苏存活率这一单目标，绝大多数高存活配方无法形成完整微针，提示必须转向多目标主动学习，把存活率、贴片完整性、断裂力与皮肤刺入成功作为耦合目标（完整性可作为硬可行性过滤），并显式加入安全性约束（更严格的乙二醇/DMSO 上限、剂量归一化暴露评估、寻找化学更安全的替代品）。作者提出的可检验假设是：成分多样化可产生协同降浓效应，使整体浓度下降后仍能成型完好的冷冻微针；下一步最直接的做法是在 ectoin/乙二醇/FBS 邻域做受控低 DMSO 的局部小网格加高不确定度边界探针，以验证"表观最优"是否稳健、乙二醇/ectoin/FBS 交互是否为可重复的配方效应而非批次偶然。

title: MSAlign: Aligning Molecule and Mass Spectra Foundation Models for Metabolite Identification
summary: Accurately identifying metabolites i.e. small molecules from mass spectrometry data remains a core challenge in metabolomics, with broad applications in drug discovery, environmental analysis, and clinical research. We address the Molecule Retrieval task, which consists in recovering the chemical structure of a metabolite from its MS/MS spectrum given a set of candidate molecules. While the recent release of benchmark datasets such as MassSpecGym and Spectraverse has considerably accelerated the development of novel machine learning approaches, the complexity of data preprocessing pipelines and the lack of unified implementations make methods and results difficult to reproduce and compare. We make three contributions. First, we propose a unified framework encompassing recent approaches based on representation alignment and contrastive learning. Second, we introduce MSAlign, inspired by multimodal alignment in vision-language models, which learns a shared representation space by aligning two frozen foundation models (DreaMS for mass spectra and ChemBERTa for molecules) through lightweight MLP projections trained with a candidate-based contrastive objective. MSAlign is simple to implement, fast to train and consistently outperforms existing approaches across all benchmarks. Third, we investigate a long-standing evaluation problem: data splitting strategies in molecule retrieval implicitly trade off data leakage against domain shift. We formalize this tension by introducing a quantitative measure of distribution shift, and use it to evaluate splitting strategies in existing benchmarks. All datasets, splits, candidate sets, and a unified implementation of MSAlign and baselines are publicly released to support reproducible research.

AI.tldr: 本文针对质谱（MS/MS）代谢物鉴定中的「分子检索」任务（给定候选分子集合，从谱图中检索正确结构），提出统一框架与轻量级方法 MSAlign：通过 MLP 投影对齐两个冻结的基础模型（质谱端 DreaMS、分子端 MolDeBERTa），用「候选集 InfoNCE」损失训练共享表示空间；再以凸组合的晚期分数融合（4 个对齐分数 + 3 个基于 ppm 质量误差的高斯分数）得到 MSAlign⁻，显著超越 DeepSets/JESTR/Emb-Cos/MIST/MVP/FLARE 等基线，且训练极快（MassSpecGym 上约 0.8 小时/epoch 级）。此外，论文形式化并量化了 MS/MS 基准中「数据泄漏 vs. 分布漂移」的划分权衡，提出归一化 Sliced Wasserstein 距离（Shift 指标）来比较 Random/InChIKey/Formula/Murcko/MCES 等划分，并建议采用 Formula 划分；所有数据、划分、候选集与统一实现均开源发布。
AI.motivation: 代谢物鉴定（metabolite identification）是代谢组学的核心问题，支撑药物发现、环境分析与临床研究。传统谱库匹配覆盖极低（PubChem 约 1.1 亿化合物中覆盖率不足 1%），而 de novo 结构解析仍然极难，因此论文聚焦更可解的 Molecule Retrieval 子问题：给定一张 MS/MS 谱和一组候选分子（如按质量过滤得到的 PubChem 候选），检索出正确结构。作者指出该方向存在两大痛点：(1) 现有工作（MIST、JESTR、MVP、FLARE、Emb-Cos 等）虽都用表示对齐/对比学习，但架构、数据表示、损失函数各不相同，缺乏统一抽象与统一实现，导致预处理管线复杂、结果难以复现与横向比较；(2) 基准数据集的数据划分策略存在长期争议——同一分子在不同实验条件下会有多条谱，随机划分会造成数据泄漏；而更严格的划分（MCES 编辑距离≥10）又会引入巨大分布漂移，现有文献缺少量化这种权衡的原则性方法。此外，多篇论文报告的结果与公开实现存在出入（如 JESTR 官方 issue）。
AI.method: 1）统一框架：将各类方法统一为打分函数 ρ_θ(s,m)=sim(g_θ(s), h_θ(m))，其中 g_θ=(φ_ms∘E_ms)、h_θ=(φ_mol∘E_mol)，E_* 为不可训练预处理（谱分箱/分子指纹等），φ_* 为可训练编码器（MLP/GNN/Transformer）；损失分为指纹回归 L_FP、in-batch InfoNCE L_batch 与候选集 InfoNCE L_cand 三类（Table 1 系统对比 MIST/JESTR/FLARE/Emb-Cos/MSAlign）。2）MSAlign：受视觉-语言对齐与「柏拉图表示假说」启发，冻结 DreaMS（谱，1024 维）与 MolDeBERTa（分子，768 维）作为 E_ms/E_mol，预计算嵌入后仅训练轻量 MLP 适配器（谱塔：线性投影 + 64 维加合物类别/极性嵌入 + 64 维碰撞能 Fourier 编码 + 2 层 MLP；分子塔：3 层 MLP；共享维度 512），以余弦相似度 + 可学习温度（初始 0.07）用候选集 InfoNCE 训练：每个谱从质量窗候选集采样 K 个负例（B=128，K=128）。理论证明 1−R@1 ≤ L_cand/log2，即 L_cand 是 top-1 误差的凸上界代理；同时证明 in-batch InfoNCE 可被「仅依赖质量的平凡打分器」压到接近 0 而准确率为 0，说明 batch 内负例过弱、与准确率解耦（给出损失上界 L ≤ log(1+(B−1)p_ε)）。3）MSAlign⁻（晚期分数融合）：以验证集 R@1 为目标，用 log-softmax 凹代理在单纯形上求凸权重 α（Algorithm B.2，带融合温度网格选择），融合 7 个分数：DreaMS/MolDeBERTa、DreaMS/Fingerprint、Binned/MolDeBERTa、Binned/Fingerprint 四个对齐分数，以及基于 ppm 质量误差高斯核（σ ∈ {0.01, 0.1, 1} ppm）的三个质量分数；另给出 MSAlign⁻(+Filter) 变体（需 oracle 公式）。4）分布漂移分析：把样本编码为拼接的 L2 归一化谱/分子嵌入，计算训练/测试集间的 Sliced Wasserstein 距离（POT，100 次随机投影），并以随机划分下的期望 SWD 归一化得到 Shift 指标，在 4 种编码器组合上评估 6 种划分策略。5）可解释性：改造 LIME——以“真实分子分数减去最佳干扰项分数”的 margin 为解释目标，用伯努利(0.1)峰丢弃扰动 + 1024 样本线性回归给出峰重要度。实验设置：MassSpecGym（231,104 对/28,936 唯一分子）与 SpectraVerse（488,797 对/44,307 唯一分子）；PubChem 10 ppm 质量窗候选，检索时 K=256；Formula 划分（3 个随机种子）+ 官方 MCES 划分（两个变体）。基线：DeepSets(Fourier)、MIST、JESTR、MVP、FLARE、Emb-Cos。
AI.result: 1）检索性能（R@1，%）：SpectraVerse：MSAlign 41.3±2.7、MSAlign⁻ 58.2±3.4、(+Filter) 44.4±2.6，而最强公式无关基线 Emb-Cos 26.6、MIST 22.7、FLARE 14.2；MassSpecGym (Formula)：MSAlign 47.5±3.4、MSAlign⁻ 58.2±3.4、(+Filter) 60.4±3.7，基线最好者 Emb-Cos 42.7、FLARE 32.8；MassSpecGym (MCES)：MSAlign 19.0、MSAlign⁻ 30.8、(+Filter) 37.7，均超过所有基线。分数融合相对 MSAlign 分别提升 R@1 约 9.5/10.7/11.8 个百分点，公式过滤再提升 3.1/2.2/6.9 个百分点，最强竞争者差距达 17.8/17.7/9.3 个百分点。2）消融：损失对比中候选集 InfoNCE（47.5）远超 in-batch InfoNCE（19.5）、mol→ms 回归（22.8）、ms→mol 回归（16.7）；编码器对比中 DreaMS 替换分箱谱 +4.3%、MolDeBERTa 替换 Morgan 指纹 +10.2%、两者同时替换 +13.2%，但不同分子基础模型（ChemBERTa-13M、IBM MoLFormer、GROVER、MHG-GED）差异有限（42.2–47.0%）；融合近似可加（对齐模型 +6.9、质量分数 +3.8、两者 +10.7），Jaccard 重叠分析显示不同打分器错误互补（MSAlign 与质量打分器重叠 <5%）。3）效率：MSAlign 训练 0.75–1.31 小时（单张 V100，MassSpecGym 每 epoch <2 分钟），远快于 JESTR(7–13h)、MVP(15–25h)、FLARE(2–4h)；MSAlign⁻ 为 3.0–5.7 小时（含 4 个对齐模型，可并行）。4）划分分析：Shift 指标显示 MCES 与 Murcko 划分漂移最大（9–18），Formula/InChIKey 居中（4–5），作者推荐 Formula 划分；t-SNE 显示 MCES 测试集在联合潜空间中形成远离训练集的独立簇。5）可解释性：约半数样本 ≤10 个峰即可解释 MSAlign 输出的 95%，全部样本 ≤60 个峰；失败案例集中于候选与目标高度相似（Tanimoto 距离最小）的情况，最难 10% 子集 R@1 仅约 22–25%。
AI.conclusion: MSAlign 证明「对齐冻结的基础模型 + 候选集 InfoNCE」这一极简配方即可在分子检索任务上取得 SOTA：单模型 MSAlign 在三个设置上均超过所有公式无关基线，晚期分数融合再带来约 10 个百分点的 R@1 增益，且计算代价可忽略、训练极快；候选集 InfoNCE 在理论与实证上均优于 in-batch InfoNCE 与回归损失。作者同时指出 MS/MS 基准的数据划分本质上是在「避免数据泄漏」与「控制分布漂移」之间权衡，InChIKey/Formula 划分给出更平衡的折中，MCES/Murcko 更适合评估分布外泛化能力并呼吁专门的领域自适应方法。所有数据集、划分、候选集与统一实现（MSAlign 与全部基线）公开发布以支持可复现研究。局限与展望：方法依赖底层基础模型质量，不适用于 de novo 结构解析；未来方向包括在共享空间上附加（预训练）解码器以实现 de novo 鉴定、以及引入前向模型做伪标注增强。另需注意摘要中写作 ChemBERTa，而正文默认分子编码器为 MolDeBERTa（ChemBERTa-13M 仅作为表 4 中的对比选项），另 MassSpecGym 官方 MCES 划分仅有两个变体、结果方差较大。

title: AR1-ZO: Topology-Aware Rank-1 Zeroth-Order Queries for High-Rank LoRA Fine-Tuning
summary: Zeroth-order (ZO) optimization enables large-language-model fine-tuning without storing backpropagation activations, while LoRA supplies compact trainable adapters. Combining them creates a rank paradox: increasing LoRA rank improves adapter capacity, but standard two-point ZO either perturbs a rank-dependent number of coordinates or, under atomwise updates, can make the finite-difference signal unobservable. This paper shows that the bottleneck is a measurement-topology problem rather than a need for an external subspace. LoRA already decomposes into matched rank-$1$ atoms, each a complete factor-coordinate block of dimension $d_\text{out}+d_\text{in}$. Querying one atom per step keeps the stored adapter rank $r$ while removing $r$ from the single-query perturbation dimension. The naive atomwise query is still miscalibrated: if it inherits canonical LoRA scaling $α/r$, the active finite-difference signal shrinks as $1/r$ and the active finite-difference signal-to-noise ratio (FD-SNR) as $1/r^2$, producing directional collapse under a fixed residual evaluation-noise floor. AR1-ZO pairs alternating rank-$1$ atom queries with topology-aware scaling $γ=αr$, restoring rank-invariant active signal without auxiliary bases, activation hooks, curvature estimates, or extra forward queries. Theory proves atom minimality, rank-independent active query dimension, directional collapse and restoration, and the remaining rank dependence as an amortized coverage cost. Experiments on OPT and Qwen3 models validate the signal mechanism and show that AR1-ZO makes high-rank LoRA effective among matched-budget ZO methods under the standard two-forward-pass query budget.

AI.tldr: 本文解决零阶（ZO）优化与LoRA结合时的"秩悖论"问题：当LoRA秩增加时适配器容量提升，但标准两点ZO要么扰动秩依赖数量的坐标，要么在原子级更新下使有限差分信号不可观测。作者提出AR1-ZO方法，通过交替秩-1原子查询与拓扑感知缩放γ=αr，在无需辅助基、激活钩子、曲率估计或额外前向查询的情况下恢复秩不变的有效信号。
AI.motivation: 零阶优化允许在不需要存储反向传播激活的情况下微调大语言模型，LoRA提供紧凑的可训练适配器。然而将两者结合时存在"秩悖论"：增加LoRA秩虽然提升适配器容量，但标准两点ZO方法要么扰动秩依赖数量的坐标，要么在原子级更新下导致有限差分信号无法观测。这是一个测量-拓扑问题，而非需要外部子空间的问题。
AI.method: 核心洞察：LoRA本身已分解为匹配的秩-1原子，每个原子是维度为d_out+d_in的完整因子坐标块。AR1-ZO方法：1) 每步仅查询一个原子，保持存储适配器秩r；2) 从单次查询扰动维度中移除r；3) 采用拓扑感知缩放γ=αr替代标准LoRA缩放α/r，恢复秩不变的有效有限差分信噪比（FD-SNR）。
AI.result: 理论上证明了：原子极小性、秩无关的有效查询维度、方向坍缩及其恢复、以及剩余的秩依赖作为摊销覆盖成本。实验在OPT和Qwen3模型上验证了信号机制，表明在标准两次前向传播查询预算下，AR1-ZO使高秩LoRA在匹配预算的ZO方法中变得有效。
AI.conclusion: AR1-ZO通过交替秩-1原子查询与拓扑感知缩放，成功化解了ZO优化与高秩LoRA结合的秩悖论，在保持秩不变信号的同时无需任何辅助机制，为在激活存储受限场景下高效微调大语言模型提供了新思路。

title: B-cos GNNs: Faithful Explanations through Dynamic Linearity
summary: We introduce B-cos GNNs, an inherently explainable class of graph neural networks whose predictions decompose exactly into per-node, per-feature contributions via a single input-dependent linear map. B-cos GNNs use linear (sum-based) aggregation and replace non-linear message and update functions with B-cos transforms. This induces meaningful, task-specific weight-input alignment that is directly accessible through the model's dynamic linearity. Instance-level explanations follow from a single forward and backward pass, requiring no auxiliary explainer, modified learning objective, or perturbation procedure. Instantiated as a GIN, our approach trades small losses in predictive accuracy for state-of-the-art explainability across diverse synthetic and real-world benchmarks, producing explanations orders of magnitude faster than post-hoc baselines.

AI.tldr: 本文提出 B-cos GNNs：一类"天然可解释"的图神经网络。它将 GIN/GINE 中的 ReLU-MLP 替换为 B-cos 变换（一种无偏置、带权重-输入对齐的线性型变换），在和式（sum）聚合下保留"动态线性"（dynamic linearity）性质，使预测可被精确分解为逐节点、逐特征的贡献。这些贡献即解释，只需一次前向+反向传播即可获得，无需任何辅助解释器、修改损失函数或扰动采样。在三个带真值 rationale 的基准上，B-cos GIN 的 Jaccard@k 分别为 0.84（BA-2Motif）、0.96（Di-Halo-Benzene）、0.91（MNIST-75sp），全面优于 GNNExplainer、Integrated Gradients 与 GSAT；单图解释耗时约 0.6–1.2 ms，比后验方法快 2–3 个数量级。代价是部分真实数据集上 F1 下降数个百分点（由单一超参 B 控制权衡）。
AI.motivation: 图神经网络的高风险部署、科学发现以及检测捷径学习都要求"忠实性"（faithfulness）解释，即解释须反映模型实际执行的计算，而非用代理模型近似。现有三类方法各有缺陷：通用后验归因（Saliency、IG、GradCAM、LRP）依赖梯度而非真实贡献；图专用后验方法（GNNExplainer、PGExplainer、GraphMask、SubgraphX）把训练好的 GNN 当黑盒、需优化辅助模型、需精调正则且脆弱；天然可解释 GNN（IB-subgraph、DIR、GSAT）则引入辅助子图生成器、rationale 模块或改造的信息瓶颈目标，架构复杂。作者的核心观察是：B-cos 变换（Böhle et al., 2022）满足"动态线性"——输出可精确写为输入依赖的线性映射 W̃_θ(x)x，其元素直接量化权重与输入的对齐度；将该性质与 GNN 的和式聚合结合，即可得到精确的逐节点贡献分解，而无需任何额外解释机制。此外，作者强调需按 RINGS 框架筛选基准（结构性必要性 P1、特征-拓扑互依 P2），避免"平凡可解"的图XAI基准导致虚假结论。
AI.method: 1) 核心性质：B-cos 激活 f_(W,B)(x)_j = ||ŵ_j||·||x||·|c(x,ŵ_j)|^B·sgn(c(x,ŵ_j))，动态权重 W̃_θ(x)=diag(|c(x,Ŵ)|^B−1)Ŵ；深层复合的动态权重为各层动态矩阵之积，贡献图 M(x)=W(x)⊙x，输出等于各行和，因此 M_{i,j} 精确量化第 i 个输入特征对第 j 个输出的贡献；B>1 时天然非线性，激活上界为 ||x||。2) 理论保证（附录B）：引理1证明和式加权聚合保持动态线性；命题1用归纳法证明若所有 Φ^(k)、Ψ^(k) 满足动态线性且聚合仅为 A 加权和，则各层节点嵌入 x_i^(k)=W_i^(k)(X,A)x；读出层同理（Readout-Then-Agg：ŷ=Σ_i Θ(x_i^(L))）。3) 架构实例：B-cos GIN 用 B-cos MLP 替换 GIN 的 MLP（Φ 为恒等，ε 固定为 0），Readout-Then-Agg + sum pooling；B-cos GINE 将边特征作为邻居嵌入的加性偏置（x_j+e_ji），保持线性。4) 解释生成：图级预测的贡献图 M*=W*(X,A)⊙x ∈ R^{c×np0}，取预测类对应行按节点聚合 s_i，再取 top-k 或累计贡献达目标比例的最小子集作为解释子图。5) 实验设置：数据集为 PATTERN、NCI1、OGB-MolHIV（仅预测）+ 自建/重制的 BA-2Motif、Di-Halo-Benzene（9 类卤素-取代位置异构体，8 节点真值）、MNIST-75sp；基线为 vanilla GIN/GINE + GNNExplainer / IG，以及重训的 GSAT-GIN/GINE；指标为 F1/Acc、Jaccard@k（k=|G*|）、节点级 AUROC、ms/graph；5 个随机种子，AMD EPYC 7662 + A100；超参 B∈{1,1.5,2,2.5,3} 做敏感性分析，最优为 B=2。
AI.result: 预测性能（B=2，5 种子均值±标准差）：BA-2Motif 上 GIN/B-cos/GSAT 均 F1=1.00；Di-Halo 上 GIN=1.00、B-cos=1.00、GSAT=0.97；MNIST-75sp 上 B-cos F1=0.93 显著高于 GIN(0.86) 与 GSAT(0.89)；PATTERN 上 B-cos 与 GIN 持平（0.69）但远超 GSAT（0.43）；NCI1 上 GIN 0.80 > GSAT 0.78 > B-cos 0.72；MolHIV 上 GIN 0.79 > GSAT 0.75 > B-cos 0.73——即真实数据集上仅有数个百分点的精度代价。解释质量：B-cos 的 Jaccard@k 在三个数据集上全部最优（0.84/0.96/0.91），AUROC 0.96/0.99/0.99；基线中 IG 最强（Di-Halo 0.83、MNIST 0.63），GNNExplainer 较弱（0.57/0.36/0.34），GSAT（0.57/0.48/0.61）。速度：B-cos 单图解释 0.62/1.17/0.94 ms，GNNExplainer 291/316/327 ms，IG 61/71/78 ms，GSAT 0.44 ms——比优化型后验方法快约 2–3 个数量级，仅略慢于 GSAT 的单次前向。敏感性：B=1 时模型等价线性（表达力不足），增至 B=2 性能提升（NCI1 F1 0.581→0.703，MolHIV AUROC 0.752→0.791），B=3 时合成基准解释 AUC 接近 100% 但真实数据略降。定性分析显示 B-cos 贡献图能精确定位 House/Cycle 拓扑、苯环与卤素原子并区分邻/间/对位异构体，以及 MNIST 数字笔画超像素。
AI.conclusion: B-cos 变换可"几乎零改动"地迁移到图上：与和式聚合组合后仍保持权重-输入对齐，从而单次反向传播即可得到忠实的逐节点、逐特征贡献图。该构造刻意最小化（无辅助解释器、无改造目标函数），仅引入单一超参 B 在对齐强度与预测灵活性间取舍。实验证明 B-cos GIN/GINE 在与真值 motif 的结构对齐上同时超越后验解释器（GNNExplainer、IG）与天然可解释基线（GSAT），解释生成速度快 2–3 个数量级，代价仅是图分类数据集上的适度精度损失。局限与未来工作：仅支持和式聚合（mean/max/注意力聚合待扩展）、仅适合分类任务（回归待探索）、边特征作为加性偏置因而无逐边贡献、需补充分布内忠实性评测、需在缺乏真值 rationale 的大规模真实图上验证、以及 GSAT 的原文精度在统一骨干下未能复现（本文使用重训模型比较）。

title: Going PLACES: Participatory Localized Red Teaming for Text-to-Image Safety in the Global South
comment: Published at ACM Conference on FAccT 2026
summary: Despite the global deployment of text-to-image (T2I) models, their safety frameworks are largely calibrated to a Western-centric default, creating significant vulnerabilities for the rest of the world. To embrace cultural pluralism and bring historically under-represented perspectives in T2I safety, we conduct localised community-centered red teaming studies in the Global South. Our two-fold approach prioritizes localization and participation, by focusing on secondary urban centers in these regions, and conducting community engagement and training workshops to contextualize local norms. As a result, we present PLACES, a dataset comprising over 26,000 examples of T2I model failures collected in partnership with universities in Ghana, Nigeria, and two regions of India (Karnataka and Punjab). Analysis of prompts collected reveals a wide-ranging diversity in socio-cultural and linguistic attributes, when compared to existing geography-agnostic crowdsourced red-teaming data. We observe unique adversarial patterns enabled by local cultural and linguistic nuances, and distinct clusters within region around specific themes, such as religion in India. Moreover, we uncover structural contextual gaps in existing safety frameworks by identifying novel harms showing normative dissonance (e.g., violating religious norms, ignoring local customs, and ominous symbolism). This work argues that expanding T2I safety requires moving beyond mere scale to incorporate deeply localised, participatory methodologies for data collection and contextualization. Content warning: This paper includes examples containing potentially harmful or offensive content.

AI.tldr: 本研究通过在全球南方的加纳、尼日利亚和印度（卡纳塔克邦和旁遮普邦）开展本地化社区中心红队研究，提出了一个超越西方中心主义的T2I安全框架。研究成果PLACES数据集包含超过26,000个模型失败案例，揭示了现有安全框架中的文化盲点，强调需要采用深度本地化和参与式的方法来改进AI安全研究。
AI.motivation: 现有T2I安全框架主要基于西方中心视角校准，导致对世界其他地区存在显著安全漏洞，忽视了文化多元主义和历史上代表性不足的群体视角。
AI.method: 1）二次城市中心聚焦：选择全球南方的二级城市而非主流中心；2）社区参与式研究：开展社区参与和培训研讨会以情境化当地规范；3）合作数据收集：与加纳、尼日利亚、印度（卡纳塔克邦和旁遮普邦）的大学合作建立数据集。
AI.result: 1）建立了PLACES数据集，包含超过26,000个T2I模型失败案例；2）提示语在社会文化和语言属性上呈现高度多样性；3）发现由当地文化和语言细微差异驱动的新型对抗模式；4）识别出围绕特定主题（如印度宗教）的区域独特聚类；5）发现现有安全框架的结构性情境差距，包括规范性失谐（如违反宗教规范、忽视当地习俗、不祥符号学）的新型危害。
AI.conclusion:
研究主张扩展T2I安全需要超越单纯的数据规模，采用深度本地化的参与式方法进行数据收集和情境化。

title: Latent Laplace Diffusion for Irregular Multivariate Time Series
comment: Camera-ready Spotlight paper at ICML 2026. 27 pages, 5 figures. Code: https://github.com/pixelhero98/LLapDiffusion
summary: Irregular multivariate time series impose a trade-off for long-horizon forecasting: discrete methods can distort temporal structure via re-gridding, while continuous-time models often require sequential solvers prone to drift. To bridge this gap, we present Latent Laplace Diffusion (LLapDiff), a generative framework that models the target as a low-dimensional latent trajectory, enabling horizon-wide generation without step-by-step integration over physical time. We guide the reverse process utilizing a stable modal parameterization motivated by stochastic port-Hamiltonian dynamics, and parameterize its mean evolution in the Laplace domain via learnable complex-conjugate poles, enabling direct evaluation over irregular timestamps. We also link continuous dynamics to irregular observations through renewal-averaging analysis, which maps sampling gaps to effective event-domain poles and motivates a gap-aware history summarizer. Extensive experiments show that LLapDiff improves over baselines in long-horizon forecasting, and its continuous-time generative nature supports missing-value imputation by querying the same model at historical timestamps. Code is available at https://github.com/pixelhero98/LLapDiffusion.

AI.tldr: LLapDiff proposes a novel latent diffusion framework that overcomes the discrete-continuous trade-off in irregular multivariate time series forecasting by modeling latent trajectories with Laplace-domain parameterization, eliminating the need for step-by-step temporal integration.
AI.motivation: Existing methods for irregular multivariate time series forecasting face a fundamental trade-off: discrete-time methods distort temporal structure through re-gridding, while continuous-time models require sequential solvers that are prone to drift during long-horizon forecasting.
AI.method: LLapDiff models the target as a low-dimensional latent trajectory in a generative framework. The reverse diffusion process is guided by a stable modal parameterization derived from stochastic port-Hamiltonian dynamics, with mean evolution parameterized in the Laplace domain via learnable complex-conjugate poles. A renewal-averaging analysis links continuous dynamics to irregular observations by mapping sampling gaps to effective event-domain poles, motivating a gap-aware history summarizer.
AI.result: Experiments demonstrate that LLapDiff improves over baseline methods in long-horizon forecasting tasks. Additionally, its continuous-time generative nature naturally supports missing-value imputation by querying the same model at historical timestamps.
AI.conclusion: LLapDiff advances irregular multivariate time series forecasting by combining latent trajectory modeling with Laplace-domain parameterization, enabling horizon-wide generation without sequential integration. The gap-aware history summarizer and missing-value imputation capability further extend its practical utility.

title: LionMuon: Alternating Spectral and Sign Descent for Efficient Training
summary: In large-scale optimization, the cheapness and effectiveness of update steps are the most crucial factors for a successful optimizer. Sign-based optimizers like Lion or Signum produce cheap per-step updates, whereas Muon's spectral matrix-sign update gives a much stronger direction at a substantially higher per-step cost. In this work, we propose LionMuon, which retains the effectiveness of Muon steps while considerably cutting the averaged iteration cost, similar to sign-based methods. It alternates between Lion's and Muon's updates on a fixed period P, sharing a single dual-EMA momentum buffer between them. The optimizer state memory therefore matches Lion and is exactly half of AdamW's. A simpler single-EMA variant, SignMuon, by itself already outperforms pure Muon. At P = 2, LionMuon Pareto-dominates Muon, Lion, Signum, and AdamW on every dataset and architecture we tested at 124M model size, reaching lower validation loss at lower compute, and the same advantage persists at 355M and 720M scale. On the theory side, we prove sharp complexity bounds under heavy-tailed noise which are governed by period-averaged smoothness and noise that interpolate between Muon's and Lion's constants. These bounds predict the compute-optimal period and the conditions under which LionMuon outruns Muon and Lion. Code: https://github.com/brain-lab-research/lion-muon

AI.tldr: LionMuon combines Lion and Muon optimizers via periodic alternation (period P), achieving Muon's effectiveness at sign-based methods' computational cost. Matches Lion's memory footprint (half AdamW). At P=2, Pareto-dominates all baselines. Theoretically supported by heavy-tailed noise complexity bounds.
AI.motivation: Sign-based optimizers (Lion, Signum) have cheap per-step updates but weaker directions; Muon has stronger directions but higher per-step cost. A method combining Muon's effectiveness with sign-based methods' computational efficiency is desired.
AI.method: LionMuon alternates Lion and Muon updates with period P, sharing a single dual-EMA momentum buffer. SignMuon (simpler single-EMA variant) also outperforms pure Muon. State memory matches Lion (half of AdamW).
AI.result: At P=2, LionMuon achieves lower validation loss at lower compute than all competitors across 124M-720M model scales. Sharp complexity bounds established under heavy-tailed noise, governed by period-averaged smoothness and noise constants.
AI.conclusion: LionMuon achieves optimal performance-memory trade-off with P=2, Pareto-dominating Muon, Lion, Signum, and AdamW across all tested scales. Theoretically grounded with sharp complexity bounds under heavy-tailed noise.

title: FLUXtrapolation: A benchmark on extrapolating ecosystem fluxes
summary: We introduce FLUXtrapolation, a benchmark for extrapolating ecosystem fluxes under progressively harder distribution shifts. Ecosystem fluxes are central to understanding the carbon, water, and energy cycles, yet they can only be measured directly at sparsely located measurement towers. Producing global flux estimates therefore requires training models on observed sites using globally available covariates and predicting in unobserved regions, that is, upscaling. Flux upscaling is a challenging domain generalization problem that is affected by a shift in covariate distribution across climates, ecosystem types, and environmental conditions, as well as by conditional shift: important drivers remain unobserved at global scale. We provide a quantitative analysis of both these shifts in $P_X$ and $P_{Y\mid X}$. FLUXtrapolation is designed based on domain expertise on flux upscaling: it defines temporal, spatial, and temperature-based extrapolation scenarios and evaluates performance across held-out domains, temporal aggregations, and tail errors. In a pilot study, we find that baselines perform similarly under median hourly RMSE, but separate under the proposed tail-focused and multi-scale evaluation. FLUXtrapolation therefore poses a realistic and thus relevant challenge for machine learning methods under distribution shift; at the same time, progress on this benchmark would directly support the scientific goal of improving flux upscaling.

AI.tldr: FLUXtrapolation是一个用于评估生态系统通量外推能力的基准测试，针对跨气候、生态系统类型和环境条件的协变量分布偏移（P_X）以及重要驱动因素在全球尺度上不可观测的条件偏移（P_{Y|X}）进行建模。该基准定义了时间、空间和温度三种外推场景，并从尾部误差和多尺度角度评估模型性能。
AI.motivation: 生态系统通量（碳、水、能量的通量）对于理解全球碳循环、水循环和能量循环至关重要，但只能在稀疏分布的观测塔进行直接测量。通量上upscaling是一个具有挑战性的领域泛化问题，模型需要在观测站点训练而在未观测区域预测，面临协变量分布偏移和条件偏移的双重挑战。
AI.method: FLUXtrapolation基于通量上upscaling领域专业知识设计，定义了三种外推场景：时间外推、空间外推和基于温度的外推。评估维度包括：跨留出域的性能、跨时间聚合的性能以及尾部误差。采用Hourly RMSE中位数和尾部误差的多尺度评估指标。
AI.result: 初步实验表明，基线模型在中位数小时RMSE指标上表现相近，但在本文提出的尾部聚焦评估和多尺度评估下表现出明显差异。
AI.conclusion: FLUXtrapolation为机器学习在分布偏移下的方法提供了一个现实且相关的挑战，其进展可直接支持改善通量上upscaling这一科学目标。该基准测试揭示了现有方法在处理尾部预测和跨域泛化方面的不足。

title: General Lower Bounds for Differentially Private Federated Learning with Arbitrary Public-Transcript Interactions
summary: We prove a general lower bound for differentially private federated learning protocols with arbitrary public-transcript interactions. The protocol may use any number of adaptive rounds, and each client's local samples may be reused across rounds. For parameter estimation under squared \(\ell_2\) loss, we establish a federated van Trees lower bound for every estimator satisfying a total clientwise sample-level zero-concentrated differential privacy (zCDP) constraint. The main technical ingredient is a privacy-information contraction inequality for complete public transcripts. We illustrate the bound through applications to mean estimation, linear regression, and nonparametric regression.

AI.tldr: The paper proves a general lower bound (federated van Trees bound) on the statistical accuracy achievable in differentially private federated learning protocols, covering arbitrary adaptive multi-round settings with sample reuse, with applications to mean estimation, linear regression, and nonparametric regression.
AI.motivation: Understanding the fundamental statistical limits of differentially private federated learning is critical, especially given the widespread adoption of FL systems and the tension between privacy guarantees and statistical utility. Prior work on lower bounds in this setting has been limited, leaving a gap in our understanding of optimal trade-offs.
AI.method: The proof hinges on a privacy-information contraction inequality for complete public transcripts. This inequality characterizes how zCDP constraints translate into information-theoretic restrictions on what estimators can learn, yielding a federated analogue of the classical van Trees bound.
AI.result: The result establishes a federated van Trees lower bound applicable to any estimator under total clientwise sample-level zCDP constraints. This bound is further specialized and illustrated through concrete applications in mean estimation, linear regression, and nonparametric regression, demonstrating its broad applicability.
AI.conclusion: The work provides a unified lower bound framework for private federated learning, demonstrating fundamental limits that apply broadly across estimation tasks and protocol designs.

title: ST-TGExplainer: Disentangling Stability and Transition Patterns for Temporal GNN Interpretability
summary: Temporal graph neural networks (TGNNs) have gained significant traction for solving real-world temporal graph tasks. However, their interpretability remains limited, as most TGNNs fail to identify which historical interactions most influence a given prediction. Despite promising progress on interpretable TGNNs, existing methods predominantly focus on previously seen historical interactions, which we term stability patterns, while overlooking newly emerging first-time interactions, which we term transition patterns. Both types of patterns are essential for faithful temporal explanations. To address this limitation, we propose ST-TGExplainer, a self-explainable TGNN that disentangles Stability and Transition patterns in temporal graphs for a more faithful Temporal GNN Explainer. Guided by a disentangled information bottleneck objective, ST-TGExplainer learns a compact explanatory subgraph that remains predictive of the event label while explicitly suppressing label-conditioned redundancy between stability and transition patterns. Extensive experiments demonstrate that ST-TGExplainer achieves strong predictive performance and yields more faithful explanations. Code is available at https://github.com/hjchen-hdu/ST-TGExplainer.

AI.tldr: ST-TGExplainer 将时序图神经网络的解释证据显式拆分为「稳定性模式」(已重复出现的历史交互)与「迁移模式」(首次出现的新交互)，并用解耦信息瓶颈目标 (预测 + 压缩 + 条件去冗余) 联合优化，在 6 个时序图数据集上同时取得较强的链接预测 (AP/MRR) 与更高的解释忠实度 (ACC-AUC/AUFSC)。
AI.motivation: 时序图神经网络 (TGNN) 虽在分子生物、电商、社交网络等真实场景中表现优异，但其可解释性有限——难以指出哪些历史交互真正驱动了某次预测。现有可解释 TGNN 工作主要聚焦于「已见过的历史交互」(本文称为 stability 模式)，而忽略了新出现的首次交互 (本文称为 transition 模式)。作者对 7 种主流 TGNN 在 seen / unseen 交互上的 MRR 对比分析显示：现有模型在重复性历史交互上表现良好，但难以捕捉新出现的交互，存在明显的泛化鸿沟；由此归纳出两大挑战——Challenge-1 稳定性偏置 (证据归因被高频重复交互主导，掩盖稀有迁移信号) 与 Challenge-2 迁移建模不足 (对首次交互的建模能力弱，导致对新事件/行为突变的解释不可靠)。此外，后验式解释器 (T-GNNExplainer、TempME、CoDy) 计算开销大且对骨干模型与输入时序图扰动敏感，而自解释方法 (如 TGIB) 则普遍将时序证据同质化处理，缺乏模式解耦。
AI.method: 方法包含三个模块。(1) 信息交互选择器 (Informative Interaction Selector)：围绕查询事件 (u,v,t) 采样一跳 ego-temporal 子图 (保留最近 L 条历史交互)，编码器拼接节点/边/时间差特征 (cos 时间编码 + 相对时间编码) 后经 l 层 MLP-Mixer 输出边表示 H^t；以因子化多元伯努利分布建模解释子图 p_θ(G_E|G^t)，用 Gumbel-Softmax/Concrete 松弛实现可微采样。(2) 稳定性–迁移解耦器：以交互频率 h_F 为可微软代理 (频率越高越稳定)，经 MLP 得 p_f，通过掩码实现加性分解 G_S = p_f ⊙ G_E、G_T = (1-p_f) ⊙ G_E，各自共享编码器并均值池化得 h_S、h_T；引入条件 JS 散度对抗正则 (判别器区分同标签下的条件联合样本与重采样负样本) 以抑制标签条件冗余。(3) 可解释模式特征融合器：拼接 h_S、h_T 经 MLP 融合，再由两层 MLP + sigmoid 预测链接。训练目标为 min_{θ,φ} max_ψ L_Pre + β·L_Com + γ·L_Dis。理论上给出三个互信息项的可处理变分上界/替身：预测项用变分分类器 (等价于 BCE)，压缩项借助马尔可夫链与数据处理不等式归结为 KL(p_θ(G_E|G^t)||q(G_E))，q 取固定纳入率 r=0.7 的伯努利先验 (课程式从 0.9 衰减)，解耦项以 JS 散度密度比估计替代不可解的条件 KL。复杂度为每条交互 O(L²d + Ld²)。
AI.result: 链接预测：AP 在 6 个数据集中的 5 个上取得最佳 (如 UCI 97.28、Enron 94.87、USLegis 94.47、Can.Parl. 90.25)，Wikipedia 上与最佳基线持平 (99.21)；在低重复率数据集 (USLegis、Can.Parl.) 上增益尤为明显。MRR 在 Reddit (88.96) 与 UCI (81.68) 最佳，UCI 上大幅领先；模型兼具较小参数量与中等训练耗时。解释性能：ACC-AUC 在全部 6 个数据集上均超过或持平最佳基线 (Wikipedia 92.47、UCI 96.04、Enron 90.15、USLegis 97.49、Can.Parl. 96.88)，低重复率数据集上最高提升约 9%；AUFSC 评估显示所选边同时具备必要性与充分性 (UCI 正确样本 AUFSC^- 达 0.86，优于 CoDy 的 0.65)。消融实验表明去掉 L_Dis 主要损害预测精度、去掉 L_Com 主要损害解释质量，完整模型较 G_E-only 在 Wikipedia/UCI 上分别提升 3.89 与 7.98 ACC-AUC 点；分支表现与数据集重复率一致 (Wikipedia 重复率 88.41% 时 G_S-only 更优，UCI 重复率 66.06% 时 G_T-only 更强)。超参敏感性与 PCA 可视化表明 β≈0.1、γ∈{0.1,0.2} 时最优，h_S 与 h_T 在隐空间分离明显而 h_E 纠缠。
AI.conclusion: ST-TGExplainer 是一种自解释 TGNN，通过解耦信息瓶颈将时序解释证据分解为稳定性与迁移两类互补模式，在多数据集上兼顾强链接预测性能与更忠实的时序解释，验证了「分解本身而非单纯增加瓶颈」带来的增益。局限在于：仅使用一跳历史，可能遗漏高阶时序依赖，多跳扩展会提升保真度但增加计算成本并损害可扩展性；基于频率的解耦器依赖启发式 (频率估计与软分配)，跨数据集与时序状态的鲁棒性有待检验。作者将高效多跳设计与更原则化、可扩展的频率估计留作未来工作。

title: Smooth Piecewise Cutting for Neural Operator to Handle Discontinuities and Sharp Transitions
summary: Neural operators have achieved strong performance in learning solution operators of partial differential equations (PDEs), but their inherently continuous representations struggle to capture discontinuities and sharp transitions. Existing approaches typically approximate such features within continuous function spaces, often requiring increased model capacity and high-resolution data. In this work, we propose Cut-DeepONet, a two-stage training framework that explicitly models discontinuities while reducing learning complexity. Our approach reformulates the problem via a lifting strategy, partitioning the domain into smooth subregions while representing discontinuities as boundaries in a higher-dimensional space. This separation aligns the operator learning task with the inductive bias of neural networks and avoids directly approximating discontinuities. An additional network predicts input-dependent discontinuity locations for unseen inputs, which are then used to guide the neural operator in generating smooth components within each region. Experiments on benchmark PDEs show that Cut-DeepONet outperforms state-of-the-art methods, even when trained on low-resolution datasets. The method excels on problems with discontinuities and sharp transitions, while using fewer trainable parameters. Our results highlight the benefits of changing the representation of operator learning rather than increasing model complexity.

AI.tldr: Cut-DeepONet：一个两阶段训练框架，通过"提升（lifting）"把含间断的PDE解映射到高维空间中的多个光滑子区域，并用额外网络（Cutting Net）预测随输入变化的不连续位置，从而在算子学习中"真正生成"间断而非用连续函数逼近间断。在线性对流、无粘 Burgers 方程、稀疏简约模型三个基准上，L1 与间断区误差全面超越 DeepONet、flexDeepONet、HyperDeepONet、FNO，且参数量更少、可在低分辨率数据上训练。
AI.motivation: 神经算子（DeepONet、FNO 等）的输出被限制在连续函数空间（如 Sobolev 空间、RKHS），具有固有的平滑偏差（smoothing bias），只能把间断近似为"陡峭但仍光滑"的过渡，因此无法真正表示间断。Gottlieb 等指出 Fourier 展开逼近间断会出现 Gibbs 现象，需要更多高频基函数；而在算子学习中，间断的位置与形状随输入变化，所需基函数规模更大（Lanthaler 等）。已有改进（NOMAD、flexDeepONet、HyperDeepONet 的非线性重构）仍停留在连续表示内；而 XPINN/cPINN、φ-DeepONet 等高维嵌入方法假设间断位置已知且固定，不适用于非线性 PDE 中数量与位置未知的间断。已有的激波捕获数值格式（ENO/WENO）精度高但计算代价大。作者因此主张：与其增大模型容量或换架构，不如改变算子学习所依赖的表示形式。
AI.method:
核心思想：将含间断解视为若干光滑片段的组合，通过提升（lifting）把域划分为光滑子区域，使间断只出现在高维空间中的子区域边界处，从而让神经算子只需学习光滑函数（符合其归纳偏置），间断由"边界"天然重建。

具体做法：
